e554f6e88cae9289464f56049413570f404532c5.title: Deepfakes and Synthetic Media: Generation, Detection, and Governance
e554f6e88cae9289464f56049413570f404532c5.summary: Deepfakes, synthetic audiovisual content produced by deep generative models, have escalated into a critical threat across civilian and military domains, enabling identity fraud, disinformation campaigns, and evidence fabrication. In high-stakes environments, ranging from journalism and finance to healthcare and legal contexts, the consequences extend to severe misinformation, market manipulation, identity fraud, and the erosion of institutional trust. This entry explores how modern visual intelligence and computer vision techniques are used to detect deepfakes. It outlines key deepfake generation models, such as GANs, autoencoders, neural rendering, and diffusion systems, while also explaining how adversarial methods enhance realism and challenge existing detectors. The overview highlights visual artifacts, digital patterns, and physiological cues commonly leveraged in detection and reviews major CNN, transformer, and frequency-based approaches. It also summarizes evaluation practices and the difficulty of achieving strong generalization. Finally, it identifies emerging directions, including modern intelligence techniques for civilian and military content verification. This survey covers generation architectures (GANs, latent diffusion, neural rendering, video synthesis), the spatial, temporal, frequency-domain, and physiological artifacts they produce, and the detector families that exploit them. We examine evaluation benchmarks and protocols, highlighting cross-generator generalization as the field's central open challenge. Beyond detection, we discuss cryptographic provenance standards, watermarking, and regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, DSA, GDPR). We conclude that effective deepfake governance requires defense-in-depth integrating forensic detection, verifiable provenance, and institutional accountability.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理深度伪造的生成、检测与治理：涵盖GAN、自编码器、神经渲染、扩散模型及对抗增强，分析视觉、数字、生理与时空频域伪影，评述CNN、Transformer和频域检测方法，强调跨生成器泛化是核心开放挑战，并提出检测、溯源水印与法规问责相结合的纵深防御。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造已在新闻、金融、医疗、法律及高安全场景中引发身份欺诈、虚假信息、市场操纵和机构信任侵蚀，亟需系统理解其生成机制、检测手段与治理框架。
AI.method: 综述生成架构（GAN、潜在扩散、神经渲染、视频合成）及其产生的空间、时间、频域和生理伪影；归纳利用这些伪影的检测器家族；讨论对抗方法、评估基准与协议、跨生成器泛化、加密溯源、水印及监管框架（EU AI Act、DSA、GDPR）。
AI.result: 总结了现有检测方法与评估实践，指出跨生成器泛化仍是领域中心难题；单靠检测不足，需结合可验证溯源与制度问责。
AI.conclusion: 有效深度伪造治理需要纵深防御，整合取证检测、可验证来源与机构问责，并关注民用与高安全场景下的内容验证需求。

0747a4c3de0f0d2e89803ff76b73a1ceecbdfb72.title: SPARC: SuperPixel-Aware Region Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Dense Prediction
0747a4c3de0f0d2e89803ff76b73a1ceecbdfb72.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to the IEEE ICASSP 2027 Conference
0747a4c3de0f0d2e89803ff76b73a1ceecbdfb72.summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become an effective approach for learning visual representations without manual annotations. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has been widely used for visual representation learning. However, existing contrastive SSL methods have focused primarily on image-level or pixel-level representation learning, while region-level representation learning remains less explored. We propose SPARC, a region-level contrastive learning framework that leverages superpixels to establish explicit correspondence between augmented image views. SPARC introduces a region contrastive branch that performs superpixel-based feature pooling and optimizes a region-level contrastive objective jointly with a global image-level objective. Under identical settings, SPARC consistently outperforms previous methods such as MoCo-v2 and DenseCL, achieving improvements of up to +9.79 mIoU for semantic segmentation and +4.88 AP for object detection. Ablation studies further demonstrate that region-level objectives produce the strongest performance. Thus, region-level contrastive learning is an effective approach for improving self-supervised visual pretraining for dense prediction tasks. Code repository can be accessed at https://github.com/xRIPEIx/SPARC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPARC，一种基于超像素的区域级对比学习框架，通过显式建立增强视图间的超像素对应关系，联合优化区域级与图像级对比目标，在语义分割和目标检测等密集预测任务上显著优于 MoCo-v2 和 DenseCL。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习已成为无需人工标注学习视觉表征的有效途径，其中对比学习被广泛使用。然而现有对比式自监督方法主要聚焦于图像级或像素级表征学习，区域级表征学习探索不足，而区域级信息对密集预测任务尤为重要。
AI.method: SPARC 利用超像素（superpixels）在增强图像视图之间建立显式对应关系。具体而言，框架引入一个区域对比分支，执行基于超像素的特征池化（feature pooling），并将区域级对比目标与全局图像级目标联合优化。
AI.result: 在相同设置下，SPARC 持续优于 MoCo-v2、DenseCL 等先前方法：语义分割最高提升 +9.79 mIoU，目标检测最高提升 +4.88 AP。消融实验进一步表明，区域级目标产生最强的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 区域级对比学习是改进自监督视觉预训练、服务于密集预测任务的有效途径。代码已开源（https://github.com/xRIPEIx/SPARC）。

8cfc0e76e7153de5ab521ad74e1b25d1ef11e700.title: You've Seen Enough: Quality-Constrained Image Coding for Machines
8cfc0e76e7153de5ab521ad74e1b25d1ef11e700.summary: Visual data is increasingly consumed by machine-vision systems rather than by human observers. Image Coding for Machines (ICM) compresses images assuming the main observer is a computer vision application and that the human observer needs to inspect or validate the decisions. Inspired by just-noticeable distortion, which sets the quality to the just-acceptable level for human observers, we aim to cap the human-observed quality at a desired level, with the goal of using the remaining coding capacity to improve the machine performance. We recast joint compression-segmentation training as a constrained optimization problem in which the codec must meet a predefined acceptable target visual quality while a task term consumes the remaining coding capacity. We solve this by designing a penalty function to guide the quality to the desired target. We propose two penalty functions, an absolute function and a bilinear function, the latter applying a steeper slope once the target visual quality is exceeded. Experimental results show that, under the quality constraint, the proposed method achieves a BD-rate of $-22.82\%$ over an unconstrained joint rate--distortion--task optimization and $-29.81\%$ over a simple rate--distortion baseline, showcasing bitrate reduction with the same task performance. This is achieved while the codec also meets the target visual quality with a reasonable error and without adding any complexity overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向机器视觉主导的图像编码（ICM），提出一种受“恰可察觉失真”启发的受约束联合压缩-分割训练方法：将人眼可观察质量限制在预设可接受水平，把剩余码率用于提升机器任务性能。方法通过绝对函数与双线性函数两种惩罚项引导质量达到目标；在质量约束下取得相对无约束联合率-失真-任务优化 -22.82%、相对简单率-失真基线 -29.81% 的 BD-rate，且任务性能不变、无明显额外复杂度。
AI.motivation: 视觉数据越来越多由机器视觉系统消费而非人类观察者。ICM 假设主要观察者是计算机视觉应用，但人类仍需检查或验证决策，因此需要在保证人类可接受视觉质量的前提下，尽可能把编码能力用于提升机器任务性能。
AI.method: 将联合压缩-分割训练重新建模为约束优化问题：码率需满足预设可接受的目标视觉质量，同时任务项利用剩余编码容量。为此设计惩罚函数引导质量逼近目标，并提出两种形式：绝对函数，以及当目标视觉质量被超过后采用更陡斜率的双线性函数。
AI.result: 实验表明，在质量约束下，所提方法相对无约束的联合率-失真-任务优化取得 -22.82% 的 BD-rate，相对简单率-失真基线取得 -29.81% 的 BD-rate，即在相同任务性能下降低码率；同时编解码器能以合理误差达到目标视觉质量，且未增加复杂度开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过受约束优化与惩罚函数设计，可在满足人类可接受视觉质量的同时，将剩余码率用于提升机器视觉任务性能，实现码率节省、任务性能保持与复杂度可控的 ICM 方案。

1418787a6639de5e34dd0436a1e02d4f81f62b0c.title: Ultra-fast Neural Inference for Stochastic Gaussian Splatting Denoising
1418787a6639de5e34dd0436a1e02d4f81f62b0c.summary: Stochastic rendering eliminates the sorting and alpha blending process in Gaussian splatting, at the cost of introducing spatial noise. Formulating temporal denoising over the pixel stream shared by view-consistent stochastic splatting renderers, we propose a temporal neural denoiser validated on stochastic 2D Gaussian Splatting rendering, combining dual-path exponential moving average accumulation, per-pixel learned trust prediction for history validation, a fixed anisotropic spatial filter and a variance-gated composition with stabilization. The denoiser suppresses the noise, achieving temporally stable, visually compelling outputs during free camera navigation, all while retaining the sort-free, blend-free rasterization performance. The combined pipeline retains a PSNR gap to sorted alpha-blending renderers, but the denoiser's overhead stays below the time saved by removing sorting and blending.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向随机高斯泼溅渲染的时序神经降噪器，在随机2D高斯泼溅上验证，可在保留无排序、无alpha混合光栅化性能的同时，抑制噪声并获得时序稳定、视觉可观的自由视角导航结果；虽与排序alpha混合渲染器仍有PSNR差距，但降噪开销低于省去排序与混合所节省的时间。
AI.motivation: 随机渲染可消除高斯泼溅中的排序与alpha混合过程，但会引入空间噪声。核心动机是在不放弃无排序、无混合光栅化性能优势的前提下，利用视图一致随机泼溅渲染器共享的像素流进行时序降噪，以恢复时序稳定且视觉可用的输出。
AI.method: 将时序降噪建模在像素流上，提出时序神经降噪器，并在随机2D高斯泼溅渲染上验证。方法组合包括：双路径指数移动平均累积、用于历史验证的逐像素学习信任预测、固定各向异性空间滤波器，以及带稳定化的方差门控合成。
AI.result: 降噪器能够抑制随机渲染噪声，在自由相机导航中实现时序稳定、视觉可观的输出，同时保留无排序、无混合光栅化性能。该组合管线与排序alpha混合渲染器之间仍存在PSNR差距；但降噪器引入的额外开销低于移除排序与混合所节省的时间。
AI.conclusion: 随机渲染结合时序神经降噪是一种可行方案：以较低计算开销获得无排序、无混合光栅化的性能收益，并显著改善时序稳定性与视觉质量；局限在于相比传统排序alpha混合渲染器仍有PSNR差距。

e3f8b9d8feb4b254beee23d01e11534b1ab3d540.title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
e3f8b9d8feb4b254beee23d01e11534b1ab3d540.summary: Interaction understanding in 3D scenes requires a joint description of movable parts, their motion, and the regions through which they can be operated. We present Segment-Snap, which connects these outputs through the physical relationship between parts and handles. Learned predictors identify broad part surfaces and small handles. A geometric decoder uses planar and upright priors to constrain motion, then selects hinge lines using predicted handle locations, without training a motion regressor. Conversely, a joint part-and-handle predictor supplies additional handle candidates, whose motion classes are refined using containing parts. Each information transfer is applied once, without iterative feedback. On Articulate3D validation, handle guidance raises motion-gated AP from 13.74% to 40.98% at fixed masks and axes. Additional handle candidates raise handle AP from 24.63% to 29.65%; part-based class correction adds 0.98 points, and full context reaches 30.99%. Repeated training, learned-decoder controls and paired visualizations establish the benefits and limitations of combining geometric and semantic evidence for interaction understanding.

AI.tldr: Segment-Snap 通过“部件—把手”之间的物理关系，将可动部件分割、运动轴/铰链线预测与可操作区域检测联合起来，在 Articulate3D 上显著提升运动门控 AP 与把手 AP。
AI.motivation: 3D 场景中的交互理解需要同时描述可动部件、其运动方式以及可被操作的区域。现有流程往往将这些输出割裂处理，缺少对部件表面与把手之间物理关系的显式建模。论文希望利用几何先验与语义线索的互补性，提高交互理解的整体一致性。
AI.method: 提出 Segment-Snap：1）学习型预测器分别识别大范围部件表面和小尺寸把手；2）几何解码器利用平面先验与竖直/直立先验约束运动，并基于预测的把手位置选择铰链线，从而无需训练运动回归器；3）联合部件—把手预测器提供额外把手候选，并利用其所属部件修正把手的运动类别；4）各部分信息传递仅执行一次，不进行迭代反馈。
AI.result: 在 Articulate3D 验证集上：固定掩码与轴时，把手引导将 motion-gated AP 从 13.74% 提升至 40.98%；额外把手候选将 handle AP 从 24.63% 提升至 29.65%；基于部件的类别修正再增加 0.98 个百分点；完整上下文达到 30.99%。重复训练、学习型解码器对照实验与成对可视化验证了方法的收益与局限。
AI.conclusion: Segment-Snap 表明，将几何证据（平面/直立先验、铰链选择）与语义证据（部件—把手关系、运动类别修正）结合，可有效提升 3D 交互理解；其单次信息传递设计简洁，但论文也通过对照与可视化指出了该组合策略的局限。

0b32bd12d6fb69f552989d45b951681e6fed1015.title: AgriGen: Large-Scale Scene Generation Framework for Photorealistic Agricultural Robotics Simulation
0b32bd12d6fb69f552989d45b951681e6fed1015.comment: Presented at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Agricultural Robotics (https://agrifoodroboticsworkshop.wordpress.com/icra2026/)
0b32bd12d6fb69f552989d45b951681e6fed1015.summary: Agricultural robotics is advancing rapidly, yet progress remains constrained by limited field access, lack of control over field conditions, geographic variability, and seasonal crop cycles. These factors make it difficult and costly to acquire diverse agricultural datasets, resulting in limited evaluation and reduced system robustness. While other robotics domains have scaled learning and evaluation through high-fidelity simulation, agricultural robotics still lacks comparably capable tools. In this paper, we present a ROS-integrated framework, built on Isaac Sim, for large-scale procedural generation of agricultural environments. The framework supports photorealistic rendering, physics simulation, and domain randomization at scales relevant to robotics research, with built-in support for row crops, orchards, and vineyards and straightforward extensibility to additional crop categories. Project Page: https://baj31415.github.io/agrigen/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于 Isaac Sim 的 ROS 集成框架，用于大规模程序化生成农业环境，支持逼真渲染、物理仿真与域随机化。
AI.motivation: 农业机器人研究受限于实地获取难度，包括田间访问受限、无法控制田间条件、地理差异以及季节性作物周期，导致难以低成本获取多样化农业数据集，进而造成评估不充分、系统鲁棒性不足。其他机器人领域已通过高保真仿真实现规模化学习与评估，而农业机器人仍缺乏同等能力的工具。
AI.method: 构建一个基于 Isaac Sim、与 ROS 集成的仿真框架，对农业环境进行大规模程序化生成；支持逼真渲染、物理仿真和域随机化，并内置对行播作物、果园和葡萄园的支持，且可便捷扩展到其他作物类型。
AI.result: 框架能够以与机器人研究相关的规模生成农业环境，具备逼真渲染、物理仿真与域随机化能力，并原生覆盖行播作物、果园与葡萄园三类场景（项目主页：https://baj31415.github.io/agrigen/）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为农业机器人提供了可规模化、可扩展的高保真仿真工具，有望缓解农业数据获取难的问题，提升学习与评估的可扩展性及系统鲁棒性。

c65438642ccd00b1e73bf91081f44f6082c90c9a.title: Towards Adaptive Interaction Strategies for Human Companion Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning
c65438642ccd00b1e73bf91081f44f6082c90c9a.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems
c65438642ccd00b1e73bf91081f44f6082c90c9a.summary: In the field of Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), achieving flexibility in human-accompanying within real-world environments holds great potential for various applications but also poses significant challenges. Traditional methods typically restrict robots to fixed positions relative to humans, such as tracking from behind, in front, or side-by-side, which limits robot adaptability in dynamic workspaces. This study introduces a novel human-companioning strategy that uses Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to enable mobile robots to dynamically adjust their tracking positions according to varying conditions. An interaction space is defined to capture the relationship between the human and the robot while considering the environment, which serves as the basis for state spaces in DRL to assist the robot in adapting to environmental changes. A human-robot companion controller is developed by integrating Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with Control Barrier Functions (CBF), ensuring that the robot accurately follows the target's movement in both position and orientation while avoiding obstacles and enhancing social acceptance and safety. The proposed approach is evaluated in real-world scenarios, both indoors and outdoors, and compared with other studies. The results show that the proposed method improves the success rate and tracking accuracy by at least 24% and 47%, respectively, while enhancing human comfort. Experiments demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly accompany a person walking at speeds of up to 1.7 m/s, dynamically adjusting its strategy without being confined to a fixed position. Additionally, the robot respects the human's intimate space to ensure safety, comfort, and effective obstacle avoidance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的人机伴随策略，使移动机器人可在真实室内外环境中动态调整跟随位置，并结合MPPI与CBF实现安全、舒适、高精度的伴随控制。
AI.motivation: 传统人机伴随方法通常将机器人限制在人类后方、前方或侧方等固定相对位置，难以适应动态工作空间，限制了机器人在真实环境中的灵活性与适应性。
AI.method: 定义人-机器人-环境交互空间，并将其作为DRL状态空间基础；利用DRL学习动态跟踪位置策略；构建人机伴随控制器，将模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制与控制障碍函数（CBF）结合，在位置和朝向跟踪的同时实现避障，并考虑社会接受度与安全性。
AI.result: 在真实室内外场景中评估并与其他研究比较，所提方法将成功率与跟踪精度分别至少提升24%和47%，并提高人类舒适度；机器人可伴随以最高1.7 m/s速度行走的人，动态调整策略而不局限于固定位置，同时尊重人类亲密空间，兼顾安全、舒适与有效避障。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了基于DRL与MPPI-CBF的人机伴随策略在真实环境中的有效性和灵活性，表明机器人能够摆脱固定跟随模式，实现更安全、舒适且高精度的人类伴随。

677dacfdcfc6c56a2d454eac02ef6388a28f50f2.title: "As a Language Model...": Chat Template Switches LLM Self-Referential Voice and Activation Steering Reproduces It
677dacfdcfc6c56a2d454eac02ef6388a28f50f2.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning and KONVENS 2026 First Workshop on Evaluating LLMs for Specialized Domains (Eval4SD)
677dacfdcfc6c56a2d454eac02ef6388a28f50f2.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to add disclaimers like "I'm just an AI" when asked about something related to themselves. The self-reports from such responses are used in debates about AI safety or self-knowledge of the models, yet what drives them is not well understood. Are the models telling us about themselves or rather how they are deployed? In this work, we show that the chat template works like a switch - when present, it turns this disclaimer voice up and experiential voice like "I feel" down, across 8 popular open-source instruct models up to 9B parameters in size. And conversely when the chat template is not present, it turns the disclaimer voice down and experiential voice up. Inside the activations of 3 models, we find a direction that steers this behavior. Removing the direction in the model's activation space turns disclaimer voice down and adding it turns it up, while a random direction of the same size has little effect. We find that instruct models without chat template, when we add the disclaimer direction to them, disclaim like the template was there. Since the chat template controls the disclaimer voice of LLMs, then researchers studying self-reports or introspection of models might have a confound they need to control for. Our results show that there is a direction they can use to steer this voice. More broadly, our work shows that what models say about themselves is not a fact about them. What they say doesn't come only from weights, but it is partially set by the chat template, and because of that a model's self-description shouldn't be treated literally.

AI.tldr: 聊天模板像开关一样控制大模型自我表述中的“免责声明语气”与“体验性语气”；模型激活空间存在可操控该行为的单一方向，说明模型关于自身的表述并非其内在事实，而部分由部署方式决定。
AI.motivation: 大模型在被问及自身时倾向加上“我只是AI”等免责声明，这类自我报告常被用于AI安全或模型自我知识争论，但其驱动机制尚不明确：模型是在陈述自身，还是在反映部署方式？作者希望厘清聊天模板与模型自我表述之间的关系，并提示自我报告/内省研究可能存在混淆变量。
AI.method: 在8个流行的开源指令模型（规模至多9B参数）上比较有无聊天模板时的输出；测量“免责声明语气”和“体验性语气”（如“我感觉”）的变化。在3个模型的激活中寻找可操控该行为的方向；通过移除/添加该方向进行因果干预，并设置同尺寸随机方向作为对照；还将免责声明方向添加到无聊天模板的指令模型中观察效果。
AI.result: 聊天模板存在时，免责声明语气增强、体验性语气减弱；无聊天模板时则相反。在3个模型的激活中发现一个方向：移除该方向会降低免责声明语气，添加则增强，而同尺寸随机方向影响很小。向无聊天模板的指令模型添加免责声明方向后，其表现如同模板存在一样产生免责声明。
AI.conclusion: 聊天模板控制着大模型的免责声明语气，因此研究模型自我报告或内省的学者需要控制这一混淆因素。该激活方向可用于操控此语气。更广泛地说，模型关于自身的表述不是关于模型本身的事实；其内容不仅来自权重，还部分由聊天模板设定，因此不应将模型的自我描述按字面理解。

b4a6dfcffecd96dca8a75721c49dda0ba98abf50.title: Do Synthetic Personas Predict Real Audience Response? A Sim-to-Real Study Where a No-Persona Baseline Beats Persona-Based Copy Simulation
b4a6dfcffecd96dca8a75721c49dda0ba98abf50.summary: Marketers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as "synthetic personas" to predict how an audience will react to a piece of copy before it ships, encouraged by evidence that profile-conditioned LLMs mimic human samples. But is that prediction actually valid against real behaviour - and does the persona machinery help? We present a sim-to-real validity study using the Upworthy Research Archive - thousands of headline A/B tests on shared real traffic, with measured click-through - as held-out ground truth. We compare a ten-persona panel, grounded in the real audience's demographics, against a no-persona zero-shot baseline that simply asks the model how likely a typical reader is to click. Two findings stand out. First, ground-truth reliability is the binding constraint: most A/B tests have no statistically distinguishable winner, so validity can only be measured on the reliable subset (n = 399). Second, and counter to the persona-simulation premise, persona conditioning degrades predictive validity: the no-persona baseline ranks variants markedly better (Kendall τ = 0.361, a medium effect; top-1 accuracy 49.2%) than the persona panel (τ = 0.084; top-1 34.6%), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Asking the model directly taps an accurate population-level prior; forcing it to role-play specific personas injects bias and noise. The result replicates across three independent Upworthy splits, holds in direction on a different-domain news dataset, and is robust to seed, prompt phrasing, and model choice - across three Gemini tiers and a different model family (OpenAI gpt-4.1, significant paired gap). The takeaway: for predicting aggregate engagement, a plain LLM ranker beats persona simulation - synthetic personas are not merely a weak predictor, they are worse than not using them. All numbers regenerate from a public, artifact-first replication package.

AI.tldr: 本文利用 Upworthy 研究档案（数千组共享真实流量的标题 A/B 测试）作为留出真值，开展「仿真到现实」效度研究，发现无角色设定的零样本 LLM 基线在预测点击率时显著优于十人合成角色（persona）面板；即对聚合互动量的预测，直接询问模型优于让模型进行角色扮演。
AI.motivation: 营销者日益将大语言模型（LLM）当作「合成角色」来预测受众对文案的反应，其依据是「经受众画像条件化的 LLM 能模拟人类样本」这一证据。但作者质疑：这种预测对真实行为是否真的有效？角色扮演机制是否真的有帮助？因此需要针对合成角色预测与真实行为之间的一致性进行效度检验。
AI.method: 采用「仿真到现实」效度研究范式，以 Upworthy 研究档案为留出真值（含真实流量的标题 A/B 测试与实测点击率）。对比两个条件：①基于真实受众人口统计信息构建的十人角色面板；②无角色的零样本基线（直接询问模型一般读者点击的可能性）。评估指标为排序一致性（Kendall τ）与 top-1 准确率。并做稳健性与复现检验：三个独立 Upworthy 数据划分、另一领域新闻数据集、随机种子、提示措辞、模型选择（三个 Gemini 档位及 OpenAI gpt-4.1）。
AI.result: ①真值可靠性是核心约束：多数 A/B 测试没有统计上可区分的优胜者，故效度只能在可靠子集上度量（n=399）。②与角色模拟前提相反，角色条件化会降低预测效度：无角色基线排序更好（Kendall τ=0.361，中等效应；top-1 准确率 49.2%），明显优于角色面板（τ=0.084；top-1 34.6%），且置信区间不重叠。③该结果在三个独立划分上可复现，在另一领域新闻数据集上方向一致，并对种子、提示措辞与模型选择（三档 Gemini 及 gpt-4.1，配对差距显著）均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 对于预测聚合互动量，普通的 LLM 排序器优于角色模拟；合成角色不仅是弱预测器，甚至比不使用角色更差。直接询问模型可获取准确的人群级先验，而强制其扮演特定角色会引入偏差与噪声。所有数值均可通过公开的、以工件为先的复现包重新生成。

24a4faef6baa186b1c7a2c345469cbbb817e2f43.title: ImIR: Image-Instruction Tuning for All-in-One Image Restoration
24a4faef6baa186b1c7a2c345469cbbb817e2f43.summary: Degradations vary widely across images, so a practical restoration system has to handle many degradation types with one model. A recent and effective recipe adapts a large pretrained image-editing model to restoration using a small low-rank adapter with a text prompt. We replace that prompt with an instruction derived from the degraded image itself. The image reaches the editor through two paths: its structure comes from the model's VAE, and its semantic instruction comes from a lightweight token mapper that shifts the degraded image's vision-language embedding toward the embedding a clean image would produce. Because the instruction is a continuous vector, scaling it yields a family of valid restorations for tasks whose target is not unique, such as low-light enhancement. We adapt one Qwen-Image-Edit model to six tasks with a single adapter trained in about three hours on one GPU. The image instruction outperforms text conditioning under a matched comparison, and it supports task agnostic restoration without a degradation label, which the text variant does not.

AI.tldr: 提出用退化图像自身生成连续“图像指令”替代文本提示，通过轻量 token mapper 将退化图像的视觉-语言嵌入映射到干净图像嵌入，并将该指令注入 Qwen-Image-Edit 的低秩适配器，实现单模型多任务图像复原。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中图像退化类型多样，实用复原系统需用单一模型处理多种退化。现有有效方案将大型预训练图像编辑模型通过小型低秩适配器和文本提示适配到复原任务，但文本提示依赖人工指定或退化标签，难以覆盖复杂、未知退化，也不支持目标不唯一的任务。
AI.method: 以退化图像自身生成指令替代文本提示。图像经两条路径进入编辑器：结构信息由模型 VAE 提供；语义指令由轻量 token mapper 产生，将退化图像的视觉-语言嵌入向干净图像应产生的嵌入偏移。由于指令是连续向量，对其缩放可得到一族有效复原结果，适用于低光照增强等目标不唯一的任务。方法将 Qwen-Image-Edit 通过单个适配器适配到六种任务。
AI.result: 在单张 GPU 上约 3 小时训练单个适配器，即可用一个 Qwen-Image-Edit 模型处理六种复原任务。在匹配比较下，图像指令优于文本条件；且无需退化标签即可实现任务无关复原，而文本变体无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 以退化图像导出的连续图像指令可有效替代文本提示，提升多退化复原性能，并支持任务无关、无标签的实用复原，同时通过指令缩放为不唯一目标提供可控的多样化输出。

0e3ab03bcdc7574c2e74a289e23f4299181d7d1d.title: PartLLM: A Unified Multimodal Foundation for 3D Part Segmentation
0e3ab03bcdc7574c2e74a289e23f4299181d7d1d.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (ACM Transactions on Graphics). Project Page: https://czvvd.github.io/PartLLMPage/
0e3ab03bcdc7574c2e74a289e23f4299181d7d1d.summary: Part segmentation is a fundamental problem in computer graphics and 3D vision. Recent works have expanded 3D part segmentation beyond fixed taxonomies, but existing approaches typically only address a specific setting, such as text-guided part segmentation or point-based interaction. In this work, we argue that these settings can be unified as an intent-conditioned generative problem, where different prompts specify the desired part decomposition. To this end, we introduce PartLLM, a unified multimodal model that formulates 3D part segmentation as autoregressive semantic decomposition. Conditioned on an input shape and a user prompt, PartLLM autoregressively generates semantic part hypotheses as queries for mask prediction and feeds them to a decomposition-aware decoder that jointly predicts coherent part masks. This unified design supports text-guided part segmentation, interactive segmentation, and full-shape semantic decomposition with controllable granularity within a single model. Extensive experiments across these task settings show that PartLLM consistently outperforms task-specific baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unifying 3D part segmentation under an intent-conditioned generative formulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 PartLLM，将 3D 部件分割统一建模为“意图条件生成”问题，通过自回归语义分解与分解感知解码器，在单一模型中支持文本引导、交互式及全形状可控粒度分割，并优于任务专用基线。
AI.motivation: 3D 部件分割是计算机图形学与 3D 视觉的基础问题。现有工作虽已突破固定分类体系，但通常只针对单一设定，例如文本引导分割或基于点的交互，缺乏统一框架。作者认为这些设定可统一为意图条件生成问题：不同提示对应不同的部件分解需求。
AI.method: 提出统一多模态模型 PartLLM，将 3D 部件分割形式化为自回归语义分解。模型以输入形状和用户提示为条件，自回归生成语义部件假设，并将其作为查询送入分解感知解码器，联合预测连贯的部件掩码。该设计在单一模型中支持文本引导分割、交互式分割以及可控粒度的全形状语义分解。
AI.result: 在上述多种任务设定下进行大量实验，PartLLM 一致优于任务专用基线，验证了在意图条件生成框架下统一 3D 部件分割的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PartLLM 表明，将 3D 部件分割统一为意图条件生成问题具有可行性与优越性，可用一个模型覆盖多种分割交互范式，并实现可控粒度的语义分解。

9633ec925ed9496d3e7c073f32c1b8a50adb949c.title: Cosserat Modeling of Trimmed Helicoid Soft Arms with a Separated-Section Constitutive Law
9633ec925ed9496d3e7c073f32c1b8a50adb949c.summary: Cosserat rod models for soft robots usually construct sectional stiffness by summing material properties over a common cross-section. This assumption becomes inaccurate for trimmed helicoid arms, where load-bearing helix domains are separated and connected only through sparse fused crossings. This paper formulates a separated-section constitutive law that evaluates each helix domain in its local frame and pulls its constitutive response back to the backbone, yielding an effective backbone stiffness. Sparse-fusion mechanics captures the additional compliance caused by relative motion between neighboring domains and determines channel-wise reduction profiles $η_c(s/L)$ for bending, torsion, and extension. The resulting effective sectional stiffness is strongly anisotropic: bending and extension are reduced by about one order of magnitude, whereas torsion remains close to the effective backbone stiffness. The resulting sectional law is embedded in a geometrically exact dynamic Cosserat model with GVS discretization and routed-tendon actuation. Across 103 measured configurations, the three datasets give pooled normalized position errors of \SI{7.7}{\percent}, \SI{6.7}{\percent}, and \SI{7.8}{\percent}, while each full-arm solve requires approximately \SI{0.3}{s} on one CPU core (Intel Xeon, Cascade Lake, \SI{2.8}{GHz}), enabling rapid model-based planning, state and load estimation, and morphology--control co-design for architected soft robots.

AI.tldr: 提出面向裁剪螺旋软体臂的“分域截面本构+稀疏融合力学”建模方法，得到强各向异性有效刚度，并嵌入几何精确动态Cosserat模型，实现高精度且快速的全臂求解。
AI.motivation: 传统Cosserat杆模型通常在同一截面上叠加材料属性来构造截面刚度。对于裁剪螺旋臂，承载螺旋域彼此分离，仅通过稀疏融合交叉点连接，该假设不再准确，需要刻画域间相对运动带来的额外柔度。
AI.method: 1）构建分离截面本构律：在各螺旋域局部坐标系中评估本构响应，并将其拉回主干，得到有效主干刚度。2）引入稀疏融合力学：捕捉相邻域相对运动导致的附加柔度，确定弯曲、扭转、拉伸的通道缩减剖面 η_c(s/L)。3）将所得截面律嵌入几何精确动态Cosserat模型，采用GVS离散与绳驱 actuation。
AI.result: 有效截面刚度呈强各向异性：弯曲与拉伸刚度约降低一个数量级，而扭转刚度接近有效主干刚度。在103个实测构型上，三个数据集的归一化位置误差分别为7.7%、6.7%、7.8%；单CPU核心（Intel Xeon Cascade Lake, 2.8 GHz）完成一次全臂求解约需0.3 s。
AI.conclusion: 该建模框架兼顾精度与计算效率，可支撑基于模型的快速规划、状态与负载估计，以及面向架构化软体机器人的形态—控制协同设计。

95d9f5cd7cd7693a70b9e4ee5fcc326bc80676c3.title: Federating Quantum and Classical Computing: A Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Approach
95d9f5cd7cd7693a70b9e4ee5fcc326bc80676c3.summary:
Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly recognized as one of the most promising near-term applications of quantum computing, viewed as a next-frontier candidate beyond purely classical approaches. Hybrid quantum-classical models operationalize this potential by embedding a parameterized quantum circuit within a model where all other components remain classical-a design already applied to chemistry simulation, financial modeling, and image classification. However, their deployment in privacy-sensitive, multi-party settings is constrained by the need to avoid centralizing raw data and by the requirement that modern quantum circuits remain parameter-efficient to stay trainable at scale.
  In this paper, we address these constraints by evaluating federated learning (FL) as a means of combining a hybrid quantum-classical active party with a classical passive party, using Sherpa.ai's Blind Vertical FL (SBVFL) protocol to avoid centralizing raw data, while drastically reducing communication. We construct the split multiplicative periodic parity (SMPP) benchmark, following common QML design practice. On this task, our simulations show that SBVFL raises accuracy from 0.7227 to 0.8757 compared to local training, closely approaching non-private centralized accuracy, and that the hybrid quantum-classical model achieves this with substantially fewer trainable parameters than the classical neural networks and random forest alternatives. These results show that FL enables high-performing, privacy-preserving quantum-classical collaboration without centralizing raw data.

AI.tldr: 本文评估联邦学习在隐私敏感多方场景下，将混合量子-经典主动方与经典被动方结合的效果，采用Sherpa.ai盲式纵向联邦学习（SBVFL）协议避免原始数据集中，并在SMPP基准上验证其性能与参数效率。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习是量子计算近期最有前景的应用之一，混合量子-经典模型已在化学模拟、金融建模和图像分类中展现潜力；但其在隐私敏感、多方场景部署时，受限于不能集中原始数据，且量子电路需保持参数高效才能大规模可训练。
AI.method: 采用联邦学习（FL）框架，将混合量子-经典主动方与经典被动方结合；使用Sherpa.ai的Blind Vertical FL（SBVFL）协议避免集中原始数据并显著降低通信开销；构造分裂乘性周期奇偶性（SMPP）基准任务，遵循常见QML设计实践进行仿真评估。
AI.result: 在SMPP任务上，SBVFL将准确率从本地训练的0.7227提升至0.8757，接近非隐私集中式训练的准确率；同时，混合量子-经典模型所需可训练参数量显著少于经典神经网络和随机森林替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习能够在不集中原始数据的前提下，实现高性能、隐私保护的量子-经典协作，表明混合量子-经典模型在多方隐私场景中具有可行性与参数效率优势。

7d0ccc326a803dd2eebc68d2d0ed30d35198c698.title: Do Existing Preconditioners Improve Biomedical Tabular Foundation Learning? An Empirical Study on TabPFN Optimization
7d0ccc326a803dd2eebc68d2d0ed30d35198c698.summary: Tabular foundation models have recently shown strong potential for structured biomedical data analysis. Among them, TabPFN has emerged as an effective approach for low-data tabular classification tasks. However, the impact of optimization and preconditioning strategies on biomedical fine-tuning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical investigation of five AdamW-based preconditioning strategies for fine-tuning TabPFN v2.5 on 59 biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease, breast cancer, schizophrenia, significant memory concern (SMC), KEEL biomedical datasets, and UCI biomedical benchmarks. The evaluation considers predictive performance, computational efficiency, and statistical significance analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that the original AdamW optimizer consistently achieves the best overall performance and statistical ranking, while existing curvature-aware preconditioners fail to provide reliable improvements across diverse biomedical learning scenarios. The findings suggest that generic preconditioning approaches may not adequately capture the optimization characteristics of biomedical tabular learning, motivating the development of biomedical-aware preconditioners specifically tailored for healthcare-oriented tabular foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了TabPFN v2.5在59个生物医学表格数据集上微调时的五种AdamW预条件策略，发现原始AdamW在预测性能与统计排名上最优，现有曲率感知预条件器未带来可靠提升，需开发生物医学专用预条件器。
AI.motivation: TabPFN等表格基础模型在低数据表格分类中展现潜力，但优化与预条件策略对生物医学微调的影响尚不明确；现有通用预条件方法能否适配医疗表格学习缺乏系统实证评估。
AI.method: 在涵盖阿尔茨海默病、乳腺癌、精神分裂症、SMC、KEEL及UCI生物医学基准的59个数据集上，对TabPFN v2.5进行微调，比较五种基于AdamW的预条件策略，并从预测性能、计算效率和统计显著性三方面评估。
AI.result: 原始AdamW优化器在整体性能和统计排名上持续最优；现有曲率感知预条件器在多样化生物医学学习场景中未能提供可靠改进。
AI.conclusion: 通用预条件方法可能无法充分捕捉生物医学表格学习的优化特性，未来需针对医疗导向的表格基础模型设计生物医学感知的预条件器。

2105c5a82679bb3517934e81d0ebcffabdd0c727.title: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
2105c5a82679bb3517934e81d0ebcffabdd0c727.summary: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) code from natural-language instructions is an open-ended task without absolute visual ground truth, leaving both evaluation and policy optimization without a faithful signal. Scalar metrics (CLIP, Aesthetic) calibrated on natural images transfer poorly to stylized vector content, and reusing them as RL rewards triggers reward hacking. We address both limitations with rubric-based scoring. We first establish empirically that prompting a vision-language judge with a multi-axis rubric correlates with human judgments far better than scalar metrics, both across samples and within instructions. Building on this finding, we introduce RULER (Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for Reinforcement Learning), which converts each instruction into an instance-aware rubric of six items spanning semantic, visual, and stylistic axes; a judge VLM scores rendered rollouts item-by-item, and the weighted satisfactions form a fine-grained reward optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization. Because the rubric is derived from text alone, RULER requires neither paired SVG ground truth nor human preference labels. On MMSVG-Illustration and MMSVG-Icon, RULER lifts the rubric score from 0.432/0.395 to 0.693/0.683, surpassing dedicated SVG specialists and matching the substantially larger DeepSeek-V3, with ablations identifying rubric design as the active lever for RL on open-ended SVG generation. The project page is available at https://hangyuran.github.io/RULER/.

AI.tldr: 提出基于评分量规（rubric）的评分方法，并以此构造强化学习奖励 RULER，实现从自然语言指令生成可扩展矢量图（SVG）代码的优化。
AI.motivation: 从自然语言生成 SVG 代码属于开放式任务，缺乏绝对的视觉真值，导致评估与策略优化都缺乏可靠信号。CLIP、Aesthetic 等标量指标在自然图像上校准，难以迁移到风格化矢量内容，且直接作为 RL 奖励会引发奖励劫持（reward hacking）。
AI.method: 先用多轴 rubric 提示视觉语言评判模型，实证其与人类判断的相关性远优于标量指标（跨样本与指令内均成立）。据此提出 RULER（Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for Reinforcement Learning）：将每条指令转化为包含语义、视觉、风格三个维度共六项的实例感知 rubric；由评判 VLM 对渲染出的 rollout 逐项打分，加权满足度构成细粒度奖励，并用 GRPO 优化。rubric 仅由文本推导，无需配对 SVG 真值或人类偏好标注。
AI.result: 在 MMSVG-Illustration 与 MMSVG-Icon 上，RULER 将 rubric 分数从 0.432/0.395 提升至 0.693/0.683，超过专门的 SVG 专用模型，并匹配规模更大的 DeepSeek-V3；消融实验表明 rubric 设计是开放式 SVG 生成中 RL 的有效杠杆。
AI.conclusion: rubric 式评分比标量指标更贴近人类判断，可作为开放式 SVG 生成的可靠 RL 奖励；RULER 无需配对真值或人工偏好即可显著提升生成质量，且 rubric 设计是性能提升的关键因素。

9434f4c4a7eab6966bdcf917334c3bda44159ed6.title: VideoX-Qwen: Data-Centric Instruction-Based Video Editing
9434f4c4a7eab6966bdcf917334c3bda44159ed6.summary: Progress in general-purpose video editing depends on constructing large-scale paired supervision and effectively adapting video-generation backbones to instruction-driven editing. Unlike video generation, video editing must execute a requested transformation while preserving unrelated subjects, scene structure, motion, and temporal continuity. We present VideoX-Qwen, an integrated data-construction and model-training framework for general instruction-based video editing. Our scalable production pipeline organizes specialized generation and understanding models into complementary routes for addition, removal, replacement, and attribute editing, followed by quality screening and instruction enrichment. It produces more than 1.2 million directional video-editing records, including over 400,000 records in each major task group, with an automatic acceptance rate of 89%. The resulting corpus provides broad and structured coverage of common editing operations through a unified source-instruction-target interface. We further develop a unified Qwen-Wan editor that combines multimodal semantic conditioning with dense source-video latent guidance. A progressive image-video training strategy aligns the multimodal instruction interface, adapts the video generator to source-conditioned editing, and refines output quality with selected high-resolution data. In a 100-example comparison with UniVideo and Kling O1, VideoX-Qwen achieves the best mean result on nine of eleven reported metrics, including instruction following, editing quality, content preservation, structural and perceptual similarity, and video-distribution quality. Together, the large-scale data-production system and unified training framework provide a practical foundation for more capable instruction-driven video editing.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoX-Qwen：一个面向通用指令视频编辑的数据构建与模型训练一体化框架，构建超120万条视频编辑数据并训练统一 Qwen-Wan 编辑器，在多项指标上优于 UniVideo 与 Kling O1。
AI.motivation: 通用视频编辑进展依赖大规模成对监督数据，以及将视频生成骨干有效适配到指令驱动编辑。与视频生成不同，视频编辑不仅要执行指定变换，还必须保持无关主体、场景结构、运动与时间连续性。
AI.method: 数据侧：可扩展生产管线组织专用生成与理解模型，覆盖 addition、removal、replacement、attribute editing 的互补路线，并进行质量筛选与指令增强；产出超过120万条 directional video-editing records，每个主要任务组超过40万条，自动接受率89%，统一为 source-instruction-target 接口。模型侧：统一 Qwen-Wan editor，结合多模态语义条件与密集源视频 latent guidance；采用渐进式 image-video 训练策略，对齐多模态指令接口、使视频生成器适配源条件编辑，并用精选高分辨率数据精修输出质量。
AI.result: 在100例与 UniVideo、Kling O1 的对比中，VideoX-Qwen 在11项报告指标中的9项取得最佳均值，包括指令遵循、编辑质量、内容保持、结构与感知相似度以及视频分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 大规模数据生产系统与统一训练框架为更强大的指令驱动视频编辑提供了实用基础。

11da9ff299d4224ce597ce21a85e1e94ed9c231c.title: Beyond the Flat Seafloor: A Closed-Form Two-View Constraint to Aid Sidescan Sonar Reconstruction
11da9ff299d4224ce597ce21a85e1e94ed9c231c.comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media. This work was accepted for publication in the Proceedings of IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey
11da9ff299d4224ce597ce21a85e1e94ed9c231c.summary: Sidescan sonar is a common sensor for both manned and autonomous marine exploration and mapping, yet very few methods build upon or exploit the geometric projection model of the sensor. As sidescan sonar is limited to a 1D range measurement, many approximations are frequently used, including the long-standing assumption of a flat seafloor. Rather than make similar approximations, this paper focuses on a multi-view geometry based approach and formalizes a two-view geometric constraint and proves that a shared feature is constrained to a locus within the intersection of a sphere and a plane. In addition, we characterize what governs the size of the ambiguity locus through Monte Carlo simulation that is grounded in real aperture and mounting geometry for both a surface vessel and an underwater vehicle. We translate additional simulations of relative trajectories for both vehicle platforms into concrete survey-planning guidance. Our results show that locus length is strongly governed by elevation misalignment, and peaks at a moderate oblique crossing angle of approximately 20 degrees, with minimal locus lengths obtained at near parallel and anti-parallel passes.

AI.tldr: 本文基于多视角几何研究侧扫声呐的两视角约束，证明共享特征位于球面与平面交集上的轨迹，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真分析模糊轨迹长度，为水面和水下平台的测量规划提供指导。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声呐广泛用于载人和自主海洋探测与制图，但少有方法利用其几何投影模型。由于侧扫声呐仅提供一维距离测量，现有方法常采用近似，例如长期假设平坦海底。本文旨在避免此类近似，从多视角几何角度建立更严格的约束。
AI.method: 提出多视角几何方法，形式化两视角几何约束，证明共享特征被约束在球面与平面交集内的一条轨迹上。基于真实孔径和安装几何，对水面船只与水下航行器进行蒙特卡洛仿真，刻画模糊轨迹尺寸的影响因素。进一步将两种平台的相对轨迹仿真转化为具体测量规划指导。
AI.result: 轨迹长度主要受仰角失配影响，在约20度的中等斜交角处达到峰值，在接近平行和反平行的通过条件下获得最小轨迹长度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将侧扫声呐多视角几何约束与模糊轨迹分析相结合，给出了相对轨迹与测量规划之间的定量关系，可为水面和水下平台的侧扫声呐测量设计提供指导。

d8be26589094ef5c9a69fda8d77247ecc991ef63.title: Entropy Can Flow, or It Can Guide. Be Entropy. LEDFlow: Introducing Entropy-guided Generation Order into Uniform Discrete Flow
d8be26589094ef5c9a69fda8d77247ecc991ef63.summary: Uniform discrete flow permits repeated updates at every generation position. While continued revision supports correction of wrong tokens, it also exposes correct intermediate predictions to later errors. An experiment on Sudoku puzzles shows that 9.4% of generated cells are correct at an intermediate step but incorrect in the final output. We introduce generation order into uniform discrete flow through selective absorption, which fixes chosen predictions while preserving the uniform-flow velocity at active positions. To prevent absorbing incorrect predictions, we propose Low-Entropy Discrete Flow (LEDFlow), a training-free sampler that adaptively orders absorption by local entropy. By decomposing absorption error into joint dependence and conditional prediction terms, we show that selecting the lowest-entropy positions under a fixed absorption budget minimizes an upper bound on the conditional term. We further support the choice of local entropy by showing that the decision-error bound of global lookahead grows with the lookahead window under an imperfect denoiser. Across reasoning benchmarks, LEDFlow attains 0.845 Nikoli Sudoku solve accuracy, with the largest gains on strongly constrained tasks. On text-to-image generation it attains the best overall score, and on multimodal understanding it improves over the native sampler on all six benchmarks, at an inference cost comparable to standard flow sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出LEDFlow：一种无需训练的采样器，通过按局部熵自适应选择吸收位置，为均匀离散流引入生成顺序，减少正确中间预测被后续更新破坏的问题。
AI.motivation: 均匀离散流允许每个生成位置反复更新，虽能纠正错误token，但也会把已正确的中间预测暴露给后续错误。Sudoku实验显示，9.4%的生成单元在中间步骤正确但最终输出错误，说明需要控制更新/吸收顺序。
AI.method: 通过选择性吸收将生成顺序引入均匀离散流：固定已选预测，同时在活跃位置保持均匀流速度。为避免吸收错误预测，提出Low-Entropy Discrete Flow（LEDFlow），一种训练-free采样器，按局部熵自适应决定吸收顺序。理论分析将吸收误差分解为联合依赖项和条件预测项，证明在固定吸收预算下选择最低熵位置可最小化条件项上界；并说明在非完美去噪器下，全局前瞻的决策误差界随前瞻窗口增大而增大，从而支持使用局部熵。
AI.result: 在推理基准上，LEDFlow达到0.845的Nikoli Sudoku求解准确率，在强约束任务上增益最大；在文本到图像生成上取得最佳综合得分；在多模态理解上于六个基准均优于原生采样器，推理成本与标准流采样相当。
AI.conclusion: LEDFlow以无需训练、低成本的方式为均匀离散流引入局部熵驱动的吸收顺序，在保持标准采样效率的同时提升推理、图像生成和多模态理解表现，尤其适合强约束任务。

fb1fae4fa81a25f58ab32929c003970bd51c3c37.title: 4DGS-JEPA: Temporally Compositional Joint-Embedding Prediction for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
fb1fae4fa81a25f58ab32929c003970bd51c3c37.summary: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation of evolving 3D scenes, but existing approaches are primarily optimized for reconstruction, future-state generation, or rendering rather than for learning reusable predictive dynamics. We propose 4DGS-JEPA, a Gaussian-native joint-embedding predictive architecture for causal multi-horizon prediction over dynamic Gaussian scenes. The model uses a hierarchical scene-, motion-group-, and Gaussian-level representation together with a horizon-conditioned transition operator that supports both direct prediction and recursive rollout. Its central principle is temporal composition: different chronological transition paths reaching the same future endpoint should produce compatible predictive states. Endpoint and multi-horizon path supervision anchor these predictions to future target embeddings, while a selective geometry decoder and geometry-level composition ground the learned dynamics in consistent group motion and Gaussian geometry without requiring complete future appearance reconstruction. We further introduce a hybrid correspondence mechanism that combines persistent canonical identity with residual optimal-transport matching under reordering and topology change. We characterize zero-loss path agreement and finite-error rollout accumulation theoretically. Three controlled experiments provide mechanism-level evidence that temporal composition reduces latent path dependence while retaining predictive accuracy, geometry-level composition improves consistency of decoded motion, and hybrid correspondence preserves reliable identity while remaining robust when correspondence becomes ambiguous. Together, 4DGS-JEPA provides a predictive, temporally compositional formulation of dynamic Gaussian worlds.

AI.tldr: 提出4DGS-JEPA，一种面向动态高斯场景的Gaussian-native联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），用于因果多视界（multi-horizon）预测，以“时间组合”为核心原则，在不做完整未来外观重建的前提下学习可复用的预测性动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅（Dynamic Gaussian Splatting）虽能显式表示演化中的3D场景，但主要面向重建、未来状态生成或渲染优化，而非学习可复用的预测动力学；因此需要一种与高斯表示原生兼容、强调预测性与时间一致性的建模框架。
AI.method: 1）采用场景级、运动组级、高斯级的层次化表示，并设计视界条件转移算子，同时支持直接预测与递归展开（recursive rollout）。2）核心原则为时间组合：不同时序转移路径若到达同一未来端点，应产生兼容的预测状态；通过端点监督与多视界路径监督将预测锚定到未来目标嵌入。3）引入选择性几何解码器与几何级组合，用一致的组运动与高斯几何约束学习到的动力学，无需完整未来外观重建。4）提出混合对应机制：结合持久规范身份（canonical identity）与残差最优传输匹配（optimal-transport matching），以应对重排序与拓扑变化。5）从理论上刻画零损失下的路径一致性与有限误差下的展开累积。
AI.result: 三项受控实验提供机制级证据：时间组合在保持预测精度的同时降低潜空间路径依赖；几何级组合提升解码运动的一致性；混合对应机制在保持可靠身份识别的同时，在对应关系模糊时仍具稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 4DGS-JEPA为动态高斯世界提供了一种预测性、时间组合式的建报表述，将动态高斯建模从重建/渲染导向推进到可复用预测动力学的学习，并结合理论分析与受控实验验证了各项机制的有效性。

d6e6967b7575b2b236df4d49e79abee5c6c42f65.title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Residual Wavelet Diffusion for Ultra Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
d6e6967b7575b2b236df4d49e79abee5c6c42f65.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026 (MICCAI 2026 workshop). This is the version submitted for peer review
d6e6967b7575b2b236df4d49e79abee5c6c42f65.summary: Ultra low-field MRI expands global access to neuroimaging but produces scans with low signal-to-noise ratio, reduced contrast, and thick slices. While regression-based super-resolution can recover anatomical detail for segmentation, it returns a single deterministic estimate that gives no indication of regions where the low-field input leaves anatomy underdetermined. Generative diffusion models offer an alternative by sampling the posterior distribution of plausible high-field images, quantifying this anatomical ambiguity. However, applying them to 3D whole-brain MRI is restricted by memory bottlenecks, slow sampling, and scanner domain shifts. We propose a 3D residual wavelet diffusion model that combines three ideas to overcome these hurdles. A lossless wavelet reparameterisation shrinks the spatial grid to fit a whole brain on a single GPU, residual shifting accelerates sampling by starting from the low-field input, and domain randomisation promotes scanner generalisation without paired training data. As the high-field reference is not a voxel-aligned ground truth, we evaluate downstream volumetric agreement. On a healthy cohort (n=19) imaged at 0.064T and 3T, our method matches a leading general-purpose regression approach in volumetric accuracy while additionally generating per-voxel uncertainty maps highlighting underdetermined regions. Furthermore, on a pilot dataset (n=11) of participants with cognitive impairment, disease-relevant atrophy is preserved rather than normalised towards a healthy prior. Our framework brings whole-brain posterior sampling to low-field super-resolution without sacrificing volumetric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种3D残差小波扩散模型，用于超低场脑MRI超分辨率重建；通过无损小波重参数化、残差移位采样和域随机化，实现全脑后验采样，在保持体积学精度的同时提供体素级不确定性，并保留疾病相关萎缩。
AI.motivation: 超低场MRI可扩大神经影像可及性，但存在低信噪比、低对比度和厚层扫描问题。基于回归的超分辨率虽能恢复解剖细节，却只给出单一确定性估计，无法指示低场输入中解剖结构不确定的区域。扩散生成模型可采样高场图像后验以量化解剖模糊性，但用于3D全脑MRI时受显存瓶颈、采样缓慢和扫描仪域偏移限制，且高场参考并非体素对齐真值，需评估下游体积一致性。
AI.method: 提出3D残差小波扩散模型，融合三项设计：1）无损小波重参数化，缩小空间网格，使全脑可在单张GPU上处理；2）残差移位，从低场输入出发加速采样；3）域随机化，无需配对训练数据即可提升扫描仪泛化能力。评估不依赖体素对齐真值，而采用下游体积一致性指标。
AI.result: 在健康队列（n=19，0.064T与3T）上，方法在体积精度上匹配领先的通用回归方法，并额外生成体素级不确定性图，突出欠定区域。在认知障碍试点数据集（n=11）上，疾病相关萎缩得以保留，而非被归一化到健康先验。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将全脑后验采样引入低场MRI超分辨率，且不牺牲体积学精度，为低场神经影像提供不确定性感知的超分辨率方案。

67e66aaed5579432b55d3a319b431dd8eca77d66.title: φ-RIE: From Photorealistic Reconstruction to Interactive Environments
67e66aaed5579432b55d3a319b431dd8eca77d66.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reconstruct a captured scene photorealistically, but the resulting representation does not by itself support physical interaction. Robot simulation instead requires object-level change, \textit{i.e.}, objects must move independently, make contact, and reveal previously occluded surroundings. This gap arises because object appearance may remain entangled with the background, while hidden object geometry and occluded background content may be unobserved. To address this challenge, we present φ-RIE, a Gaussian-native pipeline that converts selected objects into movable simulator assets while preserving the remaining reconstruction. Our key observation is that asset construction and source removal should be coupled, \textit{i.e.}, one object identity should define the movable asset and the scene content to remove and complete. Accordingly, Scene Observation supplies shared evidence to Coupled Scene Construction, which creates registered assets and completed background Gaussians for simulator-driven rendering in an Interactive Environment. This coupling preserves unedited Gaussians while aligning visual and physical state. On 50 ScanNet++ scenes, evidence-based selection and registration retry increase matched F1 at 20\,mm from 0.336 to 0.383 at fixed retention. Further tests demonstrate asset executability, manipulation gains over a single-generator baseline, and the visual cost of conversion. Together, these results demonstrate that \name\ enables interactive scene conversion.

AI.tldr: φ-RIE：将3DGS重建场景中的选定对象转化为可移动仿真资产，并同步补全背景，实现交互式场景转换。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽可逼真重建场景，但表示本身不支持物理交互；机器人仿真需要对象级变化（独立运动、接触、揭示遮挡区域）。难点在于对象外观与背景纠缠，且隐藏几何与被遮挡背景未被观测。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian-native流程φ-RIE。核心是耦合“资产生成”与“源移除”：同一对象身份同时定义可移动资产及需移除/补全的场景内容。流程为Scene Observation提供共享证据，Coupled Scene Construction生成配准资产与补全背景Gaussians，供Interactive Environment中仿真驱动渲染；保留未编辑Gaussians并对齐视觉与物理状态。
AI.result: 在50个ScanNet++场景上，基于证据的选择与配准重试在固定保留率下将20 mm匹配F1从0.336提升至0.383；进一步验证资产可执行性、相较单生成器基线的操作增益及转换的视觉代价。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明φ-RIE可实现交互式场景转换，将3DGS重建转化为支持机器人仿真的可操作资产与补全环境。

7c6a0ac880f08fc708c6c991eefcb91f2f6c5cd4.title: Learning to Plan in Human-Robot Collaboration: Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Interaction
7c6a0ac880f08fc708c6c991eefcb91f2f6c5cd4.summary: Robot assistants for older adults and people with disabilities need to perform collaborative tasks with users effectively. The core component of these systems is an interaction manager whose job is to observe and assess the task and infer the state of the human and their intent for the robot to choose the best course of action. Due to the sparseness of the data in this domain, the policy for such multimodal systems is often crafted by hand; as the complexity of interactions grows, this process is not scalable. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to automatically generate the multimodal policy of the robot. Our system focuses on a realistic scenario where a robot assists a user in locating objects within a home environment, managing multimodal signals, including language and physical actions, to select the best action. In contrast to traditional dialog systems, our agent is trained with a simulator that uses human data and can deal with multiple modalities. We use a simple high-level reward function that needs no fine-tuning and enforce some preconditions to speed up the training process. A human study evaluating the system in a real-world setting demonstrates promising results, indicating high usability and effective task completion. This RL-based approach offers a scalable and interpretable alternative for designing interaction managers in multimodal human-robot collaborations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的方法，自动生成机器人在多模态人机协作中的交互策略，用于辅助老年人及残障人士完成居家物品定位任务。
AI.motivation: 面向老年人及残障人士的机器人助手需要与用户高效协作，其核心是交互管理器：需观察并评估任务、推断人类状态与意图，从而选择最优动作。由于该领域数据稀疏，现有多模态系统策略多依赖人工设计；随着交互复杂度提升，人工设计难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出用强化学习自动生成机器人多模态策略。系统针对真实场景：机器人协助用户在家庭环境中定位物品，并融合语言与物理动作等多模态信号以选择最佳动作。与传统对话系统不同，该智能体在包含人类数据的模拟器中训练，可处理多模态输入；采用无需精细调参的简单高层奖励函数，并施加若干前置条件以加速训练。
AI.result: 在真实世界环境中开展的人类被试研究（human study）显示，系统取得有前景的结果，表现出较高的可用性，并能有效完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 该基于RL的方法为多模态人机协作中的交互管理器设计提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

273d725c8b93baccfc4b0a63fdb090ed041d8490.title: The Probabilistic Structure of Large Language Models
273d725c8b93baccfc4b0a63fdb090ed041d8490.comment: Expository article on the probabilistic structure of large language models, 27 pages
273d725c8b93baccfc4b0a63fdb090ed041d8490.summary: This paper presents a probabilistic perspective on large language models (LLMs), developed with the aim of bringing together, in a single self-contained account, tools that are usually treated separately across the literature. LLMs are described through probability measures on the set of sequences of tokens, specified via their autoregressive conditional distributions. Training is formulated as a maximum-likelihood estimation problem, addressed by stochastic gradient methods, while text generation is viewed as the sequential simulation of the resulting stochastic process. The role of the asymmetry of the Kullback--Leibler divergence in text generation is examined in relation with characteristic phenomena such as hallucination and the distinction between statistical plausibility and truth. As a complementary illustration of the same viewpoint, we also discuss diffusion models, built around the score function, which cast generation not as sequential token prediction but as the simulation of a reverse-time stochastic process transforming noise into data both in discrete and continuous time.

AI.tldr: 本文从概率视角统一刻画大语言模型与扩散模型：将LLM视为词元序列上的概率测度，训练为最大似然估计，生成为自回归随机过程的序贯模拟，并借助KL散度不对称性解释幻觉及“统计合理性”与“真实性”的区别；扩散模型则通过得分函数和反向时间随机过程实现从噪声到数据的生成。
AI.motivation: 文献中处理大语言模型与生成模型的概率工具通常彼此分离，缺乏一个自包含、统一的论述框架。本文旨在将相关工具整合到同一概率视角下，建立连贯的理论叙述。
AI.method: 采用概率论与随机过程框架：用词元序列集合上的概率测度描述LLM，并通过自回归条件分布指定该测度；将训练表述为最大似然估计问题，用随机梯度方法求解；将文本生成视为所得随机过程的序贯模拟。进一步分析KL散度不对称性在文本生成中的作用，并讨论以得分函数为核心的扩散模型，将其生成过程刻画为离散与连续时间中把噪声转化为数据的反向时间随机过程模拟。
AI.result: 给出了LLM训练与生成的统一概率解释，阐明了KL散度不对称性与幻觉现象以及统计合理性与真实性区分之间的联系；同时说明扩散模型可作为同一概率视角的补充实例，其生成机制不同于序贯词元预测。
AI.conclusion: 该概率视角为理解LLM和扩散模型提供了统一、自包含的理论框架，有助于从随机过程与概率测度角度解释生成式模型的训练、采样及其典型现象。本文主要为概念性与方法论综述，未报告具体实证结果。

78fb1225218d86e914360660fc9f921468fb52e8.title: An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction
78fb1225218d86e914360660fc9f921468fb52e8.summary: Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个多模态可解释性GBM生存预测框架，将sheaf超图卷积、概念瓶颈层与扩展充分性检验（EST）正则统一起来，在UPenn-GBM 593例患者5折交叉验证中取得C-index 0.643，且折间标准差最低（0.015）。
AI.motivation: 现有胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）生存预测模型普遍将准确性与可解释性视为相互竞争的目标：高性能模型牺牲透明度，可解释模型则损失预测能力；同时，多数方法仅依赖单一影像模态，未充分利用多模态MRI与临床元数据中的互补信息。作者主张这一权衡并非固有，并试图同时实现高判别力与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出多模态框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) sheaf超图神经网络，通过有向、非对称消息传递建模组织patch间的高阶关系；(2) 概念瓶颈层，将学习到的表示压缩为具有临床依据的概念，实现事前（ante-hoc）可解释性；(3) 扩展充分性检验（EST）正则项，在训练中惩罚不忠实解释，确保解释真实反映内部决策过程。临床与基因组特征通过门控融合引入，在保留分子标志物主导预后信号的同时维持概念级可追溯性。
AI.result: 在UPenn-GBM数据集593例患者上进行5折交叉验证，框架取得0.643的一致性指数（C-index），并在所有对比模型中具有最低的折级方差（std = 0.015）。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个将sheaf超图卷积、概念瓶颈监督与EST正则统一用于脑MRI可解释生存预测的工作，表明可解释性与预测性能之间并非必然存在权衡。

cade38797e52aeae261d071dc2c912507fac6b64.title: MirrorDistill: Illumination-Aware Latent Distillation for Efficient Low-Light Restoration
cade38797e52aeae261d071dc2c912507fac6b64.summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an im- portant component of visual sensing systems operating under degraded illumination, including nighttime surveillance, au- tonomous navigation, remote sensing, and inspection in poorly lit industrial environments. Most LLIE methods rely on output- level reconstruction losses that supervise only the final restored image, leaving the intermediate feature recovery process weakly constrained. This paper proposes MirrorDistill, an illumination- aware latent distillation framework that links the low-light and clean domains through feature mirroring. During training, a shared encoder and an exponential-moving-average teacher decoder process the clean reference image to generate clean- domain latent targets. These targets supervise the low-light student at two levels: raw encoder features and standardized multi-scale decoder projections. The alignment is applied layer by layer, while a proposed illumination-aware weighting scheme gives greater emphasis to underexposed regions. The teacher and reference branches are used only during training, so inference requires only the lightweight student encoder-decoder and in- troduces no teacher-side computational cost. Under evaluation on the standard LOL benchmarks, MirrorDistill outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the real-captured LOL-v2-Real set, while having the lowest compute complexity (GMACs) and while remaining competitive on the LOL-v1 and LOL-v2-Synthetic datasets. Ablation studies further show the contributions of the encoder mirror, decoder mirror, and illumination-aware weighting. Finally, we release our code as open-source for the benefit of future research.

AI.tldr: MirrorDistill：一种面向低光照图像增强（LLIE）的照度感知隐空间蒸馏框架，通过特征镜像在训练阶段用干净域教师引导低光照学生网络，实现逐层特征对齐，并在推理阶段仅保留轻量学生编解码器。
AI.motivation: 低光照图像增强是夜间监控、自动驾驶导航、遥感及弱光工业检测等退化照明视觉感知系统的关键环节。现有大多数LLIE方法依赖输出级重建损失，仅监督最终恢复图像，导致中间特征恢复过程约束不足。
AI.method: 提出MirrorDistill照度感知隐空间蒸馏框架，通过特征镜像连接低光照域与干净域。训练时，共享编码器与指数滑动平均（EMA）教师解码器处理干净参考图像，生成干净域隐空间目标；这些目标在两个层级监督低光照学生网络：原始编码器特征与标准化的多尺度解码器投影。对齐逐层进行，并引入照度感知加权机制，对欠曝光区域赋予更高权重。教师与参考分支仅在训练阶段使用，推理仅需轻量学生编解码器，不引入教师侧计算开销。
AI.result: 在标准LOL基准上评估，MirrorDistill在真实拍摄的LOL-v2-Real数据集上优于现有最先进方法，同时具有最低计算复杂度（GMACs）；在LOL-v1与LOL-v2-Synthetic数据集上保持竞争力。消融实验进一步验证了编码器镜像、解码器镜像与照度感知加权的贡献。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: MirrorDistill通过隐空间蒸馏与特征镜像有效约束中间特征恢复，在真实低光照增强任务上取得领先性能并保持低计算复杂度；其编码器镜像、解码器镜像和照度感知加权均具有效性，且已开源以促进后续研究。

a3aba2aacdc76279c6032fb01088fce32b3162ce.title: JAMB: Joint Action-Motion Diffusion for Bimanual Manipulation
a3aba2aacdc76279c6032fb01088fce32b3162ce.summary: Coordinated bimanual manipulation is challenging because the motion of either arm can alter the shared 3D scene and thereby affect the other arm. Yet most diffusion policies generate actions without explicitly modeling these future geometric consequences, while predictive variants typically use future state only as auxiliary supervision or fixed conditioning. We address this limitation by proposing JAMB, a diffusion policy that jointly denoises bimanual actions and future 3D point tracks. By allowing action and track hypotheses to evolve together within a shared Transformer, each can inform and refine the other throughout denoising. We further ground multimodal representations in a shared spatiotemporal coordinate system to facilitate geometry-aware interaction during joint denoising. We evaluate JAMB on diverse bimanual manipulation tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 and on a real-world robot, comparing it with action-only policies and alternative future-prediction approaches spanning different state representations and learning objectives. Across 16 simulation tasks, JAMB achieves an average success rate of 83.4%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 23.9 percentage points. On three real-world tasks, it outperforms the action-only and auxiliary geometry prediction methods by 50.0 and 21.2 percentage points, respectively. Beyond these performance gains, JAMB shows stronger generalization to cluttered scenes and out-of-distribution backgrounds than the evaluated baselines. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our joint action-motion modeling framework for coordinated bimanual manipulation. Our project website is available at https://jam-bimanual.github.io/

AI.tldr: JAMB 提出一种联合去噪双臂动作与未来 3D 点轨迹的扩散策略，通过共享 Transformer 让动作与轨迹假设在去噪过程中相互修正，并在统一时空坐标系中融合多模态表示，从而提升双臂协调操作性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 双臂协调操作具有挑战性，因为任一机械臂的运动都会改变共享 3D 场景并影响另一臂。然而，多数扩散策略在生成动作时未显式建模未来几何后果，而预测型方法通常仅将未来状态用作辅助监督或固定条件，难以充分利用未来几何信息指导动作生成。
AI.method: 提出 JAMB，一种扩散策略，联合去噪双臂动作与未来 3D 点轨迹。其核心是允许动作假设与轨迹假设在共享 Transformer 内共同演化，使二者在去噪全过程中相互提供信息并迭代修正。同时，将多模态表示锚定在共享时空坐标系中，以支持联合去噪过程中的几何感知交互。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 16 个仿真任务上，JAMB 平均成功率为 83.4%，比最强基线高 23.9 个百分点；在三个真实机器人任务上，分别比仅动作策略和辅助几何预测方法高 50.0 和 21.2 个百分点。此外，在杂乱场景和分布外背景上，JAMB 相比所评估基线表现出更强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，联合动作-运动建模框架能有效提升协调双臂操作，验证了未来 3D 点轨迹与动作联合去噪、共享时空表示对几何感知决策的价值。

3365b88871353842a8e34dd490a2de33b89c23a6.title: Stable Unsupervised Continual Chunking with Sheaf SyncMap
3365b88871353842a8e34dd490a2de33b89c23a6.summary: Unsupervised Continual chunking is a fundamental problem in machine learning and neuroscience, where the goal is to identify groups of states that frequently co-occur in temporal sequences. A key challenge is to form accurate chunks while maintaining their stability over time. In this work, we propose sheaf regularization to reduce local inconsistencies in Decentralized SyncMap, a self-organizing system, and thereby stabilize its chunking dynamics. We introduce a radial sheaf structure that penalizes distance-dependent radial motion between pairs of variables. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the highest normalized mutual information (NMI) among the evaluated SyncMap variants on 12 of 18 probabilistic Continual General Chunking Problem (CGCP) graphs with two-state memory and on 17 of 18 graphs with dynamic memory. In the sequential adaptation experiment, Sheaf SyncMap also achieves high NMI after shifts in the input distribution, indicating that it can adapt to new knowledge while avoiding the negative transfer commonly observed in modern machine learning systems such as neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sheaf SyncMap：用径向层（sheaf）正则化约束 Decentralized SyncMap 中变量对之间随距离变化的径向运动，减少局部不一致，从而稳定无监督持续分块（chunking）动态，并在多组 CGCP 图与分布迁移实验中取得更高 NMI 且缓解负迁移。
AI.motivation: 无监督持续分块是机器学习与神经科学中的基础问题，目标是从时序序列中识别频繁共现的状态组。核心挑战在于：既要形成准确的分块，又要在时间演化中保持分块稳定性。
AI.method: 在自组织系统 Decentralized SyncMap 上引入 sheaf 正则化，以降低局部不一致并稳定分块动态；具体提出径向 sheaf 结构，对变量对之间依赖距离的径向运动进行惩罚。
AI.result: 在 18 个概率型持续通用分块问题（CGCP）图中，二状态记忆设置下于 12 个图上取得所评估 SyncMap 变体中最高的归一化互信息（NMI）；动态记忆设置下于 17 个图上取得最高 NMI。在顺序适应实验中，输入分布发生偏移后 Sheaf SyncMap 仍保持高 NMI。
AI.conclusion: Sheaf SyncMap 能提升分块的稳定性与准确性，并可在分布变化后适应新知识，同时避免神经网络等现代机器学习系统常见的负迁移，表明 sheaf 正则化是稳定持续分块动态的有效途径。

ffba8f6119c022756808e652af050f13e0ee54fd.title: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
ffba8f6119c022756808e652af050f13e0ee54fd.summary: In this report, we introduce \textbf{Ovis-Embedding}, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make \textbf{three key advances}: (1) \textbf{native omni-modal initialization}: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive training with low-rank initialization; (2) \textbf{data-centric omni-modal training}: we construct a broad, high-quality corpus spanning text, images, video, audio, and interleaved multimodal data. To improve data efficiency, we introduce homogeneous-source sampling to form task-consistent batches with informative in-batch negatives; and (3) \textbf{embedding-specific training and inference optimization}: we use focal loss to emphasize hard examples and similarity-based Embedding Distillation to transfer fine-grained similarity structure from complementary experts. At inference time, low-rank feature decomposition enables compact embeddings with flexible dimensionality and minimal performance loss. Empirical evaluations show that the \textbf{Ovis-Embedding} family achieves state-of-the-art performance on \textbf{MMEB-v3}, \textbf{MMEB-v2}, \textbf{MVEB}, \textbf{MAEB}, and \textbf{RTEB}, demonstrating its effectiveness across text, image, video, and audio modalities. These results highlight the potential of unified omni-modal training to overcome modality fragmentation and advance universal embedding models for any-to-any retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ovis-Embedding 全模态嵌入模型系列，基于 Qwen-Omni 共享多模态骨干，在文本、图像、视频、音频统一表示空间中训练，在 MMEB-v3/v2、MVEB、MAEB、RTEB 等基准取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型通常为不同模态搭建独立编码塔，导致模态割裂、表示空间不统一，难以支持任意模态间的检索。作者希望用统一的全模态训练范式构建通用嵌入模型，实现 any-to-any 检索。
AI.method: 核心设计为共享多模态骨干而非独立模态塔，包含三项关键改进：(1) 原生全模态初始化：以预训练 Qwen-Omni 为嵌入骨干，通过低秩初始化进行对比训练适配；(2) 数据中心全模态训练：构建覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频及交错多模态数据的高质量语料，并提出同源采样构建任务一致批次以提供有效批内负样本，提高数据效率；(3) 面向嵌入的训练与推理优化：采用 focal loss 强化困难样本，使用基于相似度的 Embedding Distillation 从互补专家迁移细粒度相似结构；推理阶段通过低秩特征分解获得紧凑嵌入，支持灵活维度且性能损失极小。
AI.result: Ovis-Embedding 系列在 MMEB-v3、MMEB-v2、MVEB、MAEB、RTEB 上均达到 state-of-the-art，覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频模态，验证了全模态统一训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明统一全模态训练能够缓解模态碎片化问题，推动通用嵌入模型发展，为任意模态到任意模态的检索提供可行路径。

00577377fb37f21ae6c50a3117fbccf824999bf5.title: Sex Estimation from Footwear Outsole Impressions Using CNN Transfer Learning and Interpretable Image Statistics
00577377fb37f21ae6c50a3117fbccf824999bf5.summary: Footwear outsole impressions are a common form of forensic pattern evidence, yet quantitative methods for estimating wearer attributes from these images remain relatively underdeveloped. We investigate binary sex estimation from footwear outsole impressions by comparing convolutional neural network (CNN) transfer learning with traditional feature-based classification. Using a publicly available outsole-impression dataset, we adopt a shoe-level training and test partition that keeps replicate scans of the same physical shoe together to reduce data leakage. We evaluate pretrained CNNs through end-to-end fine-tuning, frozen feature extraction followed by support vector machine classification, and hybrid feature fusion incorporating handcrafted, geometric, and metadata-derived descriptors. Fine-tuned CNNs achieve the strongest overall predictive performance and substantially outperform traditional classifiers trained on the manually specified descriptors alone, while frozen-feature approaches offer a less computationally demanding alternative. Exploratory analysis of low-dimensional CNN representations reveals associations with frequency threshold ratio, image contrast, and wavelet-based summaries, providing a connection between learned representations and measurable properties of outsole impressions. These findings suggest that CNN transfer learning captures discriminative information beyond the descriptors considered and offers a promising approach to footwear-based forensic screening. Further validation on independently collected and casework-like impressions is needed before operational use.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较CNN迁移学习与传统特征方法在鞋底压痕性别推断中的表现，发现微调CNN效果最佳，能捕获手工特征之外的信息。
AI.motivation: 鞋底压痕是常见的法庭模式证据，但从图像推断穿着者属性的定量方法仍不成熟，亟需评估深度学习方法在该任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 基于公开鞋底压痕数据集，采用鞋级（shoe-level）训练/测试划分以避免同一鞋的重复扫描造成数据泄漏；比较三种策略：预训练CNN端到端微调、冻结特征提取+SVM分类、以及融合手工、几何与元数据描述符的混合特征；并对低维CNN表征进行探索性分析。
AI.result: 微调CNN整体预测性能最强，显著优于仅用人工描述符的传统分类器；冻结特征方法提供了计算成本更低的替代方案；低维CNN表征与频率阈值比、图像对比度及小波特征存在关联。
AI.conclusion: CNN迁移学习能捕获超出所考虑描述符的判别信息，为基于鞋底的法庭筛查提供了有前景的途径；但在实际应用前仍需在独立采集及类案压痕上进一步验证。

bf05e4deda165e4c6f7e736a286780ce7f26f94b.title: GINIO: A Geometric SO(3)-Equivariant Interface for Neural Inertial Odometry
bf05e4deda165e4c6f7e736a286780ce7f26f94b.comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 26 pages, 14 figures
bf05e4deda165e4c6f7e736a286780ce7f26f94b.summary: Neural inertial odometry increasingly uses networks as learned measurements inside filtering pipelines. Such measurements should transform consistently under arbitrary IMU mounting conventions: their mean must transform as a vector, and their covariance must transform congruently as a second-order tensor. We present GINIO, a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry under arbitrary rotations of the IMU measurement frame. Given calibrated IMU windows, our framework predicts a motion measurement and uncertainty obeying these tensorial laws. To support efficient sensor-frame learning, we introduce Last-Frame Alignment (LFA), a deterministic preprocessing step that is provably equivalent to world-frame training for SO(3)-equivariant predictors. The connected estimator tracks sensor-local states such as IMU bias, separating nuisance estimation from the geometric law enforced by the learned measurement. We instantiate the same interface in filter-connected NIO, AirIO-style recurrent aerial prediction, EqNIO-style full-SO(3) canonicalization, and ResNet-style temporal backbones. On TLIO, GINIO achieves 2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE while EqNIO degrades to 76.389 m, using 11.6x fewer FLOPs. On NanoBench, our AirIO-style instantiation improves ATE from 5.579 m to 1.430 m without external attitude input, and our ResNet-style instantiation reaches 0.581 m ATE versus 0.645 m for ResNet1D. On Fetch, GINIO empirically reduces unseen physical-remount ATE from 8.15 m to 0.50 m without retraining, demonstrating robustness beyond the exact coordinate-frame guarantee. For uncertainty, spectral covariance reduces covariance-equivariance error by over three orders of magnitude compared with a diagonal head.

AI.tldr: GINIO：面向神经惯性里程计的SO(3)等变几何接口，统一保证运动测量均值按向量、协方差按二阶张量变换，并通过Last-Frame Alignment实现传感器系高效训练；在多数据集和多种骨干上显著提升精度、效率、重装鲁棒性与不确定性等变性。
AI.motivation: 神经惯性里程计常将网络输出作为滤波管线中的学习测量，但IMU安装坐标系任意旋转时，测量应满足几何一致性：均值需按向量变换，协方差需按二阶张量同余变换。既有方法在任意旋转下易退化，且难以兼顾传感器系学习效率与不确定性建模。
AI.method: 提出GINIO，一个在IMU测量系任意旋转下保持SO(3)等变的神经惯性里程计接口。输入标定后的IMU窗口，预测满足张量变换律的运动测量与不确定性。引入Last-Frame Alignment（LFA）确定性预处理，并证明其对SO(3)等变预测器等价于世界系训练。连接的估计器跟踪传感器局部状态（如IMU偏置），将干扰量估计与学习测量所施加的几何律分离。该接口可实例化于filter-connected NIO、AirIO式循环空中预测、EqNIO式全SO(3)规范化及ResNet式时序骨干。
AI.result: TLIO上，GINIO达到2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE，EqNIO退化为76.389 m，且GINIO FLOPs少11.6倍；NanoBench上，AirIO式实例在无外部姿态输入下将ATE从5.579 m降至1.430 m，ResNet式实例达到0.581 m，优于ResNet1D的0.645 m；Fetch上，无需重训练即可将未见物理重装ATE从8.15 m降至0.50 m；不确定性方面，谱协方差相比对角头将协方差等变误差降低三个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: GINIO以几何等变方式统一了学习测量与滤波估计，在保持高效传感器系学习的同时，显著提升跨安装坐标系、跨平台与重装场景的鲁棒性，并改善协方差等变性，验证了SO(3)等变接口在神经惯性里程计中的有效性与通用性。

b5c46f097e4aec843112167865e0e9b09eda96a9.title: Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Modularity for General Continual Learning
b5c46f097e4aec843112167865e0e9b09eda96a9.summary: Continual learning, the ability to learn from sequential experience while retaining and adapting prior knowledge, is central to intelligent systems operating in changing environments. However, conventional continual learning is typically studied with offline task-wise training and clear task boundaries, leaving a substantial gap from general continual learning under online, uncertain, and evolving data streams. In this regime, intelligent systems must separate conflicting experience to reduce interference while integrating compatible experience to promote generalization. Inspired by the organization of the Drosophila learning and memory system, we identify a hierarchical modular principle that coordinates both functions through expert specialization and ensemble integration. We instantiate this principle as lightweight modular adaptation of pretrained foundation models, combining brain-inspired random expansion for expert routing and diversified modular integration across spatial and temporal scales. Across visual recognition, vision-language understanding, ego-exo video understanding, and embodied vision-language-action learning, our method consistently improves learning under online and uncertain data streams, with gains exceeding 50 percentage points over replay-free alternatives in embodied manipulation. These findings support hierarchical modularity as a biologically grounded path for learning from dynamic experience.

AI.tldr: 该论文受果蝇学习与记忆系统启发，提出分层模块化持续学习原则：通过专家特化分离冲突经验、通过集成整合兼容经验，并将其实例化为预训练基础模型的轻量模块化适配，在在线且不确定的数据流中显著提升学习性能。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习通常依赖离线、按任务划分的训练和明确任务边界，难以应对在线、不确定、持续演化的数据流。在该场景下，智能系统既要分离冲突经验以降低干扰，又要整合兼容经验以促进泛化，现有方法存在明显差距。
AI.method: 借鉴果蝇学习与记忆系统的组织机制，识别出协调上述两种功能的分层模块化原则，即专家特化与集成整合。具体实例化为对预训练基础模型的轻量模块化适配，结合脑启发的随机扩展进行专家路由，并在空间与时间尺度上进行多样化模块集成。
AI.result: 在视觉识别、视觉-语言理解、自我中心-他人中心视频理解以及具身视觉-语言-动作学习等任务中，该方法在在线且不确定数据流下均取得一致提升；在具身操作任务中，相较无回放方法提升超过50个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，分层模块化是一种具有生物学基础、面向动态经验学习的有效路径，为在线持续学习与预训练基础模型适配提供了新思路。

5f59638af34dbb0db367d6869a69f420ff949531.title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
5f59638af34dbb0db367d6869a69f420ff949531.summary: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. A frozen latent-to-text reconstruction objective provides a semantic anchor for the latent representation. Offline two-step planning evaluation places X-Planner second among four evaluated models on both BERTScore-F1 and a judge-based Overall score. In real-robot experiments, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baselines. These results characterize planning-text quality and downstream execution.

AI.tldr: X-Planner 是一个面向长程操作任务的具身规划前端：用多源分层数据与接管时/失败标注增强监督，并以共享 VLM 主干提供离散事件状态与连续潜变量 CoT 两种事件结构化计划形式；离线二步规划评估中在四个模型中位列第二，真机实验优于所评估基线。
AI.motivation: 现代 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）系统虽需任务规划来连接高层指令与可执行行为，但常将中间规划结构隐式化；现有 chain-of-thought（CoT）规划器又依赖粗粒度任务级标注，或逐 token 序列化长推理轨迹，导致具身推理在监督信号与表示形式两方面均不充分。
AI.method: 数据侧：融合 Ego、UMI 与遥操作数据，采用层次化粒度与源相关标注深度；利用接管时（takeover-time）标注和人工设计失败样本，监督进行中的错误识别。模型侧：共享 VLM 主干暴露两种事件结构化计划形式——离散接口输出可解释的事件状态；潜变量接口通过 Staircase Decoding 在交错 Transformer 深度间传递连续 CoT 状态；并以冻结的 latent-to-text 重建目标为潜表示提供语义锚点。
AI.result: 离线二步规划评估中，X-Planner 在 BERTScore-F1 与基于 judge 的 Overall 分数上，于四个被评估模型中排名第二；在真机实验中分别优于所评估的基线。摘要同时指出，这些结果用于刻画规划文本质量与下游执行表现。
AI.conclusion: X-Planner 作为规划前端，同时改进具身推理的监督方式与表示结构，在离线规划文本质量和真实机器人下游执行上取得有竞争力的表现；其核心贡献在于用事件结构化、双接口与潜变量语义锚定来显式化长程操作中的任务规划。

d202c5beb7d97f68d1aa04fc57e28ccff6fc00f5.title: Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representations (DTV-INR) for Continuous Super-Resolution in Degraded Imaging Domains
d202c5beb7d97f68d1aa04fc57e28ccff6fc00f5.summary: In this paper, we introduce the Directional Total Variation-Regularized Implicit Neural Representation (DTV-INR), an advanced variational paradigm that synergistically integrates coordinate-driven implicit neural networks with an anisotropic, structure-tensor-informed total variation regularizer tailored for resolution-agnostic image super-resolution. Casting the continuous-to-discrete acquisition process into an ill-posed inverse problem framework, our formulation equips a SIREN-architected coordinate network with a dynamic Riemannian metric tensor field D(x). By leveraging its spectral decomposition, the proposed regularizer preferentially directs diffusion parallel to dominant structural contours while penalizing cross-edge dissipation, successfully circumventing the classical staircasing artifacts inherent to scalar total variation schemes. We rigorously prove the well-posedness of this formulation in H^1(Omega) by establishing the existence, uniqueness, and metric stability of the variational minimizer, and realize this via an alternating projected optimization algorithm that decouples network parameter tuning from adaptive tensor field updates. Comprehensive experiments conducted on clinical brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and biomedical transmission electron microscopy confirm substantial quantitative and qualitative improvements, yielding PSNR enhancements reaching +5.05 dB over baseline unregularized INRs and +1.71-2.85 dB over isotropic TV-INR across continuous (non-integer) upsampling factors, alongside remarkable noise robustness up to sigma_eta = 0.10 and monotonic preconditioned convergence behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出DTV-INR：将SIREN坐标型隐式神经网络与结构张量引导的各向异性全变分正则相结合，用于任意分辨率（含非整数倍）图像超分；在H^1上证明适定性，并用交替投影优化求解；在脑MRI与生物TEM上取得显著PSNR提升与噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统隐式神经表示（INR）在连续超分中易欠约束、对噪声敏感；标量全变分（TV）虽能正则化，但各向同性扩散会抹平结构并产生阶梯伪影（staircasing）。因此需要一种能按图像几何结构自适应扩散、且具备理论适定性的各向异性正则化范式。
AI.method: 1) 将连续到离散的采集建模为病态逆问题；2) 以SIREN架构构建坐标驱动隐式网络，并引入动态Riemann度量张量场D(x)，由结构张量谱分解获得各向异性方向；3) 设计方向性TV正则项：沿主结构轮廓方向优先扩散，惩罚跨边缘耗散；4) 在H^1(Ω)中证明变分解的存在性、唯一性与度量稳定性；5) 用交替投影优化算法，分离网络参数更新与自适应张量场更新。
AI.result: 在临床脑MRI与生物透射电镜（TEM）数据上，连续（非整数）上采样倍率下：相对无正则INR基线PSNR最高提升+5.05 dB；相对各向同性TV-INR提升+1.71~2.85 dB；在噪声标准差σ_η=0.10下仍具显著鲁棒性，并呈现单调的预条件收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: DTV-INR通过结构张量引导的各向异性TV正则与隐式神经表示协同，兼顾分辨率无关超分、边缘保持与噪声抑制，并具备适定性理论与稳定优化机制，验证了其在医学与生物成像中的有效性。

05c71770f050e3953725e7f119631c63a38e1ea3.title: Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport
05c71770f050e3953725e7f119631c63a38e1ea3.summary: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative behavior. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset of dyadic human transport demonstrations, our transformer architecture distills collaborative behavior into predictions of future object motion. Across 108 real-world trials with a 9-DoF mobile manipulator, PROACT reduces mean interaction work by 59.2\% and 20.4\%, and mean completion time by 12.9\% and 6.9\%, relative to compliance-only and MPC baselines, respectively. Footage from our experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/qAGvQfVPjbk.

AI.tldr: 提出 PROACT 框架，将人类协作行为预测融入顺应式全身控制，实现人机协作搬运，显著降低交互功与完成时间。
AI.motivation: 人机协作搬运（物流、制造、家庭等场景）要求机器人既能高效搬运物体，又能对用户输入保持物理顺应性。但已有工作通常将这两种能力割裂处理：要么高效移动物体却抗拒用户输入，要么迁就用户却依赖持续引导，难以兼顾。
AI.method: 核心洞见在于：受障碍物约束的协作搬运需要将人类协作行为预测与顺应式机器人控制相结合。为此提出 PROACT——通过一个学习到的人类协作行为模型，把"预见性"嵌入到顺应式全身控制中。该方法基于大规模真实双人搬运示范数据集训练，采用 Transformer 架构，将协作行为蒸馏为对物体未来运动的预测。
AI.result: 在 9 自由度移动机械臂上开展 108 次真实世界试验。相比仅顺应（compliance-only）与 MPC 基线，PROACT 分别将平均交互功降低 59.2% 与 20.4%，平均完成时间降低 12.9% 与 6.9%。
AI.conclusion: PROACT 证明将人类协作行为预测与顺应式全身控制融合，能有效提升人机协作搬运的效率与顺应性，兼顾降低用户施力负担与高效完成任务。

7c65d2fce7d8faeefa72c0fc53b4ab855a472250.title: Dual-GNN Multilevel Coarsening for Maximum Independent Set
7c65d2fce7d8faeefa72c0fc53b4ab855a472250.summary: Solving large-scale instances of the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) exactly is computationally expensive. Researchers often employ graph sparsification methods to improve computational efficiency. Traditional sparsification methods typically rely on fixed heuristics and fail to fully exploit instance-specific structural information. In this paper, we propose Graph Edge Sparsification (GES), a learning-based sparsification approach for Euclidean TSP.
