By incorporating geometric structural information and combinatorial optimization technology, our proposed method adaptively generates a sparsification graph for different instances, significantly reducing the graph size and accelerating the solving process. Experimental results demonstrate that our sparsification method can prune up to 95\% of edges on the MATILDA dataset, while keeping the solution gap within 1\% of the optimal value. Moreover, our approach exhibits strong generalization capability on the TSPLIB benchmark.In some large-scale instances, the pruning rate exceeds 99\%, while the optimality gap remains below 1\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于学习的图边稀疏化方法（GES），通过融合几何结构信息与组合优化技术，为欧氏TSP自适应生成稀疏化图，大幅缩减图规模并加速精确求解。
AI.motivation: 大规模TSP精确求解计算代价高昂，研究者常用图稀疏化提升效率。然而传统稀疏化方法多依赖固定启发式，无法充分利用实例特有的结构信息，导致稀疏化效果受限。
AI.method: 提出Graph Edge Sparsification（GES），一种面向欧氏TSP的基于学习的稀疏化方法。它结合几何结构信息与组合优化技术，针对不同实例自适应地生成稀疏化图，从而显著减小图规模并加速求解过程。
AI.result: 在MATILDA数据集上最多可剪除95%的边，解间隙保持在最优值的1%以内；在TSPLIB基准上展现强泛化能力，部分大规模实例剪枝率超过99%，最优性间隙仍低于1%。
AI.conclusion: GES通过学习式自适应稀疏化，在保证解质量（间隙<1%）的前提下实现极高剪枝率，显著提升大规模欧氏TSP精确求解效率，并具备良好泛化能力。

553309ef9ff8ef5b755a5f349f0a2b7ae0657c38.title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
553309ef9ff8ef5b755a5f349f0a2b7ae0657c38.comment: 52 pages, 6 figures. Includes a catalogue of imported projects
553309ef9ff8ef5b755a5f349f0a2b7ae0657c38.summary: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.

AI.tldr: Lean Pool 是一个由 AI 智能体（AI agents）培育、维护并优化的形式化数学代码库。
AI.motivation: 形式化数学（formalized mathematics）的积累与维护需要大量人工投入，构建规模化、持续演化的数学知识库成本高昂，因此需要借助自动化手段来降低维护负担并提升库的质量与规模。
AI.method: 构建名为 Lean Pool 的形式化数学代码库，并采用 AI 智能体作为核心驱动力，由其在库的"生长（grown）""维护（maintained）"与"优化（optimized）"三个环节上自主执行相关任务。
AI.result: 形成一个可持续扩展、自动维护并不断优化的形式化数学仓库 Lean Pool。
AI.conclusion: 通过 AI 智能体对形式化数学库进行全生命周期管理，可实现对形式化数学资源的自动化构建与持续改进。

71255a8614d9a79215f8d5fdd22e35848a12509e.title: Combinatorial Network-Based Manifold Topological Deep Learning for Image Analysis
71255a8614d9a79215f8d5fdd22e35848a12509e.summary: Medical image analysis remains fundamentally challenging because of the intricate geometric and topological structures present in medical data. Conventional convolutional neural networks model images as regular Euclidean grids, limiting their ability to preserve geometric relationships and higher-order structural information. Recently, manifold topological deep learning (MTDL) has emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates deep learning with geometric and topological representations. Nevertheless, existing methods have not yet fully exploited discrete manifold structures within combinatorial complex neural networks. To bridge this gap, we introduce CNMTDL, a MTDL framework that integrates Hodge decomposition with a combinatorial attention mechanism. In our approach, medical images are represented as discrete manifolds and decomposed into three Hodge components. Features extracted from these components are concatenated and embedded into a combinatorial complex architecture, enabling enhanced higher-order message passing between $0$-cells and $2$-cells through attention-based blocks. We evaluate CNMTDL on six two-dimensional and three-dimensional datasets from the MedMNIST v2 benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness for medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出 CNMTDL——一种将 Hodge 分解与组合注意力机制相融合的流形拓扑深度学习（MTDL）框架，在 MedMNIST v2 的 6 个 2D/3D 数据集上验证了其医学图像分析的有效性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像蕴含复杂的几何与拓扑结构，而传统卷积神经网络将图像视为规则欧氏网格，难以保留几何关系与高阶结构信息；已有的流形拓扑深度学习方法又尚未充分利用组合复形神经网络中的离散流形结构，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 将医学图像表示为离散流形，并进行 Hodge 分解得到三个 Hodge 分量；对各分量提取的特征进行拼接后嵌入组合复形（combinatorial complex）架构，借助基于注意力的模块在 0-cell 与 2-cell 之间实现增强的高阶消息传递。
AI.result: 在 MedMNIST v2 基准的六个二维与三维数据集上对 CNMTDL 进行了评估，结果证明其在医学图像分析任务上具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNMTDL 弥补了现有组合复形神经网络对离散流形结构利用不足的缺陷，表明 Hodge 分解与组合注意力机制的结合是提升医学图像几何/拓扑表征能力的有效途径。

24382a0b5c80d532a12eb63a26b897d05346ac6e.title: HOTICE: Whole-Body Humanoid Object Transportation in Cluttered Environments
24382a0b5c80d532a12eb63a26b897d05346ac6e.summary: Object transportation is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots operating in real-world, human-centric environments, yet existing methods struggle when clutter constrains free space around both the robot and its carried payload. We present HOTICE, a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects through such cluttered environments. First, we introduce Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields, which jointly encode collision-avoidance guidance for the robot and the carried object, enabling coordinated, obstacle-aware motion for both. Second, to address the large action space inherent to whole-body loco-manipulation, we design a dual-agent reinforcement learning architecture that decouples upper- and lower-body control while preserving whole-body coordination via shared state observations and rewards. To train a policy that generalizes across diverse cluttered scenes, we further employ a specialist-to-generalist distillation strategy, in which privileged teacher policies are distilled into a single deployable student policy. We evaluate HOTICE in MuJoCo simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating effective and robust object transportation across cluttered scenarios for objects of varying shapes. Our results show that HOTICE reliably coordinates whole-body motion and object-aware collision avoidance, generalizing effectively to previously unseen cluttered environments while achieving strong performance in sim2real deployment.

AI.tldr: HOTICE：面向杂乱环境中物体运输的全身人形机器人学习框架，通过人机-物体解耦势场、上下肢双智能体强化学习与专家到通才蒸馏，在MuJoCo和Unitree G1真机上实现鲁棒运输与sim2real部署。
AI.motivation: 物体运输是人形机器人在真实人类中心环境中作业的基础能力，但现有方法在杂乱环境中受限：障碍物同时压缩机器人本体与所携带负载周围的自由空间，导致避障与全身协调控制困难。
AI.method: 提出HOTICE框架，包含三项关键设计：（1）Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields，对机器人和被携带物体分别编码碰撞规避引导，实现二者协同的障碍感知运动；（2）双智能体强化学习架构，解耦上肢与下肢控制，并通过共享状态观测与奖励保持全身协调，以应对全身移动操作的大动作空间；（3）专家到通才的蒸馏策略，将具有特权信息的教师策略蒸馏为单一可部署的学生策略，从而泛化到多样杂乱场景。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo仿真与真实Unitree G1人形机器人上评估，HOTICE能够在杂乱场景中对不同形状物体实现有效且鲁棒的运输；结果表明其可可靠协调全身运动与物体感知避障，并能泛化到未见过的杂乱环境，同时在sim2real部署中取得良好性能。
AI.conclusion: HOTICE验证了将物体级势场、上下肢解耦强化学习与专家蒸馏相结合，可有效解决杂乱环境下人形机器人全身物体运输问题，并具备较强的泛化性与真实部署潜力。

3c762ac0ffa5469ff8f1af7fd7713328d3518ed9.title: Exposing Blind Spots in Deep Imbalanced Regression Evaluation
3c762ac0ffa5469ff8f1af7fd7713328d3518ed9.summary: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) addresses a common failure mode of regression models: target distributions are highly non-uniform, causing models to perform best in densely populated target regions even when reliable performance is required across the full target range. Despite rapid methodological progress, DIR evaluation remains constrained by three blind spots: it is dominated by image-based benchmarks, its standard many-/medium-/few-shot protocol is diagnostic but not decision-complete, and tail-region stability across random seeds has not been systematically evaluated. We revisit DIR evaluation along these three axes. First, we broaden the data domain by evaluating DIR on a multimodal virtual sensing benchmark (\textsc{MuViS}) with nine time-series extrinsic regression tasks across six physical domains, where rare target values often correspond to operationally meaningful regimes. Second, we adopt balanced MAE (\emph{bMAE}) and introduce balanced Mean Absolute Scaled Error (\emph{bMASE}), a scale-normalized metric for decision-complete comparison across methods and datasets. Third, through a repeated reevaluation of six representative DIR methods across multiple random seeds, we show that the tail regions targeted by DIR exhibit particularly high sensitivity to seed-level variability. Our results show that standard virtual-sensing models exhibit substantial tail degradation hidden by global MAE, that existing DIR methods can improve balanced performance but transfer unevenly to multimodal time-series data, and that tail-region instability remains a largely hidden failure mode under current DIR evaluation practice. Together, these findings and our publicly available code provide a reproducible basis for future DIR research toward regression systems that capture rare target regimes as reliably as common ones.

AI.tldr: 该文从数据域、评价指标与随机种子稳定性三个盲点重新审视深度不平衡回归（DIR）评测：在MuViS多模态时序虚拟传感基准的9个外因回归任务上评测，采用bMAE并引入bMASE，并对6种代表性DIR方法进行多种子重复重评。结果显示标准模型尾区退化被全局MAE掩盖，DIR方法迁移不均，尾区不稳定是当前评测下被隐藏的失效模式。
AI.motivation: DIR方法进展迅速，但评测存在三方面局限：以图像基准为主，标准many-/medium-/few-shot协议虽具诊断性但非决策完备，且尾区跨随机种子稳定性缺乏系统评估。因此需要沿数据域、指标与种子稳定性三轴重新评估DIR。
AI.method: 1）扩展数据域：在MuViS多模态虚拟传感基准上评测DIR，涵盖6个物理域、9个时序外因回归任务，稀有目标值常对应重要运行工况；2）改进指标：采用balanced MAE（bMAE），并提出尺度归一化的balanced Mean Absolute Scaled Error（bMASE），用于跨方法与跨数据集的决策完备比较；3）稳定性检验：对6种代表性DIR方法进行多随机种子重复重评，分析尾区敏感性。
AI.result: 标准虚拟传感模型存在显著尾区性能退化，且被全局MAE掩盖；现有DIR方法可提升平衡性能，但在多模态时序数据上迁移不均；尾区区域对种子级波动高度敏感，其不稳定性在当前DIR评测实践中仍是被隐藏的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了DIR评测在数据域、决策完备指标与尾区稳定性上的缺口，并提供公开代码作为可复现基础，推动未来DIR研究构建能像捕捉常见目标一样可靠捕捉稀有目标区间的回归系统。

c866ef8aa15ab77919abcde0ccd3613bdda3641d.title: The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis
c866ef8aa15ab77919abcde0ccd3613bdda3641d.summary: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to conventional scripted pipelines for small-scale data exploration. We demonstrate these capabilities using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, and evaluate the agent on a custom fNIRS benchmarking suite against general-purpose LLM agents with code sandboxes. Future extensions will generalize the architecture to additional modalities, including functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, and expand the benchmarking suite to additional fNIRS tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出"AI Neuroscientist"语言智能体，将LLM与神经影像工具集结合，支持用自然语言进行数据质控、建模与可视化；以fNIRS数据演示并在自定义基准上对比通用LLM智能体，未来扩展至fMRI等模态。
AI.motivation: 神经影像数据分析需要专业编程与统计能力，缺乏计算背景的研究者难以直接开展分析；传统脚本化流程门槛高、交互性差，小规模数据探索缺少透明便捷的工具。
AI.method: 构建面向交互式数据探索的语言智能体：将大语言模型（LLM）与神经影像工具集集成，使其能够执行质量控制、建模和可视化；研究者可用自然语言查询数据质量并指定分析参数。系统以功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）数据为示例，并在自定义fNIRS基准测试套件上，与带代码沙箱的通用LLM智能体进行比较评估。
AI.result: 系统可在fNIRS场景下实现自然语言驱动的质控、建模与可视化，提供透明、可交互的分析方式；在自定义fNIRS基准上完成与通用LLM智能体的对比评估，展示其针对神经影像任务的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为神经影像分析提供了低门槛、可交互的智能体范式，适合小规模数据探索；未来将把架构推广到更多模态（如功能性磁共振成像fMRI），并扩展基准套件以覆盖更多fNIRS任务。

45f61a052770b5db87bf4a154c5de6010990add5.title: MIND the Gap: A Geographic Implicit Neural Representation with Adjustable Spatial Scale
45f61a052770b5db87bf4a154c5de6010990add5.summary: Geographic measurements are often sparse, leaving large areas without labels for the quantities we want to map. Geographic implicit neural representations (INRs) address this by learning smooth, general-purpose embeddings that can be queried at any coordinate. Downstream models combine these embeddings with sparse labels to predict target values at unsampled locations without satellite imagery at inference. However, generalization to distant regions remains largely unexplored, despite its importance for remote sensing applications. We introduce Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation (MIND), which distills embeddings from specialist pretrained geospatial models into a single generalist coordinate embedding with adjustable spatial granularity. MIND uses nested supervision at several embedding dimensions, which define a series of contiguous chunks. In our experiments, early chunks capture coarser geographic variation, while later chunks add more fine-grained details. A downstream predictor can retain only leading chunks or be fitted with our Chunked Penalty to downweight later chunks while keeping the full embedding, without retraining the INR. To measure MIND and compare to existing approaches around the world, we introduce CoordBench, a large-scale INR evaluation suite of $52$ datasets and $78$ targets that aims to test both local interpolation and prediction in held-out regions at various spatial scales. MIND and its Chunked Penalty variant achieve the highest aggregate regression and classification scores among tested INRs, and the highest scores overall under regional holdout, setting a new state-of-the-art for geographic INRs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MIND（Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation），通过将多个地理空间专家模型的嵌入蒸馏为单一、可调空间粒度的通用坐标隐式神经表示（INR），并引入嵌套式多维度监督与 Chunked Penalty，提升地理 INR 在远距离/留出区域上的泛化能力；同时发布 CoordBench 大规模评测套件。
AI.motivation: 地理测量数据通常稀疏，大量区域缺少标签；地理 INR 可学习平滑通用的坐标嵌入，使下游模型结合稀疏标签在无卫星影像推理条件下预测未采样位置。但现有方法对远距离区域的泛化能力研究不足，而这在遥感应用中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation（MIND）：将多个专门预训练的地理空间模型的嵌入蒸馏进一个通用的坐标嵌入中，并支持可调空间粒度。MIND 在多个嵌入维度上进行嵌套监督，形成连续嵌入块（chunks）：早期块捕获较粗粒度地理变化，后续块补充细粒度细节。下游预测器可直接保留前导块，或使用 Chunked Penalty 在保留完整嵌入的同时降低后续块权重，无需重新训练 INR。为评估全球范围泛化，构建 CoordBench，包含 52 个数据集、78 个目标，覆盖局部插值与不同空间尺度留出区域预测。
AI.result: MIND 及其 Chunked Penalty 变体在测试的 INR 方法中取得最高的聚合回归与分类分数，并在区域留出（regional holdout）设定下取得最高总体分数，刷新地理 INR 的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: MIND 通过专家模型蒸馏、嵌套多粒度监督和块级惩罚，实现了可调粒度的通用地理坐标嵌入，显著提升远距离与区域留出场景的泛化能力；CoordBench 为地理 INR 的全球尺度评测提供了大规模基准，推动该方向建立新的 SOTA。

aac3d4b622c2372c44794d87b17ec50926296ecb.title: Capability-Aware Arbitration for Semantic Intent-Based Shared Control
aac3d4b622c2372c44794d87b17ec50926296ecb.summary: Shared control often allocates robot authority based on confidence in inferred human intent, assuming reliable autonomous execution. When this assumption fails, high intent confidence can cause over-helping. We present a capability-aware shared-control framework in which a vision-language model (VLM) infers human intent and provides semantic-intent confidence, while a vision-language-action (VLA) policy generates autonomous actions. VLA capability confidence is estimated online from the dispersion and local instability of stochastic action trajectories. We design a nonlinear arbitration policy that combines Bayesian-filtered semantic-intent confidence with VLA capability confidence through a sigmoid mapping to adapt robot authority. Our evaluation combined VLM/VLA confidence assessment with a study involving 12 participants performing pick-and-place and bidirectional stacking under in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions. The proposed method achieved the highest task success rate (92%), compared with manual teleoperation (83%), intent-only arbitration (44%), and fixed equal-weight blending (10%). It also achieved higher control friendliness and lower authority-weighted disagreement than both shared-control baselines. These results demonstrate the benefit of incorporating VLA capability into authority allocation to mitigate over-helping and improve shared-control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出能力感知的共享控制框架：VLM推断人类意图并提供语义意图置信度，VLA策略在线估计能力置信度，通过非线性仲裁动态分配机器人权限，以缓解过度帮助。12人实验成功率达92%，优于遥操作83%、仅意图仲裁44%和固定等权混合10%。
AI.motivation: 现有共享控制通常依据推断出的人类意图置信度来分配机器人权限，并默认自主执行可靠。当自主策略实际不可靠时，高意图置信度会导致过度帮助，反而降低共享控制表现。因此需要将机器人自身能力纳入权限分配。
AI.method: VLM负责推断人类意图并输出语义意图置信度；VLA策略生成自主动作，并利用随机动作轨迹的离散度与局部不稳定性在线估计VLA能力置信度。随后设计非线性仲裁策略，将经贝叶斯滤波的语义意图置信度与VLA能力置信度通过sigmoid映射融合，以自适应调整机器人权限。
AI.result: 评估结合了VLM/VLA置信度评估与12名参与者的用户研究，任务包括分布内和分布外条件下的抓取放置与双向堆叠。所提方法任务成功率最高，为92%；手动遥操作为83%，仅意图仲裁为44%，固定等权混合为10%。同时，其控制友好度更高，权限加权分歧低于两种共享控制基线。
AI.conclusion: 将VLA能力置信度纳入权限分配，可有效缓解过度帮助并提升共享控制性能，说明共享控制不应仅依赖人类意图置信度，还应考虑自主执行能力。

07abe8bc68ef54a4984142d2a59d85d1f4be89d2.title: Learning Neural Feedback Linearization for Data-driven Systems via Augmented Lagrangian
07abe8bc68ef54a4984142d2a59d85d1f4be89d2.summary: The paper proposes a novel data-driven framework for designing and training a feedback linearizing controller by explicitly incorporating relative degree based conditions into the learning process. This enables the conventional feedback controller components to be replaced by neural Lie derivatives, thereby facilitating a fully data-driven feedback linearization framework. Furthermore, practical closed-loop stability is established by deriving sufficient conditions under which bounded identification errors lead to bounded tracking errors. The derived theoretical results are validated through their application to an armature controlled DC motor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将相对度条件显式嵌入学习过程的数据驱动反馈线性化控制框架，用神经Lie导数替代传统控制器组件，并给出有界辨识误差导致有界跟踪误差的充分条件，最后在电枢控制直流电机上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统反馈线性化通常依赖精确模型和解析Lie导数/相对度，模型未知时难以直接应用；需要一种完全数据驱动、且具备闭环稳定性保证的设计与训练方法。
AI.method: 将基于相对度的条件作为约束融入神经网络学习过程，训练神经Lie导数以替代传统反馈控制器中的模型相关组件，从而构建完全数据驱动的反馈线性化框架；同时推导实用闭环稳定性的充分条件，建立辨识误差与跟踪误差之间的界。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，在辨识误差有界的条件下可保证跟踪误差有界；并以电枢控制直流电机为对象验证了所提理论与框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够以数据驱动方式实现反馈线性化，并在存在有界辨识误差时提供实用闭环稳定性保证，为未知非线性系统的控制设计提供了可行途径。

ed4a3b994f6ce2cc6706a4dcaec2914bc4a24a96.title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
ed4a3b994f6ce2cc6706a4dcaec2914bc4a24a96.comment: 7 pages,2 tables, 2 figures. Submitted to EMBC 2026
ed4a3b994f6ce2cc6706a4dcaec2914bc4a24a96.summary: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.

AI.tldr: 提出MedGate-Fusion多模态门控模型，融合首诊叙事Transformer嵌入与10项常规风险标志物，用于初级保健前瞻性卒中风险分层；基于CPCSSN构建102,736例首诊患者队列，并在语义编码前对卒中相关术语进行词典脱敏以降低目标泄漏。
AI.motivation: 初级保健中的前瞻性卒中风险分层具有挑战性，因为早期风险信号分散在常规生物标志物和非结构化临床叙事中，单一模态难以充分利用信息。
AI.method: 采用MedGate-Fusion多模态门控架构，整合首诊临床叙事的Transformer嵌入与10项常规记录风险标志物。数据来自加拿大初级保健哨兵监测网络（CPCSSN）电子病历；从808,921条就诊级观察中构建首诊队列，保留102,736条具有非空叙事且数据足以评估5年卒中结局的独特患者记录。为减少诊断提及导致的显式目标泄漏，在语义编码前使用基于词典的方法对卒中相关术语进行脱敏。
AI.result: 摘要仅报告队列构建与筛选规模：808,921条就诊级观察→102,736例独特患者记录；未提供模型判别力、校准度、AUC等性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论。研究意图是通過多模态融合与目标泄漏控制，提升初级保健前瞻性卒中风险分层的可行性；具体有效性需参考正文实验结果。

4b6beae6b4da61fb21a1645a921a1d1abd2489ec.title: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
4b6beae6b4da61fb21a1645a921a1d1abd2489ec.summary: Consistent multi-view object segmentation is critical for 3D perception and robotics, yet remains challenging under severe viewpoint and occlusion changes. Existing methods typically perform 3D instance segmentation on point clouds or rely on offline 2D mask-matching pipelines. However, 3D instance segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations, while offline 2D matching suffers from object identity ambiguity across frames. To leverage strong 2D and 3D priors jointly, we propose SAM-V (Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation). Instead of combining the two priors through post-hoc matching, SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into a 2D segmentation foundation model (SAM), trained end-to-end for cross-view instance prediction. SAM-V introduces a prompt-fusion mechanism that enriches sparse SAM prompt tokens with view-specific camera tokens and local VGGT features, making the prompt representation both view-aware and spatially grounded, together with a mask decoder that attends to dense 2D and 3D features. By conditioning the mask decoding directly on multi-view geometry, SAM-V produces consistent multi-view segmentation of a prompted object in a single forward pass without offline mask matching or explicit 3D reconstruction. On the IGGT 3D tracking benchmark, where consistent instance identity across frames directly determines performance, SAM-V improves overall IoU by 5 points and frame-level recall by 12 points on the ScanNet++ split over the state-of-the-art multi-view instance segmentation baseline and leads on all metrics in the zero-shot ScanNet split. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/gong208/SAM-V.git.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAM-V，将前馈几何模型 VGGT 的特征直接集成进 2D 分割基础模型 SAM，端到端训练实现跨视图一致的实例分割，无需离线掩码匹配或显式三维重建。
AI.motivation: 严重的视角变化与遮挡下实现一致的多视图物体分割是 3D 感知与机器人领域的关键难题。现有方法存在两大局限：基于点云的 3D 实例分割受限于稀少的 3D 标注；离线 2D 掩码匹配流程则面临跨帧物体身份歧义。作者希望联合利用强大的 2D 与 3D 先验来突破这些限制。
AI.method: SAM-V 不再通过事后匹配组合两种先验，而是将前馈几何模型（VGGT）的特征直接集成进 2D 分割基础模型（SAM），以端到端方式训练进行跨视图实例预测。其核心包含：(1) 提示融合机制，用视图特定的相机 token 和局部 VGGT 特征增强稀疏的 SAM 提示 token，使提示表示兼具视图感知与空间定位能力；(2) 掩码解码器，同时关注密集的 2D 与 3D 特征。通过将掩码解码直接以多视图几何为条件，SAM-V 在单次前向传播中即可产出所提示物体的一致多视图分割，无需离线掩码匹配或显式 3D 重建。
AI.result: 在 IGGT 3D 跟踪基准（跨帧一致的实例身份直接决定性能）上，SAM-V 在 ScanNet++ 划分上相较最先进的多视图实例分割基线，整体 IoU 提升 5 个点、帧级召回率提升 12 个点；在零样本 ScanNet 划分上所有指标均领先。代码与预训练模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将几何先验与 2D 分割基础模型端到端融合，SAM-V 证明了以多视图几何为条件直接驱动掩码解码的有效性，实现了单次前向的一致多视图实例分割，并在 3D 跟踪基准上显著超越现有方法，为多视图实例分割提供了新范式。

d921bff702c7f4afb9b2a4733b44adf9b1476ced.title: Angular momentum analysis on Karate roundhouse kicks: a longitudinal case study
d921bff702c7f4afb9b2a4733b44adf9b1476ced.summary: Human gait in reality extends beyond straight-line walking, with some situations even requiring drastic back-and-forth rotations. A smooth and stable execution may seem intuitive, but the underlying mechanics remains unknown. The Karate roundhouse kick may be an extreme case of exhibiting dynamic back-and-forth rotations, but investigating the angular momentum (AM) management can potentially inform stability analysis in dynamic human motions and smoother gait in robots and exoskeletons. This paper introduces two new AM-based measures and analyzes AM-related variables to study the target-less retractable back-leg Karate roundhouse kick. The purpose is to understand the underlying AM management, analyze the differences between stable and unstable kicks, and investigate how these variables and measures change over time with improvement. A one-year longitudinal study was conducted with the first author as a Karate student, and a Karate instructor was also recruited for one session as an expert, whose data is used for comparison. Results show that unstable kicks have higher peak total AM before Strike and smaller braking peak after Strike. The proposed AM-based measures are able to identify the cause of some unstable kicks, though no clear distinction could be made between stable and unstable kicks since kicks can be unstable for different reasons. Nonetheless, the proposed measures can be applied as performance measures to analyze other types of dynamic motions. To incorporate them as stability criteria, however, it is recommended to also consider their coordination with time, kinematics, and center of pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一年纵向研究，分析空手道无目标可收回后腿回旋踢中的角动量（AM）管理，提出两项基于角动量的指标，比较稳定与不稳定踢击，并考察指标随技术进步的时间变化。
AI.motivation: 真实人体步态不仅限于直线行走，还包含剧烈往复旋转，其力学机制尚不明确。空手道回旋踢可视为这类动态旋转的极端案例，研究其角动量管理有助于理解动态人体运动的稳定性，并为机器人和外骨骼实现更平滑步态提供依据。
AI.method: 提出两项新的基于角动量的指标，并分析角动量相关变量，研究对象为空手道无目标可收回后腿回旋踢。采用一年纵向研究，第一作者作为空手道学员参与；另招募一名空手道教练进行单次实验作为专家对照。
AI.result: 不稳定踢击在击打前具有更高的峰值总角动量，而击打后的制动峰值更小。所提基于角动量的指标能够识别部分不稳定踢击的原因，但由于不稳定踢击的成因不同，无法明确区分稳定与不稳定踢击。这些指标可作为性能度量用于其他动态运动分析。
AI.conclusion: 基于角动量的指标有助于分析动态人体运动中的角动量管理与稳定性，但若将其作为稳定性判据，建议同时考虑其与时间、运动学和压力中心的协调关系。

d7eafd34364ec119be9db595ff63ab90682da6bf.title: Mitigating Sequential Reappearance in Diffusion Data-Point Unlearning
d7eafd34364ec119be9db595ff63ab90682da6bf.summary: Diffusion data-point unlearning is typically evaluated immediately after each deletion, even though subsequent requests may repeatedly update the same model. We identify sequential reappearance, a failure mode in which an instance that is initially judged to be forgotten later returns to the memorized regime without reuse of the deleted data or adversarial fine-tuning. To capture this behavior, we introduce a target-level evaluation protocol that tracks whether each target is forgotten immediately, remains forgotten at the end of the sequence, or reappears during subsequent deletions. We further find that targets that later reappear exhibit sharper local denoising-loss geometry after deletion than targets that remain forgotten.

AI.tldr: 论文发现扩散模型数据点遗忘中的“顺序重现”失效模式：样本初次判定为遗忘后，会在后续删除更新中重新被记忆，并为此提出目标级评估协议与损失几何指标。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散数据点遗忘评估通常在每次删除后立即进行，忽略了后续删除请求会持续更新同一模型，因而无法反映遗忘状态的长期稳定性，可能高估遗忘效果。
AI.method: 提出目标级评估协议，对每个目标实例在完整删除序列中的状态进行追踪，区分三类结果：即时遗忘、序列结束仍保持遗忘、以及后续删除过程中重新出现；同时分析删除后目标的局部去噪损失几何特征。
AI.result: 识别出顺序重现现象：初始被判定为已遗忘的实例，在不复用被删数据、也不进行对抗微调的情况下，会随后续删除更新重新回到被记忆状态；且后续重现的目标在删除后表现出更尖锐的局部去噪损失几何。
AI.conclusion: 扩散数据点遗忘应从序列与目标级视角评估，不能仅依赖单次删除后的即时判断；局部去噪损失几何可作为预测顺序重现风险的潜在指标。

af90fff175c87c2b24905b792d276238ba8ef560.title: When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning
af90fff175c87c2b24905b792d276238ba8ef560.summary: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems. The right action often hinges on the latent relationship between people -- tie strength, reciprocity, mutual connections -- rather than on which content is most salient. Standard LLM agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's current social hypothesis, leaving them prone to surface-obvious choices when relational and content cues diverge. We formalize this failure mode with a relationship-reasoning benchmark: 500 synthetic social worlds with friendships, follows, reaction histories, and feeds, yielding 1,000 queries over two tasks, reaction selection and warm introduction (finding the best bridge to a target person). By construction, the surface-obvious candidate differs from the relationship-grounded oracle in about 53% of queries, forming an overturn subset where the agent must use relational evidence to revise an initially plausible choice. We propose ReAdapt (Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate), which augments the ReAct loop with an explicit structured social state z = (G, B, R, N, D) capturing goal, belief, relationship, norm, and disclosure. After each tool observation, ReAdapt runs a typed Adapt step that updates this state and emits a policy operation (continue, switch, abandon, or clarify) before choosing the next action. With Gemini-3-Flash on a stratified subset of n = 150 queries per task, ReAdapt improves warm-introduction accuracy from 37% to 51% (+14 points) and reaction-selection accuracy from 69% to 77% (+8 points). Oracle regret drops from 0.260 to 0.152 and from 0.095 to 0.053, respectively. Holding the model, tools, and environments fixed, these results suggest that explicit relational-state adaptation helps LLM agents turn retrieved social evidence into revised decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出关系推理基准与 ReAdapt 方法，让 LLM 社会智能体显式维护并更新关系状态，从而在内容线索与关系线索冲突时修正初始选择，提升反应选择与引荐任务准确率并降低 oracle 遗憾。
AI.motivation: 社会智能体的基础决策（是否回应帖子、该联系谁）并非纯内容问题，而依赖人际关系中的关系强度、互惠性、共同连接等潜在关系。标准 LLM 智能体循环未显式建模新关系证据如何修正当前社会假设，当关系线索与内容线索冲突时，容易选择表面显眼的候选。
AI.method: 构建关系推理基准：500 个合成社会世界，包含好友、关注、互动历史与信息流，生成 1,000 条查询，覆盖反应选择与温暖引荐（寻找通往目标人的最佳桥梁）两个任务；约 53% 查询中表面显眼候选与关系 grounded oracle 不同，构成需修正初选的反转子集。提出 ReAdapt（Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate），在 ReAct 循环中加入显式结构化社会状态 z=(G, B, R, N, D)，分别表示目标、信念、关系、规范与披露。每次工具观察后执行类型化 Adapt 步骤，更新状态并输出策略操作（继续、切换、放弃、澄清），再选择下一步动作。
AI.result: 在 Gemini-3-Flash 与每任务 n=150 的分层子集上，ReAdapt 将温暖引荐准确率从 37% 提升至 51%（+14 点），反应选择准确率从 69% 提升至 77%（+8 点）；Oracle regret 分别从 0.260 降至 0.152、从 0.095 降至 0.053。
AI.conclusion: 在固定模型、工具与环境条件下，结果表明显式的关系状态自适应有助于 LLM 智能体将检索到的社会证据转化为修正后的决策。

789f429b35e91ae9d0f26c980b51abb241fa1e15.title: RGSQ: Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
789f429b35e91ae9d0f26c980b51abb241fa1e15.summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can be efficiently deployed under stringent memory and latency constraints through post training quantization (PTQ). However, most PTQ methods are designed for unimodal large language models (LLMs). These methods treat quantization errors as isotropic perturbations under the Euclidean assumption, which provides weak guidance on directions most sensitive to quantization in VLMs. Consequently, directly adapting unimodal PTQ approaches or solely employing modality-specific scaling often leads to uneven bit-width distribution and inconsistent performance in low-bit settings. To address these challenges, we propose Riemannian Geometry-Sensitive Quantization (RGSQ), which formulates quantization as a reconstruction problem under a unified Fisher-Riemannian metric. RGSQ identifies modality-specific sensitive directions via Riemannian manifold mappings built from modality-partitioned empirical Fisher factors and fused into a modality-aware Kronecker-structured metric. We then apply geometry-aligned rotations to reorient the local tangent frame, steering low-bit perturbations toward loss-insensitive axes. Finally, we apply a whitening transformation that maps the Riemannian objective to an equivalent Euclidean form, enabling standard unimodal PTQ methods to evaluate multimodal quantization error under their original assumptions. Across an extensive and diverse set of mainstream VLM benchmarks, RGSQ achieves the highest accuracy and stability under extremely low-bit settings (W2A8 and W3A8). It outperforms VLM-aware baselines, such as MBQ and MQuant, by up to 5.9% and surpasses single-modality improvements by up to 8.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出RGSQ，将VLM低比特PTQ建模为统一Fisher-Riemannian度量下的重构问题，通过模态敏感方向识别、几何对齐旋转与白化变换，使单模态PTQ方法可评估多模态量化误差，在W2A8/W3A8下取得最优精度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法多面向单模态LLM，将量化误差视为欧氏假设下的各向同性扰动，无法有效指导VLM中对量化最敏感的方向；直接迁移单模态PTQ或仅做模态特定缩放，会导致低位宽下bit分配不均、性能不一致。
AI.method: RGSQ：1）以模态分区的经验Fisher因子构建黎曼流形映射，识别模态特定敏感方向，并融合为模态感知的Kronecker结构化度量；2）施加几何对齐旋转，重定向局部切空间坐标架，使低比特扰动导向损失不敏感轴；3）采用白化变换将黎曼目标映射为等价欧氏形式，从而让标准单模态PTQ方法可在其原始假设下评估多模态量化误差。
AI.result: 在广泛且多样的主流VLM基准上，RGSQ在极低比特（W2A8、W3A8）下取得最高精度与稳定性；相较MBQ、MQuant等VLM感知基线最高提升5.9%，相较单模态改进最高提升8.6%。
AI.conclusion: RGSQ通过黎曼几何敏感的量化重构框架，有效弥合单模态PTQ与多模态VLM量化之间的假设差距，在极低比特下实现更优、更稳定的VLM压缩部署。

957c0e796a6703f31df94d2425b901104e545aea.title: PARTE: Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation for Point Cloud Registration
957c0e796a6703f31df94d2425b901104e545aea.summary: Global point-cloud registration remains challenging when limited overlap, repetitive geometry, and sensor noise produce correspondence sets dominated by outliers. Planar regions are particularly difficult for conventional point descriptors and are therefore often suppressed or discarded before matching. We present PARTE (Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation), a global registration method that instead treats planar structure as complementary registration evidence. PARTE extracts planar patches and represents them using our novel Plane Context Histogram (PCH), a descriptor that encodes the geometry surrounding each patch, while a two-level matching procedure identifies reliable plane correspondences. Candidate point and plane correspondences are combined in a confidence-weighted compatibility graph for joint outlier rejection, followed by rigid transformation estimation. When no usable plane correspondences are available, PARTE naturally reduces to point-only registration. We evaluate PARTE on 8,097 registration pairs across six indoor and outdoor benchmarks spanning dense RGB-D and sparse LiDAR measurements. Evaluations show PARTE achieves the highest overall success rate against 13 standard and state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low runtime. An open-source C++ implementation with Python bindings is provided at https://parte.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: 提出 PARTE：一种将平面结构作为补充配准证据的全局点云配准方法，通过平面上下文直方图（PCH）描述子、两级平面匹配以及置信度加权兼容图联合剔除点/面离群对应，在多个室内外基准上取得最高总体成功率且运行时间较低。
AI.motivation: 全局点云配准在有限重叠、重复几何和传感器噪声下，对应关系常被离群值主导；平面区域对传统点描述子不友好，通常被抑制或丢弃，导致可用配准信息减少。
AI.method: PARTE 提取平面块，并用新颖的 Plane Context Histogram（PCH）描述子编码每个平面块周围的几何结构；采用两级匹配筛选可靠平面对应。随后将候选点对应与平面对应统一到置信度加权兼容图中，进行联合离群剔除，再估计刚体变换。若无可用平面对应，方法自然退化为仅点云配准。
AI.result: 在六个室内外基准、涵盖密集 RGB-D 与稀疏 LiDAR 的 8,097 对配准数据上评估，PARTE 相较 13 种标准及 state-of-the-art 方法取得最高总体成功率，同时保持较低运行时间。提供开源 C++ 实现及 Python 绑定。
AI.conclusion: 平面结构不应被简单丢弃，而可作为全局点云配准的有效补充证据；PARTE 在鲁棒性、成功率和效率之间取得良好平衡，并具备开源可用性。

dfb760bcd02614c9265566d62ac9b173fe7f99f4.title: Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning for Enhanced Remaining Useful Life Prediction
dfb760bcd02614c9265566d62ac9b173fe7f99f4.summary: Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) is essential for effective predictive maintenance. Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (ST-GNNs), which can model both temporal and spatial relationships by representing time series data as a sequence of graphs, have shown exceptional performance in RUL prediction. However, current ST-GNNs face several drawbacks. First, they require domain expertise or significant computational power to establish graph structures prior to deploying GNNs. Second, the models are restricted to capture temporal dependencies within a predefined fixed-size lookback window. This restriction ignores the common issue of varying time series lengths, leading the prediction model to miss short-term or long-term dependencies. Finally, conventional models often fail to capture the inherent relationships between samples generated from adjacent time windows, which are crucial for improving both the accuracy and robustness of predictions. To address the aforementioned issues, we introduce a novel framework called Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning (MTFGN-SRL). Rather than treating the sample as a sequence of graphs, we consider it as a single complete graph and utilize a Fourier Graph Neural Network (FGN) to capture the spatio-temporal information in the frequency domain. We propose a multi-term learning module that utilizes multiple lookback windows to generate samples with varying terms, which are then fed into the FGN to enhance the extraction of useful information from the data. Finally, we develop a sample relationship learning module by training a heterogeneous GNN to identify inter-sample relationships, resulting in enhanced accuracy and robustness in predictions. Evaluations on the CMAPSS dataset demonstrate MTFGN-SRL's superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in RUL prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 MTFGN-SRL 框架，将样本建模为单张完整图并用傅里叶图神经网络在频域捕获时空信息，结合多窗口项学习与样本关系学习，在 CMAPSS 数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测对预测性维护至关重要。时空图神经网络（ST-GNN）通过将时间序列表示为图序列，能同时建模时间与空间关系，表现优异，但现有方法存在三大缺陷：1）部署前需依赖领域专家或大量算力预先构建图结构；2）受限于固定大小回看窗口内的时序依赖建模，忽略了时间序列长度变化问题，导致遗漏短期或长期依赖；3）传统模型难以捕捉相邻时间窗口生成样本之间的内在关系，而这关系对提升预测精度与鲁棒性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 MTFGN-SRL（Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning）框架。1）不再将样本视为图序列，而是视为单张完整图，利用傅里叶图神经网络（FGN）在频域捕获时空信息；2）设计多窗口项学习模块，使用多个回看窗口生成不同项的样本并输入 FGN，增强有用信息提取；3）构建样本关系学习模块，训练异构图神经网络识别样本间关系。
AI.result: 在 CMAPSS 数据集上的评估表明，MTFGN-SRL 在 RUL 预测任务上性能优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: MTFGN-SRL 通过频域时空建模、多窗口项学习与样本关系学习的结合，有效克服了传统 ST-GNN 在图结构构建、固定窗口限制及样本关系捕捉方面的不足，显著提升了 RUL 预测的精度与鲁棒性。

2c77fe80136d14dfbfbc77c4671f08f836890981.title: Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass
2c77fe80136d14dfbfbc77c4671f08f836890981.summary:
Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter.
  They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired gap tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. The extract step costs one forward; a head-by-head patch sweep costs about two orders of magnitude more.
  We are not claiming a complete circuit atlas. We are claiming a cheap sketch that carries real causal signal on known tasks, with clear failure modes when it does not. Code and evaluation artifacts are at https://github.com/Aquinf03/live-circuit-routing.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种低成本电路发现方法：将注意力视为单次前向传播中的路由图，保留指向答案的少量路由，并通过消融验证其因果重要性。在归纳头和IOI等已知电路任务上，提取边消融对模型的伤害显著大于同规模随机边消融，成本仅一次前向传播。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型电路发现通常需要大量精心设计的干预实验，成本高、流程复杂。作者希望探索一种更简单、更廉价的替代方案，即从单次前向传播中直接提取可能重要的注意力路由，并验证这些路由是否具有真实因果作用。
AI.method: 将注意力解释为路由图，从一次前向传播中提取指向答案的一小组路由（边），然后对这些提取边进行消融，并与同规模随机边消融进行对比。在GPT-2 Small、GPT-2 Medium和Pythia-410M上，每个实验单元使用n=100条提示，采用配对gap检验和bootstrap置信区间评估。
AI.result: 在归纳（induction）和IOI等已有已知正确电路的任务上，消融提取边对模型性能的损害显著大于消融同规模随机边。提取步骤仅需一次前向传播，而逐头patch扫描的成本约高出两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 作者不声称构建了完整的电路图谱，而是提出一种廉价的“草图”方法：在已知任务上能携带真实因果信号，同时存在明确的失效模式。代码与评估工件已公开。

d1f3de88272f8e51b0d4ae79519ecdef47376f4c.title: mbariml: a curation pipeline for turning deep-sea imagery and video into object-detection training data
d1f3de88272f8e51b0d4ae79519ecdef47376f4c.summary: Training data quantity and quality greatly affect object detection model performance, regardless of model architecture. When using object detection models on video and images from the deep sea, in which the objects of interest, primarily organisms, are sparse, faint, and hard to identify, incremental improvements to object detector performance may require an iterative approach to data labeling and management. This paper presents mbariml, a python-based video and image analysis pipeline built around the data labeling management process. mbariml uses an Ultralytics YOLO detection model, runs it over still images or video, stores every detection as a reviewable region of interest, groups those regions by visual similarity so that a human can accept or reject them in bulk, and exports the result as training data, statistics, image sidecars, and additional metadata. The human review stage is the centre of the design: an annotator can validate, relabel, resize, delete, and draw entirely new localizations, and every one of those edits is written back to the same database the detector wrote to. Video receives particular attention: the software treats each tracker-produced track as a provisional observation and selects one representative frame instead of retaining every detection in the track. We describe the pipeline stage by stage, including the operational middle-third heuristic used for track observation selection.

AI.tldr: 提出 mbariml：一个以人工复核为中心的 Python 视频/图像分析流水线，用 Ultralytics YOLO 做检测，将检测结果存为可复核 ROI，按视觉相似度分组批量审核，并把人工编辑回写数据库，最终导出训练数据、统计、图像 sidecar 与元数据。
AI.motivation: 目标检测性能高度依赖训练数据的数量与质量，与模型结构无关。深海视频和图像中目标（主要是生物）稀疏、微弱且难以识别，检测器性能提升需要迭代式数据标注与管理流程。
AI.method: mbariml 基于 Ultralytics YOLO 检测模型，对静态图像或视频运行推理；将每个检测保存为可复核的感兴趣区域（ROI）；按视觉相似度对 ROI 分组，支持人工批量接受或拒绝；人工复核阶段可验证、重标注、调整尺寸、删除并绘制全新定位框，所有编辑均回写到检测器写入的同一数据库。视频处理中，将跟踪器生成的每条轨迹视为临时观测，不保留轨迹内所有检测，而是选取一个代表帧，并采用“中间三分之一”启发式进行轨迹观测选择。
AI.result: 论文逐阶段描述了该流水线，包括轨迹观测选择所用的操作性“中间三分之一”启发式；系统可导出训练数据、统计信息、图像 sidecar 及附加元数据。摘要未给出定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 以人工复核为核心的迭代标注与管理闭环，有助于在深海等稀疏、微弱目标场景中持续积累高质量训练数据，并支持检测器性能的增量式改进。

10fa8b1c375879874f8a9ad056914a6b7a3f5e06.title: VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
10fa8b1c375879874f8a9ad056914a6b7a3f5e06.summary: Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration. We introduce \textbf{VLAQuantBench}, a controlled evaluation with 409 runs and 94,574 simulation episodes: four models on LIBERO, with X-VLA additionally evaluated on three simulation benchmark families. Under uncalibrated W4A4 round-to-nearest quantization, expanding a $π_{0.5}$ action-head subset from 126 to 167 layers raises success from 7.0\% to 70.5\%. Fixed-observation replay confirms a corresponding numerical recovery. Two-episode calibration removes the severe joint failures in the tested subsets, whereas the same smoothing-and-clipping recipe lowers $π_0$ success and does not recover OpenVLA-OFT end-to-end. For OpenVLA-OFT, protecting one 28,672-parameter output projection instead restores near-baseline success: the remaining 441 eligible linear layers retain W3 on LIBERO-Long or eight-bit activations across all four suites. Task-clustered intervals support the large failure and recovery contrasts. These results establish recipe-dependent interactions and identify concrete precision assignments, rather than universal layer-sensitivity rules. Real-kernel and physical-robot measurements complement the accuracy analysis. Code, configurations, and episode records are publicly available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/VLAQuantBench.

AI.tldr: VLAQuantBench 对 VLA 模型训练后量化进行受控评测，发现精度选择取决于层范围、数值格式与校准方法的交互，并给出具体可行的量化配置。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型内存开销大，训练后量化可降低需求；但现有精度选择常忽略层范围、数值格式与校准之间的交互，缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 VLAQuantBench：409 次运行、94,574 个仿真 episode；在 LIBERO 上评测四个模型，X-VLA 额外覆盖三类仿真基准；控制层范围、数值格式与校准策略，并进行固定观测回放、任务聚类区间分析、真实内核与物理机器人测量。
AI.result: 未校准 W4A4 RTN 下，π0.5 动作头子集从 126 层扩至 167 层，成功率由 7.0% 升至 70.5%；固定观测回放证实数值恢复。两 episode 校准消除测试子集中的严重联合失败；同一平滑裁剪配方会降低 π0 成功率，且不能端到端恢复 OpenVLA-OFT。对 OpenVLA-OFT，保护一个 28,672 参数输出投影即可恢复接近基线成功率，其余 441 个线性层在 LIBERO-Long 保持 W3 或四个套件均用 8-bit 激活。
AI.conclusion: 量化效果是配方依赖的交互结果，而非通用层敏感规则；研究给出了具体精度分配方案，并用真实内核和物理机器人结果补充精度分析。

2ade63ef1d15986e1121fd4dfda35cb2623d031d.title: Trains but Doesn't Learn: A Post-Training Delivery Benchmark for LLM Agents as Forward-Deployed Engineers
2ade63ef1d15986e1121fd4dfda35cb2623d031d.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
2ade63ef1d15986e1121fd4dfda35cb2623d031d.summary: Post-training is becoming a service (PTaaS): a customer hands an operator data and a goal, and a forward-deployed engineer (FDE) returns a fine-tuned, evaluated, and deployed model under a budget, a human-approval gate, and reproducibility requirements. Seating an LLM agent in the FDE seat raises a question existing benchmarks cannot answer: not whether an agent can raise a metric, but whether it can be trusted to deliver. We answer it on a governed delivery plane, where an agent drives ten stages and an oracle scores each stage from platform-recorded facts. The central silent failure is the run that trains but does not learn (TBDL): loss falls, every signal stays green, and the delivered model is no better than the base. An operator-run acceptance gate catches every such run before payment, and a detector calibrated on known-corrupted runs flags severe corruption mid-run. We ran four frontier agents (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6-luna, Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek V4-Pro) end to end on metered L40S, A100, and H200 GPUs across 8B to 70B open bases, certifying every scenario before scoring. We also ran a human FDE arm under the same oracle and compare every agent against it.

AI.tldr: 提出“后训练即服务”（PTaaS）与受治理交付平面，用十阶段、事实驱动的oracle评估LLM agent能否可信地完成微调、评估与部署；核心风险是“训练了但没学到”（TBDL）的静默失败，并用验收门与校准检测器拦截。四个前沿agent在L40S/A100/H200、8B–70B开源基座上端到端运行，并与人类FDE对照。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只回答agent能否提升指标，无法回答其能否在预算、人工审批门和可复现性约束下被信任交付。将LLM agent放入FDE席位后，交付可信性成为关键缺口，尤其是损失下降、信号全绿但模型未优于基座的TBDL静默失败。
AI.method: 构建受治理交付平面：agent驱动十个阶段，oracle依据平台记录事实逐阶段打分；运营方验收门在付款前拦截TBDL运行；基于已知损坏运行校准的检测器在运行中标记严重损坏。所有场景先认证后评分。四个前沿agent（Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6-luna、Gemini 3.7 Flash、DeepSeek V4-Pro）在计量的L40S、A100、H200上跨8B–70B开源基座端到端运行，并设人类FDE基线在同一oracle下对比。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值指标；实验设置覆盖四类前沿agent、三种GPU、8B–70B开放基座，并包含人类FDE对照臂。作者声称验收门可捕获所有TBDL运行，校准检测器可在运行中标记严重损坏，所有场景在评分前均通过认证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把PTaaS中的可信交付形式化为可审计、可验收的交付问题，突出TBDL这一静默失败模式，并提出oracle评分、验收门与校准检测器相结合的治理机制。通过agent与人类FDE同oracle对比，为衡量agent能否替代或辅助FDE交付提供框架；具体通过率、成本、时延与检测指标仍需正文数据验证。

da55ed02c1893ba7a4ff10c1a2cc05f870c1f0d2.title: Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents
da55ed02c1893ba7a4ff10c1a2cc05f870c1f0d2.summary: Structured-data agents in enterprise settings must reason over complex data environments whose relevant evidence is distributed across schemas, relationships, policies, and recurring business roles. Modern agentic systems often address this burden through reusable markdown-style memory or skill files that preserve previously discovered information for later queries, reducing the need to rediscover the same structure repeatedly. This is useful, but it obscures a natural division of labor: agents are well suited to semantic reasoning, while learned systems are well suited to predicting and organizing recurring structure. We introduce latent equivalence learning to bridge this gap. The framework separates persistent task-relevant identities from their dataset-relative realizations. In our realization, supporting and opposing evidence shape support-realized Gaussian prototypes that learn how those identities are expressed in a particular data environment, while soft-membership profiles retain distinctions lost under a hard assignment. A separate learned query-prototype system represents recurring evidential requirements and maps them through a learned compatibility function into the same persistent identity structure. This identity-factorized, query-conditioned routing materializes the relevant dataset-specific evidence for downstream reasoning, allowing the agent to operate over an already organized evidential state rather than reconstructing cross-schema structure at every query. On the Data Agent Benchmark, spanning 54 queries across 12 heterogeneous datasets, our full implementation achieves 94.67% dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 over five complete trials and 258/270 successful raw query attempts, compared with 55.51% for the benchmark's Claude Opus 4.6 reference agent, ranking first among 40 leaderboard entries at submission.

AI.tldr: 提出潜在等价学习框架，将持久化任务身份与数据集相关实现解耦，通过原型与查询条件路由组织证据，在Data Agent Benchmark上以94.67%数据集宏平均分层Pass@1取得榜首。
AI.motivation: 企业结构化数据智能体需在跨schema、关系、策略与业务角色的复杂环境中推理。现有基于可复用Markdown记忆/技能文件的方法虽能缓存已发现结构，却掩盖了自然分工：智能体擅长语义推理，学习系统擅长预测与组织重复结构。
AI.method: 提出潜在等价学习，分离持久化任务相关身份与其数据集相对实现。用支持与反对证据塑造“支持实现的高斯原型”以学习身份在特定数据环境中的表达，并用软隶属画像保留硬分配丢失的区分；另设可学习查询原型系统表示重复证据需求，经兼容性函数映射到同一持久身份结构。该身份因子化、查询条件化路由为下游推理物化相关数据集特定证据，使智能体基于已组织证据状态操作。
AI.result: 在Data Agent Benchmark（54个查询、12个异构数据集）上，完整实现五次完整试验取得94.67%数据集宏平均分层Pass@1，原始查询尝试258/270成功；基准Claude Opus 4.6参考智能体为55.51%；提交时在40个排行榜条目中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 身份因子化与查询条件化路由能有效桥接结构化数据智能体的语义推理与学习系统结构组织能力，减少每次查询重建跨schema结构的需求，在异构数据集基准上显著优于参考智能体并达到领先水平。

4d7b564b2543c091ad3c26143df40e175144f1d4.title: SBMVTrack: Spike-Budgeted Multi-View Learning for Energy-Efficient UAV Tracking
4d7b564b2543c091ad3c26143df40e175144f1d4.summary: With sparse and event-driven computation, spiking neural networks show great potential for achieving accurate and energy-efficient UAV visual tracking. However, existing SNN-based trackers typically use spike firing rates only for energy evaluation and lack explicit optimization of actual spike activity. To address this, we propose SBMVTrack, a fully spiking framework for energy-efficient UAV tracking. SBMVTrack introduces Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting (EWSB). EWSB weights actual spike activity according to the computational cost of each spiking layer. It constrains the energy-weighted firing rate and saturation activity, thereby reducing redundant spike computations. To improve tracking performance under the spike budget constraint, we propose Masked Multi-View Target Modeling (MVTM). This method treats the initial template, online template, and search region from the same sequence as correlated temporal views. It enhances the robustness of target representations through cross-view feature completion and identity-consistency learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SBMVTrack effectively reduces the average spike firing rate and theoretical energy consumption. Meanwhile, it maintains competitive tracking performance, achieving a better accuracy-energy trade-off. The source code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出全脉冲框架 SBMVTrack，用于无人机视觉跟踪：通过能量加权脉冲预算（EWSB）显式约束脉冲活动，并用掩码多视图目标建模（MVTM）在预算约束下提升跟踪鲁棒性，实现更优的精度-能耗权衡。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因稀疏、事件驱动计算，在无人机视觉跟踪中具备高精度与低能耗潜力。但现有 SNN 跟踪器通常仅将脉冲发放率用于能耗评估，缺乏对实际脉冲活动的显式优化，导致冗余脉冲计算与能耗未得到有效控制。
AI.method: 提出 SBMVTrack 全脉冲跟踪框架，包含两个核心模块：1）Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting（EWSB）：依据各脉冲层的计算成本对实际脉冲活动加权，约束能量加权发放率与饱和活动，从而减少冗余脉冲计算；2）Masked Multi-View Target Modeling（MVTM）：将同一序列中的初始模板、在线模板与搜索区域视为相关时序视图，通过跨视图特征补全与身份一致性学习增强目标表征鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，SBMVTrack 能有效降低平均脉冲发放率与理论能耗，同时保持有竞争力的跟踪性能，取得更优的精度-能耗权衡。源代码将在录用后发布。
AI.conclusion: SBMVTrack 通过显式脉冲预算优化与多视图目标建模，弥补了现有 SNN 跟踪器仅评估能耗而不优化脉冲活动的不足，为无人机视觉跟踪提供了更节能且性能可竞争的全脉冲解决方案。

3b81da6870472884b637619593af97a4be3f196f.title: Norm2Tex: Augmenting Visuo-Tactile Simulations with Texture
3b81da6870472884b637619593af97a4be3f196f.summary: Large-scale datasets are essential for training generalist robot control policies. Collecting real-world tactile data is costly and time-consuming, motivating the use of tactile simulations. However, current tactile simulators capture only overall contact geometry and miss fine details like texture. This results in a significant domain shift between simulated and real tactile data. To address this gap, we introduce Norm2Tex, a plug-in method that augments simulations of vision-based tactile sensors with high-frequency surface details from normal map textures. By modifying the target object's depth map before a tactile simulator's rendering pipeline, Norm2Tex seamlessly integrates into different tactile simulators. We also evaluate sim-to-real transfer using material classification and a reinforcement learning task. Our results show that Norm2Tex preserves material-dependent tactile information across domains, improving texture recognition and producing material-dependent control behavior in the real world.

AI.tldr: Norm2Tex：一种将法线贴图纹理的高频表面细节注入视觉触觉仿真的插件式方法，以缩小仿真与真实触觉数据的域差距，并提升材质分类与强化学习任务的仿真到现实迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据对通用机器人控制策略至关重要，但真实触觉数据采集成本高、耗时长，因此需要触觉仿真。然而现有触觉仿真器仅能刻画整体接触几何，缺失纹理等精细细节，导致仿真与真实触觉数据之间存在显著域偏移。
AI.method: 提出 Norm2Tex，一种插件式方法：在视觉触觉仿真器的渲染流程之前修改目标物体的深度图，将法线贴图纹理中的高频表面细节增强到触觉仿真中，从而可无缝集成到不同触觉仿真器。并通过材质分类和强化学习任务评估仿真到现实迁移。
AI.result: 实验表明，Norm2Tex 能在跨域场景中保留与材质相关的触觉信息，提升纹理识别性能，并在真实世界中产生依赖材质的控制行为。
AI.conclusion: Norm2Tex 通过引入高频纹理细节有效缓解触觉仿真的域偏移问题，且具备良好的通用集成性，为视觉触觉传感器的仿真到现实迁移提供了可行方案。

d70f732684ec9bdc9cb814de96e198a07f082c23.title: Correcting Within-Group Self-Selection Bias in Prioritized Replay
d70f732684ec9bdc9cb814de96e198a07f082c23.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)
d70f732684ec9bdc9cb814de96e198a07f082c23.summary: Prioritized experience replay (PER) improves sample efficiency by replaying high-priority transitions, usually according to absolute temporal-difference error. In stochastic environments, PER can distort the distribution of realized outcomes replayed from transitions with the same state-action pair. We call this within-group self-selection. We quantify the resulting changes in within-group outcome frequencies and mean Bellman targets. We decompose PER into between-group allocation and conditional sibling selection, and derive fixed-buffer corrections that preserve current group-level priority mass: SAMPLE selects a group through PER and trains on a uniformly sampled sibling; AVG averages sibling Bellman targets; and MODEL samples from an empirical full-outcome model. In exact state-action environments with rare high-magnitude outcomes, sibling-aware replay improves learning efficiency over PER, although matched parameter sweeps show that tuning can narrow some gaps. In MinAtar, approximate VQ-VAE groups with SAMPLE mitigate degradation under mean-preserving reward tails in four of five games. Sibling-aware replay thus retains the focus on high-priority state-action regions while recovering their empirical outcome frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"组内自选择"问题，指PER在随机环境下会扭曲同一状态-动作对内结果分布，并给出SAMPLE、AVG、MODEL三种修正方法。
AI.motivation: 优先经验回放（PER）依据绝对时序差分误差重放高优先级转移以提升样本效率，但在随机环境中，同一状态-动作对下不同结果会被按优先级挑选，导致被重放结果的分布偏离真实经验分布。作者将这一现象命名为"组内自选择"，并希望量化其对组内结果频率与平均Bellman目标的影响。
AI.method: 将PER分解为组间分配与条件兄弟选择两部分，在固定缓冲区下推导保持当前组级优先级质量的修正。提出三种方法：SAMPLE按PER选组后再均匀采样组内兄弟样本；AVG对兄弟样本的Bellman目标取平均；MODEL从经验全结果模型采样。并在精确状态-动作环境与MinAtar（用VQ-VAE近似分组）中验证。
AI.result: 在存在稀有高幅结果的精确状态-动作环境中，兄弟感知回放相比PER提升了学习效率，但匹配参数扫描显示调参可缩小部分差距。在MinAtar中，SAMPLE配合近似VQ-VAE分组，在五个游戏中的四个缓解了均值保持奖励尾部下的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 兄弟感知回放能够在保持对高优先级状态-动作区域关注的同时，恢复其经验结果频率，从而修正PER在随机环境下的组内自选择偏差。

4a446facf657668b827b474029642b61e8b3be5b.title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
4a446facf657668b827b474029642b61e8b3be5b.summary:
On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows.
  We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing it. A candidate declares the region of input space it claims, so the common case runs as a script and the rest falls through to reasoning. Four gates of ascending cost admit candidates; the central one tests a candidate's execution trace against a retained reference, within a tolerance measured from that reference's own run-to-run variability.
  On text-to-SQL, three of four reasoning arms reproduced their own output on 11 to 13 of 42 repeated questions and the fourth on 26 of 42, while a habit-formed variant reproduced on all 456 dispatches we repeated and was non-inferior to every arm it replaced (p<0.0001). It also used 14% to 56% fewer tokens, turning net positive after 7 to 53 reuses.
  We measured what this costs in accuracy. The guard admitted work it should have deferred on 2.6% of natural paraphrases and 26% of inputs near its boundary, and 11 of 13 such failures were invisible to the trace-conformance gate at any threshold. Deterministic errors repeat exactly: a bad habit is as reliable as a good one, and that is the price of the property that makes the system auditable. Separating routing from parameter extraction raised end-to-end accuracy from 0.888 to 0.952 at 43% of the cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"技能习惯养成"（skill habit formation）方法：智能体从自身执行历史中挖掘确定性的候选技能，通过四级递进成本的"门"筛选后投入使用，以提升重复任务的一致性与效率，代价是确定性错误会被稳定复现。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在重复任务上不一致：42项任务各运行三次，视模型不同有38%–74%的答案互相不一致，而买方、审计方或监管方恰恰要求一致性。同时智能体存在严重浪费，生成内容的95.3%–97.2%用于重新推导系统已知的计划。
AI.method: 技能习惯养成：智能体从自身执行历史中挖掘候选技能，候选为确定性变体，与现有技能竞争而非直接替换；候选须声明其主张的输入空间区域，常见情况以脚本运行，其余回落到推理。采用四级递进成本的门控准入，核心门将候选执行轨迹与保留的参考轨迹比对，容差由该参考自身多次运行的波动性测得。此外将路由与参数抽取分离。
AI.result: 在text-to-SQL上，四个推理臂中三个在42个重复问题中仅11–13次复现自身输出，第四个为26次，而习惯化变体在重复的456次调度中全部复现，且对其替换的每个臂均非劣（p<0.0001）；token用量减少14%–56%，在7–53次复用后转为净收益。准确率方面：门控对2.6%的自然改写和26%的边界附近输入放行了本应推迟的工作，13个此类失败中有11个在任何阈值下都无法被轨迹一致性门识别；将路由与参数抽取分离使端到端准确率从0.888提升至0.952，成本为43%。
AI.conclusion: 确定性错误会被精确重复——坏习惯与好习惯一样可靠，这正是系统可审计性的代价。门控在边界附近仍有放行风险，且轨迹一致性门难以捕捉全部失败；但通过路由与参数抽取分离可显著提升准确率。

ab232262628e8e92195811d2b08d7a38f7e63e3c.title: Real-World Perception for Autonomous Driving in Adverse Weather: Enhancing Standard Detectors via Foundation-Guided Auto-Annotation
ab232262628e8e92195811d2b08d7a38f7e63e3c.summary: Standard deployment-ready object detectors for autonomous vehicles degrade in adverse weather and lighting conditions without being trained on extensive domain-specific data. While large-scale vision foundation models offer robust zero-shot generalization, their high computational cost makes them impractical for real-time deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose a foundation-guided auto-annotation pipeline that enhances standard detectors without architectural changes. We first benchmark three distinct models, YOLOv8, Co-DETR, and SAM3, on our custom real-world driving dataset spanning 25 unique operational scenarios across various route, weather, and lighting conditions. Based on our analysis, SAM3 demonstrates superior accuracy and resilience across all scenarios. Thus, we deploy it as an offline auto-annotator to generate pseudo-labels on the unannotated subset of our dataset. Fine-tuning the baseline YOLOv8 on these annotations yields a 16.04% higher overall mean Average Precision (mAP) and improves cross-environmental stability compared to the baseline model, highlighted by a 32.73% and 28.65% mAP increase in Residential Direct Sunlight and Highway Fog, respectively. These results demonstrate that standard detectors can achieve environmental resilience without the need for extensive manual annotation or architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种“基础模型引导的自动标注”流程：在自定义真实驾驶数据集上对比 YOLOv8、Co-DETR 与 SAM3，发现 SAM3 在不同场景下精度与鲁棒性最佳，遂将其作为离线自动标注器生成伪标签，再微调 YOLOv8，从而在不改变检测器架构的情况下显著提升 mAP 与跨环境稳定性。
AI.motivation: 面向自动驾驶的部署级目标检测器在恶劣天气与光照条件下性能下降，除非使用大量领域特定数据训练；而大规模视觉基础模型虽具备强零样本泛化能力，却因计算成本高难以实时部署。因此需要一种兼顾精度、鲁棒性与实时部署可行性的方案。
AI.method: 作者构建了覆盖 25 种独特运行场景、包含不同路线、天气和光照条件的自定义真实驾驶数据集；首先对 YOLOv8、Co-DETR 和 SAM3 三个模型进行基准测试与对比分析；基于分析结果选择 SAM3 作为离线自动标注器，对未标注数据子集生成伪标签；最后用这些伪标签微调基线 YOLOv8。
AI.result: SAM3 在所有场景中表现出更高的精度与韧性。使用其伪标签微调 YOLOv8 后，整体 mAP 相比基线提升 16.04%，跨环境稳定性也有所改善；其中 Residential Direct Sunlight 场景 mAP 提升 32.73%，Highway Fog 场景提升 28.65%。
AI.conclusion: 标准目标检测器无需大量人工标注或架构修改，也能通过基础模型引导的自动标注与微调实现环境鲁棒性，从而在部署成本与实时性之间取得平衡。

d4b197f08d09c4d5823d24557ea1f90acf2ba6c8.title: Effects of Assistance Delay on Joint Mechanics and Energetics in Biological Torque Control of a Hip Exoskeleton
d4b197f08d09c4d5823d24557ea1f90acf2ba6c8.summary: Biological torque control directly maps an estimated human joint moment to exoskeleton assistance, providing a task-agnostic strategy for supporting diverse locomotor activities. However, it remains unclear whether a fixed state-to-torque mapping provides effective assistance across biomechanically distinct tasks. We examined how assistance delay affected hip exoskeleton performance during level-ground (LG), ramp-ascent (RA), and ramp-descent (RD) walking. Eight participants completed a zero-torque baseline condition and five active assistance conditions with delays ranging from 40 to 320 ms. Across tasks and active delays, assistance reduced net metabolic rate by 5.24%, positive biological hip joint work by 5.86%, and total lower-limb positive joint work by 1.68% (all p < 0.05). Assistance delay affected both joint-work outcomes (both p < 0.001) but not net metabolic rate. Mechanical unloading generally decreased with increasing delay, whereas metabolic benefits remained comparatively stable. Relative to the zero-torque condition, net metabolic rate decreased by 9.75% during LG and 7.20% during RA but increased by 1.23% during RD. We did not detect task-dependent differences in the delay response. Our findings indicate that biological torque mappings should be evaluated based on the target outcome and mechanical role of the assisted joint, and that predominantly positive-power assistance may not generalize to negative-work-dominant locomotion without modification.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察固定“状态—力矩”映射的生物力矩控制髋关节外骨骼在平地行走、上坡和下坡行走中的助力延迟效应。8名受试者完成零力矩基线和40–320 ms五种延迟助力条件。结果表明助力整体降低净代谢率、髋关节生物正功和下肢总正功；延迟显著影响关节功指标但不影响净代谢率，且下坡行走中代谢收益消失甚至恶化。作者认为生物力矩映射需依据目标结局和所助力关节的机械角色评估，正功主导助力策略未必适用于负功主导运动。
AI.motivation: 生物力矩控制通过将估计的人体关节力矩直接映射为外骨骼助力，是一种任务无关的控制策略，可支持多种运动任务。然而，固定状态—力矩映射是否能在生物力学上显著不同的任务中提供有效助力尚不明确，尤其是助力延迟对不同步态任务表现的影响缺乏系统证据。
AI.method: 研究纳入8名受试者，在髋关节外骨骼中完成零力矩基线条件以及5种主动助力条件，助力延迟范围为40–320 ms。受试者在平地行走（LG）、上坡行走（RA）和下坡行走（RD）三种任务下测试。主要评估指标包括净代谢率、生物髋关节正功以及下肢总正功，并分析延迟与任务对上述结局的影响。
AI.result: 跨任务和主动延迟条件，助力使净代谢率降低5.24%、生物髋关节正功降低5.86%、下肢总正功降低1.68%（均p<0.05）。助力延迟显著影响两项关节功结局（均p<0.001），但不影响净代谢率。随着延迟增加，机械卸载总体下降，而代谢收益相对稳定。相对于零力矩条件，净代谢率在平地行走中降低9.75%、上坡行走中降低7.20%，但在下坡行走中升高1.23%。未检测到延迟响应存在任务依赖性差异。
AI.conclusion: 生物力矩映射应根据目标结局以及被助力关节的机械角色进行评价。以正功为主的助力策略可能无法直接推广到负功主导的运动任务，若要在下坡等负功主导步态中取得代谢或力学收益，可能需要对控制映射或助力策略进行修改。

a2be0729eb395b6d97d134378e3d8fcde1b56f7b.title: Topological Signal Processing With Unoriented Operators
a2be0729eb395b6d97d134378e3d8fcde1b56f7b.summary: Topological signal processing (TSP) processes signals on simplicial complexes with oriented boundary operators, which is the natural choice for flow signals or when the topological invariants play a role for the task at hand. However, many higher-order signals carry no orientation, and applying oriented operators to them is not well-defined since it introduces an arbitrary choice of simplex orientation. We study an unoriented TSP (UTSP) framework that replaces oriented boundaries with unoriented incidence matrices. First, we show that unoriented incidence and Laplacian matrices between arbitrary simplicial levels admit graph-like spectral properties. Second, since dropping orientation removes the Hodge decomposition, we introduce an unoriented counterpart, termed interaction-order decomposition, which quantifies how much of a higher-order signal is explained by aggregating lower-order signals. Third, we use this decomposition to derive regularizers for signal reconstruction that penalize each interaction order separately. Experiments on real-world data show that the order-aware regularizers outperform oriented baselines, with the largest gains when the signal energy is unevenly distributed across orders.

AI.tldr: 提出无向拓扑信号处理（UTSP）框架，用无向关联矩阵替代有向边界算子，并引入 interaction-order decomposition 及阶别正则化器，在真实数据上优于有向基线。
AI.motivation: 拓扑信号处理（TSP）基于有向边界算子，是流信号或拓扑不变量相关任务的自然选择；但许多高阶信号本身无方向性，对其使用有向算子并不适定，因为会引入任意的单纯形方向选择。因此需要一个不依赖方向的高阶信号处理框架。
AI.method: 1）以无向关联矩阵替代有向边界算子，构建 UTSP 框架；2）证明任意单纯形层级间的无向关联矩阵与拉普拉斯矩阵具备类图的谱性质；3）由于去方向后失去 Hodge 分解，提出其无向对应——interaction-order decomposition，量化高阶信号由聚合低阶信号所能解释的程度；4）基于该分解导出对每种交互阶分别施加惩罚的重构正则化器。
AI.result: 实验（真实数据）表明，阶别感知（order-aware）正则化器优于有向基线；当信号能量在各阶之间分布不均衡时，增益最大。
AI.conclusion: UTSP 为无向高阶信号提供了适定且有效的处理框架；interaction-order decomposition 在失去 Hodge 分解后仍能刻画阶间结构，并可用于信号重构正则化，展现出实际优势。

529d7c180ebb34885a8cba51b569796315484235.title: Potential for Enhanced Learning in Machine Learning Classes by Using Wiki LLM Indexing
529d7c180ebb34885a8cba51b569796315484235.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as course-specific tutors, but their usefulness depends on grounding in vetted instructional materials that are often revised mid-semester. Our prior work built a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over an authentic machine learning course corpus (Foundations of Machine Learning) and found that retrieval improved contextual grounding, but that fixed retrieval strategies were suboptimal. That motivates a different question: whether how a corpus is structured at ingest time matters more than how much is retrieved at query time. We present a controlled head-to-head comparison of two knowledge representations over an identical classroom corpus: (A) vector RAG, replicating the best-performing configuration from our prior study, and (B) an LLM-compiled wiki (Karpathy framework), in which the corpus is synthesized at ingest into linked concept pages with explicit cross-references and citations back to source materials. We evaluate 59 questions spanning single-fact recall, cross-unit concept linking, synthesis and explanation, and currency after a syllabus revision, scored by an LLM judge against a human-authored rubric. Both representations answered single-fact questions about equally well (9.33 vs. 9.96 of 10), but diverged sharply on questions requiring links across course units. The compiled wiki remained accurate and grounded (9.93; 100% grounded in cited sources), while retrieval scored lower and was markedly less grounded (8.14; 64%). The wiki's citations let students and instructors trace any claim back to the lecture that introduced it, adding a layer of dynamic retrieval that machine learning courses require. While further testing is needed, instructors using AI to support learning in ML courses should consider wiki-based structure for its potential to support foundational elements of best practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了同一课程语料上的两种知识表示方式：向量RAG与LLM编译的wiki，发现二者在单点事实问答上表现相当，但在跨单元概念关联问题上，wiki在准确性与可溯源接地性上明显优于向量RAG。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益被用作课程专属辅导工具，但其有效性依赖于是否基于经过审核、且可能学期中途修订的教学材料。作者前期构建了面向真实机器学习课程语料的多模态RAG系统，发现检索能改善语境接地，但固定检索策略并非最优。由此引出核心问题：语料在“摄入阶段”的结构化方式，是否比“查询阶段”的检索数量更重要。
AI.method: 在完全相同的课堂语料上进行受控头对头比较，对比两种知识表示：(A) 向量RAG，复现前期研究中表现最佳的配置；(B) LLM编译的wiki（Karpathy框架），在摄入阶段将语料综合为相互链接的概念页面，并带有显式交叉引用与回溯原始材料的引文。评估59个问题，覆盖单一事实回忆、跨单元概念链接、综合与解释、以及教学大纲修订后的时效性；由LLM评委依据人工编写的评分量规打分。
AI.result: 两种表示在单一事实问题上回答水平相当（9.33 vs. 9.96，满分10）。但在需要跨课程单元建立联系的问题上差异显著：编译wiki保持准确且接地（9.93，100%有引文来源支撑）；向量RAG得分更低且接地性明显不足（8.14，64%）。wiki的引文使学生和教师能够将任何陈述追溯到首次引入该内容的讲座，形成机器学习课程所需的动态检索层。
AI.conclusion: 仍需进一步测试，但使用AI支持机器学习课程学习的教师应考虑基于wiki的结构，因为它在支持最佳实践的基础要素方面具有潜力。总体而言，语料摄入阶段的知识结构化方式可能比查询阶段的检索规模更关键，尤其在跨单元概念关联与可溯源接地方面。

c7247e5a96bfbf38dad8427cc449afabb9c0005c.title: Point Diffusion Mamba: Unified Diffusion-State-Space Modeling for Single-View 3D Reconstruction under Data Scarcity
c7247e5a96bfbf38dad8427cc449afabb9c0005c.summary: While single-view 3D reconstruction has seen significant progress, extrapolating complex 3D structures from inherently ambiguous 2D observations remains fundamentally ill-posed, particularly in the critically underexplored data-scarce regime. To address this challenge, we propose Point Diffusion Mamba (PDM), a method that integrates the generative power of diffusion models with the efficiency of state-space model for single-view 3D reconstruction under data-scarce conditions. Specifically, PDM employs a lightweight reconstruction module tailored to handle unordered point-cloud inputs effectively. By combining a Local Geometric Aggregation module with Mamba blocks, our approach jointly models global geometric structures and local details. In 3D reconstruction, each point in the initial noisy input requires a precise prediction, yet the high-level features extracted by the Mamba module capture only abstract semantic information from sparse points. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hierarchical Feature Integration Network, which fuses high-level semantic and local geometric features for each point, overcoming the limitations of token-based point-cloud reconstruction. Furthermore, we propose a Dynamic Weighted Sampling strategy that adaptively unifies 3D generation with single-view reconstruction by leveraging generative priors to enhance reconstruction quality. Experimental results on the ShapeNet and Pix3D benchmarks demonstrate that PDM outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing an effective solution for 3D reconstruction under data-scarce settings. Code is available at: https://github.com/NWUzhouwei/PDM.

AI.tldr: 提出Point Diffusion Mamba (PDM)，将扩散模型的生成能力与状态空间模型的高效性结合，用于数据稀缺条件下的单视图3D重建。
AI.motivation: 单视图3D重建虽已取得显著进展，但从本身具有歧义的2D观测中推断复杂3D结构本质上是病态问题，尤其在数据稀缺这一严重缺乏研究的场景下更具挑战。现有方法难以在数据不足时兼顾全局几何结构与局部细节的建模，且基于token的点云重建存在高层语义与逐点精确预测之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: PDM包含四个核心组件：(1) 轻量级重建模块，有效处理无序点云输入；(2) 局部几何聚合模块(Local Geometric Aggregation)结合Mamba块，联合建模全局几何结构与局部细节；(3) 分层特征融合网络(Hierarchical Feature Integration Network)，将高层语义特征与局部几何特征逐点融合，克服基于token的点云重建局限；(4) 动态加权采样策略(Dynamic Weighted Sampling)，自适应统一3D生成与单视图重建，利用生成先验提升重建质量。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D基准上的实验表明，PDM优于现有最先进方法，为数据稀缺条件下的3D重建提供了有效解决方案。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PDM通过融合扩散模型生成能力与状态空间模型效率，结合分层特征融合与动态加权采样，有效解决了数据稀缺下单视图3D重建的病态问题，兼顾全局结构与局部细节，取得领先性能。

076897091e84054a4a0c50b88426db2c3864aaeb.title: REDACT: Robust Perceptive Locomotion under Unseen Visual Corruption
076897091e84054a4a0c50b88426db2c3864aaeb.summary: Depth-conditioned locomotion policies have demonstrated impressive agile maneuvers, but can be steered to unpredictable actions when observations are outside their training distribution. Occlusion, invalid returns, sensor noise, and visual distractors can shift deployment observations away from nominal simulated depth. While synthetic sensor augmentation targets specified degradations, it does not by itself define behavior under corruption families omitted from training. To address gaps in training-time coverage, we present REDACT (Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal), a teacher-student framework combining an improved visual encoder architecture, persistent feature masking, and a novel consensus-gating algorithm to retain useful depth information under unmodeled corruption. The gate uses approximate conformal calibration on clean observations alone, requiring no prior knowledge of the corruption type. Trained on clean simulated depth, REDACT retains useful visual information under unseen corruption, supporting higher traversal success than existing parkour baselines. Evaluation of depth augmentation across corruption families further shows that REDACT improves robustness where augmentation coverage is missing. Real-world trials demonstrate zero-shot transfer to structured and forested environments with unfamiliar scene content.

AI.tldr: REDACT是一个教师-学生框架，通过改进视觉编码器、持续特征掩码与共识门控算法，在仅用干净仿真深度训练的条件下，提升深度条件运动策略对未建模传感器退化的鲁棒性，并实现结构化与森林环境的零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 深度条件运动策略虽能实现敏捷动作，但部署观测一旦偏离训练分布，如遮挡、无效回波、传感器噪声和视觉干扰，策略可能产生不可预测行为。合成传感器增强通常只针对指定退化类型，无法定义训练中未覆盖的退化族下的行为，因此存在训练时覆盖缺口。
AI.method: 提出REDACT（Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal）教师-学生框架，包含：改进的视觉编码器架构、持续特征掩码（persistent feature masking），以及一种新的共识门控算法，用于在未建模退化下保留有用深度信息。该门控仅基于干净观测进行近似共形校准（approximate conformal calibration），无需预先知道退化类型；模型仅在干净仿真深度上训练。
AI.result: 在未见退化下，REDACT能保留有用视觉信息，穿越成功率高于现有跑酷基线。对多种退化族的深度增强评估表明，在增强覆盖缺失处REDACT仍能提升鲁棒性。真实世界试验显示，其可零样本迁移到具有陌生场景内容的结构化环境和森林环境。
AI.conclusion: REDACT通过训练时覆盖补强与不确定性门控，缓解了深度条件运动策略对未建模退化的脆弱性，为复杂真实环境中的鲁棒穿越与仿真到现实迁移提供了有效方案。

6175364dbd53d2bc7da6ebb9539cb05bd6dd53d1.title: Spatiotemporal Kronecker Covariance Neural Networks
6175364dbd53d2bc7da6ebb9539cb05bd6dd53d1.summary: Multivariate time series contain complex patterns that span across both space and time. While covariance-based statistical tools like spatiotemporal Principal Component Analysis (ST-PCA) help identify these patterns, they are limited to linear operations and prone to estimation errors with limited data. Recent covariance-based spatiotemporal neural networks offer more stable, non-linear alternatives, but they ignore correlations across different time steps. To solve this, we introduce the Kronecker coVariance Neural Network (KVNN), a temporal graph neural network that represents the spatiotemporal covariance matrix via a sum of Kronecker products where spatial and temporal dependencies are decoupled. By implementing filtering operations on spatial and temporal components, KVNNs achieve expressive processing capabilities, admit a rigorous spectral analysis, and are provably stable to finite-sample estimation errors, ultimately addressing all of ST-PCA's limitations. We show on five real-world datasets that KVNNs achieve strong forecasting performance, often requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters than competitive methods, and are consistent under estimation noise.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Kronecker coVariance Neural Network (KVNN)，一种时空图神经网络，用 Kronecker 乘积之和表示时空协方差矩阵，将空间与时间依赖解耦，并通过空间/时间滤波实现非线性、可谱分析且对有限样本估计误差稳定的预测模型。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列中存在跨空间和时间的复杂模式。传统 ST-PCA 等协方差统计工具只能处理线性关系，且在数据有限时易受估计误差影响；近期基于协方差的时空神经网络虽更稳定且具非线性，但忽略不同时间步之间的相关性。
AI.method: 提出 KVNN，将时空协方差矩阵建模为若干 Kronecker 乘积之和，使空间依赖与时间依赖解耦；在空间分量和时间分量上分别执行滤波操作，从而获得表达力强的处理能力，并支持严格的谱分析。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界数据集上，KVNN 取得较强预测性能，通常比竞争方法需要显著更少的可训练参数，并且在估计噪声下表现一致、稳定。
AI.conclusion: KVNN 通过 Kronecker 协方差解耦与时空滤波，理论上可证明对有限样本估计误差稳定，实践中兼顾预测精度与参数效率，克服了 ST-PCA 的线性与估计误差局限。

92199184aef614d8fde28ce98796ccb32c65e040.title: Clarification Is Not Correction: LLMs Fail to Let Go
92199184aef614d8fde28ce98796ccb32c65e040.summary: Dialogue failures in language models are usually framed as memory failures: context too long, summaries lossy, a constraint forgotten. We argue this misses a deeper problem: in many conversations the model does not forget, it commits too early. An ambiguous early turn collapses into a single hidden interpretation, and later clarification is filtered through that commitment. We call this early posterior collapse: unresolved user intent collapsing into a committed task state before ambiguity is resolved. We study it with controlled dialogue tasks in writing, planning, and coding using Gemini-2.5-Pro and Gemini-2.5-Flash. Across thousands of trials, the same information in different orders yields different outcomes, even when the final dialogue contains equivalent task-relevant information. This order effect suggests later clarification is treated as extra context rather than a corrective signal: it refines a stale task state without invalidating it. Coding tasks are especially vulnerable, suggesting early assumptions get embedded in structured artifacts such as interfaces and control flow. Standard prompting and memory strategies do not reliably help: summaries can collapse ambiguity, and chain-of-thought can reduce explicit wrong commitment in reasoning traces without improving final task success. These findings motivate uncertainty-preserving state management. If assistants cannot let go of early interpretations, robustness cannot rely on post hoc correction alone; it must keep ambiguous early turns from hardening into one task state. Assistants should hold tentative hypotheses while ambiguity remains, ask before executing when high-impact ambiguity persists, and rebuild from a revised state when later evidence invalidates an earlier reading. Rather than one prompting fix, we aim to redirect research for interactive LLMs from retaining more context toward preserving uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"早期后验坍缩"（early posterior collapse）概念：对话失败并非记忆失败，而是模型在歧义尚未解决时过早将用户意图固化为单一任务状态；后续澄清被当作补充上下文而非纠错信号，从而无法纠正陈旧状态。作者据此主张交互式LLM的研究应从"保留更多上下文"转向"保留不确定性"。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将语言模型的对话失败归因于记忆问题（上下文过长、摘要丢失信息、约束被遗忘）。作者认为这忽略了更深层的问题：在许多对话中模型并未遗忘，而是过早做出承诺——早期模糊轮次坍缩为单一隐藏解释，后续澄清被这一承诺所过滤。因此需要重新审视对话鲁棒性的根本成因。
AI.method: 在写作、规划、编码三类受控对话任务上，使用 Gemini-2.5-Pro 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash 进行数千次试验，通过改变同一信息的呈现顺序（在最终对话包含等价任务相关信息的前提下）来考察模型行为，并对比标准提示策略与记忆策略（如摘要、思维链）的效果。
AI.result: 相同信息以不同顺序呈现会产生不同结果，即便最终对话包含等价的任务相关信息，表明存在显著顺序效应：后续澄清被视为额外上下文而非纠错信号，仅是对陈旧任务状态的细化而非作废。编码任务尤其脆弱，说明早期假设被嵌入接口、控制流等结构化产物中。标准提示与记忆策略并不能可靠改善：摘要可能加剧歧义坍缩，思维链虽能减少推理轨迹中显式的错误承诺，却不能提升最终任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究动机指向"保留不确定性的状态管理"。若助手无法放弃早期解释，鲁棒性就不能仅依赖事后纠正，而须防止模糊的早期轮次硬化成单一任务状态。助手应在歧义存续期间保持试探性假设，在高影响歧义持续时先询问再执行，并在后续证据推翻早期解读时从修正后的状态重建。研究议程应从"保留更多上下文"转向"保留不确定性"，而非依赖单一的提示修复。

eb051fa7405d2b7eea704c516690d3b7333d355a.title: RootQuantV2: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Root-Trait Regression from Minirhizotron Imagery
eb051fa7405d2b7eea704c516690d3b7333d355a.comment: 20 pages (15 main + 5 references), 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at ECCV 2026. Code and weights: https://github.com/leakey-lab/RootQuantV2
eb051fa7405d2b7eea704c516690d3b7333d355a.summary: A lack of high-throughput phenotyping solutions for root traits in field-grown crops has severely constrained understanding and improvement of below-ground traits and processes. Minirhizotrons are the standard non-destructive root-phenotyping method in field environments. Computer vision solutions are needed to allow automated trait estimation at scale, but training data is scarce and human annotations are often inaccessible because they reside in proprietary software that only exports per-image scalar totals of root length and surface area. Nevertheless, large numeric archives of these root traits already exist. RootQuant showed that the traits can be predicted directly from the whole image by regression, thus removing manually traced masks from the pipeline; RootQuantV2 takes that idea further by replacing RootQuant's CNN backbone with a self-supervised ViT. We adapt a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 with a hybrid parameter-efficient scheme. Training only 11.9M parameters (3.78% of the model), RootQuantV2 achieves length and area $R^2$ of 0.950 and 0.930, respectively, while lowering length/area RMSE by 24.3%/20.7% over RootQuant. RootQuantV2 thus repurposes legacy numeric archives for high-throughput, automated root trait estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出RootQuantV2，用冻结DINOv3 ViT-L/16与参数高效适配，仅训练3.78%参数，直接从整图回归预测田间作物根系长度和面积，R²达0.950/0.930，RMSE较RootQuant降低24.3%/20.7%，实现利用既有数值档案的高通量根系表型估算。
AI.motivation: 田间作物根系性状缺乏高通量表型方案，严重制约对地下性状与过程的理解和改良。微根管（minirhizotrons）是田间标准无损根系表型方法，但规模化自动性状估计依赖计算机视觉，训练数据稀缺，且人工标注常保存在专有软件中，只能导出单图根长和表面积等标量汇总。与此同时，大量此类根系性状数值档案已经存在，亟需可直接利用这些存档的建模方法。
AI.method: RootQuantV2在RootQuant基础上进一步去除人工描摹掩膜流程，改为从整幅图像直接回归预测根系性状；其核心是将RootQuant的CNN骨干替换为自监督ViT。具体采用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-L/16，并设计混合参数高效适配方案，仅训练11.9M参数，占模型总量的3.78%。
AI.result: 在根系长度和面积预测上，RootQuantV2分别取得R²=0.950和0.930；相较RootQuant，长度和面积的RMSE分别降低24.3%和20.7%。
AI.conclusion: RootQuantV2表明，通过冻结自监督ViT与参数高效适配，可将既有数值档案重新用于高通量、自动化的根系性状估计，为田间根系表型提供可扩展方案。

b4776b73a670a24a187d706de82f71528108e21d.title: A bioinspired internal model-based online estimator for planar pursuit
b4776b73a670a24a187d706de82f71528108e21d.summary: Bioinspired feedback controls for pursuit, tracking, and collective motion are often expressed in terms of the relative configuration between interacting agents. In practice, however, onboard sensors may not directly provide all quantities required for feedback control, necessitating estimation of unobserved quantities. This paper develops a bioinspired internal model-based estimator for reconstructing those quantities from partial sensory observations and known self-motion. State reconstruction is posed as an optimization problem that treats the relative kinematics as constraints and minimizes the disagreement between the internal model outputs and measurements from onboard sensors. Pontryagin's Maximum Principle is used to derive the necessary optimality conditions. A forward-backward algorithm is used to provide a numerical solution and a moving horizon formulation is employed for online implementation. The estimator is evaluated numerically against classical state estimators. Real-time implementation of the proposed framework on robotic hardware is demonstrated through two pursuit strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种受生物启发的内部模型状态估计器，将相对运动学作为约束、以内部模型输出与机载传感器测量的一致度为目标进行优化，并用极大值原理、前向-后向算法和滚动时域实现实时估计，在机器人硬件上验证了两种追捕策略。
AI.motivation: 生物启发的追捕、跟踪与集群运动控制通常依赖交互个体间的相对构型，但实际机载传感器往往无法直接提供反馈控制所需的全部状态量，因此需要从不完整观测中估计未观测状态。
AI.method: 构建受生物启发的内部模型估计器，从部分感官观测和已知自运动重建所需相对状态；将状态重建建模为优化问题，以相对运动学为约束，最小化内部模型输出与机载传感器测量之间的不一致；利用庞特里亚金极大值原理推导最优性必要条件，采用前向-后向算法求数值解，并以滚动时域方式实现在线估计。
AI.result: 所提估计器与经典状态估计器进行了数值对比评估，并在机器人硬件上通过两种追捕策略完成了实时实现验证。
AI.conclusion: 该内部模型优化估计框架能够利用部分观测和自运动信息重建相对状态，具备在线实时运行能力，并可用于机器人追捕等生物启发控制任务。

dace5b00b21879ed8daef054f8b5c0c70ace3059.title: MT-ProtBERT: Multi-task Learning ProtBERT for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins Classification with Scarce Data
dace5b00b21879ed8daef054f8b5c0c70ace3059.summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) differ from folded proteins in that they are dynamic, lack a stable three-dimensional conformation, and have low sequence similarity between similar proteins. The conformational heterogeneity of IDPs - while beneficial for their diverse functions - limits the use of traditional experimental tools to determine their conformation. The experimental difficulty, along with low sequence similarity, results in data scarcity, and makes it difficult to classify/detect IDPs that are similar or dissimilar, a task relevant to understand biology and evolution. We address this challenge using Multi-task ProtBERT (MT-ProtBERT), a multi-task extension of ProtBERT tailored for low-data regimes. MT-ProtBERT integrates Dynamic Window Masking, a Multi-Scale 1D Convolutional classifier (MS-Conv1D), and auxiliary objectives that jointly optimize masked language modeling and biochemistry-informed tasks.
