We evaluate this framework on two tasks under limited data: (i) phosphorylation site prediction (S/T/Y) in short sequences and small datasets, and (ii) protein compaction prediction on two small datasets (684 and 530 sequences), including sequences comparable in length to typical disordered regions. MT-ProtBERT consistently outperforms PARROT, an RNN-based IDP-specific model, across all tasks. These results demonstrate that combining self-supervised and biochemistry-informed tasks, and multi-scale learning enables robust modeling of unstructured proteins under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多任务版 ProtBERT（MT-ProtBERT），通过融合动态窗口掩码、多尺度一维卷积分类器与生化先验辅助任务，在低数据条件下实现对内在无序蛋白（IDP）的稳健建模，并在磷酸化位点预测与蛋白致密性预测上超越 PARROT。
AI.motivation: 内在无序蛋白（IDP）具有动态、无稳定三维构象、序列相似度低等特性。其构象异质性虽利于多样功能，却限制了传统实验手段对其构象的测定；叠加低序列相似度导致的数据稀缺，使得对相似/不相似 IDP 的分类与检测极为困难，而该任务对理解生物学与进化具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出 MT-ProtBERT——面向低数据场景的 ProtBERT 多任务扩展。其核心组件包括：(1) 动态窗口掩码（Dynamic Window Masking）；(2) 多尺度一维卷积分类器（MS-Conv1D）；(3) 辅助目标，联合优化掩码语言建模（MLM）与生化信息驱动的任务。整体在有限数据下进行多任务学习。
AI.result: 在两个低数据任务上评估：(i) 短序列小数据集中的磷酸化位点预测（S/T/Y）；(ii) 两个小数据集（684 与 530 条序列，含与典型无序区长度相当的序列）上的蛋白致密性预测。MT-ProtBERT 在所有任务上一致优于基于 RNN 的 IDP 专用模型 PARROT。
AI.conclusion: 将自监督任务与生化信息驱动的任务相结合，并引入多尺度学习，能够在数据稀缺条件下对无序蛋白实现稳健建模。

fd3e18a03909c708b909603d5191486701f7e6c6.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
fd3e18a03909c708b909603d5191486701f7e6c6.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), September 2026. Code/ dataset available at the project repository and huggingface
fd3e18a03909c708b909603d5191486701f7e6c6.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is only meaningful if written reasoning causally constrains the answer. We introduce continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain, and forces the model to continue from the corrupted prefix. It measures how load-bearing a CoT is for the final answer, a behavioral notion distinct from mechanistic faithfulness. Across Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on GSM8K, MMLU, and BIG-Bench Hard, CoT load-bearingness tracks model-relative task difficulty: on easy tasks models silently bypass their own reasoning; on hard tasks they follow corrupted steps and propagate errors. A matched 2x2 analysis shows task difficulty dominates perturbation type: error propagation rises 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic, and a variance partition over 28,584 continuations attributes 98.8% of explained deviance to task difficulty versus 0.8% to perturbation type. Reasoning-specific RL suppresses error propagation and compresses the gradient. A four-variant judge-sensitivity analysis and blind two-annotator study (n=500) show the error-propagation vs. non-propagation label is invariant to judge prompt, with perfect inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa = 1.00). This gradient creates a structural problem for CoT-based oversight and AI safety monitoring: where the trace is easy to read it carries little signal, and where it matters errors propagate before a monitor can intervene. Linear probes on hidden states separate silent bypass, self-correction, and error propagation, but additive activation steering provides limited causal control, flipping only about 25% of error-propagation cases at best. Behavioral mode is readable but not reliably controllable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于续写的因果测试，用 ablation-patch 扰动一步推理、截断链并强制模型从被污染前缀继续生成，以衡量 CoT 对最终答案的“承载性”。在 Gemma-2-9B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 与 GSM8K、MMLU、BIG-Bench Hard 上发现：任务难度主导误差传播；简单任务模型会静默绕开自身推理，困难任务则会跟随被污染步骤并传播错误。这使 CoT 监督存在结构性风险：易读的推理信号弱，关键处错误又会在监控介入前传播。行为模式可线性探测读出，但激活干预控制有限。
AI.motivation: CoT 监控要真正有效，前提是书面推理对最终答案具有因果约束力；已有机械忠实性研究不足以回答“推理步骤是否实际支撑答案”这一行为问题，因此需要可操作、可复现的因果干预度量。
AI.method: 提出 continuation-based causal testing：对 CoT 中某一步进行 ablation-patch 干预，截断后续推理链，并强制模型从被污染的前缀继续生成，从而测量该 CoT 对最终答案的 load-bearingness。在 3 个模型与 3 个任务上测试，并进行匹配的 2x2 分析、对 28,584 条续写做方差分解、推理专用 RL 对比、四变体 judge 敏感性分析，以及 n=500 的盲评双标注者研究；另用隐藏状态线性探针和加性激活引导检验模式可读性与可控性。
AI.result: CoT load-bearingness 与模型相对任务难度一致：简单任务中模型静默绕开自身推理；困难任务中模型跟随被污染步骤并传播错误。2x2 分析显示任务难度主导扰动类型：从 GSM8K 到 BBH 多步算术，误差传播上升 16 倍；方差分解将 98.8% 的可解释偏差归因于任务难度，仅 0.8% 归因于扰动类型。推理专用 RL 抑制误差传播并压缩该梯度。误差传播/非传播标签对 judge prompt 不变，双标注者一致性完美（Cohen's kappa = 1.00）。线性探针可区分静默绕开、自我纠正与误差传播，但加性激活引导的因果控制有限，最多仅翻转约 25% 的误差传播案例。
AI.conclusion: 该梯度给基于 CoT 的监督与 AI 安全监控带来结构性问题：推理轨迹容易阅读时信号弱，真正关键时错误会在监控介入前传播。行为模式虽可由隐藏状态读出，但不能可靠控制，说明“可读”不等于“可控”。

2cd8f4899bfa24bff7fd06a8befb402ea0109faa.title: Agentic Building-Aware Satellite Gaussian Splatting for Auditable Urban DSM Reconstruction
2cd8f4899bfa24bff7fd06a8befb402ea0109faa.summary: Urban-scale 3D reconstruction from satellite imagery supports disaster response, city monitoring, and geospatial digital twins, yet neural rendering methods typically optimize average visual fidelity rather than the structures that analysts inspect first: buildings. We present an agentic building-aware satellite Gaussian Splatting workflow that uses Segment Anything-derived building masks as semantic priors and an Agentic Reconstruction Controller to select, verify, and record DSM reconstruction policies. On the DFC2019 JAX\_004 scene, building-aware weighting reduces building-region DSM MAE from 0.844 m to 0.806 m, showing that semantic priors can shift reconstruction capacity toward analyst-critical regions. A staged schedule provides a balanced operating point, improving full-scene MAE from 1.362 m to 1.349 m while retaining a building gain. Across four JAX scenes, the Agent selects validated policies for both general DSM and building-focused DSM objectives, and produces building-inventory metadata and per-scene decision records. The system combines semantic priors, policy selection, region-specific DSM metrics, and DSM-derived GIS surface products for auditable urban 3D analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种建筑感知的智能体卫星高斯泼溅工作流：以 SAM 建筑掩膜为语义先验，由 Agentic Reconstruction Controller 选择、验证并记录 DSM 重建策略；在 DFC2019 JAX 场景中同时改善建筑区域与全场景 DSM 精度，并输出可审计的建筑清单元数据与逐场景决策记录。
AI.motivation: 城市级卫星影像三维重建对灾害响应、城市监测和地理空间数字孪生很重要，但现有神经渲染方法通常优化平均视觉保真度，而非分析师首先关注的建筑结构，导致关键区域重建能力分配不足。
AI.method: 提出 agentic building-aware satellite Gaussian Splatting 流程：使用 Segment Anything（SAM）导出的建筑掩膜作为语义先验；引入 Agentic Reconstruction Controller 选择、验证并记录 DSM 重建策略；采用建筑感知加权与分阶段调度；使用区域特定 DSM 指标，并生成 DSM 衍生的 GIS 表面产品。
AI.result: 在 DFC2019 JAX_004 场景中，建筑感知加权将建筑区域 DSM MAE 从 0.844 m 降至 0.806 m；分阶段调度提供平衡工作点，将全场景 MAE 从 1.362 m 改善至 1.349 m，同时保留建筑增益。在四个 JAX 场景中，Agent 为通用 DSM 与建筑聚焦 DSM 目标选择经验证策略，并生成建筑清单元数据和逐场景决策记录。
AI.conclusion: 语义先验可将重建容量转向分析师关注的关键区域；结合策略选择、区域特定指标与 DSM 衍生 GIS 产品，可支持可审计的城市三维分析。

900b721ad1b29f877c17ccd5d4cdbb7c2fb1667c.title: Brace Yourself: Task-Conditioned Environmental Bracing for Forceful Humanoid Manipulation
900b721ad1b29f877c17ccd5d4cdbb7c2fb1667c.comment: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). 8 pages, 6 figures. Video demonstration: https://youtu.be/zPrGLxWJzI4. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
900b721ad1b29f877c17ccd5d4cdbb7c2fb1667c.summary: Forceful manipulation is challenging for humanoid robots because interaction forces can disturb whole-body balance. We introduce the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), which enables a humanoid to brace against the environment with one hand while performing forceful manipulation with the other. SHS optimises a task-conditioned support configuration that guides two synchronous reinforcement-learning policies, without human motion data or online whole-body trajectory planning. On a Unitree G1, SHS achieved usable contact forces up to 60 N, compared with a maximum sustained force of 13.5 N without environmental bracing, while substantially improving force tracking over a task-independent support configuration. The same policies generalised to different task regions without retraining. SHS therefore provides a simple mechanism for substantially extending humanoid forceful-manipulation capability.

AI.tldr: 提出"支撑手策略"(SHS)，让类人机器人用一只手撑住环境、另一只手施加有力操作，从而大幅提升施力能力。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人在执行强力操作时，交互作用力会干扰全身平衡，导致其施力能力受限。如何在不牺牲平衡的前提下实现有力操作，是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出支撑手策略(SHS)：机器人用一只手撑靠环境形成支撑，同时用另一只手执行强力操作。SHS 优化一个"任务条件化"的支撑配置，用以引导两个同步的强化学习策略；该方法无需人类运动数据，也无需在线全身轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 机器人上，SHS 可实现最高 60 N 的可用接触力，而无环境支撑时最大可持续力仅为 13.5 N；同时相比"任务无关"的支撑配置，显著提升了力跟踪性能。同一策略无需重新训练即可泛化到不同任务区域。
AI.conclusion: SHS 提供了一种简单机制，能显著拓展类人机器人的强力操作能力。

11ea7c44e1a30efeb40e4d67f3abec593de7f2eb.title: Concept Drift from a Causal Perspective
11ea7c44e1a30efeb40e4d67f3abec593de7f2eb.summary: Concept drift is a common phenomenon in real-world data streams, in which changes in the data-generating distribution can degrade predictive model performance. Most existing definitions characterize drift as changes in the joint distribution $P(\mathbf{x}, y)$, without distinguishing which component of the data-generating process has changed. In this work, we introduce a causal perspective on concept drift based on Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We propose a taxonomy that categorizes drift events by their causal origin, including changes in exogenous variables, endogenous mechanisms, confounders, and target-generating processes. Building on this framework, we develop an SCM-based data stream generator that simulates controlled mechanism-level drift events. Our experiments empirically characterize the distributional effects of each drift type and show that drifts with different causal origins induce distinct patterns of distribution shift and predictive behavior. Furthermore, by integrating causal discovery methods, we use our framework to construct data streams grounded in real-world dependency structures, enabling more realistic and informative evaluation scenarios. We also demonstrate that leveraging the generated data can improve downstream performance. These results highlight the importance of accounting for causal structure when studying and evaluating adaptive learning methods, and establish a foundation for causally-aware evaluation in non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 本文从因果视角重新审视概念漂移，基于结构因果模型（SCM）提出按因果来源分类的漂移分类法，并构建可控的机制级数据流生成器，验证不同因果来源的漂移会引发不同的分布偏移与预测行为。
AI.motivation: 现实数据流中概念漂移普遍存在，数据生成分布的变化会降低预测模型性能。然而现有定义大多仅将漂移刻画为联合分布 P(x, y) 的变化，未能区分数据生成过程中究竟是哪个组件发生了变化，缺乏对漂移因果来源的细粒度理解与评估手段。
AI.method: 作者基于结构因果模型（SCMs）提出概念漂移的因果视角，构建了一个按因果来源对漂移事件进行分类的分类法，涵盖外生变量变化、内生机制变化、混杂因子变化以及目标生成过程变化。在此框架上，设计了一个基于 SCM 的数据流生成器，用以模拟受控的机制级漂移事件；并整合因果发现方法，将数据流建立在真实世界的依赖结构之上。
AI.result: 实验刻画了每种漂移类型的分布效应，表明不同因果来源的漂移会诱发不同模式的分布偏移与预测行为；同时，基于真实依赖结构构建的数据流提供了更真实、更具信息量的评估场景，且利用生成数据能够提升下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了在研究与评估自适应学习方法时考虑因果结构的重要性，为非平稳环境中的因果感知评估奠定了基础。

2f221e627ccdb5b2a1154da7909562aae1eee974.title: Robust Failure, Conservative Repair: Textual Knowledge Distillation from Cross-Model Failures
2f221e627ccdb5b2a1154da7909562aae1eee974.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main track)
2f221e627ccdb5b2a1154da7909562aae1eee974.summary: Failure-based textual knowledge distillation aims to discover gaps in a model's knowledge by examining its task errors. The distilled knowledge can be useful for the reasoning of both this model ("source model") and other models. However, this transfer of knowledge may not be stable. We define a rule atom to be a standalone rule injected into a model's textual input at inference time. A rule atom can encode transferable task knowledge or model-specific reasoning patches that can confuse other models. Also, the injected rule atoms can be misapplied to unrelated cases, causing the model to incorrectly flip its answer based on irrelevant information. Building on a pipeline that distills training examples into task-specific cheat sheets that aid model reasoning, we examine when failure-derived rules can improve these cheat sheets. Our early experiment shows rule distillation from a single model's failures underperforms the baseline cheat sheet on non-source model families. This motivates Robust Failure, Conservative Repair (RFCR), a textual distillation procedure that derives rules from failures shared across models, sharpens their application boundaries using boundary cases, and abstains when no useful rule is found. On a 400-item BIG-Bench Hard task set, RFCR improves the baseline cheat sheets from 68.50% to 71.25% (+2.75 pp; 95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]) without performance degradation on previously correct cases. Ablations and cross-model diagnostics support that accuracy gains come from both new knowledge injection and strict rule-application control.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何将模型失败案例中的文本知识稳定地蒸馏为可注入推理的规则，提出 RFCR 方法，在 BIG-Bench Hard 任务上提升 cheat sheet 推理准确率且不损害原本正确样本。
AI.motivation: 基于失败的文本知识蒸馏可发现模型知识缺口，并有望同时帮助源模型和其他模型推理；但此类知识迁移并不稳定。论文将“规则原子”定义为推理时注入文本输入的独立规则，它可能包含可迁移任务知识，也可能包含模型特定的推理补丁，从而干扰其他模型；同时规则可能被误用于无关案例，导致模型基于无关信息错误翻转答案。早期实验表明，仅从单一模型失败中蒸馏规则，在非源模型家族上不如基线 cheat sheet，因此需要更稳健的失败规则蒸馏与修复机制。
AI.method: 在将训练样例蒸馏为任务特定 cheat sheet 以辅助模型推理的流程基础上，提出 Robust Failure, Conservative Repair（RFCR）文本蒸馏程序：从多个模型共享的失败中提取规则，利用边界案例锐化规则的应用边界，并在未找到有用规则时选择弃权（abstain）。其核心是控制规则注入的适用条件，避免规则原子被误用到无关案例。
AI.result: 在包含 400 个条目的 BIG-Bench Hard 任务集上，RFCR 将基线 cheat sheet 的准确率从 68.50% 提升至 71.25%（+2.75 个百分点；95% CI [+1.25, +4.50]），且在原本回答正确的案例上未出现性能下降。消融实验与跨模型诊断表明，准确率增益既来自新知识注入，也来自严格的规则应用控制。
AI.conclusion: RFCR 通过跨模型共享失败、边界约束和保守弃权，提高了失败驱动文本知识蒸馏的稳定性和可迁移性。实验支持：规则蒸馏的收益不仅依赖知识本身，还依赖对规则适用范围的严格控制，从而在提升准确率的同时避免误用规则带来的负面影响。

fa24724f50e1e66615bb630df86d1dceaf09b4ca.title: Hi-OPD: Hierarchy-Aware Open-Prompt Detection for Remote Sensing Images
fa24724f50e1e66615bb630df86d1dceaf09b4ca.summary:
Hi-OPD addresses a failure mode left uncontrolled by flat open-prompt training: descendant retrieval need not persist under ancestor queries when multi-source remote sensing annotations exhibit inconsistent granularity and missing labels. A detector may localize \textit{car} and \textit{van} under atomic prompts yet miss the same instances under \textit{vehicle}; flat AP does not expose this cross-level inconsistency.
  We propose Hi-OPD, a hierarchy-aware open-prompt detector, and construct RS153-HierOPD from 175,644 retained training image/tile records and 3.48M boxes mapped to 153 atomic categories with sparse hierarchy and alias relations. Hi-OPD learns ancestor retrieval through hierarchy-safe negative sampling, path multi-positive supervision, and one-way upward consistency, while per-source risk exclusion handles potentially missing labels. ConvVPE converts K-shot support boxes into text-compatible embeddings using detector-native features and the shared contrastive head.
  On Track A, Hi-OPD obtains 79.7/72.3 AP50 on DIOR/DOTA-v2.0, above the literature-reported OpenRSD results of 76.7/71.8. Under controlled training on the original converted annotations, the full hierarchy recipe raises DOTA-v2.0 parent AP50 from 7.2 to 71.5 and FAIR1M grandparent AP50 from 31.6 to 71.4, while DOTA-v2.0 atomic AP50 changes from 71.4 to 72.3. The text path reaches 99.7% CAR50 (0.3% violation) across the three common sources and 99.9%/0.1% on FAIR1M grandparent relations. On held-out VEDAI, text AP50 is 75.9, 6.2 points above OpenRSD. Joint AP and CAR show that explicit hierarchy training repairs this failure mode while retaining atomic detection and prompt transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出层级感知开放提示检测器 Hi-OPD，并构建 RS153-HierOPD 数据资源，通过层级安全负采样、路径多正样本监督与单向向上一致性修复“原子类别可检出但祖先提示漏检”的跨层级不一致，同时保持原子检测与提示迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 扁平开放提示训练存在未被控制的失效模式：多源遥感标注粒度不一致且标签缺失时，检测器在 atomic prompt（如 car、van）下可定位实例，但在 ancestor query（如 vehicle）下不必然保持后代检索能力；flat AP 无法暴露这种跨层级不一致。
AI.method: 提出 Hi-OPD 层级感知开放提示检测器；构建 RS153-HierOPD，由 175,644 条保留训练图像/切片记录与 3.48M 个框组成，映射到 153 个原子类别，并含稀疏层级与别名关系。训练上采用 hierarchy-safe negative sampling、path multi-positive supervision、one-way upward consistency，并用 per-source risk exclusion 处理潜在缺失标签；ConvVPE 将 K-shot 支持框通过检测器原生特征与共享对比头转换为文本兼容嵌入。
AI.result: Track A 上 DIOR/DOTA-v2.0 达到 79.7/72.3 AP50，高于文献报道 OpenRSD 的 76.7/71.8。在原始转换标注的受控训练下，完整层级配方将 DOTA-v2.0 parent AP50 从 7.2 提升至 71.5，FAIR1M grandparent AP50 从 31.6 提升至 71.4，DOTA-v2.0 atomic AP50 从 71.4 到 72.3。文本路径在三个常见源上达到 99.7% CAR50（0.3% violation），FAIR1M grandparent 关系为 99.9%/0.1%。留出 VEDAI 上 text AP50 为 75.9，较 OpenRSD 高 6.2 点。
AI.conclusion: 联合 AP 与 CAR 表明，显式层级训练可修复该跨层级失效模式，同时保持原子检测与提示迁移能力。Hi-OPD 通过数据集构建与层级一致性监督，将开放提示检测从扁平原子类别扩展到可用的祖先检索。

7be54615c299665030f4a24951177669db39b355.title: RoboMP-DINOv2: Prompts, Not Filters for Robust Robot Manipulation
7be54615c299665030f4a24951177669db39b355.summary: Robot manipulation policies must generalize across visual shifts while preserving scene context relevant to action. General-purpose vision encoders are not tailored to visuomotor control, while object-centric approaches often use segmentation masks as hard filters that discard potentially useful context. We propose RoboMP-DINOv2 (Robotics Mask-Prompted DINOv2), a full-scene vision encoder that treats masks as spatial prompts rather than visibility filters. It extracts dense DINOv2 features from the full observation, injects learned region-specific embeddings at masked locations, and jointly contextualizes prompted and unprompted tokens for action prediction. We further introduce masked-region color randomization (MCR) to improve appearance robustness, yielding RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR. Across seven simulated manipulation settings, RoboMP-DINOv2 achieves 60.7% success under spatial shifts and 59.7% under scene clutter, compared with 50.7% and 41.0% for a DINOv2-based Diffusion Policy. Under unseen object colors, RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR achieves 72.5% success versus 35.1% for the strongest color-randomized baseline. Additional experiments and representation analyses show improved robustness while preserving behaviorally relevant scene information. Code is available at https://github.com/han20192019/RoboMP_DINOv2.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboMP-DINOv2，将分割掩码作为空间提示（而非可见性过滤器）注入 DINOv2 全场景特征，并引入掩码区域颜色随机化（MCR）提升外观鲁棒性，在七种仿真操作任务中显著优于基于 DINOv2 的 Diffusion Policy 基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略需要在视觉变化下保持泛化，同时保留与动作相关的场景上下文。通用视觉编码器并非为视觉运动控制设计；而以物体为中心的方法常把分割掩码当作硬过滤器，直接丢弃了可能有用的上下文信息，导致鲁棒性与场景理解能力受损。
AI.method: 1) 提出 RoboMP-DINOv2，一个全场景视觉编码器，把掩码作为空间提示而非可见性过滤器：从完整观测中提取稠密 DINOv2 特征，在掩码位置注入可学习的区域特定嵌入；2) 将提示 token 与未提示 token 联合上下文建模，用于动作预测；3) 引入掩码区域颜色随机化（MCR）增强外观鲁棒性，得到 RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR。
AI.result: 在七个仿真操作设置中：空间位移下 RoboMP-DINOv2 成功率 60.7%（DINOv2-based Diffusion Policy 为 50.7%）；场景杂乱下 59.7%（对照 41.0%）。在未见物体颜色下，RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR 成功率达 72.5%，而最强的颜色随机化基线仅为 35.1%。
AI.conclusion: 实验与表征分析表明，该方法在提升鲁棒性的同时保留了行为相关的场景信息，验证了"掩码作为空间提示"这一设计的有效性，代码已开源。

1c5488ef3a287065e483079191d58918c73506e0.title: Extending FunctionGemma for Practical On-Device Mobile Function Calling
1c5488ef3a287065e483079191d58918c73506e0.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Includes main paper, references, and appendices. Code, datasets, models, and demo available at GitHub and Hugging Face
1c5488ef3a287065e483079191d58918c73506e0.summary: On-device assistants require function-calling models that map natural language to local system actions, but existing resources emphasize web APIs or narrow mobile-action catalogs. We extend FunctionGemma 270M-it to practical Android workflows by introducing MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED, a synthetic, schema-validated dataset of ~9,500 conversations covering fifteen device-control categories, including messaging, phone calls, camera/screenshot, brightness control, device-status queries, flashlight control, and application management. We fine-tune the 270M model with TRL supervised fine-tuning under completion-only loss, producing an extended specialist and a combined model trained jointly with Google's MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE. On MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED, end-to-end accuracy improves from 29.3% for the base model and 17.2% for Google's Mobile-Actions variant to 76.5%. The combined model retains 76.5% on MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED and reaches 82.3% on MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE, down from the 90.3% of Google's Mobile-Actions specialist, representing an 8.0-percentage-point trade-off in return for doubling category coverage. We release the dataset, fine-tuned models, reproducible training/evaluation pipeline, and an Android demo, highlighting compact local function calling as a practical path towards low-latency and privacy-preserving mobile assistants.

AI.tldr: 将 FunctionGemma 270M-it 扩展到 Android 设备控制函数调用，构建约 9,500 条、15 类任务的 MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED 数据集并微调，端到端准确率由 29.3%/17.2% 提升至 76.5%；联合训练模型在扩大类别覆盖的同时保留较强性能。
AI.motivation: 端侧助手需要能将自然语言映射为本地系统操作的函数调用模型，但现有资源多聚焦 Web API 或窄范围移动动作，缺少面向实际 Android 工作流、schema 可验证的数据与模型。
AI.method: 提出合成且经 schema 校验的 MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED 数据集，约 9,500 条对话，覆盖消息、电话、相机/截图、亮度、设备状态查询、手电筒、应用管理等 15 类设备控制任务；基于 FunctionGemma 270M-it，使用 TRL 监督微调与 completion-only loss，训练扩展专家模型，并与 Google 的 MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE 联合训练得到组合模型。
AI.result: 在 MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED 上，端到端准确率从基座模型 29.3%、Google Mobile-Actions 变体 17.2% 提升到 76.5%。组合模型在 MOBILEACTIONSEXTENDED 上保持 76.5%，在 MOBILEACTIONSGOOGLE 上达到 82.3%，低于 Google Mobile-Actions 专家的 90.3%，即以 8.0 个百分点性能权衡换取类别覆盖翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 发布数据集、微调模型、可复现训练/评估流程及 Android 演示，表明紧凑的本地函数调用是实现低延迟、隐私保护移动助手的可行路径。

a81e5f1a64f7eafc2a6622ec9d2847b71e675176.title: Efficient Iterative Retrieval with Heterogeneous Batching
a81e5f1a64f7eafc2a6622ec9d2847b71e675176.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
a81e5f1a64f7eafc2a6622ec9d2847b71e675176.summary: Modern information retrieval increasingly employs both embedding and generative models to handle complex queries. However, current serving systems suffer from low throughput and poor GPU utilization because they execute these models in isolation. Coarse-grained partitioning, such as dedicating GPUs to specific tasks, fails to adapt to dynamic workloads and creates computational "bubbles". To address these, we present Orthrus, a serving system that performs heterogeneous batching within a unified inference loop. The primary challenge lies in unifying embedding and generation workloads with conflicting computational patterns while optimizing batch composition for high performance. Orthrus addresses these challenges through chunked embedding with incremental pooling and by adjusting batch composition in a workload-aware manner. Evaluation on four A100 GPUs shows that, relative to baseline deployments, Orthrus achieves 1.28$\times$--4.52$\times$ higher throughput on controlled workloads and up to 55.8% lower end-to-end p99 latency on an iterative-RAG benchmark. We release our code at https://github.com/illinoisdata/Orthrus .

AI.tldr: Orthrus 通过在统一推理循环中进行异构批处理，联合服务 embedding 与生成模型，利用分块 embedding、增量池化和负载感知的批组合，显著提升吞吐并降低尾延迟。
AI.motivation: 现代信息检索同时使用 embedding 模型和生成模型处理复杂查询，但现有服务系统将二者隔离执行，导致吞吐低、GPU 利用率差；按任务粗粒度分配 GPU 难以适应动态负载，并产生计算“气泡”。
AI.method: 提出 Orthrus 服务系统，在统一推理循环中执行异构批处理。针对 embedding 与生成工作负载计算模式冲突、批组合优化困难的问题，采用分块 embedding 与增量池化，并以负载感知方式调整批组合。
AI.result: 在四块 A100 GPU 上评估：相比基线部署，在受控工作负载上吞吐提升 1.28×–4.52×；在迭代式 RAG 基准上，端到端 p99 延迟最多降低 55.8%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: Orthrus 表明，将异构的 embedding 与生成负载统一到同一推理循环并进行细粒度批组合优化，可有效提升服务吞吐、GPU 利用率和尾延迟表现。

928b37d1d3223614aa22c55606aca453494b6e2c.title: Observer Choice and Threshold Selection in Retinal Vessel Segmentation: A Subject-Separated Evaluation
928b37d1d3223614aa22c55606aca453494b6e2c.summary: The annotation used to select a segmentation threshold is part of the evaluation protocol, yet its effect is easily conflated with model quality. We examine this choice for retinal vessel segmentation using all 28 CHASE DB1 images and both human annotations. A fixed seven-fold protocol keeps both eyes of each of the 14 subjects together. Random forests and Extra Trees are fitted against observer 1 with three random seeds, yielding 42 fits. Five threshold policies share identical score maps: fixed 0.50, observer-1 tuning, observer-2 tuning, mean-observer tuning, and maximin tuning of the per-image lower observer Dice. For random forests, maximin changes the threshold in 19 of 21 fits, but worst-observer Dice decreases from 70.53 percent to 70.45 percent. The paired difference is -0.073 percentage points, with a conditional subject-bootstrap 95 percent interval of [-0.384, 0.238]. Extra Trees shows the same direction. Identical observer-1-tuned random-forest masks score 73.66 percent against observer 1 and 71.06 percent against observer 2. The results support explicit reporting of both the threshold-selection reference and evaluation reference; they do not support an accuracy benefit from maximin tuning in this cohort. All splits, raw predictions, metrics and code are supplied. AI assistance is disclosed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视网膜血管分割中阈值选择对评估结果的影响，基于CHASE DB1全部28张图像和双人标注，比较固定阈值与多种观察者相关阈值调优策略，发现maximin调优虽频繁改变阈值，但未带来精度提升，建议同时明确报告阈值选择参考与评估参考。
AI.motivation: 分割阈值的选择属于评估协议的一部分，但其影响容易被误认为是模型质量差异。作者希望厘清阈值选择参考（用于选阈值的标注）与评估参考（用于计算指标的标注）对Dice等结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用CHASE DB1全部28张图像及两位人类观察者标注。采用固定七折协议，保证14名受试者的双眼处于同一折。以观察者1标注训练随机森林和Extra Trees，使用3个随机种子，共42次拟合。五种阈值策略共享相同score map：固定0.50、观察者1调优、观察者2调优、平均观察者调优、以及对每张图像较低观察者Dice的maximin调优。比较最差观察者Dice、配对差异，并用条件受试者bootstrap估计95%区间。
AI.result: 随机森林中，maximin在21次拟合中有19次改变阈值，但最差观察者Dice从70.53%降至70.45%；配对差异为-0.073个百分点，条件受试者bootstrap 95%区间为[-0.384, 0.238]。Extra Trees结果方向一致。相同观察者1调优的随机森林掩膜对观察者1得分为73.66%，对观察者2为71.06%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在评估中明确报告阈值选择参考和评估参考；在该队列中不支持maximin调优能带来精度收益。所有数据划分、原始预测、指标和代码均已提供，并披露了AI辅助。

c7b89a9f37a312eb97203a968ab1f14dce04b0de.title: A Deployment Study of Identity-Gated Drone Gesture Control
c7b89a9f37a312eb97203a968ab1f14dce04b0de.summary: Vision-based gesture control accepts commands from any hand in the camera field of view, which is unsafe in shared indoor spaces. This paper presents IGate, an identity-gated control stack that includes gesture control and face tracking, in which commands are admitted only when an enrolled operator is verified. The system performs few-shot user enrolment from 20 initial face frames, without prior user-specific training: verification compares an embedding of the current face crop against the enrolled template by cosine similarity, while face tracking uses proportional correction. Gesture control is achieved by classifying extracted hand landmarks using an RBF-SVM trained on a custom dataset. Additionally, a hierarchical finite-state machine handles mode selection, default, and fallback behaviours. The approach is tested on a DJI Tello EDU, each component evaluated offline and in-flight across 270 trials (149 flown). Face verification yields a 0.32% offline equal error rate versus 19.3% in-flight. Under hover-locked conditions, the RBF-SVM gesture classifier outperforms the geometric rule (0.850 vs. 0.651 accuracy), with 82% of this gap stemming from the depth channel. All logs and reproduction scripts will be released.

AI.tldr: IGate 是一种身份门控的视觉手势控制栈，仅允许已注册操作者的手势命令生效，并在 DJI Tello EDU 上完成了离线与飞行试验验证。
AI.motivation: 共享室内空间中，基于视觉的手势控制会响应相机视野内任意人的手，缺乏身份鉴别，存在误触发与安全风险，因此需要将手势控制与操作者身份验证绑定。
AI.method: 提出 IGate 控制栈，融合人脸跟踪与手势控制：使用 20 帧初始人脸进行少样本注册，无需用户特定预训练；通过余弦相似度比较当前人脸裁剪嵌入与注册模板完成验证，并采用比例校正进行人脸跟踪；手势控制对提取的手部关键点使用在自定义数据集上训练的 RBF-SVM 分类；另设分层有限状态机处理模式选择、默认与回退行为。
AI.result: 在 DJI Tello EDU 上对各组件进行离线与飞行测试，共 270 次试验（149 次实际飞行）。人脸验证离线等错误率为 0.32%，飞行中为 19.3%；悬停锁定条件下，RBF-SVM 手势分类器准确率 0.850，优于几何规则的 0.651，其中 82% 的性能差距来自深度通道。
AI.conclusion: IGate 验证了身份门控手势控制栈的可行性：离线人脸验证表现良好，但飞行中验证性能显著下降；RBF-SVM 手势分类明显优于几何规则，且深度信息是关键增益来源。作者将公开日志与复现脚本。

fcc9c498e35d888e3ddd9864292bd72c86339bd1.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
fcc9c498e35d888e3ddd9864292bd72c86339bd1.summary: The one-dimensional bin packing problem (1D-BPP) is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications ranging from logistics and manufacturing to cloud resource management. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has become a competitive paradigm for data-driven optimization, most learned packing methods target 2D and 3D variants, and intelligent learned solvers for 1D-BPP remain scarce. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP. We formulate the packing process as a Markov decision process on an item-compatibility graph, serving as a structural knowledge representation in which every action merges two partial bins that fit together. A graph neural network actor-critic policy extracts relational features from this representation and is trained through reinforcement learning and decoded by stochastic beam search, enabling a single trained model to generalize zero-shot to instances of any size. We conduct a systematic empirical study across graph encoders, DRL algorithms, reward functions, training distributions, and hyperparameters. Evaluated zero-shot on the full BPPLIB benchmark against a constructive heuristic, a grouping genetic algorithm, and recent learned methods, our data-driven policy lowers the mean optimality gap of the constructive heuristic from 2.66\% to 2.31\%, with the largest gains on structured instances. Against learned baselines evaluated on the same benchmark, it attains a lower gap on most of the nine families and is far more stable across instance distributions. On the hardest benchmark family, it outperforms a state-of-the-art learned solver that relies on column generation and integer programming, while using no solver at all. A grouping genetic algorithm remains ahead overall, and we analyze where and why the residual gap arises.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于一维装箱问题（1D-BPP）的端到端、尺寸无关图强化学习框架：将装箱建模为物品兼容图上的马尔可夫决策过程，用GNN actor-critic学习合并可行部分箱，经随机束搜索解码，可零样本泛化到任意规模实例，并在BPPLIB上取得优于构造启发式和多数学习基线、逼近分组遗传算法的效果。
AI.motivation: 1D-BPP是经典NP难组合优化问题，应用广泛；深度强化学习已成为数据驱动优化范式，但已有学习型装箱方法多集中于2D/3D变体，面向1D-BPP的智能学习求解器仍较缺乏。作者希望填补这一空白，并提升学习型方法在1D-BPP上的泛化性与稳定性。
AI.method: 将装箱过程形式化为物品兼容图上的MDP，图中动作表示合并两个可兼容的部分箱，从而引入结构化知识表示；采用图神经网络actor-critic策略提取关系特征，通过强化学习训练，并以随机束搜索解码；框架端到端、尺寸无关，单一模型可零样本迁移到任意规模实例。实验系统比较了图编码器、DRL算法、奖励函数、训练分布和超参数。
AI.result: 在完整BPPLIB基准上零样本评估：相比构造启发式，平均最优性间隙从2.66%降至2.31%，在结构化实例上提升最大；与同基准学习基线相比，在九类实例族中的多数上间隙更低且跨分布更稳定；在最难的基准族上，不使用列生成和整数规划求解器，仍优于依赖列生成与整数规划的先进学习求解器；但分组遗传算法整体仍领先。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于物品兼容图的图强化学习可有效求解1D-BPP，并具备尺寸无关的零样本泛化能力和较好的稳定性；其性能已超过构造启发式与多数学习基线，并在困难实例族上优于部分SOTA学习求解器，但与分组遗传算法仍有残余差距，作者进一步分析了差距来源。

34fe3f9f6e9efa5fd7998e23e18ecae02bf30f90.title: From Offline Proxies to Online Decisions: A Layered Engagement Evaluation Framework for Conversational AI
34fe3f9f6e9efa5fd7998e23e18ecae02bf30f90.comment: 11 pages main text, 9 pages supplementary material; 2 figures, 25 tables
34fe3f9f6e9efa5fd7998e23e18ecae02bf30f90.summary: Online A/B experiments are the decision standard for user engagement, but traffic and readout time limit how many conversational-AI changes can be tested. We ask whether an offline signal designed to be computable without treatment-arm user exposure agrees with the outcomes of those experiments. We contribute a reusable construction and diagnosis checklist that treats an offline proxy as a chain of three alignments: behavioral label to product outcome, learned classifier to candidate-assistant behavior, and aggregated offline signal to experiment effect. A companion evaluation protocol audits the whole composite by interval-aware decision agreement, which compares offline and online confidence intervals instead of point estimates, and by within-experiment ranking. The instantiation we evaluate comprises a fixed evaluation suite on which candidate behavior is scored, an engagement classifier trained to predict session/prompt level engagements, and a calibration layer mapping sample-level score differences to online model-level engagement deltas. We then report the audit: 489 paired offline-online contrasts (one candidate arm against its control) from 27 experiments on a deployed multi-turn assistant, spanning model checkpoints to system-prompt tuning. Our primary test uses the 113 contrasts from eight experiments that ran after the map was frozen: on these the composite reaches 81.1% F1, against 34.3% for the raw classifier score it is built on, and makes no wrong-direction calls where that raw score makes 31. Every offline prediction was computed before its experiment ran to prevent overfitting. The evidence supports using the composite to prioritize candidates before scarce experiment traffic is allocated---in our deployment of the experiment, selecting among training checkpoints and tuning system prompts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套可复用的离线代理构建与诊断清单，将离线代理视为三层对齐链，并用区间感知决策一致性与实验内排序进行审计。在已部署多轮助手的27个在线实验中，主测试使用映射冻结后8个实验的113个离线-在线对比，复合代理达到81.1% F1，显著高于原始分类器34.3%，且无反向误判（原始分数有31次），支持在稀缺实验流量分配前用于候选优先级排序。
AI.motivation: 在线A/B实验是用户参与度决策标准，但受流量和读出时间限制，可测试的对话式AI改动数量有限。核心问题是：一个无需处理组用户暴露即可计算的离线信号，能否与在线实验结果一致，从而在实验前筛选候选、节省实验资源。
AI.method: 提出可复用的构建与诊断清单，把离线代理拆解为三层对齐：行为标签到产品结果、学习分类器到候选助手行为、聚合离线信号到实验效应。评估协议通过区间感知决策一致性（比较离线与在线置信区间而非点估计）和实验内排序审计整个复合体。实例化包括：固定评估套件对候选行为打分、参与度分类器预测会话/提示级参与、校准层将样本级分数差映射为在线模型级参与度增量。共报告27个实验、489个配对离线-在线对比，覆盖模型检查点到系统提示调优；主测试使用映射冻结后8个实验的113个对比，且离线预测均在实验运行前计算以防过拟合。
AI.result: 在映射冻结后的8个实验、113个离线-在线对比中，复合代理达到81.1% F1，而其所基于的原始分类器分数仅为34.3%；复合代理没有反向误判，原始分数则有31次。整体证据支持该复合代理在稀缺实验流量分配前用于候选优先级排序，具体场景为训练检查点选择与系统提示调优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，经过三层对齐与区间/排序审计的离线代理可作为在线实验前的候选筛选工具，在已部署多轮助手、参与度结果、检查点与提示调优场景中显著优于原始分类器。其贡献在于提供可复用的构建与诊断框架，并通过冻结映射后的前瞻性验证降低过拟合风险。局限在于结论依赖离线-在线校准映射与特定任务/指标，跨任务、跨指标及分布漂移下的泛化仍需进一步验证。

1d20dd96d828dfef10a524809ad0bbb7baeaed49.title: Digital Twin-Driven VR Teleoperation with Multi-View Spatial Perception for Surgical Robots
1d20dd96d828dfef10a524809ad0bbb7baeaed49.summary: Current robot-assisted minimally-invasive surgery (RMIS) platforms provide a fixed console for the surgeon to view stereo endoscopic images and teleoperate instruments inside the patient. Several researchers have proposed the use of a head-mounted display (HMD) as a portable console, with video pass-through rendering of the endoscope images which, like the fixed console, restricts the operator to a single endoscopic viewpoint and limits depth perception. We present a digital twin-driven virtual reality (VR) teleoperation platform, where the digital twin is created from markerless perception of the surgical environment and streamed for display on the HMD. This overcomes the limitations of video pass-through by providing multi-view rendering and natural motion-parallax cues, enabling decoupling of the user's hand posture from strict instrument alignment. The system utilizes VR hand controllers to increase the teleoperation workspace and to improve the robustness and stability of instrument control compared to the hand tracking approach adopted by most prior systems. A 15-participant user study on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) shows that our VR platform significantly outperforms a state-of-the-art HoloLens 2 mixed reality baseline, reducing path length by 86% and jerk by 95%, while achieving depth perception confidence comparable to or exceeding the traditional console across all conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数字孪生驱动的VR远程操作平台：基于无标记感知构建手术环境数字孪生并流式显示于头显，支持多视角渲染与运动视差，结合VR手柄提升操作空间与稳定性；在dVRK上15人实验表明其显著优于HoloLens 2混合现实基线，路径长度降低86%、抖动降低95%，深度感知置信度达到或超过传统控制台。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）平台依赖固定控制台，术者只能观看立体内窥镜图像并遥操作器械。已有研究尝试用头戴显示器（HMD）作为便携控制台，但视频透视方式仍受限于单一内窥镜视角，深度感知不足，且多数系统采用手部追踪，存在操作空间受限、控制鲁棒性和稳定性不足等问题。
AI.method: 构建数字孪生驱动的VR远程操作平台：通过无标记感知重建手术环境数字孪生，并流式传输至HMD进行显示；利用多视角渲染和自然运动视差线索克服视频透视的单一视角限制，使用户手部姿态与器械严格对齐解耦；采用VR手柄进行遥操作，以扩大工作空间并提高器械控制的鲁棒性与稳定性。
AI.result: 在da Vinci Research Kit（dVRK）上开展15名参与者用户研究。相比最先进的HoloLens 2混合现实基线，该VR平台显著降低路径长度86%、降低抖动95%；在所有实验条件下，深度感知置信度与传统控制台相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生驱动的VR远程操作平台可克服传统固定控制台和视频透视HMD在视角与深度感知上的限制，并通过VR手柄改善操作空间与控制稳定性，在任务性能和深度感知方面优于现有混合现实基线，具备作为RMIS便携控制台的潜力。

6ce73eefa3a4a525af75fdd6dd9ff7652abcb46d.title: Predictive Uncertainty for Neural CAE Surrogates
6ce73eefa3a4a525af75fdd6dd9ff7652abcb46d.summary:
Neural surrogates can substantially accelerate computer-aided engineering (CAE) workflows, but their use in design requires uncertainty estimates that remain meaningful across varying geometries, spatial prediction fields, and engineering quantities of interest. We investigate how established uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches behave when adapted to geometry-conditioned neural surrogates. We compare one closed-form and two sampling-based approaches-a Gaussian process (GP)-based method, concrete Monte Carlo (MC) dropout, and deep ensembles-and evaluate them on three large, industry-relevant CAE datasets for external aerodynamics and crash dynamics.
  We examine whether predicted uncertainties have credible magnitudes, identify locations with larger prediction errors, respond to unfamiliar inputs, and remain informative for derived engineering quantities. On the DrivAerStar dataset, where all three methods are compared, each generally assigns higher uncertainty to locations with larger prediction errors, and validation-based rescaling brings interval coverage close to nominal on a disjoint in-distribution test set. Results on AirFRANS and automotive crash also show useful error ranking and interval estimates, but the relative performance of the methods changes with the dataset and evaluation criterion. UQ methods and evaluation metrics should therefore be selected based on the intended downstream CAE decision.

AI.tldr: 将GP、Concrete MC Dropout与深度集成三类不确定性量化方法适配到几何条件神经代理，在三个工业CAE数据集上评估其可信度、误差定位、对陌生输入的响应及对派生工程量的信息性；结果显示方法优劣随数据集和评价指标而变，应依据下游CAE决策选择UQ方法与评估指标。
AI.motivation: 神经代理可显著加速CAE工作流，但若用于设计，其不确定性估计必须在变化的几何、空间预测场和工程关注量上保持有意义。因此需要考察既有UQ方法在几何条件神经代理中的实际表现。
AI.method: 比较一种闭式方法与两种采样式方法：基于高斯过程（GP）的方法、Concrete Monte Carlo Dropout和深度集成（Deep Ensembles）。在三个大规模、工业相关的CAE数据集上评估，涵盖外部空气动力学与碰撞动力学。评估维度包括：预测不确定性的量级是否可信、能否识别误差更大的位置、是否对不熟悉输入作出响应，以及是否对派生工程量保持信息性；并在DrivAerStar上以验证集重标定检验区间覆盖率。
AI.result: 在三种方法均可比较的DrivAerStar数据集上，各方法通常会给预测误差更大的位置分配更高不确定性；基于验证集的重标定使独立同分布测试集上的区间覆盖率接近名义水平。AirFRANS与汽车碰撞数据集也显示出有用的误差排序和区间估计，但各方法的相对表现会随数据集和评价准则而变化。
AI.conclusion: UQ方法与评估指标的选择应服务于预期的下游CAE决策，而不存在跨数据集、跨准则普遍最优的单一方案。

496a26d91cb1528ffba600aec5e430801a4c0196.title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
496a26d91cb1528ffba600aec5e430801a4c0196.comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Full research report with an ancillary archive containing reference code, raw experimental records, and offline verification tools
496a26d91cb1528ffba600aec5e430801a4c0196.summary: Moving authorization earlier can shorten an agent's dispatch boundary without removing authorization work. It can also admit an action whose payload, authority, or relevant state has changed. ZeroGate separates exact-action approval from durable local admission: an issuer signs a short-lived ActionPass, and a trusted runtime adapter reconstructs the final action before a local gate checks its binding and consumes its nonce. A SQLite transaction couples nonce consumption, applicable quota updates, and an admission receipt. We state a conditional decision-preservation proposition: successful local admission implies that a specified synchronous policy would authorize the same action at the admission point, provided approval is sound, all policy dependencies are represented and current, observations are faithful, and consumption is atomic. The implementation alone establishes neither current-world freshness nor exactly-once remote effects. Evaluation separates authored semantic fixtures, controlled concurrency and crash experiments, and an Azure Blob study comparing synchronous and prepared execution through the same issuer and gate. Both modes mint an exact-action pass; lifecycle latency includes preparation and prepared-batch dwell. Across 4800 cloud attempts, prepared worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 ranges from 9.802 to 11.374 ms, versus 25.018 to 334.000 ms synchronously, across the tested concurrency levels. Prepared mean complete lifecycle is longer at every level: the boundary improvement is not a net speedup. The contribution is an explicit revalidation contract, a durable reference boundary, and an auditable comparison of where authorization cost is paid, not a new cryptographic primitive or a universal performance frontier.

AI.tldr: ZeroGate 将“精确动作授权”与“本地持久化准入”分离：签发短期 ActionPass，由可信运行时适配器重建最终动作，本地门校验绑定并原子消耗 nonce；它只缩短派发边界，不减少授权工作，也不保证当前世界新鲜性或远端恰好一次效果。
AI.motivation: 把授权提前可缩短 agent 的派发边界，但并未消除授权工作，且可能放行 payload、authority 或相关状态已改变的动作。因此需要一种明确的重新验证契约与持久参考边界，来界定“何时授权仍可被本地准入继承”。
AI.method: ZeroGate 分离 exact-action approval 与 durable local admission：issuer 签发短期 ActionPass；可信 runtime adapter 在本地门之前重建 final action；local gate 检查其绑定并消耗 nonce。SQLite 事务将 nonce 消耗、适用配额更新与 admission receipt 耦合。作者提出条件性 decision-preservation proposition：若 approval 可靠、所有策略依赖均被表示且当前、观测忠实、消耗原子，则成功本地准入意味着指定同步策略在准入点会授权同一动作。评估分为 authored semantic fixtures、受控并发与崩溃实验，以及 Azure Blob 研究，在同一 issuer 与 gate 下比较 synchronous 与 prepared execution；两种模式均 mint exact-action pass，生命周期延迟包含 preparation 与 prepared-batch dwell。
AI.result: 4800 次云端尝试中，prepared 的 worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 为 9.802–11.374 ms，而 synchronous 为 25.018–334.000 ms，覆盖所测并发级别。但 prepared 的 mean complete lifecycle 在每个级别都更长，说明边界改善并非净加速。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于显式 revalidation contract、durable reference boundary，以及对授权成本支付位置的可审计比较；它不是新的密码学原语，也不是通用性能前沿。实现本身不能确立 current-world freshness，也不能保证 exactly-once remote effects。

ae18a411eaf80916253e8c59cb35a08c36b77d16.title: Evidence-gated multimodal parsing and vectorization of architectural floor plans
ae18a411eaf80916253e8c59cb35a08c36b77d16.summary: Architectural floor plans remain a high-friction barrier to archive digitization and early design-model preparation because heterogeneous graphics encode spatial semantics and editable geometry together. We introduce SALI-FP, an evidence-gated multimodal pipeline that converts a plan into reviewable semantic maps, objects, vectors, and relation records while constraining local revisions by image evidence. In a full production audit of 11,534 heterogeneous plans, SALI-FP produced structured outputs for every plan, including 752,510 valid polygon-bearing objects. The same output form has supported initial drawing digitization and design-model preparation in practical design work. Public-benchmark calibration is paired with a 30-case matched visual evidence set in Appendix F, where room-scale coverage, openings, oblique boundaries, and circulation continuity can be inspected directly. SALI-FP offers an engineering-oriented interpretation-to-geometry workflow for reviewed CAD/BIM preparation and existing-building information recovery.

AI.tldr: SALI-FP 是一个证据门控的多模态流程，将建筑平面图转化为可审查的语义图、对象、矢量和关系记录，并在生产审计中处理 11,534 份异构平面图，输出 752,510 个有效带多边形对象，服务于 CAD/BIM 准备与既有建筑信息恢复。
AI.motivation: 建筑平面图数字化与早期设计模型准备存在高摩擦：异构图形同时编码空间语义与可编辑几何，难以直接自动化转换。因此需要一种兼顾语义解析与几何生成、且可人工审查的工程化流程。
AI.method: 提出 SALI-FP，一个证据门控的多模态流水线。它将平面图转换为可审查的语义地图、对象、矢量和关系记录，并通过图像证据约束局部修订，保证输出与原始图像证据一致。
AI.result: 在生产审计中处理 11,534 份异构平面图，所有平面图均产生结构化输出，共包含 752,510 个有效带多边形对象。该输出形式已支持实际设计工作中的初始图纸数字化和设计模型准备。公开基准校准与附录 F 的 30 例匹配视觉证据集结合，可直接检查房间尺度覆盖、开口、斜向边界和流线连续性。
AI.conclusion: SALI-FP 提供了一种面向工程的“解释到几何”工作流，用于经审查的 CAD/BIM 准备和既有建筑信息恢复。其价值在于可审查、可追溯的结构化输出，而非仅追求端到端自动生成。

bc44c414711bb3be113b105d13a6d48e89a4b11f.title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
bc44c414711bb3be113b105d13a6d48e89a4b11f.summary: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 freezes GC-VLA and applies Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow (GCRF), using a binary intervention router and a single bounded residual velocity policy learned from closed-loop feedback. GC-VLA achieves 95.20% success on LIBERO, and GC-VLA with GCRF achieves 99.55%. Inference uses current observations and the learned GC representation without executing the offline target encoders.

AI.tldr: 提出 GC-VLA：以“多视角未来-当前几何变化”为预训练接口，经四阶段训练（GC-VLM→ActionExpert对齐→联合微调→GCRF残差流），在 LIBERO 上达 95.20%，加 GCRF 后达 99.55%。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽受益于几何监督，但仅用当前帧几何无法显式描述操作过程中发生的变化。作者希望学习一种具身无关（embodiment-agnostic）的视觉接口，使其可先在机器人视频与第一视角视频上预训练，再与机器人特定动作对齐。
AI.method: GC-VLA 从当前观测预测多视角的“未来-当前几何变化”token。离线帧对定义名义 0.5 秒预测时域，未来观测仅用于构造训练目标。训练分四阶段：Stage 1 训练几何变化视觉-语言模型（GC-VLM）；Stage 2 引入连续 ActionExpert，与机器人动作对齐，并在 VLM 接口处停止动作流梯度；Stage 3 允许这些梯度与 ActionExpert 联合更新可训练 VLM 组件；Stage 4 冻结 GC-VLA，施加 Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow（GCRF），使用二值干预路由器与单一有界残差速度策略，从闭环反馈中学习。推理仅使用当前观测与学到的 GC 表示，不执行离线目标编码器。
AI.result: GC-VLA 在 LIBERO 上取得 95.20% 成功率；GC-VLA + GCRF 取得 99.55% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模未来-当前几何变化可作为具身无关的预训练视觉接口，配合分阶段动作对齐与闭环残差流修正，能显著提升 VLA 操作策略性能，且推理无需目标侧编码器，部署更简洁高效。

c16e50269ee1b9a6db825d3d91acb5c9b728cd95.title: Lightweight Ranking Heads: Accelerating Multi-Task Experimentation in Production Recommender Systems
c16e50269ee1b9a6db825d3d91acb5c9b728cd95.comment: ACM RecSys 2026 - Online and Adaptive Recommender Systems
c16e50269ee1b9a6db825d3d91acb5c9b728cd95.summary: Modern production-scale recommender systems rely on complex, multi-task ranking models. Introducing new prediction tasks into these massive systems often causes bottlenecks - it risks negative task conflicts with existing tasks, and can lead to long development and experimentation cycles due to the expensive retraining of backbone models and downstream models or tuning of reward combination formulas. To address the critical challenge of slow experimentation velocity, we introduce the Lightweight Ranking Heads (Light Heads) framework. Designed for continuous online learning environments, Light Heads enable the dynamic injection of new tasks into existing multi-task ranking models, effectively obviating the need for model cold-starting and retraining of backbone models. By utilizing stop-gradients and stateless daily training, this design strictly isolates new tasks, mitigating the risk of adverse task conflicts. Crucially, this framework uses a centralized configuration that allows Light Heads to be added to multiple models simultaneously, unblocking faster training data generation and co-training of downstream models. Successfully deployed at YouTube scale, this approach reduces the iteration cycle for multi-task experimentation from several weeks to days. In this paper, we detail the system architecture, analyze the training dynamics of stateless cold-started heads, compare their performance to full heads, and demonstrate how Light Heads have enabled the rapid A/B experimentation and deployment of new ranking tasks that yield measurable production value.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lightweight Ranking Heads（Light Heads）框架，用于在已有多任务排序模型中动态注入新任务，避免主干模型冷启动与重训练，缓解任务冲突，并将多任务实验迭代周期从数周缩短到数天，已在 YouTube 规模落地。
AI.motivation: 生产级推荐系统依赖复杂多任务排序模型。新增预测任务常带来瓶颈：一方面可能与已有任务产生负向任务冲突；另一方面需要重训练主干模型与下游模型，或调优奖励组合公式，导致开发与实验周期过长、实验速度慢。因此核心挑战是提升实验迭代速度。
AI.method: Light Heads 面向持续在线学习环境，支持将新任务动态注入现有多任务排序模型；无需模型冷启动和主干模型重训练。其关键技术包括：使用 stop-gradient 与无状态每日训练（stateless daily training）严格隔离新任务，降低负向任务冲突风险；采用集中式配置，使 Light Heads 可同时添加到多个模型，加速训练数据生成与下游模型协同训练。
AI.result: 在 YouTube 规模成功部署；将多任务实验迭代周期从数周降至数天。论文进一步描述了系统架构，分析无状态冷启动 heads 的训练动态，将其性能与完整 heads 对比，并展示 Light Heads 如何支持新排序任务的快速 A/B 实验与部署，产生可衡量的生产价值。
AI.conclusion: Light Heads 通过动态注入、任务隔离与集中式配置，在不大规模重训练主干模型的前提下支持新排序任务快速实验和上线，显著提升多任务推荐系统的实验迭代效率，并具备大规模生产部署价值。

5919193cb50898993c85b344a807255851422ef4.title: Rollout Efficiency in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Taxonomy and Future Directions
5919193cb50898993c85b344a807255851422ef4.summary: Reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning enables large language models to solve mathematical, coding, and other multi-step tasks, but shifts a substantial portion of the training cost to rollout, where trajectories are generated for policy updates. Efficient rollout mechanisms are therefore essential to reduce this cost while maintaining the freshness, consistency, and statistical validity of training data. This survey provides a systematic taxonomy of recent research on rollout efficiency for reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning, classifying existing approaches from both mechanism and bottleneck perspectives. Based on this taxonomy, we analyze how different technique families address distinct sources of rollout inefficiency, examine opportunities and potential conflicts for combining them, identify gaps in the evaluation and reporting of efficiency gains, and discuss open challenges and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于面向推理的强化学习（Reasoning-oriented RL）中 rollout 效率的系统性综述，按机制与瓶颈两个视角对现有方法进行分类，并讨论技术组合、评估缺口与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 推理导向强化学习虽能提升大语言模型在数学、代码等多步任务上的能力，但训练成本很大一部分转移到 rollout 阶段：需要为策略更新生成大量轨迹。因此，如何在保持训练数据新鲜性、一致性和统计有效性的同时降低 rollout 成本，成为关键问题。
AI.method: 该综述采用系统性分类法（taxonomy），从机制（mechanism）和瓶颈（bottleneck）两个视角梳理近期关于推理导向强化学习 rollout 效率的研究，并分析不同技术族分别针对哪些 rollout 低效来源。
AI.result: 基于该分类体系，论文分析了各类方法如何解决不同的 rollout 低效来源，考察了技术组合的机会与潜在冲突，并指出当前在效率增益评估与报告方面存在的缺口。
AI.conclusion: 最后，综述讨论了该领域的开放挑战与未来研究方向，强调需要更统一的效率评估标准，以及更深入地理解不同 rollout 加速技术的兼容性与组合边界。

f3c7d2ff2cc40921b165c16ae06df11c231e3274.title: Shallow to Deep: Aligning Token Pruning with Stage-wise Roles in LVLMs
f3c7d2ff2cc40921b165c16ae06df11c231e3274.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables
f3c7d2ff2cc40921b165c16ae06df11c231e3274.summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur high computational costs from redundant visual tokens. Although training-free attention-based multi-layer pruning in the vision encoder stage has been explored as an effective strategy, we find that pruning in shallow layers consistently degrades performance. In this paper, we aim to understand this problem and seek a solution. By analyzing attention patterns across network depth, we find that shallow layers primarily function as edge detectors with chaotic attention maps, while deeper layers transition through local subject recognition and unstable semantic aggregation. To address the misalignment between pruning strategies and network stages, we propose STD, a hierarchical token pruning framework that adapts token selection mechanisms to the functional role of each network stage. STD employs High-Frequency Spectral Analysis in shallow layers to deterministically preserve structural edges, uses Gaussian-Smoothed Attention in intermediate layers to maintain spatial coherence, and introduces a Stability-Adaptive Trigger in deep layers to execute pruning only during semantically stable phases. Extensive experiments show that STD outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods by 1.1% on LLaVA-1.5-7B with 88.9% token reduction, while also being plug-and-play and highly effective when combined with other methods, and by 2.1% on LLaVA-NeXT-7B with 94.4% reduction, delivering a 3.9x speed-up in the prefilling stage. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Twilight03/STD.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现浅层剪枝会损害性能，通过分析不同深度注意力模式的功能差异，提出STD分层token剪枝框架，按网络阶段自适应选择剪枝机制，在保持高剪枝率的同时提升精度与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）因冗余视觉token导致高计算开销，基于注意力的免训练多层剪枝是有效策略，但作者发现浅层剪枝会持续降低性能，其原因在于剪枝策略与网络不同深度的功能角色不匹配。
AI.method: 作者分析了各深度的注意力模式：浅层主要作为边缘检测器、注意力图混乱；中层经历局部主体识别；深层进行不稳定的语义聚合。据此提出STD分层token剪枝框架，按网络阶段适配token选择机制：浅层用高频谱分析确定性保留结构边缘；中层用高斯平滑注意力保持空间一致性；深层引入稳定性自适应触发器，仅在语义稳定阶段执行剪枝。框架为免训练且即插即用。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，以88.9%的token缩减率超越SOTA剪枝方法1.1%；在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上以94.4%的缩减率超越2.1%，prefilling阶段实现3.9倍加速；与其他方法组合时同样高效。
AI.conclusion: STD通过将剪枝策略与网络各阶段功能角色对齐，解决了浅层剪枝的性能退化问题，在极低token保留率下仍能提升精度并大幅加速，具备免训练、即插即用的通用性。代码将开源。

9f57a6438881d8f96fbc529bcd078217e9e928d0.title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
9f57a6438881d8f96fbc529bcd078217e9e928d0.summary: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IndustrialVLA-Bench，对6个已发布的VLA与WAM机器人策略系统在统一报告规范下进行证据感知评测，分别考察LIBERO干净能力、LIBERO-Plus非语言鲁棒性、LIBERO-Para指令敏感性和执行成本。结果显示系统间干净能力差异很小（1.58分），但鲁棒性与复述鲁棒性差异显著（14.62与31.08分）；仅用3个协议忠实系统仍保持该结论。基准还报告推理延迟、峰值内存、运行模式与证据等级，强调可追溯比较而非断言范式优劣。
AI.motivation: VLA与WAM是当前机器人策略的两大范式：前者直接将观察和指令映射为动作，后者引入学习到的视频或世界动态。二者面向相同操作任务却常在不同评测协议下报告，导致能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感性和部署成本之间的权衡不清楚。因此需要一个统一、可追溯且区分证据等级的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出IndustrialVLA-Bench统一评测规范，对6个已发布VLA/WAM系统进行评估；维度包括LIBERO干净能力、LIBERO-Plus非语言鲁棒性、LIBERO-Para指令敏感性以及观测到的执行成本（推理延迟、峰值内存、运行模式）。任务分数在固定checkpoint与推理配置下聚合3次完整评测、不同随机种子；同时为每个系统标注证据状态（协议忠实、近复现、待验证），仅协议忠实条目支持严格比较。
AI.result: 六个系统的LIBERO干净平均分仅相差1.58分；鲁棒性与复述摘要跨度分别达14.62分和31.08分。将比较限制在3个协议忠实系统后，对应差异为1.36、14.62和23.10分，说明诊断性分离不依赖较弱证据层级。
AI.conclusion: IndustrialVLA-Bench并不宣称某一范式普遍优越，而是为已发布机器人策略在共享实践标准下提供可追溯证据。干净任务分数趋同但鲁棒性与语言敏感性差异显著，提示评测应超越单一任务精度并纳入证据等级与部署成本。

d8f4883fc7a979a32d2bca802cafb9301da235eb.title: PermuFormer: Multi-Task Pretraining for Permutation Representation in Algebraic Combinatorics
d8f4883fc7a979a32d2bca802cafb9301da235eb.summary: Diverse pretraining has been shown to be an effective method for learning reusable, domain-aware representations that provide a starting point for fine-tuning on downstream tasks. While much of the excitement in AI for math has been concentrated in the use of frontier reasoning models to solve well-specified problems through the medium of language, narrow, specialized models remain an important component of the AI for math ecosystem. In contrast to large language models, specialized models are usually trained directly on the mathematical objects themselves (e.g., graphs, sequences of numbers) rather than the textual descriptions that characterize these objects. However, the common practice of training specialists from scratch may limit their ability to develop domain-aware representations that capture the multifaceted nature of mathematics. In this paper, we describe an approach to pretraining for permutation-focused tasks in algebraic combinatorics. We introduce PermuFormer, an autoregressive transformer trained on a 2.8 billion token multi-task, multi-encoding corpus. We show that PermuFormer is an effective starting point for fine-tuning on basic tasks unseen during pretraining and more complex research-level tasks, frequently outperforming the same architecture trained from scratch, baseline MLPs, and a fine-tuned generic language model of comparable size. We also analyze some of the internal mechanisms by which PermuFormer learns to solve training tasks. For example, we show that while some tasks can be linearly decoded directly from the internal representation of the prompt, other tasks require multiple rounds of generation before the answer can be decoded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向代数组合学中排列任务的预训练方法PermuFormer，一个在28亿token多任务多编码语料上训练的自回归Transformer，作为微调起点优于从头训练、MLP基线及同规模通用语言模型，并分析了其内部学习机制。
AI.motivation: 当前AI for math多聚焦于用前沿推理模型以语言解决明确定义的问题，而专用小模型仍是生态系统的重要组成。专用模型通常直接基于数学对象（如排列、图、数列）训练而非文本描述，但常见的从头训练做法可能限制其学习能捕捉数学多面性的领域感知表示。
AI.method: 提出PermuFormer：一个自回归Transformer，在包含多任务、多编码方式的28亿token语料上进行预训练，面向代数组合学中排列相关任务。
AI.result: PermuFormer作为微调起点，在预训练未见的基础任务和更复杂的研究级任务上均有效，常优于同架构从头训练、MLP基线及同规模通用语言模型微调。内部机制分析显示，部分任务可直接从提示的内部表示线性解码，而其他任务需多轮生成后才能解码出答案。
AI.conclusion: 预训练可为排列相关任务提供有效的领域感知表示，利于下游微调；同时揭示了PermuFormer解决训练任务的部分内部机制，即不同任务对内部表示解码的需求存在差异。

2040a68b0da2a5c3c8fb6a863f1af85c2ebdf950.title: Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition for OpenXR Using Transformer-Based Machine Learning
2040a68b0da2a5c3c8fb6a863f1af85c2ebdf950.summary: Hand gesture recognition is a key component in human-computer interaction (HCI), enabling intuitive interfaces for applications in gaming, virtual reality (VR), robotics, and more. This study integrates transformer-based machine-learning models for real-time hand gesture recognition, using hand-tracking data captured through the OpenXR standard in Unity. We leverage positional data of hand joints and wrist rotation angles to train a custom gesture recognition system. By utilizing the sequential modeling capabilities of transformers, the system captures temporal dependencies within short gesture windows and classifies gestures robustly across hand orientations and sizes. The results show a significant improvement in gesture classification accuracy. Building on this, we outline how the approach can be extended toward detecting the flow of movement, i.e., the transitions between gestures, as future work.

AI.tldr: 在Unity中基于OpenXR手部追踪数据，集成Transformer模型实现实时手势识别，显著提升分类准确率并对不同手部朝向与尺寸保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 手势识别是人机交互（HCI）的关键组件，可支撑游戏、虚拟现实（VR）、机器人等直观界面；但现有系统在实时性及面对手部朝向、尺寸变化时的鲁棒性方面仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 通过Unity中的OpenXR标准采集手部关节位置数据与手腕旋转角度，构建自定义手势识别系统；利用Transformer的序列建模能力捕捉短时手势窗口内的时序依赖关系，实现对手势的鲁棒分类。
AI.result: 手势分类准确率获得显著提升，且系统在不同手部朝向与手部尺寸条件下均表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 验证了基于Transformer的时序建模在手势识别中的有效性；未来工作将把该方法扩展至动作流（即手势之间过渡状态）的检测。

e37b06bc29f7424191be6603fc9c013d53089b18.title: What Drives Hierarchy-Aware Image Retrieval? Taxonomy Alignment, Objective Choice, and Geometry
e37b06bc29f7424191be6603fc9c013d53089b18.comment: 17 pages total: 9-page main paper (including references) + 8-page supplementary material; 3 figures and 2 main-paper tables
e37b06bc29f7424191be6603fc9c013d53089b18.summary:
Foundation vision models provide strong generic representations, yet high class-level retrieval accuracy does not necessarily imply that an embedding respects a target semantic taxonomy. We study strict explicit-taxonomy image retrieval on frozen DINOv2 features and ask: when hierarchical retrieval improves, how much of the change is associated with the organization of taxonomy-aware supervision, and how much with the Euclidean-hyperbolic geometry choice?
  We evaluate higher levels with strict cross-class criteria that exclude finer-grained matches, and compare Euclidean and hyperbolic projections trained with taxonomy-distance regression or a taxonomy-aware supervised contrastive objective. A compute-matched 2 x 2 Geometry x Loss factorial uses the same 768-256-32 projector capacity, optimization schedule, batch order, and fixed 100-epoch budget; the Loss axis denotes the Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon objective-family contrast. On CUB, the objective-family contrasts in mean hierarchy mAP (strict middle/high average, excluding Class/Leaf) are +0.0487 in Euclidean space and +0.0414 in hyperbolic space, compared with geometry contrasts of +0.0102 and +0.0030. On NABirds Parent-disjoint retrieval, the corresponding objective-family contrasts are +0.0467 and +0.0440, whereas geometry contrasts are +0.0017 and -0.0009.
  A semantic-alignment control shows that the true taxonomy substantially outperforms a structure-preserving shuffled hierarchy, while a NABirds curvature/radius control does not support stronger negative curvature as the explanation for the observed hierarchy gains. Across the two taxonomies, the Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon contrasts are larger in aggregate than the evaluated geometry contrasts; semantic alignment also matters separately, while geometry remains hierarchy-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究冻结DINOv2特征上的严格显式分类体系图像检索，通过计算量匹配的2×2（几何×损失）因子实验，量化“分类体系感知监督组织方式”与“欧氏/双曲几何选择”对层级检索提升的相对贡献。
AI.motivation: 基础视觉模型虽具强通用表征，但高类级检索精度并不必然意味着嵌入遵循目标语义分类体系；作者希望厘清层级检索提升主要来自分类体系感知监督目标，还是来自欧氏/双曲几何选择。
AI.method: 在冻结DINOv2特征上做严格跨类层级检索评测，排除更细粒度匹配；比较欧氏与双曲投影，并分别用分类体系距离回归或分类体系感知监督对比目标训练。采用计算量匹配的2×2 Geometry×Loss因子设计，固定768-256-32投影器容量、优化日程、批次顺序与100轮预算；损失轴表示Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon目标族对比。另设语义对齐控制（真实分类体系 vs 结构保持的乱序层级）与NABirds曲率/半径控制。
AI.result: CUB上，严格中层/高层平均层级mAP中，目标族对比在欧氏空间为+0.0487、双曲空间为+0.0414，而几何对比仅为+0.0102与+0.0030。NABirds Parent-disjoint检索中，目标族对比为+0.0467与+0.0440，几何对比为+0.0017与-0.0009。语义对齐控制显示真实分类体系显著优于结构保持的乱序层级；NABirds曲率/半径控制不支持更强负曲率解释层级增益。
AI.conclusion: 在两个分类体系上，Regression-to-Taxonomy-SupCon的目标族对比总体大于所评估的几何对比；语义对齐本身也独立重要，而几何效应仍依赖具体层级/分类体系。

173f0d14c3c3d97abd8f2bbcec8e777a9b2ce8bc.title: Recording Hand-Held Laparoscopic Instrument Motion in the Operating Room: Magnetometer-Free Fusion of Inertial, Range and Visual Sensing
173f0d14c3c3d97abd8f2bbcec8e777a9b2ce8bc.summary: Most minimally invasive procedures are still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, yet only the endoscopic video is retained; the instrument motion that expresses surgical skill, and that could support skill assessment and robot learning, is lost. Pose from video alone remains millimeters to centimeters off, and an instrument-mounted inertial measurement unit (IMU) cannot rely on its magnetometer, whose field changed with tool pose and between sessions in our measurements. We present a surgical instrument-state logger that clips onto a conventional instrument without modifying the part that enters the patient and fuses a six-axis IMU and a time-of-flight (ToF) rangefinder with a markerless camera in an error-state Kalman filter under the remote center of motion (RCM) of the trocar. Heading comes from the shaft silhouette, segmented by a U-Net, in place of the magnetometer: the rotation-angle error is 0.200°, against 3.58° from the accelerometer and magnetometer alone. Against a Franka Research 3 manipulator, and without alignment to it, the displacement error over 300 translation trials was 1.21mm RMS and the relative-rotation error over 180 rotation trials 0.34° RMS. On continuous trajectories, tracked and displayed in real time, the absolute tip error was 1.22mm (programmed) and 3.04mm (teleoperated) after post-hoc tuning of three filter parameters, and the full fusion beat every sensor subset. Because the estimator uses no magnetic measurement, its accuracy does not rely on an undisturbed field. The same clip-on device could thus record metric tip trajectories during routine hand-held laparoscopy, while displaying the insertion depth and attitude that are hidden once the instrument is inside the patient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可夹装在常规腹腔镜器械上的手术器械状态记录器，在不改动入体部件的前提下，融合六轴IMU、ToF测距仪与无标记相机，并在套管针远心运动（RCM）约束下用误差状态卡尔曼滤波估计器械位姿；以U-Net分割轴杆轮廓获取航向以替代磁力计。
AI.motivation: 多数微创手术仍使用手持腹腔镜器械，但仅保留内窥镜视频，蕴含手术技能的器械运动信息被丢失，无法用于技能评估与机器人学习。仅凭视频估计位姿误差达毫米至厘米级；器械上安装的IMU又无法依赖磁力计，因为实测中磁场随器械姿态及不同时段而变化。因此需要一种不依赖磁场、且不改动入体部件的器械位姿记录方案。
AI.method: 设计可夹装于常规器械上的状态记录器，不改动进入患者体内的部分；将六轴IMU与飞行时间（ToF）测距仪同无标记相机在误差状态卡尔曼滤波中融合，并施加套管针远心运动（RCM）约束。航向由U-Net分割出的轴杆轮廓提供，替代磁力计。
AI.result: 仅用旋转角时误差为0.200°，而单靠加速度计与磁力计为3.58°。对Franka Research 3机械臂、且未与之对齐条件下，300次平移试验位移误差1.21mm RMS，180次旋转试验相对旋转误差0.34° RMS。连续轨迹实时跟踪显示，经三个滤波参数事后调优后，绝对末端误差为1.22mm（程序驱动）与3.04mm（遥操作），且完整融合优于任一传感器子集。
AI.conclusion: 由于估计器不使用磁测量，其精度不依赖无干扰磁场。该夹装装置可在常规手持腹腔镜手术中记录具有度量尺度的末端轨迹，同时显示器械进入体内后不可见的插入深度与姿态。

4dfe3c458f756995fe622d91246ac06446e7ffef.title: Mean Velocity Matching: Rethinking Generative Dynamics in Diffusion Models
4dfe3c458f756995fe622d91246ac06446e7ffef.summary: This work studies prediction parameterization for stochastic generative dynamics in diffusion models. Existing velocity-based generative models provide the simplicity of learning a single transport field, but their standard formulation is deterministic, whereas stochastic extensions generally require additional score information or an intermediate velocity-to-score reconstruction. To retain single-field prediction while directly supporting stochastic reverse dynamics, this paper introduces Mean Velocity Matching (MVM). MVM constructs a Gaussian perturbation process for which the conditional expectation of a restoration-oriented velocity, $(x_0-x_t)/t$, directly forms the reverse-SDE drift. Consequently, a single learned field is sufficient to parameterize the stochastic reverse process without separately estimating or reconstructing the score. Because direct regression of this velocity becomes unbounded near $t=0$, MVM further introduces a $\sqrt{t}$-scaled parameterization that preserves the reverse dynamics while yielding a bounded training target. The same learned field also induces a deterministic probability-flow ODE, enabling stochastic and deterministic sampling to be studied within a unified formulation. Experiments with Transformer-based generative models achieve an FID of $\MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID$ at \MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $32\times32$ and $\MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixFID$ at \MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE\ NFE on ImageNet $256\times256$. Controlled SDE--ODE comparisons further show that the ODE performs better under very low NFE, whereas the stochastic reverse process achieves lower FID when sufficient function evaluations are available. These results demonstrate that MVM provides a direct single-field parameterization of stochastic reverse dynamics while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出均值速度匹配（Mean Velocity Matching, MVM），用单一学习场直接参数化扩散模型的随机逆向动力学，无需额外估计或重建得分，并引入 √t 缩放参数化以解决 t=0 附近目标无界的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于速度的生成模型只需学习单一传输场，形式简洁，但其标准形式是确定性的；若扩展到随机情形，通常需要额外的得分信息或速度—得分中间重建步骤。作者希望在保留单场预测简洁性的同时，直接支持随机逆向动力学。
AI.method: MVM 构造一个高斯扰动过程，使其复原导向速度 (x_0-x_t)/t 的条件期望直接构成逆向 SDE 的漂移项，因此单一学习场即可参数化随机逆向过程，无需单独估计或重建得分。由于直接回归该速度在 t→0 时无界，MVM 引入 √t 缩放参数化，在保持逆向动力学不变的同时给出有界训练目标。同一学习场还诱导出确定性概率流 ODE，从而在统一框架下研究随机与确定性采样。
AI.result: 基于 Transformer 的生成模型在 ImageNet 32×32 上达到 \MVMImageNetThirtyTwoFID 的 FID（\MVMImageNetThirtyTwoNFE NFE），在 ImageNet 256×256 上达到 \MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixFID 的 FID（\MVMImageNetTwoFiftySixNFE NFE）。受控的 SDE—ODE 对比表明：在极低 NFE 下 ODE 表现更好，而在函数评估次数充足时随机逆向过程取得更低的 FID。
AI.conclusion: MVM 为随机逆向动力学提供了一种直接的单场参数化方法，在保持有竞争力的生成质量的同时，统一了随机与确定性采样，并揭示了二者在不同 NFE 下的性能权衡。

d2b891b3d9c93a97cc408e58a90c04d811ee3cca.title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
d2b891b3d9c93a97cc408e58a90c04d811ee3cca.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and dataset linked in the paper
d2b891b3d9c93a97cc408e58a90c04d811ee3cca.summary: We often teach a colleague by showing the work and explaining the decisions as we go. How can we check what an agent understood from the same lesson? We introduce ShowTellArena, a benchmark protocol and public dataset for comprehension after narrated business demonstrations. The v1.0 release contains 50 business workflow tasks, with recordings, screenshots, narration, fixture seeds, and 502 questions. Tasks span finance, hiring, procurement, customer decisions, inventory, and logistics. The protocol holds the business scenario and quiz fixed while allowing each product to capture the lesson through its own teaching interface. Questions test operational rules, boundaries, exceptions, and errors in proposed automations. We analyze 218 selected pilot attempts across 39 workflow cases, including 28 cases attempted by all three evaluated systems. These exploratory results expose both answer errors and failures to complete the teaching experience. We describe the release's verification gaps and the pilot's uneven coverage, exclusions, and grading provenance. The contribution is an inspectable dataset and assessment workflow that others can extend; the selected pilot is not a controlled product ranking.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShowTellArena：一个面向“ narrated business demonstrations 后理解能力”的基准协议与公开数据集，v1.0 含 50 个业务流程任务、录音/截图/讲解/夹具种子与 502 道题；并对 218 次试点尝试进行探索性分析，强调数据集与评估流程可扩展，而非受控产品排名。
AI.motivation: 现实中常通过展示工作过程并同步解释决策来教同事；需要一种方法来检验智能体是否从同样的“讲解式演示”中真正理解了业务规则。现有工作缺少针对 narrated business demonstrations 的理解评估基准与可检查数据。
AI.method: 构建 ShowTellArena 基准协议与公开数据集：固定业务场景与测验，允许不同产品用自身教学界面捕获课程。v1.0 覆盖财务、招聘、采购、客户决策、库存、物流等 50 个业务工作流任务，包含录制、截图、讲解、fixture seeds 和 502 道问题。问题考察操作规则、边界、例外以及自动化方案中的错误。对 39 个流程案例中的 218 次精选试点尝试进行分析，其中 28 个案例由三个被评估系统共同尝试。
AI.result: 探索性结果同时暴露两类问题：答案错误，以及未能完成教学体验。论文还说明了该发布的验证缺口，以及试点在覆盖范围、排除标准和评分来源方面的不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提供可检查的数据集与评估工作流，供他人扩展；该精选试点不是受控的产品排名，结果应谨慎解读。

4188657edcebbaf9b40af8e0e0c3ffc3a990ec70.title: Decoupling Disease, Covariates, and Individual Variability: A Unified Disentanglement Framework for Medical Image Classification
4188657edcebbaf9b40af8e0e0c3ffc3a990ec70.summary: Accurately isolating disease-related features from confounding covariates (e.g., age, gender, site) and individual variations remains a fundamental challenge in medical image classification. Traditional regression-based approaches may ignore non-linear relations between image features and true covariates. To overcome this issue, we present a generalized Medical Imaging Disentanglement Learning (MedIDL) framework. MedIDL maps image features into three mutually orthogonal latent spaces through specialized disentanglement heads: a disease classification head guided by a supervised loss, a covariate-alignment head constrained by cross-subject similarity matching, and a Gaussian head absorbing individual variations. We evaluated our framework across 7 datasets encompassing diverse imaging modalities. MedIDL outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised classification methods in accuracy across all datasets. Association analyses demonstrate that MedIDL successfully isolates target-specific latent representations. Gradient-based interpretability mappings localize pathognomonic patterns aligning with established clinical literature.

AI.tldr: MedIDL 是一个广义医学影像解耦学习框架，通过三个正交隐空间分别建模疾病特征、混杂协变量与个体差异，在 7 个数据集上超越现有监督与自监督分类方法，并具备可解释性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类中，疾病相关特征常与年龄、性别、站点等混杂协变量及个体差异纠缠，传统基于回归的方法可能忽略图像特征与真实协变量之间的非线性关系，难以准确分离疾病信号。
AI.method: 提出 MedIDL 框架，将图像特征映射到三个相互正交的隐空间，并设计专用解耦头：疾病分类头由监督损失引导；协变量对齐头通过跨受试者相似性匹配约束；高斯头用于吸收个体变异。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种成像模态的 7 个数据集上评估，MedIDL 在准确率上均优于当前最先进的监督与自监督分类方法；关联分析表明其成功分离出目标特异性的隐表示；基于梯度的可解释性映射定位到与既有临床文献一致的病理模式。
AI.conclusion: MedIDL 能有效解耦疾病特征与混杂因素及个体差异，提升医学图像分类性能，并提供具有临床一致性的可解释证据，为医学影像解耦学习提供了通用框架。

6af7408739ec0f3c214ea6678d65f40ce827b9c1.title: CableVLA: Simulation-Privileged Global-Local Representation Learning for Cable Routing
6af7408739ec0f3c214ea6678d65f40ce827b9c1.summary: Cable routing requires coordinated control of global cable topology and changing local contacts. We present CableVLA, an end-to-end multimodal vision-language-action framework that converts simulation-privileged supervision into deployable cable-topology and tactile representations. TopoHead distills node-level physics and current and future cable-topology information into causal visual context for the action expert. TacSense uses complementary frame and taxel branches to learn contact dynamics from resistive arrays, with simulator-derived kinematics and contact events providing supervision beyond the measured force map. A contact gate activates force-tactile residuals that refine the next 8 arm-and-gripper actions of a frozen topology-conditioned policy. Across 345 MuJoCo evaluations, CableVLA improves success from 62.6% for the $π_{0.5}$-V visual baseline to 84.9%. TacSense achieves pronounced gains in slip-transition recognition over a CNN-LSTM baseline with a similar parameter count, and this advantage persists under frozen-encoder probes. Topology prediction and 57-task tactile evaluations assess representation quality, while policy adaptation studies evaluate downstream control performance. Cross-simulator and real-robot comparisons further examine zero-shot policy transfer under changes in dynamics and sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出 CableVLA：端到端多模态视觉-语言-动作框架，将仿真特权监督转化为可部署的线缆拓扑与触觉表示；TopoHead 提供因果视觉上下文，TacSense 学习接触动力学，接触门控残差微调冻结的拓扑条件策略。MuJoCo 345 次评测中，成功率由 62.6% 提升至 84.9%。
AI.motivation: 线缆布线需同时协调全局线缆拓扑与不断变化的局部接触。纯视觉基线难以充分表征接触/滑移等局部动力学与拓扑关系，且真实部署中缺少仿真特权信息与可靠触觉监督。
AI.method: CableVLA 为端到端多模态 VLA 框架。TopoHead 将节点级物理信息及当前/未来线缆拓扑蒸馏为动作专家的因果视觉上下文；TacSense 采用 frame 与 taxel 互补双分支，从电阻式阵列学习接触动力学，并以仿真推导的运动学与接触事件提供超出实测力图的监督；接触门控激活力-触觉残差，细化冻结的拓扑条件策略未来 8 步机械臂与夹爪动作。
AI.result: 345 次 MuJoCo 评测中，成功率由 π0.5-V 视觉基线的 62.6% 提升至 84.9%。TacSense 在参数量相近条件下相较 CNN-LSTM 基线显著提升滑移转换识别，且在冻结编码器探测下优势仍保持。拓扑预测与 57 项任务触觉评测用于评估表示质量；策略自适应研究评估下游控制性能；跨仿真器与真机对比进一步考察动力学与传感变化下的零样本策略迁移。
AI.conclusion: CableVLA 表明可将仿真特权监督有效迁移为可部署的拓扑与触觉表示，统一增强线缆布线策略的接触感知、拓扑推理与跨域泛化迁移能力。

d44df4fff6ffea8c15765dc0a36d6a14c8c61009.title: A Practical Recipe for Semi-Supervised Federated ASR: Online Pseudo-Labels with Server Update Stabilization
d44df4fff6ffea8c15765dc0a36d6a14c8c61009.summary: Semi-supervised federated learning (SSFL) trains models on clients' unlabeled data using a teacher to generate pseudo-labels, with a small labeled seed dataset on the server. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is particularly fragile here: pseudo-label errors compound across the output sequence and across training rounds into divergence, leaving a large gap to fully-supervised FL. We show that closing this gap turns on two coupled design axes -- the teacher (which model generates the pseudo-labels) and the anchor (the server-side updates on labeled data that stabilize training). On the teacher axis, a per-client online teacher (each client's own evolving model) diverges on its own, but once stabilized it matches or beats the broadcast global teacher (one server model, fixed within a round) -- decisively in-domain and competitively under domain shift. As the seed grows stronger and the online teacher's advantage narrows, a transitioning teacher (global $\rightarrow$ online at round $r$) matches or beats both. On the anchor axis, the server must keep training on labeled data between rounds -- otherwise the online teacher drifts -- and this interleaving, more than the seed model, governs convergence. The two axes are inseparable: aggressive teacher choices pay off only once the anchor stabilizes training, which is highly sensitive to data augmentation and batch size -- the settings that govern how much input and gradient noise the server injects. How much stabilization is needed is domain-dependent, governed by the dispersion of the seed data and its overlap with client data. These findings yield guidelines for SSFL in ASR training, improving over the strongest prior method on 9 of 11 pairs, by $20.8\%$ on average in-domain and $10.0\%$ cross-domain, narrowing the gap to fully-supervised FL.

AI.tldr: 该文研究半监督联邦学习（SSFL）在自动语音识别（ASR）中的训练稳定性问题：伪标签误差会在输出序列和训练轮次中累积并导致发散。作者指出，要缩小与全监督联邦学习的差距，关键在于耦合的“教师（teacher）”和“锚点（anchor）”两个设计轴，并据此给出训练准则。实验在11组对比中9组超越最强基线，域内平均提升20.8%，跨域提升10.0%。
AI.motivation: SSFL利用客户端无标签数据和服务器少量有标签种子数据训练模型，由教师生成伪标签。ASR场景尤其脆弱：伪标签错误会沿输出序列传播，并在多轮训练中复合，最终导致模型发散，与全监督联邦学习存在较大差距。因此，作者希望系统分析并缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 围绕两个耦合设计轴展开分析：1）教师轴：比较“每客户端在线教师”（客户端自身演化模型）、“广播全局教师”（每轮固定的单服务器模型）以及“过渡教师”（在第r轮由全局切换为在线）；2）锚点轴：服务器在轮次之间持续用有标签数据训练，以稳定在线教师并控制收敛；同时考察数据增强、批大小等影响输入噪声和梯度噪声的设置，以及种子数据离散度及其与客户端数据重叠程度对所需稳定化程度的域依赖性。
AI.result: 在线教师单独使用会发散，但一旦被锚点稳定，便可匹配甚至超过广播全局教师：域内优势明显，域偏移下具备竞争力。随着种子数据增强，在线教师优势缩小；“过渡教师”可匹配或超过二者。服务器必须在轮次间继续用有标签数据训练，否则在线教师会漂移；这种交替训练比种子模型本身更主导收敛。激进的教师选择只有在锚点稳定训练后才有效，且对数据增强和批大小高度敏感。方法在11组对比中9组优于最强先前方法，域内平均提升20.8%，跨域平均提升10.0%，缩小了与全监督联邦学习的差距。
AI.conclusion: 教师轴与锚点轴不可分割：更强的伪标签教师需要匹配的服务器锚点稳定机制，稳定化强度取决于域特性与种子数据分布。该研究为ASR中的SSFL提供了可操作的设计准则，并显著缩小了与全监督联邦学习的性能差距。

76cdd19c7568e5aad35d3b9fa7f098933b00b83a.title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
76cdd19c7568e5aad35d3b9fa7f098933b00b83a.summary: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as the dominant architecture for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in verifiable external knowledge, yet their structural reliance on a dynamic retrieval pipeline introduces a largely unexplored class of adversarial vulnerability. Existing knowledge-base poisoning attacks are fundamentally static. Adversarial documents are pre-computed and injected without any awareness of what the victim system will actually retrieve for a given query, leaving the attack blind to the competitive documentary landscape that surrounds its payload in the generator's context window. Unlike traditional static poisoning attacks that are blind to the retrieved context, we introduce RAG-NAROK (Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse), a RAG attack framework that adapts to the query text. RAG-NAROK exploits the transparency inherent in RAG pipeline to first extract the legitimate source identities, then generate Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that explicitly name and devalue retrieved sources while leveraging recency and authority biases to steer the text generation toward a target answer. Our results demonstrate that RAG-NAROK significantly outperforms static baselines across diverse domains, revealing a fundamental tension between RAG transparency and AI security.

AI.tldr: RAG-NAROK：一种针对RAG系统的查询自适应投毒攻击框架，通过提取合法来源身份并生成针对性反驳文档，利用近因与权威偏差将生成结果导向目标答案，性能显著优于静态基线。
AI.motivation: RAG已成为将大模型输出锚定于可验证外部知识的主流架构，但其对动态检索管线的结构性依赖引入了尚未充分探索的对抗脆弱性。现有知识库投毒攻击基本是静态的：对抗文档被预先计算并注入，对受害系统针对特定查询实际检索到的内容毫无感知，因而对生成器上下文窗口中围绕其载荷的竞争性文档环境是"盲"的。
AI.method: 提出RAG-NAROK（Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse）攻击框架，能够自适应查询文本。它利用RAG管线固有的透明性，先提取合法来源身份，再生成"锚点特定反驳（Anchor-Specific Refutation）"文档，显式点名并贬低被检索来源，同时借助近因偏差（recency bias）与权威偏差（authority bias）将文本生成导向目标答案。
AI.result: 在多个不同领域中，RAG-NAROK显著优于静态投毒基线，表明其攻击有效性更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了RAG透明性与AI安全性之间的根本性张力：RAG的透明机制在提升可验证性的同时也被转化为攻击面。

2dd90f1d1747ad827b6300fb0a3968b024c75e89.title: GameDirector: Decoupling Gameplay Logic from Rendering for Player-Configurable Game World Models
2dd90f1d1747ad827b6300fb0a3968b024c75e89.summary: Recent game world models support realistic visual simulation and interactive gameplay based on player inputs. However, they typically learn environment dynamics from pixel-level supervision, jointly modeling perception, memory, state transitions, and rendering within a single end-to-end framework. While this design enables open-ended, action-controllable generation, it still falls short of delivering a complete gameplay experience. Games are governed by explicit mechanics, such as health deduction, skill activation, combat rules, and termination conditions. These mechanics depend on precise and consistent state transitions that generative models alone cannot reliably enforce. In contrast, game engines can guarantee such mechanics through hard-coded rules, but provide limited flexibility for player-driven creation. To bridge these paradigms, we introduce GameDirector, the first agentic framework that decouples rule-based gameplay logic from visual rendering. Given player-defined configurations, the framework acts as an intelligent director that interprets visual observations, updates game states, tactically controls NPCs, and enforces gameplay rules. It then translates these decisions into text prompts that guide the video world model to render the resulting gameplay.
