This separation allows players to configure characters, states, and rules much like a game developer while preserving coherent game mechanics. Experiments on three games, using data collected by our automated gameplay agent, show that GameDirector achieves accurate state tracking, reliable rule following, and improves boss action quality by more than 39.9% over various end-to-end game world model settings. Overall, by externalizing player-controllable game logic, GameDirector establishes a middle ground between hard-coded simulation and generative modeling, enabling more flexible and closed-loop gameplay experiences.

AI.tldr: GameDirector 是一个解耦"规则化游戏逻辑"与"视觉渲染"的智能体框架，用外部智能体充当导演来追踪状态、控制 NPC 并执行规则，再把决策转成文本提示驱动视频世界模型渲染，从而在硬编码引擎与生成式建模之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型依赖像素级监督，将感知、记忆、状态转移与渲染耦合在单一端到端框架中。这种设计虽能实现开放式、动作可控的生成，却无法可靠保证游戏所依赖的显式机制（如扣血、技能激活、战斗规则、终止条件等精确一致的状态转移）。而游戏引擎虽能通过硬编码规则保证机制正确，却缺乏玩家驱动的创作灵活性。因此需要在两者之间寻找平衡。
AI.method: 提出 GameDirector——首个将基于规则的游戏逻辑与视觉渲染解耦的智能体（agentic）框架。给定玩家自定义配置后，框架作为"智能导演"：解释视觉观测、更新游戏状态、战术性地控制 NPC、执行游戏规则，随后将这些决策转化为文本提示，引导视频世界模型渲染对应的游戏画面。这种分离使玩家能够像游戏开发者一样配置角色、状态与规则，同时保持游戏机制的一致性。
AI.result: 在三个游戏上使用自动化游戏智能体采集的数据进行实验，结果显示 GameDirector 实现了准确的状态追踪与可靠的规则遵循，并将 Boss 动作质量相比多种端到端游戏世界模型设置提升超过 39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将玩家可控的游戏逻辑外部化，GameDirector 在硬编码模拟与生成式建模之间建立了一个中间方案，实现了更灵活且闭环的游戏体验。

fce798901285142c0e1bbfd373a570f6949cc91e.title: A Deployable Four-Finger Payload for Teleoperated Free-Flying Manipulation with Astrobee
fce798901285142c0e1bbfd373a570f6949cc91e.summary: This article presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and conceptual design of a deployable four-finger payload for intra-vehicular free-flyers. Future habitats in low-Earth orbit (LEO) will require systems to perform mundane tasks like cargo handling and maintenance during crewed and uncrewed periods. The gripper payload provides 17 manipulation degrees-of-freedom (DoF) through four independently actuated fingers on a linear rail system. To control it, a virtual reality (VR) device interface maps the human ground operator's hand motions to the finger pairs, their separation to the rail, and common wrist motion to Astrobee translation. We present the preliminary results of teleoperating Astrobee in a custom zero-gravity MuJoCo-based International Space Station (ISS) simulator through ten repeated trials of transporting a rigid ISS Cargo Transfer Bag (CTB). We measure task success, continuous contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.

AI.tldr: 该文提出面向舱内自由飞行机器人（Astrobee）的双臂遥操作流程，以及一种可展开四指抓取载荷的概念设计；通过VR接口将地面操作员手部动作映射为17自由度抓取与移动控制，并在零重力MuJoCo ISS仿真器中完成10次刚性货包搬运试验，评估任务成功、持续接触保持、完成时间与货物运动。
AI.motivation: 未来低地球轨道（LEO）居住舱在有人和无人阶段都需要执行货物搬运、维护等常规任务，因此需要可部署、可遥操作的舱内自由飞行机器人抓取与操作能力，以降低对宇航员人力的依赖。
AI.method: 设计可展开四指抓取载荷：四个独立驱动手指安装在直线导轨上，共提供17个操作自由度。控制端采用VR设备接口，将地面操作员的手部运动映射到成对手指，将手部开合映射到导轨间距，并将共同腕部运动映射为Astrobee平移。在定制的零重力MuJoCo国际空间站（ISS）仿真环境中进行遥操作试验，重复10次搬运刚性ISS货物转运袋（CTB）。
AI.result: 初步试验围绕10次重复的刚性CTB搬运任务展开，测量指标包括任务成功率、连续接触保持情况、任务完成时间以及货物运动状态，用于评估所提出遥操作流程与抓取载荷概念在零重力仿真中的初步表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了面向舱内自由飞行器的双臂遥操作与可展开四指抓取载荷方案，并通过零重力ISS仿真中的重复搬运试验验证了初步可行性；结果指标为后续优化抓取设计、VR映射策略和自主/遥操作控制提供依据。

d9c503ee6f6a80fc8e1fa5a671d1409ee4cd2801.title: Terminal Shrinkage Averaging Reveals a Schedule-Estimator Interaction in LLM Pretraining
d9c503ee6f6a80fc8e1fa5a671d1409ee4cd2801.summary: Large language model (LLM) pretraining conventionally returns the raw final iterate. This couples two design choices: the learning-rate schedule that generates the parameter trajectory and the estimator that constructs the deployed model (e.g. the raw final iterate or a checkpoint average). A schedule that promotes optimization progress may differ from one that minimizes variation in the raw final iterate. Separating these choices creates an opportunity to maintain progress late in training while reducing variation in the returned model. To this end, we propose \emph{Terminal Shrinkage Averaging (TSA)}, which interpolates between the raw final iterate and the average of recent checkpoints to balance recent progress against terminal variation. We analyze how TSA changes the preferred terminal learning-rate schedule under a local quadratic approximation and test this interaction through a sequence of controlled NanoChat experiments. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting gains transfer to depth-22 NanoChat, where the combined schedule and estimator improve validation quality. A qualifying time-to-GPT-2 run also finishes faster than the public baseline used in our experiments, providing preliminary evidence of benchmark acceleration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“终端收缩平均”（TSA），通过在最终原始参数与近期检查点平均之间插值，解耦学习率调度与模型估计器，从而在训练末期兼顾优化进展并降低终端方差；在NanoChat深度22实验中提升验证质量，并在达到GPT-2级别的时间上快于公开基线。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM预训练直接返回最终原始迭代权重，将两个本可分离的设计耦合在一起：一是决定参数轨迹的学习率调度，二是用于部署的模型估计器（原始最终迭代或检查点平均）。促进优化进展的调度未必能最小化最终权重的方差。作者希望分离二者，以便在训练后期继续保持进展，同时降低返回模型的终端波动。
AI.method: 提出Terminal Shrinkage Averaging（TSA）：在最终原始迭代与近期检查点平均之间进行插值，以权衡近期优化进展与终端方差。方法上先在局部二次近似下分析TSA如何改变偏好的终端学习率调度，再通过一系列受控的NanoChat实验检验调度与估计器之间的交互作用。
AI.result: 受控NanoChat实验验证了TSA与终端学习率调度之间的交互效应；在深度22的NanoChat上，联合使用调度与估计器可提升验证质量。此外，一项达到GPT-2级别的time-to-GPT-2运行比实验所用公开基线更快完成，提供了基准加速的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 将学习率调度与模型估计器显式解耦是有效的：TSA可在训练末期维持优化进展并减少终端方差，其收益可迁移到更深模型并改善验证质量，且初步显示可加速达到GPT-2级别性能的时间。

bedf9880f13136759fe66bb066128bd2968c7a5b.title: Spectra: A Rules-Driven LLM Pipeline for Automated KYC Document Processing
bedf9880f13136759fe66bb066128bd2968c7a5b.summary: Know Your Client (KYC) onboarding in capital markets requires analysts to manually classify documents, extract structured data from heterogeneous sources, and validate compliance against complex regulatory policies. This process requires significant analyst time per client, with end-to-end onboarding often stretching to multiple weeks due to sequential handoffs. In this work, we analyze an on-boarding process and find that it comprises repeatable components well-suited to AI automation. We therefore propose a restructured workflow to be amenable to automation: we consolidate the traditional four-party process into two parties that share most of the work and can be automated together, eliminating intermediate handoffs that compound delays. To automate the remaining steps, we introduce Spectra, an AI-assisted document processing platform that combines a structured rules engine with LLM-based classification, extraction, and validation agents. The rules engine encodes compliance policy as a queryable database, enabling focused context injection that reduces token usage while improving extraction precision. Rather than a single monolithic prompt, the system decomposes document processing into isolated, auditable stages, each optimized independently and traceable to specific policy clauses. In evaluation on real KYC documents, Spectra achieves 100% classification accuracy and 89.4% extraction accuracy. Human review burden dropped by 96%.

AI.tldr: 本文分析资本市场KYC开户流程，提出将其重构为便于自动化的两方流程，并构建Spectra平台（规则引擎+LLM智能体）实现文档分类、抽取与合规校验，实测分类准确率100%、抽取准确率89.4%，人工审核负担下降96%。
AI.motivation: 资本市场KYC开户高度依赖分析师人工完成文档分类、异构数据抽取与合规校验，单客户耗时巨大，且因多环节顺序交接导致端到端流程常长达数周。作者观察到该流程包含大量可重复、适合AI自动化的组件，因此希望通过流程重构与AI辅助来自动化并压缩周期。
AI.method: 1）流程重构：将传统四方流程整合为两方共享大部分工作、可共同自动化的流程，消除造成延迟累积的中间交接；2）提出Spectra平台，将结构化规则引擎与基于LLM的分类、抽取、验证智能体结合；3）规则引擎将合规政策编码为可查询数据库，实现聚焦式上下文注入，在降低token消耗的同时提升抽取精度；4）不做单一巨型提示词，而是把文档处理拆解为相互隔离、可审计的阶段，各阶段独立优化并可溯源至具体政策条款。
AI.result: 在真实KYC文档上的评测中，Spectra实现100%的分类准确率和89.4%的抽取准确率，人工审核负担下降96%。
AI.conclusion: 通过流程重构消除中间交接、并以规则引擎结合LLM智能体的分阶段可审计架构实现自动化，可在保证高准确率与合规可追溯性的同时显著降低人工审核成本，为KYC开户等复杂合规流程的AI自动化提供了可行范式。

4116a0b8fe2d4db9362d525fe43db1f85bb7a15a.title: Real-Time Atomic-Resolution Electron Phase Imaging without Probe Calibration via Ptychography-Supervised Learning
4116a0b8fe2d4db9362d525fe43db1f85bb7a15a.comment: Submitted to Advanced Science on June 18, 2026
4116a0b8fe2d4db9362d525fe43db1f85bb7a15a.summary: Atomic-scale phase imaging is central to resolving defects, interfaces, and weakly scattering atoms that govern the behavior of nanoscale materials. Electron ptychography delivers sub-ångström phase sensitivity but remains an offline technique, because its iterative reconstruction is computationally expensive and sensitive to experimental calibration, preventing live use during data acquisition. Here, a ptychography-supervised local inference framework is presented that converts four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) into an acquisition-compatible phase-imaging workflow. Physics-constrained reference phase maps reconstructed from a single experimental AuPd dataset serve as teacher labels for a compact model that predicts local phase patches directly from diffraction measurements, without explicit probe input or online iterative optimization. Full-field images are assembled by deterministic overlap stitching. The workflow reaches an online latency of about 0.27 ms per probe position and a throughput of about 20,000 positions per second, an approximately 1,000-fold speed-up over GPU-accelerated ePIE, while preserving atomic-scale lattice contrast and reciprocal-space fidelity. Without fine-tuning, the same model transfers across materials (WS2), defocus conditions (high-entropy alloy nanoparticles), and instruments (hBN at 300 kV). The approach amortizes ptychographic redundancy into a fast, generalizable workflow that enables real-time atomic-scale phase imaging for materials microscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"叠层成像监督的局部推理"框架，将4D-STEM转化为可实时采集的相位成像流程：以单组AuPd数据经物理约束重建得到的参考相位图作教师标签，训练紧凑模型直接从衍射数据预测局部相位块，再通过确定性重叠拼接生成全场图像，实现约0.27 ms/探针位置的在线延迟与约2万位置/秒的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度相位成像对解析缺陷、界面及弱散射原子至关重要；电子叠层成像（ptychography）虽能提供亚埃级相位灵敏度，但其迭代重建计算昂贵且对实验标定敏感，属于离线技术，无法在数据采集过程中实时使用，阻碍了材料显微学的实时应用。
AI.method: 构建叠层成像监督的局部推理框架：从单组实验AuPd数据集经物理约束重建出参考相位图，作为教师标签监督一个紧凑模型；该模型直接从衍射测量预测局部相位块，无需显式探针输入，也无需在线迭代优化；最终通过确定性重叠拼接（overlap stitching）组装出全场图像。
AI.result: 在线延迟约0.27 ms/探针位置，吞吐量约20,000位置/秒，相比GPU加速的ePIE约提速1,000倍，同时保持原子级晶格对比度与倒空间保真度；无需微调即可跨材料（WS2）、跨离焦条件（高熵合金纳米颗粒）与跨仪器（300 kV下hBN）迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将叠层成像的冗余性"摊销"为一个快速、可泛化的工作流，实现了面向材料显微学的实时原子尺度相位成像，为在线、实时的原子分辨率表征提供了可行途径。

d6d0d24096e6a70a7f79965d40c5803cd1737a18.title: Relative Contact Velocity-Controlled Hand-Object Mechanism for Dexterous Tool Manipulation
d6d0d24096e6a70a7f79965d40c5803cd1737a18.summary: This work investigates how to enable general multi-finger robotic hands to perform the complete tool manipulation process, which entails picking up a tool, loading it into a suitable pose, and then wielding it. Inspired by human tool manipulation and mechanical design principles, we model the hand and the tool as a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) composed of sub-assemblies. Specifically, we define a HOM as consisting of the hand, the object, and the generalized contact frames, allowing the HOM's motions to be expressed with the same set of Cartesian-space relative contact velocities, irrespective of the hand's kinematics and geometry. Then, we define a HOM's sub-assemblies as relative contact velocity and contact force constraints between fingers. Building on these definitions, we developed a lightweight and physically interpretable motion planning and contact estimation framework using least squares and a complementary filter. We evaluated our framework in simulation by teleoperating five different robotic hands. The results show that our framework enabled all five hands to execute the complete tool manipulation process, achieving dexterous behaviors even from identical, simple reference trajectories. Furthermore, the results showcase our framework's adaptability to different hands, tools, and tasks, enabled by its kinematic and geometric foundation.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出统一的“手-物体机构”（HOM）建模与规划/接触估计框架，使多种多指机械手能完成抓取、装载到合适位姿并挥动工具的完整工具操作流程。
AI.motivation: 实现通用多指机械手完成完整工具操作流程仍具挑战：需要兼顾抓取、工具位姿调整与挥动，并适应不同手部运动学与几何结构。受人类工具操作与机械设计原理启发，作者希望建立与具体手型无关的统一表示，以支持跨手、跨工具、跨任务的泛化。
AI.method: 将手与工具建模为由子装配体构成的统一“手-物体机构”（HOM）：HOM包含手、物体及广义接触坐标系，使HOM运动可用同一组笛卡尔空间相对接触速度表达，不依赖手的运动学与几何；子装配体定义为手指间的相对接触速度与接触力约束。基于这些定义，提出轻量且物理可解释的运动规划与接触估计框架，采用最小二乘法与互补滤波器。
AI.result: 在仿真中通过遥操作五种不同机械手进行评估。结果表明，该框架使五种手均能执行完整工具操作流程，即使从相同且简单的参考轨迹出发也能产生灵巧行为；同时展示了框架对不同手、工具和任务的适应性，这得益于其运动学与几何基础。
AI.conclusion: HOM提供了一种与手部运动学和几何无关的统一工具操作表示；结合最小二乘与互补滤波的规划/接触估计框架，可跨多种多指机械手、工具和任务实现完整工具操作，并具备轻量、物理可解释和良好泛化能力。

ebcfd5db7cf851d38552bd849795487b923b1ab0.title: Learning Defensive Policies against Diverse Inference Attacks for Smart Meter Privacy
ebcfd5db7cf851d38552bd849795487b923b1ab0.summary: Smart meter (SM) data provides fine-grained visibility into household energy consumption, but also exposes users to privacy risks. Inference attacks, known as non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), can perform appliance-level inference from aggregate signals and recover sensitive behavioral patterns. In practice, attacker models are unknown and heterogeneous, making robust defense challenging. We formulate SM privacy protection as a black-box inference defense problem, aiming to reduce the recoverability of appliance-level information while generalizing across diverse and unseen attackers. We propose a proxy-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns battery-based load-shaping policies to inject realistic but misleading appliance-level signatures into the aggregate signal, thereby disrupting the structured patterns exploited by NILM. A self-supervised aggregate-structure privacy probe provides a reconstruction-error-based surrogate reward for disrupting recoverable load structure, while a signature library makes the perturbations appliance-relevant and physically realizable through battery control. We provide theoretical rationale showing that proxy-guided optimization improves inference robustness under attacker diversity. Experiments on real-world datasets UK-DALE and REDD demonstrate strong cross-model and cross-appliance generalization. Across six unseen NILM attackers, covering four appliances on UK-DALE and five on REDD, our proposed defense increases average appliance-level RMSE by 107% and 166%, respectively, while reducing F1 score by 79% and 80%.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究智能电表数据的隐私保护问题，将防御非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）攻击建模为黑盒推理防御，提出代理引导的分层强化学习框架，通过电池负载整形注入具有家电级特征的误导性信号，从而提升对未知异构攻击者的泛化防御能力。
AI.motivation: 智能电表数据能提供细粒度家庭能耗可见性，但NILM攻击可从聚合信号中推断家电级用电信息，暴露用户行为隐私。实际中攻击者模型未知且异构，传统防御难以泛化，因此需要一种面向未知攻击者的鲁棒隐私保护方法。
AI.method: 论文将智能电表隐私保护形式化为黑盒推理防御问题，目标是在多样化、未见攻击者下降低家电级信息可恢复性。提出代理引导的分层强化学习框架，学习基于电池的负载整形策略，向聚合信号注入真实但误导性的家电级签名，以破坏NILM利用的结构化模式。采用自监督聚合结构隐私探针，提供基于重建误差的替代奖励；并构建签名库，使扰动与家电相关且可通过电池控制物理实现。理论上说明代理引导优化可提升攻击者多样性下的推理鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实数据集UK-DALE和REDD上实验，方法表现出较强的跨模型与跨家电泛化能力。面对六种未见NILM攻击者，在UK-DALE的四种家电和REDD的五种家电上，所提防御分别使家电级RMSE平均提高107%和166%，F1分数分别降低79%和80%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于代理引导分层强化学习与电池负载整形的黑盒防御，能够有效干扰NILM攻击并泛化到未见攻击者与不同家电，为智能电表隐私保护提供了物理可实现且鲁棒的解决方案。

602882b3490f45c2cff571ea8049c1b0e70dd5e2.title: Queer inclusion in speech datasets: An audit and taxonomy of practical tensions
602882b3490f45c2cff571ea8049c1b0e70dd5e2.summary: In this paper, we examine speech datasets for their inclusion of LGBTQIA+, or queer, voices and provide a taxonomy of tensions to better understand why there is a lack of such voices in current speech technology datasets. Through an audit of six diverse speech datasets, we find that measurable queer representation is low (0-1.4% of speakers) - insufficient for robust disparity measurement. We take this community as a case study to consider what challenges and tensions are associated with collecting speech data from marginalized communities. For comparison, we audit an additional two datasets from the speech sciences that were created by, for, and with the queer community. We note that many customs in speech dataset collection efforts in AI and speech technology research may conflict with values emphasized in participatory approaches with marginalized communities, and provide a taxonomy describing these tensions.

AI.tldr: 论文审计语音数据集对LGBTQIA+（酷儿）声音的包含情况，发现代表性极低，并提出一套"张力分类体系"来解释边缘化群体语音数据缺失的原因。
AI.motivation: 当前AI与语音技术数据集中缺乏LGBTQIA+等边缘化群体的声音，作者希望理解为何这类声音缺失，以及在从边缘化社区收集语音数据时面临的挑战与张力。
AI.method: 以酷儿社区为案例，审计6个多样化语音数据集中酷儿说话人的比例；同时对照审计另外2个由酷儿社区"为、与、由"其共同创建的语音科学数据集；对比AI/语音技术研究的收集惯例与参与式方法所强调的价值观，归纳并构建张力分类体系（taxonomy）。
AI.result: 6个数据集中可测量的酷儿代表性很低（仅占说话人的0–1.4%），不足以支撑稳健的差异（disparity）测量；发现AI与语音技术研究的数据集收集惯例，可能与面向边缘化社区的参与式方法所强调的价值观相冲突。
AI.conclusion: 语音数据集中的酷儿代表性严重不足，且主流收集惯例与参与式价值观存在张力；作者提出的张力分类体系有助于理解并改进边缘化社区语音数据收集的包容性问题。

a8cb995ec35ceb9878e84b2a0d423cba63b511f6.title: Initialization and Stopping Tolerance in CPU Dermoscopic Segmentation
a8cb995ec35ceb9878e84b2a0d423cba63b511f6.summary: Contour initialization and numerical stopping can jointly affect the evaluation of active-contour segmentation. We examine their interaction using the open-source scikit-image Chan-Vese implementation on a resized ISIC 2017 mirror. A fixed development set of 100 images selects a common input channel; all 600 images in the repository's held-out partition are then evaluated. Otsu thresholding is compared with checkerboard-, disk-, and Otsu-initialized contours under default and tighter level-set tolerances. At the default tolerance, Otsu initialization increases mean image Dice from 0.6011 to 0.6660 relative to checkerboard initialization, a paired difference of 0.0649 (95% image-bootstrap interval [0.0452, 0.0860]). Otsu thresholding alone achieves 0.6897. The default disk initializer stops after one iteration on 471 images. Tightening the tolerance reduces the Otsu-seed advantage over checkerboard initialization to 0.0197, with most runs reaching the 500-iteration limit. The default-tolerance advantage also reverses between small- and large-lesion strata. These findings show that an improvement over a generic initializer can coexist with deterioration relative to the threshold baseline. Evaluations should retain the unrefined mask as a comparator and report the initial-field definition, stopping tolerance, and observed iteration counts together.

AI.tldr: 轮廓初始化方式与数值停止容差会共同影响主动轮廓分割的评价结果；Otsu初始化在默认容差下优于棋盘初始化，但仍不如Otsu阈值基线本身，且该优势在收紧容差后会缩小甚至反转。
AI.motivation: 主动轮廓分割（如Chan-Vese）的评价常受轮廓初始化方式和数值停止条件两个因素干扰，但二者的交互作用尚未被系统检验。作者希望厘清：在改变初始化方式时，"相对通用初始化器有所改进"是否可能同时意味着"相对简单阈值基线反而变差"，从而揭示评价设置对结论的敏感性。
AI.method: 使用开源scikit-image的Chan-Vese实现，在缩放后的ISIC 2017镜像数据集上实验。先用固定100张开发集选定统一的输入通道，再对held-out分区的全部600张图像评估。对比Otsu阈值法与棋盘、圆盘、Otsu三种初始化轮廓，并在默认容差与更严格容差两种设置下运行。采用配对图像自助法（image-bootstrap）估计置信区间，并按病灶大小分层分析。
AI.result: 默认容差下，Otsu初始化将平均图像Dice由棋盘初始化的0.6011提升至0.6660，配对差为0.0649（95%自助区间[0.0452, 0.0860]）；但仅用Otsu阈值即可达0.6897。默认圆盘初始化器在471张图像上仅迭代一次即停止。收紧容差后，Otsu相对棋盘的优势缩小至0.0197，且多数运行达到500次迭代上限。默认容差下的优势在小病灶与大病灶分层之间还发生反转。
AI.conclusion: 相对通用初始化器的改进可以与相对阈值基线的退化同时存在，因此仅报告"优于某初始化器"不足以说明方法有效性。建议评价时保留未细化的阈值掩膜作为对照，并同时报告初始场定义、停止容差与观测到的迭代次数，以保证结果可复现、可比。

3bdf843454cdf64107b1408e55357bf49bf669ed.title: From Instrument-Mounted Demonstrations to In-Vivo Execution: Learning Bimanual Laparoscopic Appendectomy Without Robot-Collected Demonstrations
3bdf843454cdf64107b1408e55357bf49bf669ed.summary: Most minimally invasive surgery is still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, and the surgeon's instrument kinematics are lost when the operation ends; only the endoscope video is kept. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that captures this motion in the operating room and uses it to train a surgical robot policy, validated on live animals. We introduce a surgical instrument-state logger that mounts on the shaft of a standard laparoscopic instrument and recovers its pose and jaw state from an inertial sensor, a time-of-flight sensor and a Hall sensor, with no external camera or tracker. A data pipeline measures the latency of every sensor channel against a robot ground truth and aligns the channels before forming observation-action pairs. On these demonstrations we train a diffusion policy with a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone, selecting its design by closed-loop rollouts in a physics simulator reconstructed from depth maps of an ex-vivo rabbit appendix. The policy is then retrained on 849 in-vivo demonstrations from four live rabbits and deployed on four additional live rabbits with electrosurgery armed. With the surgeon selecting the surgical phase, the policy completed the appendectomy in three of the four animals. The results show that demonstrations recorded from a surgeon's own instruments are sufficient to train, select and deploy a bimanual surgical policy in vivo. The robot serves only as the timing reference for sensor calibration and as the executor, and collects no demonstrations. Both demonstration corpora are released to support future surgical robot learning research.

AI.tldr: 提出一套端到端流程：用可安装在标准腹腔镜器械杆上的器械状态记录器采集术者操作，经传感器延迟对齐后训练基于扩散策略与微调DINOv3的双手手术机器人策略，并在活兔体内验证，4只中3只完成阑尾切除。
AI.motivation: 微创手术仍多使用手持腹腔镜器械，手术结束后术者的器械运动学信息丢失，仅保留内窥镜视频；作者希望直接捕获术者真实器械操作，用于训练可部署的手术机器人策略，并在活体动物中验证。
AI.method: 1）设计器械状态记录器，安装于标准腹腔镜器械杆上，利用惯性传感器、飞行时间传感器和霍尔传感器恢复器械位姿与钳口状态，无需外部相机或跟踪器。2）数据管线以机器人为真值，测量各传感器通道延迟并对齐，构建观察-动作对。3）训练扩散策略，骨干网络为微调DINOv3；在由离体兔阑尾深度图重建的物理模拟器中通过闭环rollout选择设计。4）在4只活兔的849条体内演示上重训练，并部署到另外4只活兔，电外科设备处于启用状态；由术者选择手术阶段。
AI.result: 策略在4只活兔中的3只完成了阑尾切除术。结果表明，仅使用术者自身器械记录的演示，足以训练、选择并部署双手手术策略于活体环境。机器人仅作为传感器校准的时序参考和执行器，不采集任何演示数据。两套演示数据集均已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可从术者手持器械中捕获运动学并转化为可部署的体内手术机器人策略，为未来手术机器人学习研究提供了数据与流程基础。

213bb8d6cc662a0c606400ff554a9050ff4df894.title: Continuous Optimization for p-adic Models
213bb8d6cc662a0c606400ff554a9050ff4df894.summary: We present the first method for native, continuous gradient descent for machine learning models with $p$-adic parameters. Existing native optimizers are discrete, mostly combinatorial searches, as the $p$-adic numbers $\mathbb{Q}_p$ are totally disconnected, with standard losses that are flat away from their minima. To enable continuous optimization, we propose working with $\mathbb{Q}_p$ via its Berkovich affine line: a canonical, path-connected expansion of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ that preserves its isometries and uniquely extends its analytic maps. This hull is a metric tree with interpretable points and local derivatives, which we show enables effective optimizers and backpropagation. We formulate gradient descent and show that its approximations efficiently learn linear models with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}_p$ to do modular arithmetic, an XOR-like task not expressible by linear models in $\mathbb{R}$. We also demonstrate momentum and Adam variants, linear regression, and classification on binary-encoded hierarchies (Quillian semantic networks), addressing open problems posed by Martins (2025). Library at https://github.com/google-deepmind/padic-ml

AI.tldr: 首个面向 p 进参数模型的连续梯度下降方法：用 Berkovich 仿射线把完全不连通的 Q_p 扩展为路径连通、可微的度量树，从而实现可解释的梯度优化与反向传播。
AI.motivation: 现有 p 进原生优化器多为离散/组合搜索，因为 Q_p 完全不连通，且标准损失在极小值之外平坦，难以进行连续优化。
AI.method: 在 Q_p 的 Berkovich 仿射线上工作：这是保持等距性并唯一扩展解析映射的规范路径连通扩张，形成可解释、具局部导数的度量树；据此定义梯度下降、动量、Adam 及反向传播。
AI.result: 近似方法能有效学习系数在 Q_p 中的线性模型以完成模运算（一种 R 上线性模型无法表达的 XOR 类任务）；还展示了动量与 Adam 变体、线性回归，以及二进编码层级（Quillian 语义网络）分类。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 p 进机器学习提供了连续可微优化框架，回应 Martins (2025) 提出的开放问题，并开源库 https://github.com/google-deepmind/padic-ml。

910b43303af5e1c01be1d8e78178830294bfbd88.title: Towards participatory speech dataset curation: A queer case study and conceptual framework
910b43303af5e1c01be1d8e78178830294bfbd88.summary: In this paper, we motivate the need for a participatory speech dataset creation framework through a case study of the LGBTQIA+, or queer, community - a community with documented concerns about AI and reported harms, including attempts to develop 'gaydar' technologies that purportedly identify individuals as queer. We review common speech data collection practices, why these methods may be unsuitable for engaging with queer speakers, and discuss previous efforts in participatory AI with queer community engagement, as well as participatory endeavours specific to speech data collection for other marginalized communities. From this review, we develop a conceptual framework for participatory speech data curation by, for, and with marginalized communities drawing on insights from co-design and knowledge sharing. We propose a framework comprising overlapping and two-way processes of defining a community, project formulation, modes of participation, and personal autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过LGBTQIA+（酷儿）社群案例，论证语音数据集创建需要引入参与式框架，并基于既有数据采集实践、参与式AI与协同设计经验，提出由社群界定、项目构思、参与模式和个人自主权四个双向重叠过程构成的参与式语音数据策展概念框架。
AI.motivation: LGBTQIA+等边缘化社群对AI存在明确担忧并报告过受伤害经历，例如所谓“gaydar”技术试图通过语音识别个体是否为酷儿；现有语音数据采集实践可能不适合与酷儿说话者互动，因此需要更尊重社群、由社群参与的语音数据创建方式。
AI.method: 采用案例研究与文献综述方法：回顾常见语音数据采集实践及其对酷儿说话者的不适用性；梳理参与式AI中与酷儿社群互动的努力，以及其他边缘化社群语音数据采集的参与式实践；借鉴协同设计与知识共享的洞见，构建参与式语音数据策展的概念框架。
AI.result: 提出一个参与式语音数据策展概念框架，包含四个相互重叠且双向的过程：界定社群（defining a community）、项目构思（project formulation）、参与模式（modes of participation）与个人自主权（personal autonomy）。
AI.conclusion: 面向、为了并与边缘化社群共同开展语音数据策展，需要参与式框架；该框架强调社群界定、项目构思、参与方式与个人自主权之间的双向互动，为更合乎伦理、更具包容性的语音数据集创建提供概念基础。

a486cb4c33a71ab73cf8eafd0074098b16d6e49e.title: C2FXNet: Coarse-to-Fine Scene Expert for Unified Object Detection across Adverse Weather
a486cb4c33a71ab73cf8eafd0074098b16d6e49e.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
a486cb4c33a71ab73cf8eafd0074098b16d6e49e.summary: Object detection in adverse weather remains challenging because severe degradations weaken visual quality and disrupt semantic feature representations across diverse scenes. Existing methods usually rely on condition-specific designs, which limits their ability to generalize within a unified detector. In this paper, we propose a Coarse-to-Fine Scene Expert Network (C2FXNet) that achieves unified detection through hierarchical scene guidance. Specifically, C2FXNet introduces a dual-level guidance mechanism consisting of a Multi-step Reasoning Router (MRR), which performs GRU-based recurrent scene reasoning over compressed multi-scale visual cues and frozen coarse scene prototypes, and a Fine Scene Refinement (FSR) module, which uses image-specific semantic cues to modulate high-level features for local variation handling. Furthermore, a Scene-aware Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) dynamically combines scene-specific experts under the joint guidance of MRR and FSR. By coupling coarse scene reasoning with fine-grained semantic refinement, C2FXNet enables robust multi-scene detection without scene-specific training. Extensive experiments on RTTS, ExDark, and our newly constructed Adverse Weather Dataset (AWD) demonstrate that C2FXNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across foggy, dark, and clear conditions, reaching 63.70%, 71.14%, and 54.19% mAP on RTTS, ExDark, and AWD, respectively. The source code will be released at https://github.com/PolarisFTL/C2FXNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C2FXNet（粗到细场景专家网络），通过分层场景引导实现统一的目标检测，无需针对特定场景训练即可在雾、暗、晴等多种天气条件下取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气下的目标检测仍具挑战性：严重退化会削弱视觉质量并破坏跨多样场景的语义特征表示。现有方法通常依赖针对特定条件的设计，限制了其在统一检测器内的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 C2FXNet，通过分层场景引导实现统一检测，包含双级引导机制：1）多步推理路由器（MRR），基于 GRU 对压缩的多尺度视觉线索与冻结的粗粒度场景原型进行循环场景推理；2）细粒度场景精炼（FSR）模块，利用图像特定的语义线索调制高层特征以处理局部变化。此外设计场景感知混合专家（SMoE），在 MRR 与 FSR 的联合引导下动态组合场景专用专家。
AI.result: 在 RTTS、ExDark 及新建的恶劣天气数据集（AWD）上，C2FXNet 在雾天、暗光与清晰条件下均持续优于现有最先进方法，分别在 RTTS、ExDark、AWD 上达到 63.70%、71.14%、54.19% mAP。
AI.conclusion: 通过将粗粒度场景推理与细粒度语义精炼相耦合，C2FXNet 实现了鲁棒的多场景检测且无需场景特定训练，验证了分层场景引导在统一恶劣天气目标检测中的有效性。

daa267e97c68b85e9571f5974a773a207a66931a.title: MachEmbodied-U0: Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Embodied Intelligence
daa267e97c68b85e9571f5974a773a207a66931a.comment: Technical report. Project page: https://machembodied.com/ME-U/ME-U0.html. Code: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-U0
daa267e97c68b85e9571f5974a773a207a66931a.summary: General-purpose robot control requires models to understand task intent, identify where to interact, capture how the scene evolves, and generate precise actions. Vision-language-action models provide strong semantic priors but typically do not explicitly model scene dynamics, while world-action models couple visual prediction with control without necessarily exposing the task-relevant semantic and spatial structure needed for fine-grained manipulation. We present MachEmbodied-U0 (ME-U0), a unified embodied foundation model connecting understanding and generation experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Subtask prediction and affordance grounding guide joint visual-dynamics and action generation via flow matching. Visual dynamics encompass future RGB, depth, surface normals, and optical flow, providing complementary supervision for appearance, geometry, and motion. Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) aligns visual dynamics with fine-grained control. We pretrain ME-U0 on approximately 4,200 hours of curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets. Using only the supervision natively available in each downstream benchmark, ME-U0 achieves an average score of 17.66 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and average success rates of 99.0\% and 82.5\% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, respectively. We additionally validate ME-U0 on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond simulation. Without corresponding downstream supervision, ME-U0 further demonstrates zero-shot subtask prediction, affordance grounding, and visual dynamics on simulated and real-world observations. Overall, ME-U0 combines competitive downstream control performance with transferable task-grounding and visual-dynamics capabilities across simulation and the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出统一具身基础模型 ME-U0，以 Mixture-of-Transformers 连接理解与生成专家，通过子任务预测与可供性定位引导视觉动态和动作的联合生成，在仿真与真实机器人操作中取得强性能并展现零样本任务定位与视觉动态能力。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人控制需同时具备任务意图理解、交互位置识别、场景演化建模和精确动作生成能力。现有 VLA 模型语义先验强但未显式建模场景动态；世界动作模型虽耦合视觉预测与控制，却未必暴露细粒度操作所需的语义与空间结构。因此需要统一理解与生成的具身基础模型。
AI.method: 提出 MachEmbodied-U0（ME-U0），采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构连接理解专家与生成专家。以子任务预测和可供性定位作为引导，通过 flow matching 联合生成视觉动态与动作。视觉动态覆盖未来 RGB、深度、表面法线和光流，为外观、几何和运动提供互补监督。引入多速率旋转位置编码 MRPE，对齐视觉动态与细粒度控制。在约 4,200 小时机器人数据与自我中心数据上进行预训练。
AI.result: 仅使用各下游基准原生监督，ME-U0 在 RoboDojo 仿真基准平均得分 17.66，在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 上平均成功率分别为 99.0% 和 82.5%。在真实机器人操作任务上验证有效。无对应下游监督时，还展示零样本子任务预测、可供性定位和视觉动态能力。
AI.conclusion: ME-U0 将竞争性的下游控制性能与可迁移的任务定位及视觉动态能力结合，在仿真和真实世界中均有效，说明统一理解—生成框架对通用具身控制具有潜力。

64c8afba9f65cf7a679262471f3af5e8cebd2bbd.title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
64c8afba9f65cf7a679262471f3af5e8cebd2bbd.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can improve solutions to verifiable scientific and algorithmic problems by spending additional computation at test time. Recent systems achieve strong results with increasingly elaborate evolutionary search harnesses or by updating model parameters during test-time training. We ask how much of this machinery is necessary. We introduce Hill Sampling, a simple procedure that repeatedly samples candidate program edits from a frozen LLM, retains the best program found so far, and conditions all subsequent samples on that program. We evaluate the method on circle packing, sums/differences of sets, and Erdos' minimum-overlap problem using three open-weight models. Hill Sampling sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods, improves over the AlphaEvolve reference on Erdos' minimum-overlap problem, and achieves strong results on sums and differences of finite sets. The circle-packing and Erdos results require only hours of wall-clock time on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. To our knowledge, we also conduct, the largest study, by parameter count, of evolution strategies (ES) applied directly to LLM weights at test time. Surprisingly, learning the weights is worse than setting the ES learning rate to zero: at zero learning rate, the method is still searching in weight space through fixed random perturbations. Those perturbations can help exploration, but randomness from token sampling is stronger still, and repeated sampling remains substantially weaker than Hill Sampling. These results suggest a simple test-time compute allocation strategy: repeatedly sample edits to the best verified solution found so far, before introducing additional complexity such as adding archives, diversity mechanisms, evolutionary scaffolds, or test-time parameter learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Hill Sampling：一种极简的测试时计算策略——冻结 LLM 反复采样程序编辑，保留当前最佳程序，并以该程序为条件继续采样；在圆填充、集合和差、Erdos 最小重叠问题上验证其有效性，并质疑复杂进化搜索/测试时训练的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有提升 LLM 解决可验证科学/算法问题的方法常依赖复杂进化搜索框架或测试时参数更新，但尚不清楚这些机制是否必要。作者希望探究：在测试时投入额外计算时，最简单的策略能走多远。
AI.method: 提出 Hill Sampling：使用冻结 LLM，反复采样候选程序编辑；维护目前已找到的最佳程序；后续所有采样都以该最佳程序为条件。评估任务包括圆填充、集合和/差、Erdos 最小重叠问题；使用三种开放权重模型。另对直接作用于 LLM 权重的进化策略（ES）进行大规模研究（按参数量计），并比较不同学习率与随机扰动、token 采样随机性等。
AI.result: Hill Sampling 在圆填充上取得已发表方法中的新 SOTA；在 Erdos 最小重叠问题上优于 AlphaEvolve 参考结果；在有限集合和/差问题上表现强劲。圆填充和 Erdos 结果仅需八张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 数小时墙钟时间。测试时 ES 学习权重的效果反而差于将 ES 学习率设为零；零学习率下仍在固定随机扰动下搜索权重空间，这些扰动有助于探索，但 token 采样随机性更强；重复采样仍明显弱于 Hill Sampling。
AI.conclusion: 测试时计算分配可采用简单策略：反复对当前已验证的最佳解采样编辑，再考虑引入档案、多样性机制、进化脚手架或测试时参数学习等额外复杂性。

58f5c7be444820cd9c999464b3e99f5117e2ac5d.title: SMTB: Fast Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds
58f5c7be444820cd9c999464b3e99f5117e2ac5d.summary: Structure-mapping forms analogies by aligning systems of relationally connected elements based on shared structure instead of surface features. We introduce a new structure-mapping algorithm: Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds (SMTB) that is 5--15x faster than the structure-mapping engine (SME) and about 50\% better at finding mappings in large nested domains. SMTB is part of the broader Cognitive Rule Engine (CRE) project, a flexible multi-language-compatible framework with an accessible Python interface to state-of-the-art C++ implementations of core algorithms commonly used in cognitive systems such as pattern matching, planning, and structure-mapping. CRE and SMTB are designed to work with a wide range of representation choices. Unlike SME, which biases higher-order correspondences in tree-like predicate logic, SMTB maximizes relational connectivity without privileging higher-order relations. This allows SMTB to work just as well over arbitrary relational graphs as it does in tree-like domains of nested predicate logic. We discuss situations where privileging "higher-orderness" in structure-mapping can cause issues, and illustrate how SMTB avoids failure modes that SME would encounter in these situations. We also provide an evaluation comparing SMTB to SME v4 over 5845 domain pairs from the SME corpus.

AI.tldr: 提出 SMTB 结构映射算法，比 SME 快 5–15 倍，在大型嵌套域中找映射能力提升约 50%，且不偏好高阶关系，可通用于任意关系图与树状谓词逻辑。
AI.motivation: 结构映射通过依据共享结构对齐关系连通元素来形成类比，而非依赖表面特征。但现有 SME 在树状谓词逻辑中偏好高阶对应，限制了其在任意关系图上的适用性，并可能引发特定失败模式，因此需要一种不偏袒"高阶性"、通用性更强的结构映射算法。
AI.method: 提出 Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds（SMTB）算法，作为 Cognitive Rule Engine（CRE）项目的一部分。CRE 是灵活的多语言兼容框架，提供 Python 接口以调用模式匹配、规划、结构映射等认知系统核心算法的先进 C++ 实现。SMTB 在最大化关系连通性时不偏好高阶关系，并兼容多种表示选择。
AI.result: SMTB 比 SME 快 5–15 倍；在大型嵌套域中寻找映射的能力约提升 50%。在 SME 语料库的 5845 个域对上，将 SMTB 与 SME v4 进行了对比评估。
AI.conclusion: SMTB 在任意关系图上与在嵌套谓词逻辑的树状域中表现同样良好。论文讨论了偏好"高阶性"可能引发的问题，并说明 SMTB 如何避免 SME 在这些情形下的失败模式。CRE 与 SMTB 可适配多种表示选择，具备良好的通用性。

976610d989144dd711fe9e6dc7b51e56c7ba9bff.title: Interpretable AI plus Handheld, Portable Retinal Photographs: A Low-Cost Glaucoma Screening Solution for West Africa
976610d989144dd711fe9e6dc7b51e56c7ba9bff.summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) framework for glaucoma screening from low-cost portable, handheld retinal fundus photographs in a West African population and to compare its performance with clinical tabletop fundus imaging. Methods: We used data from a community-based study of 681 participants (1,362 eyes) in Nigeria, comprising 414 glaucoma, 478 glaucoma suspect, and 470 non-glaucoma eyes. Fundus photographs were acquired using the low-cost handheld, portable Volk Viva retinal camera and the Canon CR-2-AF tabletop camera. We fine-tuned component models separately to each device to perform vessel segmentation, cup and disc boundary segmentation, and feature extraction to detect optic nerve head features. A final classification model combined these components to classify scans as glaucoma, glaucoma suspect or non-glaucoma. Feature-weight analysis and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping were used for interpretation. Results: The models performed well on both Volk Viva and Canon CR-2-AF images: Vessel segmentation: 0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC) (Volk) and 0.94 DC (Canon); Cup and disc segmentation: 0.95 DC (Volk) and 0.96 DC (Canon); Optic nerve head feature detection: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.83$\pm$0.03 (Volk) and 0.87$\pm$0.04 (Canon); Classification model: AUCs of 0.85$\pm$0.01 (Volk) and 0.93$\pm$0.01 (Canon). Reports for each image, present model decision confidence scores and decision-rationale visualizations to support clinical interpretation. Conclusions: Volk Viva results were reasonably comparable to Canon CR-2-AF in the component models and not far behind in classification. This shows that interpretable AI combined with low-cost, portable imaging may enhance community-level glaucoma screening, especially in settings with limited specialist access and resources.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发并评估了一种可解释AI框架，利用低成本便携式手持视网膜相机（Volk Viva）在尼日利亚社区人群中筛查青光眼，并与台式相机（Canon CR-2-AF）对比。模型在血管分割、视杯视盘分割、视神经头特征检测及三分类任务上均表现良好，手持设备结果与台式设备具有可比性，支持资源有限地区的社区级青光眼筛查。
AI.motivation: 青光眼筛查在专科医生和资源匮乏地区面临可及性挑战。低成本便携式眼底成像有望扩展社区筛查，但需要验证其图像质量与AI模型性能能否接近临床台式设备，并提升模型可解释性以支持临床决策。
AI.method: 基于尼日利亚社区研究，纳入681名参与者、1,362只眼，包括414只青光眼、478只疑似青光眼和470只非青光眼眼。分别使用低成本手持Volk Viva和Canon CR-2-AF台式相机采集眼底照片。针对每种设备分别微调组件模型，完成血管分割、视杯与视盘边界分割及视神经头特征提取，最终分类模型整合各组件，将图像分为青光眼、疑似青光眼或非青光眼。采用特征权重分析和Grad-CAM进行解释。
AI.result: 模型在Volk Viva和Canon CR-2-AF图像上均表现良好：血管分割Dice系数分别为0.98（Volk）和0.94（Canon）；视杯视盘分割分别为0.95（Volk）和0.96（Canon）；视神经头特征检测AUC分别为0.83±0.03（Volk）和0.87±0.04（Canon）；分类模型AUC分别为0.85±0.01（Volk）和0.93±0.01（Canon）。每张图像的报告提供模型决策置信度评分和决策依据可视化，以支持临床解读。
AI.conclusion: Volk Viva在组件模型上与Canon CR-2-AF结果具有合理可比性，分类性能也差距不大。这表明可解释AI结合低成本便携式成像可增强社区级青光眼筛查，尤其适用于专科医生和资源有限的场景。

a177cde864d75c080e685be000f6f8260f9b1469.title: PAKT: Physically-Aligned Kinesthetic Teaching for Reinforcement Learning
a177cde864d75c080e685be000f6f8260f9b1469.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables, Conference on Robot Learning
a177cde864d75c080e685be000f6f8260f9b1469.summary: Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) systems still struggle with the demands of contact-rich industrial manipulation, including micrometer-level precision, success rates above 99%, and human-level cycle times. Although off-policy algorithms can improve performance by leveraging demonstrations and interventions, a key bottleneck is the lack of an intuitive interface for collecting such guidance while complying with constraints of the physical system and the policy. We propose PAKT, a framework for kinesthetic teaching in RL. As opposed to teleoperation approaches, PAKT relies on kinesthetic guidance, which is widely used in industry. However, a critical weakness of kinesthetic guidance is the possibility for the operator to move the robot along trajectories (e.g., velocities, accelerations, jerk) that the robot and/or policy cannot physically reproduce. Using PAKT, operators guide the robot through admittance control, which maps human-applied forces to motion. The downstream reference generator applies the same kinematic limits used during policy execution, keeping the collected trajectories within these limits. To support this teaching interface with an appropriate execution layer, PAKT adds a high-performance control stack that maps low-frequency RL actions to high-frequency torque commands. It consists of a reference generator and subsequent impedance controller, where the reference generator preserves the tracking performance of the impedance controller while improving contact handling and producing smoother policy actions. Across the reported runs on four insertion and industrial assembly benchmarks, including a data center compute tray, the end-to-end system reduces cycle time by 23%-48% and cumulative intervention count by 62%-86% relative to the HIL-SERL baseline. Project website: https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website}{https://pakt-website.github.io/pakt-website

AI.tldr: 提出 PAKT 框架，通过导纳控制的动觉示教与高频控制栈，将低频 RL 动作映射为高频力矩指令，在接触密集的工业装配任务中显著缩短节拍时间并减少人工干预。
AI.motivation: 现实强化学习系统在接触密集的工业操作中仍难以满足微米级精度、99% 以上成功率及人类水平节拍时间的要求。尽管 off-policy 算法可借助示范与干预提升性能，关键瓶颈在于缺乏一种直观的示教接口，能够在遵循物理系统与策略约束的前提下采集指导数据。
AI.method: PAKT 采用动觉示教（而非遥操作）。操作者通过导纳控制施加人力并映射为机器人运动；下游参考生成器施加与策略执行阶段相同的运动学限制（速度、加速度、 jerk 等），确保采集轨迹在可复现范围内。执行层引入高性能控制栈，将低频 RL 动作映射为高频力矩指令，由参考生成器与随后的阻抗控制器组成，在保持阻抗控制器跟踪性能的同时改善接触处理并生成更平滑的策略动作。
AI.result: 在包括数据中心计算托盘在内的四个插装与工业装配基准任务上，端到端系统相对 HIL-SERL 基线将节拍时间缩短 23%–48%，累计干预次数减少 62%–86%。
AI.conclusion: PAKT 提供了一种符合工业实践且受约束的动觉示教接口及配套高频执行层，有效提升了接触密集工业操作中 RL 的部署效率与可靠性。

ea3c0e80f2bcbac026752506ce2b8e0026c3d3ad.title: A JEPA Recipe for Tabular Foundation Models
ea3c0e80f2bcbac026752506ce2b8e0026c3d3ad.summary: Tabular foundation models learn to predict cell values in context, whereas world-model self-supervision asks for prediction in representation space (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023). On a tabular foundation-model prior, the latent term of a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) collapsed in our earlier runs and took the encoder with it to a constant map. We report a recipe under which the latent term survives to convergence beside the value objective: the value head reads the encoder field rather than the predictor, and the target is an exponential moving average (EMA) difference. To bound its cost against the value-only arm, both arms train until a plateau rule stops them, with no fixed step budget. A fixed horizon had confounded a slowdown with a ceiling, since the value-only arm was still improving well past the usual budget. At convergence, in one run per arm, the JEPA arm trails the value-only arm across 147 real datasets, 32:70 wins to losses on classification (29:63 with one entry per dataset name) and 8:24 on regression, the margin small on classification and wider on regression, and the count leans the same way in each stratum and each benchmark. The JEPA arm (jepa) needs 1.42 times as many steps as the value-only arm (ds), and 1.66 times its wall-clock, to reach its plateau.

AI.tldr: 在表格基础模型先验上引入JEPA式潜在自监督，早期运行中潜在项坍缩并导致编码器退化为常数映射；本文给出使潜在项与数值目标共同收敛的配方，但JEPA臂在147个真实数据集上仍逊于仅数值臂，且训练步数与墙钟时间更高。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文预测单元格值，而世界模型自监督（如JEPA）要求在表示空间进行预测。作者尝试将二者结合，但初步运行中联合嵌入预测架构的潜在项坍缩，并将编码器拖成常数映射。因此需要找到一种配方，使潜在项能在收敛时与数值目标并存，并公平评估其性能与计算代价。
AI.method: 关键设计：数值预测头从编码器场读取，而非从预测器读取；潜在目标采用指数移动平均（EMA）差值。为公平比较JEPA臂与仅数值臂，两臂均按平台期规则停止训练，不设固定步数预算。作者指出，固定训练时域会把减速误判为性能上限，因为仅数值臂在常规预算之后仍在持续提升。
AI.result: 收敛后，每臂一次运行，在147个真实数据集上，JEPA臂整体落后于仅数值臂：分类胜负比为32:70（按数据集名称去重后为29:63），回归为8:24。分类差距较小，回归差距更大；各分层与各基准的胜负计数方向一致。JEPA臂达到平台期需要1.42倍训练步数和1.66倍墙钟时间。
AI.conclusion: 所提配方可避免潜在项坍缩，使JEPA潜在目标与数值目标共同收敛，但在当前设置下并未带来性能收益，反而在多数数据集上弱于仅数值目标，并增加训练成本。未来需进一步分析表格基础模型中潜在自监督的价值与效率权衡。

70247adf152d933b9beb6ac8e457770c543b5125.title: Weakly Supervised Quantum Error Mitigation
70247adf152d933b9beb6ac8e457770c543b5125.summary: Supervised approaches to quantum error mitigation learn a map from noisy circuit outputs to ideal ones, and therefore require the ideal outputs. Producing those ideal outputs demands noiseless classical simulation, whose cost grows exponentially with system size, so supervision is unavailable in exactly the regime where mitigation matters most. We ask whether cheap, individually unreliable signals drawn from circuit structure and hardware calibration can take the place of ideal labels. We assemble sixteen heuristic labeling functions (stabilizer and parity constraints, relaxation and readout characteristics, local depth, gate counts, and neighboring activity), reconcile their disagreements with a probabilistic label model, and read the resulting per-qubit error probabilities as a readout channel whose inverse mitigates the measured distribution. No ideal output enters the training path. On $147{,}000$ five-qubit circuits executed on two IBM devices, the method removes $24.3\%$ (Algiers) and $28.8\%$ (Hanoi) of the Kullback-Leibler divergence to the ideal distribution, against $15.4\%$ and $21.5\%$ for the strongest published analytical baseline, a margin that holds on both devices and lies far outside its bootstrap interval. Supervised neural models trained on ideal distributions remain stronger where such labels exist, and we quantify that gap rather than setting it aside; the method's claim is to the regime where they do not, since the labels they require cannot be computed for the circuits mitigation is needed for. The codes will be released shortly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需理想标签的量子误差缓解方法：用16个来自电路结构与硬件校准的启发式标注函数，经概率标签模型整合分歧，得到逐比特误差概率并作为读出信道的逆来缓解测量分布。在147,000个五比特电路、两台IBM设备上验证，较最强解析基线显著降低与理想分布的KL散度。
AI.motivation: 监督式量子误差缓解需要从噪声输出学习到理想输出的映射，因而依赖理想输出标签。但获取理想输出需无噪声经典模拟，其成本随系统规模指数增长，导致在误差缓解最关键的大规模场景中恰恰无法获得监督标签。作者由此发问：能否用廉价但单独不可靠的信号（来自电路结构与硬件校准）替代理想标签。
AI.method: 构建16个启发式标注函数，涵盖稳定子与奇偶约束、弛豫与读出特性、局部深度、门计数以及邻域活动等信号；用概率标签模型调和这些标注函数之间的分歧；将所得的逐比特误差概率视为读出信道，通过求其逆来缓解测量分布。整个训练路径中不引入任何理想输出。
AI.result: 在147,000个五比特电路、两台IBM设备上执行：本方法分别消除24.3%（Algiers）和28.8%（Hanoi）到理想分布的KL散度，而最强已发表解析基线仅为15.4%和21.5%；该优势在两台设备上均成立，且远超其自举（bootstrap）置信区间。在存在理想标签的场景下，基于理想分布训练的监督神经网络模型仍然更强，作者量化了这一差距而非回避。
AI.conclusion: 本方法的适用定位是无理想标签可用的场景——即误差缓解真正被需要的、无法计算监督标签的电路规模区间。该方法以廉价弱监督信号替代理想标签，在实测中稳定优于解析基线，代码将很快发布。

d0d7d26043a1bc07cd92dbd2150a49d43bff1a58.title: FoMo: Forking Moment in Generative Trajectory as a Perceptual Distance
d0d7d26043a1bc07cd92dbd2150a49d43bff1a58.summary: Reference-based image quality assessment (IQA) metrics aim to reflect how humans perceive the perceptual distance between a pair of images. To learn how the human visual system (HVS) operates, recent reference-based IQA metrics heavily rely on human-annotated data. Mean opinion score (MOS)-based pointwise scoring, which assigns a scalar quality value per image, is preferable for annotation but is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale and is known to be noisy due to inconsistent human judgments. As an alternative, two-alternative forced choice (2AFC) pairwise labels have gained popularity due to their reliability and efficiency, but they capture only relative comparisons between pairs. In this paper, we propose a fully automated data generation pipeline that generates pointwise perceptual distance labels between image pairs without any human annotation. Our approach exploits the generative dynamics of diffusion models as a perceptual distance proxy, where the coarse structure of an image is generated in the early timesteps and the fine details are generated in the later timesteps. Images that fork early in the generation process share only coarse structure and are perceptually far apart; images that fork late differ only in fine detail. We demonstrate that the diffusion trajectory aligns well with the human visual system, and use this forking moment, FoMo, as a reference-grounded distance label to supervise the training of a reference-based IQA metric. The pointwise labels, which support universal comparison between arbitrary image pairs, enable an information-rich training objective. Extensive experiments across diverse backbone architectures confirm the effectiveness of our generation pipeline, outperforming human-annotated datasets in multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全自动数据生成流程，利用扩散模型生成过程中的“分叉时刻”（FoMo）作为感知距离标签，无需人工标注即可训练参考型图像质量评价（IQA）指标，并在多个基准上优于使用人工标注数据的方法。
AI.motivation: 参考型IQA需反映人类视觉系统（HVS）对图像对感知距离的判断。现有方法依赖人工标注：基于MOS的逐点标量评分便于标注但大规模采集成本极高且噪声大；2AFC成对标签更可靠高效，却只能提供相对比较，缺乏逐点绝对距离信息。
AI.method: 利用扩散模型的生成动态作为感知距离代理：早期时间步生成粗结构，后期时间步生成细节。若两张图像在生成过程中较早分叉，则仅共享粗结构，感知距离较大；若较晚分叉，则仅细节不同，感知距离较小。将这一分叉时刻FoMo作为参考锚定的逐点距离标签，监督参考型IQA指标训练；该逐点标签支持任意图像对之间的通用比较，形成信息量更丰富的训练目标。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络架构上进行广泛实验，验证了所提生成流程的有效性，并在多个基准上超过使用人工标注数据集训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 扩散生成轨迹与人类视觉感知具有良好一致性；基于FoMo的自动标注可替代昂贵且噪声较大的人工MOS标注，为参考型IQA提供可扩展、信息丰富的监督信号。

bac0bb533fc0f6d025c724be5d3c7aff8870598c.title: DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation
bac0bb533fc0f6d025c724be5d3c7aff8870598c.summary: Dynamic object manipulation is essential for robots operating in real-world environments, yet methods for generating high-quality demonstrations remain limited. Methods designed for static tasks do not readily transfer to dynamic settings. Among dynamic demonstration generators, planning-based methods can fail near contact, while DOMINO-style replay simplifies dynamic interactions and may limit the experience available for policy learning. We present DynaForge, a planning-guided framework that learns residual corrections for dynamic manipulation demonstration generation. DynaForge combines low-frequency global planning with high-frequency object-centric inverse kinematics across task phases, and applies a residual policy to correct actions during dynamic interaction. An implicit curriculum groups rollouts under matched conditions and selects mixed-success groups, focusing residual reinforcement learning on the evolving competence frontier. On Can and Bottle, it uses 0.73x as many optimizer steps as vanilla GRPO at the same nominal environment-step budget, with higher observed final success rates. Across nine simulation tasks, DynaForge increases mean demonstration-generation success from 41.30% of the planning prior to 78.37%. With 800 demonstrations per task, DP3 policies trained on DynaForge data achieve 49.11% mean success, compared with 7.07% for DOMINO data. On three real-world dynamic tasks, DynaForge-trained policies achieve 30-60% success, compared with 0-10% for DOMINO-trained policies, showing the ability of DynaForge for sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: DynaForge 是一种规划引导的动态操作示范生成框架，通过学习残差修正来提升动态交互示范质量与下游策略性能。
AI.motivation: 动态物体操作对真实环境中的机器人至关重要，但高质量示范生成方法有限。为静态任务设计的方法难以迁移到动态场景；基于规划的方法在接触附近容易失败，DOMINO 式回放则简化了动态交互，可能限制策略学习可用的经验。
AI.method: DynaForge 将低频全局规划与高频以物体为中心的逆运动学跨任务阶段结合，并应用残差策略在动态交互过程中修正动作。通过隐式课程将匹配条件下的 rollout 分组，并选择“混合成功”组，使残差强化学习聚焦于不断演化的能力前沿。
AI.result: 在 Can 和 Bottle 上，相同名义环境步数预算下，DynaForge 使用 0.73 倍于 vanilla GRPO 的优化器步数，并取得更高最终成功率。在九个仿真任务中，平均示范生成成功率从规划先验的 41.30% 提升至 78.37%。每任务 800 条示范时，基于 DynaForge 数据训练的 DP3 策略平均成功率为 49.11%，DOMINO 数据为 7.07%。在三个真实世界动态任务中，DynaForge 训练的策略成功率为 30–60%，DOMINO 为 0–10%，显示出 sim-to-real 迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: DynaForge 能有效提升动态操作示范生成成功率，并显著改善下游策略在仿真与真实任务中的表现，具备较好的仿真到现实迁移能力。

6bc8cba587281052de4eb68d2fd289a5c57be583.title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
6bc8cba587281052de4eb68d2fd289a5c57be583.summary: Corporate default prediction is a core problem in financial risk management, yet traditional credit models rely heavily on financial statements that are often sparse or unavailable for many firms. Corporate transaction networks offer a complementary view of real economic activity, but how risk propagates through buyer-seller relationships remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study using real-world electronic tax-invoice data spanning six years that links transaction histories with default events, revealing that transaction-driven risk is both role-dependent (buyer or seller) and scale-dependent. Based on these findings, we construct multiplex buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks and propose DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective graph neural network-based framework for corporate default prediction. DefaultGNN integrates both views to model how risk flows through transactional relationships, achieving strong improvements over both attribute-based and graph-based baselines, especially for firms with limited intrinsic risk signals. We further provide interpretable network-based explanations by visualizing how distressed trading partners contribute to default risk. In collaboration with a licensed credit rating agency, we validate that DefaultGNN's predictions complement existing credit scoring models, improving approval rates by 7-11%p without increasing default risk among approved firms. The source code can be found at https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN

AI.tldr: 该论文利用六年电子发票交易数据研究企业间风险传播，发现交易风险具有角色依赖性与规模依赖性，进而构建买方/卖方双视角多层交易网络，提出双视角图神经网络框架 DefaultGNN 用于企业违约预测，并在与持牌信用评级机构合作中验证其可补充现有信用评分、在不大幅增加违约风险的情况下将通过率提升 7–11 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 企业违约预测是金融风险管理的核心问题，但传统信用模型高度依赖财务报表，而许多企业财务报表稀疏或不可得。企业交易网络提供了反映真实经济活动的补充视角，但风险如何通过买卖关系传播仍研究不足。
AI.method: 基于六年真实电子税务发票数据开展大规模实证研究，将交易历史与违约事件关联，揭示交易驱动风险的角色依赖性（买方或卖方）和规模依赖性。据此构建买方视角与卖方视角的多层交易网络，并提出 DefaultGNN：一种双视角图神经网络企业违约预测框架。该框架整合两个视角，建模风险沿交易关系流动，并提供基于网络的可解释性可视化，展示困境交易伙伴如何贡献违约风险。
AI.result: DefaultGNN 相对基于属性的模型和基于图的基线均取得显著提升，尤其对自身风险信号有限的企业效果更明显。与持牌信用评级机构合作验证表明，其预测能补充现有信用评分模型，在获批企业违约风险不增加的情况下，将通过率提升 7–11 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 交易网络中的风险传播具有角色与规模异质性，双视角图神经网络能够有效利用买卖关系信息提升企业违约预测，并具备可解释性与现实业务补充价值，可作为传统信用评分体系的有效增强工具。源代码已公开。

e54f38640ab2482a1b668fcdba69d14aaf6e47da.title: Recovering Agentic Sovereignty: Mitigating the Consensus Paradox via Contrastive Epistemic Decoding
e54f38640ab2482a1b668fcdba69d14aaf6e47da.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a parametric vulnerability to adversarial swarm consensus. To mitigate this sycophancy, we introduce Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED), a zero-shot inference intervention. Unlike standard Contrastive Decoding (CD) which relies on a weaker secondary model, CED utilizes a dual forward-pass on a single architecture to isolate conformity bias. By introducing a novel asymmetric, zero-bounded probability clamp and discrete top-k truncation mask, CED mathematically suppresses toxic consensus tokens without causing grammatical collapse. Evaluated across 7,200 paired trajectories on complex benchmarks (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) using Gemma-2 (9B), Llama-3.1 (8B), and Mistral v0.3 (7B), CED successfully neutralizes architectural and positional biases. By reducing cognitive loafing by up to 33.00% absolute, CED drives significant performance gains, yielding up to a 30.75% accuracy recovery. Regaining sovereignty induces distinct architectural behaviors---passive task-focus in Gemma-2 and active refutation of the simulated swarm in Llama-3.1---showing CED decouples compliance from capability without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本推理干预方法 Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED)，利用单模型双前向对比抑制对抗性群体共识引发的从众偏差，在多个复杂基准上最高恢复 30.75% 准确率，且无需微调。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对对抗性群体共识存在参数化脆弱性，并表现出谄媚/从众行为；标准 Contrastive Decoding 依赖较弱的辅助模型，作者希望以零样本、单架构方式缓解 conformity bias。
AI.method: CED 是一种零样本推理干预：在单一架构上进行双前向传播以隔离从众偏差；引入非对称、零下界概率 clamp 和离散 top-k 截断掩码，从数学上压制 toxic consensus tokens，同时避免语法崩塌。
AI.result: 在 GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge 等复杂基准上，使用 Gemma-2 (9B)、Llama-3.1 (8B)、Mistral v0.3 (7B) 评估 7,200 条成对轨迹。CED 成功中和架构与位置偏差，将 cognitive loafing 最多绝对降低 33.00%，带来最高 30.75% 的准确率恢复；行为上，Gemma-2 表现为被动任务聚焦，Llama-3.1 表现为主动反驳模拟群体。
AI.conclusion: CED 无需微调即可解耦模型的顺从性与能力，恢复模型自主决策并产生不同架构下的差异化行为，说明缓解谄媚不必以牺牲任务能力为代价。

3bb46588caf7bc493b537969e896809277b6226c.title: Annual Earth-observation embeddings encode wildfire disturbance and support simplified burned area mapping
3bb46588caf7bc493b537969e896809277b6226c.summary: Medium-resolution (10-30 m) burned area mapping is vital for monitoring wildfires and their impacts, but remains difficult to scale. Existing methods require either curated fire-specific imagery or dense time-series analysis. Here, we tested whether annual Earth-observation embeddings retain wildfire disturbance signals sufficiently to map burned areas without either requirement. Using Tessera and AlphaEarth embeddings, we tested individual burn-scar delineation, mapping of all same-year fires within an area, regional wall-to-wall mapping, cross-continental transfer, and intra-annual fire timing. Tessera strongly encoded wildfire disturbance, allowing even linear models to separate burned from unburned pixels; the signal was weaker in AlphaEarth. Models trained on a single Tessera embedding matched or exceeded equivalent models using paired pre- and post-fire HLS imagery, and outperformed post-fire imagery alone. The same approach mapped all same-year fires within benchmark scenes (F1 = 0.90). Applied across California, with no California fire data used for downstream training, it recovered 97% of reference burned area and detected substantially more small and medium-sized fires than GABAM or MCD64A1. Separately, a model trained on 2018-2021 US fires transferred without retraining to 88 European fires from 2024-2025 (F1 = 0.88). For well-detected fires, ignition timing was recovered with a mean absolute error of 13 days. Performance declined for fires ignited near the end of the calendar year, and wall-to-wall deployment produced systematic false positives in some unseen landscapes. Annual embeddings nevertheless achieve high segmentation accuracy while moving the burden of dense time series processing upstream, providing a promising path towards simpler regional burned area mapping.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试年度地球观测嵌入（Tessera与AlphaEarth）能否在无需火情专用影像或密集时间序列分析的条件下，实现中分辨率（10–30 m）火烧区制图，并证明Tessera嵌入足以支撑高精度、可迁移的烧痕识别。
AI.motivation: 中分辨率火烧区制图对野火监测至关重要，但现有方法依赖专门筛选的火情影像或密集时序分析，难以规模化推广。作者希望验证年度嵌入是否保留足够的火灾扰动信号，从而简化区域级火烧区制图流程。
AI.method: 使用Tessera和AlphaEarth年度嵌入，开展多项任务测试：单烧痕勾绘、同一年内全部火灾制图、区域无缝制图、跨大陆迁移以及年内火情时间推断。比较单幅Tessera嵌入模型与配对火前/火后HLS影像模型、仅火后影像模型的表现；并在加州无本地火情训练数据的条件下进行区域应用，同时测试2018–2021年美国火灾模型向2024–2025年88场欧洲火灾的零样本迁移。
AI.result: Tessera强编码野火扰动信号，线性模型即可区分烧毁与未烧毁像元；AlphaEarth信号较弱。单幅Tessera嵌入模型匹配或超过配对火前/火后HLS影像模型，并优于仅火后影像模型。同一年内全部火灾制图F1=0.90；加州区域制图恢复97%参考烧毁面积，较GABAM或MCD64A1检测到更多中小型火灾；跨大陆零样本迁移F1=0.88；对检测良好的火灾，点火时间平均绝对误差13天。年末点火火灾性能下降，无缝部署在部分未见景观中产生系统性误报。
AI.conclusion: 年度嵌入可实现高精度火烧区分割，并将密集时序处理负担前移至上游，为更简化的区域火烧区制图提供了有前景的路径，但需关注年末火灾与未见景观中的误报问题。

27ae96c61ca26cc8d1264c2d4ccc3d02832077ff.title: RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents
27ae96c61ca26cc8d1264c2d4ccc3d02832077ff.summary: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive success rates, yet their actual instruction-following ability is far weaker than these numbers suggest. We trace this illusion to a structural property we term low scene entropy: when a visual scene admits only one valid task, language becomes redundant and a policy can score highly while barely using it. We introduce RoboFollow, a diagnostic benchmark with three principles: (1) High Scene Entropy: each training scene supports multiple kinematically distinct task branches, making vision alone insufficient and forcing reliance on language. (2) Hierarchical Diagnostic Protocol: a four-level protocol (L0--L3) progressively perturbs visual layout and semantics, probing whether equivalent instructions yield consistent behavior and distinct ones yield discriminable behavior across spatial relations, attributes, trajectory constraints, and logic. (3) Confound-Controlled Diagnosis: we simplify interaction objects, restrict actions to the trained repertoire and report stage-wise Intent and Execution scores, isolating comprehension from motor execution. Evaluation of nine VLA and WAM policies shows that strong L0 performance, where attained, does not reliably transfer to L1--L3 under our fine-tuning setup. Representative mitigations, including stronger VLM backbones, QA co-training, LangForce, and Classifier-Free Guidance, all fail to close this gap. RoboFollow exposes genuine instruction following as a critical, overlooked bottleneck. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboFollow and https://huggingface.co/datasets/AutoLab-SJTU/robofollow-data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboFollow 诊断基准，通过"低场景熵"解释具身智能体指令跟随能力的虚高，并设计高场景熵、四级诊断协议（L0–L3）与混淆受控评估，揭示现有 VLA/WAM 策略在语言依赖上的真实缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前具身智能体虽取得很高的成功率，但其真实指令跟随能力远弱于数字所示。作者将这一"错觉"归因于结构性属性——低场景熵（low scene entropy）：当视觉场景只对应唯一有效任务时，语言信息变得冗余，策略可在几乎不使用语言的情况下获得高分，从而掩盖了指令理解能力的不足。
AI.method: 提出 RoboFollow 诊断基准，含三项原则：(1) 高场景熵：每个训练场景支持多条运动学上不同的任务分支，使视觉信息不足以决策，迫使模型依赖语言；(2) 分层诊断协议：L0–L3 四级协议逐步扰动视觉布局与语义，检验等价指令是否产生一致行为、不同指令是否产生可区分行为，覆盖空间关系、属性、轨迹约束与逻辑；(3) 混淆受控诊断：简化交互物体、将动作限制在已训练动作库内，并分阶段报告 Intent（意图）与 Execution（执行）得分，以隔离理解与运动执行。
AI.result: 对九种 VLA 与 WAM 策略的评估显示：即便在 L0 上表现优异，也难以在微调设定下可靠迁移到 L1–L3。代表性缓解手段——更强的 VLM 骨干、QA 协同训练、LangForce 以及 Classifier-Free Guidance——均未能弥合这一差距。
AI.conclusion: RoboFollow 揭示了真正的指令跟随能力是被长期忽视的关键瓶颈；代码与数据集已开源。

fbf7c4a0028c18e381cf0fcc790a7d64bf833ab8.title: SambaGraph: Action-Reaction Spatio-Temporal Graphs for Soccer Tactical Response Modeling
fbf7c4a0028c18e381cf0fcc790a7d64bf833ab8.summary: Soccer tactics are interactive: an attacking action changes the opponent's defensive problem, and the observed response depends on the multi-agent match state. We introduce SambaGraph, an action--reaction spatio-temporal graph dataset and benchmark for soccer tactical response modeling. From tracking and event data for all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup, we curate 4,070 action-centered episodes represented as temporally aligned 23-node player--ball graph sequences with attack/defense views, response labels, and 26,270 split-safe attack--defense pairs. We study three questions: whether observed responses can be classified from graph episodes, whether successful defenses can be retrieved for a query attack, and whether graph-derived summaries support grounded LLM reasoning. A compact signature MLP obtains $0.796\pm0.007$ macro-F1 for response classification, while a fused graph--signature dual encoder reaches $0.471\pm0.029$ Hit@5 and $0.655\pm0.051$ Hit@10 for full-bank defensive retrieval. Hard negatives maximize pair discrimination but not retrieval quality. Local LLMs underperform supervised encoders for direct classification and do not improve over a strong original order in eight-candidate reranking, but they provide grounded tactical rationales. These results position SambaGraph as a reproducible benchmark for graph-based soccer strategy-response research. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/areyesan/SambaGraph.

AI.tldr: SambaGraph：基于2022世界杯全部64场比赛构建的动作—反应时空图数据集与基准，用于足球战术反应建模，并系统评估响应分类、防守检索与LLM推理三类任务。
AI.motivation: 足球战术本质是交互式的：进攻动作会改变对手的防守问题，而观察到的防守反应又依赖于多智能体的整体比赛状态。然而现有工作缺乏能够显式刻画“动作—反应”交互关系、且可复现的图结构数据与基准，难以支持战术响应建模的系统研究。
AI.method: 基于2022 FIFA世界杯全部64场比赛的追踪数据与事件数据，构建SambaGraph数据集：整理出4,070个以动作中心的回合（episode），表示为时间对齐的23节点“球员—球”图序列，并区分进攻/防守视角；包含反应标签以及26,270个防划分泄露（split-safe）的攻防配对。围绕三类问题展开评测：(1) 从图回合中分类观察到的反应；(2) 为查询进攻检索成功防守；(3) 图衍生摘要是否支持有据可依的LLM推理。采用紧凑签名MLP与融合的图—签名双编码器，并对比局部LLM在直接分类与八候选重排序中的表现。
AI.result: 紧凑签名MLP在响应分类上取得0.796±0.007的macro-F1；融合图—签名双编码器在全库防守检索上达到0.471±0.029的Hit@5与0.655±0.051的Hit@10。实验表明硬负样本能最大化配对区分度但并不提升检索质量；局部LLM在直接分类上弱于监督编码器，在八候选重排序中也不优于强原始顺序，但能提供有据可依的战术理由。
AI.conclusion: SambaGraph为基于图的足球战术“策略—反应”研究提供了一个可复现的基准，并揭示了监督编码器与LLM在该任务上的能力边界。代码与数据集已开源。

dd65f260345ddd1ffafe53adda100bab6cfc7c99.title: A Behavioral Trait Leaks into Preferences: Diagnosing Trait Interference in LLM User Simulators
dd65f260345ddd1ffafe53adda100bab6cfc7c99.summary: LLM-based user simulators aim to bridge the offline-online gap in recommender evaluation by emulating users through injected traits, where preference attributes determine what a user engages with and a behavioral activity trait governs how long they browse. However, we show this intended trait independence collapses during simulation, causing two failures: (i) Trait Interference, where amplified activity distorts preference boundaries and forces interactions with mismatched items to sustain browsing, and (ii) Evaluation Invalidity, where satisfaction scores inflate with activity-driven page counts despite taste mismatches, biasing evaluation toward trait distributions rather than recommender performance. To resolve this, we propose PQA, a page-level quality anchoring method that guides simulators using a personalized anchor reflecting each user's intrinsic preference standard. By assessing whether a page meets this standard before further browsing, PQA enables proactive exits from low-quality pages, letting the activity trait retain its intended role of modulating browsing depth within preference-conforming pages. Experiments show PQA mitigates trait interference and improves the reliability of LLM-based simulator evaluation under activity shifts. Our code is available at https://github.com/chaehyun1/PQA

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示LLM用户模拟器中偏好属性与行为活跃度属性本应相互独立，但在模拟中发生"特质干扰"与"评估失效"，并提出页级质量锚定方法PQA，以个性化锚点引导模拟器主动退出低质量页面，从而恢复特质的独立作用并提升评估可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM用户模拟器被用于弥合推荐系统评估中的离线-在线差距，其设计依赖特质注入：偏好属性决定用户与何种物品交互，行为活跃度特质决定浏览时长。作者发现这种假定的特质独立性在模拟过程中会崩塌，导致评估偏差，因此需要一种能维持特质各自作用、保证评估有效性的方法。
AI.method: 提出PQA（页级质量锚定，Page-level Quality Anchoring）。该方法为每个用户构建反映其内在偏好标准的个性化锚点，在模拟器继续浏览之前先评估当前页面是否满足该标准，从而支持对低质量页面的主动退出。这样，活跃度特质被约束为只在符合偏好的页面内调节浏览深度，恢复其原本的调制角色。
AI.result: 实验表明，PQA能够缓解特质干扰（Trait Interference），并在活跃度变化（activity shifts）条件下提升LLM模拟器评估的可靠性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PQA通过页级质量锚定恢复了偏好属性与活跃度特质的预期分工，抑制了特质干扰与评估失效，为基于LLM的推荐评估提供了更可靠的方案。

4f574256b79698109397ad78c0e5be6aa6cc89dd.title: Fysiverse-3D-Vision Technical Report: Generating Executable 3D Worlds from Images through Unified Spatial Reasoning
4f574256b79698109397ad78c0e5be6aa6cc89dd.summary: Generative models have advanced image-conditioned 3D content creation, yet generating controllable and executable 3D scenes from a single image remains challenging. Existing 3D generative approaches can synthesize visually plausible objects and scenes, but their spatial layout estimation is coupled with specific asset generators. They struggle to jointly model object semantics, metric geometry, and scene-level spatial relationships, which are essential for interactive editing, physical simulation, and embodied applications. We propose Fysiverse-3D-Vision, a unified vision-language-geometry framework for generative 3D scene reconstruction and executable asset construction from a single image. We establish a shared representation where spatial reasoning and geometric reconstruction mutually enhance each other, allowing object layouts to be inferred beyond the constraints of individual asset generators. Our model integrates textual supervision, semantic visual cues, and geometric representations within a unified Transformer to capture scene context, metric geometry, and object-level interactions. An object-conditioned layout module performs cross-attention between target object representations and global geometric features to predict object translation, rotation, and scale. Training progressively learns geometry-language alignment, introduces layout reasoning while preserving reconstruction capability, and refines physical consistency through collision-aware optimization. By separating spatial layout reasoning from asset synthesis, Fysiverse-3D-Vision provides an adaptable interface for interactive scene editing, object-level manipulations, and executable 3D content generation. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves superior geometric consistency, layout estimation, rendering quality, and physical property understanding compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fysiverse-3D-Vision，一个统一的视觉-语言-几何框架，从单张图像生成可控且可执行的 3D 场景，通过解耦空间布局推理与资产生成实现更好的几何一致性、布局估计与物理理解。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法虽能合成视觉上合理的物体与场景，但空间布局估计与特定资产生成器深度耦合，难以联合建模物体语义、度量几何与场景级空间关系，从而限制了交互式编辑、物理仿真和具身应用。
AI.method: 构建共享表示使空间推理与几何重建相互增强；在统一 Transformer 中整合文本监督、语义视觉线索与几何表示以捕捉场景上下文、度量几何和物体级交互；设计物体条件布局模块，通过目标物体表示与全局几何特征的交叉注意力预测平移、旋转和尺度；采用渐进式训练：先学习几何-语言对齐，再引入布局推理并保持重建能力，最后通过碰撞感知优化精炼物理一致性；将空间布局推理与资产合成分离，提供可适配的交互接口。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在几何一致性、布局估计、渲染质量以及物理属性理解方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦空间布局推理与资产合成，Fysiverse-3D-Vision 为交互式场景编辑、物体级操作和可执行 3D 内容生成提供了可适配接口，验证了统一视觉-语言-几何框架在单图生成可控可执行 3D 场景上的有效性。

afc54ad7c3008bf904e2e918abb953458307ef01.title: A Reconfigurable Bidirectional Cable-Driven Hip Exoskeleton with Swappable Bench/Backpack Dual-configuration Actuation
afc54ad7c3008bf904e2e918abb953458307ef01.summary: Hip exoskeletons provide an important hardware basis for lower-limb rehabilitation and locomotor assistance. Laboratory rehabilitation assessment and system development require substantial actuation and computing resources, whereas mobile assistance requires untethered portability. Integrating both capabilities within one reusable platform remains a central design challenge. This paper presents a reconfigurable bidirectional cable-driven hip exoskeleton platform that rapidly switches between bench-mounted and backpack-mounted actuation while sharing one cable-free wearable hip interface. The platform modularly adapts the actuation configuration, end-effector sensing path, and low-level control interface. Each cable-driven end-effector weighs 0.405 kg, excluding the cable and actuation unit, and integrates an encoder and a torque sensor; experiments validated bench-mounted admittance-based motion tracking capability and backpack-mounted open-loop torque tracking. Human-worn experiments with three healthy participants used myoMOTION to evaluate the platform's wearable-side hip-motion sensing capability, verified bench-to-backpack and backpack-to-bench motion-ready switching across 30 trials in $30.1\pm16.3$ s, and formed a small-scale multimodal wearable-exoskeleton gait dataset for sensing validation and data-driven algorithm development, comprising 8 min bench-mounted treadmill records and 11 min backpack-mounted outdoor walking records. These results show that, by unifying the wearable structure, actuation interface, and sensing path, the proposed platform enables validation of the same hip exoskeleton in both bench-mounted and backpack-mounted configurations, providing reusable hardware for iterative development and applications across scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可重构双向线驱动髋关节外骨骼平台，可在台式与背包式驱动间快速切换，共用无线缆可穿戴髋部接口，实现同一硬件在实验室康复评估与户外移动辅助两类场景中的复用。
AI.motivation: 实验室康复评估与系统开发需要充足的驱动和计算资源，而移动辅助则要求无缆便携。将两种能力集成于同一可复用平台是核心设计挑战。
AI.method: 设计可重构双向线驱动髋外骨骼平台，模块化适配驱动构型、末端传感路径与底层控制接口，实现台式/背包式驱动与同一无缆可穿戴髋部接口的共享。每个线驱动末端执行器重0.405 kg（不含线缆与驱动单元），集成编码器与力矩传感器。验证了台式导纳式运动跟踪与背包式开环力矩跟踪，并由3名健康受试者佩戴myoMOTION评估可穿戴侧髋部运动感知能力。
AI.result: 30次试验中完成台式至背包式及背包式至台式运动就绪切换，平均耗时30.1±16.3 s；构建小规模多模态可穿戴外骨骼步态数据集，包含8 min台式跑步机记录与11 min背包式户外行走记录。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一可穿戴结构、驱动接口与传感路径，该平台使同一髋外骨骼可在台式与背包式构型下验证，为跨场景迭代开发与应用提供可复用硬件。

d2d2d0e9d585f05f8bcb55af025de592ec5e27c3.title: EMGBlend: Heterogeneity-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining for Gesture and Force Decoding
d2d2d0e9d585f05f8bcb55af025de592ec5e27c3.summary: Public surface electromyography (EMG) datasets vary widely in electrode layout, channel count, frequency support, and size. Simply mixing them for pretraining can misalign channel semantics, introduce spectral targets that some devices cannot observe, and let large or high-channel-count datasets dominate learning. We introduce EMGBlend, a self-supervised framework designed around these differences. It combines shared channel patches with geometry-aware attention, restricts spectral targets to each recording's supported frequency band, and balances exposure across data sources. We pretrain a 109M-parameter model on 11 public EMG sources and evaluate it on gesture recognition, continuous-force regression, and contact classification. EMGBlend consistently outperforms matched random initialization and waveform reconstruction controls. Fixed-budget source controls show that multi-source pretraining improves gesture recognition and remains competitive for force decoding. Ablations confirm that geometry, band-aware targets, and source balancing each contribute to transfer, although cross-person NinaPro force estimation remains difficult. Overall, EMGBlend shows how heterogeneous EMG datasets can be combined through explicit mechanism design rather than simple concatenation. Code is available at https://github.com/tamanano/EMGBlend

AI.tldr: EMGBlend：面向异构公共sEMG数据集的自监督预训练框架，通过共享通道patch、几何感知注意力、频带受限谱目标与数据源平衡，在11个公开源上预训练109M参数模型，并在手势识别、连续力回归和接触分类上优于随机初始化与波形重构对照。
AI.motivation: 公共表面肌电（sEMG）数据集在电极布局、通道数、频率支持范围和规模上差异显著；直接混合预训练会导致通道语义错位、引入部分设备无法观测的谱目标，并让大规模或高通道数数据集主导学习。
AI.method: 提出EMGBlend自监督框架：结合共享通道patch与几何感知注意力；将谱目标限制在每条记录支持的频带内；跨数据源平衡采样/暴露。基于11个公开EMG源预训练109M参数模型，并迁移至手势识别、连续力回归与接触分类。
AI.result: EMGBlend持续优于匹配的随机初始化与波形重构对照。固定预算数据源对照表明，多源预训练提升手势识别，并在力解码上保持竞争力。消融显示几何、频带感知目标与数据源平衡均对迁移有贡献；但跨受试者NinaPro力估计仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: 异构EMG数据集可通过显式机制设计有效结合，而非简单拼接；EMGBlend为多源sEMG预训练提供了可迁移框架，代码已开源。

6ef032c6df2de95eb374b63e7a59cee92a2690e8.title: Direct Optimization of Generators for Search in Automated Theorem Proving
6ef032c6df2de95eb374b63e7a59cee92a2690e8.summary: Fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advance Automated Theorem Proving (ATP), but are often deployed as guiding policies within tree search rather than for single-attempt generation. Recent work shows cross entropy is suboptimal for an LLM used in flat search strategies such as aggregation or filtering and that work has developed new loss functions to correct this misalignment. Extending this alignment to tree search is more challenging: proof discovery depends on exploration and recovery through off-trace states that supervised demonstrations do not reveal. We extend Compute-Aligned Training (CAT) to this setting through an abstraction of policy-guided search, deriving tractable, trace-supported losses. Alongside these search-aware losses, we introduce a search-agnostic uniform-allocation (UA) loss that accounts for the budget without specifying the specific search. Both induce scalar weights on per-tactic cross-entropy gradients. We characterize how off-trace behavior affects the search-aware weights, including conditions for vanishing approximation error at large budgets. On a Lean benchmark, both approaches achieve higher observed proof-success rates than cross-entropy across six search strategies, with strong results from a single shared UA adapter. Budget sweeps show larger gains over cross-entropy at 16 than at 256 expansions, implying CAT scales with test time compute.

AI.tldr: 该工作将计算对齐训练（CAT）从扁平搜索扩展到树搜索，提出搜索感知的、有轨迹支持的损失以及搜索无关的均匀分配（UA）损失；二者等价于对逐策略交叉熵梯度施加标量权重，在Lean基准上于六种搜索策略中提升证明成功率，并显示性能随测试时计算预算扩展。
AI.motivation: 微调大语言模型（LLM）已成为自动定理证明（ATP）的重要方法，但LLM通常作为树搜索中的引导策略，而非单次生成。已有研究表明，交叉熵损失对于聚合、筛选等扁平搜索策略并非最优，并提出了相应损失函数；然而将这种训练-搜索对齐扩展到树搜索更具挑战：证明发现依赖探索以及从监督演示未揭示的偏离轨迹（off-trace）状态中恢复。
AI.method: 作者将计算对齐训练（CAT）扩展到策略引导的树搜索场景：通过对策略引导搜索进行抽象，推导可计算且由轨迹支持的搜索感知损失；同时提出搜索无关的均匀分配（UA）损失，在不指定具体搜索策略的情况下考虑预算分配。两类损失均可归结为对逐策略（per-tactic）交叉熵梯度施加标量权重。作者还刻画了偏离轨迹行为对搜索感知权重的影响，并给出大预算下近似误差消失的条件。
AI.result: 在Lean基准上，两类方法在六种搜索策略下均取得高于交叉熵的观测证明成功率；其中单一共享的UA适配器表现强劲。预算扫描显示，在16次展开时的增益大于256次展开，表明CAT方法随测试时计算增加而扩展。
AI.conclusion: 将训练目标与树搜索的计算分配对齐可显著提升LLM引导的自动定理证明效果；搜索感知损失和搜索无关的UA损失均优于交叉熵，且UA以单一适配器提供跨搜索策略的强泛化。结果表明CAT类方法能够利用测试时计算扩展，为策略引导树搜索提供更匹配的训练信号。

5687511c66f5a5a708536812105b8afdcef22604.title: SAMI3D-DW: Interactive Segmentation of Any 3D Medical Images
5687511c66f5a5a708536812105b8afdcef22604.summary:
Interactive segmentation of 3D medical images supports quantitative analysis of anatomical structures and disease while allowing users to specify and refine their targets.
  Despite substantial progress by nnInteractive and VISTA3D, reliable segmentation across diverse clinical targets remains challenging, particularly for complex anatomical
  structures and the heterogeneous, long-tailed spectrum of pathology. We present SAMI3D-DW V1 (hereafter SAMI3D-DW), an interactive 3D segmentation model trained on
  Deepwise's large-scale proprietary medical image datasets. We evaluate the model under simulated user interactions on a CT/MR benchmark comprising 4,326 cases from 219
  source datasets, spanning 107 anatomical and pathological categories, organized by a medical taxonomy and evaluated with a category-balanced DSC score. SAMI3D-DW achieves
  the highest category-macro Dice among evaluated methods in both interaction modes. With one point, it scores 0.5764 versus 0.5315 for nnInteractive, the strongest
  baseline, rising to 0.7771 versus 0.7494 with five points. With bounding-box initialization, the scores are 0.7130 versus 0.6530. After five corrective clicks, SAMI3D-DW
  reaches 0.8002 versus 0.7868, making it the only evaluated box-compatible model to exceed 0.80. For radiologists and clinicians, SAMI3D-DW enables segmentation of complex
  anatomical structures, including intracranial vessel trees on CT and MR angiography, with a few clicks. In a preliminary in-house comparison involving neurofibromatosis
  type 1 (NF1), SAMI3D-DW-assisted tumor annotation took minutes per case and approximately one-fifteenth of the time required for manual annotation, highlighting its
  potential to support volumetric treatment-response assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式3D医学图像分割模型SAMI3D-DW，基于Deepwise大规模私有医学数据训练，在涵盖107类解剖/病理目标、4326例CT/MR的基准上，以类别平衡DSC评测，在点/框交互模式下均优于nnInteractive等基线，并展示临床标注提效潜力。
AI.motivation: 3D医学图像交互式分割对解剖结构定量分析和疾病评估很重要，用户可指定并修正目标。尽管nnInteractive、VISTA3D等已有进展，但面对复杂解剖结构和长尾异质性病理，跨多样临床目标的可靠分割仍具挑战。
AI.method: 训练SAMI3D-DW（SAMI3D-DW V1）于Deepwise大规模专有医学图像数据集；在模拟用户交互条件下评测。基准包含219个来源数据集的4326例CT/MR病例，覆盖107个解剖与病理类别，按医学分类体系组织，并使用类别平衡DSC（category-macro Dice）评估。交互模式包括单点、五点、边界框初始化以及五次修正点击。
AI.result: 在两种交互模式中，SAMI3D-DW均取得最高类别宏平均Dice。单点：0.5764 vs nnInteractive 0.5315；五点：0.7771 vs 0.7494；边界框初始化：0.7130 vs 0.6530；五次修正点击后：0.8002 vs 0.7868，是唯一超过0.80的框兼容模型。可用于CT/MR血管造影中颅内血管树等复杂结构少点击分割。NF1初步内部对比中，辅助肿瘤标注每例仅需数分钟，约为手动标注时间的1/15。
AI.conclusion: SAMI3D-DW在多样临床目标上展现出更优的交互式3D分割性能，尤其适合复杂解剖结构；其临床标注提效潜力可支持体积化治疗反应评估，但结果基于模拟交互与初步内部对比，仍需更广泛临床验证。

9b4f33985d28e51e68e35e881ab39bc13289edcc.title: Contact-Stable Deformable Tissue Simulation Using Implicit Integration and Live-Pose Grasp Constraints for Laparoscopic Surgery Robot Policy Evaluation
9b4f33985d28e51e68e35e881ab39bc13289edcc.summary: Closed-loop evaluation of surgical robots requires tissue that deforms, can be grasped and lifted, and reproduces the anatomy in which the robot will operate. We present a simulator in which this tissue is reconstructed from a fixed-view RGB-D recording of the surgical field, composited to remove the instruments, closed into watertight volumes and tetrahedralised; the pipeline was applied unchanged to three specimens of two species (thirteen organs, 146,061 tetrahedra, no inverted elements). For one specimen, the organs are placed in a bimanual cell in which two Franka FR3 arms operate motorised instruments through 6 mm trocars. The core contribution is the numerical and contact design that keeps this cell stable: implicit integration, simulation meshes separate from collision meshes, numerical guards, and a grasp constraint captured at the live tissue pose. In 45 repeated grasp-lifts, a friction grasp held the tissue in 0 of 15 trials and each constraint grasp in 13 of 15; on displaced tissue, a rest-pose constraint produced one-step snaps of up to 17.8 mm, which live-pose capture eliminates. Against the recording, front-surface depth error is 1.33 to 1.41 mm, organ silhouette IoU is 0.80, and in five grasp-lifts reproduced from video the landmark displacement RMSE is 11.8 mm against 14.2 mm for a static prediction. Biofidelity is not claimed; the environment is intended for closed-loop feasibility, safety, contact and policy screening.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从固定视角RGB-D手术野记录重建可变形组织并四面体化的手术机器人闭环仿真器；通过隐式积分、仿真/碰撞网格分离、数值保护和“活体姿态抓取约束”保证双Franka FR3机械臂经6 mm trocar操作时的稳定性，用于闭环可行性、安全性、接触与策略筛选，但不声称生物保真。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人的闭环评估需要同时具备可变形、可抓取提拉并复现真实解剖结构的组织模型；现有方法难以从真实手术记录中直接构建稳定可交互的仿真组织，尤其难以在机械臂接触操作中保持数值稳定与抓取可靠。
AI.method: 从固定视角RGB-D手术野记录重建组织：合成去除器械、封闭为水密体、四面体化；该流程未经修改地应用于2个物种的3个标本（13个器官，146,061个四面体，无反转单元）。将其中一个标本置于双臂操作单元中，两台Franka FR3机械臂通过6 mm trocar驱动电动器械。核心是数值与接触设计：隐式积分、仿真网格与碰撞网格分离、数值保护，以及在活体组织姿态下捕获的抓取约束。
AI.result: 45次重复抓取-提拉中，摩擦抓取15次均未保持组织（0/15），每种约束抓取均为13/15成功。对已位移组织，静息姿态约束会产生最大17.8 mm的单步突跳，活体姿态捕获可消除该问题。与原始记录相比，前表面深度误差为1.33–1.41 mm，器官轮廓IoU为0.80；在5次由视频复现的抓取-提拉中，标志点位移RMSE为11.8 mm，优于静态预测的14.2 mm。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不声称生物保真，定位为用于闭环可行性、安全性、接触与策略筛选的仿真环境；其价值在于从真实手术记录构建可稳定操作的组织仿真，并以接触/数值设计支撑手术机器人闭环评估。

8cda5668cbd3e01518eff1feea6d1a6ab0e8d57e.title: Rewired or Gated? How Instruction Tuning Shapes Knowledge-Conflict Circuits in LLMs
8cda5668cbd3e01518eff1feea6d1a6ab0e8d57e.comment: Accepted at BlackboxNLP 2026, Co-located with EMNLP 2026
8cda5668cbd3e01518eff1feea6d1a6ab0e8d57e.summary: In language models, the choice between believing the prompt and believing the weights is made by a handful of identifiable attention heads. Instruction tuning changes how models behave under conflict, but whether it rewires the underlying circuit or merely gates/reweights already present components, remains unknown.
