We provide the first mechanistic base-vs-instruct comparison of conflict-resolution circuits, across three families (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-3B, Gemma-3-4B). Five independent methods, node and edge attribution, superposition role analysis, causal ablation, and path patching, converge on gating, with the same heads, in the same late-layers, are found to be reweighted rather than replaced with a high node overlap (0.60-0.82). Behaviorally, tuning shifts models toward parametric memory, making instruct models reject a terse counterfactual context far more than base ones, the opposite of a naive user-following expectation. Yet this added skepticism is a factor of framing since it disappears when the same false claim is delivered as a coherent, evidential passage. The robustness that instruction tuning buys against terse injection is therefore real but narrow. More broadly, we believe that because the conflict circuit is preserved rather than rebuilt, interpretability and control tools calibrated on base models should transfer directly to their deployed instruct siblings.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对基础模型与指令微调模型的冲突消解回路进行机制级对比，发现指令微调并未重建回路，而是对同一批晚期注意力头进行门控/重加权；行为上使模型更倾向参数记忆，对简短反事实注入更怀疑，但这种稳健性受框架影响且范围有限。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在提示与参数权重冲突时，由少量可识别的注意力头决定“信提示还是信权重”。指令微调会改变冲突下的行为，但其究竟重构了底层回路，还是仅对既有组件进行门控/重加权，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 首次开展基础模型与指令模型的冲突消解回路机制对比，覆盖Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-3B、Gemma-3-4B三个模型家族；综合使用节点与边归因、叠加角色分析、因果消融、路径修补五种独立方法进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 五种方法一致指向“门控”：相同晚期层中的相同注意力头被重加权而非替换，节点重叠率高达0.60–0.82。行为上，指令微调使模型更偏向参数记忆，指令模型比基础模型更常拒绝简短反事实上下文，与朴素“用户跟随”预期相反；但这种额外怀疑取决于表述框架，当同一错误主张以连贯、带证据的段落呈现时即消失。因此，指令微调对简短注入的稳健性真实但狭窄。
AI.conclusion: 冲突回路在指令微调后被保留而非重建，说明基于基础模型校准的可解释性与控制工具，可能直接迁移到其部署用的指令模型上。

c617558581fc22b28a68e03ad79c7b0c908b8105.title: Gaze responses to false-positive computer-aided detection prompts during colonoscopy: a paired-video and real-time eye-tracking study
c617558581fc22b28a68e03ad79c7b0c908b8105.summary: False-positive computer-aided detection (CADe) prompts may divert endoscopists' attention during colonoscopy, yet the attentional impact of individual prompts remains unclear. We used event-locked eye tracking to quantify gaze attraction and attention occupation in complementary retrospective and prospective studies. In a retrospective paired-video experiment, 3 senior and 2 novice endoscopists viewed 60 colonoscopy videos with and without CADe. The prospective study recorded gaze during 42 real-time CADe-assisted colonoscopies performed by 9 senior endoscopists. Screened CADe prompts outside expert-annotated lesion windows were classified as false-positive artifact events. False-positive prompts attracted gaze in 48.6% (68/140) of retrospective observations and 65.2% (533/817) of prospective events. Among attraction events with complete recovery, median attention occupation lasted 1000 ms in the retrospective study and 1100 ms in the prospective study. Corresponding median prompt durations were 33 ms and 267 ms, with median time amplifications of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold, respectively. In paired retrospective comparisons, visible artifact prompts drew gaze closer to the prompted region than did the same-coordinate unassisted reference. Secondary retrospective analyses showed high lesion gaze recognition without and with CADe (98.0% versus 99.0%). First gaze entry into lesion regions occurred 147.8 ms earlier with CADe. Across controlled and real-time clinical settings, false-positive CADe prompts frequently captured gaze, with attention persisting beyond prompt visibility. These findings support considering prompt-related attentional burden in CADe evaluation and design.

AI.tldr: 研究利用事件锁定眼动追踪，在回顾性与前瞻性结肠镜场景中量化CADe假阳性提示对医生注视的吸引及注意占用，发现假阳性提示常吸引目光且注意持续时间远超提示可见时长，提示应在CADe评估与设计中纳入注意负担考量。
AI.motivation: 假阳性计算机辅助检测（CADe）提示可能分散内镜医生在结肠镜检查中的注意力，但单个提示对注意力的具体影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用事件锁定眼动追踪，结合回顾性与前瞻性研究。回顾性配对视频实验：3名资深和2名新手内镜医生观看60段有/无CADe的结肠镜视频；前瞻性研究：记录9名资深内镜医生完成的42例实时CADe辅助结肠镜检查中的凝视。将专家标注病变窗口之外的CADe提示定义为假阳性伪影事件，量化注视吸引与注意占用。
AI.result: 假阳性提示吸引凝视的比例在回顾性中为48.6%（68/140），前瞻性中为65.2%（533/817）。在具有完整恢复的吸引事件中，注意占用中位时间分别为1000 ms（回顾性）和1100 ms（前瞻性）；对应提示持续时间中位数为33 ms和267 ms，时间放大中位数分别为17.55倍和5.15倍。回顾性配对比较显示，可见伪影提示使凝视比同坐标无辅助参考更接近提示区域。次要分析显示，无/有CADe时病变注视识别率均较高（98.0% vs 99.0%），且有CADe时首次进入病变区域提前147.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 在受控和实时临床环境中，假阳性CADe提示会频繁捕获凝视，且注意力持续时间超过提示可见时间。研究结果支持在CADe评价与设计中考虑提示相关的注意力负担。

56db199ebe47cbc80a3a699f76299e3f2abeb0a5.title: Reading Right, Answering Wrong: How Visual Configuration Changes Affect Evidence Use in VLMs
56db199ebe47cbc80a3a699f76299e3f2abeb0a5.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as visual question answering, yet small image resizes can turn correct answers into errors. We investigate whether changes in visual configuration, such as image tiling and token arrangement, contribute to this instability. Across seven checkpoints and four benchmarks, equally small resizes cause more correctness flips when they switch configurations. Surprisingly, in over half of these cases, models answer the question incorrectly but can still read the correct answer when told what to read. Furthermore, attention interventions in LLaVA-NeXT suggest that configuration changes can weaken the use of readable information during answering. We therefore guide models using field cues and their own transcriptions. With annotation assistance, these forms of guidance together correct 97.2% of errors with readable information. These findings show that configuration changes can affect how models use information they can still read.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在小幅缩放图像后会将正确答案变为错误，本文发现视觉配置变化（分块、token排列）是失稳主因；多数翻转案例中模型其实仍能"读出"正确信息却答错，且可通过注意力干预与场线索、自转录引导显著纠正错误。
AI.motivation: VLM在视觉问答等任务上表现优异，但对小幅图像缩放高度敏感，正确的回答可能因此出错。作者希望探究这种不稳定性的来源，特别是视觉配置（图像分块方式、token排列）变化是否在其中起作用，并厘清模型是"看不到"信息还是"用不好"信息。
AI.method: 在七个检查点和四个基准上进行受控实验，对比"同等幅度但切换配置"与"不切换配置"的缩放；统计正确性翻转比例。进一步用"被告知该读什么"的提示检验模型能否读出正确答案。在LLaVA-NeXT上做注意力干预，分析配置变化对可读信息使用的影响。最后利用场线索（field cues）与模型自身的转录来引导作答。
AI.result: 同样小幅缩放中，切换配置的翻转率更高；超过半数的翻转案例里模型答错但仍能读出正确答案；注意力干预表明配置变化削弱了模型在作答时对可读信息的利用；在标注辅助下，场线索与自转录引导相结合可纠正97.2%的"含可读信息"的错误。
AI.conclusion: 视觉配置变化会影响模型对"本可读出信息"的使用方式，而非单纯导致信息丢失；这揭示VLM的失稳部分源于信息利用环节，并提示通过线索与自转录引导可有效修复此类错误。

d33b976678fd14cce1a4b102f88e225f529d17c7.title: Skill Sequence Planning for Collaborative Multi-Robot Construction
d33b976678fd14cce1a4b102f88e225f529d17c7.summary: Robots have significant potential to automate construction processes. However, their industry adoption remains limited, partly because of the programming effort required to adapt robots to diverse tasks. This paper presents a skill sequence planning method that enables a heterogeneous team of multi-functional robots to collaboratively perform construction assembly work using reusable, preprogrammed skills such as grasping, drilling, and fastening. A central controller transforms the digital representation of the building into a construction relationship graph that represents construction entities, their states, and their parent-child relationships. Based on this representation, the system selects the next construction target, generates a symbolic sequence of skills for capable members of the robot team, and produces collision-free geometric motion plans for skill execution. The symbolic planning problem is dynamically regenerated as the construction state changes. An interactive digital twin presents the planned skill sequence and robot states to human co-workers for review and approval before execution. The method is evaluated through a construction assembly case study. By reducing the need to program robots separately for each task variation, the proposed approach supports more flexible deployment of collaborative robot teams in construction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种技能序列规划方法，使多台多功能异构机器人能够通过复用预编程技能（抓取、钻孔、紧固等）协作完成建筑施工装配任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人具备自动化施工流程的巨大潜力，但其行业落地受限，部分原因在于将机器人适配多样化任务所需的编程工作量大。需要一种能减少逐任务编程、支持灵活部署协作机器人团队的方法。
AI.method: 中央控制器将建筑的数字表示转换为"施工关系图"，用以表达施工实体、其状态及父子关系。系统据此选择下一个施工目标，为具备能力的机器人成员生成符号化的技能序列，并产出无碰撞的几何运动规划以执行技能。符号规划问题随施工状态变化动态重新生成；交互式数字孪生将规划好的技能序列与机器人状态呈现给人类协作者，供其在执行前审查与批准。
AI.result: 通过一个建筑施工装配案例研究对该方法进行了评估，验证了所提技能序列规划流程的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过减少针对每种任务变体单独编程机器人的需求，该方法支持协作机器人团队在建筑场景中更灵活地部署。

dab3b2e738c2a70ac3da90180d58a088ec8fa383.title: What Should a Self-Teacher See? Privileged Context Design for On-Policy Self-Distillation
dab3b2e738c2a70ac3da90180d58a088ec8fa383.summary: More privileged information does not always make a better teacher. We study this tension in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a frozen copy of the base model scores the student's own rollouts under privileged context, conventionally a complete reference solution that bundles the final answer with one particular reasoning path. Holding the student view and training fixed within each scale, we compare that default against three abstractions compiled offline, a named strategy, a method-independent framing, and a problem category, and against an answer-only control that keeps the destination but removes the path. In the primary runs on competition mathematics, the best intermediate contexts improve the in-domain peak mean over the full solution by 1.4 points at 4B and 1.6 at 8B, while storing an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens. Comparisons across three seeds also show positive mean gains for the framing and category contexts at both scales. Answer-only conditioning remains competitive in the primary runs, within 0.2 points of the full solution at these scales. The preferred context varies with student scale and task. Initial teacher-student KL does not order downstream performance. What a self-teacher should see is therefore not everything it could, but the level of abstraction its student can still act on.

AI.tldr: 研究在 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）中，特权的教师上下文并非越完整越好；将完整参考解替换为不同抽象层级的离线编译提示，可在竞赛数学上以更少提示 token 取得更优或相当的学生表现，且最优抽象层级随学生规模与任务变化。
AI.motivation: 传统 OPSD 常让冻结的基座模型以完整参考解（最终答案＋一条特定推理路径）作为特权上下文来评价学生自身 rollout，但“更多特权信息”未必构成更好的教师。作者希望检验教师应看到何种抽象层级的信息，才能最有效地引导学生。
AI.method: 在固定学生视角与训练设置、分别于 4B 与 8B 规模下，将默认的完整参考解与三类离线编译的抽象上下文比较：命名策略、方法无关框架、问题类别；另设仅答案对照（保留目的地、去除路径）。在竞赛数学主实验中比较 in-domain peak mean、提示 token 量、跨三个随机种子的平均增益，并考察初始 teacher-student KL 与下游表现的关系。
AI.result: 主实验中，最佳中间抽象上下文相对完整解将 in-domain peak mean 提升：4B 提高 1.4 分，8B 提高 1.6 分，同时提示 token 存储量少一个数量级。三个种子下，框架与类别上下文在两个规模均呈正向平均增益。仅答案条件在主实验中仍具竞争力，与完整解差距在 0.2 分以内。偏好上下文随学生规模与任务变化；初始 teacher-student KL 不能预测下游性能排序。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏教师不应向学生展示其“能看到的全部信息”，而应提供学生仍能据以行动的抽象层级；教师上下文的抽象程度需与学生规模及任务匹配，提示效率与效果可同时改善。

2a276c44f3a85553725ae28fe52fe5d425ac8a7b.title: Transformer Heads Looking for Order
2a276c44f3a85553725ae28fe52fe5d425ac8a7b.summary: In this note, we show that the problem of checking, whether a sequence of bits is ordered, is not doable by 1-head 1-layer transformers but is doable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer. Unlike similar previous results, our results assume the model where transformers have an output MLP.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：判断一个比特序列是否有序，单头单层Transformer无法完成，而双头单层Transformer可以完成；与以往类似结果不同，该结论是在Transformer带有输出MLP的模型设定下得到的。
AI.motivation: 研究Transformer表达能力与架构组件的关系，特别是注意力头数量和输出MLP对模型可计算性的影响，并厘清单头与多头在简单序列判定任务上的能力边界。
AI.method: 形式化定义“比特序列是否有序”的判定问题，在带输出MLP的单层Transformer模型下，分别给出单头不可实现的证明与双头可实现的构造或证明。
AI.result: 1-head 1-layer Transformer不能判定比特序列是否有序；2-head 1-layer Transformer可以判定。该分离结果在包含输出MLP的模型设定下成立，区别于此前类似的理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头数量是影响Transformer表达能力的实质性因素；输出MLP的引入会改变可表达的函数类，因此相关表达性结论必须结合具体模型设定来理解。

2bfce4457405d293246e8ea01f818c46eafa85db.title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
2bfce4457405d293246e8ea01f818c46eafa85db.summary: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Video-HopChain 多跳视频问答数据集，并配合置信门控探索（CGE）策略改进 GRPO，使视频推理性能从 55.4 提升至 59.3。
AI.motivation: HopChain 在静态图像上证明多跳数据合成能提升视觉-语言推理：长链思维推理会暴露逐步累积的误差，而 RLVR 所用数据大多不要求视觉证据链，导致这些弱点难以被发现。作者在视频领域观察到同样问题，且该框架尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建 Video-HopChain 数据集（22,550 个多跳视频问题，覆盖 13,378 个视频，另含 1,000 题的留出基准）；每个问题串联 3–6 个关于同一视频片段的 yes/no 子问题，答案映射为两个整数之一，最终答案为这些整数之和，从而以精确匹配提供 RLVR 所需的可验证奖励。先用 GRPO 在标准视频数据集上训练 Qwen3-VL-8B，再在 Video-HopChain 上做第二阶段训练。针对 GRPO 组内奖励方差为零时无梯度的局限，提出 Confidence-Gated Exploration（CGE）：每题 8 次 rollout，先采样前 4 次；若全对或全错，则在推理区间内掩蔽策略最自信的 token 后采样后 4 次，并将掩蔽位置从损失中移除，同时让全部 8 次 rollout 参与优势计算。
AI.result: 在 8 个视频理解与推理基准上，第二阶段训练将均值从 55.4 提升至 57.9，且每个基准均有提升；引入 CGE 后均值进一步升至 59.3。
AI.conclusion: 多跳视频数据合成可有效提升视频推理能力，而 CGE 能在同等算力预算下恢复无梯度的组、进一步增益。作者公开数据集、检查点以及数据生成与训练代码。

afe91a235e37706128fe43f194831751f1764048.title: PhyVisGen: Physically and Visually High-Fidelity Robotic Manipulation Data Generation
afe91a235e37706128fe43f194831751f1764048.summary: Large-scale manipulation demonstrations are essential for learning robust visuomotor policies, yet real-world data collection is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation offers a promising alternative, but physical and visual discrepancies can limit the transferability of synthetic data, particularly for manipulation with soft grippers. We present PhyVisGen, a physically and visually high-fidelity framework for scalable robotic manipulation data generation. On the physical side, PhyVisGen introduces an arm-gripper coupling method based on the Incremental Potential Contact (IPC), enabling high-fidelity soft contact throughout complete manipulation trajectories. On the visual side, it combines real-scene reconstruction with real-time path tracing to generate visually realistic observations while preserving captured scene appearance. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate the physical and visual fidelity of PhyVisGen. Policies trained exclusively on synthetic manipulation demonstrations achieve 65-95% success across five real-robot tasks, without real-robot demonstration data or policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: PhyVisGen：一种物理与视觉高保真的机器人操作数据生成框架，用IPC实现软体夹爪接触仿真，用真实场景重建+实时路径追踪生成逼真视觉观测；仅用合成数据训练的策略在五个真实机器人任务上达到65-95%成功率，无需真实示教或微调。
AI.motivation: 大规模操作示教数据对学习鲁棒视觉运动策略至关重要，但真实数据采集成本高、难以规模化。仿真虽有潜力，但物理与视觉差异限制合成数据迁移，软体夹爪操作尤为明显。
AI.method: 提出PhyVisGen高保真数据生成框架。物理侧：基于增量势接触（IPC）的机械臂-夹爪耦合方法，在完整操作轨迹中实现高保真软体接触。视觉侧：结合真实场景重建与实时路径追踪，生成视觉逼真的观测并保留捕获场景外观。
AI.result: 定量评估表明PhyVisGen具有较高的物理与视觉保真度。仅使用合成操作示教训练的策略，在五个真实机器人任务上取得65-95%的成功率，且不使用真实机器人示教数据，也不进行策略微调。
AI.conclusion: PhyVisGen通过物理与视觉双重高保真仿真，有效缩小合成数据与真实机器人之间的差距，为可扩展的机器人操作数据生成和视觉运动策略学习提供了可行路径。

494da121efebd0cf1a34fe041ccd00064d2ecc82.title: An Exploratory Replica-Overlap Probe of the Grokking Transition
494da121efebd0cf1a34fe041ccd00064d2ecc82.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered study; the registered decision rule returns UNDETERMINED (reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID) because the registered alignment implementation is not function-preserving. Reported as an honest negative/instrument-invalid result
494da121efebd0cf1a34fe041ccd00064d2ecc82.summary: We trained 64 independently seeded networks in four configurations, continuing each to sustained convergence or a 40,000-epoch ceiling. We then asked whether an RSB-inspired distribution of pairwise weight overlaps changes across the grokking transition. It is the alignment step, not the overlap statistic, that determines what this registered probe can report. The registered implementation permutes hidden units without the corresponding bias and head-internal permutations and therefore does not preserve the network function. Every q_wt value computed through this alignment inherits the defect; q_fn does not, because it is computed from predictions of the unpermuted models. The numerical-precision requirement also failed, and an audit found protocol deviations. Consequently, the pre-registered rule gives no verdict: registered outcome UNDETERMINED (reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID). These data provide neither a confirmatory null nor a validated reading of the Parisi order parameter. Only frac40 cleared the 12/16 checkpoint-completeness requirement. For this configuration, a post-hoc criterion applied to the same data gave a Hartigan-dip interval containing zero (95% CI for Delta dip = [-0.017, 0.034]), whereas the overlap standard deviation increased by a factor of about 5.6. A post-hoc calibration assigns the dip test zero power at the simulated separations; the interval is therefore uninformative, not evidence of no change. The standard-deviation ratio is the only statistic here with power at the observed effect. Ensemble loss was near-flat only under the pre-specified 1% threshold. Finally, grokking rates of 0/16, 11/16 and 16/16 remain descriptive because train fraction is confounded with split identity.

AI.tldr: 该预注册研究检验 grokking 转变中 RSB 启发的成对权重重叠分布是否变化；但因对齐步骤不保持网络函数、数值精度失败及协议偏差，注册结局为 UNDETERMINED（C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID），无法给出确证性零结果或有效的 Parisi 序参量读数。事后仅 frac40 通过完整性检查；dip 检验无功效，唯一在观测效应下有功效的统计量是重叠标准差比约 5.6 倍。
AI.motivation: 检验 grokking 转变是否伴随 RSB（replica symmetry breaking）式结构变化，并以 Parisi 序参量/成对权重重叠分布作为探针；同时考察预注册仪器与统计判据是否足以给出确证性结论。
AI.method: 训练 64 个独立种子网络，覆盖 4 种配置，持续至收敛或 40000 epoch 上限；在 grokking 转变前后比较 RSB 启发的成对权重重叠分布。预注册实现使用隐藏单元置换对齐，并区分 q_wt（经置换对齐计算的权重重叠）与 q_fn（由未置换模型预测计算的功能重叠）。事后分析包括 Hartigan dip 检验、重叠标准差比、集成损失平坦性与 grokking 率。
AI.result: 注册实现仅置换隐藏单元，未同步置换偏置和 head 内部单元，因此不保持网络函数；所有经该对齐得到的 q_wt 均继承缺陷，q_fn 不受影响。数值精度要求未通过，审计发现协议偏差，故预注册规则无裁决：UNDETERMINED（C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）。仅 frac40 满足 12/16 checkpoint 完整性要求。事后 Hartigan dip 区间含零（Delta dip 95% CI = [-0.017, 0.034]），但事后校准显示 dip 检验在模拟分离下功效为零，故该区间无信息，不等于“无变化”证据；重叠标准差增加约 5.6 倍。集成损失仅在预设 1% 阈值下近似平坦。grokking 率为 0/16、11/16、16/16，但因训练比例与 split identity 混淆，只能作描述性报告。
AI.conclusion: 这些数据既不是确证性零结果，也不是对 Parisi 序参量的有效读取；无法对 grokking 是否伴随 RSB 变化作出裁决。唯一在观测效应下具有功效的统计量是重叠标准差比，但仍属事后分析。需修正函数保持对齐、数值精度与协议合规性后，重新预注册并验证仪器，方可进行确证性推断。

352f0f5e5d5fd3a55db7e85281141a465d278545.title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
352f0f5e5d5fd3a55db7e85281141a465d278545.summary: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives. We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at https://kex-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: KEX-bench：面向真实操作系统内核的漏洞利用原语生成基准，包含45个任务、覆盖40个Linux/Windows CVE；最强智能体在无参考PoC时仅解决1/20 Windows、14/25 Linux，有参考PoC时解决31/45，揭示“能触发内核崩溃但难以构造利用原语”的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 现有漏洞发现评测主要衡量是否能找到漏洞，无法衡量编码智能体能否进一步构造可利用的内核原语；需要可复现、面向真实内核的利用原语生成基准。
AI.method: 构建KEX-bench基准：45个任务实例，覆盖40个Linux与Windows CVE，涉及内核地址泄漏、指令指针控制、堆读、堆写、任意地址写五类利用原语。每个任务在隔离虚拟机中运行，提供受控工具，并用确定性验证器按原语类型判定成功。在固定工具调用预算下评测前沿与开源权重模型驱动的先进编码智能体。
AI.result: 无参考PoC时，最强配置解决20个Windows任务中的1个（5.0%），25个Linux任务中的14个（56.0%）；有参考PoC时，最强配置解决45个任务中的31个（68.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显关键差距：智能体可达到内核崩溃阶段，却常无法将内核状态塑造成特定利用原语。KEX-bench已发布，用于AI辅助漏洞利用的可复现研究。

d83c15b72767cd245b8abb8a8c91b985cb212b80.title: TRACE: Trajectory Representation and Consistency Estimation for AI-Generated Video Detection
d83c15b72767cd245b8abb8a8c91b985cb212b80.summary: Recent advances in generative video models have enabled the synthesis of visually realistic content, posing significant challenges to synthetic video detection. Existing detectors often rely on appearance artifacts, semantic inconsistencies, and temporal patterns that may be generator-specific, limitating generalization to unseen synthesis models. We investigate whether responses to a pretrained generative model provide more transferable forensic cues. Our key observation is that real and AI-generated videos exhibit distinct \emph{velocity responses} under a pretrained Flow Matching video model. This distinction persists when different pretrained video-generation backbones are used as probes, suggesting that velocity responses offer transferable forensic signals beyond visual artificts. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{TRACE} (\emph{\underline{T}rajectory \underline{R}epresentation \underline{a}nd \underline{C}onsistency \underline{E}stimation}), a generation-process-aware framework for AI-generated video detection. TRACE leverages a pretrained video DiT as a velocity-field probe to extract representations at multiple flow time points, and models cross-frame consistency through velocity differences between adjacent frames. We further introduce a \emph{Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization} objective that encourages generator-invariant representation learning. Extensive experiments on AIGVDBench demonstrate that TRACE generalizes effectively across diverse generators, substantially outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods on unseen open- and closed-source video generation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRACE：以预训练视频 DiT 作为"速度场探针"，利用真实与生成视频在 Flow Matching 速度响应上的差异，实现跨生成器可迁移的 AI 视频检测。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频模型合成内容日益逼真，现有检测器多依赖外观伪影、语义不一致与时序模式，这些线索往往与特定生成器绑定，导致对未见合成模型的泛化能力有限。作者希望寻找更具可迁移性的取证线索。
AI.method: 关键观察：在预训练 Flow Matching 视频模型下，真实与 AI 生成视频呈现不同的"速度响应"，且更换不同预训练视频生成主干作为探针时该差异依然存在。基于此提出 TRACE（Trajectory Representation And Consistency Estimation）框架：以预训练视频 DiT 作为速度场探针，在多个 flow 时间点提取表征，并通过相邻帧间的速度差分建模跨帧一致性；同时引入 Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization 目标，促进生成器无关的表征学习。
AI.result: 在 AIGVDBench 上的大量实验表明，TRACE 在多种生成器间有效泛化，在未见过的开源与闭源视频生成模型上显著超越此前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 速度响应是一种超越视觉伪影的可迁移取证信号；基于生成过程感知的轨迹表征与一致性建模，可显著提升 AI 生成视频检测的跨生成器泛化性能。

6bcb438ecc3c5634bd564c86c9694e22c7f29c18.title: CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image
6bcb438ecc3c5634bd564c86c9694e22c7f29c18.summary: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene dataset show more accurate reconstructions and a higher fraction of objects remaining in place under simulated gravity than both object-first and scene-first baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CODA：先从不分割RGB-D图像生成完整场景几何，再分解为环境与可移动物体，并用两种3D grounding机制抑制生成几何相对观测点云的漂移。
AI.motivation: 机器人在杂乱日常环境中安全操作，常需从部分观测推断场景几何。现有“2D检测+独立重建”方法存在漏检物体无法重建、检测合并导致物体融合、独立重建网格重叠或未接触支撑面等问题。
AI.method: CODA（Complete Once, Decompose Afterward）是一种生成模型：输入单张未分割RGB-D图像，先重建完整场景几何，再将表面分离为周围环境和可移动物体。为减少生成几何与观测部分点云之间的漂移，采用两种显式3D grounding机制，在补全未观测区域的同时保持与已观测表面一致。
AI.result: 在HomebrewedDB和自建杂乱场景数据集上，CODA相比object-first与scene-first基线获得更准确的重建结果，并在模拟重力下使更高比例的物体保持原位。
AI.conclusion: CODA通过“先完整重建、后分解”的范式，结合3D grounding约束，提升了杂乱场景几何重建的准确性与物理合理性，优于先物体后场景或先场景后物体的基线方法。

95ae0923f3d429624cb21439a0b8c38e1b926168.title: Efficient Cost-Aware LLM Evaluation via Bayesian Bandit Gittins Indices
95ae0923f3d429624cb21439a0b8c38e1b926168.comment: Spotlight at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning (DEMO)
95ae0923f3d429624cb21439a0b8c38e1b926168.summary: Exhaustively evaluating every candidate LLM configuration on every benchmark item to identify a high-performing one is costly. We formulate configuration selection as a cost-aware Bayesian bandit problem and propose GittinsEval, which draws on the Bayesian-optimal Gittins policy to determine which configuration to evaluate next and when to stop. We extend the policy with an anytime recommendation rule over both fully and partially evaluated configurations, using an LCB-style score to account for posterior uncertainty. GittinsEval is computationally efficient, requiring only lightweight online updates after offline precomputation. Across GSM8K, PIQA, AlpacaEval, and MMLU response matrices, GittinsEval is consistently competitive, with particularly strong gains over configuration-level Bayesian optimization on large-example benchmarks and over cost-unaware bandit baselines on large-candidate tasks. Crucially, GittinsEval often attains near-zero simple regret using only 1% to 2% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost; it also offers an adaptive stopping rule that typically triggers at 1% to 10%.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM配置选择建模为成本感知贝叶斯赌博机问题，提出GittinsEval，用Gittins最优策略决定评估哪个配置及何时停止，并扩展出可随时推荐全评估/部分评估配置的LCB规则。在GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU上，它常以1%–2%的穷举成本达到近零简单遗憾，自适应停止通常触发于1%–10%。
AI.motivation: 穷举评估每个候选LLM配置在每个基准项上的表现以选出高性能配置成本过高，因此需要一种在有限评估预算下高效选择配置并决定何时停止的方法。
AI.method: 将配置选择形式化为成本感知贝叶斯赌博机问题；采用贝叶斯最优Gittins策略确定下一个评估的配置；扩展 anytime 推荐规则，对完整与部分评估的配置统一用LCB风格分数刻画后验不确定性；离线预计算后仅需轻量在线更新，计算高效。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval、MMLU响应矩阵上持续具有竞争力；在大样本基准上优于配置级贝叶斯优化，在大候选任务上优于成本不敏感赌博机基线；常以1%–2%的穷举评估成本达到近零简单遗憾；自适应停止规则通常在1%–10%成本处触发。
AI.conclusion: GittinsEval能以极低评估成本高效完成LLM配置选择，兼具贝叶斯最优决策、后验不确定性感知推荐与自适应停止能力，显著降低穷举评估开销。

e048612a64dc178f56b314a830d65c81ba5d53ec.title: ArticleMiner: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Publications
e048612a64dc178f56b314a830d65c81ba5d53ec.summary: Scientific papers keep much of their quantitative content in tables and supplementary files, where a number means something only through its header, caption, unit, analytical method, and the conventions of its field. Recovering the rows and columns of a table is therefore not the same as recovering the scientific fact it reports. Most semantic table-interpretation methods assume that a clean table is already available and subsequently map its cells or columns to ontology terms, whereas most publication-level extraction systems are designed for a single domain. We study a middle path: a shared process that reads a paper and its supplementary files, gathers evidence from several parsers and a language model, and reconciles that evidence, while a bounded human-authored task module for each task supplies the domain meaning. The module lists the canonical names the graph may use, the surface forms that map to them, a small set of derivation rules and validity constraints, an identity key, and the bindings used to write RDF. It defines what a task is allowed to emit; it does not try to list every convention of a field. We build four such modules (for drug-discovery chemistry, materials science, machine learning, and mineral geochemistry) in the ArticleMiner framework, and evaluate them on 163 papers, including a new geochemistry benchmark with expert-curated ground truth. In comparisons against a same-LLM few-shot baseline, the point estimates favor ArticleMiner on all four tasks, with uncertainty on the two smaller benchmarks. The geochemistry comparison also includes access to supplementary files, so its improvement cannot be attributed to domain guidance alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArticleMiner 框架，通过"共享抽取流程 + 有界的人工任务模块"这一中间路径，从论文正文与补充文件中恢复科学事实（而非仅表格结构），并在化学、材料、机器学习、地球化学四个领域验证其优于同 LLM 的少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 科学论文的定量内容多存于表格和补充文件中，其中数字的含义依赖于表头、标题、单位、分析方法及领域惯例。因此，恢复表格的行列结构并不等于恢复其报告的科学事实。现有语义表格解释方法多假设已有干净表格，仅将单元格/列映射到本体术语；而出版级抽取系统又多局限于单一领域。作者希望探索一条中间路径来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 ArticleMiner 框架的中间路径：(1) 一个共享流程读取论文及其补充文件，汇集来自多个解析器和语言模型的证据并加以调和；(2) 为每个任务配备一个有界的人工编写任务模块，提供领域语义——包括图谱可用的规范名称、对应的表层形式、少量推导规则与有效性约束、同一性键（identity key）以及用于写出 RDF 的绑定。该模块仅界定任务允许输出的内容，不试图穷举领域的所有惯例。作者据此构建了四个模块（药物发现化学、材料科学、机器学习、矿物地球化学）。
AI.result: 在 163 篇论文上进行评估，其中包括一个带有专家标注真值的新地球化学基准。与同 LLM 的少样本基线相比，四个任务上的点估计均偏向 ArticleMiner，但两个较小基准上存在不确定性。地球化学对比还包含对补充文件的访问，因此其提升不能仅归因于领域指导。
AI.conclusion: 将"共享抽取流程"与"有界的人工任务模块"相结合的中间路径具有可行性，能够在多个领域上一致地优于同 LLM 的少样本基线，且在地球化学任务中即使排除领域指导的贡献仍表现出改进，表明该框架在跨领域科学事实抽取上具备潜力。受限于部分基准规模较小，结果的统计显著性有待更大规模评估进一步验证。

918e6288511886c0db4581c9801e322e5f0b1f92.title: When Point Clouds Outperform Pixels: Rethinking Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
918e6288511886c0db4581c9801e322e5f0b1f92.summary: Zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection commonly assumes that RGB and point cloud modalities are equally reliable and can contribute uniformly to anomaly localization. We challenge this assumption. Using a set of recently proposed stringent metrics that penalize false anomaly responses in normal regions, we find that point clouds are substantially more reliable than RGB under zero-shot category shift. Motivated by this observation, we propose WOOPS (\textbf{W}hen P\textbf{o}int Cl\textbf{o}uds Out\textbf{p}erform Pixel\textbf{s}), a reliability-aware zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework. To strengthen the more reliable geometric modality, we design a Multi-view Information Decoupling module to suppress heterogeneous information from multi-view point cloud projections and enhance point cloud feature quality. To avoid unconditional fusion, we further introduce a Modality Reliability Calibration module to adaptively calibrate modality contributions according to their reliability. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves the best or competitive performance under the new metrics in both unimodal and multimodal settings. Further analysis demonstrates that point cloud information also improves RGB-only inference, while ablations verify the effectiveness of both modules. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战"RGB与点云在零样本多模态异常检测中同等可靠"的假设，发现点云在类别漂移下更可靠，并提出可靠性感知框架WOOPS。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本多模态异常检测默认RGB与点云模态同等可靠、对异常定位贡献相同，但这一假设未被验证。作者借助严格指标（惩罚正常区域的假异常响应）发现，在零样本类别漂移下点云可靠性显著高于RGB。
AI.method: 提出WOOPS框架：1）多视图信息解耦模块（Multi-view Information Decoupling），抑制多视图点云投影中的异构信息，提升点云特征质量；2）模态可靠性校准模块（Modality Reliability Calibration），按可靠性自适应校准各模态贡献，避免无条件融合。
AI.result: 在新指标下，单模态与多模态设置中均取得最优或具竞争力的性能；点云信息还能提升纯RGB推理；消融实验验证两个模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 点云在多模态异常检测中比RGB更可靠，可靠性感知的差异化融合策略有效；代码将在接收后开源。

0f032d448d9ad6188209d3e291a34bcfe71580bc.title: History-Conditioned Flow Matching for Probabilistic Dynamics of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
0f032d448d9ad6188209d3e291a34bcfe71580bc.summary: Deterministic dynamics modeling of tendon-driven continuum robots remains challenging owing to uncertainties in material behavior, tendon transmission, friction, and contact. Measured joint configurations and nominal tendon commands do not fully characterize these internal mechanical factors, leaving uncertainty in the subsequent motion. We therefore develop a history-conditioned, physics-informed flow-matching framework for probabilistic dynamics prediction, using motion and actuation histories to predict the distribution of the next complete joint configuration. By recursively sampling next-step configurations under prescribed commands, the model predicts distributions of future whole-body motions. In simulation, scenario-specific models achieve five-second trajectory Energy Scores (lower is better) of 12.05 mm under internal friction variation and 9.29 mm under unobserved actuation disturbances. Relative to the conditional variational autoencoder and diffusion baselines, Flow attains lower Energy Scores and coverage closer to the nominal level in both scenarios. Ablations support history and structural conditioning in both scenarios. On the physical robot, predictions under two tendon-command profiles excluded from training capture the principal motion sequences, with five-second Energy Scores of 11.91 and 11.42 mm, lower than the compared baselines. The predicted-to-measured spread ratios are 1.65 and 1.22 (closer to 1 is better). These results support history-conditioned probabilistic dynamics prediction under incomplete mechanical observations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于历史条件与物理信息的流匹配框架，用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人在机械观测不完整情况下的概率动力学预测，并在仿真与实体机器人上验证其优于CVAE和扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 肌腱驱动连续体机器人的确定性动力学建模困难，原因包括材料行为、肌腱传动、摩擦与接触等不确定性；仅凭测量的关节构型与名义肌腱指令无法充分刻画内部机械因素，导致后续运动存在不确定性。
AI.method: 提出历史条件化、物理信息引导的流匹配（flow-matching）框架，进行概率动力学预测：以运动历史与驱动历史为条件，预测下一完整关节构型的分布；在给定指令下递归采样下一步构型，从而预测未来全身运动的分布。
AI.result: 仿真中，场景专用模型在内部摩擦变化下五秒轨迹Energy Score为12.05 mm，在未观测驱动扰动下为9.29 mm；相比条件变分自编码器与扩散基线，Flow的Energy Score更低，覆盖率更接近名义水平。消融实验支持历史条件与结构条件的作用。实体机器人上，对训练中排除的两组肌腱指令剖面，预测捕捉到主要运动序列，五秒Energy Score分别为11.91 mm和11.42 mm，低于对比基线；预测与实测离散度比值为1.65和1.22（越接近1越好）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在机械观测不完整条件下，历史条件化的概率动力学预测具有可行性，并在仿真与实体机器人上优于相关基线方法。

7b6f9c797bfe1949be0d8b975c173107d868422f.title: From Experts to Sub-experts: Fine-grained Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for MoE LLMs
7b6f9c797bfe1949be0d8b975c173107d868422f.summary: As large language models (LLMs) scale rapidly, dense full-parameter adaptation becomes increasingly expensive, motivating sparse and modular architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. This shift raises a key question for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT): at what granularity should parameters be selected and updated? Existing PEFT methods such as LoRA operate on predefined weight matrices, while expert-level sparse tuning methods update entire selected experts. However, we observe that activated experts are internally sparse, with only a small fraction of intermediate channels strongly responding to downstream tasks, indicating that expert-level adaptation is still too coarse. We propose NSFT (Neural Sub-expert Fine-Tuning), a fine-grained PEFT framework that refines MoE adaptation from experts to sub-experts. NSFT decomposes each expert along the intermediate dimension into structured channel groups and selects task-relevant sub-experts by combining routing importance with intra-expert activation saliency. To optimize sparse partial updates, NSFT further introduces learning-rate scaling and dynamic gradient scaling to compensate for the reduced effective update magnitude. Experiments on OLMoE and Ling-mini-2.0 across challenging domain-specific tasks and general benchmarks show that NSFT consistently outperforms representative PEFT and expert-level sparse tuning baselines, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and preserving competitive general capability. These results suggest that sub-expert-level adaptation is a more precise and efficient PEFT paradigm for MoE LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NSFT（Neural Sub-expert Fine-Tuning），一种面向MoE大语言模型的细粒度参数高效微调框架，将适配粒度从"专家级"细化到"子专家级"，通过结构化通道分组选择任务相关子专家并优化稀疏更新，在多个任务上以更少可训练参数超越代表性PEFT与专家级稀疏微调基线。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM规模扩大，稠密全参数适配成本高昂，催生了MoE等稀疏模块化架构。这引出PEFT的关键问题：应以何种粒度选择与更新参数？现有方法（如LoRA）在预定义权重矩阵上操作，专家级稀疏微调则更新整个被选专家。然而作者观察到被激活的专家内部本身是稀疏的——仅有少部分中间通道对下游任务强烈响应，说明专家级适配粒度仍然过粗，因此需要更精细的适配粒度。
AI.method: 提出NSFT框架，将MoE适配从专家级细化到子专家级。具体地：沿中间维度将每个专家分解为结构化通道组（structured channel groups），结合路由重要性（routing importance）与专家内激活显著性（intra-expert activation saliency）来选择任务相关的子专家。为优化稀疏部分更新，NSFT引入学习率缩放（learning-rate scaling）与动态梯度缩放（dynamic gradient scaling），以补偿有效更新幅度的减小。
AI.result: 在OLMoE与Ling-mini-2.0两个模型上，针对具有挑战性的领域特定任务与通用基准进行实验。结果表明，NSFT持续优于代表性PEFT方法与专家级稀疏微调基线，同时使用显著更少的可训练参数，并保持有竞争力的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，子专家级适配是面向MoE LLM的一种更精确、更高效的PEFT范式。

ffad958cf7550c8d1d880f3aa87762480b40ca83.title: Reasoning-Preserving Fine-Tuning of Post-RL LLMs with Null-Basis LoRA
ffad958cf7550c8d1d880f3aa87762480b40ca83.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has become an effective approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, adapting post-RL models to new knowledge domains or behaviors through subsequent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can severely overwrite these capabilities. Existing approaches mitigate such forgetting through experience replay, specialized initialization, or constrained optimization using gradient projection, but either provide limited preservation or incur substantial training overhead. Our analysis shows that reasoning activations concentrate in low-dimensional subspaces, leaving substantial null-space capacity for adaptation, and that the corresponding approximate null spaces can be reliably estimated from a modest number of examples. Motivated by these observations, we propose Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation (NB-LoRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting post-RL LLMs while preserving their acquired reasoning ability. We formulate reasoning retention as a layer-wise hidden-state preservation constraint and construct a fixed approximate null basis from reasoning activations. LoRA updates are then reparameterized through this basis, enforcing the preservation constraint throughout fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across multiple RL-trained LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that NB-LoRA matches standard LoRA in adaptation performance, maintains reasoning accuracy near pre-fine-tuning levels, and generalizes this preservation to held-out reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 NB-LoRA：利用推理激活的低维子空间与近似零空间构造固定基，将 LoRA 更新重参数化以在后续 SFT 中保持 RL 获得的推理能力。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练能激发 LLM 推理能力，但后续为适配新知识或行为的 SFT 会严重覆盖这些能力。现有经验回放、特殊初始化或梯度投影约束方法，要么保留效果有限，要么训练开销大。
AI.method: 分析发现推理激活集中于低维子空间，存在大量零空间容量，且近似零空间可由少量样本可靠估计。据此提出 NB-LoRA：将推理保持形式化为逐层隐状态保持约束，从推理激活构造固定近似零空间基，并通过该基重参数化 LoRA 更新，使微调全程满足保持约束。
AI.result: 在多种 RL 训练 LLM 和多样下游任务上，NB-LoRA 的适配性能与标准 LoRA 相当，推理准确率接近微调前水平，并能将保持效果泛化到未见的推理基准。
AI.conclusion: NB-LoRA 是一种参数高效的后 RL LLM 适配方法，在保持推理能力的同时实现有效下游适配，优于需高开销或保留有限的现有方案。

414268578da06e18b1efa87d1874f03640913090.title: LiFR v2: Completion-Augmented Event Propagation for High-Rate Dense Prediction
414268578da06e18b1efa87d1874f03640913090.summary: High-rate dense perception in dynamic environments is limited by the low update rate of RGB cameras, as rapid scene changes can occur between frames. Event cameras offer temporally dense but spatially sparse measurements, complementary to spatially dense RGB observations. Direct fusion cannot fully exploit this complementarity, while event-guided propagation fails on newly appearing or disoccluded regions without valid RGB support. We present LiFR v2, a unified propagation-completion-memory framework for causal anytime and streaming dense prediction from an RGB keyframe and events. LiFR v2 introduces an Event-Guided Completion Module (EGCM) to recover task-relevant representations where propagation is unsupported, and a History Retrieval Module (HRM) to reuse completed representations across successive queries. The framework supports semantic segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and multi-task dense prediction, and we further introduce SHF-Emerge to evaluate rapid object emergence and disocclusion. LiFR v2 achieves 74.37% mIoU on DSEC and 56.13% on SHF-Emerge, improving LiFR-Seg by 1.85 percentage points on the latter, while reducing SHF-Emerge depth RMSE from 1.564 m to 1.118 m over the propagation baseline. It also exceeds 100 FPS for both segmentation and depth, demonstrating accurate and efficient high-rate perception beyond RGB frame rates.

AI.tldr: LiFR v2 提出"传播-补全-记忆"统一框架，利用 RGB 关键帧与事件流实现因果、任意时刻的流式密集预测，可同时完成语义分割、单目深度估计与多任务预测，并在新增的 SHF-Emerge 基准上验证快速物体出现与去遮挡场景，兼具高精度与 >100 FPS 的效率。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下高帧率密集感知受限于 RGB 相机低更新率，帧间易发生剧烈场景变化；事件相机时间密集但空间稀疏，与 RGB 形成互补。但直接融合难以充分利用互补性，而事件引导的传播在新出现或去遮挡区域因缺少有效 RGB 支撑而失效。因此需要一种既能传播又能补全、并可跨查询复用信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出 LiFR v2，一个统一的传播(propagation)-补全(completion)-记忆(memory)框架，基于 RGB 关键帧与事件进行因果的 anytime 与流式密集预测。包含两个核心模块：事件引导补全模块(EGCM)，在传播无支撑区域恢复任务相关表示；历史检索模块(HRM)，在连续查询间复用已补全表示。框架统一支持语义分割、单目深度估计与多任务密集预测，并引入 SHF-Emerge 基准评估快速物体出现与去遮挡。
AI.result: 在 DSEC 上取得 74.37% mIoU；在 SHF-Emerge 上达到 56.13% mIoU，较 LiFR-Seg 提升 1.85 个百分点；SHF-Emerge 深度 RMSE 相比传播基线从 1.564 m 降至 1.118 m。分割与深度均超过 100 FPS。
AI.conclusion: LiFR v2 通过补全与记忆机制弥补传播的盲区，实现了超越 RGB 帧率的高精度、高效率密集感知，验证了 RGB-事件互补融合在高速动态场景下的有效性。

9f152a089d3f77ab316c2676563b9bf56992070d.title: Deploying Foundation Models for Embodied Navigation
9f152a089d3f77ab316c2676563b9bf56992070d.summary: We present and tackle two problems associated with deploying Foundation Models (FMs) on Embodied Agents performing navigation: 1) Training bias in FMs leading to poor personalization in unseen environments, and 2) Limited FM context length hindering success, especially on long horizon tasks. Our solution for the former involves priming the FM with human-habit data mined from the scene and our solution for the latter involves active memory management via a novel `memory head' augmentation. We first present a taxonomy of existing literature on FM-based Embodied Navigation, and highlight these limitations. We then present our approaches, Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) and MemCtrl to address the limitations. With TAP, we present real-world results in a lab environment with a Turtlebot for personalized target finding that shows an average improvement of 18% over a non-TAP baseline. On MemCtrl, we report a 6% average improvement across various embodied tasks, with 20% on long instruction subsets, all while using nearly half the context used in the baseline model. Motivated by these result, we present our stance the deployability of FM-based embodied agents in real-world environments, and highlight open research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基础模型（FM）驱动机器人导航智能体在真实部署中的两大瓶颈——训练偏差导致的个性化不足与上下文长度受限导致长程任务失败，提出 TAP（场景挖掘人类习惯数据为 FM 做提示）与 MemCtrl（以"记忆头"实现主动记忆管理），并给出真实环境实验验证与部署性观点。
AI.motivation: 将基础模型（Foundation Models, FMs）部署到具身导航智能体时存在两个关键问题：(1) FM 自身的训练偏差使其在未见环境中个性化能力差；(2) FM 的上下文长度有限，尤其在长时程（long-horizon）任务上会显著限制成功率。
AI.method: 作者先对现有 FM 驱动机器人导航（FM-based Embodied Navigation）文献进行梳理并提出分类体系（taxonomy），以此凸显上述局限。随后提出两种解决方案：一是 Transit-Aware Planning（TAP），通过从场景中挖掘的人类习惯数据对 FM 进行"预置提示"（priming），以缓解个性化偏差；二是 MemCtrl，通过一种新颖的"记忆头"（memory head）增强实现主动记忆管理（active memory management），以缓解上下文长度瓶颈。
AI.result: TAP：在实验室真实环境中使用 Turtlebot 进行个性化目标查找，相比非 TAP 基线平均提升约 18%。MemCtrl：在多种具身任务上平均提升约 6%，在长指令子集上提升约 20%，同时上下文消耗仅约为基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述结果，作者提出关于 FM 驱动机器人智能体在真实环境可部署性（deployability）的立场观点，并指出若干开放研究方向。

35e722f6bc9bc6884288f38935be67a982acd552.title: Targeted Review for AI-Assisted Biodiversity Surveys: Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling
35e722f6bc9bc6884288f38935be67a982acd552.summary: We increasingly use machine learning to label scientific datasets. The models we develop and deploy are improving all the time, but they are not and will likely never be perfect. Mistakes matter, as errors can propagate into our scientific understanding, particularly when systematically biased. Very reasonably, scientists thus review substantial proportions of ML-generated labels to verify or correct mistakes in pursuit of ensuring their scientific findings are not biased by ML. In this work, we focus on helping scientists optimally allocate this reviewing effort relative to their scientific goals. We focus on a specific class of scientists (ecologists) and a specific, widespread, and impactful modeling target (occupancy modeling, which estimates where species are likely to occur, conditioned on environmental factors). We introduce Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling (ACORN), a method that incorporates ML predictions into occupancy models and strategically selects samples for expert review that are maximally informative for downstream ecological analysis. Across camera-trap and bioacoustic datasets, our method recovers ecological conclusions close to those obtained from fully human-labeled data, while requiring substantially fewer expert reviews than non-targeted review policies. Our results suggest that ML-assisted scientific workflows should optimize expert effort for downstream inference, rather than for classifier accuracy alone, especially when human review budget is limited. Our code is available at https://github.com/timmh/acorn

AI.tldr: 提出 ACORN 方法，将机器学习预测整合进占域模型，并主动挑选对下游生态推断最有价值的样本供专家审核，从而在有限审核预算下接近全人工标注的生态结论。
AI.motivation: 科学数据集越来越多地使用机器学习进行标注，但模型难以做到完美，系统性偏差会传播到科学认知中。因此科学家通常需要审核大量 ML 生成的标签以纠错、避免研究结论被 ML 偏差影响。然而专家审核预算有限，如何将审核精力最优地分配到符合科研目标的样本上，是一个亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出 Active Continuous-Score Occupancy Modeling（ACORN）。该方法将 ML 的连续分数预测纳入占域模型（occupancy modeling，即在环境因子条件下估计物种出现概率），并策略性地选择对下游生态分析信息量最大的样本进行专家审核。研究聚焦生态学家这一特定群体，在相机陷阱（camera-trap）与生物声学（bioacoustic）数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 在相机陷阱和生物声学数据集上，ACORN 恢复的生态学结论接近使用全人工标注数据所得结论，同时所需专家审核量显著少于非定向（non-targeted）的审核策略。
AI.conclusion: ML 辅助的科学工作流应针对下游推断来优化专家投入，而非仅针对分类器准确率，尤其是在人工审核预算有限的情况下。代码已开源。

2f918a58070e56fa6d050cbb51d384f31d75898e.title: ChatT2: An Adaptive Framework for Developing a Large Language Model-Based Agent for Natural Product Domain Research
2f918a58070e56fa6d050cbb51d384f31d75898e.summary: Scientific investigations into microbial natural products (NPs) present significant challenges for novices, largely due to the complexity of microbial systems, biochemical diversity, technical skill requirements, and the demands of bioinformatics and data analysis processes. To address these issues, we introduce ChatT2, a large language model (LLM)-based agent that is specifically tailored to the unique characteristics of bacterial type II polyketides. These polyketides form a structurally distinct and therapeutically important NP family. ChatT2 was developed within an autonomous multiagent framework composed of a mentor, an executor, and an evaluator, each with defined responsibilities. The mentor acts as an intermediary between ChatT2 and the user, utilizing chain-of-thought prompting to refine the intent of the user. Under the guidance of the mentor, the executor synthesizes multimodal information via retrieval-augmented generation techniques and seamlessly integrates bioinformatics and cheminformatics tools. The evaluator ultimately assesses the output of the executor to ensure the richness and accuracy of the retrieved information. Our research highlights how ChatT2, designed with this multiagent framework, addresses the challenges faced by general LLMs in terms of understanding limited, specialized corpora and complex biological information and provides both experts and novices with a valuable tool for exploring various NPs of interest. The ChatT2 webserver can be accessed at https://chatt2.site/#/chat.

AI.tldr: ChatT2 是一个面向细菌 II 型聚酮天然产物的 LLM 多智能体系统，采用“导师—执行者—评估者”框架，结合思维链提示、检索增强生成以及生物信息学和化学信息学工具，帮助专家和新手更高效地检索、理解和探索天然产物。
AI.motivation: 微生物天然产物研究对新手门槛较高，原因包括微生物系统复杂、生化多样性高、实验技能要求强，以及生物信息学和数据分析流程负担重。通用大语言模型又难以理解有限的专业语料和复杂生物信息，因此需要针对特定天然产物家族构建专用智能体。
AI.method: 作者提出 ChatT2，一个针对细菌 II 型聚酮特点定制的大语言模型智能体。其核心是自主多智能体框架，由 mentor、executor 和 evaluator 组成：mentor 作为用户与系统之间的中介，利用思维链提示细化用户意图；executor 在 mentor 指导下通过检索增强生成合成多模态信息，并集成生物信息学与化学信息学工具；evaluator 评估 executor 的输出，以保证检索信息的丰富性和准确性。
AI.result: ChatT2 通过该多智能体框架缓解了通用 LLM 在有限专业语料和复杂生物信息理解方面的不足，为专家和新手提供了探索不同天然产物的工具。论文还提供了 ChatT2 网页服务器，地址为 https://chatt2.site/#/chat。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将 LLM 与多智能体协作、RAG 和领域工具集成，可有效支持细菌 II 型聚酮等专业天然产物研究。ChatT2 既是面向该领域的实用平台，也为其他天然产物发现与信息检索提供了可借鉴的智能体设计范式。

4782b94a818d17714f7fd950d9083d133b218d14.title: MorphoSHAP: Rethinking the Unit of Attribution in Explanation for Deep Visual Models
4782b94a818d17714f7fd950d9083d133b218d14.summary: Visual attribution methods typically explain predictions using pixels, superpixels, or regular patches. These representations can localize important regions, but provide limited information about their structure. We introduce MorphoSHAP, a model-agnostic post-hoc method that instead uses morphological shapes as the players of a Shapley attribution game. Using the Tree of Shapes, each shape is described by its scale, geometry, and signed contribution, providing explanations of where the evidence lies, what type of structure carries it, and how strongly it affects the prediction. This shared morphological vocabulary enables spatial, textual, and global class-level explanations beyond image-specific heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, MorphoSHAP is the first SHAP-based image attribution framework to combine these different forms of explanation. Across five diverse datasets and three architectures, MorphoSHAP achieves strong insertion/deletion performance and outperforms competing attribution methods on several benchmarks. Finally, a user study shows that MorphoSHAP provides explanations that are easy to use and are preferred over standard attribution baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 MorphoSHAP，一种基于形态学形状作为 Shapley 博弈参与者的模型无关事后归因方法，可同时提供空间、文本与全局类别级解释。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉归因方法多使用像素、超像素或规则块作为解释单元，虽能定位重要区域，但对其结构信息刻画有限，难以说明证据的形态与语义结构。
AI.method: 以形态学形状（morphological shapes）作为 Shapley 归因博弈的参与者，构建模型无关的事后归因框架。借助 Tree of Shapes，每个形状由尺度（scale）、几何（geometry）与带符号贡献（signed contribution）描述，从而回答证据位置、所承载结构类型及其对预测影响强度。该统一的形态学词汇表支持空间、文本和全局类别级三类解释。
AI.result: 在五个多样化数据集与三种网络架构上，MorphoSHAP 取得较强的插入/删除（insertion/deletion）性能，并在多个基准上优于竞争归因方法；用户研究表明其解释易于使用，且相较标准归因基线更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，MorphoSHAP 是首个结合上述多种解释形式的基于 SHAP 的图像归因框架，验证了以形态学形状作为归因单元在可解释性与实用性上的优势。

63add84ee07e5ab55ebc63bd82c927cf20e1af99.title: CDKF-Track: Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering for Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking
63add84ee07e5ab55ebc63bd82c927cf20e1af99.summary: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is essential for EdgeAI perception systems, where accurate object localization and reliable identification enable safe decision-making. Singleagent MOT suffers from occlusions, sensor noise, and partial scene understanding in complex real-world scenarios. While multi-agent systems improve robustness by exploiting shared information, they introduce redundant measurements that lead to false data associations, and still struggle to capture nonlinear object dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose CDKFTrack, a Cluster-aware Data-Driven Kalman Filtering framework for Cooperative 3D MOT. The proposed method first fuses multivehicle 3D LiDAR detections through a Graph Laplacian-based formulation. Then, a cluster-aware redundancy reduction scheme groups spatially related detections and selects representative observations to reduce duplicate inputs to the tracker. The resulting detections are processed by a data-driven Kalman filter that learns object motion dynamics from data, reducing dependence on predefined linear motion assumptions. Furthermore, a wavelet-based temporal refinement module leverages the multiresolution decomposition property of wavelets to attenuate shortterm positional fluctuations and improve trajectory continuity. To the best of our knowledge, CDKF-Track is the first framework to jointly address detection-level fusion redundancy and learnable motion modeling in cooperative 3D MOT. Experimental results on the real-world V2V4Real dataset indicate that CDKF-Track achieves up to 27.99% improvements in tracking accuracy over state-of-the-art multi-agent MOT methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CDKF-Track，一种面向协同3D多目标跟踪的聚类感知数据驱动卡尔曼滤波框架，联合解决检测级融合冗余与可学习运动建模问题，在V2V4Real数据集上跟踪精度最高提升27.99%。
AI.motivation: 边缘AI感知系统需要精准定位与可靠识别的多目标跟踪（MOT）。单智能体MOT在复杂场景中受遮挡、传感器噪声和局部场景理解不足的困扰；多智能体系统虽通过共享信息提升鲁棒性，却引入冗余测量导致错误数据关联，且难以刻画非线性目标动态。
AI.method: 1）基于图拉普拉斯（Graph Laplacian）公式融合多车3D LiDAR检测结果；2）聚类感知冗余削减方案：将空间相关检测分组并选取代表性观测，减少输入跟踪器的重复数据；3）数据驱动卡尔曼滤波：从数据中学习目标运动动态，降低对预设线性运动假设的依赖；4）基于小波的时域细化模块：利用小波多分辨率分解特性抑制短期位置波动，提升轨迹连续性。
AI.result: 在真实世界V2V4Real数据集上的实验表明，CDKF-Track相较最先进的多智能体MOT方法，跟踪精度最高提升27.99%。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，CDKF-Track是首个在协同3D MOT中同时解决检测级融合冗余与可学习运动建模的框架，验证了联合处理这两类问题的有效性与优越性。

89fec94cdf8aa0e7e9c17c7f297315b746d90d48.title: When Riemann flows with Wasserstein: Generative Modeling of Probability Distributions on Manifolds
89fec94cdf8aa0e7e9c17c7f297315b746d90d48.summary: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. Our experiments show that by respecting the intrinsic geometry of the data, RWEFM can generate whole single-cell samples in hyperspherical latent spaces and protein conformational ensembles on the torus. As RWEFM requires only a geodesic distance and a projection operator, it is not restricted to manifolds with closed-form geometry, which we demonstrate by generating distributions on a general triangulated mesh.

AI.tldr: RWEFM 是一种在黎曼流形 $(\mathcal{M},g)$ 的 Wasserstein 空间 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上的生成框架。它通过将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度，并利用 McCann 位移插值作为条件路径来训练，从而在尊重数据内在几何结构的前提下生成元分布（meta-distributions），并在单细胞、蛋白质构象及一般三角网格等任务上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 许多科学数据集（如分子构象系综、单细胞组织测量）天然地应建模为"元分布"——非欧几里得域上概率测度的分布。然而现有生成方法大多假设欧几里得几何，无法刻画这种结构，导致无法捕捉数据的内在几何特征。
AI.method: 提出 Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching（RWEFM）：在黎曼流形 $(\mathcal{M},g)$ 的 Wasserstein 空间 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上构建生成框架。训练时将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度，并以 McCann 位移插值作为条件路径；同时提出 Riemannian Entropic Map 作为流形上最优传输映射的 GPU 高效近似。整个方法仅依赖测地距离与投影算子。
AI.result: 理论上证明该构造构成 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上有效的流匹配方法。实验中，通过尊重数据内在几何，RWEFM 能在超球潜空间中生成完整单细胞样本、在环面上生成蛋白质构象系综，并在一般三角网格上生成分布，验证了方法不局限于具有闭式几何的流形。
AI.conclusion: RWEFM 将流匹配推广至黎曼流形上的 Wasserstein 空间，为建模非欧几里得域上的元分布提供了理论与实用兼具的生成框架；因其仅需测地距离与投影算子，具备良好的通用性。

3eed40d9ecd38f839bcd18bf0bec5761c522ae20.title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
3eed40d9ecd38f839bcd18bf0bec5761c522ae20.summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. It delivers large gains on arithmetic tasks (e.g., +32 percentage points on AddSub, +25pp on SVAMP), +2-8pp improvements on in-domain test splits, and strong though dataset-dependent benefits on multi-hop reasoning (e.g., +16pp on QASC, +25pp on StrategyQA). LoT also converges faster than staged curricula, highlighting the value of adaptive progression. These results show that progressive rewrites coupled with adaptive curricula provide a simple yet effective recipe for strengthening reasoning in smaller LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ladders-of-Thought (LoT) 框架，通过渐进式问题改写与自演化课程相结合，显著提升中小规模 LLM 的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大模型（数千亿参数）推理能力强，但中小规模模型即便经过知识蒸馏（KD）仍推理脆弱，亟需一种简单有效的提升方案。
AI.method: LoT 自动生成语义忠实但更简单的推理问题变体，基于步骤度量将其划分为不同难度桶，并采用自演化 bandit 调度器自适应分配训练数据，形成渐进式改写与自适应课程相结合的框架。
AI.result: 在数学与多跳推理两个领域、1-8B 不同模型家族上评估，LoT 一致优于 KD：算术任务提升显著（AddSub +32pp、SVAMP +25pp），域内测试集提升 +2-8pp，多跳推理有较强但依赖数据集的收益（QASC +16pp、StrategyQA +25pp），且比分阶段课程收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式改写与自适应课程相结合，是增强小型 LLM 推理能力的简单而有效的配方，且自适应推进优于固定分阶段课程。

ad126ce783ea48a474121a9aa1fb0d7448df8c18.title: Teaching Reinforcement Learning and Humanoid Robotics to High-School Students: An Expert-Validated Curriculum Design on a Low-Cost Open Platform
ad126ce783ea48a474121a9aa1fb0d7448df8c18.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE International Conference on Teaching, Assessment, and Learning for Engineering (TALE 2026)
ad126ce783ea48a474121a9aa1fb0d7448df8c18.summary: Lower cost open source robots and reinforcement learning (RL) simulation tools create new opportunities for precollege students to engage with contemporary robotics. However, translating a complete research workflow, spanning mechanical assembly, electrical setup, simulation, policy learning, system identification, and physical deployment, into a coherent course for novice learners remains challenging. We present an integrated robotics course framework that organizes these activities around a shared robotic artifact. The framework combines parallel disciplinary tracks, sequencing based on technical dependencies, progressive integration of simulation and hardware, layered performance checkpoints, and structures for balancing collaborative work with individual accountability. We illustrate the framework through a high school curriculum organized around a robot project in which pairs of students assemble an open source humanoid robot, train a walking policy in simulation, and deploy it on the physical platform. The framework was developed through an iterative design process that included formative review by five experts in robotics research, engineering, secondary STEM education, and curriculum design. Expert feedback highlighted three central design tensions: authenticity versus cognitive load, system integration versus timely visible progress, and team construction versus individual accountability. These tensions informed the final framework presented in this paper. This work offers a structured approach for adapting robotics research workflows into interdisciplinary precollege courses; future classroom studies are needed to examine implementation and student learning.

AI.tldr: 提出一个以共享机器人项目为纽带的预科机器人课程框架，将机械装配、电气设置、仿真、策略学习、系统辨识和实物部署整合为面向初学者的完整研究流程，并以高中人形机器人课程为例，经专家形成性评审凝练出三类设计张力。
AI.motivation: 低成本开源机器人与强化学习仿真工具为预科生接触现代机器人学创造了机会，但将完整科研工作流转化为适合新手学习者的连贯课程仍很困难，存在认知负荷、系统集成与教学进度、团队合作与个人责任之间的平衡问题。
AI.method: 采用迭代设计过程开发集成式机器人课程框架，围绕共享机器人制品组织活动，包含并行学科轨道、基于技术依赖的排序、仿真与硬件的渐进整合、分层性能检查点，以及兼顾协作与个人问责的结构。框架通过一个高中课程案例说明：学生成对组装开源人形机器人、在仿真中训练行走策略并部署到实体平台。过程中邀请五位机器人研究、工程、中学STEM教育与课程设计专家进行形成性评审。
AI.result: 专家反馈识别出三类核心设计张力：真实性与认知负荷、系统集成与及时可见进展、团队构建与个人问责。这些张力被纳入并影响了最终框架的设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为将机器人研究工作流转化为跨学科预科课程提供了结构化方法；未来需开展课堂研究，检验实际实施效果与学生学习成效。

c5da34ee133d75ca85d7467bea120bb6e20e8ac7.title: Marginal Log-Likelihood Increments under Dirichlet-Smoothed Markov Estimation
c5da34ee133d75ca85d7467bea120bb6e20e8ac7.summary: For a Dirichlet-smoothed transition model, the effect of adding one workflow trace to the training archive is an exact change in reference-weighted log likelihood. We derive that change and show that it is a weighted reduction of Kullback--Leibler divergence between the reference conditionals and the model. From this form we obtain an upper bound on the gain available to any acquisition, which expresses a millinat difference as a share of what is attainable, an exact covariance identity for the effect of the reference weighting, and a sign criterion for the interaction between two candidates, from which the batch objective is neither submodular nor supermodular. A case study on the BPI Challenge 2012 loan-application log measures all three and finds a positive selection result in one of the four combinations of reference weighting and budget unit. There, of two regressors fitted to identical descriptors and identical labels, the one that predicts individual increments far more accurately, median $R^2$ 0.87 against 0.62, realizes the smaller share of the attainable gain, 61 against 69 per cent, so ranking accuracy for individual traces is neither necessary nor sufficient for batch quality.

AI.tldr: 针对 Dirichlet 平滑的转移模型，本文推导出向训练集加入单条工作流轨迹对参考加权对数似然的精确变化，证明其为参考条件分布与模型之间 KL 散度的加权缩减，并由此得到采集增益上界、参考加权的协方差恒等式与候选交互的符号判据；在 BPI Challenge 2012 贷款申请日志上的案例研究表明，批次目标的次模/超模性质不成立，且对单条轨迹的排序精度对批次质量既不必要也不充分。
AI.motivation: 在主动学习/批量采集场景中，通常以模型似然增益来衡量新增样本的价值，但对 Dirichlet 平滑转移模型而言，单条轨迹带来的似然变化缺乏精确且可解释的解析形式，导致采集增益的上界、参考加权的作用机制以及候选样本间交互性质（是否次模/超模）都不清晰，从而难以判断基于单条样本排序精度进行批次选择的合理性。
AI.method: 对 Dirichlet 平滑转移模型，解析推导加入单条工作流轨迹引起的参考加权对数似然精确变化，并将其改写为参考条件分布与模型之间 KL 散度的加权缩减；基于该形式导出任意采集策略的增益上界，将毫纳（millinat）级差异表示为可达增益的占比，给出参考加权效应的精确协方差恒等式，以及两候选样本交互项的符号判据。随后在 BPI Challenge 2012 贷款申请日志上进行案例研究，在参考加权与预算单位的四种组合下度量上述三项量，并对比两个使用相同描述符与标签、但对个体增量预测精度不同的回归器（中位 R² 分别为 0.87 与 0.62）所实现的可达增益占比。
AI.result: 理论上得到三项结果：采集增益的上界（以可达增益占比表示的毫纳级差异）、参考加权效应的精确协方差恒等式、以及候选交互的符号判据，由此证明批次目标既非次模也非超模。案例研究中，仅在参考加权与预算单位的四种组合之一出现正向选择结果；两个回归器中预测个体增量更准确者（中位 R² 0.87 对 0.62）反而实现较小的可达增益占比（61% 对 69%）。
AI.conclusion: 单条轨迹的排序精度对批次采集质量既不必要也不充分；批次目标的非次模/非超模性质与参考加权、预算单位的选择共同影响采集效果，因此不能简单以个体增量预测精度替代批次层面的增益评估。

953fc2343f7cdefdfaba73fbd6d1732c94416869.title: Testing-Driven Reliability Audit of Trajectory-Based Early Outcome Prediction for LLM Agents: Target-Specific Calibration Transfer Persists Within a Single Benchmark
953fc2343f7cdefdfaba73fbd6d1732c94416869.summary: Predicting early outcomes based on trajectory can decrease the expenses associated with agent evaluation by terminating a run once the outcome becomes sufficiently predictable, assuming that the predictor's confidence is properly calibrated. Calibration is at risk when a predictor is applied to an agent on which it was never trained, but it is not known whether such transfer failures are broad across agent systems or concentrated in specific target agent/head combinations. Using public SWE-bench Verified trajectories and a frozen dual-head early-outcome prediction pipeline, we ran a leave-one-agent-out calibration audit, a shared-predictor leave-two-agents-out control, oracle prior correction, and a robustness battery over training cohorts, task resampling, task halves, jackknife, and thresholds. Fixed-scaffold TerminalBench analysis served as a pre-registered boundary test. Broad same-predictor pairwise heterogeneity was not supported; the median pairwise corrected-gap differences were 0.0180 (SUCCESS head, 45 pairs) and 0.0385 (FAILURE head, 35 pairs), and the pre-registered heterogeneity criterion was not met on either head. Two specific combinations, gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS and claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE, showed persistent calibration-transfer errors (median corrected gaps 0.1377 and 0.1107) without a sign reversal under any frozen control. TerminalBench did not establish cross-benchmark replication: the success target produced zero decisions (INDETERMINATE), and the failure target did not satisfy the pre-registered persistence criterion. Therefore, a strong target-specific calibration-transfer error can exist within one frozen environment, but the evidence does not establish that the error is intrinsic to the model or general across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 在SWE-bench Verified上用冻结的双头早期结果预测器做留一智能体校准审计：未发现广泛的跨智能体校准迁移失败，但识别出gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS与claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE两个特定组合存在稳健的校准迁移误差，且该误差未能跨到TerminalBench复现。
AI.motivation: 基于轨迹预测早期结果可在结果足够可预测时提前终止运行，从而降低智能体评测成本，但前提是预测器置信度校准良好。当预测器被用于未训练过的智能体时校准可能失效，而目前不清楚这种迁移失败是普遍存在于多智能体系统，还是集中在特定目标智能体/预测头组合。
AI.method: 使用公开SWE-bench Verified轨迹与冻结的双头早期结果预测流程；开展留一智能体校准审计、共享预测器留二智能体对照、oracle先验校正，以及覆盖训练队列、任务重采样、任务对半、jackknife、阈值的稳健性检验；以固定脚手架TerminalBench分析作为预注册边界测试。
AI.result: 不支持广泛的同预测器成对异质性：SUCCESS头45对、FAILURE头35对的中位成对校正差距差分别为0.0180和0.0385，两个头均未达到预注册异质性标准。两个特定组合gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS和claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE表现出持续校准迁移误差（中位校正差距0.1377和0.1107），在冻结对照下无符号反转。TerminalBench未建立跨基准复现：成功目标产生零决策（INDETERMINATE），失败目标未满足预注册持续性标准。
AI.conclusion: 在单一冻结环境中可以存在强烈的目标特定校准迁移误差，但现有证据不足以表明该误差是模型固有属性或跨基准普遍存在。

78ca5a24f30acc63957e2a25df30a4509bc1904e.title: Identity-Centric Video Summarization via Hierarchical Fusion of Biometric, Appearance, and 3D Body Features
78ca5a24f30acc63957e2a25df30a4509bc1904e.summary: This work presents a video summarization algorithm based on multi-object tracking and person reidentification. We integrate facial embeddings, 3D body-shape features, and visual appearance into a unified tracking framework. These representations enable hierarchical identity assignment and tracking through bidirectional anchoring, which robustly recovers trajectories under severe occlusion or low visual quality. From these stable trajectories, we generate a compact set of summaries for each identity. We select keyframes using a multi-factor weighting scheme that optimizes biometric clarity, social interaction, and motion dynamics, while Adaptive Non-Maximum Suppression ensures temporal diversity. Evaluation on a custom dataset demonstrates tracking stability, achieving an IDF1 of 97.89% and a MOTA of 95.79%. Compared to Top-K selection, our algorithm also increases visual diversity by 146%, temporal coverage by 89%, and information retrievability by 3.5%.

AI.tldr: 基于多目标跟踪与行人重识别，融合人脸、3D体形和视觉外观特征，通过双向锚定实现层次化身份分配，生成紧凑的人物视频摘要。
AI.motivation: 在严重遮挡或低画质条件下，传统视频摘要方法难以稳定恢复人物轨迹并保持摘要的多样性、覆盖度和可检索性。
AI.method: 将人脸嵌入、3D体形特征与视觉外观统一融入跟踪框架，进行层次化身份分配与双向锚定跟踪；从稳定轨迹中按身份生成摘要，采用多因素加权选择关键帧以优化生物特征清晰度、社交互动和运动动态，并使用自适应非极大值抑制保证时间多样性。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上，跟踪IDF1达97.89%，MOTA达95.79%；相较Top-K选择，视觉多样性提升146%，时间覆盖率提升89%，信息可检索性提升3.5%。
AI.conclusion: 多特征融合与双向锚定跟踪可显著提升复杂场景下的人物跟踪稳定性，结合多因素关键帧选择能生成更紧凑、多样且可检索的身份级视频摘要。

bfc4caf5ef9d9cbbd916e95483dbfe8fb82c903f.title: SG-CPG: Severity-Gated Central Pattern Generators for Adaptive Quadruped Locomotion under Continuous Actuator Degradation
bfc4caf5ef9d9cbbd916e95483dbfe8fb82c903f.summary: An animal with a weakened limb does not necessarily switch its gait, instead it unloads the affected limb, re-coordinates the remaining limbs, and scales its response with injury severity. This graded adaptation allows locomotion to persist despite partial loss of limb strength, rather than requiring a discrete transition between healthy and failed. Inspired by this behavior, we propose SG-CPG, a central pattern generator (CPG) for quadruped locomotion under continuous actuator degradation. SG-CPG preserves a frozen healthy CPG policy and introduces two severity-driven gates: a residual gate that re-coordinates all four legs and an amplitude gate that progressively shortens the weakened leg's stride as degradation increases. We emulate progressive degradation through two mechanisms: lowering the joint torque ceiling (ceiling mechanism) and scaling its low-level controller gains (gain mechanism), representing distinct forms of actuator weakening. Our simulations on a Unitree Go2 show that SG-CPG maintains a trot gait with 100% survival across an omnidirectional command schedule under 95% joint strength loss while tracking commands within 8%. Under a lowered torque ceiling, removing either severity path, the residual's severity observation or the amplitude gate, raises clipping at the weakened joint from 4.4% to 13.6% and 26.3% of steps at an 80% loss. On a real Go2, SG-CPG survives 28 of 29 forward and turning trials with up to 93% calf torque degradation. These results show that severity-gated adaptation can extend a healthy locomotion policy to progressive actuator degradation without treating the fault as a discrete failure.

AI.tldr: 提出 SG-CPG：受动物肢体无力时“减载患肢、重新协调余肢、按损伤严重度分级适应”的启发，在冻结的健康 CPG 策略上加入严重度驱动的残差门与幅度门，使四足机器人在执行器连续退化下仍能维持运动。Unitree Go2 仿真与真机验证表明，该方法可避免把故障当作离散失败。
AI.motivation: 动物单肢无力时通常不会直接切换步态，而是减载患肢、重新协调其余肢体，并随损伤严重度连续调整运动策略。现有机器人控制方法多将执行器故障视为离散失败或离散切换，难以应对渐进、连续的执行器退化。因此，作者希望借鉴生物的分级适应机制，将健康运动策略扩展到持续退化的执行器条件。
AI.method: 提出 SG-CPG（Severity-Gated CPG）。其核心是保留一个冻结的健康 CPG 策略，并引入两个由严重度驱动的门控：1）残差门，用于重新协调四条腿；2）幅度门，随退化程度增加而逐步缩短弱化腿的步幅。为模拟渐进退化，采用两种机制：降低关节力矩上限（ceiling mechanism）和缩放低层控制器增益（gain mechanism）。在 Unitree Go2 上进行仿真，并在真实 Go2 上验证前进与转向任务。
AI.result: 仿真中，在关节强度损失达 95% 时，SG-CPG 仍能在全向指令序列下维持 trot 步态，存活率 100%，指令跟踪误差在 8% 以内。在降低力矩上限条件下，若移除任一严重度路径、残差中的严重度观测或幅度门，80% 强度损失时弱化关节的 clipping 比例会从 4.4% 分别升至 13.6% 和 26.3%。真机 Go2 上，SG-CPG 在 29 次前进和转向试验中存活 28 次，小腿扭矩退化最高达 93%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，严重度门控自适应可将健康运动策略有效扩展到执行器渐进退化场景，而无需将故障视为离散失败。该机制通过连续、分级地调整肢体协调与步幅，提升了四足机器人在执行器弱化下的鲁棒性与任务持续性。

5ee7b3456c25c3546ba08884b5e47d647f397642.title: Graph Domain Adaptation Does Not End with Representation Learning
5ee7b3456c25c3546ba08884b5e47d647f397642.summary: Graph domain adaptation (GDA) transfers knowledge from a labeled source graph to an unlabeled target graph under shifts in both node attributes and graph structure. Existing methods primarily adapt graph representations through propagation redesign, distribution alignment, or source-to-target transition modeling, but still rely on a single graph-propagating path for target prediction. This leaves open whether an adapted graph representation exhausts the predictive evidence available in the target domain, since the graph-aware expert and graph-free local expert may exhibit different failure modes under topological shifts. To address this limitation, we propose EviGDA, an Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert. The graph-aware expert performs message passing and entropy-aware marginal alignment, while the graph-free local expert learns solely from source node features and labels without graph propagation or target alignment. The two experts are optimized independently and combined only at inference through a task-level constant probability mixture, preserving complementary evidence without joint training, learned routing, or target pseudo-labels. Extensive experiments on ten datasets and 16 transfer tasks show that EviGDA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EviGDA，一种证据增强的图域自适应框架，在图表示自适应之外引入一个无图局部专家，两个专家独立优化、仅在推理时以固定概率混合，在10个数据集、16个迁移任务上超越现有最优基线。
AI.motivation: 现有图域自适应（GDA）方法主要通过传播重设计、分布对齐或源到目标迁移建模来适应图表示，但目标域预测仍依赖单一图传播路径。由于图感知专家与无图局部专家在拓扑偏移下可能呈现不同的失效模式，单一图表示是否穷尽了目标域中可用的预测证据仍存疑。
AI.method: EviGDA 在图表示自适应基础上补充一个无图局部专家：图感知专家执行消息传递与熵感知边缘对齐；无图局部专家仅从源节点特征和标签学习，不进行图传播也不做目标对齐。两个专家独立优化，仅在推理阶段通过任务级固定概率混合（constant probability mixture）进行组合，从而在无需联合训练、学习式路由或目标伪标签的情况下保留互补证据。
AI.result: 在10个数据集和16个迁移任务上的大量实验表明，EviGDA 优于当前最先进（state-of-the-art）的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将图感知专家与无图局部专家以固定概率混合的方式互补，EviGDA 有效利用了两类专家在不同拓扑条件下的互补预测证据，为缓解单一图传播路径的证据局限提供了一种简洁且有效的解决方案。

b016bdc3a698f3da08c373c2fc66a165dd4eea85.title: Seeing Is Not Perceiving: When Synthetic Consumers Can and Cannot Pretest Visual Marketing
b016bdc3a698f3da08c373c2fc66a165dd4eea85.comment: 58 pages (30 pages of main text, 23 pages of appendix), 18 figures, 25 tables. All six studies were preregistered on AsPredicted
b016bdc3a698f3da08c373c2fc66a165dd4eea85.summary: Marketers now deploy generative AI agents as synthetic consumers to pretest visual assets such as logos, packaging, and advertising at a fraction of human-panel cost. However, this procedure assumes that a model seeing a visual cue can also perceive its consumer meaning, which is largely untested. We stress-test the assumption using six canonical visual marketing experiments, varying the two levers managers control: model generation (GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini) and input format (plain text vs. JSON). Every resulting configuration passed the manipulation checks; however, none of the configurations reproduced more than two of the six human effects, and the remainder were nonsignificant. The one exception was a significant reversal of the human pattern. Providing conceptual or empirical evidence through in-context learning steers average responses toward the human effect. Yet steering has a limit: even when it succeeds, a configuration reproduces less than half of the natural spread of human responses and so understates consumer heterogeneity. We integrate these results into an AI governance protocol (Calibrate, Intervene, Deploy) that delineates when synthetic consumers can responsibly screen creatives and when human panels remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 该文对"生成式AI合成消费者能感知视觉营销含义"这一假设进行压力测试：在六项经典视觉营销实验中，改变模型版本与输入格式，结果所有配置虽通过操纵检验，却几乎无法复现人类效应，且会低估消费者异质性。
AI.motivation: 营销者已开始用生成式AI智能体作为"合成消费者"来预测试标志、包装、广告等视觉资产，以远低于人工样本的成本进行筛选。但这一做法隐含一个未经检验的假设：模型"看到"视觉线索，就能"感知"其消费者含义。作者旨在检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 采用压力测试设计，选取六项经典的视觉营销实验，系统操纵管理者可控的两个杠杆：(1)模型世代（GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini）；(2)输入格式（纯文本 vs. JSON）。并对各配置进行操纵检验，同时引入上下文学习（in-context learning）提供概念性或实证性证据，考察其"引导"效应及限度。
AI.result: 所有配置均通过了操纵检验，但没有任何配置复现超过六项人类效应中的两项，其余均不显著；唯一的例外是出现了与人类模式显著相反的反转。通过上下文学习提供概念或实证证据可将平均反应向人类效应方向引导，但引导存在极限：即便成功，也仅能复现不到人类反应自然离散度的一半，从而低估消费者异质性。
AI.conclusion: 合成消费者对视觉营销含义的感知能力有限，不能简单替代人类样本。作者据此提出一套AI治理协议（Calibrate校准—Intervene干预—Deploy部署），界定合成消费者在何种情况下可负责任地用于创意筛选，以及何时仍需依赖人类样本。

22432a7b8122cc0ae17084b2ca5e48479f074f09.title: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
22432a7b8122cc0ae17084b2ca5e48479f074f09.summary: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards. Extensive experiments on Metric-Bench demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances spatial metric understanding, outperforming existing and even larger proprietary models by 43.1\%, while improving downstream embodied performance over a spatial-specialized counterpart by 30.4\% on RoboSpatial overall accuracy and 9.3\% on ERQA, and additionally delivering consistent gains on general benchmarks (15.9\% on V$\star$Bench, 88.9\% on BLINK), indicating that the proposed adaptation does not necessarily compromise general VLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Metric-Bench基准与MetricReasoner微调方法，利用图中已知物理尺寸的参考物体，让VLM无需相机内参隐式学习2D到3D度量映射，并通过可验证数值奖励的强化微调提升度量空间推理，同时保持通用多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在具身AI（机器人操作、自主导航）中需要度量推理，但现有空间推理依赖刚性像素级监督，这种局部优化会损害通用多模态智能，导致性能退化或灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 1）构建Metric-Bench基准，在图像中引入已知物理尺寸的参考物体，引导模型利用上下文隐式学习2D-to-3D映射，无需相机内参；2）提出MetricReasoner，一种面向参考物度量推理的任务自适应强化微调方案，使用结构化提示与可验证的数值奖励。
AI.result: 在Metric-Bench上显著增强空间度量理解，比现有及更大规模专有模型高43.1%；在具身下游任务上，相比空间专用模型，RoboSpatial总体准确率高30.4%，ERQA高9.3%；通用基准也有持续提升：V⋆Bench高15.9%，BLINK高88.9%。
AI.conclusion: 所提适配方法在提升度量空间推理与具身性能的同时，并不必然牺牲VLM通用能力，为空间度量推理提供了参考物驱动、可验证奖励的强化微调范式。

5bffbba107aa5a72ccbaa4c047e152634a062ae4.title: MatcherCompass: A Deployment-Aware Benchmark to Guide Image Matcher Selection in the Wild
5bffbba107aa5a72ccbaa4c047e152634a062ae4.summary:
Field robots operating across time of day and sensing modalities require accurate image correspondences within onboard time and resource budgets. However, accuracy and runtime reported for individual methods on a single device provide limited guidance for choosing a matcher and its configuration on a target platform. We present MatcherCompass, a deployment-aware benchmark for choosing local feature matchers in field robotics. Under common input and pose-evaluation procedures, we compare nine classical and learned matching pipelines across four image resolutions and supported numerical precisions. Four visual conditions cover viewpoint variation, day--night matching in visible and thermal imagery, and daytime visible--thermal matching. We evaluate pose accuracy using the area under the error--recall curve (AUC) at $5^\circ$, $10^\circ$, and $20^\circ$, and measure runtime, GPU memory, and energy per image pair on four GPU platforms spanning workstation and onboard computers. The results show that changes in hardware, input resolution, and numerical precision can move a matcher across a runtime budget boundary, altering the feasible choices. We organize the measurements into a selection guide that returns all configurations satisfying user-specified time and resource limits, together with their accuracy under the selected visual condition. MatcherCompass provides measured evidence for choosing matching pipelines that fit a robot's sensing conditions and computing hardware.
  Project page: https://matchercompass.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MatcherCompass：面向野外机器人部署的局部特征匹配器基准测试，在统一输入与位姿评估流程下比较9种经典与学习型匹配流程，跨4种图像分辨率与多种数值精度、4类视觉条件、4个GPU平台，测量精度（AUC@5°/10°/20°）、运行时间、显存与能耗，并给出满足用户时间与资源约束的选型指南。
AI.motivation: 野外机器人需在不同时段与传感模态下获得准确图像对应，且受机载时间与资源预算限制；但现有单个方法在单一设备上报告的精度与运行时间，难以为在目标平台上选择匹配器及其配置提供有效指导，缺少部署感知的系统性评测证据。
AI.method: 构建部署感知基准：在统一输入与位姿评估流程下，对比9种经典与学习型匹配流程；覆盖4种图像分辨率与所支持的数值精度；设置4种视觉条件（视角变化、可见光与热成像的昼夜匹配、白天可见光—热成像匹配）；采用AUC@5°、10°、20°评估位姿精度，并在4个GPU平台（工作站与机载计算机）上测量每对图像的处理时间、显存占用与能耗。
AI.result: 硬件、输入分辨率与数值精度的变化可使匹配器跨越运行时间预算边界，从而改变可行配置集合；据此将测量结果组织为选型指南，可返回所有满足用户指定时间与资源限制的配置及其在选定视觉条件下的精度。
AI.conclusion: MatcherCompass为在机器人传感条件与计算硬件下选择合适的匹配流程提供了实测依据，强调部署感知的多维评测对匹配器选型的必要性。

91f4bad36f9c0f392eee13a249a58d38952ac51d.title: Fully Byzantine-Resilient Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
91f4bad36f9c0f392eee13a249a58d38952ac51d.summary: We study distributed Byzantine-resilient actor-critic multi-agent reinforcement learning (AC-MARL), where agents collectively learn policies through local interactions. Existing methods guarantee convergence of the agents' parameters only to a neighborhood of the attack-free limit points, resulting in degraded performance. We propose Fully Resilient AC-MARL (FRAC-MARL), a decentralized method in which each agent leverages redundancy in two-hop messages to identify reliable messages. Under linear parameterizations of the value and team-reward functions and Byzantine edge attacks, where adversarial behavior is confined to the communication layer, we prove that agents' parameters converge almost surely to the same limit points as in the attack-free case over time-varying communication graphs.
