We introduce a novel topological condition for the convergence of our method, present a systematic method to construct such networks, and prove that this condition can be verified in polynomial time. Finally, we demonstrate our method on cooperative multi-robot formation control tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文研究分布式拜占庭容错Actor-Critic多智能体强化学习，提出FRAC-MARL方法，利用两跳消息冗余识别可靠消息，在拜占庭边攻击下证明参数几乎必然收敛到无攻击情形相同的极限点，并给出拓扑条件与多项式时间验证方法，在合作多机器人编队控制任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式Actor-Critic多智能体强化学习方法在拜占庭攻击下只能保证参数收敛到无攻击极限点附近的邻域，导致性能下降；需要实现完全容错，使学习结果不受通信层攻击影响。
AI.method: 提出FRAC-MARL去中心化方法：每个智能体利用两跳消息中的冗余信息识别可靠消息。在价值和团队奖励函数线性参数化、拜占庭边攻击且攻击局限于通信层的设定下，分析时变通信图上的收敛性；引入新的拓扑条件以保证收敛，给出构造满足该条件网络的系统方法，并证明该条件可在多项式时间内验证。
AI.result: 在拜占庭边攻击下，证明智能体参数几乎必然收敛到与无攻击情形相同的极限点，而非仅收敛到其邻域；给出可构造且可多项式时间验证的拓扑条件；在合作多机器人编队控制任务上验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: FRAC-MARL通过利用两跳消息冗余，在通信层拜占庭攻击下实现与无攻击情形一致的收敛性能，为分布式容错Actor-Critic多智能体强化学习提供了理论保证与可验证的网络设计条件。

e70efa1fc5a5fcad92f5ad112d05aa65bfb5dcc0.title: Toolcompass: Guiding Tool Trialing, Not Suppressing It
e70efa1fc5a5fcad92f5ad112d05aa65bfb5dcc0.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents must generalize from tools seen during training to unseen tools at deployment. A key challenge is tool trialing, i.e., excessive trials waste the interaction budget, whereas selective trials enable exploration of unfamiliar tools. Existing outcome-based post-training leaves wasteful trials unguided, while turn-level supervision may suppress necessary exploration. We introduce ToolCompass, a post-training framework that guides tool trialing by organizing tool-call representations according to shared functions. Specifically, ToolCompass models each function class as a von Mises--Fisher distribution and jointly reduces intra-function variation across domains and increases inter-function separation. This structure transfers experience from seen tools to functionally similar unseen tools, directing exploration away from unrelated alternatives. ToolCompass requires no ground-truth call traces or unseen-tool access and incurs no inference overhead. Experiments on AppWorld and FTRL show consistent gains across GRPO, RFT, and DMPO. improves AppWorld OOD task success by up to 10.71 percentage points over vanilla post-training and performs best among competitive baselines on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: ToolCompass 是一种后训练框架，通过按共享功能组织工具调用表示来引导工具试错：将每个功能类建模为 von Mises–Fisher 分布，并联合降低功能类内跨域差异、增大功能类间分离，从而把已见工具经验迁移到功能相似的未见工具，且无需真值调用轨迹或访问未见工具，也不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需要从训练时见过的工具泛化到部署时未见过的工具。核心挑战是工具试错：过度试验会浪费交互预算，而选择性试验有助于探索不熟悉的工具。现有基于结果的后训练对浪费性试验缺乏引导，回合级监督又可能抑制必要探索。
AI.method: ToolCompass 将每个功能类建模为 von Mises–Fisher 分布，并联合优化两个目标：减少同一功能类在不同域之间的类内差异，同时增大不同功能类之间的类间分离。该结构可将已见工具的经验迁移到功能相似的未见工具，引导探索远离无关替代工具。方法不需要 ground-truth 调用轨迹，也不需要访问未见工具，且不引入推理开销。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 FTRL 基准上，ToolCompass 在 GRPO、RFT 和 DMPO 上均取得一致提升；在 AppWorld OOD 任务成功率上，相较 vanilla post-training 最高提升 10.71 个百分点，并在两个基准上优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: ToolCompass 通过功能类表示结构引导工具试错，有效提升了 LLM 智能体对未见工具的 OOD 泛化能力，同时保持训练与推理成本友好，是一种无需额外监督和推理开销的后训练方案。

2e1a0d6de0a9dca5d6c3cd8ea4342e4cb39553a0.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
2e1a0d6de0a9dca5d6c3cd8ea4342e4cb39553a0.summary: Many vision applications ask several independent, forced-choice questions about the same image. Visual Jev encodes the image and public context once, executes isolated question suffixes as a batch, and reads candidate probabilities from the backbone's language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training raises equal-weight macro accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1%, with the gain concentrated on the two task families represented in training. At N=32 questions per image, shared batched execution is 8.9x faster in warm amortized time than independent serial execution and remains 3.4x faster than an already-batched baseline that recomputes the prefix, at the cost of higher peak memory. A matched typed-head control offers no consistent accuracy advantage over the language-model-head readout. The supported design is therefore simple: adapt the backbone for quality, retain the existing readout, and share execution for efficiency.

AI.tldr: Visual Jev 将同一图像的多个独立强制选择问题统一处理：图像与公共上下文只编码一次，各问题后缀以批处理方式执行，并直接复用主干语言模型头读取候选答案概率。通过答案监督后训练，四个基准上的等权宏平均准确率从 70.6% 提升到 76.1%，且提升集中在训练覆盖的两类任务；在每图 32 个问题时，共享批处理执行相比独立串行执行在热摊还时间上快 8.9 倍，相比已批处理但重算前缀的基线仍快 3.4 倍，代价是峰值内存更高。匹配的专用类型头对照未带来稳定准确率优势。结论是：适配主干以提升质量，保留现有读出方式，并通过共享执行提升效率。
AI.motivation: 许多视觉应用需要对同一图像提出多个相互独立的强制选择问题。若逐题独立编码与执行，会重复计算图像与公共上下文，造成推理效率低下；同时，是否必须引入专用任务头、以及后训练能否提升多问题视觉问答质量，仍需验证。论文因此关注在保持简单架构的前提下，同时改善多问题视觉任务的质量与执行效率。
AI.method: 提出 Visual Jev：对图像和公共上下文仅编码一次，将各问题对应的独立后缀作为批次执行，并直接从主干语言模型头读取候选概率。采用答案监督的后训练适配主干。与独立串行执行、已批处理但重算前缀的基线，以及匹配的专用类型头读出进行对照，在四个基准上评估准确率与效率。
AI.result: 答案监督后训练将等权宏平均准确率从 70.6% 提升至 76.1%，增益集中于训练中出现的两个任务族。每图 N=32 个问题时，共享批处理执行在热摊还时间上比独立串行执行快 8.9 倍，比重算前缀的已批处理基线快 3.4 倍，但峰值内存更高。匹配的专用类型头对照未显示出相对语言模型头读出的一致准确率优势。
AI.conclusion: 推荐的设计较为简单：通过后训练适配主干以提升质量，保留现有语言模型头读出，并共享执行以提升效率。专用类型头并非必要，且共享批处理在效率上优势显著，但需权衡峰值内存开销。

a660817c250746b4a895bd4c6c15af58642e3781.title: MotionForge: A Data Generation Pipeline and Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon Manipulation of Dynamic Objects with Domain Shifts
a660817c250746b4a895bd4c6c15af58642e3781.summary: Recent advances in learning-based robot policies have demonstrated promising progress, yet they are predom- inantly evaluated in static or quasi-static environments. In dynamic manipulation, objects and scenes continuously evolve while the robot perceives, reasons, and acts. However, recent dynamic simulation benchmarks largely focus on short-horizon, reactive interactions with simple motion patterns and offer limited support for both systematic evaluation under domain shifts and model-agnostic real-time execution protocols. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MotionForge, the first large- scale simulation benchmark and data-generation pipeline tailored to jointly evaluate domain shifts and long-horizon interaction in dynamic manipulation. MotionForge comprises 40 dynamic interaction tasks spanning 11 distinct motion patterns, with dedicated support for 17 long-horizon tasks. Our benchmark introduces two key novelties: (1) a systematic evaluation protocol for assessing policy robustness under both single-factor (e.g., only backgrounds shift) and joint domain shifts (e.g., simultaneous shifts of objects, backgrounds, lighting, and speed); and (2) a decoupled, latency-aware execution protocol where the environ- ment continuously evolves independently of policy inference time. Extensive evaluations of representative general-purpose robot policies on our benchmark reveal substantial limitations under joint domain shifts. These findings expose a critical gap between current policy capabilities and the requirements of robust long- horizon manipulation of dynamic objects under domain shifts, establishing MotionForge as a comprehensive testbed for future research in embodied AI.

AI.tldr: MotionForge：首个面向动态操作的大规模仿真基准与数据生成管线，联合评估域偏移与长时程交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的机器人策略多在静态或准静态环境中评估，而动态操作中物体与场景在机器人感知、推理、行动的同时持续演化。当前动态仿真基准多聚焦短时程、反应式交互，运动模式简单，且缺乏对域偏移下系统评估及模型无关实时执行协议的支持。
AI.method: 提出MotionForge仿真基准与数据生成管线，包含40个动态交互任务、覆盖11种运动模式，并专门支持17个长时程任务。引入两项关键创新：(1) 系统化评估协议，评估策略在单因子（如仅背景偏移）与联合域偏移（如物体、背景、光照与速度同时偏移）下的鲁棒性；(2) 解耦的、延迟感知的执行协议，使环境独立于策略推理时间持续演化。
AI.result: 对代表性通用机器人策略进行广泛评估，结果显示在联合域偏移下存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前策略能力与在域偏移下对动态物体进行鲁棒长时程操作所需能力之间的关键差距，确立MotionForge作为具身智能未来研究的综合测试平台。

bb7d1b747e3a396ee35e72fddc9c04fc33cbfd59.title: Slow Decay and Silenced Expression: Iterated Subliminal Trait Transfer in Language-Model Lineages
bb7d1b747e3a396ee35e72fddc9c04fc33cbfd59.comment: 7 pages plus appendix. Extended version with additional experiments to follow
bb7d1b747e3a396ee35e72fddc9c04fc33cbfd59.summary: Language models are increasingly trained on the outputs of other models, forming chains that we call lineages, in which a trait present in one generation can pass to the next. Prior work on subliminal learning has shown that a teacher's trait can transmit to a student through filtered data carrying none of the trait's content. However, the evidence covers only a single training step. We study whether such a trait holds or fades across lineages. We instill the trait into three copies of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and iterate the training step to depth ten from each, reading every generation two ways on the same held-out prompts: a keyword screen that looks for expressions of the trait in the model's output, and an activation probe that projects each model's displacement from the base onto a direction built from the other lineages' teachers. We report two findings. First, the trait persists through ten generations across three lineages. The instilled models express it on every completion; the keyword-screen rate falls to 55.6% after the first step and to 21.1% by generation ten. The base itself matches the screen on none of its 300 completions. Second, the trait can be present internally while absent behaviorally. When the model's default system prompt is removed at evaluation, the generation-ten students' keyword-screen rate is zero on every prompt while the probe score stays positive on every prompt. Steering the untreated base with the displacement of a generation-ten student, which is trained and measured under the default system prompt, induces screened expression of the trait even with the system prompt removed, while that same student shows no expression of the trait with the system prompt removed.

AI.tldr: 论文研究“阈下学习”中的特征能否跨模型谱系多代传递：将同一特征注入三个 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 副本并迭代训练至第 10 代，发现特征在三个谱系中持续存在，但行为表达逐步衰减；同时特征可“内部存在而行为不显”，且用第 10 代学生的激活位移对基座进行 steering 可诱导出被筛选到的行为表达。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地使用其他模型的输出进行训练，形成“谱系”（lineages），其中某一代模型携带的特征可能传递给下一代。已有“阈下学习”（subliminal learning）工作表明，教师模型的特征可通过不含该特征内容的过滤数据传递给学生，但证据仅覆盖单次训练步骤，尚不清楚这种特征在跨代谱系中会保持还是衰减。
AI.method: 将目标特征注入三个 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 副本，并从每个副本出发将训练步骤迭代至深度 10 代。对每一代模型，在同一组 held-out prompts 上用两种方式读取特征：一是关键词筛选（keyword screen），检测模型输出中是否出现该特征的表达；二是激活探针（activation probe），将每个模型相对基座的位移投影到由其他谱系教师构建的方向上。此外还进行两项评估：移除默认 system prompt 后重新测量第 10 代学生；以及用第 10 代学生在默认 system prompt 下测得的位移，对未处理的基座模型进行 steering。
AI.result: 第一，特征在三个谱系、十代传递中持续存在，但行为表达下降：被注入的模型在每次 completion 上都表达该特征，关键词筛选率在第一步后降至 55.6%，到第 10 代降至 21.1%；基座模型在 300 个 completion 中筛选匹配为 0。第二，特征可以内部存在而行为缺失：在评估时移除默认 system prompt 后，第 10 代学生在每个 prompt 上的关键词筛选率均为 0，而激活探针分数在每个 prompt 上仍为正。进一步，用第 10 代学生（在默认 system prompt 下训练和测量）的位移去 steering 未处理的基座，即使在移除 system prompt 的情况下也能诱导出可被关键词筛选到的特征表达；而同一学生在移除 system prompt 时并无该特征表达。
AI.conclusion: 阈下特征并非只在单步训练中有效，而可在模型谱系中跨十代持续存在，但其可观察行为表达会随代际衰减，并受 system prompt 等评估条件显著影响。激活探针能够揭示行为上不可见的内部痕迹，且该内部位移具有因果作用，可对基座模型 steering 并诱导出行为表达。因此，评估模型谱系中的阈下传递时，需要区分内部表征与行为读出，并考虑提示条件对特征显隐的影响。

d9b5c15e8c09858e6f0e4271edd04354873e3595.title: How Strongly Should Task State Influence an LLM Agent?
d9b5c15e8c09858e6f0e4271edd04354873e3595.summary: Long-horizon assigned work requires an LLM agent to track the state of a task: which steps are done, blocked, cancelled, or open to repetition. Agent systems either keep this state as text in the prompt and rely on the model to read that text, or move the state into a module that enforces it, and each system is evaluated as a whole, so no one knows how much reliability comes from the state being shown, told, or enforced. We fix the task rules, the model, and paired episodes and vary how strongly task state reaches the agent: a raw transcript, an exact checklist, per-turn directives from a state machine compiled from the brief and advanced only by execution receipts, or an enforcement gate on that machine that refuses state-violating actions; every episode is scored by exact payload matching against dynamic ground truth. Across three models, two reasoning regimes, and two domains, four findings hold without per-turn reasoning: displaying accurate state is unreliable, an unverified ledger the agent writes itself beats an accurate checklist it is shown, directives help in proportion to the model's obedience, and enforcement needs no obedience but is bounded by the correctness of its state and by the matcher that maps requests to steps; per-turn reasoning at a 235B agent compresses these separations without repairing the text rungs. The same gate, compiled from $τ^2$-bench's airline policy, raises a 235B agent's pass$^1$ from 0.39 to 0.54 and changes nothing for a 35B agent that rarely violates the policy; on PM-Bench, where acting turns on recognizing a cue rather than on state, showing the record is the best rung--matching or beating both gates and reversing the ledger-over-checklist finding--and enforcing the matcher's judgement drops a 35B agent below its raw transcript. Enforcement pays when failures are state-decidable and frequent, and hurts when the gate's judgement is wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文通过固定任务规则、模型和配对回合，仅改变“任务状态如何到达智能体”（原始记录、精确清单、状态机逐轮指令、强制门控），系统评估长时程任务中状态“展示、告知、执行”对可靠性的贡献。结论是：没有逐轮推理时，准确展示状态不可靠；强制门控仅在失败可由状态判定且频繁发生时收益显著，否则可能有害。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务要求 LLM 智能体跟踪任务状态（已完成、阻塞、取消、可重复等）。现有系统要么把状态作为提示文本让模型自行读取，要么将状态移入模块强制执行，但整体评估导致无法区分可靠性究竟来自“展示状态”“告知状态”还是“强制执行状态”。因此需要解耦并量化状态传递强度的影响。
AI.method: 固定任务规则、模型与配对回合，仅改变任务状态到达智能体的强度：1）原始对话记录；2）精确检查清单；3）由任务简报编译、仅由执行回执推进的状态机逐轮指令；4）在上述状态机上增加拒绝违反状态动作的强制门控。每个回合用动态真值进行精确 payload 匹配评分。实验覆盖三个模型、两种推理机制、两个领域，并进一步在 τ²-bench 航空政策和 PM-Bench 上验证。
AI.result: 无逐轮推理时有四项稳定发现：准确展示状态并不可靠；智能体自行写入的未验证账本优于向其展示的准确清单；逐轮指令的收益与模型服从性成正比；强制门控无需服从性，但其效果受限于状态正确性和“请求→步骤”匹配器的正确性。235B 智能体的逐轮推理压缩了这些分离，但未修复文本层级。同一门控在 τ²-bench 航空政策上将 235B 智能体的 pass^1 从 0.39 提升到 0.54，对很少违反政策的 35B 智能体无变化；在 PM-Bench 上，由于行动依赖识别线索而非状态，展示记录成为最佳层级，匹配或超过两种门控，并逆转“账本优于清单”的发现；执行匹配器判断使 35B 智能体低于原始记录。
AI.conclusion: 强制执行并非普遍更优：当失败可由状态判定且频繁发生时，门控有收益；当门控判断错误时，强制执行会造成伤害。状态传递机制的效果取决于任务结构、模型服从性与匹配器可靠性。

531d820fc5e4baa6e0480546d47613eb213033ad.title: Less Is More in the Long Tail: Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection for Annotation-Efficient Dense Prediction
531d820fc5e4baa6e0480546d47613eb213033ad.summary: Deep learning performance generally improves with increasing training data, yet this scaling is fundamentally constrained by annotation cost in large-scale dense prediction tasks with long-tailed category distributions, where pixel- or voxel-level annotation is prohibitively expensive. We propose SASS (Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection), a stage-adaptive data-selection framework for pool-based active learning in long-tailed dense prediction. SASS combines three components: label-free self-supervised gradient scoring, prior-guided category rebalancing with validation-driven feedback, and stage-adaptive acquisition aligned with model training dynamics. This design avoids candidate ground-truth masks during gradient scoring while making acquisition responsive to long-tail imbalance and evolving representations. We evaluate SASS on a multimodal 3D medical segmentation testbed comprising over 100,000 samples spanning 108 anatomical structures. SASS recovers 98.3% of full-dataset performance with a 40% training-pool annotation budget, outperforming BADGE by 5.1 percentage points. Moreover, SASS exhibits a statistically supported less-is-more pattern, surpassing full-dataset training at the Hard-group level and, at the structure level, for the pancreas and gallbladder. More broadly, SASS shows that annotation-efficient learning depends not only on which samples are selected, but also on how the annotation budget is distributed across categories and when model-derived scores begin to guide selection.

AI.tldr: 提出SASS（阶段自适应样本选择）框架，用于长尾密集预测的池式主动学习，通过无标签自监督梯度评分、先验引导类别重平衡与验证反馈、阶段自适应采集，在超10万样本、108类解剖结构的3D医学分割任务上，以40%标注预算恢复98.3%全量性能，并优于BADGE 5.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 深度学习性能随训练数据增加而提升，但在长尾类别分布的密集预测任务中，像素/体素级标注成本极高，成为扩展瓶颈。现有主动学习方法在长尾密集预测中面临候选真值掩码依赖、类别不平衡和训练动态变化等挑战。
AI.method: SASS框架包含三部分：1）无标签自监督梯度评分，避免梯度评分时使用候选真值掩码；2）先验引导的类别重平衡，并结合验证驱动反馈；3）与模型训练动态对齐的阶段自适应采集策略。整体用于池式主动学习中的样本选择，使采集过程能响应长尾不平衡与表征演化。
AI.result: 在多模态3D医学分割测试平台上评估，数据超过100,000个样本、覆盖108个解剖结构。SASS在仅使用40%训练池标注预算时恢复98.3%的全数据集性能，比BADGE高出5.1个百分点；并呈现统计支持的“less-is-more”现象，在Hard组水平以及结构水平上对胰腺和胆囊超过全数据集训练。
AI.conclusion: 标注高效学习不仅取决于选择哪些样本，还取决于标注预算如何在类别间分配，以及模型衍生评分何时开始指导选择。SASS为长尾密集预测中的主动学习提供了阶段自适应、类别感知且不依赖候选真值的解决方案。

f82e817f53514c2bdf421dbdc4cb2e05313e7ebf.title: Induced Riemannian Metrics for Motion Planning with Constraints
f82e817f53514c2bdf421dbdc4cb2e05313e7ebf.summary: In constrained motion planning problems, task and loop-closure constraints restrict a robot's motion to a curved, lower-dimensional submanifold of its configuration space. Planners measure path length with a metric, which sets the cost of moving in each direction. Under the Euclidean metric, this cost is the same everywhere, whereas under a general Riemannian metric, such as the kinetic-energy metric, the cost can vary with direction and configuration. Existing methods often describe the submanifold either implicitly, as a constraint level set, or explicitly, through a parameterization. The implicit representation is typically combined with the Euclidean metric of the configuration space, and the explicit representation with the parameter domain, so the path length that a planner minimizes depends on the representation. Instead, we measure path length with the induced metric, which the submanifold inherits from a Riemannian metric on the configuration space. The implicit and explicit representations yield the same induced metric, expressed in different coordinates, and hence the same geometry. This result holds for any Riemannian metric on the configuration space, not only the Euclidean one. The choice of metric is therefore independent of the choice of representation. Using this result, we extend planning under a Riemannian metric from unconstrained spaces to constraint submanifolds by applying the induced metric in both a sampling-based planner and a trajectory optimizer. For an explicit representation, the induced metric also accounts for the distortion that the parameterization introduces. In experiments on a bimanual manipulation setup with two Franka arms under end-effector task constraints, we compare the Euclidean and kinetic-energy metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文研究约束运动规划中的路径长度度量问题，提出用子流形从配置空间黎曼度量继承的诱导度量来度量路径长度；证明隐式约束水平集与显式参数化给出同一诱导度量，因而度量选择独立于表示；并将该结果用于采样规划器和轨迹优化器，在双臂Franka任务约束实验中比较欧氏度量与动能度量。
AI.motivation: 在受任务约束和闭环约束限制的运动规划中，机器人运动被限制在配置空间的低维弯曲子流形上。现有方法中，隐式表示通常结合配置空间的欧氏度量，显式表示通常结合参数域度量，导致规划器最小化的路径长度依赖于子流形的表示方式，缺乏表示无关的几何定义。
AI.method: 将约束子流形视为配置空间中的低维子流形，采用其从配置空间黎曼度量继承的诱导度量来度量路径长度。理论上证明隐式约束水平集表示与显式参数化表示在不同坐标下诱导出相同度量，从而具有相同几何，且该结论对任意配置空间黎曼度量成立。基于此，将该诱导度量分别应用于采样规划器和轨迹优化器，将黎曼度量规划从无约束空间推广到约束子流形；对于显式表示，诱导度量还补偿参数化引入的畸变。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，隐式与显式表示诱导相同度量，路径长度的几何不依赖于表示选择，度量选择可与表示选择解耦。实验在双臂Franka机械臂、末端执行器任务约束的双臂操作设置中进行，比较欧氏度量与动能度量。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 诱导度量为约束运动规划提供了表示无关的路径长度定义，使黎曼度量下的规划可自然扩展到约束子流形，并统一适用于采样规划与轨迹优化。实验设置用于比较欧氏度量与动能度量在约束操作任务中的表现。

bad5e202757b129105729ad5e62c59499438a416.title: Signed Graph Pre-Training and Prompt Learning
bad5e202757b129105729ad5e62c59499438a416.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, Accepted to Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
bad5e202757b129105729ad5e62c59499438a416.summary: Signed graphs arise in trust--distrust networks, financial correlation systems, biological interaction graphs, and many other domains in which edges can be positive or negative and may also be directed. While signed graph neural networks have improved task-specific learning, graph transfer learning on signed graphs remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce TopoSIGN, a pioneer topology-guided graph pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs. TopoSIGN combines a structural encoder built on the magnetic signed Laplacian with a novel persistent-homology branch that summarizes signed topology through Dowker-complex persistence images. The fused embeddings are then transferred to a prompt learning function. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the efficacy of TopoSIGN in extracting useful structural information in signed graphs, as well as the adaptability and flexibility of the proposed general framework.

AI.tldr: 提出TopoSIGN——首个面向符号图的拓扑引导图预训练与提示学习框架，结合磁符号拉普拉斯结构编码器与基于Dowker复形持续同调的拓扑分支，实现符号图上的迁移学习。
AI.motivation: 符号图广泛存在于信任-不信任网络、金融相关系统、生物交互图等领域，其边可正可负且可有向。现有符号图神经网络虽提升了特定任务的学习效果，但符号图上的图迁移学习仍发展不足，缺乏通用的预训练与提示学习框架。
AI.method: TopoSIGN由三部分构成：(1) 基于磁符号拉普拉斯（magnetic signed Laplacian）的结构编码器；(2) 新颖的持续同调（persistent homology）分支，通过Dowker复形的持续图像（Dowker-complex persistence images）刻画符号拓扑；(3) 将融合后的嵌入输入到提示学习（prompt learning）函数中，从而实现跨任务的迁移。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TopoSIGN能够有效提取符号图中的有用结构信息，并验证了所提出通用框架的可适配性与灵活性。
AI.conclusion: TopoSIGN作为面向符号图的先驱性拓扑引导预训练与提示学习框架，弥合了符号图表示学习中迁移能力的空白，展示了拓扑信息融合在符号图通用建模上的潜力。

fab3ce95932e5c2b9ab895f8f1406f71facf2dc2.title: TCMaster: Confidence-Aware Querying and Workload-Guided Physical Design for Multi-Source Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge Graphs
fab3ce95932e5c2b9ab895f8f1406f71facf2dc2.summary: Multi-source knowledge graphs (KGs) need query mechanisms that expose reliability and exploit domain structure. This paper presents TCMaster, a property-graph query substrate for confidence-aware traversal and workload-guided physical design over Traditional Chinese Medicine KGs. TCMaster integrates pharmacopoeias, prescriptions, molecular databases, and LLM-extracted micro-semantics into a KG with approximately 221K entities and 723K base edges. It annotates edges with provenance-level confidence, rewrites Cypher queries with confidence predicates, ranks multi-hop paths under PRODUCT, MIN, or weighted-average policies, and uses ontology skew through direction selection, herb-attribute bitmaps, and materialized shortcut edges. On Neo4j, direction selection improves attribute lookup by a factor of 1.47, shortcuts accelerate high-fanout target counting by a factor of 4.42, confidence filtering removes 39.3 percent of low-quality heterogeneous paths, and KG retrieval improves TCMbench QA accuracy by 20.0 percentage points.

AI.tldr: TCMaster 是一个面向中医药多源知识图谱的属性图查询底座，支持置信度感知遍历与工作负载驱动的物理设计，在 Neo4j 上通过方向选择、捷径边与置信度过滤显著提升查询与问答性能。
AI.motivation: 多源知识图谱需要既能暴露数据可靠性、又能利用领域结构特点的查询机制，而现有查询方式难以同时兼顾置信度语义与本体偏斜带来的物理设计优化。
AI.method: 构建 TCMaster 属性图查询底座，融合药典、方剂、分子数据库与 LLM 抽取的微观语义，形成约 221K 实体、723K 基础边的中医药知识图谱；为边标注来源级置信度，将 Cypher 查询重写为带置信度谓词的形式，支持 PRODUCT、MIN、加权平均三种策略的多跳路径排序；并通过方向选择、药材属性位图与物化捷径边利用本体偏斜进行物理设计。
AI.result: 在 Neo4j 上，方向选择使属性查找提升 1.47 倍，捷径边使高扇出目标计数加速 4.42 倍，置信度过滤剔除 39.3% 的低质量异质路径，图谱检索使 TCMbench 问答准确率提升 20.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TCMaster 验证了置信度感知遍历与工作负载引导的物理设计相结合，可在多源中医药知识图谱上同时提升查询效率、数据可靠性与下游问答效果。

0478d3ac5c1b6f2659b84d26257e789354c2e422.title: MatchFusion: Explicit-Implicit Instance Matching for Spatio-Temporal Multimodal Autonomous Driving
0478d3ac5c1b6f2659b84d26257e789354c2e422.summary: Sparse instance representations provide a compact interface for spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction in multimodal perception and E2EAD. Effective interaction requires reliable instance correspondences despite geometric discrepancies and heterogeneous semantic representations. Attention-based methods exploit contextual semantics but often require specialized representation alignment, increasing computational overhead. In contrast, association based on structured object states is efficient and interpretable but lacks contextual evidence to resolve ambiguous matches. To combine these complementary strengths, we propose MatchFusion, a learnable instance matching and fusion module for spatio-temporal multimodal autonomous driving. MatchFusion initializes pairwise affinities using geometric similarity and category consistency, then selectively refines structurally plausible associations using instance embeddings. The resulting soft matchmap guides a common residual aggregation operator for adaptive information exchange. This unified matching-fusion formulation supports spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction, using multi-view image-plane geometry and motion-compensated BEV geometry as the respective structural priors. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate consistent perception gains across diverse front-end configurations. Compared with a prior instance-centric fusion method, the MatchFusion-equipped system achieves higher perception accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55.3% and GPU memory usage by 39.3%, with the matching-fusion module accounting for only 3.7% of total perception latency. Integrating temporal MatchFusion into SparseDrive further improves perception within an E2E framework without additional supervision. These results establish explicit-implicit matching as an effective and efficient mechanism for spatio-temporal instance interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 MatchFusion：一种可学习的实例匹配与融合模块，用于时空多模态自动驾驶中的稀疏实例交互。它结合几何/类别先验与实例嵌入，统一支持空间 LiDAR-相机和时间 past-current 交互，在 nuScenes 上取得一致感知增益，并显著降低 FLOPs 与显存占用。
AI.motivation: 稀疏实例表示可为 LiDAR-相机空间交互和 past-current 时间交互提供紧凑接口，但可靠实例对应受几何差异与异构语义表示影响。注意力方法能利用上下文语义，却常需专门表示对齐，计算开销大；基于结构化目标状态的关联高效可解释，却缺乏上下文证据以消解歧义匹配。因此需要兼顾二者优势。
AI.method: MatchFusion 先用几何相似性和类别一致性初始化成对亲和度，再利用实例嵌入对结构上合理的关联进行选择性细化，生成软匹配图 soft matchmap，并以此指导统一的残差聚合算子实现自适应信息交换。该匹配-融合统一公式支持空间 LiDAR-相机与时间 past-current 交互，分别采用多视角图像平面几何和运动补偿 BEV 几何作为结构先验。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 上，MatchFusion 在多种前端配置下均带来一致感知增益。相比先前实例中心融合方法，搭载 MatchFusion 的系统感知精度更高，同时 FLOPs 降低 55.3%，GPU 显存占用降低 39.3%，匹配-融合模块仅占总感知延迟的 3.7%。将时间 MatchFusion 集成到 SparseDrive 后，可在无额外监督下提升 E2E 框架内的感知性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式-隐式匹配是进行时空实例交互的一种高效且有效的机制，能够统一空间与时间多模态融合并兼顾性能、效率与可解释性。

c61c0bb81340cdfa601821e66660d94db579989d.title: The Cartesian Hand: In-Hand Manipulation with All-Linear Fingers
c61c0bb81340cdfa601821e66660d94db579989d.summary: Robotic manipulation has increasingly pursued human-like dexterous hands with many articulated degrees of freedom, offering rich manipulation capabilities at the cost of mechanical and control complexity. At the other extreme, parallel grippers are simple and robust, but provide little ability to manipulate an object after grasping it. Operating articulated objects such as threaded containers, manufacturing tools, and laboratory instruments often requires a second gripper, an external fixture, or coordinated arm motion. We introduce the Cartesian Hand, a 7-DoF end-effector that rethinks dexterous manipulation by combining independent grasping and relative manipulation within a single end-effector using only linear motion. Two independently actuated parallel grippers hold different parts of an object, while four translating fingertips generate relative motion between the grasped parts. Its configuration-independent fingertip kinematics allow manipulation to be composed from simple linear motion primitives. The Cartesian Hand is particularly suited to objects structured around common mechanisms such as threads, pivots, linear guides, plungers, and triggers. We demonstrate cap opening and closing, pipetting, pumping, two-handle manipulation, screwdriving, trigger actuation, and in-grasp reorientation across 35 objects spanning laboratory, manufacturing, and household settings. The same manipulation procedures transfer from a fixed-base robot arm to a humanoid, where we demonstrate bimanual laboratory manipulation using two Cartesian Hands. These results show that versatile in-hand manipulation capability can emerge from a mechanically simple architecture when independent grasping and relative motion are designed directly into the end-effector. We will open-source all software and hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cartesian Hand——一种 7 自由度末端执行器，通过两个独立驱动的平行夹爪与四个平移指尖，将独立抓取与相对操作集成于单一末端，仅靠线性运动实现丰富的手内操作能力。
AI.motivation: 机器手在拟人灵巧手（多关节、高复杂度）与平行夹爪（简单稳健但抓取后难以操作物体）之间存在两难。操作螺纹容器、工具、实验仪器等关节式物体往往需要第二个夹爪、外部夹具或手臂协同运动，缺少一种机械简单却能完成相对操作的单末端方案。
AI.method: 设计 7-DoF 末端执行器 Cartesian Hand。其两个独立驱动的平行夹爪分别夹持物体的不同部分，四个可平移指尖在夹持部件之间产生相对运动。指尖运动学与构型无关，使操作可由简单线性运动基元组合而成，特别适配螺纹、枢轴、直线导轨、柱塞、扳机等常见机构构成的物体。
AI.result: 在涵盖实验室、制造与家庭场景的 35 个物体上演示了开合瓶盖、移液、泵送、双手柄操作、拧螺丝、扳机驱动与手内重定向。同一操作流程可从固定基座机械臂迁移到人形机器人，并用人形搭载两个 Cartesian Hand 完成双臂实验室操作。全部软硬件将开源，网址 https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1。
AI.conclusion: 当独立抓取与相对运动被直接设计进末端执行器时，机械结构简单的架构也能涌现出多功能的在手操作能力，为灵巧操作提供了一条兼顾简洁性与通用性的新路径。

ec08ab7314a93f73d262f8f049fd70d76131731e.title: Self-Supervised Combinatorial Optimization with Constraints via Frank-Wolfe
ec08ab7314a93f73d262f8f049fd70d76131731e.summary: Self-supervised learning for combinatorial optimization has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving discrete optimization problems with neural networks, but a central challenge remains: handling hard combinatorial constraints within continuous, gradient-based training. Continuously extending combinatorial objectives to convex domains is a powerful technique, yet existing approaches often require projection steps that constrain neural network outputs to lie inside the feasible polytope and rely on ad-hoc and problem-specific constructions. We propose a general framework in which the neural network is allowed to predict arbitrary continuous vectors that could potentially lie outside of the feasible polytope. These predictions are then approximated by sparse convex combinations of feasible solutions using a geometric decomposition algorithm based on Frank--Wolfe methods and approximate Caratheodory results. This decomposition induces an a.e.-differentiable, self-supervised loss defined as the expected value of the discrete objective. The same procedure provides an automatic rounding guarantee at inference time. We demonstrate strong empirical performance across multiple combinatorial problems, including the Quadratic Assignment Problem, Maximum Coverage, and the Traveling Salesperson Problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通用自监督学习框架，用于求解组合优化问题：允许神经网络输出任意连续向量，再通过基于 Frank-Wolfe 与近似 Carathéodory 的几何分解，将其近似为可行解的稀疏凸组合，从而得到几乎处处可微的自监督损失，并在推理时自动获得舍入保证。
AI.motivation: 组合优化具有离散、硬约束特性，而神经网络训练依赖连续梯度优化，二者存在核心矛盾。现有将组合目标连续松弛到凸域的方法，通常需要投影步骤以强制网络输出位于可行多面体内，且依赖针对具体问题的临时构造，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 作者不再约束网络输出位于可行多面体内，而是允许其预测任意连续向量。随后使用基于 Frank-Wolfe 方法的几何分解算法，结合近似 Carathéodory 结果，将这些可能位于可行域外的预测近似表示为可行解的稀疏凸组合。该分解诱导出一个几乎处处可微的自监督损失，其定义为离散目标的期望值；同一过程在推理阶段还可提供自动舍入保证。
AI.result: 在多个组合优化任务上取得较强的实证性能，包括二次分配问题（Quadratic Assignment Problem）、最大覆盖问题（Maximum Coverage）和旅行商问题（Traveling Salesperson Problem）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种更通用的连续松弛与自监督训练范式，避免了对可行域投影和问题特定构造的依赖，同时统一了训练损失构造与推理舍入，为神经网络求解硬约束组合优化问题提供了可扩展框架。

3eec09d04b15352baac4911110d6b47f798ca6b8.title: LingLan: An Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Diagnosis LLM with Multimodal Data
3eec09d04b15352baac4911110d6b47f798ca6b8.summary: Though artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms modern medicine, its integration into Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has been relatively slow, primarily due to TCM's reliance on holistic, subjective diagnostic methods---namely Inspection, Auscultation and Olfaction, Inquiry, and Palpation(I-AOI-P)---which are difficult to align with quantitative, standardized medical systems. In this work, we introduce a Unification Framework for Multimodal Data (UFMD), which automatically processes tongue and pulse images into structured, clinically standard descriptions, integrating multi-source diagnostic information into a unified digital record of I-AOI-P process. Building on this structured data, we create LingLan-14B, a TCM-specific large language model fine-tuned via supervised learning to emulate the diagnostic logic and workflow of I-AOI-P process. Experimental results show that our method significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy, achieving a relative improvement of 103.5% over the baseline (62.72% vs. 30.82%) and reaching an F1-score of up to 82%.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对中医（TCM）四诊（望闻问切，I-AOI-P）难以量化、标准化的问题，提出多模态数据统一框架（UFMD），将舌象与脉象图像自动转化为结构化临床标准描述，并构建中医专用大语言模型 LingLan-14B，以模拟四诊诊断逻辑与流程。
AI.motivation: 人工智能在现代医学中应用广泛，但在中医领域整合较慢，核心障碍是中医依赖整体性、主观性的四诊方法，难以与定量、标准化的医学体系对接。
AI.method: 提出面向多模态数据的统一框架 UFMD，自动处理舌象和脉象图像，生成结构化、符合临床标准的描述，并将多源诊断信息整合为统一的 I-AOI-P 数字化记录；在该结构化数据基础上，通过监督学习微调构建中医专用大语言模型 LingLan-14B，以模拟四诊诊断逻辑与工作流程。
AI.result: 实验结果显示诊断准确率显著提升：相较基线相对提升 103.5%（62.72% vs. 30.82%），F1 分数最高达到 82%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过多模态统一建模与中医专用大模型微调，有效缓解了中医诊断主观化、难以标准化的问题，为中医四诊信息的结构化、数字化与智能化诊断提供了可行路径。

e40e669e56ac86278532b67a066d01dc432944f6.title: Delving into Asymmetric Information Dynamics for High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
e40e669e56ac86278532b67a066d01dc432944f6.summary: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires precise pixel-level fidelity, yet mainstream Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) often suffer from texture degradation and structural drift. We identify symmetric interactions in standard joint-attention mechanisms as a source of these failures. Although such interactions support semantic flexibility in general-purpose editing, they allow stochastic noise to corrupt deterministic garment features in VTON. We analyze this problem through asymmetric information dynamics and introduce two diagnostic indicators: Conditional Attention Entropy (CAE) for feature unbiasedness and Injected Information Flux (IIF) for injection effectiveness. Our analysis suggests that symmetric bidirectional attention can corrupt conditional features and attenuate the conditional signal. To address these limitations, we propose RealFit, a framework that combines Unidirectional Information Flow (UIF) with Decoupled Timestep Modulation (DTM). UIF isolates the garment condition from stochastic noise to preserve garment identity, while DTM optimizes the modulation scale to maintain a strong conditional signal. The resulting time-invariant condition branch enables a conditional KV cache that reduces inference time by approximately 75%. RealFit offers a principled approach to conditional generation with state-of-the-art fidelity and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 RealFit，通过非对称信息流与解耦时间步调制解决 DiT 虚拟试衣中纹理退化和结构漂移问题，并实现约 75% 推理加速。
AI.motivation: 虚拟试衣（VTON）要求像素级高保真，但主流 Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）常出现纹理退化和结构漂移。作者将问题归因于标准联合注意力中的对称交互：该机制虽有利于通用编辑的语义灵活性，却使随机噪声污染确定性的服装特征。
AI.method: 从非对称信息动力学角度分析该问题，提出两个诊断指标：条件注意力熵（CAE）衡量特征无偏性，注入信息通量（IIF）衡量注入有效性。基于分析，提出 RealFit 框架，结合单向信息流（UIF）与解耦时间步调制（DTM）：UIF 将服装条件与随机噪声隔离以保持服装身份，DTM 优化调制尺度以维持强条件信号。
AI.result: RealFit 形成时间不变的条件分支，支持条件 KV 缓存，将推理时间减少约 75%；在保真度和效率上达到 state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: RealFit 为条件生成提供了一种有原则的方法，兼顾高保真与高效推理。

c4e90a6da9fa3135bffcbaa46fd82b3c515b58bd.title: Zephyron: Integrated Design and Analytical Evaluation of a Solar-Assisted Mobile Manipulator for Multimodal Environmental Reconnaissance and Distributed Visual Inference
c4e90a6da9fa3135bffcbaa46fd82b3c515b58bd.summary: Environmental reconnaissance needs mobile platforms that carry sensors, preserve measurement context, and return interpretable evidence under limited energy and communication. We present a literature-informed engineering design for Zephyron, a four-wheel rover with a front manipulator, environmental sensors, distributed computer vision, local recording, and a raised rear solar module. The design keeps the prototype layout but replaces unsupported numerical assumptions with an explicit component and geometry baseline. A reproducible search retrieved 5,000 records (4,858 unique) for screening, followed by targeted review of primary literature and manufacturer documentation. The baseline uses 165 mm wheels, a 12 kg mass budget, a 72 Wh battery-energy basis, and a 20 W photovoltaic module. With rolling-resistance coefficient 0.04, steady ascent of a 10 degree grade needs about 0.517 N m per wheel under equal load sharing. An illustrative 40 W motion load gives 1.44 h from 57.6 Wh usable energy, and a 25 percent driving duty gives 4.19 h without solar input; these are calculated scenarios, not measured performance. Sensor models show how integration time, calibration, temperature, and communication delay constrain interpretation, and a quality-aware stop-and-sample policy links these constraints to mission execution. Lightweight detectors, reference-based sensor learning, and executable data-integrity checks define a reproducible machine-learning evaluation pathway. The contribution is a traceable design and evaluation framework with editable 3D models, subsystem diagrams, and reproducible analytical data. Experimental validation is required before assigning payload, endurance, detection, or field-operating ratings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Zephyron 四轮环境侦察漫游车的文献驱动工程设计：用显式组件与几何基线替代无依据数值假设，给出爬坡/能量/续航计算、传感器解释约束和可复现机器学习评估路径；结论是形成可追溯设计评估框架，但仍需实验验证。
AI.motivation: 环境侦察移动平台需在有限能量与通信条件下携带传感器、保留测量上下文并返回可解释证据；现有原型设计常含未经验证的数值假设，缺少可追溯的组件与几何基线。
AI.method: 采用可复现文献检索，获得 5,000 条记录（4,858 条唯一）用于筛选，并定向审阅一次文献与厂商文档。建立显式设计基线：165 mm 车轮、12 kg 质量预算、72 Wh 电池能量基准、20 W 后置光伏模块。基于滚阻系数 0.04 计算稳态爬坡需求；构建传感器模型分析积分时间、标定、温度与通信延迟对解释的约束；提出质量感知的“停止—采样”策略；以轻量检测器、参考式传感器学习和可执行数据完整性检查定义可复现的机器学习评估路径。
AI.result: 在等载荷分配下，稳态爬升 10° 坡每轮约需 0.517 N·m；示例性 40 W 运动负载下，57.6 Wh 可用能量可支持 1.44 h；25% 驱动占空比且无太阳能输入时可支持 4.19 h。上述均为计算场景而非实测性能。成果包括可编辑 3D 模型、子系统图和可复现分析数据；未赋予载荷、续航、检测或野外操作额定值。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献是透明、可追溯的设计与评估框架，用于连接平台几何、能量预算、传感器约束和机器学习评估；在实验验证之前，不应据此分配载荷、续航、检测或野外运行评级。

4e19541fe2d58b803f90315836635b93f98ba4b2.title: Beyond Class Marginals: Bounding Rehearsal Gaps without Freezing Class Co-occurrence
4e19541fe2d58b803f90315836635b93f98ba4b2.summary: Class-balanced replay controls class frequency but does not determine the interval between successive replay appearances of a class. We study this interval, the rehearsal gap, separately from the class marginal and class co-occurrence, and introduce randomised-pass replay (RPR), which visits each resident class once per shuffled pass. For a fixed set of C resident classes and replay batch size b less than or equal to C, RPR preserves the balanced time-averaged class marginal and bounds every gap by 2*ceil(C/b)-1; a churn-conditional bound applies while the resident set changes. The scheduler uses no future class information and adds no replay examples or forward passes. In a linear-head ER-ACE diagnostic, joint absence from the incoming and replay batches produces a one-sided classifier-bias gradient. Longer absence episodes are associated with larger negative bias displacement, and removing the incoming-loss mask attenuates the scheduling effect. In the primary ER-ACE experiments, RPR improves final average accuracy by 0.72-1.67 percentage points relative to independent class-balanced retrieval under reservoir storage, with positive effects also observed under balanced storage. Pretrained ViTs show positive effects on the tested LT10 streams with small replay batches, while matched larger-batch controls show no material effect. Fixed-cycle and reused-pass controls change more than one temporal statistic, so the experiments do not isolate rehearsal-gap length from all other forms of temporal dependence. The accuracy effects depend on the learner and operating regime.

AI.tldr: 论文将类平衡回放中“同一类相邻两次回放出现的时间间隔”（rehearsal gap）从类频率与类共现中解耦，提出 randomised-pass replay (RPR)：每轮 shuffled pass 访问每个常驻类一次。在 C 个常驻类、replay batch size b≤C 时，RPR 保持时间平均类边际平衡，并将 gap 上界限制为 2·ceil(C/b)−1，且不依赖未来类信息、不增加回放样本或前向传播。ER-ACE 实验中最终平均准确率相对独立类平衡检索提升 0.72–1.67 个百分点，但效果依赖学习器与运行区间。
AI.motivation: 类平衡回放通常只控制类的出现频率（class marginal），但不决定同一类连续两次被回放之间的时间间隔。该 rehearsal gap 可能独立影响遗忘与分类器偏置，因此需要将其与类频率、类共现分开研究。
AI.method: 提出 randomised-pass replay (RPR)：对固定 C 个常驻类，在每个 shuffled pass 中每个常驻类访问一次；当 replay batch size b≤C 时，保持平衡的时间平均类边际，并给出 gap 上界 2·ceil(C/b)−1，以及常驻类集合变化时的 churn-conditional bound。调度器不使用未来类信息，也不增加回放样本或前向传播。另用线性头 ER-ACE 诊断分析 incoming batch 与 replay batch 联合缺失时的单侧 classifier-bias gradient，并通过移除 incoming-loss mask 做机制消融。
AI.result: 线性头 ER-ACE 诊断中，更长的缺席 episode 与更大的负向 bias displacement 相关；移除 incoming-loss mask 会削弱调度效应。主 ER-ACE 实验中，在 reservoir storage 下，RPR 相比 independent class-balanced retrieval 将最终平均准确率提高 0.72–1.67 个百分点；balanced storage 下也有正向效果。预训练 ViT 在测试的 LT10 流、小 replay batch 下表现正向，但匹配的更大 batch 对照无实质效果。固定周期与 reused-pass 对照会同时改变多个时间统计量，因此实验未能将 rehearsal-gap 长度与其他时间依赖形式完全隔离。
AI.conclusion: RPR 将 rehearsal gap 作为独立于类边际与类共现的调度维度，并在部分持续学习设置中带来稳定但有限的准确率增益。其收益取决于学习器与运行区间；现有对照不能完全证明所有效果仅由 rehearsal-gap 长度导致，因此结论应限定为特定条件下的经验性改进。

b280e0b1b53670da9e879359d44b2294f791a4b7.title: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 Technical Report: Understanding the Physical World Across Modalities
b280e0b1b53670da9e879359d44b2294f791a4b7.summary: Omni-modal models have expanded multimodal interaction across vision, audio, speech, and language. However, their training is predominantly organized around semantic descriptions and general-purpose objectives, leaving physical attributes, interaction states, and causal mechanisms only partially specified. This gap is not simply a matter of modality coverage: adding more modalities does not by itself provide the supervision needed to connect observations with the physical structure of the world. We present OmniFysics-Nano-V2, a compact omni-modal model for physical-world perception and understanding. The model supports image, video, audio, speech, and text inputs within a shared reasoning framework, together with text and speech generation. To address the lack of explicit physical supervision, we construct a dual-branch physics-aware data pipeline that grounds salient objects in structured physical attributes and aligns visual changes with acoustic events, intermediate responses, and interaction outcomes. To address homogeneous training objectives, we curate reinforcement-learning prompts by reward diversity and adopt a two-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization curriculum that progresses from general task correctness to fine-grained physical perceptual reasoning. Experiments across multimodal, audio-visual, and physical reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed data and training strategy improves physical-world understanding while preserving broad omni-modal competence. The proposed model achieves leading result on 17 of 21 benchmarks against SOTA omni-modal models. By equipping AI systems with both omni-modal and physical-world perception capabilities, OmniFysics-Nano-V2 is poised to become a cornerstone of next-generation Physical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniFysics-Nano-V2，一个紧凑的全模态（omni-modal）模型，用于物理世界感知与理解。通过构建双分支物理感知数据管线并采用两阶段 GRPO 强化学习课程，模型在保留全模态通用能力的同时提升了物理世界理解能力，在21个基准中的17个上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型的训练主要围绕语义描述和通用目标组织，对物理属性、交互状态和因果机制仅做了部分刻画。作者指出这一缺口并非简单的模态覆盖问题：增加模态本身无法提供将观测与世界物理结构相连接的监督信号。因此需要显式的物理监督和更具针对性的训练目标。
AI.method: 1) 模型层面：OmniFysics-Nano-V2 支持图像、视频、音频、语音和文本输入，并共享统一推理框架，同时支持文本与语音生成。2) 数据层面：构建双分支物理感知数据管线，将显著物体锚定到结构化物理属性，并将视觉变化与声学事件、中间响应及交互结果对齐。3) 训练层面：按奖励多样性筛选强化学习提示，采用两阶段 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）课程，从通用任务正确性逐步过渡到细粒度物理感知推理。
AI.result: 在多模态、音视频及物理推理基准上，所提出的数据与训练策略在提升物理世界理解的同时保留了广泛的全模态能力。该模型在21个基准中的17个上相对 SOTA 全模态模型取得了领先结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时赋予 AI 系统全模态与物理世界感知能力，OmniFysics-Nano-V2 有望成为下一代 Physical AI 的基石。

1c08764bff312eb6e8a6cc084ea3229a7da488c2.title: BAS-OPD: Budget-Aware Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
1c08764bff312eb6e8a6cc084ea3229a7da488c2.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle with fine-grained visual perception when processing complete images, as critical evidence may only appear in local regions. On-policy self-distillation (OPD) enables transferring privileged visual knowledge from informative views to full-image policies, but querying the teacher for every rollout introduces substantial supervision costs. In this work, we propose BAS-OPD, a budget-aware selective OPD framework that allocates teacher supervision under limited query budgets. Instead of querying all rollouts, BAS-OPD selects informative samples while maintaining full-batch student generation. We explore random, uncertainty-based, and learned utility-based selection strategies, where the learned selector estimates query value from detached rollout statistics and online utility signals derived from student--teacher agreement and teacher confidence without additional student forward passes. BAS-OPD only changes training-time supervision allocation and preserves single-pass full-image inference. Experiments on fine-grained multimodal perception benchmarks demonstrate that BAS-OPD achieves strong performance while substantially reducing teacher supervision costs, highlighting the effectiveness of selective OPD under constrained budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BAS-OPD，一种预算感知的选择性在线策略自蒸馏框架，在有限教师查询预算下选择信息量高的 rollout 进行监督，同时保持全批次学生生成与单次全图推理，从而在细粒度多模态感知任务上以更低监督成本取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在处理完整图像时，细粒度视觉感知能力不足，关键证据往往仅出现在局部区域。在线策略自蒸馏（OPD）可将信息量更高的视图中的特权视觉知识迁移到全图策略，但对每次 rollout 都查询教师会带来高昂监督成本，因此需要在有限预算下进行选择性监督。
AI.method: 提出 BAS-OPD：预算感知的选择性 OPD 框架。其核心是在教师查询预算受限时，仅选择部分信息量高的样本进行教师监督，同时仍进行全批次学生生成。论文探索了随机选择、基于不确定性的选择以及基于学习效用函数的选择策略。其中学习型选择器利用分离的 rollout 统计量与在线效用信号估计查询价值，效用信号来自学生—教师一致性和教师置信度，且无需额外学生前向传播。BAS-OPD 仅改变训练阶段的监督分配，不改变推理流程，保留单次全图推理。
AI.result: 在细粒度多模态感知基准上，BAS-OPD 在显著降低教师监督成本的同时取得了较强性能，验证了在受限预算下选择性 OPD 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性在线策略自蒸馏可在有限教师查询预算下有效迁移特权视觉知识，兼顾细粒度多模态感知性能与监督效率；BAS-OPD 通过预算感知的样本选择实现了训练监督成本与模型性能之间的良好权衡，且不增加推理开销。

c5615266bd32987dc32268b6b9f8d3ce04a76dbd.title: Designing an Efficient Excavator Bucket for Lunar ISRU: A Comparative Study with Vision-Based Fill and Displacement Analysis
c5615266bd32987dc32268b6b9f8d3ce04a76dbd.comment: Accepted and presentaed at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
c5615266bd32987dc32268b6b9f8d3ce04a76dbd.summary: This paper present a spiral-cavity wheel for lunar regolith excavation and a sensor-light evaluation stack that jointly estimates fill ratio (vision), sinkage (vision), and specific energy from actuator logs. In benchtop tests (four revolutions at 5, 10, and 15~RPM) against two literature baselines, the proposed wheel achieved higher excavated mass and fill ratio, delivering 2.2-3.0 times higher excavation rate while reducing specific energy by 29 % relative to a bucket-drum baseline. Normalized sinkage (mm/kg) was also lower, indicating stable traction without bogging. Effort-time traces show a steady torque envelope with repeatable cut-carry-dump cycles across speeds. We provide a retention index $η$ that correlates with fill ratio and a DEM setup that reproduces experimental trends with low error. Results suggest spiral-cavity wheels can replace heavier multi-actuator diggers when mass, simplicity, and energy efficiency are mission drivers.

AI.tldr: 提出螺旋腔轮月壤挖掘方案，并配套轻量传感评估栈，联合估计填充率、沉陷量与比能；台架实验表明其挖掘效率、填充率和能效优于文献基线，且牵引稳定、循环可重复。
AI.motivation: 月壤采掘任务对系统质量、机构复杂度和能耗高度敏感；传统多执行器挖掘机较重、能耗较高，因此需要探索结构简单、高效低耗的挖掘机构，以及低传感依赖的性能评估方法。
AI.method: 设计螺旋腔轮作为月壤挖掘执行器；构建轻量传感评估栈：利用视觉估计填充率与沉陷量，利用执行器日志计算比能。在台架上以5、10、15 RPM进行四转实验，并与两种文献基线对比；提出保留指数η，建立离散元法（DEM）仿真。
AI.result: 相比两种文献基线，螺旋腔轮获得更高的挖掘质量和填充率；相对铲斗-滚筒基线，挖掘速率提高2.2–3.0倍，比能降低29%。归一化沉陷量（mm/kg）更低，表明牵引稳定、未发生下陷卡滞。力矩-时间曲线呈稳定包络，各转速下切削-搬运-卸载循环可重复。保留指数η与填充率相关，DEM仿真以较低误差复现实验趋势。
AI.conclusion: 当任务驱动指标为质量、简洁性和能效时，螺旋腔轮有望替代更重的多执行器挖掘装置。

74e298252d09a7cf79cadfca825cb7eda6ac2c77.title: Modular Norm RandOpt: Population-Efficient Ensembling through Architecture-Aware Perturbations
74e298252d09a7cf79cadfca825cb7eda6ac2c77.summary: RandOpt samples weight-perturbed language models and ensembles top-ranked candidates through plurality voting, but its global perturbation scale ignores heterogeneous module geometry. We propose \mbox{\textbf{\emph{Modular Norm RandOpt}}}, an architecture-aware sampling method using module-wise natural norms and calibrated scales while preserving selection and voting. It outperforms RandOpt using $3\times$ fewer candidates on Countdown and at least $12\times$ fewer on GSM8K, with corresponding wall-clock savings. Evaluations across seven tasks and three Qwen scales ($0.5$B--$3$B) show higher mean accuracy than RandOpt on Countdown, GSM8K, and MATH-500 at every scale. The gains extend to Llama 3.2 $3$B and Gemma 3 $4$B on Countdown and GSM8K. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, our ensembles also achieve higher mean accuracy than iterative baselines on both tasks at comparable main-run evaluation budgets. On GSM8K, a tail-density diagnostic implies only a $1.2$--$1.8\times$ candidate reduction, while most ensemble improvement is associated with more favorable correct-expert support. These results highlight perturbation geometry as a key design choice for population-efficient, gradient-free search around pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Modular Norm RandOpt：用模块级自然范数与校准尺度替代 RandOpt 的全局扰动尺度，在不改变候选选择与多数投票的前提下，以更少候选数和墙钟时间取得更高平均准确率，表明扰动几何是预训练模型周围无梯度搜索的关键设计。
AI.motivation: RandOpt 通过扰动语言模型权重并集成高排名候选进行多数投票，但其全局扰动尺度忽视了不同模块几何结构的异质性，导致候选效率与搜索效率受限。
AI.method: 提出 Modular Norm RandOpt，一种架构感知采样方法：采用模块级自然范数与校准尺度进行权重扰动，同时保留 RandOpt 的候选选择与多数投票机制。
AI.result: 在 Countdown 上以少 3 倍候选、GSM8K 上少至少 12 倍候选超过 RandOpt，并节省墙钟时间；在 7 个任务与 3 个 Qwen 规模（0.5B–3B）上，Countdown、GSM8K、MATH-500 各规模平均准确率均高于 RandOpt；增益扩展到 Llama 3.2 3B 与 Gemma 3 4B 的 Countdown 和 GSM8K；Qwen2.5-1.5B 上在相当主运行评估预算下平均准确率高于迭代基线；GSM8K 的尾部密度诊断显示候选缩减仅约 1.2–1.8 倍，而多数集成提升与更有利的 correct-expert support 相关。
AI.conclusion: 扰动几何是围绕预训练模型进行群体高效、无梯度搜索的关键设计选择；模块级范数与校准尺度能显著提升候选效率与集成性能。

3aa52aa063a4a8a6e2b32f9fe6161e9a8032649c.title: The Limits of Simulated Societies: How Post-Training and Survey Fine-Tuning Erase Cross-Cultural Variance
3aa52aa063a4a8a6e2b32f9fe6161e9a8032649c.summary: Using large language models (LLMs) to simulate diverse human populations has the potential to transform many aspects of computational social science, yet many evaluations score the average response rather than the spread of opinion within real groups. Here, we develop a diagnostic framework that measures point accuracy alongside dispersion retention, the ratio of predicted to human standard deviation ($\dr$), on 10{,}000 respondent--question pairs from the World Values Survey (WVS) spanning twelve countries and six continents. We evaluate eleven zero-shot language models and five variants fine-tuned on WVS data with SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We identify a failure mode we term \textit{consensus collapse}, where alignment training compresses outputs toward one stereotype per group. Along the post-training trajectory from the Llama~3.1 70B base to the Tulu~3 checkpoints, the first stage, supervised instruction tuning, removes half of the spread with minimal accuracy gain ($\dr$ 1.22 to 0.59; accuracy $+0.9$ points), the later stages do not restore it, and a gap opens between WEIRD and non-WEIRD countries that survey fine-tuning then deepens while pursuing higher point accuracy. The most accurate model (Tulu~3 70B-DPO fine-tuned on WVS, 57.9\%) keeps half the human spread overall ($\dr = 0.50$) and 11\% of it for Nigeria, against 0.70--0.87 for WEIRD countries. Raising the sampling temperature to 1.0 leaves the Wasserstein-1 distance ($\wone$) to human distributions unchanged for both fine-tuned DPO models, and GRPO on Qwen~3.5 9B does not restore the spread under either an accuracy reward or a distribution-shaped reward. Mixing the aligned model with an unaligned prior raises $\dr$ from 0.51 to 0.62 on a held-out split but leaves Nigeria at 0.36. Point accuracy alone therefore misjudges these simulators, and current post-training trades diversity for consensus.

AI.tldr: 论文提出衡量LLM模拟人类群体的诊断框架：同时评估点准确率与“离散度保留率”（预测标准差/人类标准差，DR），并在WVS 10,000个受访者-问题对、12国、6大洲数据上评测11个零样本LLM和5个SFT/DPO/GRPO微调变体，发现一种称为“共识坍缩”的失效模式：后训练在对齐过程中压缩群体内部观点分布，用多样性换取共识，而仅看平均准确率会误判模拟器质量。
AI.motivation: LLM被寄予模拟多样化人类群体的期望，但现有评测多关注平均响应或点准确率，忽视真实群体内部的观点离散度；因此需要能同时诊断准确性与群体异质性保留程度的评测框架，以揭示后训练对齐对意见多样性的影响。
AI.method: 构建诊断框架，在World Values Survey的10,000个受访者-问题对（覆盖12国、6大洲）上，同时测量点准确率与离散度保留率DR（预测标准差与人类标准差之比）。评测11个零样本语言模型，以及5个基于WVS数据、采用SFT、DPO、GRPO微调的变体；沿Llama 3.1 70B base到Tulu 3检查点的后训练轨迹分析，并检验温度提升、准确率奖励/分布塑形奖励的GRPO、以及对齐模型与非对齐先验混合等干预。
AI.result: 发现“共识坍缩”：SFT第一阶段将人类离散度削减约一半而准确率仅提高0.9个百分点（DR从1.22降至0.59），后续阶段未能恢复；WEIRD与非WEIRD国家间差距出现，调查微调在追求更高点准确率时进一步加深。最准确模型Tulu 3 70B-DPO（WVS微调，57.9%）总体仅保留一半人类离散度（DR=0.50），尼日利亚仅保留11%，而WEIRD国家为0.70–0.87。将采样温度升至1.0，两个DPO微调模型与人类分布的Wasserstein-1距离不变；Qwen 3.5 9B上的GRPO在准确率奖励或分布塑形奖励下均未恢复离散度。将对齐模型与非对齐先验混合可在留出集上将DR从0.51提升到0.62，但尼日利亚仍仅0.36。
AI.conclusion: 仅用点准确率会误判LLM人口模拟器；当前后训练流程系统性地以群体内部多样性换取共识，导致“共识坍缩”与跨文化离散度保留差距。因此需要引入离散度感知的评测与训练目标，而不能只优化平均答案准确率。

943e53fe1daf73acc5dc491d393b9ef57393025e.title: NaCR: Visual Localization via NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression
943e53fe1daf73acc5dc491d393b9ef57393025e.summary: Visual localization (VL) is a fundamental technology for vision applications such as virtual reality. Recently, a novel VL paradigm, Camera Ray Regression (CRR), has emerged, which maps 2D image patches to 3D camera rays, but its accuracy is limited. To improve CRR accuracy, we notice a compelling duality: the inverse of this mapping is inherently performed by the novel view synthesis model, \ie, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). While NeRF renders image patches from camera rays via differentiable ray marching, CRR predicts the rays from image patches. Motivated by this complementary relationship, we propose NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression (NaCR), a unified framework that seamlessly bridges NeRF and CRR at the ray level. First, NaCR incorporates three simple yet effective enhancements into the CRR baseline. Second, leveraging a pre-trained NeRF, NaCR augments the training data by synthesizing novel views tailored for efficient, patch-level consumption. Finally, exploiting the differentiability of NeRF, NaCR forms a closed-loop supervision pipeline where photometric rendering errors are back-propagated to optimize the predicted camera rays. To ensure stable convergence within the highly non-convex image space, we introduce a two-stage training curriculum. Extensive experiments across indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that NaCR achieves competitive accuracy. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the efficacy of each proposed component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NaCR：利用 NeRF 与相机光线回归（CRR）之间的对偶互补关系，在光线层面将二者统一，通过增强 CRR 基线、NeRF 合成新视图扩充训练数据、以及基于可微渲染的闭环光度监督，结合两阶段训练策略提升视觉定位精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位（VL）是虚拟现实等视觉应用的基础技术。新兴的相机光线回归（CRR）范式将 2D 图像块映射为 3D 相机光线，但其精度有限，亟需提升。作者注意到 CRR 的映射逆过程恰好由神经辐射场（NeRF）的新视图合成完成：NeRF 通过可微光线步进由相机光线渲染图像块，而 CRR 则由图像块预测光线，二者构成互补对偶关系，为提升 CRR 精度提供了新思路。
AI.method: 提出 NeRF 辅助的相机光线回归框架 NaCR，在光线层面无缝连接 NeRF 与 CRR，包含三部分：（1）在 CRR 基线上引入三项简单而有效的增强；（2）利用预训练 NeRF 合成面向高效图像块级消费的新视图，扩充训练数据；（3）利用 NeRF 的可微性构建闭环监督流程，将光度渲染误差反向传播以优化预测的相机光线。为保证在高度非凸的图像空间中稳定收敛，设计了由粗到细的两阶段训练课程。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的大量实验表明，NaCR 达到了具有竞争力的定位精度；消融研究进一步验证了各提出组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NaCR 验证了 NeRF 与 CRR 光线级统一框架的可行性与有效性，通过数据增强与闭环可微监督显著提升相机光线回归精度，为视觉定位提供了一条新路径。

aee937dbdc38dc5cb13376d4ae5700a82cde6a30.title: Minimal Recurrent Behavioral Memory for Imitation under Partial Observability
aee937dbdc38dc5cb13376d4ae5700a82cde6a30.summary: What is the least recurrent memory needed to reproduce a specified expert under partial observability? The instantaneous requirement is the conditional entropy of the expert's behavioral quotient, but recurrence must also preserve distinctions that future observations will not restore before use. We characterize this minimal recurrent behavioral memory by a compatibility relation: under transitivity its classes attain the exact minimum, while the general case is an entropy minimization over closed compatible state assignments, with exact certificates on finite instances. A sole-carrier measurement protocol separates behavioral sufficiency, excess code rate, and information carried by observations or other memory paths; experimental bit requirements refer to the induced symbolic behavioral model under the stated occupancy. Across manipulation tasks, learned code rates remain near zero- and two-bit requirements as hidden modes grow to $512$, and anticipatory memory follows a $2\to1\to0$ requirement despite zero instantaneous demand during waiting. Learning this representation remains difficult: event-agnostic future-behavior supervision yields $36/40$ sufficient seeds with one frozen configuration and improves the longest-horizon pixel setting from $0/8$ to $6/8$ sufficient held-out seeds (closed-loop success from $0.08$ to $0.57$). On unmodified community benchmarks, the protocol certifies delay-independent requirements, which sufficient codes match at mid-delay. The supervision aids commitment but can induce predictive surplus; annealing it lets imitation and rate training reduce that surplus, separating the information-theoretic target from the ability to learn it.

AI.tldr: 论文研究部分可观测下复现专家所需的最小循环记忆：以行为商的条件熵给出瞬时需求，并用兼容关系刻画循环记忆的最小性；提出单载体测量协议分离行为充分性、超额码率与信息路径，实验表明学习该表征仍困难。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测环境中，复现专家行为需要多少循环记忆？瞬时需求可由专家行为商的条件熵确定，但循环记忆还必须保留未来观测在投入使用前无法恢复的区分，因此需要精确刻画最小循环行为记忆及其可测量性。
AI.method: 将最小循环行为记忆刻画为兼容关系：在传递情形下，其等价类达到精确最小值；一般情形转化为闭兼容状态分配上的熵最小化，并给出有限实例的精确证书。提出单载体测量协议，分离行为充分性、超额码率以及由观测或其他记忆路径携带的信息；实验中的比特需求指在给定占用下诱导的符号行为模型。
AI.result: 在操作任务中，隐藏模式增至512时，学习码率仍接近0比特与2比特需求；等待期瞬时需求为零，但预期记忆呈2→1→0需求。学习该表征困难：事件无关的未来行为监督在单一冻结配置下获得36/40充分种子，并将最长视界像素设置从0/8提升至6/8充分留出种子，闭环成功率从0.08升至0.57。在未修改社区基准上，协议认证延迟无关需求，充分码在中延迟匹配。监督有助于承诺，但会诱导预测冗余；退火后模仿与码率训练可减少该冗余。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将信息论目标与可学习性分离：最小循环记忆可由兼容关系及闭兼容状态分配上的熵最小化精确刻画，但学习该表征仍具挑战；监督设计需在促进承诺与避免预测冗余之间权衡。

a01ff171114e1c454e8cf93a3cd75bdbc1f5cfe9.title: Neurosymbolic Action Model Learning under Partial Observability
a01ff171114e1c454e8cf93a3cd75bdbc1f5cfe9.summary: AI planning studies how an agent can reach a goal by executing a sequence of actions. To plan correctly, the agent needs an action model describing when each action can be executed and how it changes the world. Constructing such models by hand requires domain expertise, and can be costly and error-prone. Action models can instead be learned from available data using existing neurosymbolic approaches, but they currently assume access to complete traces of fully observable images . These approaches fail to learn action models under partial observability where some of the images might not be present or are not fully informative of the current state of the world. Hence, this paper proposes NeSyAM, a novel neurosymbolic modeling paradigm for action model learning under partial observability. In addition, the paper presents a unified variational framework for theoretically analysing the limitations of existing methods compared to our proposed approach. NeSyAM is then tested extensively on six visual planning domains and three observation regimes to show it consistently recovers relevant parts of the true action model under partial observability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NeSyAM：一种在部分可观测条件下从数据中学习动作模型的神经符号建模范式，并给出统一变分框架用于理论分析现有方法的局限。
AI.motivation: AI 规划需要动作模型来描述动作前提与效果；手工构建依赖领域知识，成本高且易出错。现有神经符号动作模型学习方法通常假设可获得完全可观测图像的完整轨迹，无法应对部分可观测场景，即图像可能缺失或不足以完整反映世界状态。
AI.method: 提出 NeSyAM，一种面向部分可观测性的神经符号动作模型学习范式；同时构建统一变分框架，从理论上分析现有方法与 NeSyAM 相比的局限性。
AI.result: 在六个视觉规划领域和三种观测机制下进行广泛实验，NeSyAM 在部分可观测条件下能够稳定恢复真实动作模型中的相关部分。
AI.conclusion: NeSyAM 扩展了神经符号动作模型学习到部分可观测场景，并通过理论与实验验证了其有效性。

062e282fe23520c8759912df61328ea77df1f459.title: AT3D-AD: Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Point-Language Alignment
062e282fe23520c8759912df61328ea77df1f459.summary: Detecting and localizing 3D point-cloud defects is essential for industrial inspection. However, existing methods often suffer from imprecise localization due to the lack of anomaly supervision and reliance on single-granularity representations. To address these limitations, we propose Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection (AT3D-AD), a unified framework for joint detection, localization, and classification. Specifically, we first design the Physics-Driven Parametric Anomaly Synthesis (PDPAS) module employing multiple parametric functions to generate synthetic anomalies, providing explicit anomaly supervision. Then, we propose the Hierarchical Global-Local Anomaly Alignment (HiGLA) module to align global and local representations within the normal and anomalous groups. Finally, we propose the Semantic-Geometric Anomaly Classification (SGAC) module to jointly learn localization and classification, yielding spatially precise and type-discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments establish new state-of-the-art performance on all four benchmarks. AT3D-AD achieves Object/Point AUROC scores of 98.1\%/98.9\% on Anomaly-ShapeNet and 95.0\%/95.2\% on Real3D-AD, while reaching 74.2\% Macro-F1 for anomaly-type recognition on Real3D-AD.

AI.tldr: 提出AT3D-AD统一框架，联合实现3D点云缺陷的检测、定位与分类，在四个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 3D点云缺陷检测与定位对工业检测至关重要，但现有方法因缺乏异常监督、且依赖单一粒度表示，导致定位不精确。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：(1) PDPAS（物理驱动参数化异常合成），用多种参数函数生成合成异常以提供显式异常监督；(2) HiGLA（分层全局-局部异常对齐），在正常组与异常组内对齐全局与局部表示；(3) SGAC（语义-几何异常分类），联合学习定位与分类，得到空间精确且类型可区分的异常表示。
AI.result: 在全部四个基准上刷新SOTA：Anomaly-ShapeNet上Object/Point AUROC达98.1%/98.9%，Real3D-AD上达95.0%/95.2%，并在Real3D-AD上取得74.2%的异常类型识别Macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: AT3D-AD通过显式异常监督与多粒度表示对齐，实现了空间精确且类型可区分的3D异常检测，验证了统一框架的有效性。

af9d3e40c3f1b3e8052a86ace7428b037b01a163.title: Dual Covariance Gaussian Splatting SLAM: Decoupling Rendering and Registration for Robust Real-Time Tracking
af9d3e40c3f1b3e8052a86ace7428b037b01a163.summary: ICP-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM tracks in real time by registering incoming frames against map Gaussians, using each primitive's covariance for both rendering and registration. These two uses place conflicting demands on one covariance. The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.

AI.tldr: 提出双协方差参数化的3DGS SLAM：每个高斯仅保留一个均值，但分别维护用于渲染的优化协方差和来自RGB-D噪声模型的跟踪协方差，并用跟踪协方差为图像角点提供高斯锚点约束，在多个数据集上实现鲁棒跟踪、降低里程计漂移并保持约60 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有基于ICP的3DGS SLAM将同一协方差同时用于渲染与配准，但两者需求冲突：建图器倾向于将协方差压扁以贴合表面、最小化光度误差；而鲁棒配准更需要反映测量不确定性的协方差。因此需要解耦渲染与跟踪对协方差的不同要求。
AI.method: 提出双协方差参数化：每个高斯保持单一均值，但拥有两个协方差——渲染协方差由建图器优化，跟踪协方差由RGB-D传感器噪声模型导出。进一步将跟踪协方差作为图像角点的高斯锚点，在深度几何较弱的约束方向上提供额外约束。
AI.result: 在TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica以及使用RealSense D435i在轮式和手持平台上采集的两段室外序列上进行评估。方法在多种场景中实现鲁棒跟踪并降低里程计漂移，同时跟踪速度约为60 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过双协方差解耦渲染与配准需求，并利用跟踪协方差增强角点约束，可在保持实时性的同时提升3DGS SLAM的跟踪鲁棒性并减少里程计漂移。

a85856ee144af7a1ac82f282aa41079eae84cd31.title: Disentangling Heterogeneous Traffic Dynamics for Multi-Step Traffic Forecasting via Adaptive Spectral Decomposition
a85856ee144af7a1ac82f282aa41079eae84cd31.summary: Accurate multi-step traffic forecasting remains challenging because observed traffic signals contain heterogeneous temporal dynamics with different characteristics and levels of predictability. Existing approaches typically model these dynamics within a unified representation or rely on predefined decomposition rules, which may limit their ability to flexibly separate persistent patterns from rapidly varying fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose the Adaptive Decomposition Network (ADNet), a component-specific forecasting framework that adaptively disentangles traffic dynamics into dominant and residual components. ADNet introduces a learnable complementary spectral decomposition mechanism that determines the contribution of each frequency bin to the two components. Unlike hard frequency partitioning, every frequency bin can contribute to both components with different learned proportions, allowing the decomposition to be optimized jointly with the forecasting objective. The reconstructed components are then modeled by two dedicated spatiotemporal forecasting branches, and their predictions are integrated to generate the final multi-step forecast. Experiments on the Alameda and Orange regions of the TraffiDent dataset show that ADNet achieves the best performance in 20 of the 24 reported region-horizon-metric comparisons, with particularly clear gains at longer forecasting horizons. Capacity-controlled ablation experiments further show that the learnable decomposition substantially outperforms a fixed decomposition and provides additional improvements beyond the dual-branch architecture alone. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of adaptive decomposition and component-specific modeling for multi-step traffic forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 ADNet，通过可学习互补频谱分解将交通流自适应拆分为主导与残差成分，并用双分支时空模型分别预测后融合，在 TraffiDent 数据集多步预测中取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 多步交通预测困难在于交通信号包含异质时间动态：既有持续稳定的模式，也有快速变化的波动。现有方法通常用统一表示建模，或依赖预定义分解规则，难以灵活分离不同可预测性的成分，从而限制预测能力。
AI.method: 提出自适应分解网络 ADNet，一种组件特定（component-specific）的预测框架。核心是可学习互补频谱分解机制：对每个频率 bin 学习其分配到主导成分与残差成分的比例，而非硬性频率划分；每个频率 bin 可以不同比例同时贡献于两个成分，并与预测目标联合优化。分解重构后的两个成分分别输入两个专用的时空预测分支，最后融合各分支预测得到多步预测结果。
AI.result: 在 TraffiDent 数据集的 Alameda 与 Orange 区域上，ADNet 在 24 项“区域-预测步长-指标”对比中取得 20 项最优，尤其在较长预测步长上提升更明显。容量控制消融实验表明，可学习分解显著优于固定分解，并且在双分支结构之外仍带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 自适应分解与组件特定建模对多步交通预测有效，验证了将异质时间动态按可学习比例拆分并分别建模、再融合的框架优势。

6f5596d82cf867613ec0d5cde99880bb273ef7df.title: Towards Omni-dimensional GUI Agent Navigation with Masked Trajectory Prediction
6f5596d82cf867613ec0d5cde99880bb273ef7df.summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) Agents autonomously interact with software to fulfill user requests, where GUI navigation stands out as the most critical and challenging capability. Mastering this capability demands a complex synergy of step-wise decision-making, state-action alignment, and long-horizon planning. While directly mixing these corresponding navigation tasks seems intuitive to simultaneously acquire these skills, such a direct combination is severely bottlenecked by inconsistent optimization objectives and profound data heterogeneity. To overcome these barriers, we propose the MaP (stands for ``\textbf{M}asked Tr\textbf{a}jectory \textbf{P}rediction''), a unified framework that seamlessly harmonizes divergent GUI navigation tasks. By modeling multi-turn GUI interactions as a trajectory and defining training objectives through component masking and prediction, MaP shifts the optimization from task-specific marginal distributions to a consistent objective. Furthermore, to handle the data heterogeneity across multiple navigation tasks, we design a role-aware adapter learning module that dynamically routes each token to a specialized representation space. Extensive experiments on five representative GUI navigation benchmarks demonstrate that MaP effectively mitigates gradient conflicts and significantly outperforms the direct mixture training, establishing a robust paradigm for multi-task GUI navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MaP（Masked Trajectory Prediction）统一框架，将多类 GUI 导航任务建模为多轮交互轨迹，通过组件掩码与预测统一优化目标，并用角色感知适配器缓解数据异构，在五个 GUI 导航基准上显著优于直接混合训练。
AI.motivation: GUI Agent 需自主操作软件完成用户请求，其中 GUI 导航是最关键且最具挑战的能力，要求逐步决策、状态-动作对齐与长时程规划。直观上可将对应导航任务直接混合以同时获得这些能力，但该做法受限于优化目标不一致与数据高度异构，导致梯度冲突和性能瓶颈。
AI.method: MaP 将多轮 GUI 交互建模为轨迹，并通过组件掩码与预测定义训练目标，使优化从任务特定的边缘分布转向一致目标；同时设计角色感知适配器学习模块，为每个 token 动态路由到专门表示空间，以处理多导航任务间的数据异构。
AI.result: 在五个代表性 GUI 导航基准上的大量实验表明，MaP 能有效缓解梯度冲突，并显著优于直接混合训练方法。
AI.conclusion: MaP 为多任务 GUI 导航建立了稳健范式，证明通过统一轨迹建模与角色感知适配可协调不同导航任务，提升 GUI Agent 的导航能力。

94ca0cf46589f362a3ef4b6ed05592c1bc46303b.title: Calibrating Retrieval Geometry: Reliability-Guided Training-Free Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
94ca0cf46589f362a3ef4b6ed05592c1bc46303b.summary: Frozen visual foundation models provide transferable features for visual place recognition, but fixed aggregation can suppress useful distinctions in new environments. We introduce TFA, a reliability-guided, training-free aggregation method requiring neither place labels nor task-specific weight updates. Our key observation is that reproducible retrieval need not be discriminative: independent codebooks can consistently retrieve a few database hubs. TFA combines cross-codebook agreement, retrieval coverage, and spectral statistics to control residual assignment, spectral shaping, and global-feature fusion. Its spectral kernel exactly recovers original descriptor similarity at zero intervention. Database-only TFA fixes its rules before accessing queries; TFA-C64 uses 64 disjoint unlabeled target images to calibrate retrieval for subsequent queries. Across 20 ground protocols with a fixed DINOv2-B backbone and matched resolution, database-only TFA improves Recall@1 over AnyLoc by 17.39 percentage points on MSLS-val and 9.55 on SPED. C64 mitigates failures of database-only calibration in driving environments. Across eight aerial/cross-view protocols, TFA achieves the highest Recall@1 among compared training-free heads in 14 of 16 DINOv2/DINOv3 backbone-protocol combinations. In a separate native-system comparison, DINOv2-G-based TFA-C64 reaches 91.46% Recall@1 on Pitts30k and 76.29% on VPAIR, outperforming the displayed training-free comparators on all five benchmarks. These results show that reliability-guided aggregation can recover additional retrieval capability from frozen representations, providing a practical baseline for new environments with scarce place supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TFA——一种可靠性引导的、免训练（training-free）视觉位置识别聚合方法，无需地点标签或任务相关的权重更新，通过独立码本的一致性、检索覆盖度与谱统计量来调制残差分配、谱塑形与全局特征融合，显著提升冻结视觉基础模型的检索能力。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉基础模型虽能提供可迁移特征，但固定的聚合方式在新环境中会抑制有用的特征区分度。作者希望在不依赖地点标签、不进行任务特定权重更新的前提下，从冻结表征中挖掘额外检索能力，为地点监督稀缺的新环境提供实用基线。
AI.method: 核心观察：可复现的检索不必具备强判别性——独立的码本能够一致地检索到少量数据库"枢纽（hubs）"。TFA 综合三类信号控制聚合：跨码本一致性（cross-codebook agreement）、检索覆盖度（retrieval coverage）与谱统计量（spectral statistics），据此调控残差分配、谱塑形与全局特征融合。其谱核在零干预时可精确还原原始描述子相似度。提出两种变体：Database-only TFA 在访问查询前固定规则；TFA-C64 使用 64 张互不重叠的无标签目标图像来校准后续查询的检索。
AI.result: 在固定 DINOv2-B 主干与匹配分辨率的 20 个地面协议中，Database-only TFA 的 Recall@1 相比 AnyLoc 在 MSLS-val 上提升 17.39 个百分点，在 SPED 上提升 9.55 个百分点；C64 缓解了 database-only 校准在驾驶环境中的失效。在 8 个航拍/跨视角协议中，TFA 在 16 个 DINOv2/DINOv3 主干-协议组合里的 14 个取得相比各类免训练头最高的 Recall@1。在独立的原生系统对比中，基于 DINOv2-G 的 TFA-C64 在 Pitts30k 上达到 91.46% Recall@1、在 VPAIR 上达到 76.29%，在全部五个基准上均优于所列免训练对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可靠性引导的聚合能够从冻结表征中恢复额外的检索能力，为地点监督稀缺的新环境提供了一个实用的基线。

5bb315c1ded4e7ea3274c10e280527c8d10987d2.title: Fisheye-VLA: Decoupling Coverage and Acuity for Manipulation with a Single Fisheye Camera
5bb315c1ded4e7ea3274c10e280527c8d10987d2.summary: Manipulation requires both broad scene awareness and detailed local feedback, yet conventional camera rigs provide them through separate front and wrist cameras. We present Fisheye-VLA, a visual interface that brings these capabilities together using a single passive fisheye. A global view preserves the workspace, while local perspective crops direct detail toward the interaction. The key design question is where this local visual budget should go. We answer it through a controlled re-rendering study, comparing alternative crop directions on the same recorded observations. The study finds that end-effector-centered views capture most of the estimated benefit of a much larger candidate pool, motivating a compact allocation around both hands. Our interface uses calibrated end-effector projection and motion lead to track the crops, while a shared ray encoding preserves their spatial meaning as they move. Integrated with a pretrained VLA, it achieves 84% and 82% success in the two expanded tabletop regions, where some target placements extend beyond the front-camera coverage, and supports shelf and conveyor manipulation. Ablations show that local crops and their viewing directions become more important in the larger workspace regions. The results demonstrate that a single fisheye can support these manipulation tasks without physical wrist cameras.

AI.tldr: Fisheye-VLA 用单个被动鱼眼相机替代"前视+腕部"双相机方案，通过全局视野保持场景感知、局部裁剪提供细节反馈，并证明以末端执行器为中心的裁剪方向最关键，在扩展桌面、货架与传送带操纵任务上取得 84%/82% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统相机配置需要前视相机提供全局场景感知、腕部相机提供精细局部反馈，二者分离带来额外硬件与标定成本。作者希望仅用一个被动鱼眼相机同时满足"广域场景感知"与"局部细节反馈"两类需求，从而去除物理腕部相机。
AI.method: 核心设计问题是局部视觉预算应投向何处。作者通过受控的重渲染研究，在相同观测数据上比较不同裁剪方向的效果，发现以末端执行器为中心的视角能捕获大候选池中的大部分收益，进而围绕双手做紧凑的裁剪分配。接口利用标定的末端执行器投影与运动超前（motion lead）来追踪裁剪区域，并用共享的射线编码在裁剪移动时保持其空间语义。最终与预训练 VLA 集成。
AI.result: 在两个扩展桌面区域中分别取得 84% 与 82% 成功率（部分目标位置超出前视相机覆盖范围），并支持货架与传送带操纵。消融实验显示，在更大的工作空间区域中，局部裁剪及其观察方向变得更加重要。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单个鱼眼相机即可支撑上述操纵任务，无需物理腕部相机，验证了以末端执行器为中心的局部裁剪作为高效视觉接口的可行性。

c59dda7a89107656ee1aa5c709a61da3f4162c8d.title: A Lightweight Plastic-Memory Framework for Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
c59dda7a89107656ee1aa5c709a61da3f4162c8d.summary: Graph Incremental Learning has garnered increasing attention as dynamic graph data continues to emerge across diverse fields. Conventional approaches primarily address catastrophic forgetting by preserving node-related knowledge through replay or distillation techniques; however, they often incur high computational costs and inefficiency. This issue is further exacerbated in real-world scenarios where labeled data for new classes is scarce. In this paper, we propose a novel lightweight plastic-memory framework specifically designed for few-shot incremental learning on graphs. The core idea of our framework is the construction of a plastic-memory module that evolves over time, continuously updating and expanding its memory to accommodate new classes while retaining previously learned knowledge. In contrast to existing techniques, our memory module is both lightweight and effective, featuring an innovative evolving micro-clustering structure that dynamically updates representations of class prototypes, sub-prototypes, and their interaction weights. Building on this memory module, we introduce a memory-driven meta-learning framework that enhances adaptability to new tasks in its inner loop while maintaining stability for earlier tasks in the outer loop. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the framework's superior performance in balancing stability for old knowledge and adaptability to new knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向图小样本增量学习的轻量“可塑记忆”框架，通过动态演化的微聚类记忆模块与记忆驱动元学习，在缓解灾难性遗忘的同时提升对新类的少样本适应能力。
AI.motivation: 图增量学习需应对动态图数据中的灾难性遗忘。现有方法多依赖回放或蒸馏保留节点知识，但计算开销大、效率低；在新类标注数据稀缺的真实场景下，该问题进一步加剧。因此需要一种轻量、高效且适用于小样本图增量学习的方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建随时间演化的可塑记忆模块，持续更新与扩展记忆以容纳新类并保留旧知识；2) 设计轻量且有效的演化微聚类结构，动态更新类原型、子原型及其交互权重；3) 基于该记忆模块提出记忆驱动元学习框架：内循环增强对新任务的适应性，外循环维持对早期任务的稳定性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明该框架在旧知识稳定性与新知识适应性之间取得了更优平衡，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 可塑记忆与元学习的结合为图小样本类增量学习提供了轻量、有效的解决思路，能够在标注稀缺条件下缓解灾难性遗忘，并提升模型对新类的快速适应能力。

7749acc467ed17b738bde902fd91f2e56f707eca.title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
7749acc467ed17b738bde902fd91f2e56f707eca.summary: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measures the taste of an agent. To address this problem, we build Taste-Bench, a benchmark of taste questions constructed automatically from trajectories that agents produced in engineering and research tasks. Each question presents a decision fork, a point in a trajectory where multiple directions are available and one of them leads to a better outcome, and the evaluated model chooses among these directions without seeing what happens after the fork. We mine these forks automatically from parallel attempts at the same task and from detours inside a single trajectory, without needing human annotation. We evaluate frontier models on Taste-Bench and find that the best model answers only 59.7% of the questions correctly. We further find that forks whose deciding evidence appears later in the trajectory are much harder for every model, and that a larger reasoning budget does not improve the accuracy. Finally, we show that taste can be trained. We distill the judgment of a teacher that has seen the outcome into a student model, and the student makes better decisions on unseen tasks and improves end-to-end success on held-out SWE-bench Pro tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Taste-Bench，用于评估 LLM agent 在长程任务中的“品味”（即做出关键长期决策的能力）。基准通过自动挖掘轨迹中的决策分叉构造题目，无需人工标注。前沿模型最佳准确率仅 59.7%，且后置证据分叉更难、增加推理预算无增益；作者进一步证明“品味”可通过教师模型蒸馏训练，并提升未见任务及 SWE-bench Pro 端到端成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 越来越多地执行长程任务，其过程中的决策（如测试哪个假设、基于哪个实现继续）决定整体结果。作者将这种做好长期决策的能力称为 agent 的“品味”。现有基准只衡量长程任务的端到端成功率，未衡量 agent 的品味，因此需要专门基准。
AI.method: 构建 Taste-Bench：从工程与研究任务的 agent 轨迹自动构造“品味问题”。每题呈现一个决策分叉，即在轨迹中存在多个可选方向且其中一个导向更好结果，模型在看不到分叉后结果的情况下选择方向。分叉通过同一任务的并行尝试以及单条轨迹中的绕路自动挖掘，无需人工标注。随后评估前沿模型，并分析证据出现位置与推理预算的影响；最后用见过结果的教师模型判断蒸馏到学生模型。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅正确回答 59.7% 的问题；决定证据在轨迹中越晚出现的分叉，对所有模型越难；更大的推理预算并未提升准确率。通过将见过结果的教师判断蒸馏给学生模型，学生在未见任务上决策更好，并在留出的 SWE-bench Pro 任务上提升端到端成功率。
AI.conclusion: Taste-Bench 首次将 agent 的长程决策“品味”作为可测量对象，表明其为独立于端到端成功的能力维度。结果表明当前前沿模型品味有限，且难以通过单纯增加推理预算解决；但品味可训练，教师蒸馏能提升学生决策与下游任务表现。

ec07999ed553f35cc0e9b6cdd0ff110ec8624595.title: Towards Systematic Qualification of Vision-Language Models for Automotive Perception Systems
ec07999ed553f35cc0e9b6cdd0ff110ec8624595.comment: Accepted in ICTSS 2026 - 38th International Conference on Testing Software and Systems
ec07999ed553f35cc0e9b6cdd0ff110ec8624595.summary: The field of Artificial Intelligence has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems

AI.tldr: 提出一种设计时资格认证工作流，结合安全相关本体结构化标注与同义词评估，对三种先进视觉语言模型在nuScenes数据上的幻觉进行统计量化，以补充运行时监控，支持模型比较与部署决策，服务于可信汽车感知系统的整体验证策略。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型已用于汽车感知与安全保证，但易产生幻觉，可能误报不存在的交通对象或漏报真实存在的对象，从而威胁汽车系统安全。现有验证与确认方法常被孤立研究，仅关注运行时或设计时单一阶段，难以满足汽车感知等安全关键场景的需求。
AI.method: 基于Huang等人提出的分类法，分析设计时与运行时验证和确认技术；提出一项汽车领域研究，设计时资格认证工作流用于补充运行时监控。该工作流将固定的安全相关本体结构化标注系统与基于同义词的评估过程相结合，对三种先进视觉语言模型在nuScenes数据集上的表现进行统计评估。
AI.result: 所提技术能够以确定且可重复的方式量化视觉语言模型在汽车感知相关任务中产生的幻觉，并支持模型比较以及面向部署的工程决策。
AI.conclusion: 该设计时工作流可补充设计时验证与确认流程，有助于形成面向可信汽车感知系统的整体验证策略。

056b60f5c1fd3b1e333751211244ecbdf3087087.title: PLAT: Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking for Humanoid Control via Privileged Latent Transition Learning
056b60f5c1fd3b1e333751211244ecbdf3087087.summary: Humanoid motion tracking policies rely on dense frame-by-frame references, limiting their use as high-level motion controllers for planning and interactive motion generation. We study \emph{Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking}, where a policy receives only sparse future keyframes and their desired arrival times, and must execute stable whole-body motions that reach successive goals. We propose \textbf{PLAT}, a three-stage sparse timed keyframe motion tracking policy learning framework with \textbf{P}rivileged \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{T}ransition learning.
