Second, using an exact remainder identity as guidance, we construct a smooth generator whose iterates yield doubly exponential error decay in total depth for square approximation and, through multiplication modules, for each fixed polynomial. For power series with absolutely summable coefficients on \([-1,1]^d\), distributing depth according to monomial degree yields a uniform approximation error of order \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) on each interior cube. These findings demonstrate how generator dynamics and remainder estimates govern depth allocation and approximation rates of deep neural networks.

AI.tldr: 论文研究深度网络逼近能力的一种基本复合机制：单标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和。作者先给出分段线性生成元的刚性定理，说明该机制对函数复杂度的限制；再利用精确余项恒等式构造光滑生成元，实现平方与多项式逼近的双指数深度误差衰减，并在高维幂级数情形得到 O(e^{-cL^{1/d}}) 的均匀逼近率。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络通过仿射映射与非线性激活的复合逼近函数，但“复合”本身如何产生逼近能力仍未被充分理解。该机制是 tent-map 构造 \(x-x^2\) 以及 Yarotsky、W. E 等人递归表示的基础，因此需要厘清其能力边界与可扩展性。
AI.method: 将问题抽象为单标量生成函数迭代的几何加权和；针对连续分段线性且有限段数的生成元，证明刚性/次数上界并给出非仿射二次函数的几何因子下界；利用精确余项恒等式设计光滑生成元，结合乘法模块，并按单项式次数分配网络深度。
AI.result: 刚性定理表明：若生成元为有限段连续分段线性函数，则任何可用该机制表示的 \(C^3\) 函数至多二次；对非仿射二次函数，几何因子至少为 \(1/4\)。构造性结果：光滑生成元的迭代可在总深度上实现平方逼近的双指数误差衰减，并经乘法模块推广到每个固定多项式；对 \([-1,1]^d\) 上系数绝对可和的幂级数，按单项式次数分配深度可在每个内部立方体上达到 \(O(e^{-cL^{1/d}})\) 的均匀逼近误差。
AI.conclusion: 生成元动力学与余项估计共同决定深度分配和深度网络的逼近速率。该结果既揭示了 tent-map 方法的局限，也补充了层次基与递归多项式构造等既有方法，并给出了基于生成元设计的高效逼近框架。

e95553b1dcc2248f151570bde190ec424bda725f.title: Adversarial Course-of-Action Generation: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Algorithms for COA matching & COA generation
e95553b1dcc2248f151570bde190ec424bda725f.comment: 5 pages. DAI 2026 Industry Track submission. Includes public reproducibility artifact link. Uses synthetic offline scenarios only; no classified data, proprietary data, human-subject data, or operational planning systems
e95553b1dcc2248f151570bde190ec424bda725f.summary: Course-of-action (COA) generation is a distributed planning problem: a system must propose structured candidate actions, evaluate them against an adversarial response, and surface options that remain tactically coherent under changing conditions. We present COA-Bench, a small offline benchmark and reproducibility artifact for comparing COA generation policies through self-play. Following the BattleCOA terminology, we reserve COA matching for asset-effect matching and COA generation for course-of-action generation; the present artifact does not implement either DecisionFunction directly. Instead, it represents COAs as typed action chains with conditional branches, assigns a synthetic COA quality score, compares opposing COAs with a BLUE-vs-RED advantage score and Nash-gap distance, and scores doctrinal coherence with an FM 3-0-inspired heuristic rubric. Across 50 synthetic scenarios spanning five operational templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight RED candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .516 to .485 and BLUE wargame win rate from .920 to .820; a two-stage multi-agent council with five BLUE proposer agents, RED-team adjudication, and critique-driven revision obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .820 BLUE win rate. We also identify and fix a benchmark-design issue in which scenario framing was stored as metadata but had no effect on generated COA content. COA-Bench is not an operational battle-management system and uses no real, classified, proprietary, or human-subject data. The contribution is an inspectable evaluation harness, preliminary benchmark evidence, and lessons for building auditable agentic planning artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 COA-Bench：一个用于通过自博弈比较行动方案（COA）生成策略的小型离线基准与可复现工件，并给出初步基准证据及可审计智能体规划工件的设计经验。
AI.motivation: 行动方案生成本质上是一个分布式规划问题：系统需提出结构化候选行动、在对抗性响应下评估，并在条件变化时仍保持战术连贯。现有工作缺乏可比较、可检查、可复现的评估手段，因此作者构建 COA-Bench 作为评估装置（evaluation harness）。
AI.method: 沿用 BattleCOA 术语，区分 COA matching（资产—效果匹配）与 COA generation（行动方案生成），本工件不直接实现任一 DecisionFunction。具体做法：将 COA 表示为带条件分支的类型化行动链；赋予合成 COA 质量分；用 BLUE-vs-RED 优势分与 Nash-gap 距离比较对抗方案；用受 FM 3-0 启发的启发式评分规则评估条令一致性。实验设置 50 个合成场景、5 类作战模板，对比两类策略：(1) 采样最佳响应策略，抽取 8 个 RED 候选；(2) 两阶段多智能体委员会，含 5 个 BLUE 提议智能体、RED 团队裁决与批评驱动修订。作者还发现并修复了一处基准设计缺陷：场景框架仅作为元数据存储，未对生成的 COA 内容产生任何影响。
AI.result: 采样最佳响应策略使 BLUE 优势分由 .516 降至 .485，BLUE 兵棋胜率由 .920 降至 .820；两阶段多智能体委员会获得 .509 的 BLUE 优势分与 .820 的 BLUE 胜率。
AI.conclusion: COA-Bench 并非作战级战斗管理系统，且不使用任何真实、机密、专有或人类受试数据。其贡献包括：一个可检查的评估装置、初步基准证据，以及构建可审计智能体规划工件的经验教训。

14d3a4bd27f9e215708f18b6de96eeb5b0356e35.title: Match One, Learn with Graph: One-to-Graph Query Collaboration with Backward Sharing for Object Detection
14d3a4bd27f9e215708f18b6de96eeb5b0356e35.summary: One-to-one (O2O) matching enables Detection Transformers (DETRs) to perform end-to-end set prediction by assigning each object to a single positive query. However, the strongest classification, center, scale, and overlap evidence for an object is often distributed across multiple queries. This mismatch leaves only the matched owner positively supervised for the object, while other evidence-bearing queries receive no box target for it. We term this query knowledge fragmentation. To exploit such complementary evidence without one-to-many supervision, we propose BS-O2G, a plug-in that builds a sparse prediction-aware graph from decoded features, boxes, and class distributions to organize query collaboration in feature and optimization spaces while preserving the original O2O matcher, positive labels, and objective. One-to-Graph (O2G) calibration propagates relative messages over this graph to consolidate query evidence in the forward pass, whereas Backward Sharing (BS) reuses its transposed detached adjacency to route gradients across persistent query basis vectors without changing the decoder input in the forward pass. Experiments across diverse DETR methods, backbones, COCO, and CrowdHuman show consistent gains and faster convergence with negligible parameter/FLOP growth and modest runtime overhead, supporting graph-based query collaboration as an alternative to expanding positive assignments.

AI.tldr: 该文针对DETR一对一匹配下“查询知识碎片化”问题，提出即插即用模块BS-O2G：在前向通过One-to-Graph校准在稀疏预测感知图上传播查询证据，在反向通过Backward Sharing沿持久查询基向量路由梯度，在不改变O2O匹配、正样本标签与目标函数的前提下实现查询协作，并在COCO、CrowdHuman上取得一致增益与更快收敛。
AI.motivation: DETR依赖一对一匹配实现端到端集合预测，但同一目标的最强分类、中心、尺度与重叠证据常分散在多个查询中。传统O2O监督只将匹配到的“所有者”查询作为正样本，其余携带证据的查询缺乏该目标的框监督，造成查询知识碎片化，限制了互补证据的利用。
AI.method: 提出BS-O2G即插即用模块。首先基于解码特征、框和类别分布构建稀疏的预测感知图，以组织查询在特征空间与优化空间中的协作，同时保持原始O2O匹配器、正标签与目标函数不变。One-to-Graph（O2G）校准在图上传播相对消息，在前向过程中整合查询证据；Backward Sharing（BS）复用其转置且detach后的邻接矩阵，将梯度跨持久查询基向量路由，且不改变前向解码器输入。
AI.result: 在多种DETR方法、不同骨干网络、COCO与CrowdHuman数据集上实验显示一致性能增益和更快收敛；参数与FLOP增长可忽略，运行时开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于图的查询协作可作为扩展正样本分配之外的有效替代方案，在不破坏O2O端到端范式的情况下缓解查询知识碎片化并提升DETR检测性能。

e7767fa664b347251b3fe3f9af8383694203c890.title: Vision-based Underwater Formation Control With Input Saturations via Barrier Lyapunov Functions
e7767fa664b347251b3fe3f9af8383694203c890.summary: In this work, we propose a communication-free framework for vision-based formation control of fully actuated underwater robots subject to sensing constraints, collision-avoidance requirements, and input saturations. Recentered barrier Lyapunov functions encode sensing and collision-avoidance constraints, while command-filtered backstepping extends the design to the second-order vehicle dynamics. The resulting control objective is enforced through a quadratic program that explicitly accounts for actuator limits. Conservative sensing domains provide margins from the physical limits and are adaptively relaxed when necessary, allowing temporary violation of the conservative bounds. The proposed approach is validated through realistic Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) simulations in Gazebo.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向全驱动水下机器人视觉编队控制的无通信框架，在感知受限、避碰与输入饱和条件下，结合重中心障碍李雅普诺夫函数、命令滤波反步法与二次规划，并通过Gazebo软件在环（SITL）仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 水下多机器人编队通常依赖通信，但通信可能不可用或受限；同时视觉感知范围有限、需避碰且执行器存在饱和。如何在无通信条件下同时满足感知、安全与输入约束，是本文要解决的问题。
AI.method: 构建无通信视觉编队控制框架；采用重中心障碍李雅普诺夫函数（recentered barrier Lyapunov functions）编码感知与避碰约束；采用命令滤波反步法将设计扩展至二阶车辆动力学；将控制目标转化为二次规划（QP）以显式处理执行器限制；引入保守感知域提供物理极限裕度，并在必要时自适应放松，允许对保守边界临时违反。
AI.result: 在Gazebo中进行逼真的软件在环（SITL）仿真，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够在无通信、感知受限、避碰与输入饱和条件下实现全驱动水下机器人的视觉编队控制，仿真结果支持其可行性。

c248992057f86f96a8c20fb03de10d395c516a12.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of SechKAN on 1D Data
c248992057f86f96a8c20fb03de10d395c516a12.summary: The connection between the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem (KART) and neural network design has led to the development of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), with applications ranging from STEM problems to AI tasks. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of a KAN variant, SechKAN, which relies on hyperbolic secant (sech) functions as basis functions, with a 1D projection to reduce the number of parameters to a level comparable to MLPs. We evaluate SechKAN on three 1D classification datasets: UCI Human Activity Recognition (UCI HAR), ElectricDevices, and Crop, and compare it with several effective networks, including EfficientKAN, MLP, CNN1D, ResNet1D, and DSCNN1D, using approximately comparable parameter budgets. The results indicate that SechKAN achieves competitive performance across the three datasets, with particularly strong performance on Crop. Ablation studies further show that grid size and normalization affect performance, suggesting that SechKAN's effectiveness depends on the dataset and architectural choices. Our source code and experimental implementation are publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/SechKAN_1D.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了KAN变体SechKAN的有效性：该网络以双曲正割(sech)函数作为基函数，并通过1D投影将参数量降至与MLP相当的水平。在三个1D分类数据集(UCI HAR、ElectricDevices、Crop)上与EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D在近似参数量预算下对比，SechKAN整体具竞争力，在Crop上表现尤为突出。
AI.motivation: Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理(KART)与神经网络设计的结合催生了KANs，已应用于STEM及AI任务。但KAN通常参数量较大，因此作者希望探索一种以sech为基函数、并通过1D投影压缩参数量的KAN变体(SechKAN)，使其参数量可与MLP相比，从而评估其在1D分类任务中的实用性。
AI.method: 提出SechKAN：以双曲正割(sech)函数作为可学习边上的基函数，并采用1D投影以降低参数量至MLP量级。在三个1D分类数据集(UCI Human Activity Recognition、ElectricDevices、Crop)上评估，与EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D在约略相当的参数预算下进行对比，并开展消融实验考察网格大小(grid size)与归一化(normalization)的影响。
AI.result: SechKAN在三个数据集上均取得具竞争力的性能，其中在Crop数据集上表现尤为强劲。消融研究表明网格大小与归一化会影响性能，说明SechKAN的有效性依赖于具体数据集与架构选择。
AI.conclusion: SechKAN作为一种参数高效的KAN变体，在1D分类任务中可与MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D、DSCNN1D等有效网络竞争，其性能受数据集和设计选择(如网格大小、归一化)影响。源码与实验实现已公开于https://github.com/hoangthangta/SechKAN_1D。

14188ecf7c7f1f2c39344b86f629f49ff0846575.title: ChainUQ: Reasoning Consistency-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models
14188ecf7c7f1f2c39344b86f629f49ff0846575.summary: While large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive reasoning capabilities, response-level confidence may remain unreliable when intermediate claims conflict with the final conclusion. Therefore, effective uncertainty quantification (UQ) is required to capture logical inconsistencies within the reasoning chain, not just the correctness of the final output. Current approaches have two major limitations: (1) their reliance on token-level probabilities fails to capture reasoning consistency, and (2) they lack mechanisms to dynamically calibrate confidence using the structural logic of the generated chain. To advance existing research, we introduce ChainUQ, a reasoning consistency-aware uncertainty quantification framework for LLMs. ChainUQ consists of two key technical components: an alignment-aware lightweight UQ module that estimates a raw intrinsic model confidence score from frozen features aligned to the final conclusion, and a reasoning consistency-aware calibrator that refines this score using reasoning-chain consistency evidence. Evaluations across diverse in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks show that ChainUQ consistently improves response-level uncertainty estimation, achieving an average 3.1% relative gain in AUROC and up to 45.0% relative reduction in ECE, and can be directly transferred to new settings without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChainUQ，一个面向大语言模型的推理一致性感知不确定性量化框架，通过"对齐感知轻量UQ模块 + 推理一致性校准器"两个组件提升响应级置信度估计的可靠性，并在多个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 大模型推理能力虽强，但响应级置信度并不可靠：当推理链中的中间论断与最终结论相互矛盾时，仅凭最终输出的正确性无法反映真实不确定性。现有方法存在两大局限：(1) 依赖 token 级概率，无法刻画推理一致性；(2) 缺乏利用生成链结构逻辑来动态校准置信度的机制。
AI.method: ChainUQ 包含两个关键技术组件：(1) 对齐感知的轻量级 UQ 模块，从与最终结论对齐的冻结特征中估计原始的内在模型置信度分数；(2) 推理一致性感知校准器，利用推理链一致性证据对该分数进行精炼。整体框架在无需额外微调的情况下即可迁移至新设置。
AI.result: 在多种分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）基准上的评估表明，ChainUQ 一致地改善了响应级不确定性估计，AUROC 平均相对提升 3.1%，ECE 相对降低最高达 45.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将置信度估计与推理链一致性证据相结合，ChainUQ 有效弥补了 token 级概率在推理一致性刻画上的不足，实现了更可靠的响应级不确定性量化，并具备良好的可迁移性。

edfe2181b81b6a45a70b38d9c2d5fb1504eee6fe.title: RECAP: Relation Evidence Calibration for Detecting Spatial Relation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
edfe2181b81b6a45a70b38d9c2d5fb1504eee6fe.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SouthWinter/RECAP
edfe2181b81b6a45a70b38d9c2d5fb1504eee6fe.summary: Vision-language models can answer spatial relation questions confidently even when the image supports an incompatible relation. We formulate relation-grounded selective prediction: accept or reject an already-produced yes/no answer by auditing its visual support, rather than treating uncertainty as evidence. RECAP, our relation-evidence calibration framework, compares image-conditioned likelihoods for a claim, its semantic contradictions, and optional one-sided supports, then converts these witnesses into an answer-conditioned rejection risk. A calibration-only gate preserves confidence as a veto when confidence is demonstrably informative and otherwise deploys relation evidence alone. Across 20 group/image-disjoint splits, RECAP lowers H-FPR@80 over confidence by between 2.0 and 17.9 points on VSR and raises Acc@80 by 3.0, 8.6, and 12.6 points on What'sUp for Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3.5-8B, and LLaVA-1.5-7B. It outperforms matched VCD-style visual contrast on all four primary metrics in all six settings. Full-pool VSR fallback, target-ranked GSR-Bench transfer, equal-budget supervised controls, and two additional checkpoints show a consistent operating principle: structured counterevidence complements certainty when confidence is misaligned, while the gate retains confidence when it is already useful.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“关系接地的选择性预测”任务与 RECAP 框架：对已生成的 yes/no 答案，通过审核其视觉支持来决定接受或拒绝，而非把不确定性当证据。RECAP 比较图像条件下原命题、语义矛盾与单侧支持的似然，转化为答案条件拒绝风险，并用仅校准的门控在置信度有信息时保留其否决权、否则单独使用关系证据。实验在 VSR、What'sUp、GSR-Bench 等设置上显著优于置信度基线和 VCD 式视觉对比。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在图像支持不相容关系时仍会自信回答空间关系问题。核心问题在于：不确定性并不等于答案错误，模型置信度可能与视觉证据错位，因此需要一种不依赖置信度、而是审计答案视觉支持的选择性预测机制。
AI.method: 提出 RECAP 关系证据校准框架。它对一个 claim、其语义矛盾以及可选的一侧支持分别计算图像条件似然，将这些“见证”转换为答案条件下的拒绝风险；再通过 calibration-only gate 进行门控：当置信度可证明有信息时，将置信度作为否决信号保留，否则仅部署关系证据。
AI.result: 在 20 个 group/image-disjoint 划分上，RECAP 相比置信度基线将 VSR 的 H-FPR@80 降低 2.0–17.9 个百分点；在 What'sUp 上，对 Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3.5-8B、LLaVA-1.5-7B 分别将 Acc@80 提升 3.0、8.6、12.6 个百分点。在全部六个设置、四个主要指标上均优于匹配的 VCD 式视觉对比。全池 VSR fallback、目标排序的 GSR-Bench 迁移、等预算监督控制以及两个额外检查点均显示一致的操作原则。
AI.conclusion: 结构化反证据在置信度错位时可补充确定性，而门控在置信度已有用时保留置信度；RECAP 为空间关系问答提供了一种基于关系证据校准的选择性预测方案。

fffad51456228d40da1ab1de95889196eb29a7e8.title: Unsigned Distance Maps on 2D Point Cloud Registration
fffad51456228d40da1ab1de95889196eb29a7e8.comment: 8 pages, 0 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the 9th Iberian Robotics Conference (ROBOT2026), November 18-20, 2026, Barcelona, Spain. Source code: https://github.com/INESCTEC/ricoslam
fffad51456228d40da1ab1de95889196eb29a7e8.summary: 2D point cloud registration arises in laser odometry and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) for mobile robots. Iterative Closest Point (ICP) is one of the most widely used approaches. Still, its iterative procedure recomputes correspondences via nearest-neighbor search at every iteration, whereas correspondence-free alternatives focus on scan-to-map alignment. This paper proposes a 2D point cloud registration approach based on unsigned distance maps, precomputing the Euclidean distance to the nearest reference point, along with its spatial derivatives, over a discrete grid, replacing the per-iteration search with O(1) lookups. Moreover, point-to-point and point-to-plane error formulations are derived on the SE(2) manifold and solved via Gauss-Newton optimization. On a synthetic benchmark and the real-world IILABS 3D dataset, the precomputed point-to-point variant outperforms its analytical counterparts, achieving competitive laser-odometry drift compared to point-to-plane formulations, as the precomputed gradient regularizes correspondences in the presence of sensor noise.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于无符号距离图（unsigned distance map）的二维点云配准方法，将最近邻搜索预计算为离散网格上的距离场及其空间导数，使每次迭代的对应关系查询降为 O(1)；在 SE(2) 流形上推导点到点与点到面误差，并用 Gauss-Newton 求解。实验表明预计算点到点变体优于解析对应版本，在激光里程计漂移上可与点到面方法竞争。
AI.motivation: 二维点云配准在移动机器人激光里程计与 SLAM 中至关重要。ICP 虽广泛应用，但每次迭代都需通过最近邻搜索重新计算对应关系，计算开销大；无对应（correspondence-free）方法多面向 scan-to-map 对齐。因此需要一种既能避免逐次最近邻搜索、又保持高精度与抗噪性的配准方案。
AI.method: 基于无符号距离图预计算参考点云的欧氏距离场及其空间导数，并存储在离散网格上，从而以 O(1) 查表替代逐迭代最近邻搜索。在 SE(2) 流形上分别推导点到点（point-to-point）与点到面（point-to-plane）误差形式，并采用 Gauss-Newton 优化求解位姿。
AI.result: 在合成基准和真实世界 IILABS 3D 数据集上验证：预计算的点到点变体优于其解析对应版本，并在激光里程计漂移指标上与点到面形式具有竞争力。原因在于预计算梯度在传感器噪声存在时对对应关系起到正则化作用。
AI.conclusion: 利用无符号距离图预计算距离与梯度，可有效替代 ICP 的逐迭代最近邻搜索，实现高效二维点云配准；其中预计算点到点方法在噪声场景下表现突出，为激光里程计与 SLAM 提供了一种兼顾效率、精度与鲁棒性的配准思路。

a769e5b4e7e97d23a7371bb0b5948697042e5bf1.title: AURA: Angular Update Rate Adaptation for training complex-valued neural networks
a769e5b4e7e97d23a7371bb0b5948697042e5bf1.summary: Complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) are increasingly adopted for complex-valued data; however, they are often trained with first-order optimizers inherited from the real-valued case. The efficiency of these methods depends largely on the step size, and their step-size rules ignore the angular information available in the complex plane. We address step-size adaptation in the complex domain by introducing AURA (Angular Update Rate Adaptation), a per-parameter step-size adaptation that can be added on top of any first-order optimizer, and removed from it, without altering its update direction. AURA measures the agreement between consecutive updates of each complex parameter, in length, alignment, and sense of rotation, and enlarges the step when they are consistent and reduces it when they are not. It requires no additional gradient evaluations and only inexpensive vector operations per step. We combine AURA with Adam and Muon and compare the resulting methods with well-known first-order optimizers on four test cases of increasing complexity, ranging from the approximation of scalar complex functions to physics-informed training. Fully connected neural networks are used throughout this work. All hyperparameters other than the step size are held fixed across test cases; for one case, we also tune the hyperparameters of each optimizer under the same budget. Our empirical tests show that AURA improves the convergence of its base optimizer in most cases with a small per-step overhead, and we identify the conditions under which it fails to do so.

AI.tldr: AURA 是一种面向复值神经网络的逐参数步长自适应方法，利用相邻复参数更新在长度、方向与旋转方向上的“一致性”来放大或缩小步长；它可叠加于任意一阶优化器且不改变更新方向、无需额外梯度计算。与 Adam、Muon 结合后在四个复杂度递增的测试任务中，多数情况下加速收敛，仅有少量每步开销，并给出了失效条件。
AI.motivation: 复值神经网络（CVNNs）越来越多地用于复值数据，但训练常沿用实值一阶优化器。这类方法的效率高度依赖步长，且其步长规则忽略了复平面中可利用的角度信息，因此需要为复域设计更合适的步长自适应机制。
AI.method: 提出 AURA（Angular Update Rate Adaptation），一种可插拔的逐参数步长自适应方法：可加在任意一阶优化器上，也可移除，且不改变其更新方向。AURA 对每个复参数的连续两次更新进行一致性度量，综合考虑长度、对齐程度与旋转方向；当更新一致时增大步长，不一致时减小步长。该方法不增加额外梯度评估，每步仅需廉价的向量运算。作者将 AURA 与 Adam、Muon 结合，并在四个复杂度递增的测试案例中与知名一阶优化器比较，任务从标量复函数逼近到物理信息训练；全程使用全连接神经网络。
AI.result: 除步长外的所有超参数在各测试案例中保持固定；其中一个案例还在相同预算下对各优化器的超参数进行调参。实验表明，AURA 在大多数情况下能改善其基础优化器的收敛性，且每步开销较小；同时作者识别了 AURA 未能带来改进的条件。
AI.conclusion: AURA 为复值神经网络提供了一种通用、低成本、不改方向的步长自适应方案，能有效提升基础一阶优化器的收敛表现，但其收益并非普遍成立，存在明确适用边界。

36c73464f711a5669cc106c72160294189507cf3.title: RankCert: When Can Simulated Learners Safely Select an AI Tutor? Robust Decision Certification Under Structural Uncertainty
36c73464f711a5669cc106c72160294189507cf3.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
36c73464f711a5669cc106c72160294189507cf3.summary: Simulation-based tutor selection can be unstable when predictively adequate learner models imply different policy rankings. RankCert certifies one of eight equal-budget tutoring policies only when model-averaged utility, probability-best, posterior regret, cross-domain rank, family coverage, and leave-one-domain-out and leave-one-visible-family-out averages support the same candidate; otherwise it abstains. We evaluated RankCert in 1,280 frozen held-out settings spanning five rotating held-out oracle families, 64 scenarios per family, and four cohort sizes. Calibration used a licensed, de-identified EdNet-KT1 derivative with 5,000 learners and 590,056 retained responses; all five family representatives passed the frozen adequacy gate. Minimum-domain mean pairwise top-1 agreement was 0.272917 (95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]), showing substantial structural disagreement. Cohort-noise variance decreased from n = 30 to n = 300, while the structural family share remained nonzero. RankCert reduced total held-out decision loss relative to full-coverage point selection by 0.006605 normalized-outcome units (95% CI [0.004859, 0.008407]). At comparable coverage, however, it did not reduce selective risk relative to a confidence-gated point certificate (difference -0.000213; 95% CI [-0.003238, 0.002384]; Holm p = 0.929654). Certification occurred in 3.75% of settings and only in stable scenarios; RankCert abstained in every ambiguous, misspecified, and structural-conflict setting. "Safe" denotes only benchmark-scoped decision certification under the declared utility and uncertainty set; no human-learning, causal, deployment-effectiveness, or general-safety claim is made.

AI.tldr: RankCert 是一种带弃权机制的政策认证方法：仅当模型平均效用、概率最优、后验遗憾、跨域排名、家族覆盖以及留一域/留一可见家族平均等多项判据一致支持同一候选时，才为八种等预算辅导政策之一颁发认证，否则弃权。在 1280 个冻结留出设置中，该方法将总决策损失相对全覆盖点选择降低约 0.0066（归一化单位），但认证仅发生在 3.75% 的场景，且在同覆盖率下未显著优于置信门控点认证。
AI.motivation: 基于仿真的辅导政策选择在预测充分的多个学习者模型给出不同策略排序时并不稳定。作者希望对这种模型不确定性下的政策排序提供一种有原则的、可弃权的认证机制，避免在存在结构性分歧或模型设定错误时输出不可靠的部署建议。
AI.method: 构建八种等预算辅导政策，并采用七类判据进行一致性认证：模型平均效用、概率最优、后验遗憾、跨域排名、家族覆盖、留一域平均、留一可见家族平均。仅当全部判据支持同一候选时才颁发证书，否则弃权（abstain）。实验在 1280 个冻结留出设置上进行，覆盖五个轮换留出 oracle 家族、每家族 64 个场景、四种队列规模。校准使用经许可、去标识化的 EdNet-KT1 衍生数据集（5000 名学习者、590,056 条保留作答）。
AI.result: 五个家族代表均通过冻结充分性门槛。最低域平均成对 top-1 一致率仅 0.272917（95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]），表明存在显著的结构性分歧。队列噪声方差随 n 从 30 增至 300 而下降，但结构性家族份额仍非零。RankCert 相对全覆盖点选择将总留出决策损失降低 0.006605 个归一化结果单位（95% CI [0.004859, 0.008407]）。但在可比覆盖率下，其选择性风险相对置信门控点认证并未降低（差值 -0.000213；95% CI [-0.003238, 0.002384]；Holm p = 0.929654）。认证仅发生在 3.75% 的设置中，且仅出现在稳定场景；在所有模糊、设定错误和结构性冲突场景中均弃权。
AI.conclusion: RankCert 能在模型排序不稳定的条件下提供保守的决策认证，其有效性主要体现在降低总决策损失和对不稳定场景的弃权保护上，而在同覆盖率的选择性风险上并不优于简单的置信门控基线。作者强调“安全”仅指在既定效用与不确定性集合范围内的基准限定决策认证，不对人类学习、因果、部署有效性或一般安全性作任何主张。

8af2f7fa6de620c093aa2bf24ad20751a48285f6.title: Test-time Reinforcement Learning for Anomalous Video Understanding
8af2f7fa6de620c093aa2bf24ad20751a48285f6.summary: Anomalous video understanding aims to identify abnormal events in videos and interpret their semantic meanings beyond simple anomaly detection. Recent video large language models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated promising zero-shot capabilities for this task, yet their performance remains limited due to insufficient adaptation to diverse anomaly patterns and evolving environments. Test-time reinforcement learning offers a promising solution by enabling models to improve through self-generated feedback signals without requiring additional human annotations. However, applying it to anomalous video understanding remains challenging due to three issues: (1) generated pseudo-labels can be unreliable when consensus is weak; (2) binary reward designs fail to capture uncertainty in model generations, resulting in ineffective optimization signals; and (3) unanimous rollout groups receive identical rewards, causing group-relative advantages to collapse and eliminating effective policy-gradient signals. To address these challenges, we present a novel test-time reinforcement learning framework for anomalous video understanding by introducing dual-query consistency filtering, an entropy-aware consensus reward, and a virtual negative anchor mechanism. The framework retains reliable samples through consistency across semantically equivalent queries, combines answer agreement with generation uncertainty for reward estimation, and introduces a virtual negative anchor to create reward variation in unanimous rollout groups, thereby preserving effective group-relative optimization signals. Experiments on VAU-Bench show that our method outperforms the compared frozen and supervised baselines. The gains are most pronounced on the ECVA subset of VAU-Bench with thinking, where accuracy improves from 75.81% to 90.00% relative to the frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向异常视频理解，提出一种测试时强化学习框架，通过双查询一致性过滤、熵感知共识奖励与虚拟负锚点机制，缓解伪标签不可靠、奖励信号不足和组相对优势坍塌问题，在 VAU-Bench 上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 异常视频理解不仅需检测异常，还需理解其语义。现有 Video-LLM 零样本能力有限，难以适应多样异常模式与动态环境；测试时强化学习可在无人工标注下自我提升，但直接应用面临三个问题：弱共识下伪标签不可靠、二值奖励无法刻画生成不确定性、全一致 rollout 组内奖励相同导致组相对优势坍塌，削弱策略梯度信号。
AI.method: 提出面向异常视频理解的测试时强化学习框架，包含三个核心机制：1）双查询一致性过滤：利用语义等价查询间的一致性保留可靠样本；2）熵感知共识奖励：将答案一致性与生成不确定性结合进行奖励估计；3）虚拟负锚点机制：在全一致的 rollout 组中引入虚拟负锚点以制造奖励差异，从而保留有效的组相对优化信号。
AI.result: 在 VAU-Bench 上，该方法优于对比的冻结基线与监督基线；在 VAU-Bench 的 ECVA 子集且启用 thinking 时提升最显著，准确率由冻结骨干的 75.81% 提升至 90.00%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，针对测试时强化学习中的伪标签可靠性、奖励不确定性与组相对优势坍塌进行联合设计，可有效提升 Video-LLM 在异常视频理解任务中的自适应能力与零样本/测试时性能。

d914e3b9d46c3396cfa816630d4c170be1c274f1.title: Destination Support Restoration for Finite-Set Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
d914e3b9d46c3396cfa816630d4c170be1c274f1.comment: Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
d914e3b9d46c3396cfa816630d4c170be1c274f1.summary: Robots operating around pedestrians often reason over a finite set of predicted human futures. Repeated online updates can concentrate this limited prediction budget on dominant destinations and leave plausible alternatives underrepresented or absent, removing those alternatives from the finite representation available to downstream decision making. We introduce Destination Support Restoration (DSR), a causal post-selection operator that repairs destination support without retraining the host predictor or increasing the maintained set size. At a repair step, DSR evaluates a temporary destination-stratified candidate bank from the observed prefix, converts candidate evidence into integer target counts, protects representatives of active modes, and reallocates redundant surplus hypotheses to deficient modes. The maintained and returned sets retain exactly $N$ hypotheses, and DSR replaces at most $\lceilρN\rceil$ entries. Protected representatives preserve current categorical support; lineage-aware particle filters also preserve surviving resampling ancestors. Each replacement reduces the allocation mismatch to the evidence-driven target by one. On the complete 3,719-trajectory Edinburgh protocol over three seeds, DSR reduces MIF weighted ADE and FDE by 13.36% and 13.30% at $N=64$. Paired integrations with CLiFF, PPT, causal GDTS, Social Informer, and PECNet improve both metrics in every evaluated pair. These results show that finite-set support allocation is a useful prediction-side control point when a fixed hypothesis set serves as the interface to downstream systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Destination Support Restoration（DSR），一种因果后选择算子：在不重新训练宿主预测器、不增大维护集合规模的前提下，修复有限假设集的目的地支持分配。DSR 在修复步骤基于观测前缀构建按目的地分层的临时候选库，将候选证据转换为整数目标计数，保护活跃模态的代表，并将冗余盈余假设重新分配给不足模态；维护集与返回集始终恰好保留 N 个假设，且最多替换 ⌈ρN⌉ 个条目。每次替换都将分配与证据驱动目标之间的失配减少 1。
AI.motivation: 机器人在行人周围作业时通常只在有限的人类未来预测集合上进行推理。重复的在线更新会把有限的预测预算集中于主导目的地，使合理的替代目的地被欠表示甚至缺失，从而把这些替代方案从下游决策可用的有限表示中剔除。因此需要一个不改变集合规模、不重训模型即可修复支持分配的控制手段。
AI.method: DSR 是一种因果后选择算子：1）在修复步骤从观测前缀评估临时的、按目的地分层的候选库；2）将候选证据转换为整数目标计数；3）保护活跃模态的代表以维持当前分类支持；4）将冗余盈余假设重分配至不足模态。对血缘感知的粒子滤波，还保留存活的 resampling 祖先。全程保持集合规模为 N，替换量不超过 ⌈ρN⌉，每次替换将分配失配降低 1，无需重训宿主预测器或扩大维护集。
AI.result: 在完整的 3,719 条轨迹 Edinburgh 协议、三个随机种子下，当 N=64 时 DSR 将 MIF 加权 ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 13.36% 与 13.30%。与 CLiFF、PPT、causal GDTS、Social Informer、PECNet 的配对集成中，每一组评估均同时改善两项指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当固定的有限假设集作为下游系统的接口时，有限集的“支持分配”是一个有效的预测侧控制点。

8180f838f0b6f6d065a4c8587dfc54c082d2fe33.title: Beyond Scalar Sensitivity: Activation-Aware Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization with Cross-Layer Refinement
8180f838f0b6f6d065a4c8587dfc54c082d2fe33.summary: Mixed-precision weight quantization is commonly formulated as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), yet existing solvers rely on scalar sensitivity proxies that collapse each weight matrix's Hessian into a single number and treat every module independently. We prove that even the optimal scalar proxy incurs multiplicative distortion up to $\sqrt{κ(\mathbf{A})κ(\mathbf{B})}$ relative to the full activation-aware quadratic, where $κ(\mathbf{A})$ and $κ(\mathbf{B})$ denote the condition numbers of the input- and output-side Hessian factors. This bound varies from $10^1$ to $10^{13}$ for typical LLM modules, making inter-module sensitivity ranking unreliable. To address these limitations, we propose Cross-layer Activation-aware Sensitivity Allocation (CASA), a two-phase method. In Stage 1, the scalar proxy is replaced by an activation-aware metric derived from the Kronecker-factored Hessian, reducing the MCKP to a form whose continuous relaxation admits a closed-form solution. In Stage 2, a cross-layer-aware local search evaluates bit-width updates using the end-to-end model loss. Experiments on multiple LLMs across different bit budgets show that CASA achieves lower perplexity than the latest scalar-proxy baselines, especially at ultra-low bit-widths ($<3$ bits per weight). Moreover, the performance gain in zero-shot accuracy tracks the per-model average condition-number over modules, confirming the distortion bound as a practical indicator of scalar-proxy failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出混合精度权重量化中常用的标量敏感度代理会把每个权重矩阵的Hessian压缩为单个数并独立处理模块，导致模块间敏感度排序不可靠；作者证明了标量代理相对完整激活感知二次型存在可达 \(\sqrt{\kappa(\mathbf{A})\kappa(\mathbf{B})}\) 的乘性失真，并提出两阶段方法 CASA：用基于Kronecker分解Hessian的激活感知度量替代标量代理，并通过跨层局部搜索优化比特宽度。
AI.motivation: 混合精度权重量化通常建模为多选择背包问题（MCKP），但现有求解器依赖标量敏感度代理：将每个权重矩阵的Hessian坍缩为单一数值，并把各模块独立处理。作者旨在揭示这种简化在LLM模块中的理论缺陷，并解决由此导致的跨模块敏感度排序不可靠问题。
AI.method: 论文首先从理论上证明，即使采用最优标量代理，相对于完整的激活感知二次型也会产生最高达 \(\sqrt{\kappa(\mathbf{A})\kappa(\mathbf{B})}\) 的乘性失真，其中 \(\kappa(\mathbf{A})\)、\(\kappa(\mathbf{B})\) 分别为输入侧和输出侧Hessian因子的条件数。为缓解该问题，提出 Cross-layer Activation-aware Sensitivity Allocation（CASA）两阶段方法：Stage 1 用由Kronecker分解Hessian导出的激活感知度量替代标量代理，将MCKP转化为连续松弛具有闭式解的形式；Stage 2 使用跨层感知的局部搜索，基于端到端模型损失评估比特宽度更新。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和不同比特预算上的实验表明，CASA相比最新的标量代理基线取得更低的困惑度，尤其在超低比特宽度（每权重小于3比特）时优势明显。此外，零样本准确率上的性能增益与各模型模块平均条件数相关，验证了所推导的失真上界可作为标量代理失效的实用指标。
AI.conclusion: 标量敏感度代理在LLM混合精度量化中存在可量化的乘性失真，其严重程度可由Hessian因子的条件数刻画；采用激活感知的Kronecker分解度量与跨层局部搜索的CASA能有效提升低比特量化性能，且条件数可作为判断标量代理可靠性的诊断指标。

4435841cf43286dbdb2304f28f1c274f26641057.title: Selection-Invariant Communication Compilers for Privacy-Aware Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
4435841cf43286dbdb2304f28f1c274f26641057.summary: Structured multi-agent workflows exchange intermediate messages whose content and form can reveal private state even when the final output is safe. We identify selection-channel leakage: after authorization fixes what may be released, a private-state-aware choice among semantically valid realizations creates an additional inference channel. We introduce the selection-invariant communication compiler(SICC), which constrains this post-authorization representation kernel rather than prescribing templates. Any deterministic or independently public-randomized generator satisfying the invariant is valid; requirement-indexed canonical forms are one auditable implementation. We prove a compositional communication-layer guarantee: authorization, public-only form generation, and a dependency-safe utility gate make the emitted transcript reveal no information beyond the complete authorized view. Private-state-aware selection remains vulnerable after surface-disjoint and length-matched controls. Across 132 AgentLeak communication replays and 100 executable LangGraph tasks, deterministic SICC retains complete protocol utility without a positive excess-gain signal; independent public randomization preserves the same result in AgentLeak and 480 controlled cases.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出多智能体工作流在授权之后仍存在的“选择通道泄漏”，并提出选择不变通信编译器SICC，通过约束授权后表示核而非固定模板，使确定性或独立公共随机化生成器均满足不泄露超出授权视图的保证，并在AgentLeak与LangGraph任务中保持协议效用且不产生正超额增益。
AI.motivation: 结构化多智能体工作流会交换中间消息，其内容与形式即使最终输出安全，也可能泄露私有状态。现有授权机制只规定“可以发布什么”，却忽略了授权后在多个语义有效实现之间进行私有状态感知选择所新增的推理通道。
AI.method: 作者形式化“选择通道泄漏”：授权固定可发布内容后，私有状态感知地在语义等价实现中选择会形成额外推断通道。提出SICC，约束授权后的表示核而非规定模板；任何满足不变量的确定性或独立公共随机化生成器均有效，需求索引的规范化形式是一种可审计实现。方法还证明组合式通信层保证：授权、仅公共形式生成与依赖安全效用门共同作用，使输出转录不泄露超出完整授权视图的信息，并用表面不相交和长度匹配控制进行检验。
AI.result: 在132个AgentLeak通信回放和100个可执行LangGraph任务中，确定性SICC保持完整协议效用且未出现正超额增益信号；独立公共随机化在AgentLeak及480个控制案例中保持相同结果。同时，私有状态感知选择在表面不相交与长度匹配控制后仍然脆弱，说明选择通道是独立泄漏面。
AI.conclusion: SICC将隐私保护从内容授权扩展到授权后的表示选择，提供可组合通信层保证和可审计实现路径。结果表明，多智能体工作流需显式约束授权后的选择机制，仅靠表面形式控制或长度匹配不足以消除私有状态推断风险。

7f8601f8ed14d63baa9695277ae44a04351f40b9.title: MIAR: Medical Image Super-Resolution With Autoregressive Modeling
7f8601f8ed14d63baa9695277ae44a04351f40b9.summary: Medical Image Super-Resolution (MISR) aims to enhance spatial resolution without requiring hardware modifications. Although deep learning has yielded promising results, existing paradigms face a critical trade-off: diffusion-based methods suffer from prohibitive inference latency and compromised structural fidelity, whereas regression-based models typically produce over-smoothed results that lack perceptual realism. To address these limitations, we propose MIAR, which reformulates super-resolution as a conditional and progressive next-scale prediction task through a multi-scale autoregressive framework. To ensure structural fidelity, we augment the autoregressive backbone with a Scale-Adaptive Structural Decoder. Furthermore, we integrate a hierarchical beam search strategy during inference to mitigate the recursive error accumulation inherent in autoregressive generation, a phenomenon that is especially pronounced in medical images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIAR establishes new state-of-the-art benchmarks while maintaining superior fidelity. Notably, our framework achieves a 7.86% improvement in the perceptual metric MUSIQ compared with the state of the art, while simultaneously delivering a 2.02x speedup over diffusion-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MIAR，将医学图像超分辨率（MISR）重新表述为多尺度自回归的下一尺度预测任务，并引入尺度自适应结构解码器与分层束搜索，兼顾结构保真度与感知真实感，同时实现高质量与高效率。
AI.motivation: 医学图像超分辨率的目标是在不改变硬件的前提下提升空间分辨率。现有深度学习范式存在关键的两难：基于扩散的方法推理延迟高且结构保真度受损；基于回归的模型则往往产生过度平滑、缺乏感知真实感的结果。因此需要一种既能保持结构保真又具备感知真实感、且推理高效的新范式。
AI.method: 提出 MIAR 框架，将超分辨率重新表述为条件化、渐进式的"下一尺度预测"任务，通过多尺度自回归框架实现。为保证结构保真度，在自回归主干上引入尺度自适应结构解码器（Scale-Adaptive Structural Decoder）。在推理阶段，整合分层束搜索（hierarchical beam search）策略，以缓解自回归生成中固有的递归误差累积问题（该问题在医学图像中尤为突出）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MIAR 建立了新的最先进基准，同时保持优越的保真度。感知指标 MUSIQ 相比最先进方法提升 7.86%，同时相比基于扩散的方法实现 2.02 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: MIAR 通过多尺度自回归范式结合尺度自适应结构解码器与分层束搜索，有效缓解了扩散方法的高延迟/低保真与回归方法的过度平滑之间的权衡，在医学图像超分辨率上同时实现了更高的感知质量、更强的结构保真度与更高的推理效率。

ec513459f59eb73f61efdc8ce21344566dd6c11b.title: An Action Is Worth One Patch: Unified World-Action Modeling with PatchWAM
ec513459f59eb73f61efdc8ce21344566dd6c11b.summary: Generative visual models offer a foundation for learning representations of physical dynamics, yet their extension to continuous control raises a fundamental question: do visual prediction and action generation require separate computational pathways? Existing approaches usually introduce trainable action heads or separate action experts to bridge low-dimensional states and high-dimensional visual representations. In this work, we explore whether the visual backbone's existing capacity can also support control when actions are expressed in a compatible representation. Thus, we introduce PatchWAM (Patch World-Action Model), which treats continuous actions as another type of patch through a fixed mapping called Action-as-Patch. This allows a single model to predict both how the robot should move and what the scene may look like afterward. Visual prediction and action generation become parts of the same generative process, without a dedicated action head or separate action expert. Experiments with subsampled training windows show gains over a matched dual-expert control, while benchmark evaluations reach 91.8% success rate on LIBERO-Plus and 96.12% on RoboTwin 2.0 in a full-data setting with additional augmented demonstrations. More broadly, the result suggests that capability need not be added where it can be inherited: the constraint on extending a generative backbone is the interface a new signal is written in, not the capacity to model it.

AI.tldr: 提出 PatchWAM，通过 Action-as-Patch 固定映射将连续动作视为一种 patch，使单一生成式视觉骨干同时完成视觉预测与动作生成，无需独立动作头或动作专家；在 LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 生成式视觉模型为物理动力学表征学习提供了基础，但扩展到连续控制时存在一个核心问题：视觉预测与动作生成是否需要分离的计算通路。现有方法通常引入可训练动作头或独立动作专家，以桥接低维状态与高维视觉表征，增加了架构复杂度并可能割裂统一的生成过程。作者希望验证：当动作被表示为与视觉骨干兼容的形式时，视觉骨干自身是否已具备支持控制的能力。
AI.method: 提出 PatchWAM（Patch World-Action Model）。核心是 Action-as-Patch：通过固定映射将连续动作表示为另一类 patch，使动作与视觉 token 处于同一表征空间。由此，单一模型在同一生成过程中同时预测机器人应如何运动以及场景随后的变化，无需专门的动作头或分离的动作专家。训练与评估涵盖子采样训练窗口设置，并与匹配的双专家控制基线进行比较。
AI.result: 在子采样训练窗口实验中，PatchWAM 相对匹配的双专家控制取得增益；基准评估在完整数据设置并加入额外增强演示时，于 LIBERO-Plus 达到 91.8% 成功率，在 RoboTwin 2.0 达到 96.12% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，能力不必在需要处新增，而可以继承：扩展生成式骨干的约束在于新信号被写入的接口形式，而非模型对该信号的建模容量。将动作以兼容表示接入统一生成过程，即可让视觉骨干同时承担视觉预测与控制生成。

133cc3225d9f9b8b79a5f31676fdb6455e2fc8c6.title: Certified Against Which Oracle? Execution Labels Set the Reported Risk of Conformal Abstention for Text-to-SQL
133cc3225d9f9b8b79a5f31676fdb6455e2fc8c6.summary: A conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL is only as truthful as the correctness labels it is calibrated on. The uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency take those labels from the single database a benchmark ships, an oracle known to be lenient. We run a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic, swapping that database for the benchmark's distilled multi-instance test suite. Across four SQL-specialist checkpoints and two split schemes, the swap raises the certificate's held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report. Neither oracle reports the risk experts assign. Under blinded labels from two SQL experts, a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints. The stricter oracle errs in both directions: most of the answers it rejects are not judged wrong, and some of those it accepts are. An AI-assigned census of what it rejects finds a semantic error in a quarter to a third of them, depending on the population. It attributes most of the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances or suspected reference-query defects, a flag supported by a preregistered blinded expert audit. The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Every execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations. Under expert labels, building such a score on suite clusters instead of shipped-database clusters raises its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) by 6.96 points on one checkpoint and 1.53 on the other. On the second, the expert interval excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. A certificate should be reported with both oracles, and an oracle-relative difference read as semantic risk only after the benchmark is audited. A consistency score should be evaluated under an oracle that did not build it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册干预实验证明：text-to-SQL 的 conformal 弃权证书（abstention certificate）的可靠性完全受限于其校准所用的正确性标签（oracle）。在 Spider-Realistic 上，用基准蒸馏的多实例测试套件替换原有单一数据库后，证书的留出风险被显著低估；且两个 oracle 均无法复现专家判定的风险。因此证书应同时报告两个 oracle，一致性评分应在未参与其构建的 oracle 下评估。
AI.motivation: conformal 弃权证书的真实性取决于其校准所依赖的正确性标签，而现有不确定性流程从基准自带的单一数据库读取执行一致性标签，该 oracle 已知偏宽松（lenient）。作者要检验：更换 oracle 会如何改变证书所报告的风险、以及评分本身的评估。
AI.method: 在 Spider-Realistic 上进行预注册干预：将原有单一数据库替换为基准蒸馏的多实例测试套件。覆盖四个 SQL 专用检查点和两种划分方案。引入两名 SQL 专家的盲标标签，并对更严格 oracle 的拒绝样本做 AI 标注普查，另以预注册的盲审专家复核其标记。
AI.result: 替换 oracle 后，证书留出风险比其自身标签所报告高出 2.73–10.23 个百分点；两个 oracle 均未复现专家判定的风险。在专家盲标下，名义 0.10 校准的证书在两项检查点上实际风险达 20.0 和 17.2 个百分点。更严格的 oracle 双向出错：多数被拒答案并非被判错误，部分被接受的实为错误；AI 普查发现其拒绝样本中 1/4 至 1/3 存在语义错误。每个执行一致性评分在其聚类构建所用 oracle 的标签下都表现更优（16/16）。在专家标签下，用套件聚类替代自带数据库聚类使 AUROC 在两项检查点上分别提升 6.96 和 1.53 个百分点，第二项上专家区间排除了套件标签报告的 8.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 证书应同时用两个 oracle 报告；oracle 相对差异只有在基准经过审计后才能解读为语义风险；一致性评分应在未参与其构建的 oracle 下进行评估。

e5e25511615b523a7f3604334c1dbf990a270704.title: The Architect, the Adversary, and the Judge: Closed-Loop Generation of Standards-Aligned Assessment Items at Scale
e5e25511615b523a7f3604334c1dbf990a270704.comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Companion paper: arXiv:2608.01000
e5e25511615b523a7f3604334c1dbf990a270704.summary: We present CLAIM, a production pipeline for K-12 assessment-item generation coupling a two-stage generate-then-attack protocol (the model drafts as a "curriculum architect", then re-enters the same conversation as a hostile adversarial reviewer), bi-directional few-shot conditioning on accepted and rejected items, the latter carrying the evaluator's diagnosis, and a knowledge dictionary of 44,844 error-correction rules mined from that feedback and retrieved per standard and item type. Across 43,227 scored items over 755 Common Core ELA standards, three item types, and ten LLMs, the pipeline reaches a 97.8% expert-evaluator pass rate on a 9,074-item production run. We then ask what that rate certifies. Re-scoring a stratified sample with three judges from other vendors, blind to the deployed verdict, reproduces the format ordering under every judge and recovers a larger open-set deficit than the deployed evaluator does; but agreement on the accept/reject binary is weak at production prevalence (kappa about 0.13), and the judges agree with each other no better. The level is therefore judge-relative, and with no student-response data our quality evidence is evaluator-judged throughout. The corpus also exposes a robust asymmetry. Multiple-choice and multiple-select generation saturate at 98% or above for both frontier models under a dozen static rules, whereas fill-in-the-blank generation is capability-tiered (82.8-96.7% across five models under a matched rule set, standards, and judge) and plateaus under prompt-only optimization, with error mass shifting between answer-key over-inclusion and omission as rules accumulate. We analyze this as open-set boundary determination, a task autoregressive decoders are structurally ill-equipped to solve, and show the asymmetry recurring when the evaluator itself is distilled: fail-recall rises from 8% to 63% while F1 saturates at 0.25.

AI.tldr: CLAIM 是一套面向 K-12 测评题目生成的量产流水线，采用"先生成、后攻击"的两阶段协议、双向少样本条件化以及包含 44,844 条纠错规则的知识字典，在 9,074 题的正式运行中达到 97.8% 的专家评审通过率；但作者进一步论证该通过率是"相对评审者"的，并揭示不同题型间的稳健不对称性。
AI.motivation: 大规模生成合规的 K-12 测评题目具有实际需求，但"高通过率"本身能否证明题目质量存疑。作者因此既要构建可量产的高质量生成流水线，又要追问：这一通过率究竟认证了什么，其质量证据在缺乏学生作答数据时是否可靠。
AI.method: 1) 两阶段"生成—攻击"协议：模型先以"课程架构师"身份起草，再在同一对话中切换为敌意对抗评审者；2) 双向少样本条件化，同时利用被接受与被拒绝的样本，后者附带评审者的诊断意见；3) 从反馈中挖掘出 44,844 条纠错规则构成知识字典，按标准与题型检索使用。评估覆盖 755 个 Common Core ELA 标准、3 种题型、10 个 LLM、共 43,227 道计分题。
AI.result: 正式运行的 9,074 题上专家评审通过率达 97.8%。用三家其他供应商、对部署结论盲评的三位评审者对分层样本重打分：所有评审者都复现了题型排序，且比部署评审者揭示出更大的开集缺陷；但在生产流行度下接受/拒绝二元判断的一致性很弱（kappa 约 0.13），评审者彼此间一致性同样低。稳健不对称性：选择题与多选题在十余条静态规则下对前沿模型即饱和至 98% 以上；填空题为能力分层（同一规则集、标准与评审者下五个模型为 82.8%–96.7%），且在仅靠提示优化时出现平台期，错误质量随规则累积在"答案键过度包含"与"遗漏"之间转移。将评审者自身蒸馏后该不对称复现：失败召回从 8% 升至 63%，而 F1 饱和于 0.25。
AI.conclusion: 该质量水平是"相对评审者"的，且在无学生作答数据的情况下，质量证据全程由评审者判定。作者将填空题的困难解释为"开集边界判定"问题——自回归解码器在结构上不擅解决此类任务，并指出该不对称在评审者被蒸馏后依然复现。

c375d23fd1d6d21f5ea8a39ca31bb21d70b29af8.title: Vorch-Human: Unified Multi-Task Human-Centric Generation via Long-Horizon Continuation
c375d23fd1d6d21f5ea8a39ca31bb21d70b29af8.summary: Human-centric audio-visual generation spans several closely related tasks: animating a person from driving speech, jointly generating speech and video from a voice reference, and synthesizing a scene from paired appearance and voice references. Existing systems commonly solve these tasks with separate models, even though they share the same target modalities and differ mainly in which observations are provided as conditions. We present Vorch-Human, a unified human-centric generation framework built on a dual-stream audio-video diffusion transformer. Vorch-Human augments the conventional noisy audio/noisy video interface with clean condition-audio and condition-video token groups. Per-token task embeddings, temporal position types, condition masks, and a shared multimodal prompt encoder allow driving speech, timbre examples, first frames, and subject images to be expressed within one model. To supply the supervision required by this interface, we develop a two-level data pipeline. Level 1 analyzes each clip with speech recognition, vocal separation, face detection and tracking, active-speaker and synchronization models, audio/visual speaker clustering, and multimodal caption correction; it produces subject-indexed speech, appearance, and timbre annotations. Level 2 links the same person across clips from a common source video and mines identity- and outfit-consistent reference images after face, body, quality, pose, and vision-language verification. Finally, we adapt Vorch-Human to long-form audio-driven generation by training with clean latent prefixes and using the same frozen-prefix recurrence at inference. Each segment contributes only its newly generated suffix, reducing boundary discontinuity and long-horizon identity drift. Experiments on short and five-minute generation demonstrate strong identity preservation, audio-visual synchronization, and temporal stability.

AI.tldr: Vorch-Human 是一个基于双流音视频扩散 Transformer 的统一人物中心生成框架，用干净的条件token组将语音驱动动画、语音-视频联合生成、场景合成三任务统一到同一模型，并配套两级数据流水线，最后通过干净潜前缀与冻结前缀递推实现长时段生成。
AI.motivation: 人物中心的音视频生成包含若干高度相关任务（由语音驱动人物动画、由音色参考联合生成语音与视频、由外观与语音参考合成场景），它们共享相同的目标模态，仅条件观测不同。但现有系统通常为每个任务训练独立模型，参数与数据复用差、缺乏统一性。
AI.method: 核心模型为双流音视频扩散 Transformer（dual-stream audio-video diffusion transformer）。在常规"噪声音频/噪声视频"接口上额外引入干净的条件-音频与条件-视频 token 组，并配合 per-token 任务嵌入、时间位置类型、条件掩码和共享多模态提示编码器，使驱动语音、音色样例、首帧、主体图像均可在同一模型内表达。数据方面提出两级流水线：Level 1 用语音识别、人声分离、人脸检测与跟踪、活跃说话人、同步模型、音视频说话人聚类和多模态字幕矫正，产出以主体索引的语音、外观、音色标注；Level 2 在同一源视频的跨片段中关联同一人物，经人脸、身体、质量、姿态与视觉-语言校验后挖掘身份与服装一致的参考图。长时段扩展上，采用干净潜前缀训练，并在推理时复用相同的冻结前缀递推，每段只贡献新生成的后缀。
AI.result: 在短视频与五分钟长视频生成任务上，均表现出较强的身份保持能力、良好的音视频同步性以及时间稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一接口、任务嵌入与精心设计的数据标注/挖掘流水线，Vorch-Human 将多个相关的人物中心生成任务整合为单一框架，并以冻结前缀递推缓解长时段生成中的边界不连续与身份漂移问题，验证了统一建模的有效性。

43eac3f5653145aa8a0771ff66a0ef0585670ba9.title: Predict Before You Step: Auditable Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance under Sparse Guidance
43eac3f5653145aa8a0771ff66a0ef0585670ba9.summary: Legged robots under sparse waypoint guidance must avoid moving obstacles using partial, rapidly changing LiDAR observations. We present LOOP (Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy), a local avoidance policy that connects sparse waypoint guidance to a frozen locomotion controller at 50 Hz. From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates. These maps guide velocity selection through map-derived features and geometric risk estimates, providing an explicit interface for inspecting and replacing predictions. In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive baseline by 8.2 percentage points. Comparisons with a rollout-free BEV policy show smaller, scenario-dependent gains from the prediction branch, including improved crossing success and reduced variability across training seeds at the highest head-on speeds. The adapter runs onboard a Unitree Go2 in 14.5 ms per step and completes all 16 real-world crossing trials without collision, demonstrating deployment feasibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOOP，一种面向稀疏路点引导的足式机器人局部避障策略：从占据栅格与自速度历史用循环预测器预测未来 1 s 占据，并通过显式地图特征驱动 50 Hz 速度选择，连接冻结的运动控制器。仿真中迎头避障成功率 57.1%，优于重训练反应式基线 8.2 个百分点；机载 Unitree Go2 单步 14.5 ms，16 次真实穿越试验零碰撞。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人在稀疏路点引导下，需仅依赖部分、快速变化的 LiDAR 观测避让动态障碍。核心动机是：在局部避障中引入对未来占据的显式预测，以提升动态场景下的前瞻性与安全性，同时保持与既有运动控制器的可插拔连接和实时部署能力。
AI.method: LOOP 作为局部避障策略，以 50 Hz 连接稀疏路点引导与冻结的运动控制器。输入为占据历史和自速度历史；循环预测器通过学习的 flow 与 visibility gates 对当前地图进行 warping，预测未来 1 s 的占据栅格。预测地图进一步生成地图派生特征与几何风险估计，用于速度选择；该接口显式可检查、可替换。评估采用 encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab，并与重训练反应式基线、无 rollout 的 BEV 策略对比。
AI.result: 在障碍速度 2.5–3.2 m/s 的迎头场景中，LOOP 成功率为 57.1%，比重训练反应式基线高 8.2 个百分点。与无 rollout 的 BEV 策略相比，预测分支带来的增益较小且依赖场景，但在最高迎头速度下改善了横穿成功率并降低了不同训练种子间的方差。适配器在 Unitree Go2 上机载运行，单步耗时 14.5 ms；真实世界 16 次横穿试验全部无碰撞完成。
AI.conclusion: LOOP 表明：将循环占据 rollout 预测嵌入局部避障接口，可在动态障碍下提升迎头与横穿避障表现，并具备机载实时性与真实机器人部署可行性。其预测分支收益具有场景依赖性，显式预测接口为后续检查与替换预测模块提供了可扩展设计。

c9ceecace9dafcf1d3dcbf72b8723e361bcc2ca8.title: Exploring Solver-Level Warmstarting for Neural Network Verification
c9ceecace9dafcf1d3dcbf72b8723e361bcc2ca8.comment: to be published in the postproceedings of WORKSHOP ON SECURE AND TRUSTWORTHY AI (2026) co-located with the European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases
c9ceecace9dafcf1d3dcbf72b8723e361bcc2ca8.summary: Neural network verification has become a key tool for providing formal guarantees on the behaviour of neural networks. However, many verification problems remain computationally intractable in the worst case: even for common adversarial robustness specifications, verification is NP-complete. Here, we explore the application of solver-level warmstarting for neural network verification to exploit information from previous solutions. We study the effect on running time as several properties are modified, including perturbation radii, input data and the networks themselves, using a pipeline that is generalisable and potentially adaptable to state-of-the-art verifiers. Our results show that warmstarting can significantly reduce verification time in most cases. Moreover, warmstarting enables the successful verification of instances that could not be solved from scratch within the given time limit.

AI.tldr: 该文研究在神经网络验证中引入求解器级热启动（solver-level warmstarting），通过复用先前求解信息来加速验证；实验表明在扰动半径、输入数据和网络发生变化时，热启动通常能显著减少验证时间，并能在时限内解决从头求解无法完成的实例。
AI.motivation: 神经网络验证虽能为网络行为提供形式化保证，但最坏情况下计算不可行，即使是常见的对抗鲁棒性验证问题也是 NP-完全问题，因此需要提升求解效率。
AI.method: 探索将求解器级热启动用于神经网络验证，以利用先前求解结果中的信息；设计通用且可潜在适配先进验证器的流水线，并在扰动半径、输入数据和网络本身等属性变化时评估其运行时间影响。
AI.result: 在大多数情况下，热启动可显著降低验证时间；同时，它使一些在给定时间限制内无法从头求解的实例能够被成功验证。
AI.conclusion: 求解器级热启动是提升神经网络验证效率的有效手段，具有通用性和可扩展性，尤其适合利用相关验证问题之间的相似性来加速求解并扩大可验证实例范围。

b4b510413effaa8314cc4eb31c40c50006452892.title: FusionMMT: A Unified Multimodal and Multitask Learning Framework for Nuclear Fusion
b4b510413effaa8314cc4eb31c40c50006452892.summary: With the growing global demand for energy, nuclear fusion has emerged as a promising direction for future clean energy. Tokamaks represent one of the leading approaches to magnetic-confinement fusion. Achieving high-performance, long-pulse, and steady-state operation requires effective diagnosis of plasma states. However, existing intelligent diagnostic methods are largely limited to either multimodal single-task or unimodal multitask learning, while a unified multimodal multitask learning framework remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct EAST-VTD640, a multimodal multitask dataset that integrates vision and time-series diagnostics from 640 EAST shots for disruption prediction, edge-localized mode (ELM) recognition, and H98 regression. On this basis, we present FusionMMT, the first unified multimodal multitask framework for intelligent tokamak plasma diagnostics. FusionMMT employs multi-scale, time-aware, and variable-aware modeling to handle heterogeneous sampling rates and the high computational cost of high-frequency sequences. It further combines task-adaptive multimodal fusion with progressive multitask optimization to learn shared and task-specific representations while mitigating cross-task conflicts and optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on EAST-VTD640 show that FusionMMT outperforms representative multimodal multitask methods across disruption prediction, ELM recognition, and H98 regression. The source code will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了面向EAST托卡马克的多模态多任务数据集 EAST-VTD640，并提出首个统一多模态多任务等离子体诊断框架 FusionMMT，在破裂预测、ELM 识别与 H98 回归三类任务上均优于代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 实现磁约束聚变高性能、长脉冲、稳态运行需要有效的等离子体状态诊断。然而现有智能诊断方法大多局限于"多模态单任务"或"单模态多任务"范式，缺乏统一的多模态多任务学习框架，难以同时利用异构诊断数据并兼顾多类诊断任务。
AI.method: 1) 构建 EAST-VTD640 数据集，融合 640 次 EAST 炮次的视觉与时序诊断信号，支持破裂预测、边缘局域模（ELM）识别和 H98 回归三任务；2) 提出 FusionMMT 统一框架，采用多尺度、时间感知与变量感知建模以应对异构采样率和高频序列的高计算开销；3) 结合任务自适应多模态融合与渐进式多任务优化，学习共享与任务特定表征，缓解跨任务冲突与优化不平衡。
AI.result: 在 EAST-VTD640 上的大量实验表明，FusionMMT 在破裂预测、ELM 识别和 H98 回归三个任务上均优于代表性多模态多任务方法。源代码将在 https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion 发布。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了统一多模态多任务等离子体诊断框架的空白，通过数据集与统一框架的结合，验证了多模态多任务学习在托卡马克智能诊断中的有效性，为聚变装置的长期稳态运行诊断提供了新思路。

0b1b1b0997c8326a1286928e2d768725e1c2cd5f.title: Moving6DPoSe: A Multimodal Database for Monocular 6D Pose Estimation and Segmentation of Moving Objects
0b1b1b0997c8326a1286928e2d768725e1c2cd5f.summary: Estimating the 6D pose of moving objects remains challenging due to motion blur and the limited temporal resolution of conventional frame-based cameras. Existing event-based datasets further provide limited sensing modalities, annotations, and motion scenarios. We introduce Moving6DPoSe, a multimodal database comprising two complementary subsets: Moving6DPoSe-R with real-world recordings and Moving6DPoSe-S with synthetic sequences generated from the same objects. The dataset contains 16 scanned objects and 1,702 real and synthetic rosbags spanning multiple motion scenarios, with annotations for semantic segmentation, object detection, and monocular 6D pose estimation. We further provide baseline results for all three tasks across frame and event-based modalities. Experimental results show that event-based representations achieve more robust moving-object segmentation than conventional RGB images, while monocular orientation estimation remains challenging, highlighting the potential of Moving6DPoSe for moving-object perception research.

AI.tldr: 提出 Moving6DPoSe 多模态数据集，包含真实（R）与合成（S）两个子集，覆盖 16 个扫描物体、1,702 个 rosbag 及多运动场景，并提供语义分割、目标检测和单目 6D 位姿标注与基线。实验表明事件表示在运动目标分割上优于 RGB，但单目朝向估计仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 运动目标的 6D 位姿估计受运动模糊和传统帧相机时间分辨率限制；现有基于事件的数据集在传感模态、标注类型和运动场景方面较为有限，难以支撑运动目标感知研究。
AI.method: 构建 Moving6DPoSe 多模态数据库：Moving6DPoSe-R 为真实录制，Moving6DPoSe-S 为由相同物体生成的合成序列；包含 16 个扫描物体、1,702 个真实与合成 rosbag，覆盖多种运动场景，并提供语义分割、目标检测和单目 6D 位姿估计标注；同时给出帧模态与事件模态下三项任务的基线结果。
AI.result: 事件表示在运动目标分割上比传统 RGB 图像更鲁棒；单目朝向估计仍然困难，说明运动目标 6D 位姿估计尚未充分解决。
AI.conclusion: Moving6DPoSe 为运动目标感知研究提供了多模态、多任务、真实与合成互补的数据基础，并揭示事件模态在分割任务上的优势及单目 6D 朝向估计的开放挑战。

c618cbf970b9d91e06abe99df4bd1bab0f2cc1b5.title: Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control for an Omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot Using Control Barrier Function
c618cbf970b9d91e06abe99df4bd1bab0f2cc1b5.summary: Providing safe and effective mobility assistance plays a crucial role in restoring independence and enhancing the quality of life for individuals with motor impairments. In this context, robotic walking assistive devices have recently emerged as promising solutions to provide physically compliant interaction while ensuring user safety and support. This paper presents a novel control framework for an omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot (I-WANDER) that integrates a Control Barrier Function (CBF) formulation into a Model Predictive Control (MPC) scheme to explicitly enforce collision-avoidance safety constraints while optimizing for energy efficiency and smooth human-robot collaboration. The method was experimentally evaluated with 12 healthy participants performing two different walking tasks using both the proposed CBF-based MPC controller (CB-MPC) and a variable admittance controller (AC). The first task involved structured navigation through a U-shaped corridor, whereas the second consisted of a single-obstacle avoidance task performed blindfolded to ensure the obstacle was unexpected. Comparative results show that the CB-MPC architecture significantly reduces energy consumption and mechanical work (p < 0.01) without compromising motion smoothness, while also decreasing the number of obstacle collisions. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of the proposed control architecture to enhance both safety and efficiency in robotic walking assistance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将控制障碍函数（CBF）嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）的CB-MPC框架，用于全向步行辅助机器人I-WANDER，在优化能效与协作平滑性的同时显式保证避障安全，并通过12名健康受试者的实验验证其优于可变导纳控制（AC）。
AI.motivation: 为运动障碍者提供安全有效的移动辅助对恢复独立性和提升生活质量至关重要；机器人步行辅助设备需在保证物理柔顺交互与用户安全支持的同时，实现碰撞规避与高效能量利用。
AI.method: 提出一种新型控制框架：将CBF约束集成到MPC中，形成CB-MPC，用于全向步行辅助机器人I-WANDER，以显式施加避障安全约束，并优化能量效率与人机协作平滑性。实验招募12名健康参与者完成两项步行任务：U形走廊结构化导航和蒙眼单障碍物避障（确保障碍意外出现），并对比CB-MPC与可变导纳控制器（AC）。
AI.result: 对比结果表明，CB-MPC架构显著降低能量消耗与机械功（p < 0.01），且不损害运动平滑性，同时减少障碍物碰撞次数。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，所提出的控制架构在机器人步行辅助中具有同时提升安全性与效率的潜力。

767f25ba1728f28a20bde01a9b39326ff53dfe8e.title: GeoPair: Geometry-Preserving Cross-Layer Factorization for Training-Free Transformer Compression
767f25ba1728f28a20bde01a9b39326ff53dfe8e.summary: Transformer architectures exhibit cross-layer redundancies, yet post-training compression pipelines typically optimize layers in isolation or rely on heuristic grouping strategies that disregard layer-specific activation geometries. We introduce a principled, training-free framework that sequentially optimizes cross-layer weight pairings and shared-dictionary factorizations. Rather than forcing weights of adjacent layers to share a basis or heuristically merging activation statistics, our approach identifies structurally compatible projections and learns a shared representation that better preserves each layer's distinct calibration geometry. Coupled with structured sparsity, this yields highly efficient weight decompositions without sacrificing functional fidelity. Across diverse architectures, scales, and modalities, our method achieves state-of-the-art results, consistently outperforming independent structured weight decompositions and alternative pairwise weight factorizations, which operate under heuristic grouping strategies. By replacing heuristic engineering strategies with a convergent, optimization-driven pipeline, we establish a theoretically grounded foundation for scalable, transformer compression across different modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的 Transformer 压缩框架，通过跨层权重配对与共享字典分解，并结合结构化稀疏，在多种架构、规模和模态上实现 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练压缩流程通常逐层独立优化，或采用忽略层特定激活几何的启发式分组策略，未能原则化地利用 Transformer 的跨层冗余。
AI.method: 顺序优化跨层权重配对与共享字典分解；识别结构兼容的投影，并学习共享表示以更好保留各层不同的校准几何；避免强制相邻层共享基或启发式合并激活统计；结合结构化稀疏，实现高效权重分解且不牺牲功能保真度。
AI.result: 在多种架构、规模和模态上取得最先进结果，持续优于独立结构化权重分解以及基于启发式分组策略的成对权重分解方法。
AI.conclusion: 以收敛的优化驱动流程替代启发式工程策略，为可扩展、跨模态的 Transformer 压缩奠定了更具理论依据的基础。

0b1e971c6b1e814117c02d7d9a4393a9ff2c24a3.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy response prediction using pretreatment diffusion and contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging with clinical variables
0b1e971c6b1e814117c02d7d9a4393a9ff2c24a3.summary: Prediction of pathological complete response before neoadjuvant chemotherapy may facilitate more tailored therapeutic planning for breast cancer patients. This work proposes a deep-learning model for pretreatment data only, combining apparent diffusion coefficient maps, dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging, and clinical variables. The study uses the public ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 multicenter dataset. The architecture employs EfficientNet-B0 pretrained encoders for image feature extraction and late fusion with clinical information. Multiple clinical variables were evaluated, including age, race, histological type, HR/HER2 subtype, SBR grade, and maximum diameter. Only HR/HER2 subtype improved the average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and was retained in the final model. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation, standalone apparent diffusion coefficient maps achieved a mean AUC of 0.79, whereas dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging achieved 0.74. Adding HR/HER2 subtype improved performance to 0.83 and 0.81, respectively. The final configuration, using both imaging modalities and HR/HER2 subtype, achieved an AUC of 0.86. These results support pretreatment multimodal learning for response prediction, although external validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅基于治疗前数据的深度学习模型，融合表观扩散系数（ADC）图、动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）与临床变量，用于预测乳腺癌新辅助化疗（NAC）的病理完全缓解（pCR）。在ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2多中心数据集上采用EfficientNet-B0预训练编码器与晚期融合策略，最终多模态组合AUC达0.86。
AI.motivation: 在NAC前预测pCR有助于为乳腺癌患者制定更个体化的治疗方案；然而仅依赖治疗前数据的无创预测仍具挑战性，需要探索影像与临床信息的多模态融合以提升预测准确性。
AI.method: 使用公开的ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2多中心数据集，构建仅利用治疗前数据的深度学习模型：以预训练的EfficientNet-B0作为编码器提取图像特征，并将ADC图、DCE-MRI与临床信息进行晚期融合。评估多种临床变量（年龄、种族、组织学类型、HR/HER2亚型、SBR分级、最大直径），采用分层五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 仅HR/HER2亚型能提升平均AUC并保留于最终模型。单模态下，ADC图平均AUC为0.79，DCE-MRI为0.74；加入HR/HER2亚型后分别提升至0.83和0.81。最终同时采用两种影像模态与HR/HER2亚型的配置AUC达0.86。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持利用治疗前多模态学习进行疗效预测，但在临床实际应用前仍需开展外部验证。

baa9ff4d3c5ad00ed9a8ac0fb6267a4004ec6b0a.title: MGRL-RSCC: Multi-Granularity Reward Reinforcement Learning for Fine-Grained Remote Sensing Change Captioning
baa9ff4d3c5ad00ed9a8ac0fb6267a4004ec6b0a.summary: Remote Sensing Change Captioning (RSCC), which aims to generate accurate and detailed linguistic descriptions of ground object variations from bi-temporal remote sensing images, is a critical and challenging task in intelligent remote sensing interpretation. The mainstream autoregressive training paradigm faces severe exposure bias and train-test distribution mismatch, resulting in cumulative generation errors. They tend to produce conservative and template-fixed captions while ignoring subtle scene change details. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel multi-granularity reward reinforcement learning paradigm, termed MGRL-RSCC. Specifically, we first leverage a CNN and hierarchical self-attention module to extract and enhance visual features from bi-temporal remote sensing images. A Transformer decoder is then utilized to complete visual-to-linguistic translation. Different from existing methods, we design a dual-decoding strategy and a two-stage joint optimization scheme, which combines token-level supervised learning via greedy decoding and multi-granularity reward-driven self-critical reinforcement learning via sampling decoding. We further construct three complementary reward functions covering linguistic fluency, change state consistency, and structural-semantic relevance to comprehensively optimize caption quality and alleviate false and missing change descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple public RSCC benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed MGRL-RSCC effectively mitigates exposure bias and conservative generation problems in traditional autoregressive methods. The source code and pre-trained models will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/MGRL-RSCC

AI.tldr: 提出 MGRL-RSCC——一种多粒度奖励强化学习范式，用于遥感变化描述（RSCC），通过双解码与两阶段联合优化缓解自回归训练的暴露偏差与保守生成问题。
AI.motivation: 遥感变化描述任务需从双时相遥感图像生成准确、细致的地物变化语言描述，是智能遥感解译中的关键难题。主流自回归训练范式存在严重暴露偏差与训练-测试分布不匹配，导致生成误差累积，倾向于输出保守、模板固定的描述，忽略细微的场景变化细节。
AI.method: 1）用 CNN 结合层次自注意力模块提取并增强双时相遥感图像视觉特征；2）采用 Transformer 解码器完成视觉到语言的转换；3）设计双解码策略与两阶段联合优化方案，融合基于贪心解码的 token 级监督学习和基于采样解码的多粒度奖励驱动自批评强化学习；4）构建覆盖语言流畅性、变化状态一致性、结构语义相关性的三个互补奖励函数，全面优化描述质量。
AI.result: 在多个公开 RSCC 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MGRL-RSCC 能有效缓解传统自回归方法中的暴露偏差与保守生成问题，并减少虚假与遗漏的变化描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了多粒度奖励强化学习范式在遥感变化描述中的有效性；源代码与预训练模型将在 https://github.com/Event-AHU/MGRL-RSCC 开源。

22d9809a80eea6e79eaaddd5b705fcf40fdb71d9.title: Manipulation with Stability Guarantees: Linear Deformable Objects with Non-negligible Physical Response Grasped at Multiple Location
22d9809a80eea6e79eaaddd5b705fcf40fdb71d9.summary: Most research on the manipulation of deformable objects focuses on lightweight systems with negligible mechanical response, effectively restricting attention to quasi-static regimes. This assumption excludes a broad class of practically relevant objects, such as hoses, pipes, and wiring harnesses, whose dynamics cannot be ignored during manipulation. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a closed-loop control architecture that explicitly accounts for object dynamics and recasts manipulation as a shape-regulation problem. Control is achieved by modulating forces and torques applied at multiple fixed points along the object. This approach builds on three methodological contributions: a fully dynamic model of linear deformable objects based on discrete strain parameterizations; an extension of the notion of actuation coordinates to SE(3), yielding a structured and inherently underactuated control architecture; and nonlinear feedback strategies providing explicit conditions for steady-state convergence to desired configurations. Extensive simulations on representative manipulation tasks demonstrate the performance gains enabled by the proposed modelbased formulation. We finally validate the approach experimentally through a real-time closed-loop implementation with online shape estimation, confirming its practical feasibility and effectiveness

AI.tldr: 针对可变形物体操作中普遍忽略动力学、局限于准静态的问题，提出一种显式考虑对象动力学的闭环控制架构，将操作重构为形状调节问题；通过离散应变参数化的全动力学模型、扩展到SE(3)的驱动坐标以及非线性反馈策略，在多个固定点调制力/力矩，实现稳态收敛到期望构型，并经仿真与实时闭环实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形物体操作研究多集中于轻量、机械响应可忽略的系统，实质上只适用于准静态工况；该假设排除了软管、管道、线束等一大类实际相关对象，因为它们在操作过程中动力学不可忽略。因此需要一种能够显式处理对象动力学的操作控制方法。
AI.method: 提出闭环控制架构，将操作建模为形状调节问题，并通过对物体多个固定点施加力与力矩进行控制。方法包含三项贡献：(1) 基于离散应变参数化的线性可变形物体全动力学模型；(2) 将驱动坐标概念扩展至SE(3)，形成结构化且本质欠驱动的控制架构；(3) 非线性反馈策略，给出稳态收敛至期望构型的显式条件。
AI.result: 在代表性操作任务上的大量仿真表明，所提出的基于模型的公式化方法带来了性能提升；同时通过带在线形状估计的实时闭环实现进行了实验验证，证实了方法的实际可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作突破了可变形物体操作中准静态假设的限制，为动力学不可忽略的线性可变形物体提供了闭环形状调节控制框架；仿真与实验共同验证了其在建模、欠驱动控制和非线性反馈收敛性方面的有效性。

5cd8e827b3efef974841058051a284eb14c45516.title: Interweaving Marginals into Multivariate Sample Paths: Training-Free Dependence Construction for Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
5cd8e827b3efef974841058051a284eb14c45516.summary: Probabilistic time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide coordinate-wise predictive distributions, but these marginals do not determine a joint distribution over multivariate future trajectories. We study training-free coupling of frozen TSFM marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths. Our primary evaluation fixes the empirical marginal sample multiset at every channel--horizon coordinate across methods, isolating the effect of coupling alone. Historical temporal and channel relations substantially improve their corresponding dependence diagnostics. The same pattern persists when the fixed-marginal constraint is removed and paths are sampled directly, and remains present under native multivariate backbone inference. These results support treating dependence reconstruction as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.

AI.tldr: 研究免训练地将冻结的概率时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的逐坐标边缘预测分布耦合为多变量未来轨迹样本路径；通过固定各通道—时域坐标的经验边缘样本集来隔离耦合效应，发现历史时序与通道关系能显著改善依赖诊断，并主张将依赖重构视为概率TSFM的独立后处理问题。
AI.motivation: 概率TSFM通常只提供逐坐标（channel-horizon）的预测分布，但边缘分布无法唯一确定多变量未来轨迹的联合分布，因此多变量预测中的依赖结构未被刻画。作者关注如何在不重新训练模型的情况下，将冻结TSFM的边缘分布耦合为多变量预测样本路径。
AI.method: 提出免训练的耦合方法，将冻结TSFM的边缘预测分布转化为多变量预测样本路径。主要评估设置中，固定每个通道—时域坐标的经验边缘样本多重集在不同方法间保持一致，从而单独隔离“耦合”这一因素的影响；同时也在去除固定边缘约束、直接采样路径，以及原生多变量骨干推理的设置下进行验证。
AI.result: 历史时序关系与通道关系能够显著改善相应的依赖诊断指标。该模式在去除固定边缘约束并直接采样路径时仍然存在，并且在原生多变量骨干推理下也保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对于概率TSFM，依赖重构应被视为一个独立的后处理问题；在边缘分布之外恢复多变量联合依赖具有独立且重要的研究价值。

bc2851af655a06e83b5de93177d6b5ef7590a9d1.title: Early Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Using Temporal Deep Learning on DWI
bc2851af655a06e83b5de93177d6b5ef7590a9d1.summary: Early identification of non-responders to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) is crucial for timely treatment adaptation in breast cancer. However, many existing predictive models rely on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), late treatment time points, or extensive clinical data, which limits their applicability. This study proposes a deep learning framework for early prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) using only diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) acquired at baseline and after the first NACT cycle. This framework feeds cropped tumor-centered patches to an EfficientNet-based temporal model that directly learns tumor shape and local tissue characteristics without explicit radiomic feature engineering. The model, trained with 10-fold cross-validation, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.90 for pCR prediction after one cycle, providing actionable information after a single treatment cycle while avoiding gadolinium administration and reducing dependence on heterogeneous clinical data. By focusing on the baseline-to-first-cycle window instead of later stages, the approach supports earlier escalation or de-escalation of NACT, and its exclusive reliance on DW-MRI facilitates protocol standardization, multi-centre deployment and privacy-preserving data sharing. These results demonstrate that DW-MRI-based deep learning on tumor-centered patches constitutes a minimally invasive, clinically deployable strategy for early pCR prediction, with direct implications for personalized treatment adaptation in neoadjuvant breast cancer therapy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅使用基线和首周期新辅助化疗（NACT）后扩散加权MRI（DW-MRI）的深度学习框架，将肿瘤中心裁剪patch输入EfficientNet时序模型，无需手工影像组学特征，10折交叉验证预测病理完全缓解（pCR）的AUC达0.90。
AI.motivation: 早期识别NACT非应答者对及时调整乳腺癌治疗至关重要；但现有预测模型多依赖多参数MRI、较晚治疗时间点或大量临床数据，限制了临床适用性。研究旨在用更微创、可标准化的DW-MRI，在首个治疗周期后即提供pCR预测信息。
AI.method: 构建深度学习框架：输入基线及第一周期NACT后的DW-MRI，裁剪以肿瘤为中心的patch；采用基于EfficientNet的时序模型，直接学习肿瘤形状与局部组织特征，避免显式放射组学特征工程；以10折交叉验证进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 首周期后预测pCR的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.90；无需钆对比剂，减少对异质性临床数据的依赖，并可在单周期治疗后提供可操作信息。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦基线至首周期的窗口而非晚期阶段，有助于NACT的早期升阶梯或降阶梯；仅依赖DW-MRI便于协议标准化、多中心部署和隐私保护数据共享。结果表明，基于DW-MRI与肿瘤中心patch的深度学习是一种微创、临床可部署的早期pCR预测策略，对乳腺癌新辅助治疗个体化调整具有直接意义。需注意摘要未提供样本量、外部验证及临床效用阈值等细节，尚需进一步多中心前瞻性验证。

bb406ee3435487de345b24c684983011547ade0d.title: End-to-End Visual Odometry with RNNs and Attention
bb406ee3435487de345b24c684983011547ade0d.summary: Video Odometry (VO) is the process of estimating the ego-motion of an object by analyzing visual information such as a sequence of frames from one or multiple cameras. It has been a popular research topic in computer vision and robotics, and its applications include mobile robotic systems as well as autonomous driving. In this project, we investigate existing end-to-end deep-learning approaches to VO, and propose a novel temporal attention-based model to improve upon the baseline. In addition, while the vast majority of existing deep-learning-based approaches to VO are trained on driving data, we investigate the performance of deep-learning-based VO to the more dynamic and complex problem of hand-held cameras.

AI.tldr: 研究端到端深度学习的视频里程计（VO），提出一种时序注意力模型以改进基线，并考察其在手持相机这一更动态复杂场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉里程计在计算机视觉与机器人领域应用广泛，尤其服务于移动机器人和自动驾驶。现有端到端深度学习VO方法大多基于驾驶数据训练，缺少对更动态、更复杂的手持相机场景的评估，因此需要研究其泛化能力并提升基线性能。
AI.method: 调研现有端到端深度学习VO方法；提出一种基于时序注意力（temporal attention）的新模型，用于改进基线；在驾驶数据以及手持相机场景下评估深度学习VO的表现。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果，仅说明提出时序注意力模型以改进基线，并研究深度学习VO在手持相机场景中的性能。
AI.conclusion: 时序注意力机制有望提升端到端VO的基线性能；同时，深度学习VO从驾驶数据迁移到手持相机等动态复杂场景时仍值得深入研究，以验证其鲁棒性与泛化能力。

7beeed2784ead5851410413a217ec52bec309c6b.title: Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
7beeed2784ead5851410413a217ec52bec309c6b.summary: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 skytopia：一种基于动作条件潜在世界模型表示的单目无人机导航策略，配套 3D Gaussian Splatting 训练平台。核心是丢弃世界模型的预测器，仅利用其表示，一个策略支持 point-goal、image-goal 和 goal-free 导航。仿真中三种设定成功率分别为 57.8%、66.0%、49.0%，均优于基线，推理成本降低 59.4%，并可零微调部署到真实无人机。
AI.motivation: 单目前视相机缺乏深度与尺度线索，单目无人机在未知环境中导航困难。现有世界模型通常按部署时执行来构建：每步生成预测并反馈给动作生成，计算开销大。作者认为，飞行中执行动作已解释观测间的大部分变化，预测本质上是已知位移下静态场景的重投影，因此策略真正需要的是产生预测所需的表示，而非预测本身。
AI.method: 构建动作条件潜在世界模型，并基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 平台训练。采用前向目标：从意图运动预测下一观测的表示；采用逆向目标：从预测的转移中恢复运动。由于预测不进入动作生成，预测器在部署时被丢弃，仅保留策略表示，从而用一个策略统一支持 point-goal、image-goal 与 goal-free 导航。
AI.result: 仿真实验中，skytopia 在三种任务设定下均优于所有基线，成功率分别达到 57.8%、66.0% 和 49.0%；丢弃预测器可减少 59.4% 的推理成本。同一策略无需微调即可部署于物理无人机，并在室内、开阔室外和林地环境中到达目标。
AI.conclusion: 策略从世界模型中需要的是表示而非预测。skytopia 通过动作条件潜在表示与 3DGS 训练平台，在保持多任务单目导航性能的同时显著降低推理成本，并展现出从仿真到真实无人机的零微调迁移能力。

8c495cf51cc9bc4c530c6dc3ec61e04861826412.title: Theory for groupoid equivariant neural networks: an approach for steerable CNNs on bounded domains
8c495cf51cc9bc4c530c6dc3ec61e04861826412.summary:
Equivariant convolutional neural networks are usually built from a group acting globally on the space of signals. This hypothesis is inappropriate for many bounded or stratified domains: an ambient rigid motion may be admissible only on part of the domain, and the boundary introduces geometric types that are invisible to a transitive group action. We develop a theory of groupoid-equivariant neural networks in which the symmetry datum consists of a groupoid, a selected pseudogroup of local bisections, a measure, and input and output representation bundles. For integral channels on the object space, we prove a bisection-equivariant kernel theorem: equivariance is equivalent to a transport constraint on the two-point kernel, and its solutions are classified by one joint-stabilizer intertwiner on each orbit of pairs. As a case study we apply the theory to bounded planar domains.
  The resulting architecture is implemented through offline nullspace bases and sparse gather--transform--scatter operations. A Poisson--Dirichlet kernel study is used separately to assess boundary-aware inductive bias; the exact inverse is shown to preserve the global symmetries of the rectangle but not general proper local bisections. The numerical results show that the proposed architectures provide significant advantages when symmetries cannot be globally implemented by group actions and provide an accuracy improvement of at least one order of magnitude with respect to the models tested.

AI.tldr: 提出群胚等变神经网络理论：以群胚、局部双截断伪群、测度和输入/输出表示丛为对称数据，证明双截断等变核定理，并在有界平面域上实现稀疏架构，实验显示在对称性无法由全局群作用实现时精度至少提升一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统等变卷积网络通常假设一个群全局作用于信号空间。该假设对有界或分层域不合适：环境刚体运动可能只在域的一部分上可行，而边界会引入传递群作用无法捕捉的几何类型。
AI.method: 构建群胚等变神经网络理论，其中对称数据包括一个群胚、选定的局部双截断伪群、一个测度以及输入和输出表示丛。对对象空间上的积分通道，证明双截断等变核定理：等变性等价于两点核上的传输约束，其解由每对轨道上的一个联合稳定化子缠绕算子分类。以有界平面域为案例，架构通过离线零空间基和稀疏 gather--transform--scatter 操作实现。另用 Poisson--Dirichlet 核研究评估边界感知归纳偏置，并表明精确逆保持矩形的全局对称性，但不保持一般真局部双截断。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，当对称性无法由群作用全局实现时，所提架构具有显著优势；相对于所测试模型，精度至少提升一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将等变网络从全局群作用推广到群胚与局部双截断框架，为有界或分层域提供可实现的边界感知等变架构，并通过核定理给出参数化与分类，实验验证其有效性。

58e7003e9bf0a7b8e223f2315aa2b96e90dc6911.title: DTOC: Dynamic Tool Output Compression for Adaptive Context Management in AI Agents
58e7003e9bf0a7b8e223f2315aa2b96e90dc6911.comment: Accepted for 29th International Conference on Discovery Science, October 5-9, 2026, Mainz, Germany
58e7003e9bf0a7b8e223f2315aa2b96e90dc6911.summary: As agent capabilities have grown, practical limitations increasingly stem from constrained context windows rather than model capacity. Common strategies, such as truncation, heuristic aging, and lossy summarization, may discard useful information or introduce hallucination risk. To address these challenges, we propose Dynamic Tool Output Compression (DTOC), a framework for scalable context management in LLM-based agents that models context updates as explicit and reversible operations within the agent reasoning loop. DTOC retains full tool outputs in external memory while inserting compact placeholders into the active context, enabling selective reconstruction when needed. We formalize the DTOC mechanism, integrate it into a ReAct-style agent architecture, and provide a production-oriented implementation supporting on-demand restoration of compressed outputs. Experiments on DeepSWE reveal model-dependent effects: for responsive models (Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4), DTOC reduces input tokens (10.3 and 12.7%) and agent steps (2.4 and 32.3%), while increasing solve rates (2.5 and 1.5 times higher) and lowering cost per solved task (3 and 3.5 times lower cost per solved task). For the other models results are more mixed, with GPT-5.5 doubling solve rate and halving cost, but no impact on solve rate and negative impact on cost for the other models. Ablation results show reversibility is critical: disable-only compression variants degraded performance, while full DTOC recovered baseline accuracy at substantially lower context cost. These findings indicate that explicit, reversible context management can improve the efficiency of long-horizon agent reasoning without degrading task performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出动态工具输出压缩（DTOC），将LLM智能体的上下文更新建模为可逆操作：完整工具输出存于外部记忆，活动上下文仅保留紧凑占位符，需要时按需重建。在DeepSWE上，DTOC对响应型模型（Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4）降低输入token与步数，并提高求解率、降低成本；消融表明可逆性是关键。
AI.motivation: 智能体能力增长后，实际瓶颈更多来自受限的上下文窗口，而非模型容量。常见的截断、启发式老化、有损摘要等策略会丢弃有用信息或引入幻觉风险，因此需要一种可扩展且不损失信息的上下文管理方法。
AI.method: 提出DTOC框架，在智能体推理循环中将上下文更新建模为显式、可逆的操作：完整工具输出保存在外部记忆，活动上下文中插入紧凑占位符；需要时可选择性重建。作者形式化DTOC机制，集成到ReAct式智能体架构，并提供面向生产实现的、支持按需恢复压缩输出的实现。
AI.result: 在DeepSWE实验中呈现模型依赖效应：对响应型模型Sonnet 4.6与GPT-5.4，DTOC分别降低输入token 10.3%和12.7%，减少智能体步数2.4%和32.3%，求解率提高至2.5倍和1.5倍，每解一题成本降低3倍和3.5倍；其他模型结果混合，GPT-5.5求解率翻倍、成本减半，但另外模型求解率无影响且成本负面影响。消融显示可逆性关键：仅压缩不可逆变体性能下降，完整DTOC以显著更低上下文成本恢复基线准确率。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可逆的上下文管理能在不降低任务性能的前提下，提高长时程智能体推理的效率。DTOC通过外部记忆与占位符、按需重建机制，缓解上下文窗口约束，并避免有损压缩的信息丢失与幻觉风险。

30ae596ce136a3c2b24af72674c9719b141d206d.title: Topology-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Cross-Dataset Retinal Vessel Segmentation
30ae596ce136a3c2b24af72674c9719b141d206d.comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
30ae596ce136a3c2b24af72674c9719b141d206d.summary: Retinal vessel segmentation in multi-domain deployment requires a source model to adapt to domains that differ in imaging conditions and annotation conventions.
