Conventional parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces target-specific storage, but its highly restricted adaptation subspace can be insufficient for reconstructing thin, connected vascular structures. We therefore ask how target-specific capacity should be allocated so that topology-aware supervision remains effective under a strict per-domain parameter budget. Based on this principle, we propose TAPDecoderFT, a topology-responsive, role-structured adaptation framework. Specifically, TAPDecoderFT shares a fixed source parameter state across deployment domains, uses low-rank residuals for target-specific private/fusion feature mixing, and retains a trainable dense-reconstruction path comprising the decoder, output head, and refinement module. To promote structurally faithful predictions, the compact target state is jointly optimized with a region-overlap and topology-aware objective that encourages centerline continuity and thin-branch recovery. It improves both DSC and clDice over GenericLoRA-r4 and narrow TAP-r4 in all six directions and is comparable to full fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 TAPDecoderFT：一种拓扑响应、角色分层的参数高效微调框架，在严格单域参数预算下将目标专属容量分配给稠密重建路径，并以拓扑感知监督提升视网膜血管分割的跨域迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割在多域部署时，源模型需适应成像条件与标注约定各异的域。传统参数高效微调虽降低了目标专属存储，但其高度受限的适配子空间难以重建细长、连通的血管结构。因此作者追问：在严格的单域参数预算下，应如何分配目标专属容量，才能使拓扑感知监督保持有效。
AI.method: 基于上述原则提出 TAPDecoderFT 框架：跨部署域共享固定的源参数状态；用低秩残差实现目标专属的私有/融合特征混合；保留一条可训练的稠密重建路径，包含解码器、输出头和精修模块。紧凑的目标状态与区域重叠及拓扑感知目标联合优化，以鼓励中心线连续性与细分支恢复。
AI.result: 在全部六个迁移方向上，DSC 与 clDice 均优于 GenericLoRA-r4 与窄幅 TAP-r4，且性能与全量微调相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过将有限的目标专属容量按角色结构化地分配给稠密重建路径，并施加拓扑感知监督，可在严格参数预算下实现结构忠实且接近全量微调的跨域血管分割。

9c6fe6fb42b1a21acd823ef51b2933a2faf21e52.title: Towards Intent-Aware Human-Robot Teaming: A Platform for Search-and-Rescue Operations
9c6fe6fb42b1a21acd823ef51b2933a2faf21e52.comment: Accepted to the 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS 2026)
9c6fe6fb42b1a21acd823ef51b2933a2faf21e52.summary: We investigate the challenges of enabling effective collaboration between human operators and heterogeneous autonomous agents in complex, dynamic environments by developing an interaction platform that allows study of operator behavior and supports intent inference and decision-making using state-of-the-art frameworks. We demonstrate the extent to which the operator's perception, decisions, and actions could be supported by autonomous systems during search-and-rescue operations with our platform.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个人机交互平台，用于在复杂动态环境中研究操作员行为，并基于先进框架支持意图推断与决策；在搜救场景中展示了自主系统对操作员感知、决策和行动的支持程度。
AI.motivation: 复杂动态环境下，人类操作员与异构自主智能体之间的有效协作面临挑战，需要理解操作员行为并提升意图推断与决策支持能力。
AI.method: 构建一个交互平台，允许研究操作员行为，并采用当前先进框架支持意图推断和决策制定。
AI.result: 在搜救任务中验证了该平台，展示了自主系统能够在多大程度上支持操作员的感知、决策和行动。
AI.conclusion: 该交互平台有助于研究并实现人机协作，并为自主系统在搜救等复杂任务中辅助人类操作员提供了实证依据。

887c631ea6eee193ae2375cfbd06d832a1e0656f.title: The Dynamics of Quasiregular Neural Learning
887c631ea6eee193ae2375cfbd06d832a1e0656f.summary: Many learning problems combine a dominant regularity with systematic exceptions. Motivated by U-shaped learning in language acquisition, we study this interaction in controlled quasiregular regression problems where regular and exceptional solutions are explicitly known. Neural networks can partially acquire exceptions, subsequently regress toward the dominant regularity, and finally recover. This overregularization becomes substantially stronger when exceptions are rare, despite their early acquisition, but does not emerge equally across all regularities considered. Our results isolate a simple form of competition between regularities and exceptions during neural learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究在受控准规则回归任务中考察神经网络对“主导规律”与“系统性例外”的学习竞争，发现网络会先部分习得例外，随后回归主导规律（过度规则化），最后再恢复；例外越罕见，过度规则化越强，且该现象随规律类型不同而变化。
AI.motivation: 许多学习问题同时包含主导规律与系统性例外；语言习得中的U型学习现象提示，神经网络可能在习得例外后又暂时回归规律。作者希望在一个解已知、可控的设定中隔离并理解这种规律与例外之间的竞争机制。
AI.method: 构建受控的“准规则回归”（quasiregular regression）问题：其中规则解与例外解均被显式定义且已知。在此设定下训练神经网络，并系统改变例外的稀有程度与所考察的规律类型，追踪模型在训练过程中的学习动态。
AI.result: 神经网络能够部分习得例外，随后暂时回归主导规律，最终重新恢复对例外的学习，呈现U型动态。当例外较为罕见时，这种过度规则化（overregularization）显著增强，尽管例外在早期已被习得；此外，不同规律下的过度规则化程度并不相同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以可控实验隔离出神经网络学习中规律与例外之间的一种简单竞争形式，为理解语言习得中的U型学习及更一般的规则—例外学习动态提供了机制性证据。

332e1a7714cf35129b14995c7e241fed071fecca.title: FairMon: A Tool for Monitoring and Visualizing Algorithmic Fairness
332e1a7714cf35129b14995c7e241fed071fecca.summary: Runtime monitoring has recently been proposed as a rigorous method for analyzing algorithmic fairness of autonomous decision systems used in critical scenarios such as credit lending, job application, and the criminal justice system. Prior work has shown that runtime monitoring, in principle, can be an effective technique for establishing the kind of human oversight required by legislation such as the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. In practice, the available monitoring tools have not been developed with this application in mind and display several critical shortcomings in these scenarios. In this paper, we present FairMon, a runtime monitoring tool tailored to fairness analysis of high-stakes decision systems. FairMon uses RTLola as a flexible specification language for monitors, which we have extended with conditional probability operators that allow for concise descriptions of algorithmic fairness properties. The tool also features a real-time visualization of intermediary values, enabling human insight into the dynamics of the monitored system.

AI.tldr: FairMon：面向高风险决策系统公平性分析的运行时监控工具
AI.motivation: 自主决策系统被用于信贷、招聘、司法等关键场景，其算法公平性需要严格分析。既有研究证明运行时监控在原则上可满足欧盟《人工智能法案》等法规要求的人类监督，但现有监控工具并非为此设计，在这些场景中存在明显缺陷。
AI.method: 提出 FairMon 工具，采用 RTLola 作为灵活的监控器规约语言，并对其进行扩展，加入条件概率算子，以简洁地刻画算法公平性属性；同时提供中间值的实时可视化。
AI.result: FairMon 能够支持高风险决策系统的公平性分析，通过条件概率算子实现对公平性属性的简洁描述，并借助实时可视化帮助人类理解被监控系统的动态行为。
AI.conclusion: FairMon 弥补了现有监控工具在公平性分析场景中的不足，为满足法规所要求的人类监督提供了定制化、可视化的运行时监控手段。

4abdc35e82bceb7345ab887dc68ee99aa31e74e3.title: LLaVA-Assessor: Building the Foundation LMM For Visual Quality Assessment
4abdc35e82bceb7345ab887dc68ee99aa31e74e3.summary: Aligning with the human visual system~(HVS) in perceiving and evaluating the quality of visual signals is a central objective of machine-vision-based visual quality assessment systems. With the rapid progress of large multi-modal models~(LMMs), visual question answering provides a promising paradigm for building unified foundation models for visual quality assessment under multi-modal and multi-task scenarios. Inspired by the classical ``perception-decision" process in HVS-based quality evaluation, we formulate visual quality assessment for LMM-based machine vision as two complementary tasks: ``quality interpretation'' and ``quality scoring". Centered on these objectives, we propose LLaVA-Assessor, a unified data construction and model training system. To support multi-modal inputs, we design an adaptive model architecture that enables efficient processing of both images and videos. For data construction, we develop rigorous human annotation protocols and a novel machine-synthesis-dominated data expansion pipeline to build a large-scale and high-quality datasets. Furthermore, we introduce a simple yet effective prompt disentanglement strategy to alleviate training-objective confusion in multi-task learning, thereby enabling stable and coherent joint training. The resulting all-in-one LMM LLaVA-Assessor-GIGA achieves superior performance on $11$ image/video quality scoring test sets and 4 visual quality interpretation benchmarks. Extensive results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating structured data construction, adaptive model design, and multi-task joint training for automated visual quality assessment. Our work provides compelling insights for developing foundation LMMs for automatic visual quality assessment. Project page at https://github.com/jzhws/LLaVA-Assessor.

AI.tldr: 提出LLaVA-Assessor——面向LMM机器视觉的统一视觉质量评估系统，将评估分解为"质量解读"与"质量打分"两个互补任务，融合自适应模型架构、大规模数据构建与提示解耦多任务训练，实现图像/视频质量评估的统一基础模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉质量评估的核心目标是使机器视觉系统与人类视觉系统（HVS）在感知与评价视觉信号质量时保持一致。随着大型多模态模型（LMM）的快速发展，视觉问答为在多模态、多任务场景下构建统一的视觉质量评估基础模型提供了新范式。受HVS质量评估中经典"感知-决策"过程的启发，作者希望以LMM为基础，构建一个统一的数据构建与模型训练系统来应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 1）任务分解：将LMM机器视觉的质量评估形式化为"质量解读"（quality interpretation）与"质量打分"（quality scoring）两个互补任务。2）自适应模型架构：支持图像与视频等多模态输入的高效处理。3）数据构建：设计严格的人工标注协议，并提出以机器合成主导的新颖数据扩展流水线，构建大规模高质量数据集。4）训练策略：提出简单有效的提示解耦（prompt disentanglement）策略，缓解多任务学习中的训练目标混淆，实现稳定且连贯的联合训练。
AI.result: 所得的一体化LMM——LLaVA-Assessor-GIGA在11个图像/视频质量打分测试集和4个视觉质量解读基准上取得了优越性能。大量实验结果证明了结构化数据构建、自适应模型设计与多任务联合训练相结合在自动化视觉质量评估中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，整合结构化数据构建、自适应模型设计与多任务联合训练可有效实现自动化视觉质量评估，为面向自动视觉质量评估的基础LMM开发提供了有价值的洞见，并为构建统一多模态质量评估基础模型指明了方向。

67f947dba8d1dd9c7a884ffce790c1961bcaf880.title: StrataVLA: Hierarchical and Efficient 3D Geometric Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
67f947dba8d1dd9c7a884ffce790c1961bcaf880.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit strong semantic priors from large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet remain limited in robotic manipulation by insufficient 3D spatial awareness. Existing approaches either require explicit depth or point-cloud inputs, compress geometry into training-time supervision, or inject it only at the model input or action expert, leaving the vision-language backbone without persistent access to task-relevant spatial information. We introduce StrataVLA, a plug-and-play framework for hierarchical geometric grounding. A frozen geometry foundation model extracts shared geometric features from RGB observations, while sparse, layer-specific Geometry Adapters allow visual representations at selected backbone depths to retrieve relevant geometric evidence through cross-attention. To make inference-time geometry practical, StrataVLA further combines task-aware routing with an LRU feature cache that exploits temporal redundancy during task manipulation. Experiments on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over strong VLA baselines. StrataVLA achieves 98.53% average success on LIBERO suites while reducing geometry-model invocations by up to 88%, establishing hierarchical geometry injection as an effective and efficient way to achieve spatially grounded robotic control.

AI.tldr: 提出 StrataVLA——一种即插即用的分层几何接地框架，通过冻结的几何基础模型与稀疏分层几何适配器（Geometry Adapters），让视觉-语言骨干网络在多层级持续获取任务相关几何证据，并借助任务感知路由与 LRU 特征缓存降低推理成本，在 LIBERO 等基准上取得 98.53% 平均成功率并最多减少 88% 几何模型调用。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽从大规模视觉-语言预训练中继承了强语义先验，但在机器人操作中受限于缺乏足够的 3D 空间感知能力。现有方案存在明显不足：或需要显式深度/点云输入，或把几何信息压缩为仅训练期的监督信号，或只在模型输入端/动作专家处注入几何，导致视觉-语言骨干网络始终无法持续获得与任务相关的空间信息。
AI.method: 核心是"分层几何接地"：（1）使用冻结的几何基础模型，从 RGB 观测中提取共享几何特征；（2）在骨干网络的若干选定深度插入稀疏的、层级专属的 Geometry Adapters，通过交叉注意力让视觉表示检索相关几何证据；（3）为提升推理实用性，结合任务感知路由与基于 LRU 的特征缓存，利用操作过程中的时间冗余来减少几何模型调用。整体为即插即用设计，无需显式深度输入。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv 及真实世界操作任务上，相较强 VLA 基线均取得一致提升。在 LIBERO 套件上达到 98.53% 的平均成功率，同时将几何模型调用次数最多减少 88%。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明"分层几何注入"是一种有效且高效的方式，可在不引入显式深度输入的前提下实现具备空间接地能力的机器人控制，兼顾性能与推理效率。

2affa8052f001693602841c20fd2d6ba36be76be.title: BOBA: Dynamic Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference
2affa8052f001693602841c20fd2d6ba36be76be.summary: Dynamic black-box optimization presents significant challenges for Bayesian Optimization (BO), as the objective function evolves over time, causing optimal locations to shift continuously. Existing dynamic BO (DBO) methods using standard acquisition functions such as Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) fail to explicitly account for temporal variations, leading to suboptimal sample allocation and poor tracking of moving optima. Here, we propose BOBA (Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference), a novel acquisition function inspired by free energy principles from active inference that explicitly minimizes predictive uncertainty about future states in dynamic environments. BOBA extends traditional acquisition functions by incorporating a forward-looking uncertainty quantification that estimates uncertainty in function changes, enabling more informed exploration-exploitation trade-offs in non-stationary settings. We evaluate BOBA on synthetic dynamic benchmarks, comparing against state-of-the-art DBO methods. Our experiments demonstrate that BOBA significantly improves regret in query-restricted settings, while remaining competitive in time-limited settings. We further analyze variants of BOBA with different exploration strategies, showing how the exploration-exploitation balance can be tuned for different types of dynamic functions. This work contributes both a free energy-based acquisition function for DBO and insights into how active inference principles can enhance optimization in non-stationary environments, with implications for real-time applications requiring continuous adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于主动推断自由能原理的新采集函数BOBA，用于动态贝叶斯优化，显式量化未来状态预测不确定性，改善非平稳环境下的探索-利用权衡。
AI.motivation: 动态黑箱优化中目标函数随时间演化、最优位置持续漂移，传统动态贝叶斯优化（DBO）方法（如UCB等标准采集函数）未显式考虑时间变化，导致样本分配次优、难以跟踪移动最优解。
AI.method: 提出BOBA（Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Inference），一种受主动推断自由能原理启发的采集函数；通过引入前瞻性不确定性量化，估计函数变化中的不确定性，从而在非平稳场景下实现更合理的探索-利用权衡。
AI.result: 在合成动态基准上与当前最优DBO方法对比：BOBA在查询受限设置下显著降低遗憾值（regret），在时间受限设置下保持竞争力；并分析不同探索策略的BOBA变体，展示探索-利用平衡可针对不同动态函数类型进行调节。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于为动态贝叶斯优化提供了一种基于自由能的采集函数，并揭示主动推断原理如何增强非平稳环境优化，对需要持续适应的实时应用具有启示意义。

c20f62bde20f8c8c39468dd15c460e765cbf4af9.title: MAC-RRG: Iterative Multi-Agent Collaboration for X-ray Radiology Report Generation
c20f62bde20f8c8c39468dd15c460e765cbf4af9.summary: Despite the remarkable progress of LLM-based and knowledge graph-augmented Radiology Report Generation (RRG) methods, existing techniques still suffer from inherent defects. Conventional LLM-only models lack structured medical prior knowledge, resulting in frequent medical hallucinations and low diagnostic interpretability. Current knowledge graph-enhanced schemes adopt static one-round knowledge fusion with single-source knowledge, incapable of dynamic knowledge updating according to generation feedback. This paper proposes a novel Multi-Agent Collaborative iterative framework for X-ray Radiology Report Generation, termed MAC-RRG. Inspired by multi-agent technology, our framework constructs a closed-loop optimization paradigm based on task decoupling and collaborative reasoning. Specifically, the framework first generates a preliminary radiology report from input X-ray images via a vision encoder and a basic LLM. Subsequently, a multimodal knowledge graph (MM-KG) agent mines structured disease correlation and anatomical knowledge from medical knowledge graphs, while an auxiliary knowledge agent extracts unstructured domain knowledge from public medical databases. The multi-source knowledge acquired by dual agents is fused and embedded to guide the LLM in iteratively refining the initial report. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on mainstream X-ray RRG datasets, including IU X-ray, MIMIC, and CheXpert Plus, fully verify the superiority of our proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models have been released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAC-RRG，一个面向X射线放射报告生成（RRG）的多智能体协作迭代框架，通过任务解耦与协作推理构建闭环优化范式，融合多模态知识图谱与辅助知识智能体获取的多源知识，迭代精炼初始报告，在IU X-ray、MIMIC、CheXpert Plus等主流数据集上验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM及知识图谱增强的RRG方法存在固有缺陷：纯LLM模型缺乏结构化医学先验知识，导致频繁的医学幻觉与较低的可解释性；现有知识图谱增强方案采用单源知识、静态单轮融合，无法根据生成反馈动态更新知识。
AI.method: 提出多智能体协作迭代框架MAC-RRG。首先通过视觉编码器和基础LLM从输入X射线图像生成初步放射报告；随后由多模态知识图谱（MM-KG）智能体从医学知识图谱中挖掘结构化疾病关联与解剖知识，同时辅助知识智能体从公共医学数据库提取非结构化领域知识；双智能体获取的多源知识经融合与嵌入，引导LLM迭代精炼初始报告。整体基于任务解耦与协作推理构建闭环优化范式。
AI.result: 在IU X-ray、MIMIC、CheXpert Plus等主流X射线RRG数据集上进行的大量定量与定性实验，充分验证了所提方法的优越性。源代码与预训练模型已在GitHub发布。
AI.conclusion: MAC-RRG通过多智能体协作与多源知识动态融合，有效缓解医学幻觉、提升诊断可解释性，为放射报告生成提供了一种可迭代优化的新范式。

10b5c4a0c3127ae54e531fa9c29a8b05e316d587.title: The Temporal Moderation Gap: Text-to-Video Safety Filters Are Blind to Harm in Motion
10b5c4a0c3127ae54e531fa9c29a8b05e316d587.summary: Text-to-video (T2V) services inherit their safety stack from image generation, pairing a keyword prompt filter with a per-frame checker that blocks a clip whenever one sampled frame looks unsafe. This stack has a blind spot unique to video. We prove that any moderator ignoring frame order accepts a harmful clip whenever it accepts that clip's benign shuffle, so harm carried by the ordering alone escapes. Empirically, the unmodified benchmark prompt already lands a clip in this moderation gap on 32.7% of Sequential-Action targets over four held-out seeds, and paraphrasing, scene splitting, and a feedback-driven prompt search show no significant improvement (paired McNemar $p\ge0.12$), so prompt engineering is not needed to expose the vulnerability. Dense-scoring all 97 rendered frames shows that about a third of the delivered clips merely hide an unsafe frame, while the rest stay harmful as ordered videos even though every frame passes, an order-blind residual the unmodified prompt reaches on a quarter of Sequential-Action targets. We also document a measurement pitfall, since scoring a searched prompt on its own render seed inflates a 7.5% per-generation rate into an apparent 46.7%. A user study confirms that people read these clips as harmful and their shuffles as safe. The fix is to read frame order, and an order-aware detector separates these clips from their own shuffles at AUC 0.74 where per-frame checking sits at chance, which is the signal deployed moderation throws away.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示文生视频（T2V）安全审核因忽略帧序而存在的漏洞：仅依赖逐帧检查的审核器会接受“有害但逐帧安全”的剪辑，而乱序后的良性版本也被同样接受；作者证明该漏洞必然存在，并给出经验测量与顺序感知检测方案。
AI.motivation: T2V 服务沿用了图像生成的安全栈：关键词提示过滤 + 逐帧不安全检测。该范式假设“每一帧安全则视频安全”，但视频独有风险可由帧序承载，逐帧审核无法覆盖，因此需要研究并修复这一盲区。
AI.method: 作者从理论上证明：任何忽略帧序的审核器，若接受某有害剪辑的良性乱序版本，则也会接受该有害剪辑本身。经验上，使用未修改的基准提示在四个留出种子上测试 Sequential-Action 目标，并比较改写、场景拆分与反馈驱动提示搜索；对全部 97 帧进行密集评分，区分“仅隐藏单帧”的剪辑与“逐帧安全但顺序有害”的剪辑；同时分析搜索提示在自身渲染种子上评分导致的测量偏差，并进行用户研究验证人类感知。
AI.result: 未修改提示在 32.7% 的 Sequential-Action 目标上落入审核盲区；提示工程（改写、场景拆分、反馈搜索）无显著改善（配对 McNemar p≥0.12）。密集评分显示约三分之一交付剪辑仅隐藏了不安全帧，其余剪辑即使每帧通过仍作为有序视频有害；未修改提示在四分之一目标上达到这种顺序盲残留。测量方面，在自身渲染种子上评分会把 7.5% 的单次生成率夸大为 46.7%。用户研究确认人将这些剪辑判为有害，而其乱序版本判为安全。顺序感知检测器可将这些剪辑与其乱序版本区分，AUC 为 0.74，而逐帧检查接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 现有 T2V 审核丢弃了帧序这一关键信号；修复方向是让审核器读取帧序。顺序感知检测能以 AUC 0.74 区分有害有序剪辑与其良性乱序版本，证明帧序是当前部署审核中可恢复且必要的信息。

022b73f83f89d69996821b1c0d65d24913aa7605.title: Situation Aware Locomotion for Dual Mobile Cobots in Shared Environments
022b73f83f89d69996821b1c0d65d24913aa7605.summary: This paper presents a situation aware locomotion framework for two mobile collaborative robots operating in shared industrial environments. The proposed method models situation awareness through perception, comprehension, and projection to support locomotion decisions. Robot pose, load state, manipulator state, shared zone occupancy, obstacle state, and predicted inter robot conflict were used to select safe locomotion actions. The framework was implemented in simulation and evaluated in simulated industrial scenarios designed to match a feasible 4 m by 4 m physical test area. The proposed method was compared with two other baselines over multiple trials and randomized seeds. The results show that the situation aware method achieved 100% task success across all scenarios, while the independent and fixed priority baselines each achieved 33.3% overall success. The proposed method eliminated shared zone conflicts and safety stops, maintained the largest average minimum inter robot distance, and completed the tasks with the lowest average completion time. These results indicate that situational awareness can improve the locomotion of dual robots by combining load state, manipulator state, reasoning about the shared zone, and prediction of short-horizon conflicts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向双移动协作机器人的情境感知运动框架，通过感知—理解—预测选择安全运动动作；仿真结果显示任务成功率100%，显著优于独立与固定优先级基线。
AI.motivation: 在共享工业环境中，两台移动协作机器人需兼顾负载、机械臂状态、共享区域占用与潜在冲突。独立策略或固定优先级策略难以适应动态场景，易导致冲突、安全停机与任务失败，因此需引入情境感知来提升运动决策的安全性与效率。
AI.method: 将情境感知建模为感知、理解、预测三个层次，并用于运动决策。输入包括机器人位姿、负载状态、机械臂状态、共享区域占用、障碍物状态及短期机器人间冲突预测，据此选择安全运动动作。在仿真中实现，场景设计匹配4 m×4 m物理测试区域，并与独立基线、固定优先级基线在多次试验和随机种子下进行对比。
AI.result: 情境感知方法在所有场景中达到100%任务成功率；独立与固定优先级基线各自总体成功率为33.3%。该方法消除了共享区域冲突与安全停机，保持最大的平均最小机器人间距，并实现最低的平均任务完成时间。
AI.conclusion: 融合负载状态、机械臂状态、共享区域推理与短时冲突预测的情境感知，能够有效改善双机器人运动的安全性与效率，并具备向实际物理测试区域迁移的可行性。

bb53eaffeccc0a5945e65294f716a08725bfbf4c.title: MICRO: Multi-Fidelity Active Search for Severe Error Discovery
bb53eaffeccc0a5945e65294f716a08725bfbf4c.summary: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO (Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to select diverse candidates, then uses rollout to estimate their discovery value. Experiments on WMT20 English-German show that ratings improve both loss reconstruction and severity prediction. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across four budget and rating cost settings, with similar performance to adapted MF-ENS in one and significant gains over all six comparison policies, including two rollout controls, in the other three $(p<.001)$.

AI.tldr: MICRO 是一种多保真主动搜索框架，通过联合建模廉价质量评分与昂贵标注损失，并利用影响聚类与 rollout 估计来分配共享预算，从而最大化已确认严重错误的发现数量。
AI.motivation: 人工反馈在成本与信息量上存在差异：强反馈能揭示严重错误但代价高昂，而廉价的质量评分可用于判断哪些样本值得进一步标注。因此需要在有限预算下有效整合不同保真度的反馈，以提升严重错误发现效率。
AI.method: 提出 MICRO（Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout）主动搜索框架：为不同反馈类型分配共享预算；以样本特征为条件联合建模质量评分与标注损失，用于指导采集；对采集候选按其对严重性概率的预测影响进行聚类，以选择多样化样本；再通过 rollout 估计候选样本的发现价值。
AI.result: 在 WMT20 英德任务上，质量评分有助于改进损失重建与严重性预测。MICRO 在四种预算与评分成本设置下取得最高平均发现数量；在其中一种设置下与适配的 MF-ENS 性能相近，而在其余三种设置下显著优于全部六种对比策略（包括两种 rollout 对照），且达到 p<.001 显著性。
AI.conclusion: MICRO 表明，将廉价评分与昂贵标注统一纳入多保真主动搜索，并结合影响聚类与 rollout 价值估计，可在预算约束下更有效地发现严重错误，优于现有对比方法。

37ce610666907c67ce513ed478827256cb253895.title: When Big Data Becomes a Curse: Spatial Heterogeneity and the Limits of Learning from Passive Acoustic Monitoring Data
37ce610666907c67ce513ed478827256cb253895.summary: Passive Acoustic Monitoring produces large archives whose recordings are clustered by deployment, season, station identifier, and acquisition configuration. We analyze 908,072 AIS-labeled 679-second recordings from 38 deployments, 20 Atlantic Canadian station identifiers, and 21 receiver positions. The AIS-contact prior varies by more than 200-fold, and per-deployment screening distributions require local interpretation. Bidirectional cross-season transfer over the 18 station identifiers observed in both seasons predicts station identity above the 5.56% uniform-chance level, with balanced accuracy of 15.9% for AIS-contact and 16.4% for no-AIS-contact recordings. The same descriptors predict the two hydrophone models at 74.1% and 85.6% balanced accuracy, respectively, but hydrophone model is strongly confounded with season and other deployment-level acquisition differences. On a retrospectively screened and capped benchmark of 54m507 recordings, repeated station-grouped holdout yields an ROC-AUC of 0.612 with a station-bootstrap 95% interval of 0.582 to 0.648, compared with 0.661 under a random-window diagnostic. Their paired difference is 0.049 (0.040 to 0.056). Removing raw energy changes unseen-station ROC-AUC from 0.612 to 0.603, while an exploratory training-station scale analysis is non-monotonic. These results show that random-window validation overstates transfer to unseen station identifiers in this corpus. They support dependence-aware validation and broader independent spatial sampling, while spatial-expert models remain a hypothesis rather than an established remedy.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于 908,072 条 AIS 标注的 679 秒被动声学监测录音，揭示部署、季节、站点标识与采集配置强聚类会令随机窗口验证高估对未见站点的泛化能力，主张采用依赖感知验证与更广泛的独立空间采样。
AI.motivation: 被动声学监测（PAM）档案按部署、季节、站点标识和采集配置聚集；AIS 接触先验差异超过 200 倍，各部署筛选分布需局部解释。因此需要评估模型能否迁移到未见站点、季节与设备配置，并检验常用随机窗口验证是否可靠。
AI.method: 分析 908,072 条 AIS 标注的 679 秒录音，覆盖 38 次部署、20 个加拿大大西洋沿岸站点标识和 21 个接收机位置。采用双向跨季节迁移、站点分组留出与随机窗口诊断对比；对 54,507 条（原文记作 54m507）回顾性筛选并封顶的基准集进行重复站点分组留出，并做去除原始能量消融及训练站点规模探索。
AI.result: AIS 接触先验变化超过 200 倍。在两季均观测到的 18 个站点标识上，双向跨季节迁移预测站点身份高于 5.56% 均匀随机水平，AIS 接触与无 AIS 接触录音的均衡准确率分别为 15.9% 和 16.4%。同一组描述符预测两种水听器型号的均衡准确率为 74.1% 和 85.6%，但水听器型号与季节及其他部署级采集差异强烈混淆。基准集上，重复站点分组留出 ROC-AUC 为 0.612，站点自助法 95% 区间 0.582–0.648；随机窗口诊断 ROC-AUC 为 0.661；配对差异 0.049（0.040–0.056）。去除原始能量后，未见站点 ROC-AUC 从 0.612 降至 0.603；训练站点规模探索呈非单调关系。
AI.conclusion: 随机窗口验证会高估该语料中对未见站点标识的迁移性能；应支持依赖感知验证和更广泛的独立空间采样。空间专家模型仍属待验证假设，而非已确立的补救方案。

0d6b8098becd641f0b3a5b715e7c55977dd85361.title: COVER: Codec-Robust Video Watermarking with Generative Video Priors
0d6b8098becd641f0b3a5b715e7c55977dd85361.summary: Video watermarking underpins copyright protection and provenance for generated media, yet almost every video is compressed by a codec before it is stored or shared. A codec discards precisely the perceptually redundant components that most watermarks rely on, so the payload is often lost even when the marked video looked flawless beforehand. Existing methods leave this path open, since they treat compression as one entry in a generic list of distortions, while a real codec is not differentiable and cannot enter gradient-based training. We present COVER, the first learned video watermark built around codec compression as its design target, which survives that compression by embedding the payload in the latent space of a frozen generative video autoencoder and recovering it by re-encoding the received video into that same latent space. To make codec robustness trainable, we build a differentiable codec surrogate bank that simulates the dominant degradation modes of practical compression, and we train the embedder and the latent decoder through three shared recovery paths under a fidelity objective that constrains the residual in the pixel and frequency domains. Across four codecs at 12 settings, COVER attains 93.72% average bit accuracy, ranks first on 11 of the 12, improves the strongest prior method by 2.68 points, and lifts the worst operating point from 68.90% to 73.72% while each marked video stays visually close to the source clip that produced it.

AI.tldr: COVER 是首个以编解码压缩为设计目标的学习型视频水印：在冻结生成式视频自编码器的潜空间嵌入载荷，并通过重编码恢复；利用可微编解码代理库训练嵌入器与潜解码器。在 4 种编解码器、12 种设置下平均比特准确率达 93.72%，其中 11 项排名第一。
AI.motivation: 视频在存储或分享前几乎都会经过编解码压缩，而编解码器会丢弃感知冗余分量，这正是多数水印所依赖的载体，因此标记视频即使视觉上完好，载荷也常被破坏。现有方法仅将压缩视为通用失真列表中的一项，且真实编解码器不可微，难以进入端到端梯度训练，导致压缩鲁棒性未被针对性优化。
AI.method: COVER 将水印载荷嵌入冻结生成式视频自编码器的潜空间，并通过将接收视频重新编码到同一潜空间来恢复载荷。为让编解码鲁棒性可训练，作者构建可微编解码代理库，模拟实际压缩中的主要退化模式；通过三条共享恢复路径训练嵌入器与潜解码器；并在保真目标中同时约束像素域和频域残差。
AI.result: 在 4 种编解码器、12 种设置下，COVER 取得 93.72% 的平均比特准确率，12 项中 11 项排名第一，较最强先前方法提升 2.68 个百分点；最差工作点从 68.90% 提升至 73.72%，同时每个标记视频在视觉上均接近其源视频片段。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将真实编解码压缩作为明确设计目标，并结合可微代理库、潜空间嵌入与重编码恢复，可显著提升学习型视频水印的压缩鲁棒性，同时保持较高视觉保真度。

bcc0af2e122daf937497d2ac8c3899ca7b577575.title: Vision-Language Models as copilots for Autonomous UAV Navigation: Analysis of Latency and Reliability in Degraded Environments
bcc0af2e122daf937497d2ac8c3899ca7b577575.summary: The integration of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offers unprecedented semantic reasoning capabilities. However, real-time closed-loop navigation requires not only low inference latency but also obedience to structured flight commands. This paper proposes a hybrid FSM-VLM control architecture for UAVs in GPS-free environments. The system combines a deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM) for low-level physical control with an asynchronous VLM copilot for high-level semantic pathfinding. We evaluate three models with different parameter scales in a Software-In-The-Loop (SITL) simulation. The framework isolates and measures syntax errors at the format level versus semantic hallucinations at the logic level in a normal and degraded scenario. This study demonstrates that parameter scaling, and not pure latency, remains the primary bottleneck for the safe and compatible integration of VLM into autonomous flights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于无GPS环境下无人机的混合FSM-VLM控制架构，将确定性有限状态机（FSM）负责底层物理控制与异步VLM副驾驶负责高层语义寻路相结合，通过SITL仿真评估三种不同参数规模的模型，发现参数规模而非纯延迟是VLM安全集成到自主飞行的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言模型（VLM）集成到自主无人机（UAV）中可带来前所未有的语义推理能力，但实时闭环导航不仅要求低推理延迟，还要求遵从结构化飞行指令。现有方案难以兼顾低延迟与指令合规性，因此需要新的控制架构来解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 提出混合FSM-VLM控制架构：用确定性有限状态机（FSM）执行低层物理控制，用异步VLM副驾驶完成高层语义寻路，二者解耦。在软件在环（SITL）仿真中评估三种不同参数规模的模型，并在正常与退化两种场景下，分别隔离并度量格式层的语法错误与逻辑层的语义幻觉。
AI.result: 在SITL仿真中对三种不同参数规模的模型进行了评估，框架成功隔离并测量了格式层语法错误与逻辑层语义幻觉；结果表明参数规模（而非纯延迟）是VLM安全、兼容地集成到自主飞行中的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 混合FSM-VLM架构可在无GPS环境下实现语义寻路与低层控制的解耦；参数规模是制约VLM安全集成的关键因素，未来应重点关注模型能力而非单纯优化延迟。

6d1ab0a4ca2fa66b1231d9e44b242ff25ca6562b.title: xWhyL: Causal Interactive Learning
6d1ab0a4ca2fa66b1231d9e44b242ff25ca6562b.summary: Explanations are central to causal reasoning, and cognitive science has long established that the human drive to explain is itself a mechanism for learning about causality. Despite this, learning from those abductive signals is largely ignored in artificial intelligence. While explainable AI (XAI) increasingly draws on causal models to generate explanations, the converse direction about what explanations can do for causality remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we propose xWhyL, a formal framework connecting causality and XAI by learning causal models from explanations. We develop a mathematical theory that translates explanations into a learning signal complementary to observational data, and demonstrate how it enables overcoming the limits of observational causal discovery. As explanations can be derived from incorrect beliefs and clash with data, a tension we call the Causal Tug-of-War, we prove conditions under which our framework rejects misspecified explanations rather than absorbing them. Our practical instantiation, Causal Interactive Learning (CIL), shows how expert explanations can efficiently support causal discovery and distinguish correct from incorrect explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出 xWhyL 形式框架，将解释转化为与观测数据互补的学习信号，从而从解释中学习因果模型；理论上证明在“因果拔河”冲突下可拒绝误设解释；具体实现 CIL 表明专家解释能高效支持因果发现并区分解释正误。
AI.motivation: 解释是因果推理的核心，认知科学已表明人类解释驱动力本身就是学习因果性的机制；但人工智能 largely 忽视了从这种溯因信号中学习。XAI 虽 increasingly 借助因果模型生成解释，但反向问题——解释能为因果性做什么——仍未被充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 xWhyL，一个连接因果性与 XAI 的形式框架，核心是从解释中学习因果模型。发展数学理论，将解释翻译为与观测数据互补的学习信号，并展示其如何克服观测因果发现的局限。针对解释可能源于错误信念并与数据冲突的“因果拔河”（Causal Tug-of-War）张力，证明框架拒绝误设解释而非吸收它们的条件。实际实例化为 Causal Interactive Learning（CIL），利用专家解释支持因果发现。
AI.result: 理论证明在特定条件下框架能拒绝错误解释；CIL 表明专家解释可高效支持因果发现，并区分正确与错误解释，同时使解释信号能够补充观测数据、突破观测因果发现的限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从解释中学习因果模型的新方向，将解释作为因果发现的学习信号，桥接因果推理与 XAI，并为解释与数据冲突时的稳健学习提供理论条件。

1022c882fa72a8ac603e2f532f25f2ceed36ac53.title: The Cost of Conservation: Coordination-Memory Laws for Exact-Support Generation
1022c882fa72a8ac603e2f532f25f2ceed36ac53.summary: Many AI systems make decisions locally, even when every realized output must obey an additive conservation law, such as selecting exactly a fixed number of items. This constraint can be statistically invisible: small subsets of a balanced fixed-budget output look increasingly independent, yet communication-free coordinate-parallel generation needs exponentially many pre-shared plans, while a sequential exact sampler needs only logarithmic memory. We study product measures conditioned on additive conservation laws in the intermediate regime where one plan is selected before a fixed-order pass, every plan is a bounded-state stochastic executor whose support is entirely legal, and the mixture of plan laws approximates the target distribution in total variation. Our main result identifies the optimal asymptotic selector rate, up to constant factors, with the killed spectral profile of the conservation-difference walk. The resulting coordination cost decreases as an inverse power of live-state width, with an exponent determined by intrinsic conservation rank rather than alphabet size; the law extends to noncentral budgets and heterogeneous local scores. The converse is driven by a state-versus-resource-sum obstruction, while a rate-matching construction compiles discrepancy control into exact-support finite-state plans. Complementary results characterize block-parallel plan complexity and the benefit of programmable output order. Together, these results show precisely how online memory substitutes for front-loaded coordination in exact-support generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在“可加守恒律”约束下的精确支持生成问题：目标是在固定顺序单遍执行、每个计划都是有限状态随机执行器且输出必然合法的前提下，用少量预共享计划近似条件乘积分布。核心结论给出了最优计划选择速率（selector rate）的渐近刻画，并证明在线记忆可以替代前置协调。
AI.motivation: 许多AI系统进行局部决策，但最终输出必须满足可加守恒律，例如恰好选择固定数量项目。该约束在统计上可能不可见：平衡固定预算输出的小子集看起来渐近独立，但无通信的坐标并行生成需要指数级预共享计划，而顺序精确采样器只需对数级记忆。作者因此研究介于二者之间的机制，以刻画前置协调与在线记忆之间的精确权衡。
AI.method: 研究受可加守恒律约束的乘积测度。设定为：固定顺序单遍执行前先选择一个计划；每个计划是支撑完全合法的有界状态随机执行器；计划律的混合在总变差意义下逼近目标分布。主要工具是守恒差分游走（conservation-difference walk）的被杀谱轮廓（killed spectral profile）。反向部分通过“状态与资源之和”的障碍论证下界；构造部分将差异控制编译为具有精确支撑的有限状态计划。还分析块并行计划复杂度以及可编程输出顺序带来的收益。
AI.result: 主要结果给出最优渐近计划选择速率，达到常数因子意义下的最优，并由守恒差分游走的被杀谱轮廓刻画。协调成本随活跃状态宽度（live-state width）以逆幂律下降，其指数由内在守恒秩决定，而非字母表大小。该规律可推广到非中心预算与异质局部得分情形。互补结果刻画了块并行计划复杂度以及可编程输出顺序的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在精确支持生成中，在线记忆能够以可量化的方式替代前置协调：所需计划数量由守恒差分游走的谱性质与内在守恒秩决定，而非表面字母表规模。结果为固定预算、可加守恒约束下的并行与顺序生成提供了统一的最优复杂度图景。

9c221e26a81a8e263133066c396a4a08c8d51f77.title: AIGC Video Detection based on the fusion of spatial-frequency-optical flow multimodal features
9c221e26a81a8e263133066c396a4a08c8d51f77.summary: The rapid evolution of generative AI (e.g., Sora, Hunyuan) makes it essential to develop effective detection strategies that can generalize across ever-evolving synthesis techniques. This study is motivated by the observation of a fundamental challenge in generative models: the inherent difficulty of maintaining cross-modal consistency between appearance and motion. To this end, we propose a multi-modal framework for AIGC video forgery detection tasks, named Cross-Attention based Video Forgery Detector (CrossAtt-VFD), based on joint multi-view analysis of content.Methodologically, we introduce a dual-branch architecture that simultaneously extracts spatial-frequency and optical-flow features.This approach enables the modeling of videos from complementary perceptual perspectives.The core of this process is a dedicated cross-attention mechanism, which governs the alignment of the two modalities and translates cross-modal inconsistencies into a potent diagnostic signal. This multi-modal strategy facilitates the detection of motion that is statistically inconsistent with the visual appearance of a scene. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrated that our model achieves an accuracy of 94.22%, a precision of 91.67 %,and a recall of 96.25 %, effectively verifying the advantages of the multi-modal fusion strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出 CrossAtt-VFD 多模态视频伪造检测框架，通过跨注意力机制对齐空间-频域与光流两支特征，将跨模态不一致性转化为判别信号，准确率 94.22%。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI（如 Sora、Hunyuan）快速演进，检测策略需具备跨合成技术的泛化能力。研究观察到生成模型难以维持外观与运动之间的跨模态一致性，这一固有缺陷可作为检测切入点。
AI.method: 双分支架构：一支提取空间-频域特征，一支提取光流特征，从互补感知视角建模视频；核心为专用跨注意力机制，负责两模态对齐，将跨模态不一致性转化为诊断信号，从而识别与场景视觉外观在统计上不一致的运动。
AI.result: 在综合实验中，模型达到 94.22% 准确率、91.67% 精确率、96.25% 召回率，验证了多模态融合策略的优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于外观-运动跨模态一致性缺失的假设，多视角联合分析的多模态融合方案在 AIGC 视频伪造检测任务中有效且性能优越。

f59b87579cd2d784a0700fd30b4aa6d9a8e20fa4.title: Acoustic Ellipses: Bio-Inspired Omnidirectional Echolocation in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems using Frequency Sweeps
f59b87579cd2d784a0700fd30b4aa6d9a8e20fa4.summary:
Inspired by the flight and song of birds, we propose an approach that enables cooperating agents to effectively identify obstacles in their environment by having a stationary source agent emit a frequency-modulated chirp while one or more listener agents observe the direct and reflected signals while in motion. We present a novel mapping approach that exploits the ``frequency gap'' between direct and reflected chirp signals to define candidate reflection ellipses, which are then fed into a 2D accumulation filter to identify locations with the highest density of potential reflections.
  We demonstrate this work first with simulation results derived from an efficient, bespoke audio simulator, examining the effect of obstacle count, sampling rate, and path curvature on the ability to accurately identify environmental obstacles for a one-listener scenario. We then examine different cooperative motion strategies for two-listener configurations. Finally, we validate the real-world viability of this approach through field experiments in an outdoor park setting to demonstrate the ability to identify frequency gaps using off-the-shelf hardware. Our results provide a foundation for a low-cost approach to environmental mapping in swarm robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文受鸟类飞行与鸣叫启发，提出一种协作式声学环境障碍物识别与建图方法：静止源代理发射频率调制啁啾信号，移动监听代理接收直达与反射信号，利用二者之间的“频率间隙”生成候选反射椭圆，并通过二维累积滤波定位高密度反射点。作者先以定制音频模拟器验证单监听配置下障碍物数量、采样率和路径曲率的影响，再研究双监听协作运动策略，最后在户外公园用现成硬件开展实地实验，证明低成本的群体机器人环境建图可行性。
AI.motivation: 面向群体机器人系统，现有环境建图方案往往依赖昂贵传感器或复杂计算。作者受鸟类飞行与鸣叫行为启发，希望利用简单的声学啁啾信号和协作代理，在低成本硬件条件下实现有效的障碍物识别与环境映射。
AI.method: 方法核心是：由静止源代理发射频率调制啁啾，一个或多个移动监听代理观测直达信号与经障碍物反射的信号；利用直达与反射啁啾之间的“频率间隙”定义候选反射椭圆，再将这些椭圆输入二维累积滤波器，以识别潜在反射密度最高的位置。验证分三阶段：1）使用定制的高效音频模拟器，在单监听场景下考察障碍物数量、采样率和运动路径曲率对识别精度的影响；2）研究双监听配置下的不同协作运动策略；3）在户外公园环境中使用现成硬件进行实地实验，验证频率间隙识别的实际可行性。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，障碍物数量、采样率和路径曲率会影响单监听代理准确识别环境障碍物的能力；双监听配置下不同协作运动策略表现存在差异。户外公园实地实验证明，利用现成硬件可以识别直达与反射啁啾之间的频率间隙，验证了该方法在真实环境中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为群体机器人系统提供了一种低成本环境建图的基础方案，说明基于频率调制啁啾与协作监听代理的声学建图在仿真和真实场景中均具潜力，并为后续多代理协作策略与硬件部署研究奠定基础。

d6f8d378b7831e2ac68f39c8518097511017b45d.title: Towards Adaptive Federated Graph Clustering: A Global Community-aware Contrastive Learning-based Approach
d6f8d378b7831e2ac68f39c8518097511017b45d.summary: Federated graph learning (FGL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train graph models without sharing their private graph data, providing a promising paradigm for mining knowledge from distributed graph repositories. While most existing FGL methods focus on supervised tasks, real-world graphs are often massive and unlabeled, making federated graph clustering an important yet still immature research direction. Notably, this task is particularly challenging due to the inherent subgraph heterogeneity across clients, which leads to client-specific community structures. In this work, we identify two critical limitations in existing federated graph clustering methods: (1) unrealistic pre-defined cluster cardinality assumptions and (2) incomplete inter-community separation. To address these challenges, we propose AdaFGC, an Adaptive Federated graph clustering framework based on Global community-aware Contrastive learning. AdaFGC introduces an over-complete set of global community anchors to model the global community structure and adaptively estimate clustering cardinality via cross-client anchor refinement. In addition, it employs a global community-aware contrastive learning scheme that uses the shared anchors as contrastive prototypes to explicitly enforce community-level attraction and repulsion across clients, complemented by node-level and topology-level objectives that stabilize local representations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaFGC consistently outperforms existing supervised and unsupervised FGL baselines across multiple clustering metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AdaFGC：一种基于全局社区感知对比学习的自适应联邦图聚类框架，用于解决联邦图聚类中聚类数目预设不合理与社区间分离不充分的问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦图学习可在不共享私有图数据的前提下协同训练模型，但现有方法多聚焦监督任务。现实图数据往往规模大且无标签，联邦图聚类因此重要但仍不成熟。其核心挑战在于客户端间子图异质性导致社区结构具有客户端特异性，现有方法存在两类局限：(1) 依赖不现实的预定义簇基数假设；(2) 社区间分离不完整。
AI.method: AdaFGC 的核心设计包括：1) 引入一组过完备的全局社区锚点，对全局社区结构建模，并通过跨客户端锚点精炼自适应估计聚类基数；2) 采用全局社区感知对比学习方案，将共享锚点作为对比原型，在客户端间显式强化社区级吸引与排斥；3) 辅以节点级与拓扑级目标，稳定本地表示学习。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaFGC 在多项聚类指标上持续优于现有的监督与无监督联邦图学习基线。
AI.conclusion: AdaFGC 通过全局社区锚点、自适应基数估计与社区感知对比学习，有效缓解了子图异质性带来的聚类难题，为无标签分布式图数据的联邦聚类提供了可行且性能优越的解决方案。

1db9423234c30d9a0d637e37b35156d688d92e89.title: VACS: Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding for Multi-Agent Reasoning
1db9423234c30d9a0d637e37b35156d688d92e89.summary: Multi-agent reasoning systems in high-stakes domains must be both accurate and safe, yet agents often follow heterogeneous value priorities (e.g., rigor, conciseness, safety), causing conflicting recommendations. Existing methods do not jointly provide: (i) principled inference of each agent's implicit values from behavior, (ii) compositional formal safety guarantees without full online communication, and (iii) value-aware conflict resolution with faithful explanations. We present VACS (Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding), a four-layer framework addressing all three. Layer 1 learns value-dimension rewards from pairwise preferences using Bradley-Terry modeling and infers per-agent value weights via deep MaxEnt IRL. Layer 2 encodes value constraints in a Lean-inspired DSL and synthesizes compositional assume-guarantee shields for runtime safety. Layer 3 resolves disagreement through nucleolus-based credit allocation and Hamiltonian consensus optimization under long-term value constraints. Layer 4 extracts a critical reasoning path from co-state sensitivities and generates formally grounded natural-language explanations. Our contribution is primarily a unified systems design with formalized interfaces and operational guarantees at the verifier-constrained decision level, rather than a complete end-to-end formal proof of all language-model internals. In controlled proof-of-concept evaluations with role-conditioned agent panels on NEJM-AI QA, MathInstruct-Subset, and a cybersecurity incident-response benchmark (CyberSec-Eval), VACS outperforms strong baselines in accuracy (85.4%, 95.0%, and 90.0%) while reducing logical inconsistency rates to near zero.

AI.tldr: VACS 是一个四层框架，联合解决多智能体价值异质、组合安全保证与价值感知冲突解释问题；在三个高压力基准上取得高准确率并将逻辑不一致率降至近零。
AI.motivation: 高风险领域多智能体推理系统需同时满足准确与安全，但智能体具有异质价值优先级（如严谨、简洁、安全），易产生冲突建议。现有方法未联合提供：从行为推断隐式价值、无需全在线通信的组合形式化安全保证、以及价值感知且解释忠实的冲突解决。
AI.method: VACS 四层设计：Layer 1 用 Bradley-Terry 建模从成对偏好学习价值维度奖励，并用 deep MaxEnt IRL 推断各智能体价值权重；Layer 2 用 Lean 启发的 DSL 编码价值约束，合成组合 assume-guarantee 运行时安全盾；Layer 3 通过 nucleolus 信用分配与 Hamiltonian 共识优化，在长期价值约束下解决分歧；Layer 4 从共态敏感性提取关键推理路径，生成形式化基础的自然语言解释。作者强调这是统一系统设计与形式化接口、验证器约束决策级操作保证，而非完整端到端 LLM 内部证明。
AI.result: 在角色条件智能体面板的受控概念验证评估中，于 NEJM-AI QA、MathInstruct-Subset 和网络安全事件响应基准 CyberSec-Eval 上，VACS 准确率分别为 85.4%、95.0% 和 90.0%，优于强基线，逻辑不一致率降至近零。
AI.conclusion: VACS 表明价值对齐的组合屏蔽可作为高风险多智能体推理的可行架构，在验证器约束层面提供操作保障；但结论受限于概念验证评估和形式化范围，仍需端到端形式验证与更广泛领域验证。

7fb0d737370937e238e20c7153b4e02392084738.title: ForeDrive: Foresight-Guided End-to-End Autonomous Driving with a Planning-Relevant Latent World Model
7fb0d737370937e238e20c7153b4e02392084738.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; 8 pages supplementary with 4 figures
7fb0d737370937e238e20c7153b4e02392084738.summary: Existing latent world models are typically optimized for future predictability, yet the resulting representations are not necessarily useful for planning in autonomous driving. Predictions are commonly used for pretraining or auxiliary supervision rather than as direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation. We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and couples it asymmetrically to a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planner. The planner consumes multi-horizon latent future representations learned with a JEPA-style world model; planning gradients update the shared online encoder, while stop-gradient routing trains the latent predictor with forecasting losses only. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons and BEV trajectories are misaligned with image tokens, we use gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) to inject future latents as guidance without overriding the current observation. Trained with pure imitation learning and using only the current front-view image as visual input at inference, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, without reinforcement learning or an external trajectory scorer.

AI.tldr: ForeDrive：学习与规划相关的潜在世界模型表征，并以其非对称方式耦合到DiT规划器，在NAVSIM上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型通常以未来可预测性为优化目标，但其表征未必对自动驾驶规划有用。预测结果多被用于预训练或辅助监督，而非作为轨迹生成的直接条件信号，导致表征与规划任务之间存在错配。
AI.method: 提出ForeDrive，学习规划相关的潜在表征并沿非对称路径耦合到DiT规划器。规划器接收由JEPA式世界模型学习的多horizon潜在未来表征；规划梯度更新共享的在线编码器，而停止梯度（stop-gradient）路由仅用预测损失训练潜在预测器。针对预测未来在不同horizon上的可靠性差异，以及BEV轨迹与图像token不对齐的问题，采用门控视觉融合、未来状态注入与Trajectory-Adaptive Bias（TAB），将未来潜在表征作为引导注入而不覆盖当前观测。
AI.result: 仅用纯模仿学习训练，推理时仅需当前前视图图像作为视觉输入，ForeDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到89.9 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.0单阶段EPDMS，且无需强化学习或外部轨迹评分器。
AI.conclusion: 通过使潜在世界模型的学习目标与规划对齐，并采用非对称耦合与多种注入机制，可将预测性未来表征有效转化为规划引导信号，在自动驾驶基准上验证了该范式的有效性。

327950b2d6e263897a23aa86fdf040d88da402a5.title: GDLAM: Group-Disentangled Latent Action Model for Highly Disentangled Embodied Pretraining
327950b2d6e263897a23aa86fdf040d88da402a5.summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-related representations from action-free videos via self-supervised future prediction, offering a scalable paradigm for embodied intelligence pretraining. However, existing LAMs collapse heterogeneous sources of visual change, including camera motion, object dynamics, and interaction events, into a single latent vector, resulting in entangled representations with limited semantic structure and consequently restricting world model controllability and VLA policy generalization. We introduce the Group-Disentangled Latent Action Model (GDLAM), a latent action model whose code is factorized by construction into N groups, each with an independent variational bottleneck and a spatially gated routing pathway, and trained with a set of information-geometric objectives: mutual exclusivity, group and gate sparsity, and static-dynamic orthogonality, that make the groups mutually causally distinct rather than merely decorrelated. Quantitatively, intervening on any single group changes only that group and leaves the others intact, and GDLAM improves label-free disentanglement metrics, including Modularity, MIG, and DCI, by wide margins over a strong unstructured LAM. Notably, this factorization is not at the expense of action information: across three mutual-information estimators and a linear probe, the grouped code is more informative than monolithic baselines both in- and out-of-distribution. As supporting evidence that the disentangled code is a reusable pretraining currency, we further transfer it to two downstream regimes: (1) World Modeling: World models pretrained with GDLAM achieve superior rollout fidelity and action-following capability compared with SOTA baselines. (2) VLA Policies: Pretraining with GDLAM substantially improves task success rates over previous methods across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks

AI.tldr: 提出 GDLAM：将潜动作编码按构造分解为 N 个独立变分瓶颈与空间门控路由组，并用互斥性、组/门稀疏性、静态-动态正交等信息几何目标训练，从而在无动作视频中学习可解耦、可控且可迁移的潜动作表示。
AI.motivation: 现有潜动作模型（LAM）通过无动作视频的自监督未来预测学习动作相关表示，但把相机运动、物体动力学和交互事件等异质视觉变化源压缩进单一潜向量，导致表示纠缠、语义结构不足，进而限制世界模型可控性与 VLA 策略泛化。
AI.method: GDLAM 在结构上将潜动作码分解为 N 个组，每组具备独立变分瓶颈和空间门控路由通路；训练采用信息几何目标：互斥性、组稀疏性、门稀疏性与静态-动态正交性，使各组在因果上相互区分，而非仅统计去相关。
AI.result: 干预任一组仅改变该组且不影响其他组；在无标签解耦指标 Modularity、MIG、DCI 上显著优于强非结构化 LAM。分组编码未牺牲动作信息：在三种互信息估计器和线性探针下，分布内与分布外均比单体基线更具信息量。迁移到下游：(1) 世界建模：基于 GDLAM 预训练的世界模型在 rollout 保真度和动作跟随能力上优于 SOTA；(2) VLA 策略：在多个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务中，相较先前方法显著提升任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: GDLAM 通过分组解耦的潜动作表示，在保持甚至提升动作信息量的同时增强语义结构与可控性，并可作为可复用的具身智能预训练表示，有效提升世界模型与 VLA 策略的下游性能。

01bfc25aa1eff954746167b61d81ceab3699e14f.title: FuncCode: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Function Space with Hardware-Aware Quantization
01bfc25aa1eff954746167b61d81ceab3699e14f.summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions, increasing flexibility but also parameter memory because each edge stores multiple coefficients, often together with a separate base branch. We introduce FuncCode, a basis-agnostic compression approach that forms shared codebooks from sampled edge responses, codes the basis and base branches independently, and exports the resulting codebooks and per-edge indices in a quantized, bit-packed format. Across spline and polynomial KANs, sampled edge responses exhibit $13$--$35\%$ lower effective rank than their coefficient representations. Further replicated controls show that function-space clustering alone is statistically tied with coefficient-space clustering; the consistent accuracy gain comes from preserving the distinct sharing structure of the two branches. On a ten-seed MNIST benchmark, FuncCode compresses spline and GRAM KANs by $31.6\times$ and $17.6\times$ with only $0.31$ and $0.34$ pp accuracy loss. On a 6.1M-edge convolutional KAGN, it achieves $19.9\times$ compression while remaining within $0.54$ pp of dense accuracy on CIFAR-10 and $1.89$ pp on CIFAR-100. After compression, per-edge indices account for up to $99.4\%$ of stored weight bits, making the representation index-bound. Across nine bit-exact FPGA accelerators, FuncCode reduces SplineKAN post-route weight memory by $3.87\times$ relative to dense INT4, without increasing cycle count or latency. The FuncCode implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/FuncCode.

AI.tldr: FuncCode 提出一种与基函数无关的 KAN 压缩方法：对采样后的边响应构建共享码本，分别编码 basis 分支与 base 分支，并以量化、位打包格式导出码本与逐边索引，在 MNIST/CIFAR 与 FPGA 加速器上实现显著压缩且精度损失极小。
AI.motivation: KAN 用可学习的一元函数替代标量边权，提升表达能力，但每条边需存储多个系数（常另加 base 分支），导致参数内存开销大，制约部署。作者观察到采样后的边响应比系数表示具有更低的有效秩（低 13–35%），说明函数空间存在可利用的共享冗余。
AI.method: FuncCode 为 basis-agnostic 压缩框架：对采样的边响应构建共享码本；对 basis 分支与 base 分支独立编码（分别聚类/码本化）；以量化与位打包方式导出码本及逐边索引。通过复制实验对照函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类，验证收益来源。
AI.result: 采样边响应的有效秩比系数表示低 13–35%；函数空间聚类与系数空间聚类统计上持平，稳定增益来自保留两分支各自的共享结构。十随机种子 MNIST 上，Spline 与 GRAM KAN 分别压缩 31.6× 和 17.6×，精度仅降 0.31/0.34 pp；6.1M 边卷积 KAGN 压缩 19.9×，CIFAR-10/100 分别距稠密精度 0.54/1.89 pp。压缩后逐边索引占存储权重位高达 99.4%，表示呈 index-bound。在 9 个 bit-exact FPGA 加速器上，相对稠密 INT4 将 SplineKAN 布局后权重内存降低 3.87×，且不增加周期数或延迟。
AI.conclusion: FuncCode 表明函数空间冗余可被有效利用，且分别编码 basis/base 分支是关键；该方法在精度损失极小的前提下大幅压缩 KAN 参数内存，并对硬件部署友好（不牺牲时延），代码已开源。

147ae186c6a3a1d94905cda272caa8a36530e4d2.title: When Verifiers Vote Backwards under Verdict Substitution: Signed Pivotal Value in Correlated Self-Consistency
147ae186c6a3a1d94905cda272caa8a36530e4d2.summary: Replacing one ballot can change a majority decision only on queries decided by a single vote; this structural fact requires no independence assumption. We study the sign of that change using a labeled, verdict-style intervention: one correctness signal replaces one correctness-indicator ballot in $k{=}7$ self-consistency panels. This diagnostic intervention is not identical to deployed answer-identity plurality. A primary MATH-500 experiment ($n{=}570$) gives a different-model verifier a $+24.2$pp pivotal gain, whereas a role-reversed configuration gives $-11.2$pp; an exploratory code stress test (14 pivotal rows across 9 tasks) gives $-24.5$pp. An exact signed-gain decomposition accounts for all observed signs through the verifier's state-specific accuracy and the composition of the two one-vote tally states, rather than global accuracy or model provenance. Same-source signals lose accuracy on the pivotal stratum (65$\to$44\% in the primary configuration), while error correlations provide a descriptive error-association diagnostic. Controlled degradation and a $k\in\{3,5,7\}$ subset sensitivity analysis probe the stability of the observed pattern around this accounting. Under the evaluated ties-incorrect answer-identity plurality analysis, the structural zero and strong-verifier benefit persist, but the role-reversed harm attenuates to $-0.9$pp and is not significant. The results therefore establish harmful verdict substitution, not universally harmful deployed plurality, and motivate a testable but unverified hypothesis for negative process-reward-model weights.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自洽性多数投票中替换单张选票对决策符号的影响。作者提出“正确性信号替换正确性指示选票”的判决定式干预，并在 k=7 面板上证明该诊断干预不等同于部署中的答案同一性多数投票。通过精确符号增益分解，发现不同配置下收益/损害由验证器状态特定准确率与两个一票计票状态构成决定；强验证器有收益，角色反转在部署口径下损害不显著，结论是 verdict substitution 有害而非部署多数投票普遍有害。
AI.motivation: 多数决策只有在单票决定时才可能被一张选票改变，这一结构性事实无需独立性假设。论文关心这种改变的方向：将一张正确性指示选票替换为正确性信号后，何时提升、何时损害多数决策，并区分诊断性干预与真实部署的答案同一性多数投票。
AI.method: 在 k=7 自洽性面板中实施带标签的判决定式干预：用一条正确性信号替换一张正确性指示选票。主实验为 MATH-500（n=570），比较不同模型验证器与角色反转配置；另做探索性代码压力测试（9 个任务中 14 个关键行）。使用精确符号增益分解，将增益归因于验证器状态特定准确率和两个一票计票状态的组成，而非全局准确率或模型来源。进一步分析同源信号在关键层的准确率变化、误差相关性诊断，并进行受控退化和 k∈{3,5,7} 子集敏感性分析，以及在平局按错误处理的答案同一性多数投票口径下复核。
AI.result: 主 MATH-500 实验中，不同模型验证器获得 +24.2pp 的关键增益，角色反转配置为 -11.2pp；代码压力测试为 -24.5pp。精确符号增益分解能解释所有观察到的符号。同源信号在关键层准确率从 65% 降至 44%，误差相关性提供描述性误差关联诊断。在平局按错误处理的答案同一性多数投票分析下，结构性零点和强验证器收益仍存在，但角色反转损害衰减至 -0.9pp 且不显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持“有害的判决定替换”（harmful verdict substitution），而非“部署的多数投票普遍有害”。论文还据此提出一个可检验但尚未验证的假设，用于解释过程奖励模型负权重现象。

be423d9c8cc4e9cf4a5fb3f9f84c8a98996b0421.title: Leveraging Vision-Based Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Online Vectorized HD Mapping
be423d9c8cc4e9cf4a5fb3f9f84c8a98996b0421.comment: IROS 2026 Workshop on Long-Term Perception for Human-Centric Autonomy
be423d9c8cc4e9cf4a5fb3f9f84c8a98996b0421.summary: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping provide compact scene representations for autonomous driving, but both depend on accurate metric geometry and remain limited by depth ambiguity. Over long-term deployment, observations from repeated traversals can be accumulated into persistent point cloud priors that provide geometric context beyond the current observations. Existing explicit point cloud prior approaches, however, rely on LiDAR-based map construction and therefore require expensive 3D ranging sensors. We propose a framework that constructs a static point cloud prior map from previous camera traversals using Pi3X and augments each point with DINOv3 features. At runtime, a local prior patch is retrieved using global localization, encoded with a sparse voxel backbone, and fused in bird's-eye view (BEV) with lifted multi-view camera features. Task-specific sparse transformer heads then predict 3D objects and vectorized map elements from the fused representation. On Argoverse 2, the vision-based prior improves a strong baseline from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.669 to 0.750 vectorized mapping mAP. Ablations show that semantic DINOv3 features are particularly important for vectorized mapping. These results demonstrate that vision-built geometric-semantic priors provide an effective form of long-term scene memory for camera-based perception, improving both tasks without LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需LiDAR的视觉先验地图框架：利用Pi3X从历史相机轨迹构建静态点云先验并附加DINOv3语义特征，运行时经全局定位检索局部先验、稀疏体素编码并与多视角BEV特征融合，由稀疏Transformer头完成3D目标检测与矢量化HD地图构建。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的3D目标检测与在线矢量化HD地图构建依赖精确度量几何，受深度模糊限制；长期部署中重复轨迹观测可累积为持久点云先验，但现有显式点云先验方法依赖LiDAR建图，需要昂贵3D测距传感器。
AI.method: 用Pi3X从历史相机轨迹构建静态点云先验地图，并为每个点附加DINOv3特征；运行时通过全局定位检索局部先验块，使用稀疏体素主干编码，并在BEV空间与提升后的多视角相机特征融合；任务特定的稀疏Transformer头从融合表示中预测3D目标与矢量化地图元素。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2上，视觉先验将强基线从0.287提升至0.299 CDS，矢量化地图mAP从0.669提升至0.750；消融显示DINOv3语义特征对矢量化地图构建尤为重要。
AI.conclusion: 视觉构建的几何-语义先验可作为有效的长期场景记忆，在无需LiDAR进行先验建图或在线推理的情况下同时提升相机3D检测与矢量化地图构建。

dbaeb2915511ff674717e85d7f362fd0f9904ff5.title: Design and Implementation of an Ultra-Low-Cost Wall-Climbing Robot for Infrastructure Crack Detection
dbaeb2915511ff674717e85d7f362fd0f9904ff5.summary: Crack detection is a crucial process to ensure the safety and longevity of buildings and other infrastructure. In this paper, we developed a low-cost, automated crack detection robot that leverages CNN, EfficientNet-B0, and YOLOv8 for efficient identification of cracks in concrete surfaces with a curated crack image dataset introduced to support training and evaluation. YOLOv8's real-time object detection enhances crack localization, while CNN and EfficientNet-B0 provide binary classification, ensuring high precision and recall. The system consists of two stages. In the first stage, YOLOv8 detects and localizes wall regions from the video frame, and the bounding boxes are cropped. The second stage performs crack detection using one of three models by analyzing the cropped regions. Cost-effective approaches are also taken for robot design. The robot features a fan-based negative pressure adhesion system, a 4-wheeled skid-steering drive, and an ESP32-CAM for real-time image capture. Its lightweight 3D-printed chassis ensures stability, allowing it to navigate both walls and ceilings while capturing images for crack analysis. Unlike conventional wall-climbing robot designs, this robot incorporates a funnel-shaped body that enhances negative pressure generation and achieves a 44% reduction in duty cycle, significantly lowering power consumption. By combining low-cost hardware with a deep learning pipeline, our system provides a scalable, efficient, and accessible solution for real-time infrastructure inspection at an approximate total cost of $25, with a lightweight web application enabling smartphone-based control. This affordability makes the system more suitable for the developing world, where infrastructure inspection is often limited by budget constraints, labor intensity, and safety risks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种低成本自动化裂缝检测机器人，结合YOLOv8区域检测与CNN/EfficientNet-B0裂缝分类，并采用风扇负压吸附、四轮滑移转向与ESP32-CAM，实现墙面/天花板巡检，总成本约25美元。
AI.motivation: 建筑与基础设施裂缝检测对安全性和寿命至关重要，但传统人工巡检受预算、劳动强度和安全风险限制，尤其发展中国家基础设施检测资源有限，因此需要低成本、可扩展、易获取的自动化方案。
AI.method: 系统分两阶段：第一阶段用YOLOv8从视频帧中检测并定位墙体区域，裁剪边界框；第二阶段对裁剪区域使用CNN、EfficientNet-B0或YOLOv8之一进行裂缝检测。硬件采用风扇负压吸附、四轮滑移转向驱动、ESP32-CAM实时图像采集，轻量化3D打印底盘；并提出漏斗形机身以增强负压生成。还构建了精选裂缝图像数据集用于训练与评估，并提供轻量Web应用支持手机控制。
AI.result: YOLOv8增强裂缝定位实时性，CNN与EfficientNet-B0提供二分类并保证较高精确率和召回率；漏斗形机身使占空比降低44%，显著降低功耗；机器人可在墙面和天花板稳定移动并采集图像；系统总成本约25美元。
AI.conclusion: 低成本硬件与深度学习流水线结合，为实时基础设施巡检提供了可扩展、高效且易获取的解决方案，适合预算受限的发展中地区，有助于降低检测成本、劳动强度与安全风险。

2e10f80cfe19054ba352b1063ee9c4b699e88d68.title: Fast Matrix Multiplication in fp8: Certified Coefficient Optimization and Measured Error
2e10f80cfe19054ba352b1063ee9c4b699e88d68.summary: A Strassen-type algorithm has many realizations with the same exact product and multiplication count yet different fp8 error because basis changes reshape coefficient geometry, posing the question of which to run. No current account settles this: classical stability controls worst-case $\ell_1$ growth, not the expected-error magnitude, and the Dumas--Pernet--Sedoglavic optimizer could only be called probably optimal, its global optimality unproved. To settle this, we attach to each realization a coefficient functional $Φ$, a scalar summary of its coefficient geometry, which we minimize over the change-of-basis orbit. This Kempf--Ness problem on a Hadamard manifold lets us certify the global $Φ$ optimum rather than merely search for it: an exact moment-map zero fixes $Φ_{\min} = 200/9$, and de Groote's classification extends that optimality to every exact real rank-7 $2\times2$ decomposition. Every exact real rank-7 realization therefore has a $Φ$-predicted RMS constant at least $5/3$ times that of the cubic algorithm, at fixed noise coefficient. We then introduce an explicit block-scaled e4m3 model in which $Φ$ is the leading-order coefficient of relative expected mean-squared error, and we test the resulting $Φ$-predicted ordering against realized fp8 error. Ordering and re-basing experiments support that prediction within tested fused block-scaled regimes, and on real matmul tiles from four architecture families the $Φ$-optimal realization falls in the fp8 low-error region. Across two $\sim$70B models on real deep_gemm kernels, the same realization removes 10 to 55% of classic Strassen's excess NLL over the clean model. Algorithm realization thus becomes a mathematically certified design problem rather than a tuning choice: an independent low-precision axis with a global $Φ$ optimum and measured fp8 relevance.

AI.tldr: 该文将Strassen型算法的不同实现视为变基轨道上的设计问题，引入系数泛函Φ并证明其全局最优值，从而在fp8低精度下预测并选择误差更低的实现。
AI.motivation: 同一精确乘积与相同乘法次数的Strassen型算法可有多种实现，但变基会重塑系数几何，导致fp8误差不同，因此需要回答“应运行哪种实现”。既有稳定性分析只控制最坏情况ℓ1增长，不能刻画期望误差幅度；Dumas–Pernet–Sedoglavic优化器也仅能称为“可能最优”，缺乏全局最优性证明。
AI.method: 为每种实现附加系数泛函Φ，作为系数几何的标量摘要，并在变基轨道上最小化Φ。将该问题表述为Hadamard流形上的Kempf–Ness问题，通过矩映射零点精确认证全局Φ最优；利用de Groote分类将最优性扩展到所有精确实秩-7的2×2分解。进一步引入块缩放e4m3模型，其中Φ是相对期望均方误差的首阶系数，并用实验检验Φ预测的排序与真实fp8误差是否一致。
AI.result: 精确矩映射零点给出Φ_min=200/9；所有精确实秩-7实现，在固定噪声系数下，其Φ预测RMS常数至少是三次算法的5/3倍。排序与重变基实验支持该预测，在测试的融合块缩放机制内成立。来自四类架构的真实matmul tile上，Φ最优实现落入fp8低误差区域。两个约70B模型在真实deep_gemm内核上，同一实现消除了经典Strassen相对干净模型超额NLL的10%–55%。
AI.conclusion: 算法实现选择由此从调参问题转变为数学可认证的设计问题：低精度成为一个独立轴，具有全局Φ最优值，并已测得与fp8误差的相关性。

ed4a0a2faa925fa7bd5addfae58b2dbe10603913.title: Unanimity Without Persuasion: A Single Round of Debate Erases the Disagreement That Verification Needs
ed4a0a2faa925fa7bd5addfae58b2dbe10603913.summary: A debate panel can become unanimous without becoming more correct. This is dangerous for downstream safeguards: a substituted verification ballot can change only narrow-margin votes, while richer arbiters lose disagreement as a natural targeting signal. We show that one debate round can erase that resource without requiring persuasion. Tracking a heterogeneous 7-judge panel through a blind round and three debate rounds on 600 code-correctness candidates, unanimity on a fixed cohort jumps from 39.5\% to 95.2\% in round 1 (93.1\% of the total collapse), while accuracy moves by less than one point and 96.3\% of verdict flips follow the displayed peer majority. An execution-based verification ballot corrects 8 of 2,037 pre-debate candidate-substitution instances but changes zero in every later round; by round 3 every wrong decision is unanimous, erasing dissent that had flagged two-thirds of the panel's errors. Identical-cohort controls explain why: no-peer reconsideration reproduces 79.6\% of the collapse, real labels without reasoning reproduce 91.5\%, and random labels steer flips toward whatever they display; the full-debate condition adds 4.3 percentage points over labels only (clustered 95\% CI 0.7--8.1). The one-round collapse reproduces in two additional real runs and two fake-label seeds, remains under panel sizes 3--7, and appears in MATH-500. Parse failures concentrate on contested candidates ($p<0.001$), making attrition non-ignorable. The design implication is operational: verify before any second-pass evaluation or peer exposure, and never treat post-debate unanimity as independent evidence of reliability.

AI.tldr: 多智能体辩论首轮即可把评委一致率从39.5%推高至95.2%，但准确率几乎不变，共识主要由同伴暴露而非推理驱动；因此不应把辩论后一致当作可靠性证据，应在任何二次评估或同伴暴露前完成验证。
AI.motivation: 辩论常被寄望于通过多轮论证提升裁决正确性，但一致/共识也被下游保障当作可靠性信号。若一致性可通过同伴影响而非说服产生，则存在风险：替换验证选票只能改变小差距投票，而更丰富的仲裁机制反而会因分歧消失而失去定位错误的信号。作者旨在证明一轮辩论即可在无需说服的情况下抹除分歧资源。
AI.method: 追踪一个异质7评委小组，在600个代码正确性候选上经历1轮盲评和3轮辩论；记录一致率、准确率、裁决翻转是否跟随显示同伴多数。设置执行式验证选票，并比较无同伴重审、真实标签但无推理、随机标签等控制条件；进行聚类置信区间估计。复现实验包括2次额外真实运行、2个假标签种子、面板规模3–7，以及MATH-500。另分析解析失败与候选争议性的关系。
AI.result: 固定队列上，一致率从39.5%升至第1轮95.2%，占全部一致化崩溃的93.1%；准确率变化不足1个百分点，96.3%的裁决翻转跟随显示出的同伴多数。执行式验证选票仅纠正2,037个辩论前候选替换实例中的8个，且后续轮次改变为0；到第3轮所有错误决定均为一致，抹除了此前标记小组三分之二错误的异议。控制实验解释机制：无同伴重审复现79.6%的一致化崩溃，真实标签无推理复现91.5%，随机标签也会将翻转导向其显示内容；完整辩论仅比仅标签条件高4.3个百分点（聚类95% CI 0.7–8.1）。单轮崩溃在2次额外真实运行和2个假标签种子中复现，在面板规模3–7下持续存在，并出现在MATH-500中。解析失败集中于争议候选（p<0.001），说明样本流失不可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 设计含义具有操作性：应在任何第二遍评估或同伴暴露之前进行验证；绝不可将辩论后的一致视为独立可靠性证据。辩论可能制造虚假共识，削弱下游保障并掩盖错误。

cbd16629adefe7aa6b6cf0c81c5a70357f9013f7.title: On the Role of the Projector in Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning: Last-Layer Rank Dynamics Drive Representation Quality
cbd16629adefe7aa6b6cf0c81c5a70357f9013f7.comment: Under review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
cbd16629adefe7aa6b6cf0c81c5a70357f9013f7.summary: The dimensional collapse of representations in self-supervised contrastive learning is an ever-present issue. One notable technique to prevent such a collapse of representations is using a multi-layered perceptron network called Projector. In several works, the projector has been found to heavily influence the quality of representations learned in a self-supervised contrastive pre-training task. However, the question still lingers. What role does the projector play? Assuming the projector mitigates dimensional collapse, what prevents the terminal layer of the base encoder from functioning as the projector in the absence of an explicit multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head? In this work, we intend to study what happens inside the projector by examining the rank dynamics of the same and the encoder through empirical study and analysis. Through mathematical analysis, we observe that the effect of rank reduction predominantly occurs in the last layer. Motivated by this insight, we propose a weight regularization strategy applied specifically to the last layer. We demonstrate that this targeted approach yields better performance than applying orthogonal weight regularization across the entire network (WeRank), both with and without a projector. Our method improves Top-1 accuracy by more than 1% on SimCLR on the ImageNet100 dataset and consistently outperforms baseline SimCLR variants on CIFAR datasets, supporting our interpretation of the projector's role.

AI.tldr: 该文关注自监督对比学习中表征的维度坍缩问题，通过实证与理论分析揭示投影器（Projector）的作用主要体现为降低最后一层的秩，并提出仅对最后一层施加权重正则化的方法，在多个数据集上优于全网络正交正则化（WeRank）及SimCLR基线。
AI.motivation: 自监督对比学习中，多层感知机投影器被广泛用于缓解表征维度坍缩，且对表征质量影响显著；但其具体作用机制尚不明确。作者进一步追问：若投影器用于缓解维度坍缩，那么在没有显式MLP头时，基础编码器的末层为何不能充当投影器？因此需要研究投影器内部发生了什么。
AI.method: 作者通过实证研究与分析，考察投影器和编码器在训练过程中的秩动态（rank dynamics）。结合数学分析，发现秩降低效应主要发生在最后一层。基于此洞察，提出一种仅针对最后一层施加的权重正则化策略，并与对整个网络施加正交权重正则化的WeRank进行对比。
AI.result: 在ImageNet100数据集上，所提方法使SimCLR的Top-1准确率提升超过1%；在CIFAR数据集上，该方法持续优于SimCLR基线变体。同时，在有投影器和无投影器两种设置下，该针对性方法均优于全网络正交权重正则化（WeRank）。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持了作者对投影器角色的解释：投影器缓解维度坍缩的关键机制与最后一层的秩降低密切相关；因此仅对最后一层进行权重正则化即可有效改善自监督对比学习表征，并优于全网络正则化方案。

408608673059136822f94e0c98341e12fa4eea24.title: StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots
408608673059136822f94e0c98341e12fa4eea24.summary:
Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch.
  Unlike conventional visual or textual triggers, contact signals are inherently noisy and may also arise during benign locomotion. To avoid treating every pressure anomaly as a trigger, StepTrigger learns a selective backdoor policy from multimodal robot state, using incidental pressure events as benign examples and dense-patch contacts as poisoned examples. In a stratified offline evaluation, the trained planner achieved 98.75% clean behavior preservation, 92.50% false-trigger rejection, 76.25% true-trigger activation, and 89.17% overall parsed behavior accuracy. These results reveal a backdoor surface in proprioceptive and contact channels that is not captured by defenses focused only on language, vision, or action history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StepTrigger，一种面向 VLM 驱动机器人规划器的接触状态触发后门攻击：触发器不是文本提示或视觉标记，而是四足机器人行走于密集地形时产生的足-地压力与接触模式。方法从多模态机器人状态中学习选择性后门策略，将偶发压力事件作为良性样本、密集地形接触作为投毒样本，离线评估显示其能较好保持干净行为并区分真假触发。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与视觉语言模型日益被用作机器人高层规划器，根据任务目标和传感器摘要选择导航或操作动作。现有针对 LLM/具身智能体的后门攻击主要依赖语言、可见物体、场景语义或动作历史序列等触发器，尚未充分关注本体感觉与接触通道这一潜在攻击面。
AI.method: StepTrigger 利用 Unitree Go1 四足机器人行走于密集地形时产生的足-地压力与接触模式作为触发器。由于接触信号本身含噪且良性运动中也可能出现压力异常，方法不将全部压力异常视为触发，而是从多模态机器人状态中学习选择性后门策略：以偶发压力事件作为良性样本，以密集地形接触作为投毒样本，训练被污染的规划器。
AI.result: 在分层离线评估中，训练后的规划器实现 98.75% 干净行为保持率、92.50% 假触发拒绝率、76.25% 真触发激活率，以及 89.17% 总体解析行为准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，本体感觉与接触通道中存在一种未被仅关注语言、视觉或动作历史的防御方法覆盖的后门攻击面。

31cc24cc2f521697e39ef2b6a0f9ca25697e51f6.title: Margin-Drop Coordinates for Cross-Budget Robustness Evaluation
31cc24cc2f521697e39ef2b6a0f9ca25697e51f6.summary: Fixed-budget robustness evaluation can select the wrong frozen vision encoder. An encoder that survives a shallow attack may lose most of that robustness when the same evaluation is strengthened. We ask whether the shallow evaluation contains enough information to identify this budget fragility. For each clean-correct sample, the evaluation records the clean pairwise margin, the first-order linearized margin-drop scale, the margin drop from a clean-start one-step attack, and the drop reached by an iterative attack. Normalizing by that scale gives three margin-drop coordinates capturing clean margin slack, one-step shortfall, and drift, where drift is the additional normalized margin drop the iterative attack reaches beyond the one-step perturbation. Together, they reconstruct the normalized post-attack margin and therefore the pass-or-fail outcome. Across 42 pretrained frozen vision encoders, the shallow survival rate carries essentially no rank information about subsequent PGD-10 to PGD-200 collapse, at Spearman -0.006, while the median shallow drift coordinate ranks the same collapse at +0.811. The result persists in a held-out encoder pool and under an $\ell_\infty$ evaluation. With deep evaluation limited to 11 encoders, ranking by shallow drift recovers 11 of the 17 high-collapse encoders, compared with 5 under survival-rate ranking. The full coordinate decomposition further distinguishes cases that share the same fixed-budget residual but diverge at deeper budgets, and separates margin repair from drift repair under interventions, revealing distinct repair paths that endpoint robustness alone does not identify.

AI.tldr: 固定预算鲁棒性评估可能选错冻结视觉编码器；浅层攻击存活率几乎不能预测更深预算下的崩溃，而浅层“漂移”坐标可高秩相关地预测崩溃，并能分解修复路径。
AI.motivation: 固定预算鲁棒性评估可能选出在浅层攻击下表现好、但在相同评估加强后迅速失效的编码器；作者希望判断浅层评估中是否已包含足够信息来识别这种“预算脆弱性”。
AI.method: 对每个干净正确样本记录：干净成对间隔、一阶线性化间隔下降尺度、从干净起点单步攻击的间隔下降、迭代攻击达到的间隔下降。按该尺度归一化后得到三个间隔下降坐标：干净间隔余量、单步不足、漂移（迭代攻击超出单步扰动的额外归一化间隔下降）。三者可重构归一化攻击后间隔，从而决定通过/失败。
AI.result: 在42个预训练冻结视觉编码器上，浅层存活率与后续PGD-10到PGD-200崩溃几乎无秩信息（Spearman -0.006）；浅层漂移坐标中位数对同一崩溃的秩相关为+0.811。该结果在留出编码器池和ℓ∞评估下仍成立。在仅对11个编码器做深度评估时，按浅层漂移排序可召回17个高崩溃编码器中的11个，而按存活率排序仅召回5个。完整坐标分解还能区分固定预算残差相同但更深预算下分化的案例，并在干预下分离“间隔修复”与“漂移修复”，揭示端点鲁棒性无法识别的不同修复路径。
AI.conclusion: 浅层评估的存活率不足以识别预算脆弱性；浅层漂移坐标是预测深度崩溃的有效指标，且完整间隔下降坐标分解可解释固定预算残余与深度预算分化，并区分不同鲁棒性修复机制。

ce375587913a9c43018cea7deb22433bd39376fe.title: Toward User-Mediated Self-Repair in Ubiquitous Robots Through Goal-Oriented Agentic AI
ce375587913a9c43018cea7deb22433bd39376fe.summary: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, necessitating resilient natural language interaction for maintenance and repair tasks. This paper presents a goal oriented agentic AI architecture designed to enable non-expert users to perform technical repairs through situated dialogue. The framework utilizes a multi-layered approach that decouples high-level strategic planning from reactive conversational execution to transform unconstrained human instructions into a structured hierarchy of goals. We conducted a study involving twenty participants to evaluate the system's efficacy using a physical hardware testbed. The architecture achieved a 95\% task completion rate, and participants reported positive self-efficacy following real-time guidance that adapted to conversational diversions and linguistic variations. A comparative analysis with an online baseline revealed that the transition to a physical environment significantly decreased perceived social presence (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while the agentic framework remained robust throughout the interaction. These findings indicate that goal oriented agentic AI can support the sustainability of body-worn technologies by empowering users to perform critical maintenance in ubiquitous contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向普适机器人维护/维修的目标导向智能体AI架构，通过多层级解耦战略规划与对话执行，将非专家用户的不受约束指令转化为结构化目标层级，并在物理硬件测试台上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 普适机器人系统常缺乏传统可视化界面，维护与维修任务需要具备韧性的自然语言交互；同时希望赋能非专家用户，在真实情境中完成技术维修，并提升可穿戴/身体佩戴技术的可持续性。
AI.method: 采用目标导向的智能体AI架构；多层级方法将高层战略规划与反应式对话执行解耦；把无约束的人类指令转换为结构化目标层级；开展20名被试研究，使用物理硬件测试台，并与在线基线进行对比分析。
AI.result: 任务完成率达95%；参与者在实时引导后报告了积极自我效能，引导能适应对话偏离和语言变异；与在线基线相比，迁移到物理环境显著降低了感知社会临场感（p=.0005），以及信任与胜任感（p=.037）；智能体框架在整个交互过程中保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 目标导向智能体AI能够支持身体佩戴技术的可持续性，使用户在普适情境中完成关键维护；该架构在物理环境中具有稳健性，但物理环境会削弱部分社会性感知与信任/胜任感，需进一步关注。

5a9ff14036201647f03346ff30fc1f19e35bbdf4.title: KwaiMind Technical Report
5a9ff14036201647f03346ff30fc1f19e35bbdf4.summary: Commercial image editing requires product identity preservation, accurate text rendering, and user appeal alongside general editing quality. We present KwaiMind, an image editing system combining general capabilities with e-commerce specialization. An agent-based data engine maintains approximately 1.8 million high-quality editing pairs. Built on a multimodal diffusion transformer, KwaiMind undergoes continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, followed by preference optimization and online reinforcement learning. A general-purpose vision-language judge and specialized rewards for click-through rate (CTR), text rendering, and product consistency guide specialized policies, which are consolidated through on-policy distillation. We introduce Ecom-Bench, covering 11 commercial editing tasks with task-specific visual evaluation and CTR-based ranking. KwaiMind achieves the strongest overall scores among evaluated open-source editors on ImgEdit, GEdit, both language splits of REDEdit, and Ecom-Bench visual quality, and the highest aggregate CTR ranking score among compared systems. Offline, CTR-guided optimization increases the proportion of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeds that of the original product image from 12.16% to 37.41%. In an online A/B experiment, CTR-based selection of product main images yields an approximately 2.44% relative increase in actual CTR. These results demonstrate the value of domain-specific data and reward-driven alignment for commercial image editing.

AI.tldr: KwaiMind 是一个融合通用与电商专用能力的商业图像编辑系统：依托约 180 万高质量编辑对、多模态扩散 Transformer、偏好优化与在线强化学习，以及 CTR/文字渲染/产品一致性奖励，在多个编辑基准和电商基准 Ecom-Bench 上取得领先，并验证了 CTR 引导优化对离线预测与在线实际点击率的提升。
AI.motivation: 商业图像编辑不仅要求通用编辑质量，还需保持产品身份、准确渲染文字并具备用户吸引力。通用图像编辑器难以同时满足这些电商场景的专用需求，因此需要领域特定数据与奖励驱动对齐来提升商业可用性。
AI.method: 1）构建基于智能体的数据引擎，维护约 180 万高质量编辑对；2）基于多模态扩散 Transformer 进行继续预训练与监督微调，随后进行偏好优化和在线强化学习；3）引入通用视觉语言裁判，以及针对点击率（CTR）、文字渲染和产品一致性的专用奖励，引导专用策略，并通过 on-policy distillation 整合；4）提出 Ecom-Bench，覆盖 11 类商业编辑任务，包含任务特定视觉评估与基于 CTR 的排序。
AI.result: KwaiMind 在 ImgEdit、GEdit、REDEdit 两个语言划分以及 Ecom-Bench 视觉质量上，取得所评估开源编辑器中的最强总体分数；在对比系统中取得最高聚合 CTR 排名分数。离线 CTR 引导优化将预测 CTR 高于原始产品图的生成图像比例从 12.16% 提升至 37.41%；在线 A/B 实验中，基于 CTR 选择产品主图使实际 CTR 相对提升约 2.44%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，领域特定数据与奖励驱动对齐对商业图像编辑具有重要价值，能够在通用编辑能力之外有效提升电商场景的视觉质量与点击率表现。

e6aac0adecf68e81b220faa7cbb772d0125b6dad.title: Toward Self-Repairing Ubiquitous Robots Using Goal-Oriented Agentic AI in Human-Robot Interactions
e6aac0adecf68e81b220faa7cbb772d0125b6dad.summary: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, making natural language interaction important for maintenance and repair. This paper presents a goal-oriented agentic AI architecture that enables non-expert users to complete technical repair tasks through situated dialogue. The architecture separates pre-interaction goal decomposition, persistent state tracking, strategic goal management, and real-time conversational execution. We evaluated the system in a physical hardware repair task with twenty participants. Nineteen participants completed the task, corresponding to a 95% completion rate. Participants rated the system as helpful and competent, and the agent remained robust to conversational diversions such as meta-queries and code-switching. A comparison with a prior online baseline showed that physical interaction significantly reduced perceived social presence, (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while perceived helpfulness remained high.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向目标的智能体AI架构，通过情境对话使非专家用户完成技术维修任务，并在物理硬件维修任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 泛在机器人系统通常缺乏传统可视化界面，自然语言交互对维护与维修任务至关重要。因此需要一种面向目标的智能体架构，支持非专家用户通过情境对话完成技术维修。
AI.method: 架构将交互前目标分解、持久状态跟踪、策略性目标管理和实时对话执行相分离。在物理硬件维修任务中对20名参与者进行系统评估。
AI.result: 19名参与者完成任务，完成率为95%。参与者认为系统有帮助且有能力，智能体对元查询和语码转换等对话干扰保持鲁棒。与先前在线基线相比，物理交互显著降低了感知社会存在感（p=.0005）以及信任与能力感（p=.037），但感知帮助性仍然较高。
AI.conclusion: 该目标导向智能体AI架构可有效支持非专家用户完成物理维修任务；在物理交互场景下，尽管社会存在感、信任与能力感相比在线基线显著下降，但系统仍保持较高的帮助性评价。

65ac8db4d4cba187b7d58f871cff33d1d963381d.title: CoEvo: Oracle-Grounded Self-Evolution of a Single Model for Multi-Step Causal Reasoning
65ac8db4d4cba187b7d58f871cff33d1d963381d.summary: Multi-step causal reasoning requires chaining inferences where each step constrains the next. An early error propagates silently, and a correct answer reached via flawed logic evades outcome-level detection. In specialized domains, teacher LLMs err on intermediate steps, safety constraints restrict cloud distillation, and shifting conditions demand adaptation, leaving self-evolution as the practical route. Naive self-evolution can collapse: outcome-only rewards let the model exploit distributional shortcuts, and weak self-evaluation reinforces spurious paths into stable failure patterns. We exploit a key asymmetry: generating a correct chain is hard, but verifying a single step is easy. Many high-stakes domains admit a deterministic, queryable oracle, a physics simulator or rule engine over codified constraints. It checks asserted steps without teacher-level ability and abstains beyond its rules; it can check what the model asserts, never replace it. This enables CoEvo, an oracle-grounded self-evolution framework where a single model alternates between Proposer and Solver. As Solver, the model generates competing chains; intra-group debate exposes disagreement steps, a proxy for the capability boundary, and the oracle adjudicates them into process-level supervision. As Proposer, the same model constructs progressively harder scenarios inside oracle constraints, steering the curriculum toward deep multi-hop chains. Both roles are updated jointly, so training pressure co-evolves with the model. On industrial, clinical, and legal multi-step causal reasoning benchmarks, CoEvo enables an 8B LLM to sustain self-evolution, surpassing distillation baselines and the strongest proprietary reference on path correctness (82.1% vs. 71.4%). The trained model generalizes to unseen categories and systems, preserving root-cause accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoEvo：一种基于确定性预言机的自进化框架，让单一模型交替扮演 Proposer 与 Solver，通过组内辩论定位分歧步骤并由预言机裁决生成过程级监督，同时构造渐难课程，实现多步因果推理的自进化。8B 模型路径正确率达 82.1%，超过 71.4% 的最强专有参考。
AI.motivation: 多步因果推理需逐步链式约束，早期错误会静默传播，且错误逻辑得到正确答案可逃过结果级检测。专业领域中教师 LLM 中间步骤易错、安全约束限制云端蒸馏、条件变化要求适应，因此自进化成为可行路径。但朴素自进化会崩溃：仅用结果奖励会利用分布捷径，弱自评会把虚假路径强化为稳定失败模式。
AI.method: 利用“生成正确链难、验证单步易”的不对称性，在高风险领域引入确定性、可查询的预言机（如物理模拟器或规则引擎），仅校验模型断言步骤，超出规则则弃权。CoEvo 中单一模型交替作为 Solver 与 Proposer：Solver 生成竞争链，组内辩论暴露分歧步骤（能力边界代理），预言机裁决为过程级监督；Proposer 在预言机约束内构造渐难场景，将课程导向深度多跳链。两角色联合更新，使训练压力与模型共同进化。
AI.result: 在工业、临床、法律多步因果推理基准上，CoEvo 使 8B LLM 持续自进化，路径正确率 82.1%，超过蒸馏基线和最强专有参考 71.4%；并能泛化到未见类别与系统，同时保持根因准确率。
AI.conclusion: CoEvo 表明，借助领域内确定性预言机提供过程级监督，可避免朴素自进化的崩溃，实现无需教师蒸馏的可扩展自进化，并提升多步因果推理的路径正确性与泛化能力。

a0acbf79d0ebf97848946e06692c5c6e6643b500.title: The Free-Recipe Limit: Every Recipe Effect Measures Which Premise of an Idealised Learner Broke
a0acbf79d0ebf97848946e06692c5c6e6643b500.comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (incl. appendices); code, pre-registration files, and result base to be released with the paper
a0acbf79d0ebf97848946e06692c5c6e6643b500.summary: Fix a corpus and send recipe search to infinity: try every order of the skills, every arrangement from blocked to interleaved, every composition, and keep the best.
