Two quantities decide what that search was worth: the diameter of the reachable set it explores, and the resolution at which anyone can tell two endpoints apart. Where the diameter falls below the resolution, no amount of search converts into a decision, and the signature is not an absence of winners but winners that do not survive re-running. We measure this recipe-search wall with 761 fine-tuning runs on 12 base models (0.5B-14B, three pretraining families) over competition-mathematics skills: base checkpoints, supervised fine-tuning under AdamW, exact-match scoring at k=4. Within one coherent domain at fixed volume the three classical freedoms average 0.010-0.021 against a 0.019 floor, and the largest contrast, 0.0619, clears a three-seed resolution and then reads +0.010 and -0.015 on two reruns. The departure with a systematic answer is coherence: halving one pooled corpus and letting the halves write answers under incompatible but equally correct conventions moves arrangement from capability to allocation between conventions, by two orders of magnitude over a same-convention control, and writing the convention into the input switches the phenomenon off. The switch replicates on a second pretraining family and survives an independent re-execution of its own protocol, with a re-execution spread (0.087) smaller than the resolution a search-selected order cell carries (0.144). Order itself is a transient whose sign crosses zero three times inside a single run. Volume, the one lever nobody calls a recipe, is the one that reliably pays. A public scorecard grades all 26 pre-registered claims: 18 supported, 5 failed, 2 untested, 1 mixed.

AI.tldr: 在固定语料下穷举"技能顺序/组合"的配方搜索几乎无法转化为可靠决策：可达集直径低于可分辨分辨率时，搜索结果不可复现。761 次微调（12 个基座模型，0.5B–14B）显示：顺序类"自由量"效应量与噪声地板相当；真正可靠起作用的是语料规模，现象背后的系统性变量是"连贯性"。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑一个常见假设：通过穷举技能顺序、排列与组合（"配方"）就能在固定语料上找到更优的微调方案。论文试图界定这种"配方搜索"到底能带来多少真实增益，并区分"可决定的差异"与"仅是重跑噪声的赢家"，从而厘清哪些杠杆值得投入。
AI.method: 以竞赛数学技能为任务域，进行 761 次微调。变量配置：12 个基座模型（0.5B–14B，来自三个预训练家族）、基座检查点、AdamW 监督微调、k=4 的精确匹配评分。用两个量刻画搜索价值：可达集直径（搜索探索范围）与端点可分辨分辨率。核心实验为"连贯性"干预：将一份合并语料对半切分，让两半在"互不兼容但同样正确"的约定下写答案，并设置同约定对照；进一步把约定写入输入。另对顺序效应做重复运行与顺序符号追踪。
AI.result: 在单一连贯域、固定量级下，三种经典自由量（顺序/排列/组合）效应量平均 0.010–0.021，而噪声地板为 0.019；最大对比 0.0619 虽通过三种子分辨率，但两次重跑仅得 +0.010 与 −0.015，即不可存活于重跑。连贯性干预显著：合并语料对半切分并使约定不兼容后，排列效应从"能力"转为"约定间的分配"，相对同约定对照提升两个数量级；把约定写入输入后该现象被关闭。此开关在第二个预训练家族上复现，并通过独立重执行，重执行离散度（0.087）小于由搜索选出的顺序单元所携带的分辨率（0.144）。顺序本身是瞬态：其符号在单次运行内三次穿越零点。语料规模是唯一稳定见效的杠杆。公开记分卡评估 26 项预注册假设：18 支持、5 失败、2 未测、1 混合。
AI.conclusion: 配方搜索的"顺序/排列/组合"多数落在分辨率以下，属于重跑即逝的瞬态赢家，而非真实增益。可复现且具系统性的变量是"连贯性"——即各技能是否在同一（约定兼容）的语义框架下作答；驱动效应其实是约定间的资源分配，而非能力提升。实际上，唯一可靠的杠杆是训练语料规模这一"常识性"变量。因此对配方搜索应持审慎态度，并重视预注册与重执行检验。

5d11901519d68ade02653bdcd0c10787767ee365.title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for World Models and Video Generation
5d11901519d68ade02653bdcd0c10787767ee365.summary: KV cache memory has become a major deployment bottleneck for video generation and world models, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency. Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods can achieve nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks such as VBench, however, we find that they still cause severe temporal flickering and visual degradation. Meanwhile, deeper investigates show that Key quantization produces smaller reconstruction errors than Value, but surprisingly leads to much larger output degradation. We trace this discrepancy to attention: small Key perturbations can change the attention logits, i.e., QK^\top, and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. These observations motivate us to explicitly preserve attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection during KV cache quantization to alleviate the visual degradation problem. To address this issue, we present QuantWM, a training-free and strictly causal 2-bit KV cache quantization framework. QuantWM introduces two complementary techniques to mitigate the attention shifts. Firstly, quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) jointly considers historical Query sensitivity and residual ranges to select INT2-friendly Key centroids, which reduces quantization errors in channels that are more critical to attention. In addition, principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) restores the remaining Key errors along the dominant Query subspace using low-rank projections, which provides a direct and efficient correction to stabilize attention logits. Extensive experiments on Causal-Forcing, LingBot-World-v2, HY-World 1.5, Matrix-Game-2 and Longcat-Video demonstrate that QuantWM significantly improves visual quality and temporal consistency, while outperforming existing methods across image and video quality metrics with up to 6.20x KV cache memory compression and limited additional overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对视频生成与世界模型中KV cache显存瓶颈，本文发现现有2-bit KV cache量化虽在VBench上近乎无损，却导致严重时序闪烁与视觉退化，其根源在于Key量化虽重构误差小，但会扰动注意力logits QK^T并改变Query选中的时空token。为此提出免训练、严格因果的2-bit KV cache量化框架QuantWM，通过QSAC与PSAC在量化过程中显式保持注意力logits与时空token选择，在多个视频生成模型上显著提升视觉质量与时序一致性，实现最高6.20倍KV cache压缩且额外开销有限。
AI.motivation: KV cache显存已成为视频生成与世界模型部署的主要瓶颈，因此需要低比特量化以提升效率。现有2-bit KV cache量化方法在VBench等视频基准上性能近乎无损，但仍造成严重时序闪烁与视觉退化。进一步分析表明：Key量化重构误差小于Value，却带来更大的输出退化。作者将这一反常现象归因于注意力机制：Key的微小扰动会改变注意力logits（QK^T），进而偏移Query所选择的时空token。因此，需要在KV cache量化中显式保持注意力logits与时空token选择，以缓解视觉退化。
AI.method: 提出QuantWM，一种免训练且严格因果的2-bit KV cache量化框架，包含两项互补技术以缓解注意力偏移：(1) 量化敏感度感知聚类（QSAC），联合考虑历史Query敏感度与残差范围，选择对INT2友好的Key聚类中心，从而降低对注意力更关键通道的量化误差；(2) 主子空间注意力补偿（PSAC），利用低秩投影沿主导Query子空间恢复剩余Key误差，直接且高效地校正并稳定注意力logits。
AI.result: 在Causal-Forcing、LingBot-World-v2、HY-World 1.5、Matrix-Game-2与Longcat-Video上的大量实验表明，QuantWM显著提升视觉质量与时序一致性，在图像与视频质量指标上优于现有方法，同时实现最高6.20倍KV cache显存压缩，且额外开销有限。
AI.conclusion: QuantWM验证了在KV cache量化中显式保持注意力logits与时空token选择的重要性，能够在不训练、严格因果的前提下实现高压缩率的2-bit KV cache量化，有效缓解视频生成与世界模型的时序闪烁与视觉退化问题，兼顾效率与生成质量。

8a877197a09999def267da723b00990541813ce1.title: Silent Sabotage: Internal State Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Powered Robotic Systems
8a877197a09999def267da723b00990541813ce1.summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotic control systems is enabling a new generation of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and planning. While this paradigm shift accelerates progress, it also introduces novel security risks that remain largely unexplored. Current research into LLM backdoors has focused on attacks triggered by external stimuli, such as specific words, visual objects, or environmental states. These attacks, while potent, overlook a more insidious class of vulnerability where the trigger is internal to the agent's own operational logic. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of history-based backdoor attacks on LLM-powered robotic systems. We demonstrate that an attacker can embed a stealthy backdoor into an LLM-based robot controller by manipulating its instructions. This backdoor is triggered not by an external cue, but by a specific, rare sequence of the robot's own past actions. It remains dormant during normal operation, preserving the robot's utility, but can be activated to induce a malicious behavior, such as a complete stop or a collision. Our experiments, conducted in a simulated environment with a variety of robots and LLMs, show that this history-based attack is highly effective, achieving a near-perfect attack success rate while remaining exceptionally difficult to detect. These findings reveal a critical and previously unaddressed vulnerability in autonomous systems and underscore the urgent need for security measures that account for an agent's internal state.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究LLM驱动机器人系统中"基于历史"的后门攻击：攻击者通过操纵控制器指令植入后门，其触发器为机器人自身过去动作的稀有序列；该后门正常时休眠、保持效用，激活后引发完全停止或碰撞等恶意行为；模拟实验中对多种机器人与多种LLM均实现近乎完美的攻击成功率，且极难被检测。
AI.motivation: LLM与机器人控制的融合带来具备复杂推理与规划能力的新一代自主智能体，同时也引入了尚未被充分探索的新型安全风险。现有LLM后门研究主要聚焦于由外部刺激（特定词语、视觉物体、环境状态）触发的攻击，忽略了触发信号内生于智能体自身操作逻辑这类更隐蔽、更危险的漏洞类别。
AI.method: 提出并研究"基于历史的后门攻击"：通过操纵LLM机器人控制器的指令嵌入隐蔽后门，其触发条件为机器人自身过去动作的特定稀有序列，而非外部线索。在含多种机器人和多种LLM的模拟环境中开展实验验证。
AI.result: 该基于历史的攻击具有很高有效性：攻击成功率接近完美，同时检测难度极高。后门在正常运行期间保持休眠，不损害机器人效用，仅在触发序列出现时激活，诱发完全停止或碰撞等恶意行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了自主系统中一个关键且此前未被处理的漏洞，表明安全防护必须考虑智能体的内部状态（动作历史），对LLM驱动机器人系统的后门防御提出了迫切需求。

c428016dbb6fa113c57daed97720711fb47b5392.title: Certified Mechanistic Interpretability: Lifting Single-Input Findings to Bounded Neighbourhoods
c428016dbb6fa113c57daed97720711fb47b5392.summary: Mechanistic interpretability reverse-engineers transformer circuits one input at a time, leaving observed mechanisms without guarantees over bounded input neighbourhoods. We address this gap with a framework based on constrained polynomial-zonotope (CPZ) propagation that lifts mechanistic-interpretability observations from a single input to certified statements over a bounded set of perturbations. Three internal-attention queries (top-$k$ stability, evidence mass, and attention entropy) are formulated as tractable programs over the simplex of attention weights, and CPZ propagation through transformer blocks is shown to preserve the softmax simplex and the LayerNorm zero-mean identity exactly. A recursive Jacobian zonotope construction extends the same certificates across layer depth by linearising the block stack at the input and avoids per-layer generator growth. We instantiate the framework on transformer attention; the resulting certificates offer a way to sharpen mechanistic statements that single-input inspection cannot resolve on its own, and to inform downstream decisions in regimes where empirical heuristics may be misleading.

AI.tldr: 提出基于约束多项式-zonotope（CPZ）传播的框架，将机械可解释性中逐输入的注意力机制观察，提升为有界扰动集合上的可认证陈述；针对三个内部注意力查询构造可解程序，并在Transformer块传播中精确保留softmax单纯形与LayerNorm零均值恒等式，进而以递归Jacobian zonotope将证书扩展至多层深度。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性通常以单个输入为单位逆向工程Transformer电路，所得机制解释仅适用于该输入，缺乏在有界输入邻域上的保证。作者旨在弥补这一缺口，使机制性观察具备可认证的覆盖范围，并支持在经验启发式可能失效的场景中辅助下游决策。
AI.method: 核心为约束多项式-zonotope（CPZ）传播：将三个内部注意力查询——top-k稳定性、证据质量（evidence mass）与注意力熵——形式化为注意力权重单纯形上的可处理优化程序；证明CPZ在Transformer块中的传播能够精确保留softmax单纯形与LayerNorm零均值恒等式；进一步构造递归Jacobian zonotope，通过在输入端对块堆栈线性化，将同一类证书扩展到层深维度，并避免逐层生成元数量增长。框架在Transformer注意力上实例化。
AI.result: 所生成的证书能够强化单输入检查无法分辨的机制性陈述，并为经验启发式可能产生误导的情形提供下游决策依据。摘要未报告具体数据集、基线或定量指标，主要贡献为理论框架与可认证性保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将机械可解释性从单输入观察推进到有界扰动邻域上的认证分析，为Transformer注意力机制提供了可跨层扩展、保持结构不变量的形式化证书框架。

f2e5433d1bac9b1bc34cde093b47e4df39db1a03.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
f2e5433d1bac9b1bc34cde093b47e4df39db1a03.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. This compliance benchmark is reviewed and corrected by human AI legal experts throughout the whole process. The resulting dataset (4,435+ QA pairs) provides an extensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy covering critical regulatory frontiers, including bias and discrimination, fairness, personal privacy protection, and values. Crucially, our compliance dataset moves beyond shallow string-matching by incorporating contextual long-horizon interactions and logic-driven hazard chains, capturing deeply embedded compliance anomalies that bypass traditional filters. Experiment evaluations demonstrate that our framework exposes critical regulatory blind spots in state-of-the-art LLMs, offering a rigorous, AI laws and regulations-aligned benchmark to safeguard high-level and deep compliance in the application of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EADC——一个基于 AI 合规知识图谱与法律专家评审的 LLM 合规性评测基准，用于揭示现有静态基准在法规一致性、隐性风险与风险传播方面的不足。
AI.motivation: LLM 已广泛落地各行业，但其对复杂法律与监管框架的合规性难以保障。现有评测主要依赖静态基准，存在三类严重局限：所用合规规则不符合 AI 法律法规要求；只能识别显性合规风险，无法发现隐性、隐蔽风险；无法追踪风险沿逻辑依赖链的系统性传播，也缺乏对真实场景中细微语境合规性的评估。
AI.method: 提出 EADC 评测基准，融合 AI 合规知识图谱与 AI 合规法律专家。将抽象法律规则映射为结构化、逻辑化的多关系图，使自动化、可演化的智能体能够蒸馏并合成高复杂度对抗场景；全流程由人类 AI 法律专家审查与修正。构建数据集包含 4,435+ 问答对，覆盖偏见与歧视、公平性、个人隐私保护、价值观等关键监管前沿，并引入上下文长程交互与逻辑驱动的风险链，超越浅层字符串匹配。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，该框架能够暴露当前最先进 LLM 的关键监管盲区，并提供一个严格对齐 AI 法律法规的评测基准。
AI.conclusion: EADC 为 LLM 应用中的高层次、深度合规提供了更严谨的评测手段，有助于保障 LLM 在复杂监管环境下的合规落地。

3efd40598f4fa313caee22990b3a5bc277d09a38.title: Latent Dataset Distillation for Human Motion Prediction
3efd40598f4fa313caee22990b3a5bc277d09a38.summary: Dataset distillation (DD) compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while preserving downstream training utility. Although DD has been widely studied for images and recently extended to time-series forecasting, its application to human motion prediction remains largely unexplored. Human motion is high-dimensional and structurally coupled, and gradient matching (GM) in the original motion space optimizes many correlated variables without a prior on pose plausibility or temporal dynamics, which frequently yields implausible and unstable synthetic motions. To address this limitation, we propose a latent DD framework that regularizes distillation with a learned motion prior. Motions are first compressed by a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RVQ-VAE), and distillation then updates only a learnable latent bank through the frozen quantizer and decoder. The pretrained decoder restricts synthetic motions to its output space, while residual quantization progressively refines the latent approximation across multiple codebooks and alleviates the representational bottleneck of single-stage vector quantization. Experiments on Human3.6M, CMU, and 3DPW with two prediction backbones show that the proposed framework outperforms direct GM in 27 of 30 evaluated settings and random subsets in every setting, and produces visibly more plausible synthetic motions in qualitative comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出一种潜在空间数据集蒸馏框架，用学习到的运动先验（RVQ-VAE）正则化蒸馏过程，将蒸馏更新限制在可学习隐变量库上，从而为人体运动预测生成更合理、更稳定的合成运动数据。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏（DD）已在图像领域广泛研究，并近期扩展到时间序列预测，但在人体运动预测上仍鲜有探索。人体运动具有高维且结构耦合的特点，直接在原始运动空间进行梯度匹配（GM）会优化大量相关变量，且缺乏对姿态合理性或时序动态的先验约束，常导致合成运动不合理且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出潜在空间DD框架，以学习到的运动先验正则化蒸馏：先用残差量化变分自编码器（RVQ-VAE）压缩运动；蒸馏阶段仅通过冻结的量化器与解码器更新一个可学习的隐变量库（latent bank）。预训练解码器将合成运动限制在其输出空间内，而残差量化通过多个码本逐步细化隐变量近似，缓解单阶段矢量量化的表征瓶颈。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M、CMU、3DPW三个数据集与两种预测骨干网络上实验：所提框架在30个评估设定中有27个优于直接GM，并在所有设定中优于随机子集；定性比较显示生成的合成运动明显更合理。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入学习到的运动先验并仅在潜在空间进行蒸馏，可有效克服原始空间梯度匹配的不合理与不稳定问题，在人体运动预测的数据集蒸馏任务上取得一致的性能提升与更优的合成运动质量。

0c657dc2994ce35d5f4a53543600b9f5f9da4d10.title: Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects Using Model Predictive Path Integral Control with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Learning
0c657dc2994ce35d5f4a53543600b9f5f9da4d10.comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables, 22nd International Conference on Informatics in Control, Automation and Robotics (ICINCO 2025)
0c657dc2994ce35d5f4a53543600b9f5f9da4d10.summary: The manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as cables poses a significant challenge for automation due to their infinite degrees of freedom and non-linear dynamics. In this paper we present a machine learning based optimal control approach for the manipulation of DLOs. This approach is divided into two main components: modeling and control. For modeling the dynamics of the DLO, we propose a learning based approach using a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (biLSTM) network. The biLSTM network is trained on synthetic data generated by the MuJoCo physics engine. For manipulating the DLO, a model predictive control strategy that employs Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is selected. The proposed approach is evaluated through simulation and experiments. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in achieving accurate and efficient manipulation of DLOs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于机器学习的DLO操作最优控制方法：用biLSTM学习线缆动力学，结合MPPI模型预测控制，仿真与实验验证其有效性与高效性。
AI.motivation: 可变形线性物体（DLO，如线缆）具有无限自由度与非线性动力学，传统建模与控制困难，给自动化操作带来显著挑战。
AI.method: 将方法分为建模与控制两部分：建模采用双向长短期记忆网络（biLSTM），使用MuJoCo物理引擎生成的合成数据进行训练；控制采用基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）的模型预测控制策略来操作DLO。
AI.result: 通过仿真与实验进行评估，结果表明该方法能够实现准确且高效的DLO操作。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的“biLSTM建模 + MPPI控制”机器学习最优控制框架对DLO操作有效，具备较好的准确性与效率。

191f7fcf00cd83670534ebd0c1560d939f661718.title: Identifying Intelligent Processes via Online Sequential Testing
191f7fcf00cd83670534ebd0c1560d939f661718.summary: Active sequential hypothesis testing studies how to identify an unknown hypothesis with a given set of sensing actions. We study this in the setting of identifying large language models (LLMs), \textit{i.e.}, if a user is conversing with an LLM drawn from a known set of models, how can they identify which one is in use? Here, the available sensing actions (evaluations) are themselves a design choice: an evaluator must first decide which environments and prompt families to construct, and only then decide how to use them sequentially. We formalize these two levels as an outer probe-design problem and an inner identification problem. Simply put, the outer stage selects a set of probes to be sent to the entire set of models, creating a kind of fingerprint dataset. This is followed by the inner stage, which sequentially sends a budget-minimizing set of those probes to identify the model in use. For the outer problem, we show that selecting which evaluations to construct at minimum cost, so that every pair of candidates is distinguished, is exactly a weighted set cover problem. Since the response distributions of the candidate models are not known exactly but only through calibration samples, we give a one-shot procedure that estimates the cover instance from these samples. For the inner problem, we bound the number of evaluations needed to identify the unknown model in terms of how well the available evaluations distinguish each pair of candidates.

AI.tldr: 将“识别正在使用的LLM”形式化为两级主动序贯假设检验：外层设计探针/评测以构建指纹数据集，内层序贯选择预算最小的探针完成模型识别；外层等价于加权集合覆盖，内层给出识别所需评测次数上界。
AI.motivation: 用户与来自已知模型集合的LLM对话时，需要判断具体是哪一个模型。与经典主动序贯假设检验不同，这里的“感知动作/评测”本身也是设计变量：必须先决定构造哪些环境与提示族，再决定如何序贯使用它们。因此需要研究“先设计探针、后序贯识别”的两层问题。
AI.method: 论文将问题形式化为外层探针设计问题与内层识别问题。外层：选择一组探针发送给全部候选模型，形成指纹数据集，目标是最小成本地构造评测集合，使任意两个候选模型都可被区分；作者证明该问题恰为加权集合覆盖问题。由于候选模型的响应分布未知、仅有校准样本，提出一次性（one-shot）程序从样本中估计覆盖实例。内层：在已有探针集合上，序贯地发送预算最小的一组探针来识别当前使用的模型，并依据各评测对候选模型对的区分能力推导所需评测次数的上界。
AI.result: 外层问题被精确刻画为加权集合覆盖，并给出从校准样本估计覆盖实例的一次性方法；内层得到识别未知模型所需评测次数的理论上界，该上界由可用评测对每一对候选模型的区分能力决定。
AI.conclusion: 论文为LLM识别提供了两层主动序贯测试框架：把探针/评测设计归约为加权集合覆盖，并在响应分布仅通过校准样本可知的条件下给出覆盖实例估计；同时量化了序贯识别阶段的预算成本。该框架可用于构建模型指纹数据集，并为预算受限下的LLM识别提供理论保证。

db1e8650e7bbdc3148620540f649edfdb5af425c.title: A Multi-Timestep LSTM Ensemble regressor for Enhanced Short-Term Runoff Prediction
db1e8650e7bbdc3148620540f649edfdb5af425c.summary: Accurately forecasting river runoff is key to managing water resources, controlling floods, and planning agriculture. This study examines the Ajichay River in northwest Iran, a major tributary of Lake Urmia that has experienced increasing water-related stress in recent years. We introduce a daily runoff prediction model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The model combines five LSTM units, each trained on different time intervals ranging from 2 to 6 days, to better capture variations in river flow patterns. To improve performance, each model was fine-tuned using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), a population-based optimization algorithm. The proposed approach was evaluated on unseen data from 2017-2018 using $R^2$, RMSE, and MSE as performance metrics. The results showed strong predictive accuracy, with $R^2$ values ranging from 74.95% to 91.42%. In addition, multiple feature-importance methods were applied to identify the most influential variables, providing further insight into the factors that drive runoff variations.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对伊朗西北部阿吉柴河（Urmia湖主要支流）的日径流预测，构建了一种基于LSTM集成的模型：由5个在不同时间尺度（2–6天）上训练的LSTM单元组成，并利用粒子群优化（PSO）对每个模型进行超参数/参数微调。模型在2017–2018年未见数据上评估，R²为74.95%–91.42%，RMSE与MSE作为误差指标；同时使用多种特征重要性方法识别关键驱动变量。
AI.motivation: 准确预测河流径流对水资源管理、洪水控制和农业规划至关重要；研究区域阿吉柴河是Urmia湖的重要支流，近年面临日益加剧的水资源压力，因此需要提高日径流预测精度并识别影响径流变化的关键因素。
AI.method: 提出基于LSTM的日径流预测模型；模型由5个LSTM单元组成，分别在不同时间间隔（2至6天）上训练，以捕捉河流流量模式变化；采用粒子群优化（PSO）对每个模型进行微调；以R²、RMSE和MSE为性能指标，在2017–2018年未见数据上评估；并应用多种特征重要性方法识别最具影响力的变量。
AI.result: 在2017–2018年未见数据上取得较强预测精度，R²范围为74.95%至91.42%；通过多种特征重要性方法识别出影响径流变化的主要变量。
AI.conclusion: 基于多时间尺度LSTM集成并经PSO优化的方法能够有效提升日径流预测精度，可为阿吉柴河及类似水资源压力区域的水资源管理、洪水调控和农业规划提供支持；特征重要性分析进一步增强了模型可解释性。

b869a463294e2e5e021b6906a3a50a09f2a1d33d.title: Radiomics-Conditioned Modulation of RenalCLIP Features for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
b869a463294e2e5e021b6906a3a50a09f2a1d33d.comment: Accepted at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026). 10 pages, 2 figures
b869a463294e2e5e021b6906a3a50a09f2a1d33d.summary: Radiomics provides quantitative descriptions of tumour appearance that may complement disease-specific foundation models in small labelled cohorts. We investigate this complementarity for computed tomography-based classification of clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Our framework uses radiomics to modulate RenalCLIP features through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), while retaining a direct radiomics contribution. Internal testing and external validation compare it with conventional fusion strategies and reference classifiers. The FiLM model achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.804 internally and 0.854 externally, with the highest mean AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies in both cohorts. Pathway ablations examine the contributions of conditional modulation and the direct radiomics residual, while feature permutation highlights the role of tumour texture. These findings support radiomics as a useful complement to RenalCLIP in a small labelled cohort and identify FiLM as an effective approach to integrating their representations for robust renal tumour classification.

AI.tldr: 提出FiLM框架，用影像组学调制RenalCLIP特征并保留直接影像组学贡献，用于CT透明细胞肾细胞癌分类；内部与外部验证AUC分别达0.804和0.854，优于所评估的常规融合策略。
AI.motivation: 在小样本标注队列中，影像组学可提供肿瘤外观的定量描述，有望补充疾病特异性基础模型；本文旨在探究二者在CT透明细胞肾细胞癌分类中的互补性。
AI.method: 通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）用影像组学调制RenalCLIP特征，同时保留直接影像组学贡献；开展内部测试与外部验证，并与常规融合策略及参考分类器比较；通过通路消融考察条件调制与直接影像组学残差的作用，并用特征置换分析肿瘤纹理的贡献。
AI.result: FiLM模型内部测试AUC为0.804，外部验证AUC为0.854；在两个队列中，其平均AUC均为所评估RenalCLIP融合策略中最高。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持影像组学作为小样本标注队列中RenalCLIP的有效补充，并表明FiLM是整合二者表征、实现稳健肾肿瘤分类的有效方法。

2d312f8493c667ea9178600266fd38123399c1c3.title: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
2d312f8493c667ea9178600266fd38123399c1c3.summary: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRIWORLDBENCH：一个用同步“头部+左腕+右腕”三视角视频评估具身世界模型的基准，包含 50 个双臂操作任务、500 条 episode 和 19 项指标，并给出 TWB-Score 以汇总整体表现、保留分视角结果定位失败来源。
AI.motivation: 具身世界模型需预测机器人动作结果以支持学习与规划。对配备头部与腕部相机的机器人而言，头部视角提供全局任务信息，腕部视角揭示夹爪—物体局部交互，二者互补；但独立评估各视角无法判断它们是否描述了同一动作与同一物体状态，因此缺少面向多视角一致性的统一评测方法。
AI.method: 构建 TRIWORLDBENCH 基准，使用同步的头部、左腕、右腕视频进行评估；数据集涵盖 50 个双臂操作任务、500 条 episode；设计 19 项指标，覆盖三视角一致性、任务对齐、物理与 3D 一致性、运动质量、时序一致性和视觉质量；将跨视角检查与针对各相机定制的度量结合，并用 TWB-Score 汇总整体性能，同时保留每视角结果以定位预测失败位置。
AI.result: 该基准能够评估“单个视角看似合理的视频”是否同时构成对目标任务的连贯、一致的预测，并可识别预测在哪些视角或维度上失败；评估范围由此从单视角视觉质量扩展到跨视角任务一致性。代码、数据与指标定义已在 GitHub 公开。
AI.conclusion: TRIWORLDBENCH 为具身世界模型提供了多视角、任务导向的评测框架，推动评估从单一视觉质量转向同步三视角下的一致性、物理合理性与任务对齐，为后续世界模型学习与规划提供更可靠的衡量标准。

f4228380f5097c123972378c1608767eec0d81b2.title: Bridging the Data Gap: Digital Twin as a New Paradigm for AI-based Radio Sensing
f4228380f5097c123972378c1608767eec0d81b2.summary: We present a methodology that places a 3D digital twin (DT) of the environment as the main enabler behind the development of radio sensing at scale. The DT acts as a world model, providing geometry, materials, and transmitter/receiver placements to a ray-tracing engine that generates time-indexed channel impulse responses (CIRs) for large numbers of plausible scenes (moving people and objects, layout variants, seasonal/weather conditions, etc). From these synthetic sequences, we train a sequential neural network that maps CIR time series to spatial occupancy estimates, enabling device-free localization (DFL) without instrumented targets. We posit that sensing is best approached as an environment-conditioned learning problem: rather than seeking a single global model, we advocate training or fine-tuning local models specialized to a site-specific DT. As a first experiment, we introduce a novel State Space Model architecture, trained and evaluated across multiple room geometries. The localization performances obtained demonstrate the potential of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出以3D数字孪生（DT）作为环境世界模型，驱动射线追踪生成大规模合成信道冲激响应（CIR）序列，并训练序列神经网络实现无设备定位（DFL）；主张将无线感知建模为“环境条件化”的本地模型学习问题，并给出基于状态空间模型的初步验证。
AI.motivation: 无线感知规模化面临真实标注数据稀缺、场景多样且站点特异的问题；单一全局模型难以适应不同环境。作者希望利用数字孪生可配置、可扩展的合成数据能力，降低对仪器化目标和真实采集的依赖。
AI.method: 以环境3D数字孪生为核心：提供几何、材质及收发机位置，输入射线追踪引擎，生成大量合理场景（人员/物体移动、布局变体、季节与天气条件等）下的时间索引CIR；再由这些合成序列训练序列神经网络，将CIR时间序列映射为空间占用估计，实现无设备定位。方法上强调“环境条件化学习”：不追求单一全局模型，而是针对站点特定DT训练或微调局部模型。首个实验引入一种新的状态空间模型（SSM）架构，并在多个房间几何中训练与评估。
AI.result: 在多个房间几何条件下完成训练与评估，定位性能表明该数字孪生驱动的环境条件化学习与序列建模方案具有可行性与潜力。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生可作为规模化无线感知的关键使能器，通过合成CIR数据与站点特化模型实现无设备定位；未来可拓展到更多环境条件与场景变体，并验证跨站点泛化与部署效果。

80ae4f3181df27f44e8ed00bfa897feb20acfed5.title: Coding Agents are Strong Prompt Optimizers
80ae4f3181df27f44e8ed00bfa897feb20acfed5.summary: Search-based prompt optimizers improve prompts through iterative search: they propose edits, execute fresh rollouts, score the resulting trajectories, and retain only edits that improve a validation metric. We show that this optimization loop is unnecessary. Given only a static corpus of agent trajectories, an off-the-shelf coding agent can directly synthesize an optimized prompt, requiring neither environment access nor validation data. We call this approach \textit{Coding-Agent Skill Distillation} (CASD). The key insight is reflection scope. Rather than reasoning over a small batch of trajectories at each optimization step, the coding agent writes and executes analysis code to compute corpus-wide statistics, identifies systematic failure modes, inspects representative episodes, and distills the resulting insights into behavioral rules. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, $τ^2$-bench retail and telecom, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), under matched data access, a single CASD pass outperforms GEPA, a state-of-the-art reflective prompt optimizer, on three of four benchmarks and outperforms validation-gated reflective search (SkillOpt) on all four, improving the unoptimized baseline by 16.6 percentage points on average versus 10.9 for GEPA and 5.3 for SkillOpt. Because CASD performs a single offline analysis pass rather than iterative search, producing an optimized prompt costs approximately \$1.60---over $22\times$ cheaper than validation-gated search. Even when competing methods are granted additional validation data and unrestricted environment access, CASD remains ahead on two of four benchmarks. These results suggest that corpus-scale statistical reflection is a viable alternative to iterative search for prompt optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CASD（Coding-Agent Skill Distillation），主张不需要迭代式搜索即可优化提示词：仅给定静态的智能体轨迹语料，通用编码智能体即可通过编写并执行分析代码，进行语料级统计反思，直接合成优化后的提示词，无需环境访问或验证数据。
AI.motivation: 现有基于搜索的提示优化器依赖迭代循环（提出编辑、重新执行、打分、保留改进项），计算代价高、需要环境访问与验证数据。作者希望验证这一优化循环是否必要，探索能否仅凭静态轨迹语料一次性完成提示优化。
AI.method: 关键洞察是"反思范围"。不同于每次优化步骤只对小批量轨迹进行推理，CASD 让编码智能体编写并执行分析代码来计算全语料统计、识别系统性失败模式、抽查代表性片段，并将洞察提炼为行为规则，从而以一次离线分析代替迭代搜索。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准（ALFWorld、τ²-bench 的 retail 与 telecom、SpreadsheetBench-Verified）上，在数据访问匹配条件下，单次 CASD 在四个基准中的三个上超越 GEPA，在全部四个上超越验证门控式反思搜索 SkillOpt。平均相对未优化基线提升 16.6 个百分点（GEPA 为 10.9，SkillOpt 为 5.3）。单次离线分析成本约 1.60 美元，比验证门控搜索便宜 22 倍以上；即便竞争方法获得额外验证数据与无限制环境访问，CASD 仍在四分之二基准上保持领先。
AI.conclusion: 语料规模的统计式反思可作为迭代搜索的有效替代方案，用于提示优化，在更低成本下取得更优或相当的性能。

74a4a05dace377817bb9eb513aa8b5e66b6df699.title: Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization for Industrial Object Detection in Low-Image-Budget Regimes
74a4a05dace377817bb9eb513aa8b5e66b6df699.summary: Retraining visual perception pipelines in High-Mix, Low-Volume (HMLV) automotive manufacturing must be carried out under tight annotation, energy, and time budgets, yet most Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) strategies still operate in the thousands of images. This work evaluates Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization (S-GDR), an annotation-free adaptation pipeline that couples Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based semantic captioning of a small unannotated real reference set with diffusion-based background synthesis (Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) conditioned by ControlNet and IP-Adapter) and mask-based object composition. On an automotive multi-object detection benchmark and with a fixed budget of 200 synthetic training images, S-GDR reaches mAP50-95 = 0.739 on a real held-out test set, outperforming a domain-randomized render baseline (mAP50-95 = 0.697) as well as brightness filtering, perceptual hashing, CycleGAN style transfer, and unguided diffusion variants sharing the same 200-image budget. These initial observations position S-GDR as a promising annotation- free alternative for extreme data-scarcity regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出免标注的语义引导域随机化（S-GDR）流水线：用VLM对少量无标注真实参考图做语义描述，结合SDXL（ControlNet+IP-Adapter）生成背景并基于掩码合成目标，在仅200张合成图的极端预算下，于汽车多目标检测基准取得mAP50-95=0.739，优于域随机化渲染基线（0.697）及多种过滤、风格迁移与无引导扩散变体。
AI.motivation: 高混合低产量（HMLV）汽车制造中，视觉感知流水线重训练受标注、能耗与时间预算严格限制，而现有合成数据生成（SDG）策略通常仍需数千张图像，难以适用于极端数据稀缺场景。
AI.method: S-GDR为免标注自适应流水线：1）使用VLM对小型无标注真实参考集进行语义描述（semantic captioning）；2）用SDXL扩散模型生成背景，并以ControlNet与IP-Adapter进行条件控制；3）采用基于掩码的目标合成完成图像组合。在固定200张合成训练图像的预算下进行评测。
AI.result: 在汽车多目标检测基准的真实留出测试集上，S-GDR达到mAP50-95=0.739，超过域随机化渲染基线的0.697，也优于亮度过滤、感知哈希、CycleGAN风格迁移以及无引导扩散等同样使用200张图像预算的变体。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，S-GDR是极端数据稀缺条件下有前景的免标注替代方案，可在严格预算内提升视觉感知模型的域适应检测性能。

eb1cf6402032937ca864c10c68a88b3410e2c3a9.title: ArborSplat: Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Orchards
eb1cf6402032937ca864c10c68a88b3410e2c3a9.summary: Orchard robots need maps that preserve small but semantically important structures such as trunks, trellises, and fruit. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM achieves high photometric fidelity. However, its optimization remains appearance-driven, and transferring image semantics to 3D points is unreliable for thin structures, whose pixels may receive depth from background surfaces. We present ArborSplat, an online semantic 3DGS SLAM system that tracks with LiDAR odometry and optimizes semantics directly on the Gaussian map, constrained by class-specific height bands above a ground plane fitted to each keyframe's stereo point cloud, and fuses multi-view evidence into a semantic point cloud online while rejecting labels inconsistent with the local ground surface or with monocular depth. Class-constrained refinement reserves Gaussian capacity for underrepresented structures and, under reduced budgets, increases training-view accuracy on tree classes. We evaluate the approach on apple and pear orchards during dormancy, flowering, and harvesting. On full routes, it keeps ATE below 0.5 m on all 12 traversals. On shared 301-frame segments, it exceeds SGS-SLAM and GS3LAM by 0.23 to 0.50 training-view and 0.15 to 0.36 held-out mIoU while running 1.7 to 7.5 times faster, whereas SemGauss-SLAM runs out of GPU memory on all six.

AI.tldr: ArborSplat：面向果园机器人的在线语义3DGS SLAM系统，通过LiDAR里程计跟踪，在高度带与地平面约束下直接在高斯地图上优化语义，实现高精度、高效率的语义建图。
AI.motivation: 果园机器人需要保留树干、棚架、果实等细小但语义重要的结构的地图。现有3DGS SLAM虽具高光度保真度，但其优化以表观驱动为主，将图像语义迁移到3D点对细结构不可靠——细结构的像素可能从背景表面获得深度，导致语义标注错误。
AI.method: 提出ArborSplat在线语义3DGS SLAM：1）用LiDAR里程计进行跟踪；2）直接在高斯地图上优化语义，受每个关键帧立体点云拟合的地平面之上的类别特定高度带约束；3）在线将多视角证据融合为语义点云，同时剔除以局部地表面或单目深度不一致的标签；4）类别约束细化将高斯容量保留给欠表达结构。
AI.result: 在苹果与梨园（休眠期、花期、采收期）评估：全程路线上，12条轨迹的ATE均低于0.5 m；在共享301帧片段上，相比SGS-SLAM和GS3LAM，训练视角mIoU提升0.23–0.50、留出集mIoU提升0.15–0.36，速度快1.7–7.5倍；而SemGauss-SLAM在全部6个片段上均耗尽GPU显存。
AI.conclusion: ArborSplat通过地平面高度带约束与多视角语义融合，实现了对果园细结构的高精度在线语义建图，在精度与效率上均显著优于现有语义3DGS SLAM方法，且显存占用更具优势。

9f609e5f299d4e7c0fa613c3af43d95a11d893a3.title: Beyond Imitation: Auditing the Recoverability of Reasoning in Distilled Models
9f609e5f299d4e7c0fa613c3af43d95a11d893a3.summary: A correct teacher solution becomes useful supervision when the receiving student can continue its reasoning. We measure this compatibility with prefix recovery: after revealing 25%, 50%, or 75% of a verified solution, we test whether the student completes it correctly. We connect recovery to the cosine conflict between cross-entropy and reverse-KL gradients over the full vocabulary. Across adjacent Qwen3 teacher-student pairs from 0.6B to 8B parameters, reverse-KL distillation delivers its most consistent mathematical and code improvements for the two students below 2B parameters. On a fixed cohort of 1,000 trajectories, average prefix recovery rises from 71.0% to 91.9% as student size increases from 0.6B to 4B, and the robust-fragile recovery gap contracts from 46.0 to 14.4 percentage points. With the teacher fixed at 8B, conflict separation falls from 0.993 to 0.233. An independent objective intervention finds the largest reverse-KL rescue on fragile trajectories. The three measurements locate the same capacity-dependent transfer regime: distribution matching has the greatest headroom when correct traces remain unevenly recoverable. Prefix recovery provides a practical diagnostic for selecting costly distribution-level distillation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用“前缀恢复”诊断教师解与学生的推理兼容性，并将其与交叉熵/反向KL梯度冲突联系起来，发现反向KL蒸馏在小于2B的学生上收益最稳定，且三种测量共同指向容量依赖的迁移区间。
AI.motivation: 正确的教师解只有在学生能够继续其推理时才是有效监督；分布级蒸馏代价高，需要一种实用诊断来预判学生能从教师解中恢复多少推理，以及何时应选择反向KL等分布匹配目标。
AI.method: 以“前缀恢复”为核心指标：揭示已验证解的25%、50%、75%后，测试学生能否正确完成剩余推理。进一步在全词表上计算交叉熵与反向KL梯度的余弦冲突，并考察0.6B至8B的相邻Qwen3师生对；在固定1000条轨迹队列上比较不同学生规模，并通过独立目标干预验证反向KL的救援效果。
AI.result: 反向KL蒸馏在小于2B的两个学生上对数学与代码任务提升最一致。学生规模从0.6B增至4B时，平均前缀恢复率由71.0%升至91.9%，稳健—脆弱恢复差距由46.0个百分点收窄至14.4个百分点；教师固定为8B时，冲突分离度由0.993降至0.233。目标干预显示反向KL对脆弱轨迹的救援最大。
AI.conclusion: 前缀恢复、梯度冲突与目标干预三种测量定位到同一容量依赖迁移机制：当正确推理轨迹的恢复性不均衡时，分布匹配的改进空间最大。前缀恢复可作为选择高成本分布级蒸馏的实用诊断工具。

7e900bb6cef7769fe15e643f481bd8302d02f326.title: Decoupling Is Not Identification: Supervised Evidential Learning in Next-Token Prediction
7e900bb6cef7769fe15e643f481bd8302d02f326.summary: A next-token probability says what a model predicts, not how much training support lies behind it. A Dirichlet head can represent this distinction by separating mean $m$ from concentration $S$, but decoupling does not identify what $S$ means. Here we propose an Evidential Next-Token Prediction (ENTOP) framework to audit this gap on character-level Moby-Dick, using exact 8-gram count as a reproducible lexical-support label and withholding count regression from 20% of context types. Standard implicit evidential training carries essentially no count signal beyond confidence on held-out-label types (partial Spearman $ρ= 0.001 \pm 0.014$), whereas explicit supervision generalizes ($ρ= 0.201 \pm 0.010$; matched-pair win $= 0.822 \pm 0.021$). CE predictive entropy is at chance for unseen 8-grams (AUROC $= 0.490 \pm 0.004$), while supervised vacuity reaches $0.772 \pm 0.003$, comparable with an indexed CE-representation baseline ($0.769$) but below the tautological corpus oracle ($1.000$). Neither longest-suffix nor representation-distance strata explain where amortization succeeds. Increasing count weight under the digamma objective improves support fit only by sacrificing prediction. A constant predictor wins natural log-RMSE, and vacuity does not improve error deferral. These results motivate a minimum evidence protocol---confidence control, matched pairs, held-out labels, a constant baseline, and a decision test---and show that concentration can pass identification while failing calibration and utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ENTOP（Evidential Next-Token Prediction）框架，在字符级 Moby-Dick 数据上审计 Dirichlet 头中"集中度 S"是否真正编码了训练支持度。核心发现：隐式证据训练无法传递计数信号，只有显式监督才能泛化；即便集中度可被"识别"，也未必校准良好或具备实用价值，由此提出一套"最小证据协议"。
AI.motivation: 下一词概率只反映模型的预测结果，无法揭示其背后有多少训练支持（lexical support）。Dirichlet 头虽可通过均值 m 与集中度 S 的分离来表达这种区分，但"解耦"并不等于"S 具有可识别的语义"。作者希望检验：这种集中度究竟能否被可靠地识别为对训练支持度的度量。
AI.method: 在字符级 Moby-Dick 语料上构建 ENTOP 审计框架：以精确 8-gram 计数作为可复现的词汇支持标签，并从 20% 的上下文类型中"扣留"计数回归任务。对比隐式证据训练与显式监督；用 partial Spearman ρ 与匹配对胜率评估；以 CE 预测熵、监督 vacuity 与索引化 CE 表示基线、语料 oracle 作对比；分析最长后缀/表示距离分层；并在 digamma 目标下调节计数权重。协议包含：置信度控制、匹配对、扣留标签、常数基线、决策测试。
AI.result: 隐式证据训练在扣留标签类型上除置信度外几乎不含计数信号（ρ=0.001±0.014）；显式监督可泛化（ρ=0.201±0.010，匹配对胜率=0.822±0.021）。CE 预测熵对未见 8-gram 处于随机水平（AUROC=0.490±0.004），而监督 vacuity 达 0.772±0.003，与索引化 CE 基线（0.769）相当但低于同义反复的语料 oracle（1.000）。最长后缀与表示距离分层均无法解释摊销成功的位置。在 digamma 目标下增大计数权重只能以牺牲预测性能来改善支持拟合。常数预测器在自然 log-RMSE 上获胜，vacuity 对错误延迟（error deferral）无改善。
AI.conclusion: 集中度 S 可以"通过识别"却"校准失败、效用不足"。研究提出一套最小证据协议（置信度控制、匹配对、扣留标签、常数基线、决策测试），用以系统审计证据式模型是否真正学到支持度信息。

0084e77d65665bee4e835446c74664d2a002fe07.title: Do Vision Model See Like the Brain? A Comparison Across EEG Encoding Model
0084e77d65665bee4e835446c74664d2a002fe07.summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers are both used to model the human visual system, but whether the two architectures diverge at a specific point in network depth is unclear. We compared six CNNs and two vision transformers by computing the Pearson correlation (r) between each model's predicted and measured EEG response at every layer or block, in ten participants viewing 200 natural images. For the transformer models, we also tested four token representations, from the classification (CLS) token alone to CLS combined with all patch tokens. CNNs showed strongest correspondence at the earliest layers, weakening at deeper layers, particularly later in the post-stimulus response. Transformers instead sustained strong correspondence at their deepest blocks, though not at their earliest ones. This advantage depended on token representation: pooled representations gave weaker peak correlations (r approx 0.48-0.51) than representations retaining all patch tokens (r=0.640 for CLIP-ViT-B/32, r=0.656 for DINOv2-ViT-B/14). Controlled comparisons showed architecture, not training objective, drove this effect: MoCo-v1 and ResNet-50 (matched architecture) performed nearly identically (r=0.673, 0.670), whereas CLIP-RN50 and CLIP-ViT-B/32 (matched objective) diverged until patch tokens were preserved. We propose that CNN training's classification bottleneck compresses brain-relevant information at depth, unlike transformers' self-attention and non-classification objectives. A spatial topography analysis showed a common occipital-dominant pattern across all models, indicating these differences reflect signal strength and persistence rather than distinct brain regions. Patch-preserving transformer representations sustain brain-predictive correspondence where CNNs collapse.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过EEG对比6个CNN与2个视觉Transformer在十名被试观看200张自然图像时的脑响应预测能力，发现CNN在浅层对应最强、深层减弱，而Transformer在深层仍保持强对应，且这一优势依赖于保留全部patch token的表征；控制实验表明是架构而非训练目标驱动该差异。
AI.motivation: CNN与视觉Transformer都被用于建模人类视觉系统，但两者是否在网络深度的某一特定阶段出现表征分化尚不明确，需要系统比较不同架构在逐层脑响应预测上的差异及其成因。
AI.method: 比较6个CNN与2个Transformer：逐层/逐block计算模型预测与实测EEG响应的Pearson相关r；被试10人、观看200张自然图像；对Transformer测试4种token表征（仅CLS到CLS+全部patch token）；并做架构匹配（MoCo-v1 vs ResNet-50）与目标匹配（CLIP-RN50 vs CLIP-ViT-B/32）的控制比较；另做空间地形图分析。
AI.result: CNN在最早层对应最强，深层减弱，尤其在刺激后反应后期；Transformer在深层block仍保持强对应而浅层较弱。token表征影响显著：池化表征峰值相关较弱（r≈0.48–0.51），保留全部patch token更强（CLIP-ViT-B/32 r=0.640，DINOv2-ViT-B/14 r=0.656）。架构匹配的MoCo-v1与ResNet-50几乎一致（r=0.673、0.670），目标匹配的CLIP-RN50与CLIP-ViT-B/32在保留patch token前差异明显。空间地形呈共同枕叶主导模式。
AI.conclusion: CNN训练中的分类瓶颈在深层压缩了与脑相关的信息，而Transformer的自注意力与非分类目标避免了这一坍缩；保留patch token的Transformer表征能在CNN对应衰减处持续维持脑预测对应。各模型空间模式相似，说明差异体现为信号强度与持续性而非不同脑区。

59602d2f820e807bbc83e4749d6a99b6729b4cd2.title: Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering
59602d2f820e807bbc83e4749d6a99b6729b4cd2.summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires an agent to explore a previously unseen environment, gather relevant information, and answer questions about the scene. Recent approaches leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with semantic maps or scene graphs to guide exploration. However, exploration is typically driven only by local observations, while structural priors about the environment remain largely unused. We propose HFLEX-EQA, a hierarchical EQA framework that combines online scene graph construction, VLM- based planning, semantic frontier exploration, and floorplan priors. The system incrementally builds a hierarchical scene graph and an open-vocabulary occupancy map from RGB-D observations, enabling a VLM to jointly reason over the scene graph, task-relevant visual observations, exploration history, and an estimated topological floorplan. Furthermore, we introduce a room-discovery strategy that leverages the floorplan and open-vocabulary frontier semantics to guide exploration toward semantically relevant yet currently unobserved room types. We evaluate HFLEX-EQA on the OpenEQA and ExploreEQA benchmarks and demonstrate deployment on a quadruped robot in real indoor environments. Our results demonstrate the benefit of combining VLM-based hierarchical planning with structural floorplan priors for the EQA task.

AI.tldr: 提出 HFLEX-EQA 分层具身问答框架，将在线场景图构建、VLM 规划、语义前沿探索与户型图先验相结合，在 OpenEQA、ExploreEQA 基准及真实四足机器人上验证了结构化先验的有效性。
AI.motivation: 具身问答（EQA）需智能体在未知环境中探索、收集信息并回答场景相关问题。现有基于 VLM 配合语义地图或场景图的方法，其探索过程通常仅由局部观测驱动，环境的结构先验（如空间布局）大多未被利用，导致探索效率和相关性不足。
AI.method: HFLEX-EQA 是一个分层 EQA 框架。系统从 RGB-D 观测中增量构建分层场景图与开放词汇占据地图；VLM 联合推理场景图、任务相关视觉观测、探索历史以及估计得到的拓扑户型图进行规划。此外引入房间发现策略，利用户型图与开放词汇前沿语义，引导探索朝向语义相关但尚未观测的房间类型；并结合语义前沿探索。
AI.result: 在 OpenEQA 与 ExploreEQA 两个基准上进行评估，并在真实室内环境中的四足机器人上完成部署验证。结果表明，将基于 VLM 的分层规划与结构化户型图先验相结合，对 EQA 任务具有明显收益。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 分层规划与环境结构先验（户型图）融合，能有效提升具身问答的探索与问答性能；分层场景图、开放词汇地图与房间发现策略共同支撑了该框架的有效性，并在仿真基准与真实机器人上得到验证。

1efcf5453b7de9ff0c6fb9fc7daa9711c0942c7c.title: MSA-CITE: A Co-Adapted LoRA Specialist Ecology for Fixed-Budget Small-Model Inference
1efcf5453b7de9ff0c6fb9fc7daa9711c0942c7c.summary: Compact language models are typically deployed by retaining a single post-training checkpoint and sampling it repeatedly. In this work, we challenge this practice by treating multiple discarded checkpoints as composable assets for deployment. Starting from a single Qwen3-4B backbone, we preserve four frozen LoRA branches, each derived from a different post-training trajectory. stead of drawing four generations from one branch, we allocate a fixed four-generation budget by sampling one completion from each branch. Our method, Multi-path Specialist Adaptation with Calibrated Inference-Time Evidence (MSA-CITE), processes the resulting portfolio by grouping terminal answers into equivalence classes, scoring each class via summed calibration-derived source priors, and selecting a representative under deterministic tie-breaking rules. The readout stage does not learn from evaluation results, nor does it introduce additional generations, verifiers, or reranking steps. On 200 held-out mathematics items, the four-path portfolio achieves 65.5% accuracy, compared with 62.0% for the strongest single-branch baseline. On a 100-item subject-disjoint shift, it attains 42.0% versus 40.0%. Under in-distribution conditions, the improvements over homogeneous SFT and Online-OPD repetition are robust; results against the strongest baseline and under shifted conditions are not conclusive. Our findings offer a narrow but concrete contribution: post-training branches, even without co-training, can be collectively beneficial for deployment.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 MSA-CITE：将同一 Qwen3-4B 骨干上四条被弃置的冻结 LoRA 分支视为可组合的部署资产，在固定四代生成预算下每条分支采样一次，通过等价类分组、校准先验打分与确定性平局规则读出答案，在数学任务上优于最强单分支基线。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型语言模型通常只保留单一后训练检查点并反复采样，浪费了后训练过程中产生的多个检查点。作者质疑这一惯例，主张将多个被丢弃的检查点视为可组合的部署资产，以在几乎不增加额外机制的前提下挖掘其集体价值。
AI.method: 以单一 Qwen3-4B 为骨干，保留四条来自不同后训练轨迹的冻结 LoRA 分支。部署时不再从单一分支采样四次，而是将固定的四代生成预算分配给四条分支各生成一次补全。读出阶段（MSA-CITE）将各分支的终态答案归并为等价类，用基于校准得到的来源先验求和为每个等价类打分，并在确定性平局规则下选出代表答案。读出阶段不利用评测结果进行学习，也不引入额外生成、验证器或重排序步骤。
AI.result: 在 200 条留出数学题上，四路径组合取得 65.5% 准确率，最强单分支基线为 62.0%；在 100 条主题不相交的分布偏移集上为 42.0% 对 40.0%。在同分布条件下，相较同质 SFT 与 Online-OPD 重复采样的提升较为稳健；但相对最强基线的结果及分布偏移条件下的结果尚不具结论性。
AI.conclusion: 即便未进行协同训练，多个后训练分支也能在部署中产生集体收益。该结论虽范围有限，但提供了一个具体且可操作的发现：多路径分支组合可作为紧凑模型部署的一种有效补充策略。

e6cb4d9f332115fa181bb98a77cb248baf918874.title: FISSION: Label Augmentation for Bot Detection
e6cb4d9f332115fa181bb98a77cb248baf918874.summary: Bot accounts and coordinated influence operations are often discovered via heuristic methods, leaving a dearth of reliable ground-truth labels for training detection systems. To address this challenge, we study a natural question: can we generate labels to assist in learning embeddings in which bots and accounts from the same coordinated operation are close? We present FISSION, a method to generate labels by splitting each account's activity into positively labeled sub-accounts. Given this label source, we train detection models which preserve behavioral regularities recurring across positive sub-accounts. We evaluate FISSION and show it outperforms prior methods in detecting Wikipedia sockpuppets and Twitter/X bots.

AI.tldr: FISSION 通过将每个账号的活动切分为带正标签的子账号来生成训练标签，学习使机器人与同一协同操作账号在嵌入空间中靠近的表示，在检测维基百科傀儡账号和 Twitter/X 机器人上优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人账号与协同影响操作通常依赖启发式方法发现，导致训练检测系统时缺乏可靠的 ground-truth 标签。
AI.method: 提出 FISSION：将每个账号的活动切分为多个正标签子账号，作为标签来源；基于该标签训练检测模型，使模型保留正子账号之间反复出现的行为规律性。
AI.result: 在检测 Wikipedia sockpuppets（傀儡账号）和 Twitter/X bots 的任务上，FISSION 的性能优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过子账号切分生成标签，可缓解协同账号与机器人检测中的标签稀缺问题，并有效学习到使同类账号聚集的嵌入表示。

3aa2f21af889bc0ddf83e492d8d041c4120ad4e8.title: Virtual Encoders in Multimodal Transformers
3aa2f21af889bc0ddf83e492d8d041c4120ad4e8.summary: Multimodal language models traditionally rely on dedicated perceptual encoders to construct task-usable representations. More integrated architectures have recently emerged, which instead expose the shared transformer to lightly projected patches, audio frames, or discrete visual tokens. Where does this encoding happen when such representations are not provided? We find that the transformer can internalize this missing computation, constructing task-usable perceptual representations within its own early-to-middle layers before the downstream language model. We call this computational structure a Virtual Encoder. Across linear probing, similarities to perceptual encoders, and causal analyses, we identify signatures of this structure in models that receive perceptual tokens without continuous encoder-derived features. These analyses also suggest that the boundary between perception and language processing need not coincide within an architectural module. Instead, encoder-like computation can emerge as a functional regime within a shared transformer, providing a new perspective for understanding where and how multimodal models process perception.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，当多模态语言模型未使用专用感知编码器时，共享Transformer会在自身早中期层内部构建可用的感知表示，作者称之为"虚拟编码器"（Virtual Encoder）。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态语言模型依赖专用感知编码器来构建可用于任务的表示，而较新的集成式架构则将轻量投影后的图像块、音频帧或离散视觉token直接送入共享Transformer。作者希望探究：当这些感知表示不再由外部编码器提供时，编码计算究竟发生在何处。
AI.method: 作者采用线性探测（linear probing）、与专用感知编码器的表示相似度比较，以及因果分析（causal analyses）三类手段，对接收感知token但无连续编码器派生特征的模型进行考察，以识别该结构的存在特征。
AI.result: 分析发现，Transformer能够内化这一缺失的计算：在语言模型下游处理之前的早中期层中，自行构建出可用于任务的感知表示，即"虚拟编码器"结构。线性探测、表示相似度与因果分析均一致地揭示了该结构的特征。
AI.conclusion: 感知与语言处理的边界不必与架构模块的划分相一致；类编码器的计算可以在共享Transformer内部作为一种功能机制涌现。这为理解多模态模型"在哪里、以何种方式"处理感知提供了新视角。

b1b90e71f1b5c73f5284c311f1cfceba3d575519.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
b1b90e71f1b5c73f5284c311f1cfceba3d575519.summary: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.

AI.tldr: MAVP 通过预测显式基座位姿目标并用定位反馈跟踪，提升移动操作策略的执行可靠性，在六项真实任务中全面超越速度控制基线。
AI.motivation: 移动操作需要底盘与机械臂协同运动并保持精确的空间定位，但仅由示教数据训练的策略往往难以可靠实现预期底盘运动，导致空间错位进而引发操作失败。因此需要一种能提供一致空间监督、并能在执行中纠偏的框架。
AI.method: MAVP 先从遥操作示教中重建静态地图，将示教的底盘轨迹表达在统一的地图坐标系中，从而获得跨示教一致的空间监督。执行时策略输入 RGB 观测、关节状态以及当前地图系底盘位姿，联合预测目标底盘位姿、手臂动作与夹爪动作；底层控制器以“前馈运动+位姿误差反馈”跟踪预测的底盘目标以纠正执行偏差。训练阶段还引入位姿噪声增强，提升策略对位姿输入误差的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在六项真实世界操作任务、三种策略族上，MAVP 在所有任务中的任务成功率均高于未锚定的速度控制基线。
AI.conclusion: 以地图坐标系为锚、显式预测并反馈跟踪底盘位姿目标，可有效缓解示教策略的底盘执行偏差，是提升移动操作可靠性的通用有效方案。

e5e6ee5453406d3e49c2d26547bf90845fb50a07.title: High-Order Liquid Evidence Modeling for Continuous and Subtle GNSS Spoofing Detection in Autonomous Driving
e5e6ee5453406d3e49c2d26547bf90845fb50a07.summary: Continuous and subtle GNSS spoofing poses a serious threat to autonomous vehicles because forged positions may remain locally plausible while gradually becoming inconsistent with vehicle motion observed by non-GNSS onboard sensors. Existing AV-oriented detectors commonly rely on residual thresholds or feature-level classification and provide limited modeling of how weak GNSS--motion inconsistency develops and persists over time. This paper formulates subtle GNSS spoofing detection as a causal sequential evidence-modeling problem and proposes a high-order liquid evidence detector. The method first compares the displacement implied by consecutive GNSS positions with that inferred from independent onboard motion observations and converts their difference into uncertainty-normalized residual evidence. It then represents the current inconsistency, its local evolution, excess above the normal level, accumulated persistence, and displacement validity as causal weak evidence. These cues are mapped into instantaneous, evolutionary, and persistent latent states, aligned through a bounded Kirchhoff-inspired symmetric exchange, and combined through an explicit third-order interaction to capture their coordinated support for spoofing. To model how this coordinated evidence develops over time, second-order liquid dynamics track its memory and evolution to estimate causal spoofing probabilities, which are converted into confirmed alarms using validation-selected threshold and persistence parameters. Experiments on the AV--GPS dataset family demonstrate strong controlled and external generalization, together with clear sequential alarm behavior. On Dataset-1, the proposed detector achieves an AUROC of 0.9932 and an AUPRC of 0.9843, while obtaining the lowest false-positive rate among the learning-based baselines. Code: https://github.com/pangjunbiao/HO-LLN-Spoofing.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动驾驶车辆中的连续细微GNSS欺骗检测建模为因果序列证据建模问题，提出高阶液态证据检测器（HO-LLN），通过将GNSS位移与车载运动观测的残差转化为不确定性归一化证据，并利用液态动力学估计因果欺骗概率，在AV-GPS数据集上取得AUROC 0.9932、AUPRC 0.9843的优异表现。
AI.motivation: 连续且细微的GNSS欺骗对自动驾驶车辆构成严重威胁：伪造位置可能在局部仍显得合理，却会逐渐与车载非GNSS传感器观测到的运动状态不一致。现有面向自动驾驶的检测器多依赖残差阈值或特征级分类，对弱GNSS—运动不一致性随时间如何发展并持续这一过程缺乏建模能力，因此难以有效捕捉此类隐蔽欺骗。
AI.method: 作者将细微GNSS欺骗检测形式化为因果序列证据建模问题，提出高阶液态证据检测器。方法步骤如下：1）比较连续GNSS位置隐含的位移与由独立车载运动观测推断的位移，将其差异转化为不确定性归一化残差证据；2）将当前不一致性、其局部演化、超出正常水平的超额量、累积持续性以及位移有效性表示为因果弱证据；3）把这些线索映射到瞬时、演化与持续三类潜在状态，经有界Kirchhoff式对称交换对齐，并通过显式三阶交互整合，以捕捉其对欺骗的协同支撑；4）采用二阶液态动力学追踪该协同证据的记忆与演化，估计因果欺骗概率，并借助验证集选取的阈值与持续性参数转化为确认告警。
AI.result: 在AV-GPS数据集族上的实验表明，该方法具有强大的受控泛化与外部泛化能力，并呈现清晰的序列化告警行为。在Dataset-1上，所提检测器取得AUROC 0.9932、AUPRC 0.9843，同时在所有基于学习的基线中实现最低的假阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了将细微GNSS欺骗检测转化为因果序列证据建模问题的有效性，所提高阶液态证据检测器在精度、泛化性与低误报方面均具优势，代码已开源（https://github.com/pangjunbiao/HO-LLN-Spoofing）。

d02a090b1eb4505e62192b12ddce4803eb6eb953.title: Dual-Frontier: When Can an Agent Trust Its World Model?
d02a090b1eb4505e62192b12ddce4803eb6eb953.summary: Learned world models are becoming essential to general-purpose agents: by predicting action consequences, they support planning and decision-making while reducing reliance on costly trial and error. This reliance creates a fundamental ambiguity: when a world-model-guided decision fails, the trajectory alone may not reveal whether the agent's decision rule or the world model caused the loss. We formalize this failure-attribution problem as a counterfactual decomposition of return loss and prove that its components are not identifiable from passive interaction, even for finite-horizon planners. This obstruction motivates Dual-Frontier, a learning principle that admits a world-model-guided decision only when its predicted advantage exceeds a certified bound on decision-relevant world-model error; otherwise, evidence is allocated to world-model verification. Action-conditioned value bounds and a closed-loop extension guarantee non-decreasing return for admitted decisions. Calibrated gates and simultaneous confidence sequences support adaptive evidence reuse, with sufficient and necessary verification bounds. Controlled learned-model experiments validate the predicted failure modes and certification behavior, while cross-backbone tool-use benchmarks instantiate the same verify-then-promote rule in realistic agent world-model pipelines, consistently improving decision quality and reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"世界模型引导决策失败"的归因问题形式化为回报损失的反事实分解，证明其成分在被动交互下不可识别，并提出Dual-Frontier学习原则：仅当预测优势超过世界模型误差的认证上界时才采纳决策，否则将证据分配给模型验证，从而保证回报非递减。
AI.motivation: 学习型世界模型已成为通用智能体的核心组件，通过预测动作后果来支撑规划与决策，减少对高成本试错的依赖。但这种依赖带来根本性歧义：当世界模型引导的决策失败时，仅凭轨迹难以判断到底是决策规则出错，还是世界模型本身出错。作者希望正式刻画并解决这一"失败归因"问题。
AI.method: 1) 将失败归因问题形式化为回报损失（return loss）的反事实分解，并证明即使在有限时域规划器下，其各成分也无法从被动交互中识别。2) 提出Dual-Frontier学习原则：仅当预测优势超过"决策相关世界模型误差"的认证上界时，才采纳世界模型引导的决策；否则将证据预算分配给世界模型验证。3) 引入动作条件价值界（action-conditioned value bounds）与闭环扩展，保证被采纳决策的回报非递减。4) 使用校准门控（calibrated gates）与同步置信序列（simultaneous confidence sequences）支持证据的自适应复用，并给出充分且必要的验证界。
AI.result: 受控的学习型模型实验验证了所预测的失败模式与认证行为；跨骨干（cross-backbone）工具使用基准将同一"先验证后提升（verify-then-promote）"规则实例化到现实的智能体世界模型流水线中，一致地提升了决策质量与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了世界模型引导决策中失败归因的不可识别性这一根本障碍，并给出可证明的理论保证与实证验证的Dual-Frontier原则，在保证回报非递减的前提下，通过"先验证后提升"机制系统性地改善决策质量与可靠性。

cdcdae499b23185e4e3091c3a886daa018e76286.title: Latent Commonality Expectation-Maximisation for Box-supervised Tree Crown Instance Segmentation
cdcdae499b23185e4e3091c3a886daa018e76286.comment: 37 pages, 18 tables. Code and model checkpoints to be released upon publication
cdcdae499b23185e4e3091c3a886daa018e76286.summary: Individual tree crown segmentation from aerial imagery underpins tree-level carbon accounting, biodiversity, and restoration monitoring at landscape scale. However, existing models are predominantly trained on dense canopy forest imagery and degrade in savannah and drylands, where tree crowns are sparse, of variable appearance, and underrepresented in annotated benchmarks. These models also typically depend on costly polygon annotations. We introduce LACE (LAtent Commonality Expectation-maximisation), a box-supervised instance segmentation model, evaluated on 0.1 m/px aerial RGB tree crown imagery. LACE uses a frozen DINOv3-web ViT-L/16 encoder, applied at four spatial offsets and interlaced into a denser feature grid, with a lightweight CenterNet-style detection head trained solely on bounding boxes. We use expectation-maximisation to separate recurring appearance, the "treeness", within bounding boxes from surroundings. On the OAM-TCD benchmark test set, LACE reaches a mask AP$_{50}$ of $0.663 \pm 0.001$ (3 seeds) trained on 900 box-annotated images and without mask annotations, above the 0.626 scored by Restor's released mask-supervised Mask R-CNN, which was trained on the full ~4.2k image set. On a sparse-canopy holdout set, mask AP$_{50}$ rises to $0.691$ versus $0.612$ for Detectree2, a mask-supervised baseline. On NeonTreeEvaluation, using the official evaluation code, LACE reaches $0.728 \pm 0.003$ F1@0.4 (5 seeds) from 23,424 hand-annotated RGB boxes alone, matching the authors' DeepForest model's published 0.719, using under 0.1% of its training annotations and none of its LiDAR-derived 30M-crown pretraining set. By leveraging frozen self-supervised features, LACE matches or surpasses fully-supervised specialist baselines from boxes alone, removing the need for polygon annotation in tree crown instance segmentation for sparse-canopy environments where labelled data is scarce.

AI.tldr: LACE：一种仅需边界框监督的树冠实例分割模型，利用冻结DINOv3特征与EM分离"树性"外观，在稀疏冠层/旱地场景以极少标注匹配或超越全监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有树冠分割模型多训练于密集冠层森林影像，在稀树草原和旱地等稀疏冠层场景性能下降；且通常依赖昂贵的多边形标注，稀疏冠层基准数据稀缺。
AI.method: 提出LACE（LAtent Commonality Expectation-maximisation），一种box-supervised实例分割模型。使用冻结的DINOv3-web ViT-L/16编码器，在四个空间偏移上应用并交织成更密集特征网格；接轻量CenterNet风格检测头，仅用边界框训练；用期望最大化（EM）在边界框内分离反复出现的外观即"树性"（treeness）与背景。评估于0.1 m/px航拍RGB树冠影像。
AI.result: OAM-TCD测试集：LACE仅用900张框标注图像、无mask标注，mask AP50为0.663±0.001（3种子），高于Restor发布的mask监督Mask R-CNN的0.626（用约4.2k全量图像训练）。稀疏冠层留出集：mask AP50 0.691 vs Detectree2 0.612（mask监督基线）。NeonTreeEvaluation官方评测：LACE用23,424个手工RGB框，F1@0.4为0.728±0.003（5种子），匹配作者DeepForest模型发表的0.719，且训练标注不足其0.1%，未用其LiDAR衍生的30M树冠预训练集。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用冻结自监督特征，LACE仅凭边界框即可匹配或超越全监督专家基线，在标注稀缺的稀疏冠层环境中免除树冠实例分割对多边形标注的需求。

1698af86ebbf968c585399c4c8ce46e7eba7fe4e.title: SparseNav: Instruction-conditioned Sparse Semantic Perception for Training-Free Vision-Language Navigation
1698af86ebbf968c585399c4c8ce46e7eba7fe4e.summary: Map-based vision-language navigation (VLN) relies on persistent spatial representations to connect language understanding with geometric planning. However, acquiring semantics beyond the needs of the current instruction can introduce unnecessary perception cost and irrelevant annotations. Continuously accumulating unrelated objects may not only waste computation, but also clutter the visual-spatial representation consumed by the vision-language model (VLM) planner. To address this problem, we present SparseNav, a training-free framework that follows a less-is-more principle for semantic navigation. SparseNav persistently maintains a lightweight geometric bird's-eye-view (BEV) map and sparse landmark memory, acquiring new semantics on demand using the active sub-instruction to decide what is worth grounding. An instruction manager first tracks navigation progress and identifies the active landmark query. An instruction-conditioned perception mechanism then invokes open-vocabulary segmentation when the queried landmark is visible and its metric location can inform the next decision. The resulting landmark memory supports VLM selection among hybrid frontier and local directional waypoint candidates. Without any additional training, SparseNav achieves success rates of 42.8% on R2R-CE and 40.7% on RxR-CE, both on the Val-Unseen splits. Controlled ablations examine semantic perception strategies and the contributions of individual framework components. Furthermore, we successfully deployed SparseNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D camera for geometric mapping and landmark grounding and a Livox MID-360 LiDAR for localization, without a prebuilt map. We validated its effectiveness across multiple indoor environments using instruction-conditioned waypoint navigation.

AI.tldr: SparseNav：免训练、按需感知的稀疏语义地图VLN框架，在R2R-CE/RxR-CE Val-Unseen达42.8%/40.7%成功率，并部署于Unitree Go2四足机器人。
AI.motivation: 基于地图的视觉语言导航依赖持久空间表征，但超出当前指令需求的语义获取会带来多余感知开销与无关标注；持续累积无关物体既浪费计算，又会干扰VLM规划器所消费的视觉-空间表征。
AI.method: 提出训练-free的SparseNav，遵循"少即是多"原则：持久维护轻量几何BEV地图与稀疏地标记忆；指令管理器跟踪导航进度并识别当前活跃地标查询；指令条件感知机制仅在查询地标可见且其度量位置能辅助下一步决策时调用开放词汇分割；地标记忆支持VLM在混合前沿与局部方向航点候选间选择。
AI.result: 无需额外训练，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的Val-Unseen划分上成功率分别为42.8%和40.7%；通过控制消融检验语义感知策略与各组件贡献；在Unitree Go2四足机器人上部署，配备Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D用于几何建图与地标定位、Livox MID-360 LiDAR用于定位，无需预建地图，并在多个室内环境中验证指令条件航点导航的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SparseNav表明按需稀疏语义感知可降低感知与标注成本并保持有效导航性能，且具备真实机器人零预建地图部署能力。

e5b228e72965f8425a09c780aac6cb1c437b6850.title: Can You Delete a Year of Market Data? Machine Unlearning Against Exact Retraining Oracles
e5b228e72965f8425a09c780aac6cb1c437b6850.summary: When a data license expires, deleting stored records does not remove influence encoded in a trained forecaster. Machine unlearning seeks to remove this influence without retraining. We benchmark temporal unlearning with 3,200 paired references trained on all data and oracles retrained without the requested period. The grid covers five architectures, four rolling folds, five deletable years, and three experimental deletion levels on an S&P 500 volatility panel. The 2020 COVID crisis year produces the largest memorization gap for every architecture. Removing it improves all three deployable models in every fold, with the largest improvement in the 2022 bear market, while the two non-deployable models respond inconsistently. The target for approximate unlearning is the oracle, not low predictive accuracy on the deleted period. In one Transformer cell, an oracle that never trained on 2020 still predicts it at an information coefficient of 0.51, compared with 0.55 for the reference; pushing predictions toward noise reduces test skill. Across twelve deployable architecture-method pairs, only TSMixer with the hinge method remains near the oracle in every fold, closing 74-118% of the reference-to-oracle gap without a measurable loss of test skill. Method rankings vary across architectures and rolling windows. Audit separation rises with prior memorization but can remain small after exact deletion. The window-level loss comparison reaches at most 0.69, and treating stock-level windows as independent inflates the absolute t-statistic by a median factor of 1.9. These results call for an explicit deletion scope, oracle validation for the relevant architecture and window, and power-aware auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文在S&P 500波动率面板上系统基准测试时间序列机器遗忘：删除数据许可到期记录必须移除已训练预测器中的影响，应以“未见过该时段的 oracle”而非删除期低预测精度为目标，并需明确删除范围、按架构与窗口做 oracle 验证及功效感知审计。
AI.motivation: 数据许可到期后，仅删除存储记录并不能消除模型已编码的影响；机器遗忘希望在不重训的前提下移除这种影响，但金融时序场景中缺乏可对照的基准与评估标准。
AI.method: 构建3,200组配对基准：参照模型用全量数据训练，oracle 则在不包含目标时段的数据上重训。网格覆盖S&P 500波动率面板上的5种架构、4个滚动折、5个可删除年份、3种实验性删除强度；比较近似遗忘方法与oracle，并分析审计分离、窗口级损失比较及独立性假设。
AI.result: 2020年危机年在所有架构上产生最大记忆差距；删除该年使3个可部署模型在每个折均改善，2022年熊市中改善最大，而2个不可部署模型表现不一致。在某个Transformer格子中，未训练2020年的oracle仍能以IC=0.51预测2020年，参照模型为0.55；把预测推向噪声会降低测试技能。12个可部署“架构-方法”对中，仅TSMixer配合hinge方法在所有折接近oracle，弥合74%–118%的参照到oracle差距且无可测测试技能损失。方法排名随架构和滚动窗口变化；审计分离随先前记忆上升，但精确删除后仍可能很小；窗口级损失比较最高仅0.69，把股票级窗口视为独立会使绝对t统计量中位数膨胀1.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列机器遗忘应以oracle为验证目标，而非追求删除期低精度；评估需明确删除范围，针对相关架构与滚动窗口进行oracle验证，并采用功效感知的审计，避免因窗口独立性假设导致显著性被高估。

34da889e885d7ed1cd2234d6d6fd6dbba15e117a.title: Reliability Theory for AI Control
34da889e885d7ed1cd2234d6d6fd6dbba15e117a.summary: Reliability theory gives a mature language for layered systems, but its formal tools are not yet standard in frontier AI control. We apply them to Google DeepMind's defenses against rogue deployment. The same control stack can have cubic, quadratic, or linear rare-failure suppression depending on its failure domains. Birnbaum importance identifies which component improvements buy the most nominal reliability, while prevention changes the population on which recovery is demanded. These results give concrete guidance about what to separate, improve, measure, and test.

AI.tldr: 该文将可靠性理论引入前沿AI控制，用形式化工具分析Google DeepMind针对“失控部署”的防御体系，指出控制栈的罕见失效抑制可呈立方、平方或线性，并用Birnbaum重要度指导组件改进与预防/恢复策略。
AI.motivation: 可靠性理论已有成熟的分层系统分析语言，但其形式化工具尚未成为前沿AI控制的标准方法；作者希望把该理论用于AI控制防御的可靠性分析。
AI.method: 将AI控制栈建模为分层系统，分析其失效域结构；使用可靠性理论中的罕见失效抑制、Birnbaum重要度等工具，比较不同失效域划分下控制栈的可靠性表现，并区分预防与恢复所作用的不同总体。
AI.result: 同一控制栈在罕见失效抑制上可表现为立方、平方或线性，取决于其失效域；Birnbaum重要度可识别哪些组件改进对名义可靠性收益最大；预防会改变恢复所要求的总体。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性理论可为AI控制提供可操作的设计指导，说明应分离、改进、测量和测试哪些组件与环节。

5d95342b78bb3368db81f9f72223356182539025.title: Vision Foundation Models with Synthetic-Only Training for Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
5d95342b78bb3368db81f9f72223356182539025.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. A shorter version was accepted to the IROS 2026 Space Robotics Workshop (non-archival)
5d95342b78bb3368db81f9f72223356182539025.summary: We present an improvement on previous spacecraft pose estimation architectures that results in the lowest published mean rotation errors we know of on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets for a known, non-cooperative spacecraft. By using a previously established heatmap-based pose estimation architecture and adapting a large self-supervised ViT foundation model (DINOv3) in place of the smaller convolutional and ViT encoders of previous work, we show that pose estimation accuracy improves from 300M to 840M parameters with no saturation yet observed. We also evaluate our 840M model on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB, measuring single-pass network inference at 133.8 ms per crop with a board draw of 32.0 W. These measurements demonstrate embedded inference feasibility on a processor family with orbital flight heritage. Our resulting model outperforms previous models across lightbox and sunlamp domains while training only on synthetic data. Our best model, using DINOv3 840M adapted with LoRA as the encoder (rank 64, three-seed ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation), results in $1.56^\circ$ mean rotation error on sunlamp and $1.17^\circ$ on lightbox, compared to the previous best mean rotation errors we know of on these test sets, $2.66^\circ$ and $1.75^\circ$ by EagerNet.

AI.tldr: 该工作将DINOv3自监督ViT基础模型适配到热图式航天器位姿估计框架中，在仅用合成数据训练的条件下，于SPEED+ lightbox与sunlamp测试集取得已知最低的平均旋转误差，并验证了Jetson Orin NX上的嵌入式推理可行性。
AI.motivation: 面向已知非合作航天器的位姿估计，需要在SPEED+等基准上进一步降低旋转误差，同时评估模型在具有在轨飞行 heritage 的嵌入式处理器上的可部署性。此前方法多依赖较小的卷积或ViT编码器，精度仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 沿用已有热图式位姿估计架构，将原有较小的卷积/ViT编码器替换为大规模自监督ViT基础模型DINOv3，并以LoRA进行适配（rank 64）。最终模型采用三随机种子集成与四旋转测试时增强；训练仅使用合成数据。模型规模从300M扩展至840M参数，并在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上测量单次网络推理耗时与整板功耗。
AI.result: 参数从300M增至840M时精度持续提升且尚未观察到饱和。840M模型在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上单作物裁剪网络推理为133.8 ms，整板功耗32.0 W。最佳模型在sunlamp测试集平均旋转误差为1.56°，lightbox为1.17°；此前已知最佳结果由EagerNet取得，分别为2.66°和1.75°。
AI.conclusion: 通过将DINOv3大规模自监督ViT以LoRA方式引入热图式航天器位姿估计，可在仅用合成数据训练时显著优于现有方法，并在lightbox与sunlamp域上均取得更低的平均旋转误差；同时，嵌入式推理测量表明该方法在具有在轨飞行 heritage 的处理器上具备部署可行性。

6648dd4e9e341e79f7c4f4e2a147f5b06a1c334a.title: Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
6648dd4e9e341e79f7c4f4e2a147f5b06a1c334a.summary: Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S$^3$) draws $N$ motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S$^3$ attains the any-of-$N$ ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with $N=8$, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation ($r=0.94$).

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 S^3（sample-simulate-select）框架：用冻结的文本到动作模型采样多个候选动作，经方向匹配逆运动学重定向到 Unitree G1，再由预训练 SONIC 全身跟踪策略在完整刚体动力学下仿真执行并择优，从而在部署控制器在环的条件下缩小文本生成动作与机器人动力学之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 文本到动作模型能生成看似合理的人体动作，但不建模机器人动力学；全身跟踪控制器能可靠执行给定参考，却无法对不可行参考重新规划。既有语言到人形机器人系统依赖训练来弥合该差距，本文希望量化：完全不做训练、仅把部署控制器本身放入回路，能弥合多少差距。
AI.method: S^3 对每个 prompt 从冻结文本到动作模型采样 N 个动作；用 direction-matching 逆运动学分别重定向到 Unitree G1；在完整刚体动力学下用预训练 SONIC 跟踪策略对全部候选进行 rollout；保留策略执行效果最好的候选。由于验证器就是确定性仿真器本身，S^3 在构造上达到 any-of-N 上限，因此研究的重点是该上限位置及未达上限的原因。另用运动学验证器预测摔倒，并与 GMR 重定向器做消融。
AI.result: 在 200 个分层 HumanML3D 测试 prompt、N=8 时，直立执行率从 83.5% 升至 89.5%，硬件门控通过数从 33 升至 85；完整测试集 4,184 prompts 上从 80.5% 升至 89.5%。运动学验证器预测摔倒 AUROC 0.90，但仅恢复约四分之一增益，说明对同一 prompt 内部候选排序比总体分类更难。选择无法修复的是“压低骨盆”这一类 prompt，而用重定向机器人数据训练的生成器可以执行。语义保真度用标准 text-motion 评估器打分，并用真实 mocap 对照将损失归因于机器人投影；与 GMR 消融显示互补失败模式，两者合并 any-of-8 上限升至 95.0%；177 个门控选中片段在真实 G1 上全部完成站立，硬件跟踪误差与仿真一致（r=0.94）。
AI.conclusion: 免训练地在回路中使用部署控制器作为验证器，可显著提升文本驱动人形动作的可执行性（尤其硬件门控通过率），并在真实机器人上保持与仿真一致的跟踪误差；但候选选择存在固有局限，无法修复特定失败类别，需结合重定向器多样性与针对性生成器训练。

55b11cad46cbb114933804eaefbb745b8ffa66ce.title: Information-Theoretic Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning
55b11cad46cbb114933804eaefbb745b8ffa66ce.summary: Continual learning (CL) aims to incrementally acquire knowledge from sequential data while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Recently, prompt tuning has attracted increasing attention as an efficient approach for adapting pre-trained models to CL tasks. However, existing prompt design paradigms commonly suffer from retrieval dependence and classifier bias, which make model adaptation sensitive to prompt selection and bias predictions toward newly arrived classes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Prompt Tuning for Continual Learning (DPT4CL), which decouples the CLIP textual prompt into a task-shared prompt distribution and class-specific prompts. The task-shared prompt distribution is derived by optimizing an Information Bottleneck objective to facilitate cross-task knowledge transfer and alleviate classifier bias, while class-specific prompts enhance inter-class separability without relying on explicit prompt retrieval. Furthermore, we establish a unified excess risk bound from an information-theoretic perspective, providing theoretical support for the robust generalization and forgetting mitigation of the proposed framework. Extensive experiments on standard CL benchmarks demonstrate that DPT4CL achieves state-of-the-art performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/Cloudfly-Z/DPT4CL

AI.tldr: 提出DPT4CL，将CLIP文本提示解耦为任务共享提示分布与类别特定提示，缓解检索依赖与分类器偏置，并给出信息论泛化界，在标准持续学习基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 持续学习需在序列数据上增量获取知识且避免灾难性遗忘；提示微调是高效适配预训练模型的方式，但现有提示设计普遍存在检索依赖（对提示选择敏感）和分类器偏置（预测偏向新到达类别）两大问题。
AI.method: DPT4CL将CLIP文本提示解耦为两部分：1）任务共享提示分布，通过优化信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）目标得到，促进跨任务知识迁移并缓解分类器偏置；2）类别特定提示，在不依赖显式提示检索的前提下增强类间可分性。同时从信息论角度建立统一的超额风险界，为框架的鲁棒泛化与遗忘缓解提供理论支撑。
AI.result: 在标准持续学习基准上进行大量实验，DPT4CL取得state-of-the-art性能；理论分析给出了支持鲁棒泛化与遗忘缓解的超额风险界；源代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦提示设计并结合信息瓶颈优化与信息论泛化界，DPT4CL有效克服了提示微调在持续学习中的检索依赖与分类器偏置问题，实现了更稳健的持续学习性能。

047a8324c9e8401caab59bc3a427c7810a5a9925.title: The Source of Disturbance Matters: External, Internal, and Control-Generated Noise in Adaptive Regulation
047a8324c9e8401caab59bc3a427c7810a5a9925.summary: Adaptive regulation can itself perturb the state it is intended to stabilize. In replicated simulations of an adaptive agent, we compare external disturbance, persistent internally generated disturbance, and control-generated disturbance under regulation-first and disturbance-first ordering. Persistent internal disturbance produces the largest exposure and regulatory burden within the tested parameter grid. When positive controller updates generate an immediate disturbance cost, increasing that cost produces a nonmonotonic response: effective disturbance initially rises, variability across stochastic runs increases over an intermediate range, and corrective activity becomes strongly suppressed at higher costs. The results show how disturbance source and timing shape exposure and controller burden in this model. They motivate testing adaptive agents with distinct disturbance sources and assessing regulatory activity alongside exposure.

AI.tldr: 自适应调节本身会扰动其试图稳定的状态。该研究通过复制模拟比较外部扰动、持续内部扰动与控制生成扰动，并考察“调节优先/扰动优先”时序；发现持续内部扰动带来的暴露与调节负担最大；当正向控制更新产生即时扰动成本时，成本增加引发非单调响应：有效扰动先升，中间区间随机运行间变异增大，高成本下纠正活动被强烈抑制。
AI.motivation: 已有研究通常将自适应调节视为稳定机制，但调节行为本身可能成为扰动源。作者希望区分不同扰动来源及其出现时序，评估它们如何影响系统暴露与控制器负担，从而更全面地理解自适应智能体的稳定性。
AI.method: 在复制模拟中构建自适应智能体，在给定参数网格内比较三类扰动：外部扰动、持续内部生成扰动、控制生成扰动；同时设置“调节优先”和“扰动优先”两种事件顺序。进一步操纵正向控制器更新所引发的即时扰动成本，观察有效扰动、跨随机运行变异以及纠正活动随成本变化的表现。
AI.result: 在测试参数网格内，持续内部扰动产生最大的暴露和调节负担。当正向控制器更新带来即时扰动成本时，随着该成本增加，系统出现非单调响应：有效扰动最初上升，在中间成本范围内跨随机运行的变异性增加，而在较高成本下纠正活动被强烈抑制。
AI.conclusion: 扰动来源和发生时序共同塑造系统的暴露程度与控制器负担。研究提示，评估自适应智能体时应测试不同扰动来源，并将调节活动与暴露指标一并考察，而非仅关注最终状态偏差。

42920dc2ef501f735410f37703d2dea16d5a03e4.title: Radiomics--Foundation Fusion for Interpretable RCC Classification: Internal Benchmarking and Exploratory External Transfer
42920dc2ef501f735410f37703d2dea16d5a03e4.comment: Accepted for an oral presentation at CaPTion 2026, a MICCAI 2026 workshop. 11 pages, 3 figures
42920dc2ef501f735410f37703d2dea16d5a03e4.summary: Accurate preoperative subtype classification of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) from contrast-enhanced CT remains clinically challenging because clear cell RCC (ccRCC) and non-clear cell RCC often show overlapping imaging appearances. This study evaluates whether foundation representations reduce reliance on handcrafted radiomics, or whether radiomics remains complementary for interpretable tumour characterisation. We compared radiomics, conventional CNN features, MedicalNet-pretrained features, MedVAE representations, and fusion variants for binary ccRCC classification on KiTS23, reporting area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) with bootstrap confidence intervals and average precision (AP) as a complementary class-imbalance-sensitive metric. We further assessed branch-removal ablation, TCGA/AIMI external transfer, and interpretability using radiomics permutation importance and gate-level analysis. Internally, 3D MedVAE gated fusion achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 82.7% and AP of 92.2%. On the external TCGA cohort, the same model achieved an AUC of 79.5% and AP of 98.9%, although specificity remains uncertain because only two external non-ccRCC cases were available. Gate analysis showed a radiomics-dominant fusion regime, suggesting that foundation representations acted as case-dependent refinement signals rather than replacements for structured tumour descriptors. These findings support radiomics as a complementary and clinically interpretable component of CT-based RCC characterisation in the foundation-model era.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比放射组学、常规CNN、MedicalNet预训练、MedVAE表示及其融合变体，用于CT上肾细胞癌（RCC）透明细胞（ccRCC）与非透明细胞二分类；结果3D MedVAE门控融合内外部表现最佳，门控分析显示放射组学主导，基础模型表示起病例依赖的细化作用。
AI.motivation: 术前准确判定RCC亚型（尤其ccRCC与非ccRCC）在增强CT上具有临床挑战，因二者影像表现常重叠。核心问题是：在基础模型时代，基础表示是否能减少对手工放射组学的依赖，还是放射组学在可解释的肿瘤刻画中仍具互补价值。
AI.method: 在KiTS23上开展二分类ccRCC任务，比较放射组学、常规CNN特征、MedicalNet预训练特征、MedVAE表示及多种融合变体；以AUC（含bootstrap置信区间）为主指标、平均精度（AP）为类别不平衡敏感补充指标；并开展分支移除消融、TCGA/AIMI外部迁移及可解释性分析（放射组学置换重要性与门控层分析）。
AI.result: 内部验证中，3D MedVAE门控融合表现最佳，AUC 82.7%、AP 92.2%；外部TCGA队列中同模型AUC 79.5%、AP 98.9%，但因仅有2例外部非ccRCC病例，特异性仍不确定。门控分析显示呈放射组学主导的融合模式。
AI.conclusion: 基础表示在融合中扮演病例依赖的细化信号，而非结构化肿瘤描述符的替代品；研究支持放射组学在基础模型时代仍是CT-based RCC刻画中具互补性与临床可解释性的组成部分。

e5d7b426221a242adc1416fa11da75f4827a8e68.title: Dr-LiSA: Direct Radar-Lidar Scan Alignment for $SE(3)$ Localization
e5d7b426221a242adc1416fa11da75f4827a8e68.summary: This paper introduces Dr-LiSA, a first-of-its-kind direct method for localizing 2D spinning radar intensity measurements in $SE(3)$ against 3D lidar maps. Radar-lidar localization combines the complementary strengths of the two sensing modalities: radar is robust to adverse weather and precipitation, while lidar provides high-fidelity 3D maps in favourable conditions. However, existing radar-lidar localization methods are restricted to planar $SE(2)$ localization and have generally fallen short of the accuracy achieved by lidar-lidar and even radar-radar systems. A key challenge is the substantial sensing-modality gap between radar and lidar, which observe and represent scene structure in fundamentally different ways. Dr-LiSA bridges this gap using a learned forward model that predicts radar measurements from a lidar submap at a candidate pose, enabling direct photometric alignment of predicted and observed radar scans in $SE(3)$. Dr-LiSA outperforms prior radar-lidar approaches in $SE(2)$ while achieving planar accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art radar-radar localization across more than 90 km of on-road data.

AI.tldr: 提出Dr-LiSA——首个在SE(3)下将2D旋转雷达强度测量直接定位到3D激光雷达地图的方法。其核心是用学习的前向模型从候选位姿处的激光子图预测雷达测量，从而在SE(3)中直接对齐预测与观测雷达扫描。在超过90 km道路数据上，其SE(2)定位优于已有雷达-激光方法，平面精度可与最先进雷达-雷达定位竞争。
AI.motivation: 雷达-激光定位可融合两类传感器优势：雷达对恶劣天气和降水稳健，激光在有利条件下可提供高保真3D地图。但现有雷达-激光定位方法局限于平面SE(2)，精度普遍不及激光-激光甚至雷达-雷达系统。关键挑战在于雷达与激光之间存在显著的传感模态差异，二者对场景结构的观测与表征方式根本不同。
AI.method: Dr-LiSA采用学习的前向模型桥接雷达-激光模态差异：给定候选位姿，由激光子图预测对应雷达测量；进而对预测雷达扫描与观测雷达扫描进行直接光度对齐，在SE(3)中完成定位。
AI.result: 在超过90 km的实车道路数据上，Dr-LiSA在SE(2)定位中优于先前雷达-激光方法，同时其平面定位精度与当前最先进的雷达-雷达定位方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Dr-LiSA首次实现SE(3)下的雷达-激光直接定位，证明学习前向模型可有效桥接雷达与激光的传感模态差异，将雷达-激光定位从平面SE(2)拓展到三维位姿估计，并保持与先进雷达-雷达方法相当的平面精度。
