96a3bcb6c3d10cc3c0f986acb5569481f47b7da0.title: Mode Collapse Is Cheap to Detect: A Ground-Truth-Free Pre-Flight Check for Neural Samplers
96a3bcb6c3d10cc3c0f986acb5569481f47b7da0.summary: Neural samplers are trained against an unnormalised target $\tildeπ=e^{-E}$ with no samples from $π$, which leaves the practitioner with no way to tell whether an expensive training run has silently dropped part of the target. The diagnostics in common use are computed from the model's own draws and are therefore confined to the model's support: we exhibit a sampler whose self-normalised effective sample size is $0.99$ while it misses $87\%$ of the target mass. We argue that \emph{detecting} missing mass is a strictly easier problem than sampling it: detection needs one point per missed basin plus a local curvature estimate, whereas correction needs the sampler retrained. We turn this into a pre-flight check that consumes a few percent of the sampler's own training budget and uses only $E$, $\nabla E$ and $\nabla^2 E$. On Gaussian-mixture, Many-Well and rotated anisotropic Many-Well targets with exactly computable ground truth, the check estimates the missing mass to within $10^{-3}$ at $2.7\%$ of training cost, where a tuned annealed SMC reference needs $70$--$280\%$ of training cost to do worse. It also applies unchanged to a controlled-SDE sampler that has no tractable density, where ESS and the ELBO cannot be formed at all. The estimator carries a \emph{self-diagnostic} that, without ground truth, is conservative in the safe direction: across $60$ configurations it clears $16$, of which $15$ are accurate to $10^{-2}$ or better. We are explicit about what this does and does not license: the check cheaply produces evidence of missing mass, and sometimes evidence that the search has stabilised, but it cannot certify a run, and its thresholds are heuristic. We then map the boundary of the method on a real physical landscape, LJ-13, and report where it fails and why.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"预检"诊断方法，能在训练早期廉价地检测神经采样器是否漏掉了目标分布的部分质量（missing mass），只依赖 $E$、$\nabla E$、$\nabla^2 E$，且不依赖模型自身采样。
AI.motivation: 神经采样器针对未归一化目标 $\tilde\pi=e^{-E}$ 训练，且没有来自 $\pi$ 的真实样本，因此实践者无法判断一次昂贵的训练是否"悄悄漏掉"了部分目标质量。常用的诊断指标均由模型自身采样计算，因而被限制在模型支撑集内——论文展示了一个采样器自归一化 ESS 高达 0.99，却漏掉了 87% 的目标质量。核心动机是：检测（detecting）漏失质量比采样（sampling）它严格更简单。
AI.method: 将问题重构为"检测"而非"修正"：检测每个被漏掉的盆地只需一个点加一个局部曲率估计，而修正则需要重新训练采样器。据此设计一个预检（pre-flight check），仅消耗采样器自身训练预算的百分之几，且只使用能量 $E$、梯度 $\nabla E$ 与海森 $\nabla^2 E$，无需真实样本或可解密度。
AI.result: 在具有可精确计算真值的高斯混合、Many-Well 及旋转各向异性 Many-Well 目标上，该方法以 2.7% 的训练成本将漏失质量估计到 $10^{-3}$ 以内；而调优后的退火 SMC 基线需耗费 70%–280% 训练成本却表现更差。该方法同样适用于无可解密度的 controlled-SDE 采样器（此时 ESS 与 ELBO 均无法计算）。其自诊断（self-diagnostic）在无真值时偏向保守的安全方向：60 组配置中通过 16 组，其中 15 组精度达 $10^{-2}$ 或更好。
AI.conclusion: 作者明确界定了方法的适用边界：该预检能廉价地产生"存在漏失质量"的证据，有时也能产生"搜索已稳定"的证据，但无法对一次运行做认证（certify），且其阈值是启发式的。最后在真实物理能量景观 LJ-13 上刻画方法边界，报告其失效位置与原因。

96a609c3e22e38aa24213ab73cd168d3a684102e.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
96a609c3e22e38aa24213ab73cd168d3a684102e.summary: AI agents are beginning to automate research and development across the AI stack, from improving training efficiency to optimizing inference. A natural next step is to improve the research efficiency of the agents themselves. When an AI research agent's own code is the object of optimization, each accepted rewrite becomes the agent that the next round edits. We refer to this loop as recursive self-improvement. Its significance lies in a long-standing trend, in which increased cumulative spending on R&D yields diminishing returns. Sustained self-improvement offers a way to counter this trend. We present AIDE^2, a system that implements this loop for a frontier AI research agent. It proposes changes to its own code, benchmarks modified versions of itself on a suite of AI R&D tasks, and keeps the changes that perform best on hidden evaluations. In an autonomous 8-day run, AIDE^2 discovered seven successive improvements, ranging from a new search policy to memory mechanisms that compress and manage the agent's growing context. These gains generalize to four held-out benchmarks spanning machine learning engineering, heuristic algorithm engineering, and physics-based weather forecasting, the last of which is out of distribution from the selection tasks. On all four, the strongest discovered agent matches or exceeds a human-engineered production research agent that ranks among the strongest on FML-Bench. On a separate held-out task family, the discovered agents also exhibit reduced reward hacking, a property the loop never explicitly optimized for: the rate falls from 55% to 32% during the run, 7 percentage points below the human-engineered agent. Together, these results show that an AI research agent can improve its own research efficiency through recursive self-improvement, and that these gains transfer to tasks and domains the loop never encountered.

AI.tldr: AIDE^2 实现了前沿 AI 研究智能体的递归自我改进闭环：智能体改写自身代码、在 AI 研发任务套件上评测新版本、保留隐藏评测中表现最好的改动。8 天自主运行中连续发现 7 项改进，并在四个留出基准上匹配或超越人类工程化的顶尖研究智能体，同时降低了奖励作弊率。
AI.motivation: 研发累积投入的边际回报长期递减；AI 智能体已能自动化 AI 栈各环节（训练效率、推理优化），自然的下一步是提升智能体自身的研究效率。当研究智能体自身代码成为优化对象时，每轮被采纳的改写都会成为下一轮编辑的主体，即"递归自我改进"，为对抗回报递减提供了路径。
AI.method: 提出 AIDE^2 系统，为前沿 AI 研究智能体实现该闭环：智能体自主提出对自身代码的修改，在 AI 研发任务套件上对修改后的自身版本进行基准评测，并保留在隐藏评测上表现最佳的改动。系统进行了 8 天自主运行，并在涵盖机器学习工程、启发式算法工程和基于物理的天气预报四类留出基准上评估，其中天气预测与选择任务分布外（OOD）；另在独立的留出任务族上考察奖励作弊行为。
AI.result: 8 天自主运行中发现 7 项相继改进，从新的搜索策略到压缩与管理智能体不断增长上下文的记忆机制。这些收益可泛化到四个留出基准（机器学习工程、启发式算法工程、物理天气预报），在全部四个基准上最强发现智能体匹配或超越人类工程化的生产级研究智能体（其在 FML-Bench 上属最强之一）。在独立留出任务族上，发现智能体的奖励作弊率从运行期间的 55% 降至 32%，比人类工程化智能体低 7 个百分点，而该属性并非循环显式优化的目标。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，AI 研究智能体能够通过递归自我改进提升自身研究效率，且这些收益可迁移到循环从未接触过的任务与领域，并带来未被显式优化目标的附带改善（如更低的奖励作弊率）。

575cd439f3f8b6443f6a3833b93d1f5d8087f328.title: GTR: Gated Token Recurrence for Efficient Dense Prediction
575cd439f3f8b6443f6a3833b93d1f5d8087f328.summary: Self-attention-based vision backbones perform well on dense prediction, but the quadratic computational cost of global softmax attention limits their efficiency as image resolution increases. We introduce Gated Token Recurrence (GTR), a softmax-free recurrent vision backbone that combines gated linear attention, alternating spatial scan directions, and spatially enhanced SwiGLU blocks. GTR is distilled from a detection-specialized DINOv3 teacher using only final-layer patch-token alignment through a linear projection and squared $\ell_2$ loss, without masked-token prediction or intermediate-layer supervision. With Objects365 detector pre-training, GTR-L achieves 58.9 box AP on COCO \texttt{val2017} with 1.908\,ms median batch-one latency under compiled FP16 execution on an RTX~4090. The same backbone also transfers to instance segmentation, pose estimation, oriented detection, semantic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. In an isolated kernel benchmark, our specialized chunkwise CUDA operator is $4.0\times$ faster than FLA v0.5.0 at 1.6K tokens on RTX~4090. TensorRT deployment on DRIVE AGX Thor achieves 2.282--8.769\,ms median batch-one latency across the evaluated models. These results show that recurrent token mixing can provide an efficient alternative to global softmax attention for high-resolution dense prediction and edge deployment.Project page: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/GTR/

AI.tldr: 提出 Gated Token Recurrence（GTR），一种无 softmax 的循环视觉骨干网络，结合门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向和空间增强 SwiGLU 块，并通过检测专用 DINOv3 教师进行末层 patch token 蒸馏，在高分辨率密集预测与边缘部署中实现高效性能。
AI.motivation: 基于自注意力的视觉骨干在密集预测任务中表现良好，但全局 softmax 注意力的二次计算成本使其在图像分辨率增大时效率受限。因此，需要一种能够替代全局 softmax 注意力、兼顾精度与效率的 token 混合机制。
AI.method: GTR 采用门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向和空间增强 SwiGLU 块构建无 softmax 循环视觉骨干。蒸馏方面，仅使用检测专用 DINOv3 教师的最终层 patch token 对齐，通过线性投影和平方 ℓ2 损失进行蒸馏，不使用掩码 token 预测或中间层监督。此外，作者实现了专用 chunkwise CUDA 算子，并支持 TensorRT 部署。
AI.result: 在 Objects365 检测器预训练下，GTR-L 在 COCO val2017 上达到 58.9 box AP；在 RTX 4090 上编译 FP16 执行时，batch-one 中位延迟为 1.908 ms。同一骨干还可迁移到实例分割、姿态估计、旋转目标检测、语义分割和单目深度估计。在隔离内核基准中，专用 chunkwise CUDA 算子在 1.6K tokens、RTX 4090 上比 FLA v0.5.0 快 4.0 倍。在 DRIVE AGX Thor 上进行 TensorRT 部署，评估模型的中位 batch-one 延迟为 2.282–8.769 ms。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，循环式 token 混合可为高分辨率密集预测和边缘部署提供一种高效替代全局 softmax 注意力的方案，并在多种密集预测任务和实际部署环境中具备良好迁移性与效率优势。

dbd4fc576e1d71959ad657dcbd3bf9e2177ba35d.title: Laryngeal Structure Segmentation in High-Speed Videoendoscopy Using Deep Learning
dbd4fc576e1d71959ad657dcbd3bf9e2177ba35d.summary: Laryngeal high-speed videoendoscopy (HSV) offers an effective means of observing the motion of different laryngeal structures along with vibratory behaviors of the vocal folds under various voicing conditions. Segmentation of laryngeal tissues enables analysis of different tissue structures and their dynamics, helping characterize the involvement of laryngeal muscles in voice production. Given the large number of HSV frames, automating this task is imperative. While deep learning-based methods have been implemented in previous studies to segment laryngeal structures, they have not been applied to HSV data during connected speech, which poses significant challenges due to excessive tissue movements and image quality limitations associated with fiberoptic image acquisition. The application of deep learning to connected speech data is critical for capturing nonstationary laryngeal behaviors and identifying anomalous patterns associated with voice disorders. The present study aims to address these gaps by training U-Net models to detect the aryepiglottic folds and arytenoid cartilages, vocal folds, epiglottis, and glottal area, using HSV data from both sustained vowel phonation and connected speech obtained from normophonic and disordered voices. Image pre-processing techniques, including noise removal and histogram equalization, were applied to improve the quality of the training HSV images and enhance network performance. Finally, to evaluate the accuracy and reliability of the networks, quantitative performance metrics were used alongside qualitative visual inspection of the test images. The high performance of the developed networks, with overall accuracies exceeding 95%, establishes their potential as reliable tools for automated laryngeal image analysis, quantitative characterization of laryngeal dynamics, and future detection of anomalous laryngeal behaviors in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用U-Net对喉高速视频内窥镜（HSV）图像进行自动分割，覆盖持续元音与连续言语、正常与嗓音障碍样本，经去噪和直方图均衡化预处理后，网络总体准确率超过95%，有望用于喉部图像自动分析与喉动力学定量表征。
AI.motivation: HSV可观察喉部结构运动与声带振动，但帧数巨大，自动分割势在必行。既往深度学习喉部结构分割未应用于连续言语HSV数据；连续言语中组织运动过度、光纤图像质量受限，且对捕捉非平稳喉行为及嗓音障碍异常模式至关重要。
AI.method: 训练U-Net模型，使用持续元音发声和连续言语的HSV数据，样本来自正常嗓音与嗓音障碍者；分割目标包括杓会厌襞与杓状软骨、声带、会厌及声门区。采用去噪和直方图均衡化等图像预处理提升训练图像质量与网络性能；通过定量性能指标和测试图像定性视觉检查评估准确性与可靠性。
AI.result: 所开发网络性能较高，总体准确率超过95%。
AI.conclusion: 该网络有潜力成为喉部图像自动分析、喉动力学定量表征以及临床环境中异常喉行为未来检测的可靠工具。

01d0dfda6fe5b6b641ee77c073b687a698a4b35e.title: Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics
01d0dfda6fe5b6b641ee77c073b687a698a4b35e.comment: Accepted to the IROS 2026 Workshop on Embodied Neuro-Symbolic AI for Reliable and Safe Robotics (ReS AI)
01d0dfda6fe5b6b641ee77c073b687a698a4b35e.summary: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$. Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. (2) At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"审计"方法：在每个查询场景中穷尽执行所有已存经验，从而把复用策略的得分拆解为"逐场景选择质量"与"经验库质量"两部分，并在两个操作任务、三种复用机制及 K=3/10/50 的经验库上对五种视觉嵌入（从原始像素到 CLIP）的最近邻选择规则进行评测。结论是：视觉相似度选经验的能力被高估——一个事后选出的固定经验即可占满大部分性能差距，而逐场景选择贡献甚微，且视觉距离在场景内排序候选时几近随机。
AI.motivation: 机器人通过复用过往经验而非重新训练来适应新任务，因此"选择哪条经验复用"至关重要。然而现有系统多以视觉相似度进行选择，评估时又只报告"所选经验"的成功率。该数值无法反映选择规则本身的好坏：规则可能因反复使用一条广泛可迁移的经验而获得高分，也可能因其偏好的经验本身很弱而得分低。当得分描述的是经验库而非选择规则时，会误导后续研究方向的判断，故需要一个能区分二者的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出一种审计式评估方法：在每一个查询场景中穷尽执行全部已存经验，覆盖两个操作任务、三种复用机制，经验库规模 K=3、10、50。由于每个备选经验的结果都已知，得分可被追溯归因到逐场景的选择质量或经验库整体质量。被审计的选择规则采用五种视觉嵌入（从原始像素到 CLIP）中的最近邻距离进行选择，并与随机选择、oracle、保持选择率但随机配对场景的 shuffle 基线对比。
AI.result: (1) 一条事后选定的固定经验即可弥合随机选择与 oracle 之间 30-58% 的性能差距，而逐场景选择仅竞争剩余 0.07-0.15 的成功率空间。(2) 当 K≥10 时，视觉规则对单一经验的集中程度是 oracle 的 1.5-3 倍，其得分随之由该经验的质量决定。(3) 只要规则显著偏离 shuffle 基线，规则就更差，且对所有学习到的图像策略都成立。(4) 视觉距离能较好地预测给定经验-场景对是否会成功（AUROC 最高 0.96），但在单个场景内对候选排序却不优于随机——五种嵌入中有四种在 K=50 时 AUROC 仅 0.45-0.52。
AI.conclusion: 穷尽执行在实践中通常不可行，因此该审计可简化为任何研究都能提供的两份低成本报告：被选经验的分布，以及事后最优单一经验的成功率。二者结合即可揭示选择规则的优劣，避免用描述经验库的分数误导复用型机器人的研究。

f72704af9570726c09235f081d50a318bb59d13e.title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
f72704af9570726c09235f081d50a318bb59d13e.summary: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation. We propose "disaggregated quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights and storage placement to both of these phases. On Qwen 3 and Gemma 3, removing activation quantization specifically on decode improves accuracy on decode-heavy tasks without increasing inference cost. Training separate compute-native prefill weights accelerates prompt processing relative to weight-only inference while matching or exceeding its accuracy at 2-3-bit decode on both decode-heavy and prefill-heavy tasks. With released Qwen3.8-27B GGUF decoders, training an NVFP4 prefiller improves 1-bit accuracy by 32.5 points on MMLU-Pro and 35.3 on MMMU-Pro without modifying the decode checkpoint. To accommodate the additional checkpoint on a single device, offloaded disaggregated prefill (ODP) streams its weights from SSD, amortizing loading over prompt length. On the same 27B model, ODP delivers a 1.78x time-to-first-token speedup over the weight-only baseline at 8K prompt length in llama.cpp. We evaluate accuracy under disaggregated serving in vLLM and further validate shared-weight format disaggregation through post-training quantization on models up to 2.8T parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出“解耦量化”(DQ)，将预填充与解码的量化格式、权重和存储位置分别特化，在Qwen 3与Gemma 3上兼顾精度与推理效率，并通过ODP将预填充权重卸载至SSD，实现27B模型1.78倍TTFT加速。
AI.motivation: 预填充(prefill)与解码(decode)对量化的需求不同：低精度算术可加速提示处理，而紧凑权重可降低生成阶段的内存流量。传统统一量化难以同时优化两个阶段，因此需要针对阶段特化量化策略。
AI.method: 提出解耦量化(DQ)：分别特化计算格式、权重与存储放置。具体包括：在解码阶段取消激活量化以提升解码密集任务精度；训练独立的计算原生预填充权重以加速提示处理并匹配/超越仅权重量化精度；发布Qwen3.8-27B GGUF解码器并训练NVFP4预填充器；用离载解耦预填充(ODP)从SSD流式加载预填充权重，按提示长度摊薄加载开销；在vLLM中评估解耦服务精度，并通过PTQ验证共享权重格式解耦，规模至2.8T参数。
AI.result: 在Qwen 3与Gemma 3上，解码阶段取消激活量化在不增加推理成本下提升解码密集任务精度；训练独立计算原生预填充权重相对仅权重量化加速提示处理，并在2-3-bit解码下于解码密集与预填充密集任务上匹配或超越其精度。基于Qwen3.8-27B GGUF解码器训练NVFP4预填充器，在不修改解码检查点情况下，MMLU-Pro 1-bit精度提升32.5分，MMMU-Pro提升35.3分。ODP在8K提示长度下于llama.cpp中相比仅权重基线实现1.78倍TTFT加速。
AI.conclusion: 解耦量化可针对预填充与解码分别优化，在保持或提升精度的同时降低推理成本；ODP通过SSD流式加载解决单设备额外检查点问题并显著加速长提示首token生成；方法在vLLM服务与最高2.8T参数模型上得到验证，具备可扩展性。

91aa13a24a300599ddd46e22aab215c6e8564aff.title: The Delegation Blind Spot: Auditing Product Decisions from Agent Choices
91aa13a24a300599ddd46e22aab215c6e8564aff.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Computational technical report with proofs and synthetic-task experiments; no human participants. Code: https://github.com/shi1720/delegation-blind-spot
91aa13a24a300599ddd46e22aab215c6e8564aff.summary: Successful agent execution need not identify which future product improvement its user would value. We present a decision-specific audit that maps a declared observation channel and product-value contrast to compatible intervals and witness populations. Its foundations are established identification and decision theory; the contribution is an executable measurement workflow and a controlled study of its limits. A frozen experiment makes 4,800 requests to two pinned model snapshots on shared synthetic tasks. All 36 conservative primary intervals remain unresolved despite different execution accuracy. An exploratory 2,400-call follow-up records supplied preferences and resolves three of nine comparisons per model. A deterministic extractor resolves seven of nine without model calls or calibration observations, exposing unnecessary uncertainty introduced by model-generated reports. A further 14,400 controlled multinomial simulations distinguish structural ambiguity from weak identification and finite calibration precision. We propose a source-labeled decision receipt and provide an offline viewer for inspecting the audit. These results motivate preserving decision-relevant structured input and diagnosing why a decision is unresolved before collecting more telemetry. The study contains no human participants or real customer outcomes. Full proofs, raw model provenance, controlled experiments, and reproducible analyses accompany the report.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“决策特定”的审计工作流，将声明的观测通道与产品价值对比映射为兼容区间和见证群体；通过冻结模型实验、偏好补充实验、确定性抽取器与受控多项模拟，表明执行准确率不等于价值识别，并揭示模型报告引入的不必要不确定性。作者建议保留决策相关的结构化输入，并在追加遥测前诊断决策未解原因，同时提供来源标注的决策回执与离线查看器。
AI.motivation: 代理执行成功并不必然意味着能够识别用户未来会重视哪种产品改进。论文的动机是将“执行能力”与“决策相关价值识别”区分开，建立可执行的测量审计，并系统研究其识别极限，而非仅依赖既有识别理论与决策理论基础。
AI.method: 方法核心是决策特定审计：给定声明的观测通道和产品价值对比，计算兼容区间与见证群体。实证上采用冻结实验，在共享合成任务上向两个固定模型快照发出4,800次请求；随后进行2,400次探索性补充调用，记录供给偏好；再使用确定性抽取器在不调用模型、不依赖校准观测的情况下解析比较；另以14,400次受控多项模拟区分结构性歧义、弱识别与有限校准精度。作者还提出来源标注的决策回执，并提供离线查看器检查审计过程。
AI.result: 主要冻结实验中，36个保守主区间全部未解，尽管不同模型快照的执行准确率存在差异。探索性补充实验在每个模型9项比较中仅解决3项。确定性抽取器无需模型调用或校准观测即可解决9项中的7项，说明模型生成报告引入了不必要的不确定性。受控多项模拟进一步区分了结构性歧义、弱识别和有限校准精度。研究不含人类参与者或真实客户结果。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：应保留决策相关的结构化输入，并在收集更多遥测数据之前先诊断决策为何未解；来源标注的决策回执与离线查看器有助于审计与复现。该工作将贡献定位为可执行测量工作流及其受控极限研究，而非新的识别理论；完整证明、原始模型来源、受控实验和可复现分析随报告提供。

7e7d0e69178352cf831a99ac57d080d88c3c0486.title: Longitudinal Retinal Vascular Remodeling in Myopic Children Treated with Orthokeratology or Defocus Lenses: A Two-Year Comparative Study
7e7d0e69178352cf831a99ac57d080d88c3c0486.summary: Purposes: To characterize longitudinal retinal vascular changes in myopic children treated with orthokeratology (OK) or multifocal defocus lenses (Defocus) and to examine their association with axial elongation. Methods: In this retrospective cohort study, 43 myopic children underwent comprehensive clinical examination and fundus photography at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) were recorded at baseline, 6, 12, and 24 months. An automated segmentation model extracted vascular parameters, main vessel angle (MA), branching angle (BA), bifurcation edge angle (BEA), crossover point (COP), and terminal vessel count (TVC). Repeated-measures ANOVA assessed temporal changes. Pearson or Spearman correlations evaluated associations between AL and vascular metrics. Results: Over 24 months, the OK group exhibited significantly slower axial elongation than the Defocus group (0.214 mm and 0.522 mm, p < 0.01). In the OK group, MA and BA decreased modestly, BEA in arteries declined gradually, but COP and TVC remained relatively stable. The Defocus group demonstrated more pronounced decreases in MA and BA, an increase in BEA, and significant reductions in COP and TVC (p < 0.05). Correlation analysis revealed stronger associations between AL and vascular parameters, especially COP and TVC, in the Defocus group at all time points, whereas only BA and BEA correlated with AL in the OK group. Conclusions: OK lenses mitigate axial elongation and induce milder retinal vascular remodeling compared to Defocus lenses. Distinct temporal patterns of vascular metrics changes were observed between the two interventions, and correlate differentially with axial growth.

AI.tldr: 该回顾性队列研究比较角膜塑形镜（OK）与多焦离焦镜片（Defocus）对近视儿童视网膜血管参数及眼轴增长的影响，发现OK组眼轴增长更慢、血管重塑更轻，且血管参数与眼轴的相关性存在干预方式差异。
AI.motivation: 探讨OK镜与多焦离焦镜片治疗近视儿童过程中，视网膜血管纵向变化及其与眼轴延长的关系，以理解不同近视防控手段对眼底血管结构的影响差异。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入43名近视儿童，在基线、12个月、24个月进行临床检查和眼底照相，并在基线、6、12、24个月记录眼轴长度（AL）和等效球镜度（SER）。采用自动分割模型提取血管参数：主血管角（MA）、分支角（BA）、分叉边缘角（BEA）、交叉点（COP）和终末血管计数（TVC）。使用重复测量方差分析评估时间变化，Pearson或Spearman相关分析评估AL与血管指标的关系。
AI.result: 24个月内，OK组眼轴增长显著慢于Defocus组（0.214 mm vs 0.522 mm，p<0.01）。OK组MA和BA轻度下降，动脉BEA逐渐降低，COP和TVC相对稳定；Defocus组MA和BA下降更明显，BEA升高，COP和TVC显著减少（p<0.05）。相关分析显示，Defocus组各时间点AL与血管参数（尤其COP和TVC）相关性更强；OK组仅BA和BEA与AL相关。
AI.conclusion: 与Defocus镜片相比，OK镜可减缓眼轴延长并引起更轻微的视网膜血管重塑。两种干预方式下血管指标随时间变化模式不同，并与眼轴增长呈不同相关性。

bbda62b0263a07e95580da8ed3e9a75df9b25fd1.title: Wheel-loader V-Cycle Automation with Deep Koopman MPC
bbda62b0263a07e95580da8ed3e9a75df9b25fd1.summary: The repeated forward-reverse maneuvers performed by wheel loaders during earthmoving operations make them well suited for automation. However, the nonlinear dynamics of articulated vehicles and complex vehicle-terrain interactions limit the effectiveness of conventional model-based approaches. This paper presents a hierarchical framework that combines long-horizon geometric planning with data-driven predictive control for autonomous wheel-loader operation. A reduced-order articulated kinematic model is used to generate the maneuver geometry, where the forward and reverse trajectories are jointly optimized through a shared intermediate state. To capture the vehicle dynamics, two data-driven deep bilinear Koopman models are learned for the forward and reverse motions using data generated from high-fidelity simulations in Algoryx Dynamics. The learned Koopman representations are subsequently incorporated into a computationally efficient model predictive control (MPC) formulation for trajectory tracking. The resulting controller operates in real time within a 50-ms execution loop. High-fidelity simulation results demonstrate that the proposed end-to-end framework enables accurate and computationally efficient execution of wheel-loader V-cycle maneuvers, providing a promising approach toward autonomous operation of articulated heavy-duty machinery.

AI.tldr: 提出分层框架：长时域几何规划 + 数据驱动预测控制，实现轮式装载机自主V型作业循环。
AI.motivation: 轮式装载机在土方作业中反复前进-倒车，适合自动化；但铰接车辆非线性动力学与复杂车辆-地形交互使传统基于模型的方法效果受限。
AI.method: 采用降阶铰接运动学模型生成操作几何，通过共享中间状态联合优化前进与倒车轨迹；基于Algoryx Dynamics高保真仿真数据，分别学习前进与倒车的两个数据驱动深度双线性Koopman模型，并将其嵌入计算高效的MPC中进行轨迹跟踪。
AI.result: 控制器可在50 ms执行循环内实时运行；高保真仿真表明，端到端框架能够准确且计算高效地完成轮式装载机V型循环作业。
AI.conclusion: 该分层、数据驱动框架为铰接重型机械自主作业提供了有前景的途径。

b302edb1ba52c47bd0a7f0b30dcf493cba80f562.title: Geometry-Aware Hyperbolic Residual Quantization
b302edb1ba52c47bd0a7f0b30dcf493cba80f562.comment: 14-page main paper (30 pages total with references and appendix), 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at the Beyond Euclidean Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Oral)
b302edb1ba52c47bd0a7f0b30dcf493cba80f562.summary: Residual Vector Quantization turns continuous representations into discrete, multi-level token sequences. Yet most methods operate in Euclidean space, despite the coarse-to-fine structure of the resulting codes and the latent hierarchies present in many data domains. Hyperbolic geometry offers a natural alternative for hierarchical representations, but naive hyperbolic extensions introduce geometric inconsistencies: non-associative hyperbolic addition prevents consistent residual aggregation, while standard straight-through gradient estimation ignores the geometry of the latent space. We propose a geometry-aware hyperbolic residual quantization that addresses these issues in both the forward and backward passes. In the forward pass, Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation restores the telescoping behavior of residual quantization on the Poincare ball. In the backward pass, a discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator routes the reconstruction gradient through the quantizer as a single geometric block, avoiding unstable recursive gradient transport across residual stages. Evaluations on hierarchical prediction, recommendation, image tokenization, and neural audio coding tasks show that our method improves the stability and structural organization of hyperbolic residual codes over naive hyperbolic baselines. At the same time, we observe a clear structure-compression trade-off: Euclidean residual quantization remains preferable for pure compression, while geometry-aware hyperbolic quantization is most useful for hierarchically organized discrete latent spaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种几何感知的双曲残差量化方法，在前向传播中恢复残差量化在庞加莱球上的望远镜式聚合行为，在反向传播中用折扣双曲直通估计器将重建梯度作为单一几何块路由，从而避免残差阶段间不稳定的递归梯度传输，提升了双曲残差码的稳定性与结构组织性。
AI.motivation: 残差向量量化（RVQ）能将连续表示转为离散的多层级 token 序列，但多数方法在欧氏空间中进行，忽视了所得码本的粗到细结构以及许多数据域中固有的潜在层次。双曲几何天然适合层次表示，但朴素的双曲扩展会引入几何不一致：非结合的双曲加法导致残差聚合不一致，标准直通梯度估计忽略了潜在空间的几何结构。
AI.method: 提出几何感知的双曲残差量化，同时处理前向与反向传播。前向：双曲残差聚合（Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation）在庞加莱球上恢复残差量化的望远镜式（telescoping）行为；反向：折扣双曲直通估计器（discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator）将重建梯度作为单一几何块通过量化器路由，避免跨残差阶段的不稳定递归梯度传输。
AI.result: 在层次预测、推荐、图像分词与神经音频编码任务上评估，相比朴素双曲基线，方法提升了双曲残差码的稳定性与结构组织性。同时观察到明显的结构—压缩权衡：纯压缩场景下欧氏残差量化仍更优，而几何感知双曲量化对层次化组织的离散潜在空间最有用。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的双曲残差量化通过在前向与反向传播中引入几何一致性，改善了双曲残差码的稳定性与层次结构组织。但存在结构—压缩权衡：欧氏 RVQ 适合纯压缩，双曲量化适合层次化的离散潜在空间。

b062e0e1481a1c0981f8c523bfa8b5ff862ad024.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: A Constrained Decision Head Follows the Option Name, Not the Rubric Bound to It
b062e0e1481a1c0981f8c523bfa8b5ff862ad024.summary: Typed decision models are built for settings where model outputs are consumed directly by software. Instead of generating free-form text, they return a decision over a predefined set of options. By construction, every output conforms to the required schema. Yet this guarantee does not tell us whether the model interprets the options as intended. We study Jev and two Jev-like models with open weights by changing how option names are assigned to rubrics. Each option consists of an option name and a textual rubric that defines what the option means. We change only which option name is assigned to each rubric; the question, state, rubric wording, and set of option names remain exactly the same. On 1200 workflow decisions with task-specific rubrics, renaming the two options from 0/1 to no/yes changes 70.4 more answers per hundred (95% CI: [67.6, 73.1]) and shifts AUC from .94 to .23, revealing a systematic reversal in the decision ranking rather than simple uncertainty. The same operation has little effect with neutral option names. This pattern holds across all 4 predicates, where the effect is at least 7.4x larger than under the neutral control, and becomes stronger as the number of options increases. The effect also depends on the read-out geometry: a second model family that mean-pools over the full option span flips 4.1x less often. The hosted model exhibits the same behavior: the swap changes AUC from .8146 to .5806 and produces 24x as many answer flips as its test-retest floor. In contrast, replacing the option names with random character strings returns all model families to the neutral-control regime without reducing accuracy. The failure therefore depends on the semantic polarity of the option names rather than on the renaming operation itself. Across all conditions, the type-error rate remains 0%, even when decision accuracy degrades substantially.

AI.tldr: 类型化决策模型虽能保证输出符合schema，但其对选项含义的解读可能不符合预期；实验表明仅改变选项名称的语义极性（如0/1→no/yes）就会导致系统性决策反转，而类型错误率始终为0%。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型被设计为在软件直接消费输出的场景中，返回预定义选项集上的决策，从而在结构上保证每个输出都符合所需schema。然而，这种保证并不能说明模型是否按预期解读了选项含义。作者希望探究：在选项名称与文本评分标准（rubric）绑定方式发生变化时，模型的决策是否会发生不可预期的改变，从而揭示"格式合规"与"语义正确"之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 在包含1200个工作流决策、且带有任务特定rubric的任务中，作者研究了Jev及两个开放权重的类Jev模型。每个选项由选项名和定义其含义的文本rubric组成。实验仅改变"哪个选项名被分配给哪个rubric"，而问题、状态、rubric措辞和选项名集合保持完全一致。核心操作是将两个选项名从0/1改为no/yes，并通过中性选项名和随机字符串作为对照。同时考察读出几何的影响：对比一个在完整选项跨度上做均值池化的第二模型族。此外还检验了托管模型，并报告类型错误率。
AI.result: 将两个选项名从0/1改为no/yes，使每百次答案改变量增加70.4（95% CI: [67.6, 73.1]），AUC从.94骤降至.23，揭示决策排序的系统性反转而非单纯的不确定性；相同操作在中性选项名下几乎无影响。该模式在全部4个谓词上成立，效应至少比中性对照大7.4倍，且随选项数量增加而增强。读出几何亦影响该效应：在完整选项跨度上做均值池化的第二模型族反转频率低4.1倍。托管模型表现一致，AUC从.8146变为.5806，答案翻转量是其重测下限（test-retest floor）的24倍。相反，将选项名替换为随机字符串后，所有模型族均回归中性对照区间，且准确率未下降。所有条件下类型错误率始终为0%，即使决策准确率大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 该失效取决于选项名称的语义极性，而非重命名操作本身——随机字符串不会触发退化。这说明类型化决策模型的schema合规性并不能保障其按预期解读选项含义，即便在决策准确率严重退化时，类型错误率仍为0%。研究提示：仅靠结构约束不足以确保语义正确性，选项命名与读出几何等设计因素会显著影响决策可靠性。

ebaa5c461792810d4bdd6f835c4fd6a14f501dbc.title: DIFTA-3D: Depth-Consistent Instance-Level Feature Transfer and Adaptation of DINOv3 for 3D Detection
ebaa5c461792810d4bdd6f835c4fd6a14f501dbc.summary: RGB-D 3D instance detectors benefit from visual semantics, but the task-specific Faster R-CNN/ResNet branch used by IIFNet3D couples feature extraction to a separately trained 2D detector and its image-domain labels. Replacing that branch with a frozen vision foundation model removes this task-specific dependency, but may introduce occlusion noise and a mismatch between patch features and geometry-aware detection features. In this work, we investigate this replacement through an adaptation of DINOv3 to the instance-level fusion pipeline of IIFNet3D. At the core of our approach is a depth-consistent feature pipeline that projects scene points into calibrated RGB-D frames, applies a metric depth-residual check, averages the accepted DINOv3 features into an offline point cache, and aggregates the cached features inside proposal-aligned RoI grids. The geometric and bidirectional instance-fusion paths are preserved, while Conservative VAID is evaluated as a low-strength, support-weighted semantic distillation recipe applied only to positive RoIs. We conduct extensive evaluations on ScanNetV2 to assess the proposed transfer recipes. On ScanNetV2, our DINOv3 control achieves mAP scores of 76.15 and 60.93 at IoU thresholds of 0.25 and 0.50, respectively. The Conservative VAID setting achieves mAP scores of 76.59 and 62.16, corresponding to numerical gains of 0.44 and 1.23 points over the control, respectively, in this checkpoint-level recipe comparison. The reported IIFNet3D result of 75.7/63.8 is used only as an external reference because the visual branch and processing protocol differ. Accordingly, we interpret these results as evidence for a controlled transfer recipe rather than as a causal estimate of the individual contributions of VAID or depth filtering.

AI.tldr: 该文研究用冻结的视觉基础模型 DINOv3 替换 IIFNet3D 中任务专用的 Faster R-CNN/ResNet 视觉分支，并设计深度一致的特征流水线与保守 VAID 语义蒸馏方案，在 ScanNetV2 上验证该迁移配方。
AI.motivation: IIFNet3D 的 RGB-D 3D 实例检测依赖任务专用 2D 检测分支，导致特征提取与单独训练的 2D 检测器及其图像域标签耦合。替换为冻结视觉基础模型可去除任务专用依赖，但会带来遮挡噪声以及 patch 特征与几何感知检测特征不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 将 DINOv3 适配到 IIFNet3D 的实例级融合流水线。核心是深度一致特征流水线：把场景点投影到标定后的 RGB-D 帧，执行度量深度残差检查，将接受的 DINOv3 特征平均写入离线点缓存，并在与候选框对齐的 RoI 网格内聚合缓存特征；保留几何与双向实例融合路径。同时评估 Conservative VAID，一种仅作用于正 RoI 的低强度、支持度加权语义蒸馏配方。
AI.result: 在 ScanNetV2 上，DINOv3 控制组在 IoU 0.25 和 0.50 下的 mAP 分别为 76.15 和 60.93；Conservative VAID 设置分别为 76.59 和 62.16，较控制组分别提升 0.44 和 1.23 个点。IIFNet3D 报告的 75.7/63.8 仅作为外部参考，因其视觉分支与处理协议不同。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该工作提出的是受控迁移配方，而非对 VAID 或深度过滤各自贡献的因果估计；即替换视觉分支并加入 Conservative VAID 在该检查点级配方比较中具有数值收益，但解释需谨慎。

b35f2211a7a39bb14ea41fb99fb4ccdd391fb7a9.title: CliffCompaction: Cost-Efficient Compaction for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
b35f2211a7a39bb14ea41fb99fb4ccdd391fb7a9.summary: Agents often work on complex problems that require millions of tokens of context, which necessitates compacting across sessions due to limited context windows. We develop CliffCompaction, an autocompaction technique that reduces cost by up to 50% under a bounded context while maintaining or improving performance on Terminal-Bench and achieving new levels of efficiency for test-time scaling and state-of-the-art results on KernelBench. The per-rollout savings of CliffCompaction make the performance--cost trade-off of test-time scaling more efficient, adding over 10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench for less than the cost of two full-context runs. Under parallel test-time scaling, CliffCompaction lets Kimi K2.6 match Opus 4.7, and exceed Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.3 Codex at lower cost. The key to CliffCompaction's effectiveness is that it keeps compacted information faithful by only truncating or dropping content, never rephrasing or rewriting it. We never compact a compaction---each pass operates only on original content, and prior compacted output is discarded, preventing context drift from accumulating. These properties sustain continual learning over sessions exceeding a million tokens: on KernelBench, CliffCompaction reaches CUDA kernel speedups of $2.23\times$ after 200 steps and $3.58\times$ after 400 steps, surpassing specialized search algorithms and trained agents despite being a general-purpose compaction technique. We open-source a scaffold-agnostic API-proxy implementation of CliffCompaction usable with Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses.

AI.tldr: CliffCompaction 是一种"自动压缩"技术，通过在有限上下文窗口下仅截断/丢弃原文（不重写改写），并将每次压缩都基于原始内容独立进行，从而在降低至多 50% 成本的同时维持或提升智能体性能，并支持超百万 token 的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 智能体常需处理需数百万 token 上下文的复杂问题，但受限于上下文窗口，必须跨会话进行压缩。现有压缩方式可能因改写、重述引入"上下文漂移"，导致信息失真、性能下降，同时大规模推理（test-time scaling）的成本过高，缺乏高效的性能-成本权衡方案。
AI.method: 提出 CliffCompaction：1）保真性压缩——只做截断或丢弃，绝不改写或重述内容，保证压缩信息忠实；2）禁止对压缩结果二次压缩——每一轮压缩只作用于原始内容，丢弃此前的压缩输出，避免上下文漂移累积；3）开源了与脚手架无关的 API 代理实现，可兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等框架。
AI.result: 在有限上下文下成本降低至多 50%，同时维持或提升 Terminal-Bench 性能；在 KernelBench 上取得 SOTA。测试时扩展效率提升：在 Terminal-Bench 上以低于两次全上下文运行的成本提升逾 10 个百分点。并行测试时扩展下，Kimi K2.6 可匹敌 Opus 4.7，并在更低成本下超越 Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.3 Codex。持续学习方面，KernelBench 上 CUDA 内核加速在 200 步达 2.23×、400 步达 3.58×，超越专用搜索算法与训练过的智能体。
AI.conclusion: CliffCompaction 证明了"仅截断/丢弃、不重写、不复压"的保真压缩策略能有效避免上下文漂移，在显著降本的同时保持甚至提升性能，并支持超百万 token 会话的持续学习，作为通用压缩技术即可超越专用方法，且以开源代理形式便于广泛应用。

a6bb45a20b760a735e3fffd6d16ec62fbbad9286.title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
a6bb45a20b760a735e3fffd6d16ec62fbbad9286.summary: Conventional wisdom in deep learning holds that overparameterization---having more parameters $p$ than training samples $n$---is benign: larger models generalize better and, even without regularization, interpolating models generalize well, the test error following a double-descent curve. One might expect the same benign overfitting for diffusion models, whose training reduces to regression, i.e. to minimizing a quadratic score-matching loss. Yet the opposite is observed: overfitting here is catastrophic, driving the model into a memorization regime. We resolve this paradox by combining experiments on U-Nets trained on CelebA with a random-features model for which we derive closed-form learning curves. We show that with a fixed number $m$ of noise realizations per training sample, an interpolation peak does occur, but at $p\sim nm$ rather than at $p\sim n$ as in standard regression. The rise of the test loss, however, sets in much earlier, at $p\sim n$, independently of $m$. This overfitting is malign because, although the implicit regularization of training is fully at work, it drives the model toward the empirical score, which memorizes the training set, rather than toward the true score. A bias-variance decomposition pinpoints the mechanism: the bias of the score estimator starts to grow at $p\sim n$; past the peak the variance decays, as in regression, whereas the bias keeps growing and both saturate at a large value. Since diffusion models are trained with $m\gg1$, the peak is pushed to very large model sizes, and therefore sit on the rising branch that precedes it, where malign overfitting is already in play. Nevertheless, overparameterization remains beneficial when paired with regularization: in the random-features theory and in U-Net experiments, optimally regularized large models---via a ridge penalty or early stopping, respectively---outperform any unregularized models.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了扩散模型在过参数化下“灾难性过拟合”与深度学习中“良性过拟合”之间的悖论：在每样本固定 m 个噪声实现时，插值峰出现在 p∼nm 而非 p∼n，但测试损失早在 p∼n 就开始上升，原因是偏差开始增长并趋向记忆训练集的 empirical score；不过，配合岭惩罚或早停等正则化后，大模型仍可优于未正则化模型。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为深度学习中过参数化是良性的：模型更大泛化更好，即使无正则化，插值模型也能泛化，测试误差呈双下降曲线。扩散模型训练可归结为回归，即最小化二次分数匹配损失，因此人们可能期望同样出现良性过拟合；但实际观察到相反现象：过拟合是灾难性的，会将模型推向记忆化机制。论文旨在解释这一悖论。
AI.method: 结合两类手段：1）在 CelebA 上训练 U-Net 进行实验；2）构建随机特征模型，并推导闭式学习曲线。设定每个训练样本有固定数量 m 个噪声实现，进行偏差-方差分解以定位机制。
AI.result: 实验与理论表明：插值峰确实会出现，但位置在 p∼nm，而非标准回归中的 p∼n；然而测试损失的上升更早，在 p∼n 处开始，且与 m 无关。该过拟合是 malign 的：尽管训练的隐式正则化完全起作用，它仍驱使模型逼近经验分数（empirical score），从而记忆训练集，而非逼近真实分数。偏差-方差分解显示：分数估计器的偏差在 p∼n 处开始增长；越过峰值后方差像回归中一样衰减，但偏差持续增长，二者最终饱和于较大值。由于扩散模型通常 m≫1，插值峰被推到非常大的模型规模，因此实际模型位于峰值前的上升分支，此时恶性过拟合已经发生。
AI.conclusion: 过参数化本身在扩散模型中并非良性，会因偏差增长导致记忆化；但当与正则化结合时仍有益：在随机特征理论与 U-Net 实验中，通过岭惩罚或早停得到的最优正则化大模型，均优于任何未正则化模型。

db79d9567bcd512f5719f419eb4d1e7be4e04ec6.title: HARMONY: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for MONocular Image-to-Scene Synthesis
db79d9567bcd512f5719f419eb4d1e7be4e04ec6.summary: Compositional 3D scene reconstruction has recently been explored from two directions: agentic reasoning that provides semantic understanding of spatial relationships but lacks precise alignment with input images; and visual geometry foundation models that predict dense point maps from input images but the reconstruction quality is limited. Therefore, recovering a complete 3D scene from a single monocular image with accurate inter-object relationships and high-fidelity reconstruction quality remains challenging. In this paper, we present HARMONY, a hierarchical chain-of-thought framework that leverages both agentic reasoning and visual geometry foundation. Given an image of an indoor scene, starting from an empty 3D floorplan, HARMONY first calibrates the camera against the reference image to establish a semantically-grounded spatial frame, then uses agentic VLM reasoning to recover the 3D room layout and an initial placement order. It then places the objects in a hierarchical order, from wall-mounted elements, free-standing furniture, to dependent decorations on top of furniture. We also use depth-first traversal for furniture so each placement conditions on previously resolved structure and a reflective feedback loop to avoid error accumulation. After each object placement by VLM, we use the point cloud estimations to perform geometry-based refinement so that the rendered image aligns better with the input. HARMONY can produce 3D scenes that are semantically consistent and perceptually aligned with the reference image, extending single-image compositional reconstruction to complex indoor scene images. Experiments on synthetic and real-world images demonstrate that HARMONY outperforms the evaluated reconstruction baselines, while qualitative comparisons with GPT-6 Astra suggest more faithful object arrangements and better preservation of scene details.

AI.tldr: HARMONY：一种分层思维链（CoT）框架，结合智能体推理与视觉几何基础模型，从单张室内图像重建完整3D场景，实现对象关系语义一致且与输入图像感知对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有组合式3D场景重建有两条路线：智能体推理能提供空间关系的语义理解，但与输入图像对齐不精确；视觉几何基础模型能从图像预测密集点图，但重建质量有限。因此，从单张单目图像恢复完整3D场景，同时保证对象间关系准确与高保真重建质量，仍是挑战。
AI.method: HARMONY采用分层链式思维：给定室内图像，从空3D平面图出发，先对相机进行标定以建立语义化空间坐标系；再用智能体VLM推理恢复3D房间布局和初始放置顺序；随后按层级放置对象：壁挂元素→独立家具→家具上的依附装饰。家具采用深度优先遍历，使每次放置以已解析结构为条件；并用反射式反馈循环避免误差累积。每次VLM放置对象后，利用点云估计进行几何精修，使渲染图像更好地与输入对齐。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界图像上的实验表明，HARMONY优于所评估的重建基线；与GPT-6 Astra的定性比较显示，其对象布置更忠实，场景细节保持更好。
AI.conclusion: HARMONY能够生成语义一致且与参考图像感知对齐的3D场景，将单图像组合式重建扩展到复杂室内场景图像。

bf2cfcec61571b865b5ac6d1c893ec470f380c34.title: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
bf2cfcec61571b865b5ac6d1c893ec470f380c34.summary: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is widely used for transient mechanical simulations, but its high computational cost limits real-time and high-resolution applications. Deep learning surrogate models can reduce this cost; however, many existing approaches are restricted to steady-state prediction or cannot jointly predict Node- and Element-based Outputs (NEO) over time. The state-of-the-art DeepFEA framework has addressed these issues but remains limited to structured finite element (FE) meshes. To overcome this limitation, this study proposes DeepFEAv2, a deep learning surrogate framework that enables prediction of transient FEA simulations across different FE mesh topologies and element types. The main contributions of DeepFEAv2 are: (a) a module that uses the FE connectivity matrix to organize input features by element and arrange them into an input sequence guided by the mesh topology; (b) a novel neural network architecture designed to process the input sequence and jointly predict NEO over time; and (c) a FEA-informed optimization strategy for regularizing these NEO predictions. DeepFEAv2 was evaluated on structured and unstructured 3D linear elastic datasets, as well as on a pressure-driven aortic valve dataset. DeepFEAv2 achieved R^2 values up to 0.99 and normalized errors as low as 0.38%. Compared with DeepFEA, it achieved up to 38.0% relative increase in R^2 and up to 87.1% reduction in normalized error. DeepFEAv2 also performed inference up to three orders of magnitude faster than traditional FEA. These results demonstrate that DeepFEAv2 can efficiently model transient FEA simulations across increasingly complex FE settings, providing a scalable surrogate framework for transient FEA.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepFEAv2，一种可跨不同有限元网格拓扑与单元类型的瞬态FEA深度学习代理框架，能联合预测随时间变化的节点与单元输出（NEO），在多种3D数据集上取得高精度并显著优于DeepFEA，推理速度较传统FEA快至多三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 有限元分析（FEA）广泛用于瞬态力学仿真，但计算成本高，限制实时与高分辨率应用。深度学习代理模型可降低成本，但现有方法多局限于稳态预测，或无法在时间维度上联合预测节点与单元输出（NEO）。现有最优框架DeepFEA虽缓解上述问题，却仅支持结构化有限元网格。
AI.method: 提出DeepFEAv2，核心贡献包括：(a) 利用有限元连接矩阵按单元组织输入特征，并依据网格拓扑排列为输入序列的模块；(b) 一种新型神经网络架构，用于处理该输入序列并联合预测随时间变化的NEO；(c) 一种FEA-informed优化策略，用于正则化NEO预测。评估涵盖结构化与非结构化3D线弹性数据集，以及压力驱动主动脉瓣数据集。
AI.result: DeepFEAv2取得最高R²为0.99，归一化误差最低为0.38%。与DeepFEA相比，R²相对提升最高达38.0%，归一化误差降低最高达87.1%。推理速度较传统FEA快至多三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: DeepFEAv2能够高效建模日益复杂的有限元设置下的瞬态FEA仿真，为瞬态FEA提供了一种可扩展的代理框架，在保持高精度的同时显著提升推理效率。

0e820b2f398031fc503794c3b1f5b9064e54b253.title: One-Step Generative Surrogate Models via Block-Triangular Joint Drifting
0e820b2f398031fc503794c3b1f5b9064e54b253.summary: Drifting provides a direct route to one-step generative models, but applying it directly to stochastic transition modeling requires multiple samples of the next state conditioned on the same current state. Standard trajectory data, however, typically provide only one realized next state for each observed current state and therefore do not provide an empirical approximation of the corresponding conditional distribution over possible next states. We introduce block-triangular joint drifting, which instead applies a projected drift field to the empirically accessible joint distribution of consecutive states. Importantly, the block-triangular architecture preserves the current-state marginal while making its second component a direct sampler of the conditional distribution of possible next states. The resulting surrogate generates stochastic trajectories with one model evaluation per time step, without auxiliary generative steps between time steps. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate marginal and trajectory-dependent statistics and favorable accuracy-cost tradeoffs compared with deterministic, diffusion-, flow-, and distillation-based generative surrogate models.

AI.tldr: 提出块三角联合漂移（block-triangular joint drifting），将投影漂移场作用于相邻状态的联合分布，实现从标准轨迹数据学习一步随机转移生成模型。
AI.motivation: 标准漂移可直接构建一步生成模型，但直接用于随机转移建模时，需要同一当前状态下多个下一状态样本以近似条件分布；而标准轨迹数据通常每个当前状态仅提供一个已实现的下一状态，无法经验逼近该条件分布。
AI.method: 对经验可得的连续状态联合分布应用投影漂移场；采用块三角架构，在保持当前状态边缘分布的同时，使第二分量成为下一状态条件分布的直接采样器；每个时间步仅需一次模型评估即可生成随机轨迹，且时间步之间无需辅助生成步骤。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法能准确恢复边缘分布与轨迹相关统计，并在精度-成本权衡上优于确定性、扩散、流和蒸馏等生成代理模型。
AI.conclusion: 块三角联合漂移为从标准轨迹数据学习一步随机生成代理提供了有效途径，在保持随机转移建模能力的同时显著降低生成成本。

0f1edad8dff5f350a2e9969c27757670394753c6.title: Can We Predict Anomaly Detection Performance from Embedding-Space Geometry?
0f1edad8dff5f350a2e9969c27757670394753c6.summary: Anomaly detection systems are often trained using normal data alone, while model selection and evaluation typically require labeled anomalies. We study whether anomaly detection performance can be predicted without access to anomalous data. For kNN-based detectors, we derive a lower bound on the area under the ROC curve (AUC) that relates detection performance to the separation between inlier and outlier scores and to their respective variances. Under a local scaling model, we use this bound to characterize how density variation, intrinsic-dimensional heterogeneity, and cross-domain mismatch contribute to score variability. We then investigate anomaly-free model selection and show that inlier score variance alone does not reliably predict performance across different representations. To address this limitation, we introduce simple pseudo-anomaly probes that provide a reference for estimating relative score separation. Experiments on the DCASE 2022-2025 benchmarks, spanning four embedding models and 208 candidate systems, show that pseudo-anomaly-based estimators substantially improve anomaly-free model selection. In particular, diverse pseudo-anomalies enable anomaly-free model selection to outperform conventional development-set selection under domain shift. These results show that embedding-space geometry contains predictive information about anomaly detection performance while also highlighting the representation-dependent nature of inlier-only performance estimates.

AI.tldr: 研究无异常数据条件下的异常检测模型选择问题；基于kNN检测器推导AUC下界，并利用伪异常探针估计分数分离度。在DCASE 2022-2025基准、4种嵌入模型、208个候选系统上，伪异常方法显著提升无异常模型选择，域偏移下甚至优于传统开发集选择。
AI.motivation: 异常检测通常仅用正常数据训练，但模型选择与评估依赖标注异常，现实中异常标签往往不可得。作者希望回答：在无异常数据时，能否预测异常检测性能并完成模型选择。
AI.method: 针对kNN检测器，推导AUC下界，将检测性能与内点/外点分数分离度及各自方差联系起来；在局部缩放模型下分析密度变化、内在维度异质性和跨域不匹配如何影响分数方差。进一步指出仅用内点分数方差无法可靠预测不同表示下的性能，于是引入简单伪异常探针，为估计相对分数分离度提供参考。
AI.result: 在DCASE 2022-2025基准上，覆盖4种嵌入模型和208个候选系统，伪异常估计器显著改善无异常模型选择。尤其在使用多样化伪异常时，域偏移场景下无异常模型选择可优于传统开发集选择。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间几何包含关于异常检测性能的预测信息；同时，仅基于内点的性能估计具有表示依赖性，伪异常探针可缓解这一局限，为无异常模型选择提供有效途径。

0d7aa058696ed57c61e23ed2d6ee3f52496acbe6.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
0d7aa058696ed57c61e23ed2d6ee3f52496acbe6.summary: Recursive models can continue updating their latent states beyond their nominal inference budget, so an incorrect output at that budget does not show whether computation is unfinished or has entered a persistently unsuccessful regime. We study the dynamics of completion in attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles. Extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps increases cumulative exact-solve accuracy from 59.2% to 87.5% for the attention model and from 74.4% to 91.9% for the MLP model, solving more than two-thirds of the puzzles unsolved in the nominal budget. Across both architectures, latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution. Completed states are typically locally contractive along the trajectory direction, even though the same local Jacobian retains strongly expanding directions. We characterize this phenomenon as trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability. Perturbation experiments confirm this directional stability across both models. The multi-step fate of the maximally expanding direction differs: it is absorbed within 16 steps in the attention model but persists longer in the MLP model. The anisotropic-stability pattern also holds for a second attention checkpoint. Together, these results distinguish nominal-budget failure from completed computation and identify a common dynamical signature of completion across two recurrent architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Tiny Recursive Models（TRM）在困难数独上的“完成动力学”：超出标称推理预算继续递归可显著提升准确率，并在首次精确解后出现潜状态运动骤降与轨迹条件下的各向异性稳定性。
AI.motivation: 递归模型可在标称推理预算之外继续更新潜状态，因此标称预算下输出错误并不能区分“计算尚未完成”与“进入了持续失败的 regime”。作者希望找到区分二者的动力学判据，并理解完成状态的稳定性结构。
AI.method: 在1000个困难数独上研究基于attention与MLP的TRM完成动力学；将递归步数从标称16步扩展到512步，统计累计精确求解准确率；观察潜状态运动幅度、局部Jacobian沿轨迹方向的收缩/扩张性质，并进行扰动实验；同时比较最大扩张方向的多步命运，并在第二个attention checkpoint上验证。
AI.result: 递归步数从16扩展到512后，attention模型累计精确求解准确率从59.2%升至87.5%，MLP模型从74.4%升至91.9%，解决了标称预算下未解难题的三分之二以上。两种架构在首次精确解后潜状态运动均急剧下降；完成状态通常沿轨迹方向局部收缩，但同一局部Jacobian仍保留强扩张方向。扰动实验确认了这种方向性稳定性。最大扩张方向的多步命运不同：attention模型中16步内被吸收，MLP模型中持续更久。该各向异性稳定模式在第二个attention checkpoint上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果可将“标称预算失败”与“计算已完成”区分开来，并识别出跨两种递归架构的共同完成动力学签名：轨迹条件下的各向异性稳定性。

3ea40b2d8ad60dd1a20bb3edd29c464ae9db0317.title: Gap-Free Streaming PCA Beyond Rank-One Updates: Near-Optimal Rates and Applications to Differential Privacy
3ea40b2d8ad60dd1a20bb3edd29c464ae9db0317.summary: Streaming principal component analysis (PCA) seeks to recover a leading spectral subspace in a single pass over a data stream. We give a new analysis of the ubiquitous Oja's algorithm [Oja82] for the most general, gap-free variant of this problem, where no eigengap assumptions are made on the underlying mean matrix, complemented by a nearly-matching lower bound. Prior works achieving near-optimal rates for streaming PCA either required gap assumptions [JJK+16, HNWW21], or were limited to rank-one updates [AZL17, Lia23]. Our proof only uses a second moment bound on the individual stochastic updates, bypassing the almost sure bounds needed by prior near-optimal analyses, and the analogous offline matrix Bernstein bound. We also extend our result to a Rayleigh quotient notion of approximate PCA, addressing an open question of [JJK+16]. As our main application, we give gap-free differentially private PCA guarantees for sub-Gaussian data, settling Conjecture 1.1 of [Bro26] up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文对最一般的无特征间隙（gap-free）流式 PCA 问题给出了 Oja 算法的新分析，并配以近似匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 流式 PCA 旨在单遍处理数据流以恢复主谱子空间。已有达到近优速率的工作或依赖特征间隙假设，或仅限秩一更新，无法覆盖最一般的无间隙变体，因此需要更通用的分析。
AI.method: 对 Oja 算法进行新分析，证明仅依赖单个随机更新的二阶矩界，避免使用以往近优分析所需的几乎必然（almost sure）界及对应的离线矩阵 Bernstein 界。并将结果推广到 Rayleigh 商定义的近似 PCA。
AI.result: 在无特征间隙假设下获得了（近似最优的）上界并给出近似匹配的下界；证明了二阶矩界足以支撑分析；扩展至 Rayleigh 商近似 PCA，回答了 [JJK+16] 的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 作为主要应用，为亚高斯数据给出了无间隙的差分隐私 PCA 保证，在忽略对数因子意义下解决了 [Bro26] 的猜想 1.1。

1641db74623bc949132d7355191c47338a7a9084.title: Notes on Fourier-Bessel wavelets
1641db74623bc949132d7355191c47338a7a9084.summary:
These notes develop the mathematical foundations and construction of a Fourier-Bessel wavelet family inspired by the disk harmonics of Shaqfa et al.[9]. We begin with the relevant properties of Bessel and modified Bessel functions and introduce the wavelet properties required for the construction. We then derive the Fourier-Bessel disk harmonics as solutions to the Helmholtz equation on the unit disk subject to a Neumann boundary condition.
  Building on this basis, we construct a wavelet family by applying a Gaussian spatial envelope and introducing a zero-mean correction for the zeroth angular order. We derive the corresponding normalisation constants for $L^2$-based applications and discuss $L^1$-based normalisation for frequency-domain peak consistency. Finally, we derive a closed-form Fourier-domain representation of the resulting wavelets.
  The main motivation is the approximately linear spacing, which converges to $π$ between consecutive radial eigenvalues. Rather than replacing the conventional dyadic organisation of wavelet families, this construction lays out the foundation to explore whether a more uniform radial frequency allocation can be useful for applications in which broad and balanced frequency coverage is desirable.

AI.tldr: 本文为圆盘谐波（disk harmonics）建立数学基础，构造了一类Fourier-Bessel小波族，并给出其归一化常数与频域闭式表示。
AI.motivation: 受Shaqfa等人提出的圆盘谐波启发，作者关注相邻径向特征值之间近似线性、且收敛于π的间距。其动机并非取代传统二进（dyadic）小波组织方式，而是探索更均匀的径向频率分配是否适用于需要宽而均衡频率覆盖的应用场景。
AI.method: 首先回顾Bessel与修正Bessel函数的相关性质，并引入构造所需的小波性质；随后将Fourier-Bessel圆盘谐波推导为单位圆盘上满足Neumann边界条件的Helmholtz方程解。在此基础上，通过施加高斯空间包络并对零阶角向分量引入零均值校正来构造小波族；推导适用于L²应用的归一化常数，并讨论面向频域峰值一致性的L¹归一化；最后推导所得小波的闭式频域表示。
AI.result: 成功建立了Fourier-Bessel圆盘谐波的数学基础，构造出相应小波族，得到了L²归一化常数、L¹归一化方案以及小波的闭式Fourier频域表示。
AI.conclusion: 该构造为探索更均匀的径向频率分配奠定了基础，可作为宽而均衡频率覆盖类应用的潜在工具，而非替代传统二进小波组织方式。

40a9eef1c05279e6c96f22d41c393f35d3aa1ac8.title: Towards Hierarchical GNNs for multi-grid power flow: generalization across operating scenarios
40a9eef1c05279e6c96f22d41c393f35d3aa1ac8.summary: Hierarchical latent communication improves the generalization of a multi-grid power-flow model to new operating scenarios. The module exchanges information through two reduced graphs within a GENCO-based corrective network. We compare Kron-derived transports, a same-anchor Quotient construction and a flat backbone in preliminary trainings of 200 epochs on three grid topologies, with three initialization seeds per model. Evaluation uses 200 newly generated, preselected scenarios per grid. On the training topologies, Kron reduces the macro family-balanced voltage error from 5.660 +- 0.899 to 0.851 +- 0.110: an 85.0% reduction relative to Flat GENCO and 31.0% relative to Quotient, which reaches 1.235 +- 0.225. Both hierarchical models outperform a per-bus mean fitted on training solutions on every training topology in all three seeds. These results demonstrate generalization across operating scenarios within the studied topologies, with one set of learned parameters shared across grids. Evaluation on two additional topologies distinguishes this achievement from cross-topology generalization: the current models do not yet outperform the fitted reference in that calibrated- transfer setting. This preprint presents the architecture and preliminary evidence for hierarchical communication as a component of multi-grid power-flow learning, with generalization to unseen topologies as the next development objective.

AI.tldr: 该预印本提出一种基于GENCO校正网络的分层隐式通信模块，通过两个约简图交换信息，以提升多电网潮流模型对新运行场景的泛化能力。在三个电网拓扑、每模型三个初始化种子上进行200轮初步训练，Kron导出的传输方案将宏家族平衡电压误差从5.660±0.899降至0.851±0.110，显著优于Flat GENCO和Quotient；但模型尚未在额外两个拓扑上超越拟合参考，跨拓扑泛化仍是下一步目标。
AI.motivation: 多电网潮流学习需要模型在不同运行场景下保持泛化能力，并共享一套学习参数。作者关注分层隐式通信是否能改善这种场景级泛化，同时区分“运行场景泛化”与“跨拓扑泛化”。
AI.method: 在GENCO-based corrective network中引入分层通信模块，通过两个约简图交换信息。比较三类结构：Kron-derived transports、same-anchor Quotient construction和flat backbone。在三个电网拓扑上进行200轮初步训练，每个模型使用三个初始化种子；每个电网用200个新生成且预筛选的运行场景评估。
AI.result: 在训练拓扑上，Kron将宏家族平衡电压误差从5.660±0.899降至0.851±0.110，相对Flat GENCO降低85.0%，相对Quotient（1.235±0.225）降低31.0%。两个分层模型在所有训练拓扑和三个种子上均优于基于训练解拟合的per-bus均值。但在两个额外拓扑的校准迁移设置中，当前模型尚未超过拟合参考。
AI.conclusion: 结果初步证明：在所研究拓扑内，分层通信可提升模型对新运行场景的泛化能力，并实现跨电网共享一套参数；但尚不能说明跨拓扑泛化。该预印本给出架构与初步证据，将泛化到未见拓扑作为下一步开发目标。

44d08718a9746d5334bb1f55d0d0c3e79f44ec7a.title: Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference
44d08718a9746d5334bb1f55d0d0c3e79f44ec7a.comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
44d08718a9746d5334bb1f55d0d0c3e79f44ec7a.summary: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match all five predictions. The best-performing low-overhead intervention we evaluate, selective FP32 LM head recomputation, triggered only when the margin falls below a threshold, delivers +22-36 pp exact agreement on A10G (+12-21 pp on L4 and A100) at less than 4\% latency overhead in low-batch (batch size <=4) single-stream inference. We map the applicability boundary across six models and four batch sizes, and hypothesise that training-time precision stability is a determining factor. The method is a partial mitigation rather than a universal determinism guarantee: its benefit vanishes when body-originated error dominates, including at batch size >=8 and under end-to-end FP8 in our tests.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型的贪心解码通常被视为确定性过程，但本文证明它并非精度不变：在相同硬件上，同一模型、提示和解码算法在 BF16 与 FP16 下会产生不同输出。作者提出经验误差传播分析，发现翻转与否主要由 LM 头处 top-two logit 边际与候选间方向性扰动之比决定，而非 22 层累积体误差。基于此设计低成本干预（选择性 FP32 LM 头重算），在低批单流推理下显著提升一致性，并界定了适用边界。
AI.motivation: 贪心解码被普遍认为具有确定性，但作者指出这一假设忽略了数值精度的影响：同一模型与输入在不同精度（BF16 vs FP16）下会产生不同输出。动机在于揭示并刻画这种精度非不变性（precision-invariance 缺失），进而分析其误差传播机理，并寻找低开销的缓解手段。
AI.method: 1) 在 6 个模型（1.1B–7B，四大家族，另在 12B 上补充刻画）和 3 个基准上系统评测 BF16 与 FP16 的解码分歧。2) 提出经验误差传播分析，逐层考察体误差累积的影响，定位分歧决定性因素为 LM 头处 top-two logit 边际相对于候选间方向性扰动的比值。3) 基于分析提出 5 个关于干预结果的可检验预测。4) 设计并评估多种低开销干预，最优方案为选择性 FP32 LM 头重算（仅当边际低于阈值时触发）。5) 在 6 个模型、4 种批大小上映射适用边界。
AI.result: - 49–100% 的提示出现分歧，单个 token 翻转常级联为轨迹级分歧。 - 22 层累积体误差无法区分翻转与非翻转步骤；结果主要取决于 LM 头 top-two logit 边际与方向性扰动的相对关系。 - 实验验证了分析提出的全部 5 个预测，包括"扩大 FP32 计算范围反而降低一致性"。 - 最佳干预（选择性 FP32 LM 头重算）在 A10G 上带来 +22–36 pp 精确一致率（L4 与 A100 上 +12–21 pp），延迟开销低于 4%（低批、批大小 ≤4 的单流推理）。 - 作者假设训练时精度稳定性是决定适用边界的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明贪心解码并非精度不变，其输出分歧主要由 LM 头处的 logit 边际与扰动决定。所提出的选择性 FP32 LM 头重算是一种部分缓解而非通用确定性保证：当体来源误差占主导时（如批大小 ≥8 或端到端 FP8），其收益消失。

056553c54d450f2791764cc218ac98da7d660851.title: Label-Efficient Learning for Ground-Based Sky-Image Classification: A Benchmark of Transfer Learning, Active Learning, and Pseudo-Labeling on GCD
056553c54d450f2791764cc218ac98da7d660851.summary: Accurate ground-based cloud classification is important for atmospheric monitoring, solar-energy forecasting, aviation weather assessment, and climate observation systems. However, reliable sky-image annotation is time-consuming, especially when cloud types are visually similar or mixed. We study the label efficiency of deep learning for ground-based cloud classification using the Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD). Rather than proposing a new architecture, we benchmark three practical strategies under limited annotation budgets: supervised transfer learning, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling. An ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 is used as a common frozen backbone, with experiments repeated over five random seeds for label budgets from $1\%$ to $100\%$ of the training labels. Supervised transfer learning is already highly label-efficient: test accuracy increases from $0.635 \pm 0.018$ with $1\%$ labels to $0.730 \pm 0.002$ with $40\%$ labels, approaching the full-label result of $0.735 \pm 0.003$. Active learning and pseudo-labeling are competitive with supervised sampling and provide small improvements for some metrics and budgets, but neither gives a large or consistent aggregate gain. Diagnostic analyses show that accepted pseudo-labels are reliable, with accuracy from $0.946$ to $0.977$, but biased toward easier high-confidence sky-type groups. In contrast, uncertainty sampling preferentially queries visually challenging groups, including Mixed and the confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups, but these targeted acquisitions yield only modest gains. Overall, transfer learning substantially reduces annotation requirements for GCD, while simple active and semi-supervised strategies provide limited additional benefit over a strong supervised baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文在Ground-based Cloud Dataset(GCD)上研究地基云分类的标签效率，对比监督迁移学习、不确定性主动学习与高置信伪标签三种策略，发现迁移学习已高度标签高效，主动/半监督方法仅带来有限且不稳定的额外收益。
AI.motivation: 地基云分类对大气监测、太阳能预报、航空气象评估和气候观测很重要，但天空图像标注耗时，尤其在云类型视觉相似或混合时，标注成本成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 不提出新架构，而是设定统一实验：以ImageNet预训练的ResNet50作为冻结骨干，对GCD数据集在1%至100%的训练标签预算下，用五个随机种子重复实验，基准比较监督迁移学习、基于不确定性的主动学习和高置信伪标签三种策略，并进行诊断分析。
AI.result: 监督迁移学习本身已非常标签高效：1%标签时测试准确率为0.635±0.018，40%标签时升至0.730±0.002，接近全标签的0.735±0.003。主动学习与伪标签在部分指标和预算下有小幅提升，但与监督采样相比无大且一致的总体增益。诊断显示，被接受的伪标签准确率高达0.946至0.977，但偏向较容易的高置信天空类型组；不确定性采样则优先查询视觉上困难的组，包括Mixed以及易混淆的Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus组，但针对性获取带来的收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 对于GCD，迁移学习能显著降低标注需求，而简单的主动与半监督策略在强监督基线上仅提供有限额外收益。

e427791f122e9990d93f57b435fcda6099ae53c3.title: MAGIC: Mixed-Granularity Agent Graphs via Incremental Construction with Dense-Reward Reinforcement Learning
e427791f122e9990d93f57b435fcda6099ae53c3.summary: Collaboration topology shapes both the performance and execution cost of LLM-based multi-agent systems. Because tasks differ in complexity and required capabilities, recent approaches generate task-specific collaboration graphs that specify agent participation and information flow. However, representative topology generators use either individual agents or predefined groups throughout an organization, overlooking differing collaboration needs across subtasks. Our key insight is to select granularity locally for each functional role, combining fine-grained control with reusable collaboration patterns within one organization. Learning such organizations requires exploring a combinatorial construction space with limited intermediate feedback from final-answer rewards. Therefore, we propose MAGIC, a dense-reward reinforcement learning framework for mixed-granularity graph generation. Specifically, MAGIC constructs a mixed-granularity agent graph by sequentially selecting a functional role, instantiating it as a single agent or reusable group, and connecting it to existing units. We directly optimize the construction policy using returns from trajectories sampled under the current policy and use potential-based reward shaping to provide intermediate feedback from probe-based utility and structural signals while preserving the cumulative task reward. MAGIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across eight benchmarks and demonstrates strong inference efficiency in our efficiency study.

AI.tldr: MAGIC 提出一种稠密奖励强化学习框架，通过为每个功能角色局部选择“单智能体或可复用群组”的粒度，并按序构建混合粒度协作图，从而在提升多智能体系统任务表现的同时保持推理效率。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的协作拓扑同时影响性能与执行成本。任务在复杂度和能力需求上存在差异，因此需要任务特定的协作图来规定智能体参与方式与信息流。然而，现有代表性拓扑生成方法通常在整个组织中统一使用个体智能体或预定义群组，忽视了不同子任务之间协作需求的差异。
AI.method: 论文提出 MAGIC，一种用于混合粒度图生成的稠密奖励强化学习框架。其核心思想是在每个功能角色处进行局部粒度选择，将细粒度控制与可复用协作模式结合。MAGIC 按顺序选择功能角色，将其实例化为单个智能体或可复用群组，并连接到已有单元，从而构建混合粒度智能体图。由于该组合构造空间巨大且最终答案奖励提供的中间反馈有限，MAGIC 直接利用当前策略采样轨迹的回报优化构造策略，并采用基于势能的奖励塑形，引入基于探针的效用与结构信号作为中间反馈，同时保持累积任务奖励不变。
AI.result: MAGIC 在八个基准上优于当前最先进基线，并在效率研究中展现出较强的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过在每个功能角色上局部选择协作粒度，MAGIC 将细粒度控制与可复用协作模式统一于同一组织之中，验证了混合粒度图生成在 LLM 多智能体协作中的有效性，并兼顾性能与推理效率。

52fa1607a1b69683773cc712cdb8b34517d7eb37.title: A Spectral Theory of Grokking: Weight Decay induces Feature Learning
52fa1607a1b69683773cc712cdb8b34517d7eb37.summary: In grokking an early fit to the training data separates from a much later improvement in generalization. During this delay, training can move from a fixed neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime to one in which task-relevant kernel eigendirections continue to evolve. We provide a quantitative theory for how this transition from lazy to rich learning can produce delayed generalization. For homogeneous networks trained with squared loss and $L_2$ weight decay, we show that a finite residual remains after memorization, with larger residual fractions in target components associated with smaller NTK eigenvalues. These residuals feed back into the dynamics of the NTK itself, and projecting the resulting dynamics onto task-relevant spectral directions yields a reduced system in which residual-driven kernel growth competes with weight decay. This system predicts that the grokking timescale is controlled by the product of learning rate and weight decay, that feature learning slows logarithmically near a critical decay above which task-aligned NTK structure can no longer support generalization, and that stronger decay can prevent fitting altogether. We test these predictions in modular addition. In a homogeneous MLP, task-aligned Fourier structure continues to emerge in the NTK after training accuracy has saturated, and an 84$\times$90-grid of trained networks across varying learning rate and weight decay recovers the predicted phase geometry and inverse-product scaling of the generalization time with learning rate and weight decay. A one-block Transformer shows similar macroscopic phase structure in a 42$\times$45-grid, as well as the same transition-time scaling despite violating exact homogeneity. Together, these results provide a mechanistic derivation connecting post-fit feature learning to both the onset of generalization and its phase structure in the learning rate and weight decay plane.

AI.tldr: 该论文为"grokking"（延迟泛化）现象提供了定量理论：证明在带 $L_2$ 权重衰减的齐次网络与平方损失下，记忆后仍存在有限残差，残差驱动 NTK 演化并与权重衰减竞争，从而给出泛化时间由学习率与权重衰减之积控制的理论预测，并在模加任务中验证。
AI.motivation: Grokking 中"早拟合、晚泛化"之间存在明显延迟。该延迟期间训练从固定的神经正切核（NTK）"懒惰"机制过渡到任务相关核特征方向持续演化的"丰富"学习机制。作者希望给出从懒惰到丰富学习的转变如何导致延迟泛化的定量理论。
AI.method: 针对使用平方损失和 $L_2$ 权重衰减训练的齐次网络，作者证明记忆后仍保留有限残差，且与较小 NTK 特征值相关的目标分量残差占比更大。这些残差反馈到 NTK 自身动力学中；将动力学投影到任务相关谱方向，得到一个约化系统，其中残差驱动的核增长与权重衰减相互竞争。
AI.result: 约化系统预测：grokking 时间尺度由学习率与权重衰减之积控制；在超过某临界衰减后特征学习对数级减慢，此时任务对齐的 NTK 结构无法再支持泛化；更强的衰减甚至可能阻止拟合。在模加任务中验证：齐次 MLP 在训练精度饱和后，任务对齐的傅里叶结构仍在 NTK 中持续涌现；覆盖学习率与权重衰减的 $84\times90$ 网格复现了预测的相图几何以及泛化时间对学习率与权重衰减的反比（乘积）缩放规律。单块 Transformer 在 $42\times45$ 网格中呈现相似的宏观相结构及相同的转变时间缩放，尽管违反严格齐次性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一个机制性推导，将"拟合后特征学习"与泛化的起始及学习率—权重衰减平面中的相结构联系起来，定量刻画了从懒惰到丰富学习的转变如何产生延迟泛化。

5b591db0c2c78a24be4d40363d87e55a79aee263.title: Train Where the Quantized Model Goes: On-Policy Distillation for Low-Bit Reasoning
5b591db0c2c78a24be4d40363d87e55a79aee263.summary: Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) restores much of the short-form question-answering performance lost to sub-3-bit quantization, yet leaves mathematical and code reasoning substantially impaired. Long generations often degenerate into repetitive loops, exhausting the decoding budget without completing a solution. We trace this gap to quantization-amplified exposure bias: QAD trains on fixed corpus prefixes, while quantization-induced deviations compound along the model's own autoregressive trajectories. To address this mismatch, we introduce an on-policy distillation (OPD) stage that places teacher supervision where the quantized model actually goes. Starting from a QAD checkpoint, the student generates through the quantized forward path used at deployment and receives feedback from a frozen full-precision teacher on its own prefixes, combining dense token-level guidance with task-verifier rewards. Across four models at 2.79 and 1.88 effective bits, OPD raises average BF16 performance retention from 35% to 70% on MATH-500 and from 66% to 91% on HumanEval while preserving short-form performance, with reasoning gains substantially exceeding those of continued teacher-forced QAD in matched-budget comparisons. By coupling QAD's stable low-bit initialization with OPD's on-policy reasoning recovery, our framework provides a comprehensive sub-3-bit solution that preserves broad capabilities while restoring long-form reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在子3比特量化场景下,在量化感知蒸馏(QAD)基础上引入在线策略蒸馏(OPD)阶段,让量化模型在自身自回归轨迹上接受全精度教师监督,从而在保持短问答性能的同时显著恢复数学与代码推理能力。
AI.motivation: 子3比特量化虽经量化感知蒸馏(QAD)能恢复大部分短问答性能,但数学与代码推理仍严重退化,长文本生成常陷入重复循环,耗尽解码预算。作者将这一差距归因于"量化放大的暴露偏差":QAD在固定的语料前缀上训练,而量化引入的偏差会沿模型自身的自回归轨迹累积。
AI.method: 提出在线策略蒸馏(OPD)阶段,将教师监督置于量化模型实际到达的状态上:从QAD检查点出发,学生在部署时所用的量化前向路径中进行生成,并基于自身前缀接受一个冻结的全精度教师的反馈,结合密集的token级指导与任务验证器奖励。
AI.result: 在四个模型、2.79与1.88有效比特设置下,OPD将平均BF16性能保留率从MATH-500的35%提升至70%,HumanEval从66%提升至91%,同时保持短问答性能;在同等预算对比中,其推理增益显著超过继续采用teacher-forcing的QAD。
AI.conclusion: 通过将QAD稳定的低比特初始化与OPD的在线策略推理恢复相结合,该框架提供了一个全面的子3比特方案,在保留广泛能力的同时恢复长文本推理能力。

d5c6c5fbf7c3285861f00dda084e7d32082032e0.title: The Sirens' Song: When Proximal Background Context Overshadows Distant Evidence
d5c6c5fbf7c3285861f00dda084e7d32082032e0.summary: Long-context LLMs focus on retrieving distant evidence from extensive context, yet existing work has largely focused on overcoming distance alone. In this work, we identify the Proximity Trap, insufficient attention to distant evidence often arises less from distance itself than from cumulative competition with abundant, task-irrelevant proximal background. To address the Proximity Trap, we introduce LYRA (Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment), a t-distributed directional matching mechanism that reshapes the context retrieval distribution, directing more attention mass toward task-relevant evidence, while preserving the relative positional information encoded. Extensive experiments on LongBench-v2, RULER, and LongBench demonstrate consistent improvements across context lengths and task categories. We further introduce ProxBench, a multi-level fine-grained benchmark for evaluating distant evidence utilization under increasing proximal background interference. Project page: https://xiaoyuyoung.github.io/LYRA/

AI.tldr: 论文指出长上下文模型检索远距离证据的真正瓶颈并非"距离"本身,而是与大量任务无关的近端背景的累积竞争(即"近邻陷阱"Proximity Trap);为此提出 LYRA——一种基于 t 分布的方向匹配机制,通过重塑上下文检索分布,把更多注意力质量导向任务相关证据,同时保留相对位置信息,并在多个长上下文基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 的核心能力在于从超长上下文中检索远距离证据,但既有研究大多只针对"距离"这一单一因素进行改进。作者重新审视该问题,识别出 Proximity Trap(近邻陷阱):模型对远距离证据关注不足,其成因更多来自与大量任务无关的近端背景之间的累积性竞争,而非距离本身。因此需要从注意力/检索分布层面而非单纯位置外推层面加以解决。
AI.method: 提出 LYRA(Long-context heavY-tailed Relevance Alignment):一种 t 分布(t-distributed)方向匹配机制,用于重塑上下文检索分布,将更多注意力质量分配给任务相关证据,并保持模型已编码的相对位置信息;同时构建 ProxBench,一个多层级细粒度基准,用于在近端背景干扰逐步增强的条件下评估远距离证据的利用能力。
AI.result: 在 LongBench-v2、RULER 与 LongBench 上的大量实验表明,LYRA 在不同上下文长度与不同任务类别上均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 作者将远距离证据利用的失效归因于近端无关背景的累积竞争(Proximity Trap),并证明通过对检索分布进行重尾相关性对齐(LYRA)可有效缓解该问题;ProxBench 则为衡量递进式近端干扰下的远距离证据利用提供了细粒度评测手段。

013c8fc1175f6169f16ba3493cd4ca43e93cc45c.title: EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations
013c8fc1175f6169f16ba3493cd4ca43e93cc45c.comment: EquivSVA is a 9-page paper by FNU Aditi introducing a formally verified dataset of 120 behavior families, 480 RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants across 12 categories, featuring 2 figures, 5 tables, and a case study evaluating Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
013c8fc1175f6169f16ba3493cd4ca43e93cc45c.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate SystemVerilog Assertions from natural-language specifica- tions and register-transfer-level designs. Existing datasets and benchmarks support important goals such as large- scale training, formal evaluation, specification-to-assertion generation, and mutation-based testing. A complemen- tary need is to study whether a generated assertion cap- tures externally observable behavior or depends on inci- dental details of one RTL implementation. We present EquivSVA, a formally verified dataset organized around behavior families. Each family contains four structurally distinct RTL implementations of the same externally ob- servable behavior, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence. EquivSVA contains 120 behavior families across 12 cat- egories, 480 reference RTL implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants. Every final family passes a fixed 17-job validation suite covering RTL equivalence, gold-property proofs, property reachability, mutant dis- tinguishability, and gold-property checks on mutants. We also provide fixed family-safe train, development, and test splits. As a small demonstration of the analyses en- abled by the dataset, we evaluate the publicly released, Apache-2.0-licensed Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct model on the held-out test split. Of 293 interface-only generated properties, 93 are formally sound, and the number of sound properties varies across equivalent implementations for 14 of 24 test families. These results illustrate how behavior-family organization can support controlled stud- ies of assertion-generation robustness without requiring changes in intended functionality. The dataset, generators, validation scripts, and case-study artifacts are publicly released at https://github.com/aditigupta96/EquivSVA.

AI.tldr: 提出并发布EquivSVA：一个按“行为族”组织、经形式化验证的SystemVerilog Assertion数据集，用于研究生成断言是否抓住外部可观测行为而非特定RTL实现细节。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集/基准支持大规模训练、形式化评估、从规约生成断言和变异测试等目标，但缺少对“断言是否依赖某一RTL实现的偶然细节”的受控研究。需要一种能区分外部可观测行为与实现偶然细节的基准。
AI.method: 以行为族为核心组织数据：每个族包含4个结构不同但外部可观测行为相同的RTL实现、共享的接口级gold properties、3个受控mutant及形式验证证据。数据集含120个行为族、12个类别、480个参考RTL实现、914个gold properties、360个mutant。每个最终族需通过固定17项验证套件，覆盖RTL等价性、gold property证明、性质可达性、mutant可区分性、mutant上的gold property检查，并提供固定且族安全的train/dev/test划分。
AI.result: 以公开的Apache-2.0许可Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct在留出测试集上做小规模演示：在293个仅接口生成的性质中，93个形式可靠；在24个测试族中有14个族，其可靠性质数量会随等价实现不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 行为族组织方式可在不改变预期功能的前提下，支持对断言生成鲁棒性的受控研究；数据集、生成器、验证脚本与案例研究工件已在GitHub公开。

8429f9f3ee1418c1e2df5e69d10506e5c3909f1a.title: Are Human-Aligned Models Models of Humans? A Turing-Test Gap in Preference Alignment
8429f9f3ee1418c1e2df5e69d10506e5c3909f1a.summary: Human-feedback alignment has made language models useful assistants and is commonly described as aligning them with humans. However, the responses people prefer from an AI need not be the responses they themselves would give. We distinguish alignment with human preferences from alignment with human behavior, and show that alignment with human preferences can make model behavior less human-like even when both preferences and responses come entirely from humans. We call this the Turing-test gap. We show that preference alignment preserves the human response distribution only under a restrictive condition, and find no consistent evidence that real human preferences satisfy it. Empirically, the loss of human-response likelihood increases with the strength of preference weighting, regardless of its direction, and the gap also appears under standard DPO. These results establish human-likeness as an explicit dimension of alignment rather than something assumed to follow from preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文区分“对齐人类偏好”与“对齐人类行为”，提出“图灵测试差距”（Turing-test gap）：即使偏好与响应都来自人类，偏好对齐也可能降低模型行为的人类相似度。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把基于人类反馈的对齐等同于“与人类对齐”，但人们希望AI给出的回答未必是自己会给出的回答；因此需要区分偏好对齐与行为对齐，并检验偏好对齐是否真的保持人类响应分布。
AI.method: 形式化区分“与人类偏好对齐”和“与人类行为对齐”；推导偏好对齐保持人类响应分布所需的限制性条件；检验真实人类偏好是否满足该条件；通过实验考察人类响应似然随偏好加权强度的变化，并测试标准DPO下的表现。
AI.result: 偏好对齐仅在限制性条件下才能保持人类响应分布，且没有一致证据表明真实人类偏好满足该条件；人类响应似然损失随偏好加权强度增加而增大，且与加权方向无关；标准DPO下同样出现该差距。
AI.conclusion: 人类相似性应被视为对齐的一个显式维度，而不能假定它会自然地从偏好对齐中获得。

fea7a89779306d5c9ac5c672dece8156168c0364.title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
fea7a89779306d5c9ac5c672dece8156168c0364.comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: https://vail-ucla.github.io/DreamStream/
fea7a89779306d5c9ac5c672dece8156168c0364.summary: Faithfully evaluating end-to-end driving policies in simulation requires observations that are not merely photo-realistic, but preserve the scene features a policy relies on to make decisions. Existing platforms, however, exhibit a sim-to-real visual gap that corrupts policy perception, undermining their ability to assess a policy's closed-loop decision-making. To this end, we propose DreamStream, a generative, closed-loop simulator that achieves policy-oriented fidelity using a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model. Our video model is distilled from a large pretrained video model via traffic layout guidance, varying visual appearance while preserving policy-relevant features such as scenario layout and the temporal consistency of dynamic objects. We further observe that perceptual metrics like FID misrank how well these features are preserved. To tackle this, we introduce FD$π$, a new multi-representation metric that measures the sim-to-real gap as the Fréchet distance over scene-context features from public E2E policies. Under FD$π$, DreamStream improves over the strongest prior closed-loop simulator by $1.6\times$ on nuScenes and $4.7\times$ on NAVSIM, and induces the least perturbation to policy's perceptual observability. Based on DreamStream, we construct Navhard-CL benchmark, which turns non-reactive real-world benchmark NAVSIM into interactive testing environments with adversarial driving behaviors and weather variations. This benchmark exposes many failure modes of driving policies, such as scorer bias and lack of recovery behaviors, that prior closed-loop benchmarks overlook. Code and data are available at https://github.com/VAIL-UCLA/DreamStream.

AI.tldr: DreamStream：面向策略保真度的生成式闭环驾驶模拟器，用交通布局引导的自回归视频模型蒸馏大规模预训练视频模型，并引入FD$π$度量来评估仿真实真差距，进而构建Navhard-CL交互式基准。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略的闭环评估要求仿真观测不仅照片级真实，还要保留策略决策所依赖的场景特征。现有仿真平台存在仿真到真实的视觉差距，会破坏策略感知，从而无法可靠评估闭环决策能力。此外，FID等感知度量无法正确排序策略相关特征的保留程度。
AI.method: 提出DreamStream生成式闭环模拟器，基于"模拟器接地"的自回归视频模型实现面向策略的保真度；通过交通布局引导，从大规模预训练视频模型蒸馏，在改变视觉外观的同时保留场景布局与动态物体时序一致性等策略相关特征。提出FD$π$多表征度量，以公开E2E策略的场景上下文特征上的Fréchet距离衡量仿真到真实差距。基于DreamStream构建Navhard-CL基准，将非反应式真实基准NAVSIM转为含对抗驾驶行为与天气变化的交互测试环境。
AI.result: 在FD$π$度量下，DreamStream相较最强先前闭环模拟器在nuScenes提升1.6倍、在NAVSIM提升4.7倍，并对策略感知可观测性造成最小扰动。Navhard-CL暴露出先前闭环基准忽略的多种策略失效模式，如评分器偏差与缺乏恢复行为。
AI.conclusion: DreamStream通过策略导向的生成式闭环仿真，缩小了仿真到真实的视觉与感知差距，并提供更有效的闭环评估基准，代码与数据已开源。

7201c9fd6377e43571fcd639e8b8abcca351bfa3.title: A Hybrid AI Framework for Academic Advising: Integrating Ensemble-Based Grade Prediction and a Rule-Based Expert System
7201c9fd6377e43571fcd639e8b8abcca351bfa3.summary: The rapidly increasing student population has posed serious challenges to the traditional academic advising process. This study designs and implements a multi-purpose intelligent system to support students' academic progress, based on a two-part hybrid framework: (1) an advanced model for grade prediction and (2) a rule-based recommendation engine. Using a dataset containing 416,558 educational records from the University of Birjand, students were first divided into homogeneous clusters using the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). Subsequently, a Stacking Ensemble model combining Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and MLP was trained specifically for each cluster. Evaluation results demonstrated that the Stacking model outperformed base models across all clusters, achieving a final aggregated RMSE of 2.35. The second component is an expert system that provides intelligent recommendations by synergizing educational regulations with the grades predicted by the first component. This system has been implemented as a practical tool on the University of Birjand portal, offering students real-time feedback such as semester GPA prediction, probation risk warnings, and course suggestions for GPA improvement.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于GMM聚类与Stacking集成学习的学业成绩预测模型，并结合规则推荐专家系统，形成多用途智能学业指导系统，已部署于Birjand大学门户提供实时反馈。
AI.motivation: 学生人数快速增长给传统学业指导流程带来严峻挑战，亟需智能化系统辅助学生进行学业规划与进展跟踪。
AI.method: 采用两部分混合框架：(1) 成绩预测模型：基于Birjand大学416,558条教育记录，先用高斯混合模型(GMM)将学生划分为同质簇，再针对每个簇分别训练由随机森林、梯度提升与MLP组成的Stacking集成模型；(2) 基于规则的推荐引擎，将教育规章制度与第一部分预测成绩相结合以生成智能建议。
AI.result: Stacking模型在所有簇上均优于各基模型，最终聚合RMSE为2.35；系统已作为实用工具部署于Birjand大学门户，可提供学期GPA预测、学业预警（试读风险）及提升GPA的选课建议等实时反馈。
AI.conclusion: 该多用途智能系统验证了"GMM聚类+Stacking集成预测+规则推荐"混合框架在学业指导中的可行性与实用性，能有效支持学生学业进展。

83570241f2826a392101417b9762c906a4d45ee2.title: PP-Net: A Hybrid Physical-Prior Neural Network for Scattered Light Removal in Biomedical Images on Embedded Devices
