AI.method: 形式化"语言引导的群体加入"任务：输入为观测与目标群体的自然语言描述，输出为相关群体成员识别结果与社会可接受的加入位姿。定位阶段通过递归谱划分（recursive spectral partitioning）生成结构化候选子集，并用语言条件的图像-几何模型对其排序；在定位到目标群体后，目标预测器利用人类队形先验，在可行机器人位姿上生成多模态的能量-朝向图（energy-orientation map）以预测加入位置与朝向。
AI.result: 在交谈、排队、观众等场景中，跨不同群体规模、人群密度与视觉歧义条件下，方法取得具有竞争力的定位精度，推理时间在亚秒级，并在加入位姿预测上优于所有基线；真实机器人实验进一步验证了静态与动态变化交互中的群体加入能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将语言引导的群体加入作为独立任务提出并给出完整求解框架，兼顾语义定位与位姿预测，且满足实时性与真实场景可用性，为社交机器人融入人类群体提供了可行方案。

b8fe8eff33532188b4e94e15940b57ca102be957.title: Learning from Failures: Heterogeneous Graph Memory for Small Language Model Tool-Using Agents
b8fe8eff33532188b4e94e15940b57ca102be957.summary: Small and medium-sized language models offer cost-effective executors for tool-using agents, making them attractive for local and large-scale deployment. However, in long-horizon and stateful environments, they often make structural errors such as missing required observations, performing premature writes, repeating failed calls, and violating action preconditions. These errors can lead to incorrect state updates, policy violations, and costly or irreversible consequences, making reliable tool execution a critical deployment challenge. Existing fine-tuning approaches require substantial data and computation, while flat memory may retrieve failed actions without preserving their causal context or safety conditions. In this paper, we propose FRESH, a Failure-aware Retrieval framework over Experience-Structured Heterogeneous graphs, which transforms historical successes and failures into structured external experience for tool-using agents. By explicitly modeling the dependencies among tasks, actions, errors, repairs, and execution conditions, FRESH helps frozen language models reuse reliable strategies, avoid recurring failures, and make safer decisions in stateful tool interactions. Experiments on $τ$-Bench and AppWorld with multiple open-source models show that FRESH consistently improves task success and tool-use reliability over no-memory agents and representative memory-based baselines.

AI.tldr: FRESH：基于经验结构化异质图的失败感知检索框架，将历史成功与失败转化为结构化外部经验，帮助冻结的中小模型在长程有状态工具使用环境中复用可靠策略、规避重复失败并做出更安全决策。
AI.motivation: 中小规模语言模型作为工具智能体执行器具有成本优势，适合本地与大规模部署。但在长程、有状态环境中，它们常出现结构性错误，如遗漏必要观察、过早写入、重复失败调用、违反动作前置条件等，导致状态更新错误、策略违规及高成本或不可逆后果，可靠工具执行成为关键部署挑战。现有微调方法需大量数据与算力，而扁平记忆会检索失败动作却不保留其因果上下文或安全条件。
AI.method: 提出FRESH——一种基于经验结构化异质图（Experience-Structured Heterogeneous graphs）的失败感知检索（Failure-aware Retrieval）框架。它把历史成功与失败转化为结构化的外部经验，显式建模任务、动作、错误、修复与执行条件之间的依赖关系，从而帮助冻结的语言模型复用可靠策略、避免重复失败，并在有状态工具交互中做出更安全的决策。
AI.result: 在 τ-Bench 和 AppWorld 上，使用多个开源模型进行实验，FRESH 相比无记忆智能体及代表性基于记忆的基线，一致地提升了任务成功率与工具使用可靠性。
AI.conclusion: FRESH 通过结构化建模历史成功与失败经验的依赖关系，为中小规模工具智能体提供了免微调、可复用的外部经验机制，有效提升长程有状态环境下的任务成功率与工具使用可靠性，是缓解结构性错误与安全风险的有效方案。

94294209b98a25eac55cf4fe9f7815012326568c.title: RL Starts before RL: On Policy Distillation for Better Reinforcement Learning
94294209b98a25eac55cf4fe9f7815012326568c.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning, but its performance depends on the policy from which training begins. We study on-policy distillation (OPD) as a preparation stage for RL and ask whether its benefits extend beyond improvements in the distilled model's initial accuracy. Under shared RL settings, students initialized with OPD reach higher final performance than those trained with direct RL or supervised fine-tuning followed by RL. This advantage can emerge even when OPD produces little immediate improvement in accuracy. Pre-RL Pass@k does not fully explain the benefit: similar or even higher values do not necessarily lead to better performance after RL. Behavioral analyses point to alignment with the teacher's distribution beyond top-1 agreement as a possible explanation. Such alignment may favor higher-quality reasoning paths while retaining alternatives that RL can further refine using outcome feedback. We further examine how trajectory sources and divergence objectives affect the value of distillation for subsequent RL. Standard reverse-KL OPD performs better before RL, but forward-KL OPD overtakes it afterward; with teacher-generated distillation trajectories, reverse KL remains ahead at both stages. These findings suggest that the preferred distillation objective depends on both the trajectory source and the training that follows. Our results support evaluating OPD as preparation for RL and selecting distillation choices by the performance achieved after subsequent training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"在策略蒸馏（OPD）作为强化学习（RL）前置准备阶段"的价值：OPD初始化的学生在共享RL设置下最终性能优于直接RL或SFT+RL，且该优势不能仅由蒸馏模型的初始准确率或Pre-RL Pass@k解释，而可能源于对教师分布的对齐；同时指出最优蒸馏目标（reverse-KL vs forward-KL）取决于轨迹来源和后续训练。
AI.motivation: RL能提升推理能力，但其表现依赖于训练起始的策略。作者希望探究：将在策略蒸馏（OPD）用作RL的准备阶段时，其收益是否仅限于提升蒸馏模型的初始准确率，还是能带来超越起始精度的长期收益。核心动机是重新定位OPD的价值——不应只看蒸馏当下的准确率，而应看其作为RL准备阶段的后续表现。
AI.method: 在共享的RL设置下进行受控对比：以OPD初始化的学生，与直接RL训练、以及监督微调（SFT）后再RL的学生进行比较。通过Pre-RL Pass@k指标分析初始能力，并进行行为分析考察学生与教师分布的对齐程度（超越top-1一致性）。进一步考察不同轨迹来源（学生自生成 vs 教师生成）与不同散度目标（reverse-KL、forward-KL）对蒸馏之于后续RL价值的影响。
AI.result: OPD初始化的学生在共享RL后达到更高的最终性能，优于直接RL和SFT+RL，且这一优势即使在OPD带来的初始准确率提升很小时也能出现。Pre-RL Pass@k不能充分解释该收益：相近甚至更高的Pass@k并不必然带来更好的RL后性能。行为分析表明，超越top-1一致性的教师分布对齐可能是解释因素，这种对齐可能倾向于保留高质量推理路径，同时保留RL可借助结果反馈进一步优化的备选路径。在散度目标上：标准reverse-KL OPD在RL前表现更好，但forward-KL OPD在RL后反超；当使用教师生成的蒸馏轨迹时，reverse-KL在两个阶段均保持领先。
AI.conclusion: OPD的收益超越初始准确率的即时提升，应将其作为RL的准备阶段来评估，并依据"后续训练后所达到的性能"来选择蒸馏方案。首选蒸馏目标取决于轨迹来源与后续训练，说明蒸馏设计需结合下游训练目标进行联合考量。

a8290289ae1f0ca8988d332522690ea1bd36cb8f.title: TimeEvo: Failure-Driven Self-Evolution of a Time Series Agent
a8290289ae1f0ca8988d332522690ea1bd36cb8f.summary: Time series agents answer analytical questions by calling external tools, and which tools they carry is decided by people before the agent runs. However, we identify two failures in this setup. Human-Agent Tool Misalignment: a library of 21 expert-curated tools helps on some tasks and hurts on others, dropping anomaly accuracy under every backbone we test. Silent Harm: one round of generic self-revision changes 147 answers and breaks 56 of them, while the final score moves by less than a point. Both follow from the same gap: whether a tool helps is decided question by question at runtime, while tools are supplied in advance and judged by a single average. To address this, we propose TimeEvo, which clusters an agent's diagnosed failures into capability gaps, plans a measurement for each, synthesizes evidence-only tools that fill them, and admits the candidate library only through a paired admission gate. Experiments on ten time series QA tasks and three backbones show that TimeEvo, starting from an empty library, improves accuracy on every task and every backbone, and that a library grown on a cheap model still gains when it is installed into stronger ones. Code is available at https://github.com/Muyiiiii/TimeEvo.

AI.tldr: TimeEvo指出时序智能体预置工具导致"人机工具错配"与"静默伤害"两大问题，根因是工具的有用性需逐题运行时判定却被提前供给并按平均分评估；它通过失败诊断聚类能力缺口、按需合成证据型工具并以配对准入闸门筛选，从零构建工具库，在10个任务与3个骨干上全面提分，且弱模型培养的工具库可迁移至强模型。
AI.motivation: 现有时序智能体依赖人工在运行前预先设定工具集，但作者发现两类失效：(1) 人机工具错配（Human-Agent Tool Misalignment）：21个专家精心挑选的工具在部分任务上有帮助、在另一些任务上反而有害，导致所有被测骨干模型的异常检测准确率下降；(2) 静默伤害（Silent Harm）：一次通用自我修订改动了147个答案并破坏其中56个，而最终总分变动不足1分。二者的共同根源在于：工具是否有帮助是运行时逐题决定的，而工具却提前供给、并以单一平均值来评判。
AI.method: TimeEvo包含四个环节：(1) 对智能体运行中的失败案例进行诊断；(2) 将诊断结果聚类为若干"能力缺口"（capability gaps）；(3) 为每个缺口规划一项度量（measurement），并据此合成仅含证据（evidence-only）的工具以填补该缺口；(4) 通过配对准入闸门（paired admission gate）决定候选工具是否进入工具库。
AI.result: 在10个时序问答任务和3种骨干模型上，TimeEvo从空工具库出发，在每一个任务、每一个骨干上都提升了准确率；此外，在廉价模型上成长起来的工具库，安装到更强模型后依然能带来增益。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出TimeEvo框架，通过失败诊断、能力缺口聚类、按需合成工具与配对准入机制，实现工具库从零自演化，并在所有任务与骨干上取得稳定增益，且弱模型上成长的工具库可迁移至强模型。

b6d07f618c32c5a6cc8503891dca7181b443bd04.title: MolDesignBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agent for Scenario-grounded Molecular Design
b6d07f618c32c5a6cc8503891dca7181b443bd04.summary: Real-world molecular design remains challenging for large language model (LLM)-based agents. It requires them to interpret design contexts, satisfy multiple constraints, identify infeasible specifications, and reason over multi-step tool outputs. Existing benchmarks do not capture this complexity, focusing instead on explicit and narrow constraints, only feasible problems, and single-path solutions. To address this gap, we propose MolDesignBench, a scenario-grounded benchmark that more closely reflects real-world molecular design for evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents. MolDesignBench comprises 2K generation and optimization instances that combine implicit requirements embedded in design narratives with explicit property and functional-group constraints, including infeasible cases, and require the effective use of 17 specialized chemistry tools. Experiments across diverse frontier LLMs reveal low success rates--with the best achieving only $\sim43$\%--and frequent failures in implicit-constraint reasoning, infeasibility detection, and tool reasoning. The corresponding fine-grained failure-mode analysis identifies implicit constraint interpretation and infeasibility detection as the primary bottlenecks, establishing MolDesignBench as a rigorous testbed to guide future research on chemical agents. The benchmark, tool interface, and evaluation code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 MolDesignBench，一个面向工具增强 LLM 智能体的真实场景分子设计基准，包含 2K 生成与优化实例，融合隐式需求、显式性质/官能团约束、不可行案例与 17 种化学工具；实验显示当前前沿 LLM 成功率低（最佳约 43%），主要瓶颈在隐式约束理解与不可行性检测。
AI.motivation: 真实分子设计需要智能体理解设计语境、满足多重约束、识别不可行规格并推理多步工具输出；现有基准仅关注显式狭窄约束、仅含可行问题、单路径方案，难以刻画真实复杂度。
AI.method: 构建 MolDesignBench：以场景化叙事嵌入隐式要求，并结合显式性质与官能团约束；纳入不可行实例；要求有效使用 17 种专业化学工具；包含 2K 生成与优化实例，提供工具接口与评测代码。
AI.result: 在多种前沿 LLM 上评测，成功率普遍偏低，最佳仅约 43%；常见失败集中在隐式约束推理、不可行性检测与工具推理。细粒度失败模式分析表明，隐式约束解释和不可行性检测是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: MolDesignBench 是更贴近真实分子设计的严格测试平台，可指导化学智能体未来研究；基准、工具接口与评测代码已公开。

142158f9201dd98f9258f8f9deaf3e217557a442.title: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents
142158f9201dd98f9258f8f9deaf3e217557a442.summary: AI research agents need reliable knowledge of how their experiments change outcomes. We introduce WhatWorkedBench to measure experimental understanding, the accuracy of predictions about component changes after budgeted experimentation. Agents inspect code, select measurements, and submit a response surface, a table predicting scores for every configuration of component settings. Exhaustive CPU execution supplies reference effects for changing each component while holding the others fixed. These effects capture combinations of changes across 36 tasks from 30 data sources and 8 workflow types, with 1248 configuration records. Core evaluation combines 4,206 numerical-control records across all eight families and 108 agent episodes across the original six. At eight new measurements, pair-effect ridge selects an optimum on 15 of 22 sources and limits every effect error to 10% of score range on three. Fitting a Gaussian process (GP) to the same agent observations raises effect recovery, accuracy relative to true effect magnitude, from 0.632 to 0.698 in the original Flash cohort and from 0.621 to 0.720 in an additional cohort. On six completed beat-detection and graph submissions, the same-observation GP raises family-macro recovery from 0.303 to 0.455. On six workflows with six binary options at 20 new measurements, encoding code equivalences, configurations with identical behavior, raises GP recovery from 0.248 to 0.462. WhatWorkedBench supports research on experimental agents, adaptive experimental design, numerical inference, and use of program structure.

AI.tldr: WhatWorkedBench 是一个衡量 AI 研究智能体“实验理解”能力的基准：智能体在预算受限的实验后，需预测组件变更对结果的影响，并提交覆盖所有配置的响应面。核心指标通过穷举 CPU 执行获得参考效应，并显示高斯过程（GP）拟合能显著提升效应恢复率。
AI.motivation: AI 研究智能体需要可靠地理解其实验如何改变结果，但现有评测缺乏对“预算化实验后预测组件变更影响”这一能力的系统衡量。论文提出 WhatWorkedBench，以量化智能体的实验理解能力，并推动实验智能体、自适应实验设计、数值推断与程序结构利用等研究。
AI.method: 该基准要求智能体检查代码、选择测量点，并提交一个响应面（response surface），即预测所有组件设置组合得分的表格；通过穷举 CPU 执行提供“固定其他组件时改变某一组件”的参考效应。数据集覆盖 36 个任务、30 个数据源、8 类工作流，共 1248 条配置记录。核心评测整合了 8 个家族的 4206 条数值控制记录，以及原始 6 个家族的 108 个智能体回合。方法上对比了 pair-effect ridge 与高斯过程（GP）拟合，并考察编码代码等价性（行为相同配置）对 GP 的影响。
AI.result: 在 8 个新测量点下，pair-effect ridge 在 22 个数据源中的 15 个上选出最优配置，并在 3 个数据源上将每个效应误差限制在分数范围的 10% 以内。对同样的智能体观测拟合 GP 后，效应恢复率（相对于真实效应量级的准确度）从原始 Flash 队列的 0.632 提升到 0.698，在额外队列中从 0.621 提升到 0.720。在 6 个已完成的 beat-detection 与 graph 提交上，同一观测 GP 将 family-macro 恢复率从 0.303 提升到 0.455。在 6 个含 6 个二元选项、20 个新测量点的工作流中，编码代码等价性使 GP 恢复率从 0.248 提升到 0.462。
AI.conclusion: WhatWorkedBench 为研究实验智能体提供了可复用的评测框架，尤其支持自适应实验设计、数值推断以及利用程序结构提升实验理解的研究。结果表明，基于同一批观测的 GP 建模与代码等价性编码能显著改善效应恢复与配置选择。

268acd64947910054beda8258cfa52671bb80b03.title: TW3Cast: A Frozen Router of Lightly Fine-Tuned Foundation Models for Time-Series Forecasting on GIFT-Eval, Selected Entirely on the Training Split
268acd64947910054beda8258cfa52671bb80b03.summary: TW3Cast is a time-series forecasting system that reaches position 3 of 130 entries on the GIFT-Eval benchmark by mean MASE rank, as of 2026-09-14. The two entries above it belong to the leaderboard's agentic category, multi-step systems that use agents or language models to reason about, generate or select forecasts. TW3Cast runs no agent and no language model. Its selection is a table computed once on the training split and then frozen, and its experts are public foundation models lightly fine-tuned on those training splits. For each of the 97 dataset, frequency and horizon configurations, the table serves one of four modes: a specialist, which is a LoRA or full fine-tune of Chronos-2, TiRex or Toto whose training data was cleaned and enriched by explicit rules; a quantile blend that contains a specialist; a blend of base models; or a selection tournament played on a backtest carved from the training split. Every decision in the table was taken on that backtest. A specialist is admitted the moment it beats the tournament there, so a candidate costs a few megabytes and minutes of GPU time, and a failed candidate changes nothing. Three guarded mechanisms protect the selection from its own biases: a dual accuracy and calibration criterion, an asymmetric margin against candidates that saw the series during training, and conservative per-window gates. The selection rules themselves were chosen inside a temporal meta-backtest. The best base model served alone reaches a mean MASE rank of 33.8, the tournament served on every configuration reaches 38.0, and the full router reaches 19.4. The routing table, the expert index, the pinned base-model revisions, the submitted score file and the dated snapshot of the public scores are released, and every leaderboard number in this paper regenerates from them by one script.

AI.tldr: TW3Cast 是一个不含智能体、不调用语言模型的时间序列预测系统，在 GIFT-Eval 上以平均 MASE 排名第 3（130 个条目，截至 2026-09-14）。其核心是一次性在训练集上计算并冻结的路由表：对 97 个数据集/频率/预测步长配置，分别选择专家、分位数混合、基模型混合或回测锦标赛。专家为轻量微调的公开基础模型 Chronos-2、TiRex、Toto。全路由平均 MASE 排名 19.4，显著优于最佳基模型单独使用（33.8）和全配置锦标赛（38.0）。
AI.motivation: 现有强排行榜方法多依赖智能体或语言模型进行推理、生成或选择预测，成本高且复杂。本文希望验证：无需智能体与语言模型，仅靠一次性冻结的路由表、轻量微调的公开基础模型和严格的选择机制，是否也能在 GIFT-Eval 等基准上取得高排名，并提供可复现、低成本的预测方案。
AI.method: 系统对 97 个 dataset-frequency-horizon 配置维护一张训练集上计算后冻结的选择表，每个配置可选四种模式：1）专家：Chronos-2、TiRex 或 Toto 的 LoRA 或全量微调，训练数据经显式规则清洗与增强；2）包含专家的分位数混合；3）基模型混合；4）在训练集切出的 backtest 上进行选择锦标赛。所有决策均在 backtest 上完成。专家一旦在 backtest 上击败锦标赛即被接纳，候选成本仅为数 MB 与数分钟 GPU，失败不影响现有选择。采用三重防护机制控制选择偏差：精度与校准双重准则、针对训练中见过该序列的候选的非对称边际、保守的逐窗口门控。选择规则本身通过时间元回测确定。
AI.result: 在 GIFT-Eval 上，最佳基模型单独使用平均 MASE 排名为 33.8；锦标赛在所有配置上使用为 38.0；完整路由器达到 19.4。TW3Cast 以平均 MASE 排名位列 130 个条目第 3，仅次于排行榜 agentic 类别中的两个多步系统。系统不运行智能体或语言模型，选择表冻结，专家为轻量微调的公开基础模型。
AI.conclusion: TW3Cast 表明，通过冻结路由表、轻量专家微调、backtest 驱动的准入与多重偏差防护，可在不依赖智能体或语言模型的情况下取得强竞争力。作者释放路由表、专家索引、固定基模型版本、提交分数文件及公开分数日期快照，并提供一个脚本复现论文中的全部排行榜数字，强调可复现性与低成本候选评估。

b41735acc1de6071d3ac8f23755211fc1f066cb8.title: PAWS: Policy-driven Agentic World Simulation
b41735acc1de6071d3ac8f23755211fc1f066cb8.summary: Policy interventions propagate through public communication, institutional decisions, and stakeholder responses, yet datasets for financial multi-agent simulation rarely connect these processes to temporally aligned historical evidence. We introduce PAWS, a Policy-driven Agentic World Simulation dataset covering 36 verified U.S. financial and economic policy episodes, 12,727 policy-linked news records, and 65,291 source-grounded stakeholder actions. Each action is linked to its supporting news and represented by a multi-layer event frame capturing its interaction mode, financial-action family and subtype, semantic attributes, and conditional mappings to external taxonomies. Entities are resolved to normalized organizations, and actions are aligned with daily market-return context to support policy-agent simulation replay. On 2,522 stratified action samples, independent AI and human reviewers achieved 89.4% initial agreement on interaction mode, with disagreements subsequently adjudicated. Case studies of the 2008 short-selling ban and 2001 decimalization recover documented policy timelines and associated market patterns across both dense and sparse news settings. A replay study further shows that high accuracy can mask failure to detect rare stakeholder actions, identifying action timing and calibration as central challenges. PAWS provides an auditable substrate for evaluating agent influence, policy-response cascades, and action-outcome alignment in historically grounded financial simulations.

AI.tldr: PAWS 是一个政策驱动的智能体世界仿真数据集，整合 36 个美国金融政策事件、1.2 万余条新闻与 6.5 万余条利益相关者行动，并与市场收益对齐以支持历史锚定的多智能体仿真回放。
AI.motivation: 政策干预会通过公共传播、机构决策与利益相关者响应进行传导，但现有金融多智能体仿真数据集很少将这些过程与时间对齐的历史证据相连接，缺乏可用于仿真回放的历史锚定数据。
AI.method: 构建 PAWS 数据集：覆盖 36 个经核实的美国金融与经济政策事件、12,727 条政策相关新闻、65,291 条有来源支撑的利益相关者行动。每条行动关联其支撑新闻，并用多层事件框架表示（交互模式、金融行动族与子类型、语义属性、对外部分类体系的条件映射）；实体归一化为标准组织；行动与每日市场收益上下文对齐以支持回放。通过 2,522 条分层抽样，由独立 AI 与人类评审进行一致性验证。
AI.result: 在 2,522 条分层行动样本上，独立 AI 与人类评审在交互模式上初始一致率达 89.4%，分歧经裁定解决。对 2008 年卖空禁令与 2001 年十进制化的案例研究，在密集与稀疏新闻两种设定下均复原了有据可查的政策时间线与相关市场模式。回放研究表明，高准确率可能掩盖对稀有利益相关者行动的漏检。
AI.conclusion: PAWS 为历史锚定的金融多智能体仿真提供了可审计的数据基座，可用于评估智能体影响力、政策响应级联以及"行动—结果"对齐；同时指出行动时机识别与校准是后续研究的核心挑战。

987ed0ea636dee99a106f61694b72ef5d8febc0c.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
987ed0ea636dee99a106f61694b72ef5d8febc0c.summary: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable and preserves the reproducibility existing tooling guarantees. Agent reasoning is powered by a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM, executing locally so no sequencing data leaves the operating environment, under human-in-the-loop orchestration. Evaluation shows agent-generated configurations are concordant with expert practice, that an explicit filtering ledger renders inspectable what filtering otherwise removes without trace, and that cross-stage anomaly detection surfaces conditions execution monitoring misses. BaseCamp offers a generalizable blueprint for agentic automation of scientific data pipelines.

AI.tldr: BaseCamp 是一个面向 DNA 测序流程“决策层”的智能体 AI 框架，将流程分解为六个专用 AI 代理，用本地部署、领域微调的 LLM 联盟进行判断与协调，而实际比对、变异检测和注释仍由既有生物信息学工具执行。评估显示其配置与专家实践一致，过滤账本可追溯，跨阶段异常检测能发现常规执行监控遗漏的问题。
AI.motivation: DNA 测序流程的执行层（质控、比对、变异检测、注释）已可由工作流管理系统可靠编排，但围绕执行的决策层仍依赖人工：阈值选择、边界变异判读、异常诊断、专家复核判定等。这些决策重复、依赖经验、操作者间不一致且常缺乏记录，因此需要自动化该决策层。
AI.method: 提出 BaseCamp 智能体 AI 框架，将测序流程分解为六个专用 AI 代理：样本接收与质控、比对、变异检测、注释、跨阶段监测、报告。关键设计是代理不直接执行序列分析，而由成熟工具完成比对、检测与注释；代理负责工具选择、配置、输出解释与后续决策，从而将语言模型推理限制在更可靠的判断层，并保留既有工具的可重复性。推理由经微调的领域专用 LLM 联盟提供，由中央推理 LLM 协调，本地执行以确保测序数据不出运行环境，并采用 human-in-the-loop 编排。
AI.result: 评估表明：代理生成的配置与专家实践一致；显式过滤账本使原本无痕移除的过滤过程可检查；跨阶段异常检测可发现执行监控遗漏的情况。
AI.conclusion: BaseCamp 为科学数据流程的智能体自动化提供了可推广蓝图，其核心价值在于自动化测序流程的决策层，而非替代既有分析工具。

3f9d1314cf87394e2b67bc36f167725272abcdfd.title: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
3f9d1314cf87394e2b67bc36f167725272abcdfd.summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative
  advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a categorical policy's expected score-gradient norm vanishes as its distribution sharpens, so the predictions that most need correction receive the weakest updates. We propose Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization (DEEPO), a dual-stage enhancement combining signal
  variance regularization with gradient preconditioning: semantic-entropy-triggered expert prefixes inject grounded continuations on high-uncertainty queries, providing direct supervision and restoring advantage variance, while advantage-sign-aware Renyi preconditioning counteracts logit-level saturation so correction reaches confident errors in the operational confidence regime. Both branches improve over GRPO individually; their interaction is statistically significant on VideoMMMU---the most complex long-horizon task in our evaluation suite (+4.0$, 95\% CI [1.1, 6.9])---and additive elsewhere. DEEPO reduces hallucination while preserving accuracy and training stability.

AI.tldr: DEEPO 从 rollout 与优化两级修复 RL 修正链路：用语义熵触发的专家前缀恢复困难查询的优势方差，用优势符号感知的 Renyi 预处理穿透 logit 饱和，从而在保持准确率与稳定性的同时降低 MLLM 幻觉。
AI.motivation: 强化学习被广泛用于提升多模态大模型（MLLM）的推理能力，但其对幻觉的抑制效果并不稳定。作者将其归因于"从奖励到参数更新"的修正链路上的两个薄弱点：(1) rollout 层面，高语义熵的困难查询常产生"一致错误"的样本组，使组相对优势（group-relative advantage）坍缩为零，而这恰恰是幻觉风险最高的地方；(2) 优化层面，高置信但错误的 token 在梯度上"不可见"——类别策略的期望 score-gradient 范数随分布变尖而消失，导致最需纠正的预测获得最弱的更新。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization（DEEPO），双阶段增强：(1) 信号方差正则化——在语义熵触发的高不确定查询上注入 expert prefix（专家前缀），提供有依据的续写作为直接监督，恢复组内优势方差；(2) 梯度预处理——采用优势符号感知的 Renyi 预处理，抵消 logit 层饱和，使修正能到达"高置信但错误"的 token。
AI.result: 两条分支均单独优于 GRPO；二者在评测套件中复杂度最高、最长程的任务 VideoMMMU 上交互作用统计显著（+4.0，95% CI [1.1, 6.9]），在其他任务上呈可加性。DEEPO 在降低幻觉的同时保持了准确率与训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: DEEPO 通过在 rollout 与优化两个层面同时增强"奖励→参数更新"的修正链路，能够在保持准确率与训练稳定性的前提下降低多模态大模型的幻觉；其双分支各自独立有效，且在最长程任务上呈现显著交互增益。

5f01f45d4c20ef83ae77c5cca5d7692fc591eb70.title: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
5f01f45d4c20ef83ae77c5cca5d7692fc591eb70.comment: conversational memory, LLM agents, agent memory systems, benchmark, contradiction detection, belief revision, supersession, intervention quality, hard negatives, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation methodology, memory governance, long-term memory, human annotation
5f01f45d4c20ef83ae77c5cca5d7692fc591eb70.summary: Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and governing sensitive recall. The suite extends LoCoMo's corpora and harness, pairing every detect/block metric with a matched do-not-over-detect control: surface-matched hard negatives price false intervention, so no track can be gamed by flagging everything. The benchmark itself is validated first: independent, gold-blind double annotation with adjudication, judge decoy calibration, and a separability audit. On the human-validated Track B v1.0 key (161 items, post-adjudication kappa = 0.85), no tested configuration simultaneously achieves high contradiction recall, high hard-negative specificity, and high attribution: flat-RAG baselines detect 0.76-0.97 of true contradictions but falsely flag 16-43% of surface-matched safe drafts depending on backend, while a deployed coherence-oriented system almost never over-flags (0.98-1.00 specificity) yet catches 42% of true contradictions -- a trade-off no recall-only score can see. A 13-configuration baseline ladder localizes causes: every gold contradiction is detectable from its evidence alone (recall 1.000), calibrated models nearly solve the track given the full transcript -- consistent with substantial retrieval-coverage gaps -- and draft-only floors reveal model-dependent style priors. A system's TWIST profile, beside its recall score, measures whether memory knows when to intervene and when not to.

AI.tldr: TWIST 是一个面向长期对话记忆系统的基准套件，评测"干预质量"：系统能否在信念变化点正确检测、拦截、更新与受控回忆，并通过配对的反过度干预指标防止"一律报警"式作弊。
AI.motivation: 现有长对话记忆基准主要考察召回与提示式知识更新，近期工作也研究用户信念演化与记忆状态，但"干预质量"这一属性尚未被度量：即系统在其 ingest/recall/vet 接口中，是否能在信念变化点做出正确行为。
AI.method: TWIST 扩展 LoCoMo 的语料与评测框架，设四条赛道：无提示张力检测、用记录审查外发草稿、以当前信念作答并保留被取代历史、敏感回忆治理。每条 detect/block 指标都配一个"勿过度检测"对照，使用表面匹配的困难负例为误干预定价。基准自身先经独立、盲金标双标注与裁决、评判诱饵校准及可分性审计验证。
AI.result: 在人工验证的 Track B v1.0（161 项，裁决后 kappa=0.85）上，无任何配置能同时取得高矛盾召回、高困难负例特异度与高归因：flat-RAG 基线召回 0.76–0.97 真矛盾，但按后端不同误标 16–43% 表面匹配的安全草稿；一致性导向部署系统特异度 0.98–1.00，却只捕获 42% 真矛盾，形成纯召回分数看不到的权衡。13 配置基线阶梯定位原因：所有金标矛盾仅凭证据即可检出（recall 1.000），校准模型在给定完整转写时近乎解决该赛道，提示存在显著检索覆盖缺口；仅草稿下限则暴露模型相关风格先验。
AI.conclusion: TWIST 画像与召回分数并列，用于衡量记忆系统是否知道何时干预、何时不应干预，从而补足现有基准只测召回、无法刻画干预质量的空白。

80be353d73ad5548f481e244def2888979a121c8.title: Adversarial Closed-Loop Curriculum for Evolving Role-Playing Agents
80be353d73ad5548f481e244def2888979a121c8.summary: Role-playing agents based on large language models have been widely applied in areas such as personalized assistance and social simulation. Recent RL methods typically train on a fixed scenario pool collected before learning begins. This creates a distributional bottleneck: as the agent improves, the scenarios where it performs poorly also change, while the training distribution remains static. Therefore, we propose AdvRole, an adversarial context rewriting framework that turns role-playing RL into a closed-loop curriculum. AdvRole alternates between an Actor that learns to role-play and a Rewriter that edits character profiles and dialogue contexts into actor-specific hard scenarios. The Rewriter is trained with a performance-gap reward, which favors rewrites that reduce the current Actor's score relative to the original scenario. As a result, the scenario pool evolves with the Actor and continuously targets under-mastered regions of the character-context space. Experiments on three role-playing benchmarks covering English and Chinese, as well as a new multilingual benchmark we release, show that AdvRole consistently outperforms baselines.

AI.tldr: AdvRole：一种对抗式上下文改写框架，将角色扮演强化学习转变为闭环课程学习，通过Actor与Rewriter交替训练动态生成困难场景，在多个中英文及多语言基准上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的角色扮演智能体RL方法通常在训练开始前收集的固定场景池上进行训练，形成分布瓶颈：随着智能体能力提升，其表现较差的场景会发生变化，而训练分布却保持静态不变，导致训练场景无法持续针对智能体的薄弱区域。
AI.method: 提出AdvRole对抗式上下文改写框架，将角色扮演RL转化为闭环课程学习。框架在Actor（学习角色扮演）与Rewriter（将角色档案和对话上下文改写为针对Actor的困难场景）之间交替训练。Rewriter使用"性能差距奖励"进行训练，该奖励倾向于选择能相对原始场景降低当前Actor得分的改写，从而使场景池随Actor进化并持续聚焦于角色-上下文空间中尚未掌握的区域。
AI.result: 在涵盖英文和中文的三个角色扮演基准以及新发布的多语言基准上进行实验，AdvRole持续优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: AdvRole通过对抗式课程机制动态生成Actor特定困难场景，有效缓解了固定场景池的分布瓶颈问题，证明了闭环课程学习在角色扮演智能体训练中的有效性。

127cfed4afa14afe96befbacefbb5aed07adc065.title: Beyond Surface Style: Aligning Multi-Turn User Simulators with Behavioral Consistency
127cfed4afa14afe96befbacefbb5aed07adc065.summary: Faithful user simulation is fundamental to building, evaluating, and improving interactive AI at scale. However, plausible individual responses do not ensure that simulated users reproduce the intent evolution and outcomes observed in real interactions. We propose TRACER, a multi-turn user simulator that explicitly models users' evolving intent and learns to align simulated behavior with real interaction trajectories. TRACER is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on real user dialogues, followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning. The RL stage combines hierarchical outcome- and trajectory-level rewards with deviation-aware advantage modulation, jointly mitigating reward sparsity and credit assignment in long dialogues. On real customer-service sessions organized into reference cohorts, TRACER-7B surpasses the strongest baseline by 11.4 conversion F1, while also achieving the lowest group-level conversion-rate error and semantic trajectory distance, and generalizing to out-of-distribution scenarios. Human Turing tests yield identification accuracy close to chance, supporting the perceived naturalness of generated conversations. Building on this simulator, we further introduce the Dynamic Marketing Benchmark, which jointly evaluates persuasion effectiveness and response quality of LLMs through simulated interactions, revealing that higher response quality does not necessarily correspond to higher conversion rates.

AI.tldr: TRACER 是一种两阶段训练的多轮用户模拟器，通过显式建模用户意图演化并结合层次化结果/轨迹奖励与偏差感知优势调制，使模拟行为对齐真实交互轨迹；TRACER-7B 在转化 F1、转化率误差和语义轨迹距离上优于基线，并通过图灵测试与动态营销基准验证其自然性与评估价值。
AI.motivation: 忠实的用户模拟是大规模构建、评估和改进交互式 AI 的基础。然而，单个回复看似合理，并不保证模拟用户能复现真实交互中的意图演化与最终结果，因此需要让模拟行为与真实交互轨迹对齐。
AI.method: 提出 TRACER：一种显式建模用户演化意图的多轮用户模拟器，并学习使模拟行为与真实交互轨迹对齐。训练分两阶段：先在真实用户对话上做监督微调（SFT），再进行多轮强化学习（RL）。RL 阶段结合结果级与轨迹级的层次化奖励，并采用偏差感知优势调制（deviation-aware advantage modulation），以缓解长对话中的奖励稀疏与信用分配问题。基于真实客服会话构建参考队列进行评估，并进一步提出 Dynamic Marketing Benchmark。
AI.result: 在真实客服会话构建的参考队列上，TRACER-7B 相比最强基线提升 11.4 conversion F1，同时取得最低的组级转化率误差与语义轨迹距离，并能泛化到分布外场景。人类图灵测试中的识别准确率接近随机水平，支持生成对话的自然性。Dynamic Marketing Benchmark 通过模拟交互联合评估 LLM 的说服效果与回复质量，发现更高的回复质量并不必然对应更高的转化率。
AI.conclusion: TRACER 通过显式建模用户意图演化并对齐真实交互轨迹，提升了多轮用户模拟的忠实性；其衍生的 Dynamic Marketing Benchmark 进一步表明，回复质量高并不必然带来更高转化率。

3c17e7fbaf56123e9d8003e51c20500965df9e7d.title: Driving Epidemic Models with AI Agents: the Epydemix Agent Framework
3c17e7fbaf56123e9d8003e51c20500965df9e7d.summary: Artificial Intelligence agents based on large language models provide convenient natural language interfaces to scientific software, but reliability is not automatic. Here we introduce the Epydemix Agent Framework, an additive layer over Epydemix, an open-source Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modeling. The framework extends the library with four capabilities to facilitate interaction with an AI agent: discovery of available models and parameters, preventive validation of a declarative scenario specification, execution through tested library code, and inspectability of results. These capabilities let an agent handle the entire modeling process, from the natural-language description of the scenario to quantitative results, figures, and interpretation of findings without writing custom code. Each step reads input files and saves results in a separate output bundle, making the process auditable and reproducible. First, we show the end-to-end workflow with a case study comparing vaccination strategies for a novel respiratory virus. Second, we assessed the framework across 50 agent sessions and five modeling tasks by comparing the agent use of the framework against the direct use of the Python interface. The framework reduced turns, output tokens, and cost on most tasks, unless it trades resources for per-point reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Epydemix Agent Framework，在开源随机分室流行病建模库 Epydemix 之上增加智能体交互层，使大语言模型智能体可端到端完成建模任务，并通过 50 次智能体会话、5 类任务验证其在多数任务中减少交互轮次、输出 token 和成本。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的 AI 智能体为科学软件提供了自然语言接口，但可靠性并非自动保证；需要一种可审计、可复现且易于智能体调用的框架，以降低直接使用 Python 接口时的交互开销与出错风险。
AI.method: 在 Epydemix 库上加设附加层，提供四项能力：可用模型与参数发现、声明式场景规范的预防性验证、通过已测试库代码执行、结果可检查性；每步读写独立输出包，支持从自然语言场景描述到定量结果、图表和解释的全流程建模。
AI.result: 通过一个比较新型呼吸道病毒疫苗接种策略的端到端案例展示工作流；并在 50 次智能体会话和 5 项建模任务中，将智能体使用该框架与直接使用 Python 接口对比，结果显示在多数任务上减少了交互轮次、输出 token 和成本，但在部分场景中以资源换取逐点可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能提升 AI 智能体与科学软件交互的可靠性和可审计性，并在多数建模任务中改善效率；其代价可能是在特定可复现性需求下增加资源消耗。

ffa4018024fa77f590b3aa4b670e75225d65f931.title: Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Structural Governance through Role-Scoped Capability Delivery
ffa4018024fa77f590b3aa4b670e75225d65f931.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle to scale safely when exposed to vast enterprise toolsets. Providing an agent with access to every internal tool leads to oversized context windows, degraded tool selection, and severe governance vulnerabilities - as system policies defined purely in prompts remain probabilistic advice rather than hard constraints. Existing mitigations, such as multi-agent domain delegation, decentralize audit logs and fail to guarantee policy compliance across sessions. We introduce skilder, a framework that packages capabilities into roles: bundles of skills, tools, and instructions, together with the limits that bound them. An agent begins with a minimal role catalog, learns the roles a task requires, and receives each role's skills, instructions, and tools through a single MCP server. Because tools reach the agent only inside learned skills, the same server enforces the scope of what was learned deterministically. We evaluate skilder against flat-context tool selection and multi-agent orchestration across 13 tasks using six models (10 runs each). Our results show that, when models completed discovery and issued a governed call, the skilder simulated authorization layer enforced governance boundaries: no unauthorized tool call or parameter violation (e.g., a spending-limit breach) executed. Aggregate task pass rates also reflect whether each model followed the discovery protocol and satisfied response-quality checks; those misses are not authorization failures. Furthermore, by allowing agents to dynamically acquire cross-role capabilities mid-task, skilder preserves problem-solving flexibility while providing hard system-level enforcement.

AI.tldr: skilder 将能力封装为角色（roles），通过单一 MCP 服务器在技能学习范围内暴露工具，实现确定性的系统级授权与治理，同时允许智能体动态获取跨角色能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体接入庞大企业工具集时难以安全扩展：上下文窗口过大、工具选择质量下降、治理脆弱；仅靠提示词定义系统策略只是概率性建议而非硬约束。多智能体领域委派还会分散审计日志，且无法保证跨会话策略合规。
AI.method: 提出 skilder 框架：将能力打包为“角色”，每个角色包含技能、工具、指令及限制边界。智能体从最小角色目录开始，学习任务所需角色，并通过单一 MCP 服务器接收每个角色的技能、指令和工具。由于工具仅在学习到的技能内部到达智能体，同一服务器可确定性地执行已学习范围。评估对比 flat-context 工具选择与多智能体编排，覆盖 13 个任务、6 个模型，每个模型运行 10 次。
AI.result: 当模型完成发现流程并发起受治理调用时，skilder 的模拟授权层成功执行治理边界：未发生未授权工具调用或参数违规（如突破支出限制）。聚合任务通过率还反映模型是否遵循发现协议并满足响应质量检查；这些未通过并非授权失败。通过动态获取跨角色能力，skilder 在提供硬性系统级执法的同时保留了问题解决灵活性。
AI.conclusion: skilder 以角色化能力包与 MCP 服务器实现确定性授权和集中治理，可缓解大规模企业工具集下的上下文膨胀、工具选择退化与策略合规问题，并在安全约束下维持智能体的动态能力获取与任务灵活性。

60829d8bd9ae56eea66c3ef0cfd208d9f8bf4b3b.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Small Search Agents
60829d8bd9ae56eea66c3ef0cfd208d9f8bf4b3b.summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) performs well on problems with clear rewards, such as mathematics and coding, but whether it also works where the reward is less clear remains open. The reason-over-search recipe applies RLVR to open-domain question answering, where retrieval grounds the answer and a match against the reference supplies the reward. So far it has been demonstrated on large models, and below one billion parameters only with distillation from a larger teacher. We test the recipe on a small model. We train Qwen3.5-0.8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and an interleaved Wikipedia-search tool on MuSiQue, varying only the reward across three shapes over three seeds each, and we evaluate every checkpoint held-out on a seven-benchmark question-answering suite. The recipe works: the best run reaches 0.352 average exact match against a 0.092 untrained floor, a 3.8-fold gain, with no distillation step in the training loop. The reward shape also matters. The Search-R1-faithful exact-match-only reward is the worst of the three at every seed at the matched training horizon, and it is worst even on exact match, the metric it directly optimises. We conclude that the sparse exact-match reward, RLVR's default in mathematics and code, is the wrong starting point for models of this size. The reason-over-search setting can supply a suitable reward for RLVR on small models, but small-model RLVR needs its own reward-design study rather than a scaled-down copy of a large-model recipe.

AI.tldr: 本文检验“reason-over-search”式 RLVR 能否直接用于小模型：在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上，用 GRPO + 交错式 Wikipedia 搜索工具在 MuSiQue 上训练，仅改变奖励形状并做多种子、留出集评测。结果显示无需蒸馏即可显著提升开放域问答表现，但仅用精确匹配的稀疏奖励反而最差，说明小模型 RLVR 不能照搬数学/代码场景的默认奖励设计。
AI.motivation: RLVR 在数学、代码等奖励明确的任务上有效，但在奖励不明确的开放域问答中是否同样有效尚不清楚。现有 reason-over-search 方案多在大模型上验证，十亿参数以下通常依赖大模型蒸馏，因此需要检验小模型能否不依赖蒸馏、仅靠可验证奖励完成 RLVR，并探讨奖励设计的影响。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为对象，采用 GRPO，并接入交错式 Wikipedia 搜索工具，在 MuSiQue 数据集上训练。实验控制变量：只改变奖励形状，共三种奖励设计，每种设置跑三个随机种子；对每个 checkpoint 在包含七个问答基准的留出评测套件上评估。重点比较 Search-R1 风格的仅精确匹配奖励与其他奖励形状。
AI.result: 该训练配方在小模型上有效：最佳运行在留出评测上取得 0.352 的平均精确匹配，而未训练基线仅为 0.092，提升约 3.8 倍，且训练循环中不含蒸馏步骤。奖励形状显著影响效果：Search-R1 忠实的仅精确匹配奖励在匹配训练步数下，于每个随机种子中均为三种奖励里最差，甚至在它直接优化的精确匹配指标上也最差。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏的仅精确匹配奖励——RLVR 在数学与代码中的默认选择——并不适合该规模的小模型。reason-over-search 场景可以为小模型 RLVR 提供合适奖励，但小模型 RLVR 需要独立的奖励设计研究，而不能简单缩放复制大模型配方。

8eeac913c96c51d78c5715c0fdd26925498f30f4.title: Agent Memory with Episodic Retrieval for Financial Decision-Making
8eeac913c96c51d78c5715c0fdd26925498f30f4.comment: The paper has been accepted for AACL-IJCNLP 2026 findings
8eeac913c96c51d78c5715c0fdd26925498f30f4.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in financial analysis and reasoning, inspiring recent advances in agent-based trading frameworks. While these systems show promise, prior approaches either emphasize long-horizon forecasting or operate as stateless analyzers, limiting their applicability to the demands of trading in complicated settings. To address these gaps, we introduce META (Memory Enhanced Trading Agent), the first RAG-like episodic-memory-augmented multi-agent framework for financial decision making. META integrates a family of specialized indicator agents (e.g., Trend, MACD, Stochastic, RSI, SMA, AVWAP, Heikin-Ashi) with a Decision Agent that fuses their reports, and a Memory module that retrieves and updates past trading episodes encoded as market state embeddings with outcomes and reflections. By recalling relevant experiences and adaptively reweighting signals under similar market regimes, META achieves improved directional accuracy and robustness under short-horizon evaluation. Our results demonstrate that episodic memory provides a powerful mechanism for regime-aware, interpretable, and low-latency decision-making in trading and decision making. The code of this project is released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: META（Memory Enhanced Trading Agent）是首个类RAG、情景记忆增强的多智能体金融决策框架，通过检索并更新历史交易情景来提升短周期交易的方向准确率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体交易框架要么侧重长周期预测，要么以无状态分析器形式运行，难以满足复杂交易场景的需求，且缺乏对历史交易经验的记忆与复用。
AI.method: META集成一组专用指标智能体（Trend、MACD、Stochastic、RSI、SMA、AVWAP、Heikin-Ashi），由Decision Agent融合各智能体报告；并引入Memory模块，将过去交易情景编码为包含结果与反思的市场状态嵌入进行检索与更新，从而召回相关经验并在相似市场状态下自适应地重加权信号。
AI.result: 在短周期评估下，META提升了方向准确率与鲁棒性，表明情景记忆可实现状态感知（regime-aware）、可解释且低延迟的交易与决策。
AI.conclusion: 情景记忆是提升交易与决策的有效机制，该框架为复杂交易环境提供了新的解决思路；项目代码已在GitHub开源。

c809ff2cd8d2f87dd0cd5317edab669566a43313.title: RECLAIM: Can Agents Reproduce the Claims of Machine Learning Papers?
c809ff2cd8d2f87dd0cd5317edab669566a43313.summary: Reproducing a machine learning paper involves most research steps, from installing software and debugging to running experiments, work that AI agents increasingly do. We introduce RECLAIM, a benchmark of 100 NeurIPS 2025 papers that can be rebuilt yearly from new conferences. For each paper we fix in advance the result to reproduce, what counts as a successful reproduction, and a GPU-hour budget. An agent must reproduce that result using the paper and whatever its authors released. What the authors released decides the difficulty tier. Run-tier releases include code, data, and weights; Retrain-tier releases lack weights, so the agent trains the model; Reimplement-tier releases lack code, so the agent writes it. A separate language model grades runs from logs and outputs rather than agents' reports. We run four agents once per paper; the best agent in each tier reproduces only 41% of Run-tier papers, 27% at Retrain, and 15% at Reimplement, where every agent does worst. Failed attempts use on average 29% of their budget, so most stop with budget left. The most common agent error is writing the method without checking any part against the paper's numbers, in 63 of 400 runs.

AI.tldr: 提出 RECLAIM 基准：用 100 篇 NeurIPS 2025 论文评测 AI 智能体复现机器学习结果的能力，按作者发布物划分难度层级，并由独立语言模型基于日志与输出评分。
AI.motivation: 复现机器学习论文涵盖装环境、调试、跑实验等大量科研步骤，且正逐渐由 AI 智能体承担；但缺乏可年度更新、标准明确、能区分不同复现难度的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建包含 100 篇 NeurIPS 2025 论文的基准，每年可从新会议重建。对每篇论文预先固定：待复现结果、成功复现判定标准、GPU 小时预算。智能体仅使用论文及作者公开材料进行复现。依据作者发布物划分难度：Run 层有代码、数据和权重；Retrain 层缺权重需自行训练；Reimplement 层缺代码需自行实现。评分由另一语言模型根据日志与输出完成，而非依赖智能体自述报告。每个论文运行四个智能体各一次。
AI.result: 各层级最佳智能体复现成功率分别为：Run 层 41%，Retrain 层 27%，Reimplement 层 15%，所有智能体在 Reimplement 层表现最差。失败尝试平均仅使用 29% 预算，多数在预算未耗尽时停止。最常见错误是未将方法任何部分与论文数值核对，400 次运行中出现 63 次。
AI.conclusion: 当前 AI 智能体尚难可靠复现机器学习论文，且随作者发布物减少、复现难度升高，成功率显著下降；多数失败并非预算不足，而是方法验证与数值核对不足。RECLAIM 提供了可年度更新的分层复现评测框架。

05056efb012b6ac402639f20e1ee59cfeeb5ffa0.title: Human-AI-Powered Hypothesis Testing: Cost-Aware Selective AI Scoring and Sequential Human Escalation
05056efb012b6ac402639f20e1ee59cfeeb5ffa0.summary: Large language models are increasingly used as inexpensive judges to evaluate outputs, label data, and assess whether a system meets a desired quality standard. Yet using AI judgments for formal statistical inference is fundamentally different from simply treating them as ground-truth labels: AI evaluations can be biased or noisy, and rigorous hypothesis testing requires explicit control of type-I and type-II errors. We study how to use AI judgments, together with selective human verification, to conduct a valid hypothesis test at minimum cost. We consider a population of items with hidden binary labels. After choosing a fixed pool of items, the decision maker can selectively query AI, send an item directly to a human, escalate an AI-scored item to a human after observing the AI report, or stop once sufficient evidence has accumulated. We derive an information-theoretic lower bound that captures the minimum cost of achieving prescribed testing errors and characterizes the value of AI information and human verification through a report-dependent information frontier. Motivated by this characterization, we develop SCALE, a sequential cost-aware policy that combines selective AI scoring with adaptive human escalation. SCALE is valid at finite sample sizes and matches the lower bound to first order as the target error probabilities vanish. We further extend the framework to an unknown AI-output model using paired AI-human pilot data. Numerically, SCALE approaches Human-only or AI-only testing when one source clearly dominates, while achieving its largest savings when inexpensive AI judgments and selective human verification are both valuable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在AI判断可能有偏/带噪的前提下，结合选择性人工核验，以最小成本完成一个统计有效的假设检验；提出了信息论下界与序贯策略SCALE，在有限样本下有效且渐近最优，并在AI与人工核验互补时获得最大成本节省。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被日益用作低成本"评审"来评估输出、标注数据或判断系统是否达到质量标准。然而，将AI判断用于正式统计推断，与直接把它当作真值标签存在本质区别：AI评估可能有偏或带噪，而严格的假设检验必须显式控制第一类与第二类错误。因此，核心动机是：如何在借助AI判断与选择性人工核验的同时，以最小成本完成一个统计上有效的假设检验。
AI.method:
- 问题建模：将隐藏二元标签的总体判定形式化为假设检验，允许决策者在固定候选池上采取四种动作——选择性查询AI、直接送人工、观察AI报告后再升级至人工、以及证据充分后停止，目标是在满足指定第一类/第二类错误的前提下最小化成本。
- 理论刻画：推导信息论下界，给出达到规定检验错误率的最小成本，并通过"依赖报告的信息前沿"刻画AI信息与人工核验的价值。
- 算法设计：提出SCALE（Sequential Cost-Aware LEarning/policy）序贯策略，将选择性AI评分与自适应人工升级相结合，在有限样本下保持有效性，并在目标错误概率趋于零时与下界一阶匹配。
- 扩展：针对AI输出模型未知的情形，利用成对的AI-人工试点数据（paired pilot data）进行估计与适配。
- 实验：数值对比Human-only与AI-only基线，考察不同信息优势配置下的成本节省情况。
AI.result:
- 理论上给出了刻画最小检验成本的信息论下界，并识别出AI信息与人工核验的价值来源（报告依赖的信息前沿）。
- SCALE在有限样本下有效，且在目标错误概率趋于零时与下界一阶匹配，达到渐近最优。
- 框架可扩展至AI输出模型未知的情形（借助成对AI-人工试点数据）。
- 数值上，当单一信息源明显占优时SCALE分别逼近Human-only或AI-only测试；当廉价AI判断与选择性人工核验二者都有价值时，成本节省最大。
AI.conclusion: 本文为"以AI判断辅助统计推断"提供了首个在有限样本下有效、且渐近最优的成本感知序贯检验框架。SCALE及其扩展方法表明：AI判断不应被当作真值标签，而应通过选择性人工核验与序贯设计来发挥其信息价值，从而在保证检验错误率受控的同时显著降低评估成本。

260d90f8385f6074d5c0c944f0b40a023e0547f1.title: Thinking Leakage: A Causal Audit of NoThink Post-Training in Hybrid Reasoning Models
260d90f8385f6074d5c0c944f0b40a023e0547f1.summary: Post-training hybrid reasoning models in NoThink mode has attracted growing interest as a way to improve performance while keeping inference fast. However, these gains may draw on thinking behavior already accessible through the base model's Think mode. We formulate this thinking leakage in a causal mediation framework and audit its contribution using bidirectional interventions along a simple base-derived activation direction. Across three models and three post-training methods on competition math benchmarks, we find that leakage is real, causal, and substantial: behavioral and representational analyses reveal shifts toward Think, steering the base model along this direction reproduces most of the post-training accuracy gain, and counter-steering a checkpoint removes a substantial share of what it gains. Across nine aligned checkpoints with positive NoThink gains, the resulting leakage ratio ranges from 42% to 79%. These interventions support a substantial causal contribution of thinking leakage. Our findings show that a post-training method's apparent advantage can therefore reflect greater drift toward Think, obscuring whether it improves capability within NoThink or more effectively re-invokes existing Think behavior.

AI.tldr: 该文用因果中介与激活方向双向干预审计 NoThink 模式后训练增益，发现其相当一部分来自对基座模型已有 Think 行为的“思维泄漏”，泄漏比例达 42%–79%。
AI.motivation: NoThink 模式下后训练混合推理模型虽能提升性能并保持推理速度，但这些增益可能来自基座模型 Think 模式中已可访问的思考行为，而非 NoThink 能力本身；需要因果性地审计这种“思维泄漏”。
AI.method: 将“思维泄漏”形式化为因果中介框架，并沿一条由基座模型导出的简单激活方向进行双向干预：对基座模型沿该方向引导，对后训练检查点进行反向引导；在 3 个模型、3 种后训练方法和竞赛数学基准上开展行为与表征分析。
AI.result: 泄漏真实、因果且显著：行为与表征分析显示模型向 Think 偏移；沿该方向引导基座模型可复现大部分后训练准确率增益；对检查点反向引导可消除其相当一部分增益。在 9 个具有正向 NoThink 增益的对齐检查点上，泄漏比例为 42%–79%。
AI.conclusion: 后训练方法在 NoThink 模式下的表面优势可能主要反映模型向 Think 行为的漂移，而非在 NoThink 内部真正提升能力；这提示评估混合推理模型时需区分“能力提升”与“已有 Think 行为的重新调用”。

7c256cba5c488bdc5c1edf245b2dbb256d0a8d0b.title: PFArena: Benchmarking Language Models for Protein Modification
7c256cba5c488bdc5c1edf245b2dbb256d0a8d0b.summary: Protein modification requires navigating an immense sequence space, yet wet-lab validation remains low-throughput and costly. Although computational paradigms including protein language models (PLMs), large language models (LLMs), and LLM-based agents have shown promise in protein modification, their relative efficacy across realistic experimental decision-making settings remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce PFArena, a benchmark comprising four controlled task interfaces that cover single-mutant generation and multi-mutant ranking. By providing varying levels of mutation fitness data, PFArena reflects four representative research scenarios characterized by differing degrees of prior experimental context. We assess six PLMs, six LLMs, and five LLM-based agents using complementary metrics to measure both peak and overall protein modification performance. Our evaluation reveals that model performance shifts systematically with the availability of target-specific experimental evidence: PLMs demonstrate proficiency in open-ended single-mutant generation by leveraging protein-specific priors, whereas LLMs and agents perform strongly in multi-mutant ranking, particularly when target-specific fitness data are available. Nevertheless, all model families face fundamental challenges with increasing search-space size and mutation depth. We release our code and benchmark suite to facilitate reproducible research in model-assisted protein modification.

AI.tldr: 提出 PFArena 基准，用四个受控任务接口系统评测 6 个 PLM、6 个 LLM 与 5 个 LLM-based agents 在单突变生成与多突变排序中的表现，揭示各类模型能力随目标特异性实验证据可用性的系统性变化。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质改造需在巨大的序列空间中搜索，湿实验验证通量低、成本高。尽管 PLM、LLM 及基于 LLM 的智能体在蛋白质改造上展现潜力，但在贴近真实实验决策场景下，各类方法的相对有效性尚不清晰，缺乏统一、可控的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 PFArena 基准，包含覆盖单突变生成与多突变排序的四个受控任务接口；通过提供不同水平的突变适应度数据，模拟四种具有不同先验实验背景程度的代表性研究场景。以互补指标对 6 个 PLM、6 个 LLM 和 5 个基于 LLM 的智能体进行评测，同时衡量峰值性能与整体改造性能。
AI.result: 模型性能随目标特异性实验证据的可用性呈系统性变化：PLM 凭借蛋白特异性先验在开放式单突变生成中表现突出；LLM 与智能体在多突变排序中表现强劲，尤其在具备目标特异性适应度数据时。但所有模型族在搜索空间增大与突变深度增加时均面临根本性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 公开代码与基准套件，为模型辅助蛋白质改造的可复现研究提供支撑，并指明不同证据条件下各类模型方法的适用边界与共同瓶颈。

9634f946ad772e23c7eb133ff17307fc0abc1fbf.title: From Static Personal Values to Contextualized Personalization: Bayesian Personalized Value Alignment for LLMs
9634f946ad772e23c7eb133ff17307fc0abc1fbf.summary: Personalized value alignment has become increasingly important as large language models (LLMs) are expected to accommodate diverse user preferences. However, existing methods typically align model outputs with a static value profile across prompts, overlooking that the salience of value dimensions varies substantially across contexts. Inspired by Lewin's Field Theory, which views human behavior as jointly shaped by personal dispositions and situational constraints, we model personal values as priors and context-dependent preferences as posteriors. We propose BaCVA, an inference-time Bayesian Context-aware personalized Value Alignment method that approximates posterior personalized preferences by integrating static personal values with scenario-specific value salience. BaCVA first estimates contextual value salience from generally normative responses, and then employs a dual-view personalization module to infer posterior preferences from complementary personal-value and scenario-driven perspectives. This Bayesian formulation enables more accurate and adaptive personalized value alignment while improving data efficiency via prior values. Extensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate its superiority over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 BaCVA：一种推理时贝叶斯上下文感知个性化价值对齐方法，将静态个人价值作为先验、情境化价值显著性作为似然，推断后验个性化偏好，实现更准确、自适应且数据高效的价值对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化价值对齐方法通常用静态价值画像对齐模型输出，忽略不同提示/情境下价值维度显著性的差异；受 Lewin 场论启发，人的行为由个人倾向与情境约束共同塑造，因此需要将个人价值视为先验、上下文相关偏好视为后验。
AI.method: BaCVA 在推理阶段进行贝叶斯个性化价值对齐：先从一般规范性回答中估计上下文价值显著性，再通过双视角个性化模块，从个人价值视角与情境驱动视角互补推断后验偏好，从而融合静态个人价值与场景特定价值显著性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，BaCVA 优于强基线方法；贝叶斯建模带来更准确、自适应的个性化价值对齐，并借助先验价值提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的贝叶斯个性化价值对齐能更好刻画情境变化下的用户价值偏好，BaCVA 验证了以静态价值为先验、以情境显著性为证据进行后验推断的有效性。

07edcd9ce8e721ff36a55389a502e4e6c961bd1c.title: Back to the Definition: Estimating Step-Level Advantages via Trajectory Graphs for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
07edcd9ce8e721ff36a55389a502e4e6c961bd1c.summary: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods, such as GRPO and its variants, have become a leading paradigm for training reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs). While their group-normalized advantage estimation is reliable at the response level, it becomes systematically biased at the step level, since coarse-grained trajectory-level advantages are hard to accurately reflect the contribution of individual steps (i.e, failed trajectories may contain valuable steps). Revisiting the foundational RL definition, we notice that GRPO's success on single-turn tasks stems from its advantage estimation strategy, which adheres to the basic definition: the mean reward of multiple actions sampled from the same state constitutes a credible state-value estimate. Extending the faithful estimation to step-level would in principle demand sampling multiple actions from each intermediate state, which is too costly on a per-state basis. To mitigate this issue, we propose a Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment framework (GRAFT) that grafts all rollout trajectories into a trajectory graph, recovering node state-values via Bellman iteration on the graph, and assigning credit to each edge by the node value difference. Theoretically, the estimated step-level advantage faithfully adheres to the basic advantage definition in RL. To further ensure the reliability of step-level advantage estimation, we further propose Graph GAE, which extends GAE to the trajectory graph for reducing the impact of state-value estimation bias. Experiments across a range of multi-turn agentic benchmarks show consistent gains over GRPO and superior performance compared to recent agentic RL algorithms. Code will be available at https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT.

AI.tldr: 本文针对组式强化学习（GRPO等）在步骤级信用分配上的系统性偏差，提出基于轨迹图的忠实步骤级信用分配框架 GRAFT，并扩展出 Graph GAE，在多轮智能体基准上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO 等组式 RL 方法在响应级优势估计可靠，但在步骤级存在系统性偏差：粗粒度轨迹级优势难以准确反映单步贡献，失败轨迹中也可能包含有价值步骤。将忠实估计扩展到步骤级原则上需从每个中间状态采样多个动作，成本过高。
AI.method: 提出 GRAFT（Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment）框架：将所有 rollout 轨迹嫁接为轨迹图，通过图上的 Bellman 迭代恢复节点状态价值，并依据相邻节点价值差为每条边分配信用。理论上，估计的步骤级优势忠实符合 RL 中优势函数的基本定义。进一步提出 Graph GAE，将 GAE 扩展到轨迹图，以降低状态价值估计偏差的影响。
AI.result: 在多个多轮智能体基准上，GRAFT 相较 GRPO 取得一致增益，并优于近期智能体 RL 算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过轨迹图上的 Bellman 迭代与图式 GAE，可在不进行逐状态多次采样的前提下实现更忠实的步骤级优势估计，为多轮智能体 LLM 的 RL 训练提供有效信用分配方案。代码将开源。

17924233b22950747f7e5d868bd200bbcd272275.title: When Does Action Credit Need Updating?
17924233b22950747f7e5d868bd200bbcd272275.summary: Tool-using agents are continually updated with new interaction data. After each policy update, however, previously estimated action credits may become stale. Recomputing them from scratch can require many additional tool calls and environment interactions, making repeated updates increasingly expensive. We ask a simple question: when does historical action credit actually need to be updated? Our key observation is that a change in action value does not necessarily imply a change in the decision. Historical credit can still be useful as long as policy-induced drift is too small to overturn the existing action ranking. Building on this idea, we introduce pairwise branch sensitivity to capture how strongly a policy update affects the downstream regions that distinguish two candidate actions. We then derive a first-order anchored credit-transport estimator that updates historical credit using old interventional trajectories, and propose a Decision-Sufficient Credit Gate (DSC-Gate) that chooses whether to reuse, transport, or resample credit. Experiments show that branch sensitivity explains credit drift substantially better than global policy distance. With sufficient historical data, credit transport reduces estimation error, while its benefit to decision making is concentrated on updates that affect action-distinguishing branches. On a fully independent test set, DSC-Gate changes mean regret by only +0.00004 relative to a gap-based gate while reducing mean new tool steps from 472 to 286, a 39.4% reduction. We observe the same pattern after a real tool-agent parameter update. Overall, our results show that agents do not need to recompute action credit after every policy update: much of the historical evidence can be reused or cheaply corrected, reducing the additional interaction required to keep action decisions up to date.

AI.tldr: 针对工具智能体策略更新后历史动作信用过时、重算代价高的问题，论文提出"成对分支敏感性"概念与一阶锚定信用传输估计器，并设计 DSC-Gate 在复用/传输/重采样间自适应选择；在独立测试集上遗憾仅增0.00004而新增工具步数减少39.4%。
AI.motivation: 工具智能体持续用新交互数据更新策略，但每次更新后先前估计的动作信用（action credit）可能过时。从头重算信用需要大量额外工具调用与环境交互，使得反复更新代价越来越高。核心问题：历史动作信用究竟何时才真正需要更新？关键观察是——动作价值的变化不必然导致决策变化，只要策略诱导的漂移小到不足以改变既有动作排序，历史信用就仍然可用。
AI.method: 1) 提出"成对分支敏感性"（pairwise branch sensitivity），刻画策略更新对区分两个候选动作的下游区域的影响强度；2) 据此推导一阶锚定信用传输估计器（first-order anchored credit-transport estimator），利用旧的干预轨迹（old interventional trajectories）更新历史信用，而非完全重算；3) 提出决策充分信用门控 DSC-Gate（Decision-Sufficient Credit Gate），动态决定对历史信用进行复用（reuse）、传输（transport）还是重采样（resample）。
AI.result: 实验表明：分支敏感性对信用漂移的解释力显著优于全局策略距离；当历史数据充足时，信用传输可降低估计误差，但其对决策的收益集中在影响"动作区分分支"的更新上。在完全独立的测试集上，相比基于间隔（gap-based）的门控，DSC-Gate 使平均遗憾仅变化 +0.00004，同时将平均新增工具步数从472降至286（减少39.4%）。在真实工具智能体参数更新后观察到相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结：工具智能体在每次策略更新后无需从头重算动作信用；只要策略诱导的漂移不足以颠覆既有动作排序，大量历史证据即可被复用或低成本校正。所提出的"分支敏感性+信用传输+DSC-Gate"框架在保持决策质量（遗憾仅+0.00004）的同时，将平均新增工具调用步数从472降至286（减少39.4%），并在真实工具智能体参数更新后重现同一规律，证明可显著降低维持动作决策时效性所需的额外交互成本。

d50ca72703c130e3ad63f2d73880115a8a785a63.title: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
d50ca72703c130e3ad63f2d73880115a8a785a63.comment: 33 pages, 7 figures, 26 Tables. Preprint under review
d50ca72703c130e3ad63f2d73880115a8a785a63.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems can automate alpha factor mining, but their reliance on external APIs limits control over cost, availability, and confidentiality. Long research loops also tend to revisit a few successful economic mechanisms that lead to research path collapse. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaDiverse, a framework that integrates a multi-agent alpha research system, diverse research path collection, and post-training for local agents. We let the research system generate complementary plan portfolios and vary research environments across loops to collect diverse research paths. Using these diverse traces, we warm-start local Planner and Realizer agents with supervised fine-tuning. Then, we propose a joint GRPO method to optimize both of them using predictive quality and diversity of contributions. Research feedback is confined to inner period data, while a frozen final model is evaluated on a later outer period data, thereby avoiding test-set tuning. Experiments across four Chinese stock universes show that AlphaDiverse can combine competitive prediction with broader exploration.

AI.tldr: AlphaDiverse 通过“多智能体 alpha 研究 + 多样化研究路径采集 + 本地智能体后训练”，缓解对外部 API 的依赖和长循环中的研究路径坍缩，并在四个中国股票域上实现有竞争力的预测与更广探索。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统可自动挖掘 alpha 因子，但依赖外部 API 会限制成本、可用性与保密性；同时长研究循环容易反复回到少数成功经济机制，导致研究路径坍缩。
AI.method: 提出 AlphaDiverse：1）集成多智能体 alpha 研究系统；2）生成互补的计划组合，并在不同循环中变化研究环境，以采集多样化研究路径；3）用这些多样化轨迹对本地 Planner 与 Realizer 进行监督微调热启动；4）提出联合 GRPO 方法，基于预测质量和贡献多样性共同优化两者；5）研究反馈仅使用内层时期数据，冻结最终模型并在更晚的外层时期数据上评估，以避免测试集调参。
AI.result: 在四个中国股票域上的实验表明，AlphaDiverse 能兼顾有竞争力的预测表现与更广泛的探索。
AI.conclusion: AlphaDiverse 通过本地化后训练和多样性驱动的多智能体研究，降低了对外部 API 的依赖并缓解研究路径坍缩，在不进行测试集调参的前提下实现竞争性预测与更广探索。

33477541468e6360f7358d7a95bbda66727793cc.title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
33477541468e6360f7358d7a95bbda66727793cc.summary: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.

AI.tldr: MeshHeal 是一个完全去中心化的自愈框架，通过双时间尺度的能力匹配同伴评审，在无需集中控制的情况下保护当前任务并支持退化智能体的隔离与恢复。该方法在 BBH、MATH、MMLU-Pro 上以更少 token 取得更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 去中心化 LLM 多智能体系统依赖局部交互协调，存在"灰色故障"问题：智能体保持响应能力，但任务求解质量持续退化。此类故障要求在证据不足、尚无法调整未来路由的情况下先保护当前任务，同时仍需允许已恢复的智能体重新加入系统。
AI.method: 提出 MeshHeal，完全去中心化的自愈框架，结合两个时间尺度的能力匹配同伴评审：快速时间尺度上，自适应层级机制将不确定或低分输出从重复的单评审者评估升级到委员会审议，必要时在使用前进行纠正；慢速时间尺度上，采用任务与能力条件化的同伴相对检测器聚合分数，区分持续退化与普通输出波动，触发强制委员会评审并最终将退化智能体从常规路由中排除，同时通过恢复探针提供新证据以实现重新整合。此外提出 Model-Backed MAS Evaluation 评估方法，将能力分配与执行模型绑定。
AI.result: 在 BBH、MATH、MMLU-Pro 上，MeshHeal 以每任务 51k 模型 token 达到 0.839 的退化阶段准确率，而最强基线 Symphony 以每任务 115k token 仅达 0.807。在交错退化与恢复场景下，MeshHeal 能隔离退化智能体，使其在恢复前持续被排除于常规任务执行之外，并在恢复后将其恢复正常路由。
AI.conclusion: MeshHeal 通过双时间尺度的能力匹配同伴评审，在完全去中心化的前提下有效应对灰色故障，兼顾当前任务保护与退化智能体的恢复再整合，并以更低的 token 开销取得优于基线的准确率。

afc995fe5f1cfb748bafb7c88e4bde563ae289e1.title: SLCA-GRPO: Resolving Cross-Segment Credit Misattribution in Tool-Calling RL
afc995fe5f1cfb748bafb7c88e4bde563ae289e1.summary: Tool-calling agents produce heterogeneous outputs, interleaving structured tool invocations with user-facing natural language summaries. This output heterogeneity presents a structural failure mode in standard on-policy Reinforcement Learning (RL): algorithms like GRPO indiscriminately broadcast a homogeneous trajectory-level scalar advantage to all tokens. Consequently, gradient noise from summary generation leaks into tool-decision tokens, causing cross-segment credit misattribution and brittle optimization. In this work, we propose SLCA-GRPO, a framework incorporating Segment-Locked Credit Assignment (SLCA). To enable scalable exploration without costly real APIs and stable training, we first construct the Schema-Guided LLM Simulator (SGLS) as foundational training infrastructure. Building on this, SLCA decouples advantage estimation at the structural segment level within a single group of rollouts, without requiring additional rollouts from intermediate states. Supported by Hierarchical Rewards (HierR), SLCA routes execution advantages to tool tokens and preference advantages to summary tokens, eliminating advantage contamination (the dominant cross-segment credit misattribution channel) within each policy update. On a 7B backbone, SLCA-GRPO accelerates convergence and outperforms standard GRPO, ToolPO, and RLTR by +2.53 pp on in-domain evaluation, +1.36 pp on the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), and +9.15 pp on $τ^2$-Bench under the same training budgets, achieving higher accuracy with reduced tool redundancy and costs.

AI.tldr: SLCA-GRPO 针对工具调用智能体“工具调用+自然语言摘要”异构输出导致的轨迹级优势广播与跨段信用错配问题，提出结构段级信用分配 SLCA，并配合 SGLS 模拟器与 HierR 分层奖励，在 7B 模型上以相同训练预算超越 GRPO、ToolPO、RLTR。
AI.motivation: 工具调用智能体的输出具有异构性，结构化工具调用与面向用户的自然语言摘要交织出现。标准同策略强化学习（如 GRPO）将轨迹级标量优势无差别广播到所有 token，导致摘要生成产生的梯度噪声泄漏到工具决策 token，引发跨段信用错配，使优化脆弱。因此需要在不依赖昂贵真实 API 的前提下，实现可扩展探索并解决异构输出的细粒度信用分配问题。
AI.method: 提出 SLCA-GRPO 框架，核心为 Segment-Locked Credit Assignment（SLCA）。首先构建 Schema-Guided LLM Simulator（SGLS）作为训练基础设施，以低成本模拟真实 API 并支持可扩展探索与稳定训练。SLCA 在单组 rollout 内按结构段解耦优势估计，无需从中间状态额外采样。配合 Hierarchical Rewards（HierR），将执行优势路由至工具 token，将偏好优势路由至摘要 token，从而在每次策略更新中消除优势污染这一主要的跨段信用错配通道。
AI.result: 在 7B 骨干模型上，SLCA-GRPO 加速收敛，并在相同训练预算下优于标准 GRPO、ToolPO 与 RLTR：域内评测提升 +2.53 pp，Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard（BFCL）提升 +1.36 pp，τ²-Bench 提升 +9.15 pp；同时以更低的工具冗余和成本取得更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: SLCA-GRPO 通过结构级信用分配与分层奖励，有效缓解工具调用智能体异构输出下的跨段信用错配问题，在提升准确率的同时降低工具冗余与成本，说明面向结构化轨迹的分段优势估计是提升工具调用 RL 训练稳定性和效率的有效方向。

7b715662c155d819944ea68b0e7034d31dc96f43.title: From Self-Distillation to Self-Practice: Privileged Information for Multi-Turn Agents
7b715662c155d819944ea68b0e7034d31dc96f43.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has become a popular recipe for post-training LLM agents. It supervises the agent model at the token level with a stronger teacher view of the same model, obtained by conditioning on privileged information (PI). In this work, we show that in multi-turn agents, this paradigm teaches the student to act with confidence but without the information behind it. The trained agent behaves as if it had privileged information it never observed, and its performance falls well short of plain RL, in the worst case below the untrained base model. Therefore, we propose Privileged Self-Practice (PSP), which keeps the PI and moves it from the loss to the sampler. When the student's rollouts on a task mostly fail, we inject a short per-task instruction written by an analyzer model, sample the task again with the instruction in context, and train on the result with an unchanged GRPO objective. The privileged information stays in the prompt and never enters the loss. Across AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, with three different student models, PSP obtains the best average score in every setting and is the only method that consistently outperforms plain GRPO, improving task-goal completion by up to 65% on AppWorld and the resolved rate by up to 61% on SWE-bench Verified.

AI.tldr: 该文指出多轮LLM智能体中的on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）会把特权信息（PI）仅用于token级损失，导致学生模型“自信但缺乏信息依据”，性能不及普通RL；为此提出Privileged Self-Practice（PSP），将PI从损失移到采样器：任务rollout多数失败时，用analyzer模型生成简短任务指令并注入上下文重新采样，再以原GRPO目标训练。PSP在AppWorld与SWE-bench Verified、三个学生模型上均取得最佳平均分，且持续优于plain GRPO，任务目标完成率最高提升65%，解决率最高提升61%。
AI.motivation: OPSD已成为LLM智能体后训练的常用方法，它通过同一模型在特权信息条件下的更强teacher视图，对agent进行token级监督。但作者发现，在多轮agent中该范式让学生学到“有信心的行动”，却未真正获得支撑该信心的信息：训练后的agent表现得像拥有从未观察到的特权信息，性能远逊于普通RL，最坏情况下甚至低于未训练基座模型。因此需要保留PI带来的收益，同时避免其以不可观察方式进入损失。
AI.method: 提出Privileged Self-Practice（PSP），核心是把PI从损失函数迁移到采样器。具体而言，当学生模型对某任务的rollout大多失败时，由analyzer模型为该任务生成一段简短指令；将该指令放入上下文后重新采样该任务；随后使用未改动的GRPO目标在结果上训练。特权信息始终保留在prompt中，不进入损失，从而避免token级监督造成的信息错配。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和SWE-bench Verified上，使用三个不同学生模型，PSP在每个设置下都取得最佳平均分，并且是唯一持续优于plain GRPO的方法。在AppWorld上任务目标完成率提升最高65%；在SWE-bench Verified上resolved rate提升最高61%。
AI.conclusion: 多轮LLM智能体后训练应避免将不可观察的特权信息直接用于token级损失监督；将特权信息作为采样时的上下文引导，并保持原有RL目标，可稳定超越plain GRPO，并显著提升任务完成率与解决率。

29ad0f0d0f34a7fd3718992fd7107bca93120bad.title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
29ad0f0d0f34a7fd3718992fd7107bca93120bad.comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
29ad0f0d0f34a7fd3718992fd7107bca93120bad.summary: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.

AI.tldr: CRISS 是一个面向肿瘤登记（癌症登记）的检索增强生成（RAG）对话助手；研究用 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估其在简单/中等/困难登记问题上的证据落地与引用支持能力，RAG 显著优于非 RAG 基线，并强调保留人工最终编码决策权。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤登记员（含肿瘤数据专家 ODS）需解读复杂且频繁更新的编码与分期标准，传统检索与培训/帮助台支持效率有限；研究旨在验证 CRISS 能否提供准确、带引用的登记指南访问，改善指南理解，并支持培训/帮助台场景，同时保持人工对最终抽象编码决策的监督。
AI.method: 构建 CRISS：以国家肿瘤登记标准为领域知识库，切分为带元数据标签的文本片段并索引为稠密嵌入；检索相关片段后由大语言模型（LLM）生成基于引用的回答。评估对象涵盖 Gemini 与 GPT 系列中的开放权重模型、专有模型及非 RAG 基线；在简单、中等、困难三级登记问题上采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 协议，考察证据落地（grounding）与语义相似度等指标。
AI.result: RAG 配置持续优于非 RAG，且问题越难优势越明显。RAG 在简单/中等/困难层级的平均 grounding 分数为 0.62/0.56/0.59，非 RAG 为 0.29/0.26/0.29；RAG 模型整体语义相似度也更高。专有 RAG 模型在简单和中等问题上表现最强，本地 RAG 模型在困难问题上排名最高；专有模型总体回答更谨慎。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用 RAG 可提升肿瘤登记问题的证据落地与回答质量，并在不同复杂度下实现引用支持的辅助。CRISS 体现了以人为中心、引用可溯的 AI 在支持肿瘤登记员方面的潜力，同时保留人工对最终编码决策的监督。

088bbe760c533a4b587b5d0fe0bc1c74763dfaad.title: A Rapid Pipeline for Training and Deploying ML Models on WeBe Band
088bbe760c533a4b587b5d0fe0bc1c74763dfaad.summary:
Developing optimized machine-learning algorithms for edge devices with limited computational and memory resources is challenging, time-consuming, and highly dependent on device-specific constraints. In this work, we streamline an edge ML workflow to enable rapid development, optimization, and deployment of machine-learning (ML) models directly on the WeBe Band, a wrist-worn wearable device designed for multimodal physiological data monitoring. The proposed system automatically generates hardware-efficient ML models that can be easily integrated into the WeBe core firmware, supporting AutoML, hardware-aware quantization, and performance profiling to build models that meet desired latency targets while remaining compatible with device memory and power limitations.
  The proposed framework tightly integrates the open-source Piccolo AI ecosystem with an automated pipeline that generates deployable firmware artifacts, performs hardware-aware model compilation, and supports over-the-air (OTA) deployment. The system supports multiple lightweight model classes, including classical machine-learning algorithms and neural networks, and provides built-in on-device profiling tools to evaluate inference latency and memory footprint under realistic execution conditions. Experimental results demonstrate clear trade-offs between model complexity and deployability on a microcontroller, showing that classical models offer strong real-time performance while lightweight neural networks require careful resource management.
  Rather than proposing new learning architectures, the current work mainly focuses on system-level automation, deployability, and enabling researchers and developers to rapidly iterate on models and evaluate them directly on target hardware. Although demonstrated on the WeBe Band platform, the workflow is designed to be extensible to other ML-powered edge devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向边缘设备的自动化ML工作流，将Piccolo AI生态与自动化流水线结合，可在WeBe Band可穿戴设备上快速开发、优化并部署硬件高效的ML模型，支持AutoML、硬件感知量化、OTA部署与端侧性能剖析。
AI.motivation: 在算力与内存受限的边缘设备上开发优化的机器学习算法极具挑战、耗时且高度依赖具体硬件约束。作者希望降低这一门槛，让研究者与开发者能够快速迭代模型并直接在目标硬件上评估，而非聚焦于提出新的学习架构。
AI.method: 构建端到端边缘ML工作流：自动生成硬件高效的ML模型并集成进WeBe核心固件。系统将开源Piccolo AI生态与自动化流水线紧密耦合，可生成可部署固件产物、执行硬件感知的模型编译并支持OTA空中部署。支持多类轻量模型（经典机器学习算法与神经网络），并内置端侧剖析工具，在真实执行条件下评估推理延迟与内存占用。
AI.result: 实验揭示了模型复杂度与微控制器可部署性之间的明显权衡：经典模型具备较强的实时性能，而轻量神经网络则需要谨慎的资源管理才能满足延迟目标并兼容设备内存与功耗限制。
AI.conclusion: 本工作重点不在新学习架构，而在系统级自动化与可部署性，帮助研究者和开发者快速迭代并直接在目标硬件上评估模型。尽管以WeBe Band为验证平台，该工作流设计上可扩展至其他ML驱动的边缘设备。

3326278883f7c65c5be3bed36382219b3d344736.title: Functional Architecture of European Electricity Trading Markets: Requirements for AI Supported Trading Systems under Regulatory Constraints
3326278883f7c65c5be3bed36382219b3d344736.comment: 12 pages, 1 table. Published in Swissi AI Journal under CC BY 4.0
3326278883f7c65c5be3bed36382219b3d344736.summary: European electricity trading in the EU operates as a constrained multi-layer system in which legal design, exchange microstructure, and network physics are executed jointly across forward, day-ahead, intraday, and balancing horizons. This paper develops a functional architecture for AI-supported trading that is aligned with market-coupling mechanics, cross-zonal transfer constraints, and compliance obligations under REMIT, MiFID II, MiFIR, and EMIR. The contribution is a formal system specification composed of a decision-state vector, residual-exposure accounting, constrained optimization objective, executable-action permission gate, and fail-closed AI control logic with auditable records. The analysis maps major Nominated Electricity Market Operator (NEMO) venues and related exchange operators into an operational venue topology and identifies where cross-border coordination fails in practice: interface-level timing, permission heterogeneity, and balancing-layer coupling. The resulting framework proposes how AI can be deployed as a bounded decision component inside regulated market operation with explicit governance, rather than as an unconstrained prediction layer.

AI.tldr: 论文为欧盟电力交易提出面向AI支持交易的功能架构，将法律设计、交易所微观结构与网络物理约束统一到远期、日前、日内和平衡等时段，并给出形式化系统规范与跨境协调失败点识别。
AI.motivation: 欧盟电力交易是受约束的多层系统，AI应用必须与市场耦合机制、跨区传输约束以及REMIT、MiFID II、MiFIR、EMIR等合规义务对齐；现有做法多将AI视为无约束预测层，缺乏治理、权限边界与可审计控制。
AI.method: 构建功能架构与形式化系统规范，包含决策状态向量、剩余暴露会计、约束优化目标、可执行动作许可门、fail-closed AI控制逻辑与可审计记录；并将主要NEMO场所及相关交易所运营方映射为运营场所拓扑。
AI.result: 识别出实践中跨境协调失败的关键环节：接口级时序、许可异质性以及平衡层耦合；提出AI应作为受监管市场运营中的有界决策组件，而非不受约束的预测层。
AI.conclusion: AI可在明确治理与合规约束下部署为电力交易中的受限决策组件；该框架强调可审计性、故障安全与权限控制，以适配市场耦合、跨区约束和监管要求。

1722c9a72f339d44e50d49a19de5e2cae2fb66e4.title: Sharp Limits for Honest Uncertainty in Hard-Budget Repeated Evaluation
1722c9a72f339d44e50d49a19de5e2cae2fb66e4.summary: Repeated evaluation can estimate a benchmark score accurately while still requiring replication to certify narrow uncertainty. We characterize that requirement on a fixed grid of $M$ tasks with $L$ binary paths per task under the hard budget $(M+t)K$, where each path costs at most $K$ responses or episodes. For fixed $L \ge 3$ and $0 < α\le 1/12$, the optimal expected width on the worst pure cohort is $Θ_{α,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})$ when every task is observed and $Θ_{α,L}([M(t+\sqrt{M})]^{-1/2})$ when omission is allowed. The lower bounds cover adaptive hard-budget policies, and fixed random-subset designs attain both rates through disagreement certificates. A joint mean/disagreement interval turns the task-covering law into practical finite-budget inference. In an equal-budget LiveCodeBench replay with 16 models, 880 tasks, and five outputs per task, the task-covering design reduces median point-estimation MSE by 87.0\% relative to pooled uniform sampling, while the Joint certificate produces narrower confidence intervals in 15/16 panels and reduces median interval width by 30.6\%. Finite-regime analyses identify task coverage as the effective choice at the evaluated scale and characterize how cohort size and within-task agreement determine the useful operating region. Together, the sharp laws and fixed-budget evidence make replication and task coverage explicit design variables for information-efficient repeated evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究重复评估中基准分数的精确估计与窄不确定性认证问题，在固定任务网格和硬预算下刻画复制与任务覆盖的最优设计规律，并用LiveCodeBench回放验证任务覆盖设计可显著降低MSE和置信区间宽度。
AI.motivation: 重复评估虽能较准确估计基准分数，但若要认证较窄的不确定性，仍需复制。作者希望将“复制”与“任务覆盖”从隐含操作转化为可分析、可优化的评估设计变量，并在有限预算下实现信息高效推断。
AI.method: 在包含M个任务、每任务L条二值路径的固定网格上，设定硬预算(M+t)K，每条路径最多消耗K个响应或回合。针对固定L≥3与0<α≤1/12，推导最坏纯队列上的最优期望宽度，分别给出所有任务被观测与允许省略时的Θ速率。下界覆盖自适应硬预算策略，并通过分歧证书证明固定随机子集设计可达相应速率。进一步提出联合均值/分歧区间，将任务覆盖律转化为有限预算推断方法。在LiveCodeBench等预算回放中，使用16个模型、880个任务、每任务5个输出进行实证。
AI.result: 理论结果显示：当所有任务被观测时，最优期望宽度为Θ_{α,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})；允许省略任务时为Θ_{α,L}([M(t+√M)]^{-1/2})。LiveCodeBench回放中，任务覆盖设计相对池化均匀采样将中位点估计MSE降低87.0%；联合证书在16个面板中的15个产生更窄置信区间，并将中位区间宽度降低30.6%。有限区间分析表明，在评估规模下任务覆盖是有效选择，队列大小与任务内一致性决定其有用操作区域。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了重复评估中复制与任务覆盖的尖锐理论律及固定预算实证证据，说明二者应作为信息高效重复评估的显式设计变量。

acc7f23f8f0f35ec62344cc030af5822f95c7b64.title: Baszta: Data-Centric Fine-Tuning of a Polish Multi-Label Safety Classifier
acc7f23f8f0f35ec62344cc030af5822f95c7b64.summary:
We develop a multi-label Polish content-safety classifier by fine-tuning allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M) across five categories (hate, vulgarity, sexual content, crime, self-harm) using a Focal + R-Drop objective, and evaluate the resulting model against Bielik Guard (Sójka) on the shared out-of-distribution Gadzi Język benchmark. Both systems are given per-category threshold tuning on the same calibration split. Under that matched protocol our model holds a small but statistically significant lead in micro F1, while an apparent macro-F1 lead does not survive: it was an artifact of comparing a tuned model against an untuned one. We also report what that micro figure is worth. Because Gadzi Język is 97% crime-positive, a classifier that flags crime on every input and nothing else already scores 0.910 micro F1 on the same test split, so micro separates neither system from a degenerate strategy and macro is the column that does. Per-category and per-protocol figures are reported in Section 4.
  The residual out-of-distribution gap is one of calibration rather than discrimination. Ranking quality stays high while positive probabilities collapse, and per-category temperature scaling recovers the loss where Platt scaling and isotonic regression do not. That recovery turns out to be conditional on the calibration set containing safe text. Gadzi Język contains almost none, so thresholds fitted on it flag crime on every safe input, and a balanced refit buys a deployable operating point at the cost of adversarial recall. We report both operating points rather than only the flattering one.
  Two changes that are standard practice, per-class cost-sensitive weighting and mean pooling, each raise in-distribution macro F1 while lowering the out-of-distribution figure, which indicates that robustness has to be selected for directly rather than inherited from in-distribution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文微调 HerBERT 构建波兰语多标签内容安全分类器，并与 Bielik Guard 在 OOD 基准 Gadzi Język 上按匹配阈值协议比较；核心发现是 micro-F1 受 97% crime 基率与退化策略干扰，macro-F1 才具区分度，残余 OOD 差距主要是校准而非判别能力，且鲁棒性需显式选择。
AI.motivation: 评估波兰语内容安全模型在分布外场景下的真实鲁棒性，纠正因阈值调优不对等、指标基率偏斜和退化策略导致的误导性结论，并厘清 OOD 性能下降究竟来自判别能力还是概率校准，为部署操作点选择提供依据。
AI.method: 以 allegro/herbert-base-cased（124M）为骨干，在 hate、vulgarity、sexual content、crime、self-harm 五类上进行多标签微调，采用 Focal + R-Drop 目标；与 Bielik Guard（Sójka）在共享 OOD 基准 Gadzi Język 上评测。两系统均在同一校准划分上做逐类别阈值调优。分析 micro/macro F1、退化基线，并比较逐类别温度缩放、Platt scaling 与 isotonic regression；同时考察 per-class cost-sensitive weighting 与 mean pooling 对 ID/OOD 的影响。
AI.result: 匹配协议下，本模型 micro-F1 小幅但统计显著领先；表观 macro-F1 领先不成立，因为对比的是已调优模型与未调优模型。Gadzi Język 中 97% 为 crime 正例，一个仅将所有输入判为 crime 的退化分类器已达 0.910 micro-F1，说明 micro 无法区分系统与退化策略，macro 才能。OOD 残余差距主要是校准问题：排序质量高但正类概率坍缩；逐类别温度缩放可恢复损失，Platt 与 isotonic 不行，且恢复依赖校准集包含安全文本。Gadzi Język 几乎不含安全文本，阈值拟合后会把所有安全输入判为 crime；平衡重拟合可获得可部署操作点，但牺牲对抗召回。逐类别代价敏感加权与 mean pooling 均提升 ID macro-F1，却降低 OOD 表现。
AI.conclusion: 在极端偏斜的 OOD 内容安全评测中，应报告 macro-F1 与退化基线，不能仅凭 micro-F1 下结论；OOD 鲁棒性需通过显式选择和校准获得，不能从 ID 准确率中继承；应同时报告不同操作点及其召回代价。逐类别与逐协议细节见 Section 4。
