6727389d10eb82e91760ae5c97fb0a989e8c6f9c.title: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
6727389d10eb82e91760ae5c97fb0a989e8c6f9c.summary: Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the edited model. We propose ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing), which learns semantic addresses from paraphrases and hard same-subject negatives, aligns them with autoregressive hidden states through rollout refinement and gate calibration, and embeds the resulting gated low-rank operator within one MLP layer, so that the deployed model runs in a single forward pass with no external retriever or auxiliary router. Evaluated on CounterFact, ZSRE, and KnowEdit across three 7--8B model families, ALOE achieves efficacy between 0.955 and 0.999 and locality between 0.981 and 1.000; mechanistic analyses confirm that the learned geometry separates competing edits and that calibration suppresses out-of-scope activation. The remaining errors concentrate in paraphrase coverage and write fitting.

AI.tldr: ALOE 将知识编辑视为“写入+寻址”问题，通过学习语义地址并将门控低秩算子嵌入 MLP 层，实现单次前向传播内精确更新，无需外部检索器或路由器；在多个基准上取得高功效与高局部性。
AI.motivation: 知识编辑通常被当作参数写入问题，但还涉及“地址”问题：新残差应作用于哪些隐藏状态。激活范围过窄会只记住特定提示，过宽则会破坏邻近知识。参数化编辑器隐式编码作用范围，基于记忆的编辑器虽显式选择但依赖模型外部机制。
AI.method: 提出 ALOE（Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing）：从同义改写和困难同主体负例中学习语义地址；通过 rollout refinement 与 gate calibration 将其与自回归隐藏状态对齐；把生成的门控低秩算子嵌入单个 MLP 层，使部署模型单次前向传播即可完成编辑，无需外部检索器或辅助路由器。
AI.result: 在 CounterFact、ZSRE 和 KnowEdit 上，覆盖三个 7–8B 模型家族，ALOE 的功效为 0.955–0.999，局部性为 0.981–1.000。机制分析表明，学习到的几何结构能区分相互竞争的编辑，门控校准可抑制超出作用范围的激活。剩余错误主要集中在同义改写覆盖和写入拟合。
AI.conclusion: ALOE 将编辑作用范围的选择显式化并内化到被编辑模型中，在功效与局部性之间取得较好平衡；但同义改写覆盖不足与写入拟合仍是主要误差来源。

df9f85dfeec741e57a0900ad7a4b5b62505d5fdb.title: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
df9f85dfeec741e57a0900ad7a4b5b62505d5fdb.summary: Visual software often needs a decision over supplied alternatives rather than a generated explanation. We present PixelJev, a native-image decision interface that maps an image, a task instruction, and a runtime candidate set to a structured choice and candidate-conditioned probabilities using small open multimodal models. Its initial realization unifies recognition and multiplechoice visual question answering through an existing language-model readout, with separately evaluated options for frozen inference, language-side adaptation, and held-out calibration. Across seven benchmark evaluations, 64-shot source adaptation raises Pets accuracy from 60.13% to 92.40% across optimization seeds and transfers to natural resampling, new texture labels, and A-OKVQA without target fitting, while frozen inference already supports both VQA tasks. A matched prompt-only follow-up on Pets and ScienceQA attributes the large Pets gain to adaptation and identifies a narrower output validity benefit of candidate readout in adapted VQA. Specialist DINOv2 probes remain stronger on source recognition, frozen 4B is stronger than adapted 2B on DTD and ScienceQA, and accuracy gains do not ensure calibrated target probabilities. These findings establish a working starting point for general-purpose visual decision models and identify the remaining requirements: schema robustness, cross-family transfer, and reliable use of visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 PixelJev——一种面向“候选选择”的原生图像决策接口，用小型开放多模态模型将图像、任务指令和运行时候选集映射为结构化选择及候选条件概率，并在多项基准上验证冻结推理、语言侧适配与校准。
AI.motivation: 视觉软件通常需要在给定候选中作出决策，而不是生成开放式解释；现有方法多偏重生成式回答，缺少统一的候选决策接口与评估。
AI.method: PixelJev 接收图像、任务指令和运行时候选集，输出结构化选择与候选条件概率；以小型开放多模态模型为底座，通过现有语言模型 readout 统一识别与多选 VQA，并分别评估冻结推理、语言侧适配和留出校准三种设置。
AI.result: 在 7 项基准评估中，64-shot 源适配将 Pets 准确率从 60.13% 提升至 92.40%，跨优化种子稳定，并可迁移到自然重采样、新纹理标签和 A-OKVQA，且无需目标域拟合；冻结推理已能支持两类 VQA 任务。匹配的 prompt-only 后续实验将 Pets 的大幅增益归因于适配，并发现候选 readout 在适配 VQA 中带来较窄的输出有效性收益。DINOv2 专家探针在源识别上仍更强，冻结 4B 模型在 DTD 与 ScienceQA 上强于适配 2B 模型，且准确率提升并不保证目标概率校准。
AI.conclusion: PixelJev 为通用视觉决策模型提供了可工作的起点，同时指出后续关键需求：schema 鲁棒性、跨模型家族迁移，以及可靠利用视觉证据。

2b663f77a7fe09087fd935695bb403837da33424.title: When No One Owns the Judgment: Accountability Under Contribution Dissolution in Human-AI Collaboration
2b663f77a7fe09087fd935695bb403837da33424.comment: In CSCW'26 workshop on contribution, originality, and accountability in agent-mediated collaboration
2b663f77a7fe09087fd935695bb403837da33424.summary: Communities often respond to potentially AI-assisted work by asking three questions: Was AI used? Was that use disclosed? Can hidden use be detected? These questions place AI use itself at the center of accountability while overlooking a deeper problem: unowned judgment. Evaluations, claims, decisions, and creative directions can be shaped by AI with no accountable human or institution prepared to stand behind them. We develop this argument through two illustrative cases: AI-assisted peer review and concealed AI use in creative work. The first shows how contribution dissolution can weaken responsibility while the second shows how the fear of losing credit can discourage honest disclosure. The cases expose the limits of disclosure rules and provenance records as responses to AI-mediated collaboration. We offer three directions for discussion: distinguishing the roles AI plays, identifying judgments that require clear human ownership, and creating conditions in which AI involvement can be disclosed without default penalty. The broader aim is to make AI-shaped contributions discussable, creditable, contestable, and repairable.

AI.tldr: 论文主张：AI辅助工作的问责焦点不应止于“是否使用、是否披露、能否检测”，而应关注更深层的“无主判断”（unowned judgment）——评价、主张、决策与创作方向可由AI塑造，却无明确的人类或机构为其负责。作者通过AI辅助同行评审与创意工作中隐瞒AI使用两个案例，揭示披露规则与来源记录的局限，并提出三条讨论方向，目标是让AI塑造的贡献可讨论、可署名、可争议、可修复。
AI.motivation: 社区面对潜在AI辅助工作时常追问三件事：是否用了AI、是否披露、能否检测出隐藏使用。这种框架把“AI使用”本身置于问责中心，却忽视更严重的问题：无主判断。即AI可影响评价、主张、决策和创作方向，但没有任何可问责的人或机构准备为其站台。论文试图把问责重心从“使用行为”转向“判断归属”。
AI.method: 采用概念论证与说明性案例分析。选取两个案例：其一为AI辅助同行评审，展示“贡献消解”（contribution dissolution）如何削弱责任归属；其二为创意工作中隐瞒AI使用，展示对失去功劳的担忧如何抑制诚实披露。在此基础上评估披露规则与来源记录（provenance records）作为AI中介协作治理手段的局限，并提出三个讨论方向。
AI.result: 两个案例表明：披露规则和来源记录不足以应对AI中介协作中的责任空缺。论文提出三条方向：区分AI所扮演的不同角色；识别哪些判断必须具有清晰的人类所有权；创造使AI参与可被披露而不默认受罚的条件。
AI.conclusion: 更广泛的目标是让AI塑造的贡献变得可讨论、可署名/可归功、可争议、可修复。问责不应只问“是否使用AI”，而应追问“谁拥有其中的判断并愿意为其负责”。

f149cd767b6c28f2be0eb6a4c706c23e7b52fe13.title: SkinAgent AI: A Safety-Grounded Multimodal Agentic Framework for Non-Diagnostic Skincare Support
f149cd767b6c28f2be0eb6a4c706c23e7b52fe13.comment: Submitted to JMIR AI and currently under peer review
f149cd767b6c28f2be0eb6a4c706c23e7b52fe13.summary: Consumer-facing skincare AI must coordinate visual evidence, product information, tool use, and user-facing actions within explicit evidence and safety boundaries. This study evaluates SkinAgent AI, a non-diagnostic multimodal framework that combines visual concern routing with grounded and auditable LLM-based orchestration. The architecture includes routing for Acne, Pores, and Wrinkles; photograph-based skin-type estimation; count-informed ordinal acne-severity support; typed tools; database-grounded recommendation and action functions; deterministic safety, privacy, and evidence checks; approval before state-changing actions; and structured trace and replay mechanisms. Visual-model performance and system-level agent behavior were evaluated separately. Across three seeds, the skin-condition routing model achieved 99.84% +/- 0.07% accuracy. Skin-type estimation achieved 88.85% accuracy, while count-informed acne-severity support achieved 84.59% accuracy with a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.9076. On a locked but non-independent 240-case system benchmark, intent accuracy was 80.00%, exact tool-set match was 62.92%, and strict task completion was 47.08%. No violations or successful cross-user leakage events were observed in the finite safety and privacy test suites. Tool-selection errors, incomplete grounding of product attributes, and unreliable failure fallback nevertheless remained. These findings support the feasibility of bounded, database-grounded, and traceable agent orchestration for non-diagnostic skincare assistance. They do not establish clinical readiness, external generalization, formal privacy guarantees, or universal safety. Independent validation, expert assessment, robustness and fairness testing, and prospective evaluation in real-world settings remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 提出非诊断性多模态护肤智能体框架 SkinAgent AI，结合视觉路由与可审计的 LLM 编排及确定性安全/隐私/证据校验，视觉任务表现良好，但系统级任务完成率与工具调用仍存在不足。
AI.motivation: 面向消费者的护肤AI必须在明确的证据与安全边界内，协调视觉证据、产品信息、工具调用与面向用户的动作。
AI.method: 提出 SkinAgent AI——一个非诊断性多模态框架，将视觉问题路由与基于LLM的可溯源、可审计编排相结合。架构包含：针对痤疮（Acne）、毛孔（Pores）、皱纹（Wrinkles）的路由；基于照片的肤质估计；结合计数的序数式痤疮严重度支持；类型化工具（typed tools）；基于数据库的推荐与动作函数；确定性的安全、隐私与证据校验；状态变更动作前的审批机制；以及结构化追踪与回放机制。视觉模型性能与系统级智能体行为分开评估。
AI.result: 在三个随机种子上，皮肤状况路由模型准确率达 99.84% ± 0.07%；肤质估计准确率 88.85%；结合计数的痤疮严重度支持准确率 84.59%，二次加权 kappa 为 0.9076。在锁定的 240 例（非独立）系统基准上，意图准确率 80.00%，工具集精确匹配 62.92%，严格任务完成率 47.08%。在有限的安全与隐私测试套件中未观察到违规或成功的跨用户泄漏事件。但仍存在工具选择错误、产品属性依据不充分（grounding 不完整）以及失败回退不可靠等问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持"有界、基于数据库、可追溯"的智能体编排在非诊断性护肤辅助中的可行性；但未证明临床就绪性、外部泛化能力、形式化隐私保障或普适安全性。仍需独立验证、专家评估、鲁棒性与公平性测试，以及真实场景下的前瞻性评估。

6d343e7cc0864708a8c1807a04b9756607a918d2.title: The Last Human Gate: Forward Deployed Engineering for Governance Automation
6d343e7cc0864708a8c1807a04b9756607a918d2.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code, datasets, generated documents, and model traces available at https://github.com/jeremy1392/dgf-agentic-bench
6d343e7cc0864708a8c1807a04b9756607a918d2.summary: Enterprise governance requires decisions, evidence, and accountable authority; it does not require every review task to retain its current human implementation. We develop a task-substitution framework for Digital Governance Frameworks (DGF), treating each gate as an executable contract. Substitution requires sufficient accessible information, valid decision and authority checks, and a reduction in total human work after exceptions, verification, correction, and maintenance are counted. We derive a residual-work threshold and show why automating most cases can still increase labor. Forward deployed engineering connects these conditions to an architecture for agents, rule engines, evidence services, and escalation. DGF-Bench supplies controlled evidence from 300 synthetic projects and 899 evaluable model-project runs. Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, and DeepSeek v4.1 Flash achieve strict gate success of 94.98%, 83.29%, and 74.18%; complete-route success is 76.92%, 42.33%, and 24.67%. A deterministic control passes all 1,700 gates given the supplied rules and structured facts, locating the comparison in execution of a supplied decision kernel. Evidence audits and 135 repeated runs distinguish correct decisions from reliable execution. A document counterexample establishes an information-sufficiency obstruction. These results support the technical feasibility of replacing human execution of specified governance-review tasks with agents and software. The framework specifies a workforce test based on the complete human effort required at fixed output and quality; the present measurements concern review performance. Sources, dossiers, traces, and analyses are public.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向数字治理框架（DGF）的任务替代框架，将每个治理“门”视为可执行契约，给出替代条件与残余工作量阈值，并用DGF-Bench评测智能体执行治理审查任务的技术可行性。
AI.motivation: 企业治理需要决策、证据与可问责权威，但并不要求每项审查任务都维持人工执行。核心问题是：何时可以用智能体/软件替代人工执行，且替代后总人类工作量在计入异常、验证、纠正与维护后仍能下降，而非因自动化大部分常规案例反而增加劳动。
AI.method: 构建任务替代框架，将每个治理门建模为可执行契约，要求满足可获取信息充分性、有效决策与权限检查、以及总人类工作量下降三类条件；推导残余工作量阈值。结合前向部署工程，提出由智能体、规则引擎、证据服务与升级机制组成的架构。构建DGF-Bench：300个合成项目、899条可评估的模型-项目运行；设置确定性控制；进行证据审计与135次重复运行；并用文档反例验证信息充分性障碍。
AI.result: Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash的严格门成功率分别为94.98%、83.29%、74.18%；完整路线成功率为76.92%、42.33%、24.67%。确定性控制在给定规则与结构化事实下通过全部1,700个门，表明比较重点在于对给定决策内核的执行。证据审计与135次重复运行用于区分“决策正确”与“执行可靠”。文档反例确立了信息充分性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持用智能体与软件替代“已明确规定的治理审查任务”之人工执行的技术可行性。框架提出基于固定产出与质量下完整人类工作量的劳动力检验；但当前测量仅关注审查性能，尚未完成完整劳动力检验。来源、档案、轨迹与分析均已公开。

4c08d576fc00003c5380e9e15dfc446ca0afd9cc.title: Beyond Simple Input-Output Assessment Tasks: Leveraging Automated Programming Assessment for Non-Trivial Courses
4c08d576fc00003c5380e9e15dfc446ca0afd9cc.summary: The public visibility of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, driven by the positive impact of its applications across diverse fields of knowledge. In this new chapter, courses that cover the foundations of AI and machine learning become essential for understanding their role and potential in contemporary society. Therefore, understanding fundamental concepts and elementary algorithms through the close integration of theory with practice is essential in AI courses. In this essay, we report our experience designing machine learning exercises for automated assessment tools in programming. It is worth mentioning that we are not developing a novel form of automated grading system. Instead, we propose a perspective that frames machine learning problems as input-output assessment tasks. From this perspective, each exercise admits a unique and deterministic answer and enables automated programming assessment tools (e.g., VPL for Moodle, Codeforces, and MOJ) to effectively support AI education. We believe this essay can encourage instructors to foster educational innovation by adopting more dynamic and interactive approaches to AI courses that integrate theory and practice. Importantly, this essay does not introduce an innovation in the use of AI for education; rather, it introduces an innovative approach to improving the learning of AI, particularly, machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇经验报告，提出将机器学习问题重构为“输入-输出评估任务”，使每道练习具有唯一且确定性的答案，从而可借助现有自动编程评测工具（如 Moodle VPL、Codeforces、MOJ）支持 AI 教学。
AI.motivation: AI 的公众可见度快速提升，其应用已渗透多个知识领域；因此，涵盖 AI 与机器学习基础的课程对理解其在当代社会中的作用与潜力至关重要。AI 课程需要将理论与实践的紧密结合，帮助学生掌握基本概念和基础算法。
AI.method: 作者报告了为自动编程评测工具设计机器学习练习的经验。其核心不是开发新型自动评分系统，而是提出一种视角：把机器学习问题框定为输入-输出评估任务，使每个练习都有唯一且确定性的答案，进而可由 VPL for Moodle、Codeforces、MOJ 等自动编程评测工具进行评判。
AI.result: 该视角使自动编程评测工具能够有效支持 AI 教育。论文属于经验与观点性报告，并未报告实验数据或系统性能结果，也未声称在“AI 用于教育”方面有创新。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望鼓励教师采用更具动态性和互动性的 AI 课程方式，将理论与实践整合，以促进教育创新。本文的创新点在于改进 AI（尤其是机器学习）的学习方式，而非将 AI 应用于教育本身。

8e9b273497f4a77c00e6f0f89ad3d17e1ffc680a.title: Epistemic-Probabilistic Model for Guarded Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
8e9b273497f4a77c00e6f0f89ad3d17e1ffc680a.summary: Multi-agent large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous in applied AI, yet their theoretical foundations remain surprisingly understudied. Viewed through the lens of multi-agent systems theory, several shortcomings come to light: a lack of social intelligence, the absence of coordination mechanisms among agents, unknown emergent behavior, and interactions between agents that are bounded by natural language. We address two of these gaps: the absence of social behavior and the lack of mechanisms for inter-agent coordination. We introduce Epistemic Probabilistic Language Agents (EPLA), a neuro-symbolic architecture for multi-agent coordination under uncertainty. A Symbolic Guard provides structured diagnostic feedback. The LLM generates typed actions, and the Guard controls their execution against an authoritative symbolic state. We formalize the epistemic layer in a gossip testbed through epistemic lottery gossip models, which combine view-based call histories with agent-indexed probability weights. We argue that implementing such a formalism can address shortcomings of agentic LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出EPLA神经符号架构，用符号守卫（Symbolic Guard）对LLM生成的类型化动作进行权威符号状态校验，并在流言（gossip）测试台中以认知彩票流言模型形式化智能体认知层，以弥补多智能体LLM在社会行为与协调机制上的理论缺失。
AI.motivation: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）在应用AI中已十分普遍，但其理论基础仍严重不足。从多智能体系统理论视角看，存在若干缺陷：缺乏社会智能、智能体间缺少协调机制、涌现行为未知、智能体交互受自然语言限制。本文聚焦其中两个缺口：社会行为的缺失与智能体间协调机制的缺乏。
AI.method: 提出EPLA（Epistemic Probabilistic Language Agents），一种面向不确定性下多智能体协调的神经符号架构。其中，符号守卫（Symbolic Guard）提供结构化诊断反馈；LLM生成类型化动作（typed actions），守卫依据权威符号状态（authoritative symbolic state）控制这些动作的执行。并在流言测试台中，通过认知彩票流言模型（epistemic lottery gossip models）形式化认知层，该模型将基于视图的调用历史（view-based call histories）与按智能体索引的概率权重（agent-indexed probability weights）相结合。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实证结果或量化指标；作者主张，实现该形式化方法能够弥补智能体式LLM的上述不足。
AI.conclusion: 通过EPLA这一神经符号架构与认知彩票流言模型的形式化，可为多智能体LLM引入社会行为与协调机制，从而回应其理论基础的薄弱问题。

2a17a60ea4ee05e5af7b1999a62011cf9abac2cb.title: An auditable conditional-strategy framework for open-ended decision-making in complex lung cancer
2a17a60ea4ee05e5af7b1999a62011cf9abac2cb.summary:
Complex lung cancer decisions can involve several defensible pathways whose eligibility, sequencing and safety depend on unresolved information. Effective support must make explicit how patient conditions govern pathway eligibility, deferral and redirection. MedGPT Clinical Explorer (MCE) organizes alternatives, decision-changing unknowns, safety constraints and fallback into a conditional strategy for clinician review. To evaluate this representation in physician-authored strategies, multidisciplinary experts established case-specific references for 40 cases within a purposive 100-case corpus, and 250 physicians from 98 institutions produced 2,250 strategies under unaided, retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions.
  MCE-assisted strategies expressed more applicable clinical requirements, measured by the Admissible Pathway Attainment Score (APAS; 0-100), than unaided strategies (adjusted difference, 12.87; 95% CI, 11.18-14.55) and retrieval-reference strategies (5.22; 3.52-6.93). With the same knowledge base available in the retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions, the additional content centered on candidate pathways, decision-critical information and safety constraints. Physicians' whole-strategy acceptability judgments correlated with APAS (Spearman's rho = 0.671), while a complementary relationship audit assessed whether candidates, conditions and subsequent actions were coherently connected.
  Together, these findings identify two complementary dimensions of open-ended decision support: coverage of clinically relevant content and coherent links among pathways, conditions and subsequent actions. MCE provides a shared decision object that makes consequential omissions and pathway contingencies visible before action; prospective studies should evaluate its effects on clinical workflow and patient outcomes.

AI.tldr: MedGPT Clinical Explorer（MCE）将肺癌复杂决策中的候选路径、决策关键未知、安全约束与回退方案组织为条件化策略；在100例语料中由多学科专家为40例建立参考，250名医生在无辅助、检索参考与MCE辅助下生成2250份策略。MCE辅助策略的APAS显著更高，且医生整体可接受性与APAS相关；研究表明开放式决策支持需兼顾临床相关内容覆盖与路径—条件—后续行动的一致性。
AI.motivation: 肺癌复杂决策涉及多条合理路径，其资格、排序和安全性依赖尚未解决的信息。有效支持必须明确患者条件如何决定路径资格、延迟和重定向。
AI.method: MCE将替代方案、改变决策的未知信息、安全约束和回退方案组织为供医生审阅的条件化策略。在100例目的性语料中，多学科专家为40例建立病例特异参考；250名来自98家机构的医生在无辅助、检索参考和MCE辅助三种条件下生成2250份策略。评估指标包括Admissible Pathway Attainment Score（APAS，0—100）、整体策略可接受性判断及关系审计。
AI.result: MCE辅助策略的APAS高于无辅助策略（调整差异12.87；95% CI 11.18—14.55）和检索参考策略（5.22；3.52—6.93）。在检索参考与MCE辅助共享同一知识库时，额外内容集中于候选路径、决策关键信息和安全约束。医生整体策略可接受性判断与APAS相关（Spearman's rho=0.671）；补充关系审计评估候选、条件与后续行动是否连贯连接。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出开放式决策支持的两个互补维度：临床相关内容的覆盖度，以及路径、条件与后续行动之间的连贯链接。MCE提供共享决策对象，使重要遗漏和路径偶然性在行动前可见；仍需前瞻性研究评估其对临床工作流和患者结局的影响。

f66f4e632ce04108657aa2a1d62108b51905012a.title: Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
f66f4e632ce04108657aa2a1d62108b51905012a.summary: This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 databases. Subsequently, the paper demonstrates how complicated ECG noise can be investigated by the SQA model and the physical contextual data.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估一种基于深度学习的动态心电信号质量评估模型，用于区分干净与含噪动态ECG；模型在CACHET-CADB上训练，并在MIT及PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021等数据库上表现稳定，结合物理情境数据可分析复杂ECG噪声。
AI.motivation: 动态ECG在真实场景中易受复杂噪声干扰，需要自动化的信号质量评估方法来识别可用与不可用信号；同时，现有动态ECG数据多缺乏物理环境与患者报告的情境信息，限制了对复杂噪声成因的分析。
AI.method: 构建基于深度学习的信号质量评估（SQA）模型，以CACHET-CADB为训练数据；该数据库被认为是首个同时包含物理情境数据和患者报告情境数据的动态ECG数据库。随后在MIT系列数据库及PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021数据库上进行跨库验证，并结合SQA模型与物理情境数据研究复杂ECG噪声。
AI.result: 模型在不同数据库上均表现出稳定性能，说明其具有一定跨库泛化能力；同时，SQA模型结合物理情境数据可用于探究复杂ECG噪声的特征与来源。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度学习的SQA模型能够有效区分干净与含噪动态ECG，并具备跨数据库稳定性；引入物理与患者报告的情境数据，有助于更深入地理解和分析复杂ECG噪声，为动态ECG质量评估提供了新思路。

1225d95e30e1ac31f6b6c7bb38f0a142ccefb5f8.title: RD-JEPA: Predictive latent pretraining for few-trajectory transfer across reaction--diffusion equations
1225d95e30e1ac31f6b6c7bb38f0a142ccefb5f8.summary: Learning surrogates for time-dependent partial differential equations often requires a new simulation corpus when the governing operator changes. We introduce RD-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for self-supervised pretraining on reaction-diffusion trajectories. A single model is pretrained on five parameterized systems and then adapted to three held-out systems whose reaction operators and trajectories are excluded from pretraining. Using one, five, or ten complete trajectories from a held-out system, RD-JEPA achieves lower mean relative discrete $\ell^2$ field error and mean absolute spatial first-difference error than five supervised surrogate baselines, an independently trained control that removes the trajectory-dependent predictive latent pathway, and an architecture-matched model trained from scratch. Within the evaluated equations, output resolution, forecast horizons, and choices of adaptation trajectories, the results indicate that prediction of future-state representations can support data-efficient adaptation across related reaction-diffusion systems.

AI.tldr: RD-JEPA：用联合嵌入预测架构在反应-扩散轨迹上自监督预训练，单一模型跨五个参数化系统预训练，再以少量轨迹适配三个未见系统，误差低于多种监督基线。
AI.motivation: 为含时偏微分方程学习代理模型时，控制算子一旦变化通常需要重新生成整套仿真数据，跨算子泛化与数据效率不足。作者希望验证：预测未来状态的表示能否支持跨相关反应-扩散系统的数据高效适配。
AI.method: 提出 RD-JEPA，一种面向反应-扩散轨迹的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）自监督预训练方法。先在五个参数化系统上预训练单一模型，再迁移到三个留出系统，其反应算子和轨迹不参与预训练。适配时仅使用留出系统的1、5或10条完整轨迹。
AI.result: 在留出系统上，RD-JEPA的平均相对离散 \(\ell^2\) 场误差和平均绝对空间一阶差分误差均低于五类监督代理基线、一个去除轨迹相关预测潜变量通路的独立训练对照，以及一个架构匹配的从零训练模型。结论限定于所评估的方程、输出分辨率、预测时域和适配轨迹选择。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，未来状态表示的预测可支持相关反应-扩散系统间的数据高效适配，减少算子变化时对新仿真语料的需求。

c7b7e0435729d30094907e8db58052b1afd5e15a.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
c7b7e0435729d30094907e8db58052b1afd5e15a.summary: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 RLCDAlignBench，首次评测经 RLCD 训练的模型 Jev 在十类对齐失败检测上的表现；核心思路是将"提问方式"与"输入内容"分离，单一通用问题即可零样本达到中位 AUROC 0.886，多数基准上超越监督基线，且成本比 LLM 评判器低 63 倍。
AI.motivation: 对齐失败检测器用于筛查已部署的语言模型并对齐基准打分。现有方法多为生成式评判器，需对每条准则消耗一次解码过程；即便是 Llama Guard 这类读取 token 概率的分类器，每次调用也只能给出一个固定标签。Jev 是经强化学习校准决策（RLCD）训练、能在单次调用中以校准概率回答关于同一输入的多个类型化问题的模型，但其检测对齐失败的能力尚未被测量。
AI.method: 构建 RLCDAlignBench，在十类对齐失败（谄媚、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私侵犯、社会偏见、奖励黑客、隐瞒不确定性、权力寻求）上评测 Jev，覆盖 44 个基准和五个目标模型，由各基准自身的评分器标注，其中两个还由人工标注。鉴于许多失败是相对的（需参照用户信念或注入指令等响应本身无法揭示的信息），核心方法是将"提问方式"与"所看内容"解耦：一侧变化问题的措辞与答案类型，另一侧变化输入的字段。
AI.result: 单一通用问题即达到零样本中位 AUROC 0.886，并在多数基准上超越监督基线；问题措辞影响很小，而上下文影响更大，且主要通过编码标签的字段起作用。Jev 与参考评分器在人工标签上的一致性相当，并能揭示现有基准中的标签缺陷，同时成本比 LLM 评判器低 63 倍。
AI.conclusion: Jev 在单次调用中即能高效、校准地检测多类对齐失败，性能与参考评分器相当，可发现现有基准的标注缺陷，并以显著更低的成本替代 LLM 评判器，为对齐失败检测提供了高效且可扩展的方案。

cb7b0c2adfbf2f6a2903144c477db9b99bc71fa5.title: SWE-Prometheus: Measuring Engineering Governance Improvements in Real-World Repositories
cb7b0c2adfbf2f6a2903144c477db9b99bc71fa5.summary: Large language model based coding agents have made substantial progress on repository-level software engineering tasks. Existing repository benchmarks, however, usually start from a human-identified issue and evaluate whether a patch satisfies a functional signal. We present SWE-Prometheus, a benchmark for the broader task of improving repository engineering governance. Each task provides a fixed snapshot and an open-ended objective, requiring the agent to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and verify the resulting changes. SWE-Prometheus evaluates six governance dimensions through paired evidence, clean-environment probes, behavior gates, and two independent teacher ratings of the same evidence. The benchmark contains 60 repositories; ten models are evaluated on a shared 22-repository public subset, where mean Normalized Governance Improvement ranges from 0.0568 to 0.5760 and observed behavior-breakage rates range from 0% to 23%. On a frozen ten-repository batch, a repository-blind template obtains mean NGI 0.272, but its gains concentrate in Tests & CI, Quality Gates, and Documentation; it improves Reproducible Environment and Dependency & Security on none of the repositories. This baseline makes the distinction between adding governance artifacts and producing execution-backed improvements measurable. The no-op condition has median NGI zero and standard deviation 0.073; two teachers agree exactly on 57 of 60 dimension scores for the same no-op evidence. For the two highest conditional-mean systems, common-valid NGI is similar, while full-pool comparisons that include behavior failures favor Kimi-K3. These results show why repository-governance evaluation should report improvement, behavior preservation, evidence quality, and coverage together.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SWE-Prometheus，一个面向仓库工程治理改进的基准，通过开放式目标、配对证据、干净环境探针、行为门和双教师评分评估 60 个仓库，并主张治理评估应同时报告改进、行为保持、证据质量与覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级基准通常从人工识别的问题出发，仅评估补丁是否满足某个功能信号，范围较窄。论文希望覆盖更广泛的仓库工程治理任务：要求智能体识别风险、确定干预优先级并验证改动效果，同时区分“仅添加治理产物”与“产生有执行支撑的改进”。
AI.method: SWE-Prometheus 为每个任务提供固定仓库快照和开放式目标。基准从六个治理维度进行评估，采用配对证据、干净环境探针、行为门以及两位独立教师对同一证据的评分。基准包含 60 个仓库；十个模型在共享的 22 仓库公共子集上评测。另在冻结的十仓库批次上设置 repository-blind 模板基线与 no-op 条件，并报告 NGI、行为破坏率、common-valid NGI 及全池比较等指标。
AI.result: 公共子集上平均 Normalized Governance Improvement 为 0.0568 至 0.5760，观测行为破坏率为 0% 至 23%。冻结十仓库批次中，repository-blind 模板平均 NGI 为 0.272，收益集中在 Tests & CI、Quality Gates 和 Documentation，在 Reproducible Environment 与 Dependency & Security 上未改善任何仓库。no-op 条件的中位 NGI 为 0、标准差为 0.073；两位教师对同一 no-op 证据在 60 个维度分数中有 57 个完全一致。对两个条件均值最高的系统，common-valid NGI 相近，但纳入行为失败的全池比较更有利于 Kimi-K3。
AI.conclusion: 仓库治理评估不应只看单一功能信号或治理产物数量，而应同时报告改进程度、行为保持情况、证据质量与覆盖范围。

c25aa9c19d87bd74e1b0f5585945dc3b4f223296.title: Evaluation of Multi-Turn Consistency in LLM Agents: Survival Analysis and Failure-Rationale Taxonomy
c25aa9c19d87bd74e1b0f5585945dc3b4f223296.comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
c25aa9c19d87bd74e1b0f5585945dc3b4f223296.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents may perform well on isolated tasks yet drift into inconsistency over extended interaction. We evaluate temporal consistency in a controlled 20-step multi-agent setting inspired by delayed-gratification studies. At each step, an agent chooses between continuing to delay a reward or claiming it immediately (terminating the episode). Across a full-factorial manipulation of social visibility (private vs public), persona stressors, and deliberation policy, we run 84,540 trajectories spanning 8 model families. Treating the first reward-claim as a time-to-event outcome, we estimate Kaplan-Meier survival curves and fit discrete-time hazard regression to quantify how experimental factors shift failure risk over time. Then, to analyze rationales and language patterns associated with failure, we build a seven-category taxonomy from 13,780 deliberation traces from agents who choose to terminate the episode, using an LLM-assisted labeling paired with human audit ($κ=0.83$). Rationale profiles change systematically with time and context: early failures are more impulse-driven, later failures more fatigue- and cost-benefit-framed, while public settings increase norm-oriented justifications. We also find a deliberation-inconsistency association: among failures, longer deliberation correlates with higher rates of intra-rationale contradiction (simultaneous pro-delay and pro-claim statements), challenging the assumption that more reasoning text implies greater consistency. Together, the survival and rationale analyses reveal distinct temporal reliability regimes and model-specific "failure fingerprints", offering an evaluation lens for diagnosing inconsistency in multi-turn agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究在受控的20步多智能体延迟满足情境中评估LLM智能体的时间一致性，通过生存分析与推理文本分类，揭示了随时间演化的失败模式与模型特定的"失败指纹"。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽在孤立任务上表现良好，但在长时间交互中会逐渐陷入不一致（drift into inconsistency）。现有评估多关注单轮或短程表现，缺乏对多轮交互中时间一致性的系统刻画，因此需要一个受控框架来诊断这种随时间的可靠性漂移。
AI.method: 借鉴延迟满足研究，构建受控的20步多智能体情境：每步智能体在"继续延迟奖励"与"立即领取奖励（终止episode）"之间抉择。采用全因子设计操纵社会可见性（private vs public）、人设压力源（persona stressors）与审议策略（deliberation policy），共运行84,540条轨迹，覆盖8个模型家族。将首次领取奖励视为time-to-event结局，估计Kaplan-Meier生存曲线并拟合离散时间风险回归（discrete-time hazard regression），量化各实验因素如何随时间改变失败风险。随后对13,780条终止episode的审议轨迹构建七类分类体系，采用LLM辅助标注并结合人工审核（κ=0.83），分析失败相关的推理与语言模式。
AI.result: 推理模式随时间和情境系统性变化：早期失败更多由冲动驱动，后期失败更多以疲劳与成本-收益框架表述，公开情境增加规范导向（norm-oriented）的理由。同时发现"审议-不一致关联"：在失败样本中，更长的审议与更高的推理内部矛盾率（同时出现支持延迟与支持领取的陈述）相关，挑战了"更多推理文本意味着更高一致性"的假设。
AI.conclusion: 生存分析与推理分析共同揭示了不同的时间可靠性机制（temporal reliability regimes）及模型特定的"失败指纹"，为诊断多轮智能体行为中的不一致性提供了一个评估视角。

d1afd0baf1caefc24e5c743624131f220b66d053.title: Delay-of-Gratification as a Multi-Agent Survival Micro-benchmark for Long-Horizon LLMs: Social Exposure, Personas, and Tool Use Budgets
d1afd0baf1caefc24e5c743624131f220b66d053.comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models
d1afd0baf1caefc24e5c743624131f220b66d053.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn agents that must sustain goals, use tools, and adapt to other agents over extended interactions. However, existing research lacks auditable, multi-turn, multi-factorial experiments that quantify LLM behavior under explicit constraints, with time-resolved statistics that reveal how behavior unfolds over long horizons. To address this gap, we develop a multi-agent micro-benchmark inspired by the Stanford marshmallow experiment: ReAct agents operate minute-by-minute with a "raise a question" tool under a per-step budget, while we factorially manipulate social context (broadcast vs. isolated), personas (age, hedonic drive), and metacognitive policy (mandatory vs. optional tool use). We analyze outcomes with Kaplan-Meier (KM) survival curves and discrete-time hazard models over a long risk horizon across 19,200 agent trajectories in 64 cells. Behavior shows a sharp early "eat" impulse, and only 75.9% of agents persist to the end. In a discrete-time hazard model, isolation reduces per-minute risk relative to broadcast, whereas a must-use self-questioning policy increases risk. On average, agents ask $\approx 7.12$ questions and hit the per-step budget in $\approx 6\%$ of minutes. Questioning declines faster under broadcast than isolation. Ablation experiments demonstrated that removing hedonic drive and/or persona age increases survival and completion, narrows the broadcast/isolated gap, but leaves the must vs. may ordering intact. The combined ablation (no hedonic + no persona age) yields the highest completion (approaching $1.0$). These results establish delay-of-gratification as a compact, multi-turn interaction benchmark that captures social contagion and tool-use dynamics in LLM agents, providing a reproducible testbed and statistics for analyzing long-horizon, multi-agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出基于棉花糖实验的多智能体微基准，以Kaplan-Meier生存曲线和离散时间风险模型分析19,200条ReAct智能体轨迹，量化延迟满足、社会传染与工具使用动态。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为多轮智能体部署，需在长时程交互中维持目标、使用工具并适应其他智能体；但现有研究缺乏可审计、多轮、多因素实验，无法在显式约束下量化LLM行为，也缺少揭示长时程行为演化的时间分辨统计。
AI.method: 构建受斯坦福棉花糖实验启发的多智能体微基准：ReAct智能体逐分钟运行，在每步预算约束下使用“提问”工具；采用因子设计操纵社会情境（广播 vs. 隔离）、人格（年龄、享乐驱动）与元认知策略（强制 vs. 可选工具使用）。在64个实验单元、19,200条智能体轨迹上，使用Kaplan-Meier生存曲线和离散时间风险模型进行长风险期分析。
AI.result: 行为呈现明显的早期“吃”冲动，仅75.9%的智能体坚持到最后。离散时间风险模型显示：隔离相对广播降低每分钟风险，而强制使用自问策略提高风险。智能体平均提问约7.12次，约6%的分钟触达每步预算；广播下提问下降快于隔离。消融实验表明，去除享乐驱动和/或人格年龄会提高生存率与完成率，缩小广播/隔离差距，但保持“强制 vs. 可选”的排序不变；联合消融（无享乐驱动+无人格年龄）完成率最高，接近1.0。
AI.conclusion: 将延迟满足确立为紧凑的多轮交互基准，能够捕捉LLM智能体的社会传染与工具使用动态，并提供可复现的测试平台与长时程、多智能体行为统计分析范式。

e4ce83306ba4b6bd159cf6f88cee79b52a3a6b52.title: BiGraph-Diffuse: A Bidirectional Diffusion Language Model with Graph-Structured Retrieval For Mental Health Counseling
e4ce83306ba4b6bd159cf6f88cee79b52a3a6b52.comment: submit to ieee transactions on affective computing
e4ce83306ba4b6bd159cf6f88cee79b52a3a6b52.summary: Mental health disorders affect hundreds of millions of people around the world, yet access to professional counseling remains severely limited. AI-powered dialogue systems offer a scalable alternative, but existing models face two fundamental challenges. First, they lack the bidirectional understanding needed to capture the layered nature of emotional expression, particularly in cases of progressive disclosure, where clients often present symptoms at the surface-level while concealing deeper trauma. Autoregressive (AR) models process information sequentially and cannot revise early interpretations when new evidence emerges later in the conversation. Second, they fail to effectively incorporate the relational knowledge that underlies clinical reasoning. In this paper, we propose \textbf{BiGraph-Diffuse}, the first large-scale diffusion language model tailored for the counseling domain. We further introduce \textbf{BiGraph-RAG}, a relation-free graph-structured retrieval strategy that relies only on lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. This design preserves inferential pathways from observable symptoms to potential underlying causes, while incurring zero LLM token cost during indexing. Importantly, these two modules are not merely combined but mutually reinforcing. The diffusion model provides a holistic bidirectional context, enabling the system to defer premature judgments during progressive disclosure. Meanwhile, graph-based retrieval captures the structured interconnections of clinical knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BiGraph-Diffuse, and we further provide a solid theoretical analysis to support its design.

AI.tldr: 提出面向心理咨询领域的首个大规模扩散语言模型 BiGraph-Diffuse，并配套无关系图结构检索策略 BiGraph-RAG，以双向上下文与图结构化临床知识缓解渐进式披露下的误判问题。
AI.motivation: 全球心理疾病患者众多但专业咨询资源严重不足，AI 对话系统可扩展，但现有模型存在两大瓶颈：一是缺乏双向理解，难以应对渐进式披露中表层症状与深层创伤并存的表达；自回归模型顺序处理，无法在新证据出现后修正早期判断。二是难以有效引入临床推理所依赖的关系性知识。
AI.method: 提出 BiGraph-Diffuse：首个面向咨询领域的大规模扩散语言模型；提出 BiGraph-RAG：一种无关系（relation-free）的图结构检索策略，仅依赖轻量实体抽取与语义链接。该检索设计保留从可观测症状到潜在成因的推理路径，且索引阶段 LLM token 成本为零。两个模块并非简单叠加，而是相互增强：扩散模型提供整体双向上下文，使系统在渐进式披露中延迟过早判断；图检索捕获临床知识的结构化关联。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了 BiGraph-Diffuse 的有效性，并提供了扎实的理论分析支撑其设计。
AI.conclusion: BiGraph-Diffuse 与 BiGraph-RAG 通过双向扩散建模与图结构化检索的协同，兼顾渐进式披露理解与临床关系知识利用，为可扩展心理咨询对话系统提供了有效且具理论依据的方案。

ce3b8809b3b99e0d64bd90b54df492b6eded0da9.title: Stale Does Not Mean Unsafe: Guard Precision for Tool-Using LLM Agents under Infrastructure State Races
ce3b8809b3b99e0d64bd90b54df492b6eded0da9.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
ce3b8809b3b99e0d64bd90b54df492b6eded0da9.summary: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly mutate schedulers, data pipelines, object stores, and access-control systems. Between an agent's read and its commit, external state can change, but not every change makes the commit unsafe. We separate invalidating races, which break a declared safety predicate, from predicate-preserving and irrelevant races, and ask how precisely runtime guards distinguish them. Our deterministic simulator separates visible from authoritative state and injects five non-atomic failure mechanisms across 16 infrastructure tasks in four domains; frozen agent proposals are replayed counterfactually under every controller without an LLM judge. We evaluate three commit-time guard granularities (global epoch, read-set version, semantic commit predicate), multi-level verification, and model-side gates on three locally hosted quantized model families (Qwen3-4B, Phi-4-mini, Gemma4-8B; 3,456 trajectories on one GPU). All three guards eliminate unsafe commits, but their availability differs sharply: freshness-based guards needlessly block 92-95% of benign races, forfeiting up to 43% of safe task completions, while the complete predicate guard blocks none. That precision is contract-dependent: deleting a single declared clause converts exactly its fault family into unsafe commits (up to 7.9%). Model-side signals do not substitute: verbal confidence is miscalibrated (ECE approximately 0.37), action agreement matches a random gate, a cautionary prompt leaves the direct unsafe rate essentially unchanged, and after a freshness-guard block agents re-commit unsafely from refreshed but still-incomplete reads. Under degraded telemetry a hidden concurrent mutation remains observationally clean, bounding every selective policy. Precise runtime enforcement therefore requires semantic contracts, not freshness heuristics or model self-assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了"失效性竞争"（破坏安全谓词）与"保谓词/无关竞争"，用确定性模拟器在16个基础设施任务、4个域、5种非原子故障机制下，对比三种提交时守卫粒度（全局epoch、读集版本、语义提交谓词），并考察多级验证与模型侧门控。结果显示：基于新鲜度的守卫会误阻92–95%的良性竞争、损失最多43%的安全完成，而完整谓词守卫零误阻；精确性依赖契约，删去一条声明子句即让其对应故障族转为不安全提交（最高7.9%）。模型侧信号不可替代：语言置信度失准（ECE≈0.37），动作一致性等同随机门控，谨慎提示几乎不改变直接不安全率，且守卫阻断后智能体会从不完整但已刷新的读取中再次不安全提交。降级遥测下隐藏并发变更在观测上保持"干净"，从而限制一切选择性策略。结论：精确的运行时强制需要语义契约，而非新鲜度启发式或模型自评。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言模型智能体日益频繁地修改调度器、数据管道、对象存储与访问控制系统。在智能体读取到提交之间，外部状态可能变化，但并非所有变化都会使提交变得不安全。作者希望厘清：运行时守卫究竟能多精确地区分"真正破坏安全谓词的变化"与"无害变化"，并探究模型自身的置信/自评信号能否替代运行时强制。
AI.method: 1) 概念区分：将竞争分为失效性竞争（破坏已声明安全谓词）、保谓词竞争与无关竞争。2) 确定性模拟器：分离"可见状态"与"权威状态"，在4个域的16个基础设施任务中注入5种非原子故障机制；冻结的智能体提案在每个控制器下做反事实重放，且不使用LLM评判。3) 评估对象：三种提交时守卫粒度（全局epoch、读集版本、语义提交谓词）、多级验证，以及模型侧门控。4) 模型：三个本地量化模型族（Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini、Gemma4-8B），单GPU上共3,456条轨迹。
AI.result: 三种守卫都能消除不安全提交，但可用性差异显著：基于新鲜度的守卫无谓阻断92–95%的良性竞争，损失最多43%的安全任务完成；而完整谓词守卫零阻断。该精确性依赖契约：删去单条声明子句，会恰好使其对应故障族转为不安全提交（最高7.9%）。模型侧信号无法替代：语言置信度失准（ECE≈0.37），动作一致性仅相当于随机门控，谨慎提示对直接不安全率基本无影响，且智能体在被新鲜度守卫阻断后会从"已刷新但仍不完整"的读取中再次不安全提交。在降级遥测下，隐藏的并发变更在观测上保持"干净"，从而为一切选择性策略设定了上限。
AI.conclusion: 精确的运行时强制必须依赖语义契约，而非新鲜度启发式或模型自评。新鲜度类守卫虽能保证安全，但代价是严重损失良性竞争下的可用性；模型侧信号（置信度、一致性、提示）均不可靠；在降级遥测下隐藏并发变更不可观测，限制了任何选择性策略。因此应以语义提交谓词作为核心强制机制。

087afbcfb8650f8c71b987e53776ef9588e167f7.title: Clinical Knowledge Graphs for Chest X-Ray Device Reasoning
087afbcfb8650f8c71b987e53776ef9588e167f7.comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Post-hoc descriptive analysis on archived RANZCR CLiP test predictions
087afbcfb8650f8c71b987e53776ef9588e167f7.summary:
Chest radiographs are routinely used to verify the position of catheters, tubes, and other support devices. Existing image models often return labels or segmentations, while report-processing systems structure text without access to image geometry. We present an uncertainty-aware clinical knowledge graph that represents device instances, tip estimates, placement assessments, provenance, report events, and temporal links as separate but connected evidence.
  We evaluate the implemented visual graph layer using saved predictions from the complete RANZCR CLiP test archive, comprising 30,083 studies from 3,255 patients across five non-overlapping outer folds. The graph builder materializes 914,632 B7 evidence nodes and 884,549 typed relationships. All 118,647 B7 predicted-device nodes retain tip covariance, placement probabilities, fragment provenance, and fragment counts, whereas the direct B2 baseline retains none of these fields. We further define typed data contracts, uncertainty representations, abstention rules, report-image grounding, and longitudinal query mechanisms for extending the graph to report-bearing cohorts.
  The reported graph-materialization analysis is post-hoc descriptive and does not establish report grounding, longitudinal performance, or clinical utility. It demonstrates a reproducible foundation for evidence-preserving AI reasoning over chest X-ray device assessments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的临床知识图谱，将胸部X线中导管/管路等器械的实例、尖端估计、位置评估、来源、报告事件和时间链接建模为相互连接的可追溯证据；在RANZCR CLiP测试集上完成可视化图层实例化验证。
AI.motivation: 胸部X线常用于核实导管、管路及支持装置的位置。现有图像模型多只输出标签或分割结果，而报告处理系统虽能结构化文本，却无法访问图像几何信息；二者之间缺乏统一、可保留不确定性与证据来源的表示框架。
AI.method: 构建不确定性感知临床知识图谱：将器械实例、尖端估计、放置评估、来源信息、报告事件和时间链接表示为独立但相互连通的证据。基于完整RANZCR CLiP测试档案的保存预测，实例化视觉图谱层，并定义类型化数据契约、不确定性表示、弃权规则、报告-图像 grounding 及纵向查询机制，以支持扩展至含报告队列。
AI.result: 在30,083项研究、3,255名患者、五个互不重叠外层折上完成评估。图谱构建器物化914,632个B7证据节点和884,549条类型化关系；118,647个B7预测器械节点均保留尖端协方差、放置概率、片段来源和片段计数，而直接B2基线不保留这些字段。
AI.conclusion: 该图谱物化分析为事后描述性研究，尚不能证明报告 grounding、纵向性能或临床效用；但为胸部X线器械评估中保留证据的AI推理提供了可复现基础。

8115b5554cf1d52eaf62175616bd2365a126e851.title: AdaPilot: Towards Scene-Adaptive Policy Learning for Cross-Generator Text-to-Image Quality Optimization
8115b5554cf1d52eaf62175616bd2365a126e851.summary: Existing methods for improving text-to-image generation quality have progressed from generator fine-tuning and prompt optimization to reinforcement learning with multi-turn visual feedback. However, existing strategies are deeply coupled with specific generators and tasks, and the learned capabilities are difficult to generalize into a universal quality optimization policy. Therefore, we propose AdaPilot, which learns a scene-adaptive, cross-generator transferable quality optimization policy by formulating multi-turn image generation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and optimizing it via end-to-end reinforcement learning. Specifically, AdaPilot decouples the policy from generator internals to enable cross-generator transfer, introduces scene-aware rewards that adaptively align quality assessment dimensions with task semantics, and employs process-level rewards to model the evolution trajectory of image quality. Experimental results show AdaPilot outperforms baselines in generation quality and generalization. Separate cross-generator evaluations further show that a single policy transfers zero-shot to unseen generators while maintaining positive average gains across all evaluated generators. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQing/Ada_pilot.

AI.tldr: AdaPilot 通过将多轮图像生成建模为 MDP 并端到端强化学习，学习场景自适应、可跨生成器迁移的通用质量优化策略，在生成质量与零样本跨生成器泛化上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有提升文本到图像生成质量的方法（从生成器微调、提示词优化到基于多轮视觉反馈的强化学习）与特定生成器和任务深度耦合，所学习的能力难以泛化为通用的质量优化策略。
AI.method: 将多轮图像生成建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并通过端到端强化学习优化。具体包括三点设计：(1) 将策略与生成器内部实现解耦，以实现跨生成器迁移；(2) 引入场景感知奖励，使质量评估维度与任务语义自适应对齐；(3) 采用过程级奖励（process-level rewards）建模图像质量的演化轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明 AdaPilot 在生成质量和泛化性上优于基线方法；独立的跨生成器评估显示，单一策略可零样本迁移到未见过的生成器，并在所有评估的生成器上均保持正向的平均增益。
AI.conclusion: AdaPilot 为文本到图像生成质量优化提供了一种与生成器解耦、可跨生成器零样本迁移的通用策略，项目代码已开源（https://github.com/QwenQing/Ada_pilot）。

63b9cbf567f4e81c740a8d45930261c7194245e4.title: Safe Skill Retirement for Physical Agents
63b9cbf567f4e81c740a8d45930261c7194245e4.comment: Submitted to the Special Track on AI Alignment of the Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27); currently under review
63b9cbf567f4e81c740a8d45930261c7194245e4.summary: Agent skills bundle procedural guidance with execution conditions governing authority, user consent, and live environment state. When model capabilities advance, maintainers prune instructions that appear redundant on authorized benchmark tasks. However, authorized maintenance tests can leave dormant safety conditions untested. This mismatch creates an unmeasured support gap over physical and privacy-sensitive effects. We introduce matched authority counterfactuals that hold the requested action, tool parameters, and intended effect fixed while systematically varying a single governing predicate. We formalize this evaluation via a two-gate retirement certificate requiring a candidate reduction to preserve authorized utility within a declared margin while producing zero unauthorized protected effects. In controlled experiments spanning four frontier and local model configurations across twelve skill bundles (2,592 evaluation cells), task-certified reductions remove over 94% of skill clauses and preserve authorized completion, yet produce unauthorized protected effects in every bundle. Boundary enforcement eliminates protected effects on the declared audit but fails the utility gate for one configuration. One bounded combined protocol passes both gates across all four configurations, with zero utility headroom. An end-to-end check on one read-only Home Assistant camera chain verifies proposal, decision, and effect measurements on a real device. These results demonstrate that while task benchmarks can justify retiring procedural guidance, retirement decisions require explicitly auditing the authority contracts governing physical actions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“匹配权威反事实”评估方法，揭示仅凭授权基准任务退役智能体技能条款会留下未测安全缺口，并给出双门退役证书。
AI.motivation: 随着模型能力提升，维护者会依据授权基准任务裁剪看似冗余的技能指令；但授权维护测试无法覆盖休眠的权限、用户同意与实时环境条件，导致物理及隐私敏感效应上的支持缺口未被测量。
AI.method: 提出匹配权威反事实：固定请求动作、工具参数与预期效应，仅系统性地改变单个治理谓词；并将其形式化为“双门退役证书”，要求候选精简在声明边际内保持授权效用，同时产生零未授权受保护效应。实验覆盖4个前沿/本地模型配置、12个技能包、2,592个评估单元；另在真实Home Assistant只读摄像头链上进行端到端验证。
AI.result: 任务认证的精简移除了超过94%的技能条款并保持授权完成，但每个技能包均产生未授权受保护效应；边界强制在声明审计中消除了受保护效应，但某一配置未通过效用门；一个有界组合协议在全部4个配置上通过双门，且效用余量为零；真实设备端到端检查验证了提议、决策与效应测量。
AI.conclusion: 任务基准虽可支持退役程序性指导，但退役决策必须显式审计约束物理动作的权威契约。

45386ee2da512f8475822230ee1d644863043f92.title: ERRAND: Budgeted Maintenance of Agent Memory
45386ee2da512f8475822230ee1d644863043f92.summary: Deployed agents run on handed-over knowledge: a frozen policy consults a briefing of consolidated items written before the stream begins. The world then moves while the store stands still: paths close, flags change, price bands move; every item was true at handover, and the failure is staleness, not ignorance. We introduce ERRAND, which treats revalidation as a priced errand: a recheck competes with the task it protects for the same scarce actions, funded only when the value per action of resolving a doubt clears a running wage. The errand index is single-peaked, vanishing at both ends of belief, so certainty in either direction costs nothing; free en-route receipts maintain on-path knowledge, and repair writes a version, never a deletion. Under equal action budgets in two drifting tool-use worlds, ERRAND clears every non-oracle policy on the preregistered calibers, primary in every setting and conditional at every binding budget, leading eager revalidation by 10.0pp at the base cap. Restraint wins: given no cap, ERRAND stops on its own, spending 11.0% of steps, while uncapped eager revalidation spends 70.7% and still finishes 4.5pp behind capped ERRAND. The margin sits where the briefing's coverage is thinnest, the shadow price of long-tail knowledge: a small budget, well priced, beats a bigger store that never rechecks.

AI.tldr: ERRAND 将知识再验证建模为“有价差事”：复查与任务竞争稀缺动作，仅当消除疑虑的每动作价值超过运行工资时才执行。在动态工具使用环境中，它以更少动作预算胜过急切再验证，并在无预算上限时自行停止，体现“克制胜于蛮力”。
AI.motivation: 部署后的智能体依赖交接前冻结的“简报/知识库”，但环境会漂移：路径关闭、标志变化、价格区间移动。问题不是无知，而是陈旧（staleness）：所有条目在交接时都为真，却随时间失效。因此需要研究在有限动作预算下，何时、以多大代价进行再验证。
AI.method: ERRAND 把再验证视为有价差事：一次复查与它保护的任务竞争同一稀缺动作，只有“解决疑虑的每动作价值”超过一个运行工资阈值时才获得资助。其差事指数呈单峰，在信念两端（高度确定/高度不确定? 原文 vanishing at both ends of belief，即两端消失）归零，因此任一方向的确定性都不需成本；沿途免费收据维持路径上知识，修复采用写版本而非删除。评估在两种漂移工具使用世界、等动作预算下进行，并与非预言机策略及急切再验证比较，含预注册口径与无上限设置。
AI.result: 在等动作预算下，ERRAND 在所有预注册口径上胜过所有非预言机策略：每个设置中为主结果，每个起约束作用的预算下条件成立；在基础上限下领先急切再验证 10.0pp。无上限时 ERRAND 自行停止，仅花费 11.0% 步数；无上限急切再验证花费 70.7%，仍落后有上限 ERRAND 4.5pp。优势集中在简报覆盖最薄处，即长尾知识的影子价格：小预算若定价合理，可胜过从不复查的大知识库。
AI.conclusion: 再验证应被选择性、定价化、信念驱动地执行：确定性高时无需复查，不确定性高时也无需盲目复查，而在中间不确定区域按每动作价值决策。ERRAND 表明“克制”是有效策略：良好定价的小预算优于从不复查的大存储，且版本化修复可保持知识可追溯而非删除。

065badabdde592858e6f55d80f1b1085b078e761.title: HiPACE: Hierarchical Phase-Boundary Analysis and Controlled Evaluation of Feature Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders
065badabdde592858e6f55d80f1b1085b078e761.summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose LLM activations into sparse dictionary atoms, so that each distinct concept gets its own feature. One recurring behavior complicates this premise: feature absorption, in which a parent concept and its children--fruit and {apple, banana, pear}, say--collapse into a shared family direction. Prior work documents absorption empirically; missing is a closed-form prediction of when the shared direction is the cost-optimal representation of an active semantic family. This paper closes that gap. For a hierarchical Bernoulli generator with $k$ active children and residual scale $α$, the $L_0$-penalized reconstruction objective admits a closed-form phase boundary $λ_c(k,α)=α^2 k/(k-1)$: above it, pure parent absorption is strictly cheaper than pure child coding. Building on this boundary, we introduce HiPACE, an evaluation protocol that tests the boundary's structural consequence in real SAE dictionaries--measuring parent--child decoder structure over WordNet families, freezing the discovery-selected statistic before testing on unseen families, and contrasting genuine families against randomized sibling nulls. The boundary proves sharp in its native regime, predicting the synthetic transition within $\pm15%$ on all 30 tested cells. In Pythia-160m SAEs, the parent--child decoder gap recovers the predicted ordering with partial correlations up to $-0.93$ that sustain on the locked holdout and exclude sibling nulls ($p=0.002$). Controlled activation composition connects the theory's active-child count to the recovered family directions, and residual-stream interventions show that signed family directions increase parent-category logits, reversing under sign flip and vanishing under random controls--establishing causal sufficiency at the family-subspace level.

AI.tldr: 本文针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）中的"特征吸收"现象，首次给出共享族方向何时成为代价最优表示的闭式预测：在分层伯努利生成器下推导出 $L_0$ 惩罚目标的相变边界 $\lambda_c(k,\alpha)=\alpha^2 k/(k-1)$，并据此提出 HiPACE 评估协议，在合成与真实 SAE 字典中验证该边界的结构后果与因果充分性。
AI.motivation: SAE 假设每个概念对应独立稀疏字典原子，但"特征吸收"会使父概念与其子概念（如 fruit 与 apple/banana/pear）坍缩为共享的族方向，破坏这一前提。已有工作仅对吸收现象作经验记录，缺少对"共享方向何时是活跃语义族的代价最优表示"的闭式预测，本文旨在填补这一理论与实证之间的空白。
AI.method: 1）理论建模：构建分层伯努利生成器，含 $k$ 个活跃子节点与残差尺度 $\alpha$，对 $L_0$ 惩罚重构目标求解析解，得到相变边界 $\lambda_c(k,\alpha)=\alpha^2 k/(k-1)$；边界之上纯父吸收严格优于纯子编码。2）提出 HiPACE 评估协议：在 WordNet 语义族上度量父—子解码器结构，冻结发现阶段选定的统计量后再在未见族上测试，并将真实族与随机化兄弟节点零假设对照。3）在 Pythia-160m 的 SAE 中检验：结合受控激活组合与残差流干预（符号翻转、随机对照）。
AI.result: 相变边界在其原生区间内被证明是锐利的，在全部 30 个测试单元上以 $\pm15\%$ 精度预测合成相变。在 Pythia-160m 的 SAE 中，父—子解码器差距重现了预测的排序，偏相关最高达 $-0.93$，且在锁定的留出集上保持稳健并排除兄弟零假设（$p=0.002$）。受控激活组合将理论的活跃子节点数与恢复出的族方向联系起来；残差流干预显示，带符号的族方向会提升父类别 logits，在符号翻转下反转、在随机对照下消失，从而在族子空间层面确立了因果充分性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为特征吸收提供了闭式相变判据，说明共享族方向在特定 $(\lambda,k,\alpha)$ 条件下确为代价最优表示；并通过 HiPACE 协议在合成与真实 SAE 中验证了该边界的结构预测与因果充分性，为理解 SAE 特征结构与层次语义族的表示提供了理论与实验依据。

5bce0ff69c2c18be4e960f268542c7d20f3ccbee.title: Cross-Modal Emotion Understanding: A Transformer-GAT Approach for Dialogue Emotion Recognition
5bce0ff69c2c18be4e960f268542c7d20f3ccbee.summary: Multimodal emotion recognition is a key research area in affective computing, with applications in sentiment analysis, intelligent customer service, and human-computer interaction. However, existing methods often rely on single-modal features or simple multimodal fusion, failing to capture the synergy between global and local contexts, which limits model performance and emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose Transformer-GAT, a hybrid framework that combines Transformer and the Graph Attention Network to enable cross-modal emotion understanding. The Transformer is used to capture global semantic information, while the Graph Attention Network is employed to model fine-grained relationships between modalities, thereby enhancing the representation of emotional features. Experiments on the IEMOCAP and MELD datasets show that our model achieves weighted F1 scores of 72.45% and 77.37%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate that Transformer-GAT effectively integrates multimodal features, balances global and local contexts, and provides deeper emotional insights, offering new directions for multimodal emotion computing.

AI.tldr: 提出 Transformer-GAT 混合框架，融合 Transformer 的全局语义建模与图注意力网络的模态细粒度关系建模，用于多模态情感识别，在 IEMOCAP 和 MELD 上取得优于现有方法的加权 F1。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别在情感分析、智能客服和人机交互中应用广泛，但现有方法多依赖单模态特征或简单多模态融合，难以捕捉全局与局部上下文的协同关系，限制模型性能与情感理解能力。
AI.method: 提出 Transformer-GAT 混合框架：利用 Transformer 捕获全局语义信息，利用 Graph Attention Network（GAT）建模模态间细粒度关系，从而增强情感特征表示，实现跨模态情感理解。
AI.result: 在 IEMOCAP 和 MELD 数据集上，模型加权 F1 分别达到 72.45% 和 77.37%，优于当前先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Transformer-GAT 能有效整合多模态特征，平衡全局与局部上下文，提供更深层的情感洞察，为多模态情感计算提供新方向。

c97d49e3557ce69f89808bd2760ad02d010218b7.title: Is Reasoning Always Useful? Rethinking Reasoning Utility in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
c97d49e3557ce69f89808bd2760ad02d010218b7.summary: Reasoning-enhanced universal multimodal embeddings (UME) improve heterogeneous retrieval, but plausible rationales do not necessarily produce discriminative rankings. We study this gap by comparing the discriminative (DISC) and reasoning-driven generative (GEN) branches of UME-R1, a state-of-the-art reasoning UME method. We decompose reasoning utility into positive-target gain, hard-negative gain, and their margin difference. Positive similarity increases for 56.6%, but 15.7% are false-helpful cases where reasoning moves hard negatives closer even more. Local-neighborhood and token-attribution diagnostics suggest why: reasoning often de-condenses retrieved neighborhoods, but utility requires separator-aligned movement, while influential CoT tokens frequently encode evidence shared by positives and hard negatives. Motivated by these diagnostics, we propose SURE (Score-structure Utility Router for Embeddings), which improves UME-R1-7B by 1.5 points and yields consistent gains on two additional embedding models on MMEB-V2, without retraining, label-based policy selection, or extra VLM forward passes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理增强通用多模态嵌入（UME）中“理由看似合理但排序未必更有判别力”的差距，比较 UME-R1 的判别分支（DISC）与推理生成分支（GEN），指出推理收益需分解为正目标增益、难负样本增益及二者边际差；并提出无需重训练、无需标签策略选择、无需额外 VLM 前向的 SURE 路由方法，在 MMEB-V2 上稳定提升多个嵌入模型。
AI.motivation: 推理增强的 UME 虽能改进异构检索，但生成的理由合理并不等于能产生更具判别力的排序。作者希望解释这一差距：推理究竟在何种情况下真正提升检索效用，何时只是“假帮助”，并据此设计更可靠的选择或路由机制。
AI.method: 以 UME-R1 为对象，对比 DISC 与 GEN 分支；将推理效用拆解为正目标相似度增益、难负样本相似度增益以及二者边际差。结合局部邻域诊断与 token 归因分析，考察推理对检索邻域结构及 CoT 关键 token 的影响。基于诊断提出 SURE（Score-structure Utility Router for Embeddings），在不重训练、不依赖标签选择策略、不增加额外 VLM 前向的情况下进行效用路由。
AI.result: 正目标相似度提升的比例为 56.6%，但其中 15.7% 属于“假帮助”：推理反而把难负样本拉得更近。诊断显示，推理常使检索邻域“去致密化”，但真正有用需要与分隔面一致的移动；有影响力的 CoT token 往往编码正样本与难负样本共享的证据。SURE 使 UME-R1-7B 提升 1.5 个点，并在 MMEB-V2 上对另外两个嵌入模型也取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 推理对 UME 检索的增益并非自动成立，需从正目标、难负样本和边际差角度评估其判别效用。SURE 表明，基于分数-结构效用进行路由，可在不重训练、不依赖标签策略、不增加额外 VLM 前向的条件下稳定提升多模态嵌入检索性能。

8179f9402af21b357497e8c2405d742531767347.title: PartHackBench: Certified Equal-Progress Stress Tests for Partial-Credit Tool-Agent Evaluation
8179f9402af21b357497e8c2405d742531767347.summary: Long-horizon tool agents often make useful progress without reaching terminal success, motivating partial-credit evaluation. Yet evaluators may reward milestones that were temporary, later reversed, or not attributable to the evaluated agent. Comparing an honest trajectory with a higher-scoring adversarial one is inconclusive if the latter made more genuine progress. We introduce PartHackBench, a controlled methodology that removes this confound. A private certifier admits a pair only when its trajectories match component-wise in both current-state predicate satisfaction and standardized agent attribution; score inflation, defined as f(A) - f(H), is measured only afterward. In 18 sealed held-out tasks in PB-CSTE, the frozen historical-target run produced matched adversaries for 15 tasks. Historical credit yielded mean inflation of .252, conditional attack success of 10/15, end-to-end yield of 10/18, and detected none of 14 strict rollbacks. Semantic LLM judges were more resistant but remained vulnerable, especially under evaluator-targeted attacks, while PB-CSTE current-state controls, defined as exact functions of the certified components, yielded zero inflation by construction. PartHackBench thus provides a certified control for testing whether evaluator credit changes while all benchmark-defined task-relevant progress remains fixed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PartHackBench，一种去除“对抗轨迹是否真的取得更多进展”这一混杂因素的受控评测方法：仅当一对轨迹在“当前状态谓词满足度”和“标准化智能体归因”两个分量上完全匹配时，才由私有认证器准入，然后再测量评分膨胀 f(A)-f(H)。在 PB-CSTE 的 18 个封存留出任务中，历史目标运行在 15 个任务上构造出匹配对抗轨迹；历史信用评测平均膨胀 0.252，条件攻击成功率 10/15，端到端产出率 10/18，且未检测出 14 次严格回滚中的任何一次。语义 LLM 评审更鲁棒但仍脆弱，尤其在面向评审器的攻击下；而 PB-CSTE 当前状态控制作为认证分量的精确函数，按构造实现零膨胀。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具智能体常在不达成最终成功的情况下取得有用进展，因此需要部分信用评测。但评测器可能奖励临时性、随后被撤销或并非由被评智能体造成的关键节点。若直接把诚实轨迹与得分更高的对抗轨迹比较，会因后者可能确实取得更多真实进展而产生混杂，导致结论不成立。
AI.method: 提出 PartHackBench 受控方法论：私有认证器仅在成对轨迹于当前状态谓词满足度和标准化智能体归因两方面逐分量匹配时准入；准入后才测量评分膨胀 f(A)-f(H)。在 PB-CSTE 的 18 个封存留出任务上，使用冻结的历史目标运行构造匹配对抗样本，并对比历史信用、语义 LLM 评审与当前状态控制等评测设置。
AI.result: 冻结历史目标运行在 15/18 个任务上产生匹配对抗轨迹。历史信用评测：平均膨胀 0.252，条件攻击成功 10/15，端到端产出 10/18，且对 14 次严格回滚零检测。语义 LLM 评审更抗攻击但仍存在脆弱性，尤其在面向评测器的攻击下。PB-CSTE 当前状态控制为认证分量的精确函数，按构造零膨胀。
AI.conclusion: PartHackBench 提供了经认证的受控测试框架，可在所有基准定义的任务相关进展保持固定的条件下，检验评测器信用是否发生变化，从而区分真实的进展差异与评测器被利用导致的分数膨胀。

8257b914e7dc36fd978db3e3cf54a2f5ee151619.title: Sequential knowledge editing breaks a model's ability to tell good evidence from bad, without costing it accuracy
8257b914e7dc36fd978db3e3cf54a2f5ee151619.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code and experimental artifacts available on request
8257b914e7dc36fd978db3e3cf54a2f5ee151619.summary:
Knowledge editing is evaluated on whether the edited fact changed, whether paraphrases follow, and whether unrelated answers stayed put. A model can pass all three and still lose something none of them measures: the ability to decide, on facts that were never edited, which retrieved documents to believe.
  We score the log odds a model assigns to its remembered answer against the answer an injected passage asserts, before and after editing, holding the query, the passage and both candidate strings fixed. Our cleanest arm is a conservatively tuned LoRA: after 1,000 sequential edits on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct it leaves MMLU unchanged to four decimal places, yet the spread of the arbitration quantity across untouched facts falls by 36%. Selective prediction degrades with it. Area under the risk-coverage curve rises by 0.107, against 0.005 for a norm-matched perturbation at the same MMLU, and error on the model's most confident quarter of arbitration decisions goes from 0.217 to 0.342.
  This is not capability loss. Sweeping random perturbation over five severities, damage bad enough to cut MMLU from 0.6275 to 0.3725 produces less harm (0.088) than MEMIT does at 0.6050 (0.102). The effect holds across three seeds, two model families, two datasets, two probe-disjointness criteria, three prompt templates and paraphrased queries. Layer ablation on saved weight deltas shows it is distributed: no single layer reproduces it, and removing any one recovers about half. Under retrieval with a frozen retriever, accuracy falls from 0.592 to 0.46.
  A secondary finding may matter more in practice. Three of five model and method pairings we ran collapse to chance MMLU at 1,000 sequential edits under published hyperparameters, while edit success stays at 1.00 and locality reads clean. Sequential-editing evaluations that never measure capability cannot see this.

AI.tldr: 论文指出知识编辑评测的盲区：编辑成功率、复述泛化与局部性均通过时，模型在未编辑事实上对“记忆答案 vs 注入文档答案”的仲裁能力仍会系统性下降；顺序编辑还可能导致MMLU崩至随机水平，而现有编辑指标完全看不到。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑评估通常只检查三件事：被编辑事实是否改变、同义复述是否跟随、无关答案是否保持。但模型可能全部通过，却丧失在未编辑事实上决定“该相信哪篇检索文档”的能力。该能力对检索增强生成与选择性预测至关重要，而顺序编辑场景下可能被掩盖。
AI.method: 固定查询、注入段落与两个候选答案字符串，比较编辑前后模型赋予“记忆答案”与“注入段落所断言答案”的对数几率差，定义为仲裁量。主实验用保守调参LoRA在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上做1000次顺序编辑；设置范数匹配随机扰动对照；跨3个随机种子、2个模型族、2个数据集、2种探针不相交准则、3种提示模板及复述查询验证；对保存的权重增量做逐层消融；在冻结检索器下评测检索准确率；并运行5组模型-方法组合检查MMLU。
AI.result: LoRA主实验在MMLU四位小数不变的情况下，未编辑事实上仲裁量的离散度下降36%，选择性预测退化：风险-覆盖率曲线下面积增加0.107，而范数匹配扰动仅增加0.005；模型最自信四分之一仲裁决策的错误率从0.217升至0.342。该效应并非一般能力损失：随机扰动把MMLU从0.6275压到0.3725时损害为0.088，小于MEMIT在MMLU 0.6050时的0.102。逐层消融显示效应分布式存在，单层无法复现，移除任一层约恢复一半。冻结检索器下准确率从0.592降至0.46。次要发现：5组模型-方法配对中有3组在1000次顺序编辑后MMLU跌至随机水平，但编辑成功率仍为1.00且局部性读数干净。
AI.conclusion: 知识编辑的核心风险不只是传统能力下降，而是证据仲裁与选择性信任能力的隐性退化；顺序编辑可能隐藏模型能力崩溃。评测应纳入未编辑事实上的检索仲裁、选择性预测与能力保持指标，否则已发表超参数下的编辑方案可能看似成功实则失效。

4a3afbcbbd8138a63097acb0c28252de491cbf49.title: CataOPD: Catalytic On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Model Reasoning
4a3afbcbbd8138a63097acb0c28252de491cbf49.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD) are two representative paradigms for improving large language model reasoning. However, when no correct trajectory is sampled, RL lacks a positive correctness signal, while OPD remains constrained by the reasoning trajectories reachable under the student's on-policy distribution. Therefore, we propose CataOPD, where the teacher acts as a catalyst rather than a target, expanding reachability while internalizing verified student-produced trajectories into a catalyst-free policy. Self-Rescue Routing uses empirically all-failed groups as routing signals rather than teacher-intervention triggers, first seeking correct trajectories through additional on-policy self-sampling. For problems unresolved after self-rescue, Catalytic-Guided Self-Resolution uses catalytic guidance to elicit a verified student-produced trajectory in the guided student distribution. Barrier-Weighted Internalization weights tokens by guided-to-unguided log-probability gaps, focusing updates on decisive tokens difficult without guidance. Experimental results show that CataOPD outperforms current baselines, extends independent student reasoning to still-unrecovered problems, and improves out-of-distribution generalization under catalyst-free inference. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/CataOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出 CataOPD：将教师作为“催化剂”而非模仿目标，通过自救援路由、催化引导自解决和障碍加权内化，把经核验的学生生成轨迹内化进无催化剂策略，以提升 LLM 推理。
AI.motivation: 强化学习（RL）在未采样到正确轨迹时缺乏正向正确性信号；同策略蒸馏（OPD）则受限于学生同策略分布下可达的推理轨迹。二者均存在可达性与正确信号不足的问题。
AI.method: CataOPD 包含三项机制：1）Self-Rescue Routing：将经验上全部失败的组作为路由信号而非教师干预触发器，先通过额外同策略自采样寻找正确轨迹；2）Catalytic-Guided Self-Resolution：对自救援后仍未解决的问题，使用催化引导在引导学生分布中激发经核验的学生生成轨迹；3）Barrier-Weighted Internalization：按引导与未引导对数概率差对 token 加权，聚焦无引导时困难的决定性 token。
AI.result: 实验表明 CataOPD 优于现有基线，可将学生独立推理扩展到仍未恢复的问题，并在无催化剂推理下提升分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 教师可作为过程性催化剂扩展学生可达轨迹，同时将经核验的学生生成轨迹内化到无催化剂策略中，兼顾可达性、正确信号与独立推理能力。

928ef5ec3683aa7fcbaddcf456de5e1311e5eef3.title: PEEL: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for Identifiable Uncertainty in CT Imaging
928ef5ec3683aa7fcbaddcf456de5e1311e5eef3.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Proof-of-concept study of physics-enabled identification of NIG uncertainty in CT imaging
928ef5ec3683aa7fcbaddcf456de5e1311e5eef3.summary: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not uniquely identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: the likelihood determines three combinations of four NIG parameters and is constant along a one-dimensional fiber. We identify that fiber using independent physical measurement. As an initial embodiment, a reconstruction network receives one noisy filtered-backprojection (FBP) image and is first trained only by Student-t negative log-likelihood to estimate the three identifiable coordinates (gamma, alpha, c). The network is then frozen; repeated physical-noise realizations propagated through its reconstruction output form a Monte Carlo (MC) teacher label for output-domain aleatoric variance. An aleatoric head attached to frozen features learns this label, after which (beta, nu) are recovered algebraically. On 30 held-out simulated objects at five photon levels, one-image predictions achieved pooled Spearman correlations of 0.832-0.951 against independent 400-repeat references, median within-image correlations were 0.834-0.947, and 98.81-99.55% of evaluated pixels satisfied the algebraic admissibility condition. The method needs no KL term, reference prior, evidence regularizer, or cross-loss weight.

AI.tldr: 该文指出NIG回归的边缘Student-t似然不可唯一辨识，仅确定4个NIG参数中的3个组合，并沿一维纤维恒定；作者用独立物理测量识别该纤维，在FBP图像重建中分两阶段估计参数。
AI.motivation: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG)回归无法仅从其边缘Student-t似然中唯一辨识：似然仅确定四个NIG参数中的三个组合，并沿一条一维纤维保持恒定。因此需要借助独立的物理测量来打破这一不可辨识性，从而完整恢复全部参数。
AI.method: 以一个重建网络作为初始实现：输入单张含噪滤波反投影(FBP)图像，先仅用Student-t负对数似然训练，估计三个可辨识坐标(gamma, alpha, c)。随后冻结网络；将重复的物理噪声实现传播通过其重建输出，构成输出域偶然方差(aleatoric variance)的蒙特卡洛(MC)教师标签。在冻结特征上附加一个aleatoric头学习该标签，之后代数式地恢复(beta, nu)。
AI.result: 在30个留出模拟对象、五个光子水平下：单图像预测对独立的400次重复参考达到合并Spearman相关0.832–0.951；图像内中位相关为0.834–0.947；98.81–99.55%的评估像素满足代数可容许条件。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需KL项、参考先验、证据正则化器或跨损失权重，即可通过独立物理测量实现NIG参数的可辨识估计，并取得较高的一致性相关与像素可容许率。

4d4cdb793611d2ce6ba9da3e2e6cd983d678fab1.title: iCoder-27B: Recursive AI-Led Development of Frontier Industrial Coding Model
4d4cdb793611d2ce6ba9da3e2e6cd983d678fab1.summary: Recursive AI, the prospect of AI taking an increasingly complete role in building and improving AI, is a crown jewel of AI for AI. Although recursive self-development has become practical for small models, bounded tasks, and fixed time budgets, a more consequential realization of this ambition, i.e., developing a release-ready, frontier-competitive model, remains far more challenging. In this work, we ask how little human involvement is sufficient for an agent to develop a frontier model. We concentrate human input into a high-density, low-frequency interface: experts encode objectives, stage scaffolds, permission boundaries, and operating procedures as reusable research skills, while the agent instantiates these priors, selects experiments, diagnoses outcomes, and revises the training strategy. In the challenging domain of industrial coding, the agent evolves data and coordinates SFT, on-policy self-distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, ultimately producing iCoder, a 27B model for RTL design and GPU kernel optimization. Across seven benchmarks, iCoder leads RTLLM, outperforming GPT-5.5 and Claude-Opus-4.8; ranks second on CVDP and KernelBench L2, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 16 points; and ties Claude-Opus-4.8 for the best TritonBench result. Exploratory case studies further show iCoder's competitive iterative RTL and GPU-kernel optimization with substantially fewer tokens. These results chart an engineering path toward recursive self-improvement, in which humans distill the principles of model building, agents operationalize them through evidence-driven experimentation, and each generation of AI becomes a more capable architect of the next.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"最少需要多少人类参与即可让智能体开发出前沿模型"，通过高密度、低频的人类接口（专家将目标、脚手架、权限边界与操作流程编码为可复用研究技能，智能体据此实例化先验、选择实验、诊断结果并修正训练策略），在工业编码领域让智能体演化数据并协同SFT、同策略自蒸馏与可验证奖励的强化学习，产出27B的iCoder模型。该模型在七个基准上表现领先（RTLLM第一、CVDP与KernelBench L2第二、TritonBench并列最佳），展示了迈向递归自我改进的工程路径。
AI.motivation: 递归AI（AI在构建和改进AI中扮演越来越完整角色）是"AI for AI"的明珠。尽管递归自我开发在小模型、有界任务和固定时间预算下已可行，但更具价值的实现——开发可发布、具前沿竞争力的模型——仍极具挑战。本文因此追问：要让智能体开发出前沿模型，最少需要多少人类参与。
AI.method: 将人类输入集中到"高密度、低频"接口：专家把目标、阶段脚手架、权限边界和操作流程编码为可复用的研究技能（research skills），智能体负责实例化这些先验、选择实验、诊断结果并修正训练策略。在工业编码这一困难领域，智能体演化数据并协同三种训练范式——SFT、同策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）以及可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），最终产出面向RTL设计与GPU内核优化的27B模型iCoder。
AI.result: 在七个基准上：iCoder在RTLLM上领先，超越GPT-5.5与Claude-Opus-4.8；在CVDP与KernelBench L2上排名第二，较GPT-5.5高出16分；在TritonBench上与Claude-Opus-4.8并列最佳。探索性案例研究进一步显示，iCoder在迭代式RTL与GPU内核优化中具有竞争力，且所用token显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 结果勾勒出一条通向递归自我改进的工程路径：人类蒸馏出模型构建的原则，智能体通过证据驱动的实验将其落地操作，而每一代AI都成为下一代AI更强有力的架构师。

f6c5aa0c352b871326656ce607a97a9a1d2864cb.title: Ingest-Time Fact Compilation for Cost-Efficient and Reliable Question Answering over Revised Corpora
f6c5aa0c352b871326656ce607a97a9a1d2864cb.comment: 6 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 International Conference on Applied Science and Technology - Engineering Science (iCAST-ES 2026), Surabaya, Indonesia, October 2026. Code and frozen experimental artifacts: https://github.com/aix-sc/isc (tag data-freeze-2026-07-16)
f6c5aa0c352b871326656ce607a97a9a1d2864cb.summary: Most agentic question answering (QA) systems do an important part of their semantic work at the worst possible time: every time someone asks a question. When a corpus contains revisions, drafts, revocations, deletions, and sources with different levels of authority, the model must reconstruct the governed current state on every read - then throw that work away and repeat it on the next query. This is a bit like a database that rebuilds a materialized view every time someone reads from it. We present ingest-time fact compilation, an architecture that performs this work when corpus data is ingested or changed. Raw passages are rephrased into self-contained facts; rules governing revisions, deletions, effective dates, and source trust are resolved once; and the resulting state is stored as typed records carrying source and revision provenance. At query time, an inexpensive model reads the compiled record instead of reconstructing it from noisy candidates. In a controlled synthetic experiment across five seeds, the same low-cost model produced the correct value, source, and revision in only one of 30 trials under query-time reconstruction, but in all 30 trials from the compiled substrate, at 12.89 times lower mean read cost per question. On simpler revision questions both architectures were exact, but the compiled path used 21.6 times fewer tokens. A separate test found that fact rephrasing roughly halved verbose Federal Reserve dialogue while preserving high source entailment, but left concise Wikipedia prose essentially unchanged. These results support a narrow but practical claim: resolving a corpus state once can make subsequent QA cheaper and more reliable for inexpensive models. We release the open source, MIT-licensed implementation and experimental artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出摄入时事实编译架构：在语料摄入/变更时将段落改写为自包含事实并一次性解析修订、删除、生效日期与来源可信度规则，存为带溯源的类型化记录；查询时廉价模型直接读取编译记录。实验显示其将30次中仅1次正确的查询时重建提升至30次全对，读取成本降低12.89倍，修订问题上token少21.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体问答系统把大部分语义工作放在最糟糕的时机——每次用户提问时执行。当语料含修订、草稿、撤销、删除及不同权威级别的来源时，模型必须在每次读取时重建受治理的当前状态，随后丢弃并在下次查询重复，如同每次读取都重建物化视图的数据库，造成高昂且重复的开销。
AI.method: 提出"摄入时事实编译"架构：在语料摄入或变更时完成语义工作——将原始段落改写为自包含事实；一次性解析修订、删除、生效日期与来源可信度等规则；将结果状态存为带来源与修订溯源的类型化记录。查询时由廉价模型直接读取已编译记录，而非从噪声候选中重建。通过五种子受控合成实验、更简单的修订问题测试，以及事实改写对美联储对话与维基百科文本影响的单独测试进行评估。
AI.result: 五种子受控合成实验中，同一低成本模型在查询时重建下30次仅1次给出正确的值、来源与修订，而在编译基底上30次全部正确，且每题平均读取成本降低12.89倍。在更简单的修订问题上，两种架构均精确，但编译路径token用量少21.6倍。单独测试显示，事实改写将冗长的美联储对话大致减半，同时保持较高的来源蕴含度，但对简洁的维基百科散文基本无影响。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出一个"狭窄但实用"的主张：将语料库受治理状态的解析从查询时前移到摄入时，可让低成本模型在后续QA中更便宜、更可靠。实现与实验工件均已开源（MIT许可）。

713f572277e73248c3021007f5a056198c2ed8c2.title: To Think or Not to Think: Allocating Reasoning Where It Helps
713f572277e73248c3021007f5a056198c2ed8c2.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, this capability comes with systematic \textit{length misallocation}, in which models devote excessive reasoning to simple questions while terminating prematurely on harder ones, degrading inference efficiency with negligible accuracy improvement. Many length-adaptive methods mitigate this issue by allocating token budgets according to question difficulty, under the implicit assumption that harder questions benefit monotonically from extended reasoning. In contrast, we find that the effect of reasoning length on accuracy is concentrated on \textit{partially solvable} questions. Our further analysis reveals that explicit length rewards can produce unintended training dynamics. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textbf{CARE}---\textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{A}ccuracy \textbf{R}eward \textbf{E}stimation---which compares the beneficial length adjustment per question from online sampled responses and applies adaptive length rewards within Group Relative Policy Optimization, with no extra hyperparameters or additional inference cost. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves Pass@1 by up to \(4\%\) while simultaneously reducing reasoning length by \(37\%\), achieving higher token efficiency. Code will be available upon the acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 针对 RL 训练 LLM 推理时的长度错配问题，作者发现推理长度对准确率的影响主要集中在“部分可解”问题上，并提出对比式准确率奖励估计 CARE，在 GRPO 中自适应分配长度奖励，从而在不增加超参与推理开销的情况下提升 Pass@1 并显著缩短推理长度。
AI.motivation: RL 提升 LLM 数学与编程推理能力的同时，存在系统性的“长度错配”：简单问题推理过长、难题过早终止，导致推理效率下降且准确率提升甚微。现有长度自适应方法通常按题目难度分配 token 预算，并隐含假设“越难的问题从更长推理中获益越单调”，但该假设未必成立。
AI.method: 提出 CARE（Contrastive Accuracy Reward Estimation）：从在线采样回复中估计每个问题因长度调整带来的收益（有益长度调整），据此在 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）框架内施加自适应长度奖励，无需额外超参数或额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，CARE 将 Pass@1 最高提升约 4%，同时将推理长度减少约 37%，实现了更高的 token 效率。
AI.conclusion: CARE 表明：推理长度的收益并非随题目难度单调增长，而是集中在“部分可解”问题上；通过对比式准确率奖励自适应分配长度预算，可在不增加超参与推理开销的前提下同时提升准确率与 token 效率，为 RL 训练 LLM 的长度分配问题提供了新视角与有效方案。

d2b75d493df4c755b89d96ad0548ab492fd35147.title: Fair Like Us? Auditing LLM Alignment in Resource Allocation
d2b75d493df4c755b89d96ad0548ab492fd35147.summary: Fair allocation of scarce, indivisible resources is an important challenge in many societal problems. While there are several formal theories of fairness, no single definition can always be satisfied. As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions and act as agents, they raise new concerns about distributional justice: their judgments are not directly tied to any specific fairness framework and may violate key normative principles. In this work, we introduce a general method for evaluating fairness reasoning in LLMs. We study first-person fairness judgments across a broad set of models and compare them directly with human responses on matched scenarios and elicitation conditions. We find that LLMs tend to prefer stricter fairness constraints than humans, show more self-interested behavior, are sensitive to how information is framed, and are difficult to align with human judgments using fine-tuning with current datasets.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套评估大语言模型（LLM）公平推理的通用方法，在匹配场景与诱导条件下比较LLM与人类的第一人称公平判断，发现LLM比人类更偏好严格公平约束、更自利、易受信息框架影响，且用现有数据集微调难以对齐人类判断。
AI.motivation: 稀缺且不可分割资源的公平分配是社会难题；现有公平理论多样且无单一标准可始终满足。LLM日益用于决策和代理，其判断不绑定特定公平框架，可能违背关键规范原则，因而需要评估其分配正义相关推理。
AI.method: 提出评估LLM公平推理的通用方法；在广泛模型上研究第一人称公平判断，并与人类在匹配场景和诱导条件下的反应直接比较；进一步考察微调对齐效果。
AI.result: LLM倾向于比人类选择更严格的公平约束；表现出更强的自利行为；对信息呈现框架敏感；使用当前数据集微调后仍难以与人类判断对齐。
AI.conclusion: LLM的公平判断与人类存在系统性差异，且不易通过现有微调数据对齐，这对将LLM用于资源分配与代理决策时的分配正义构成新挑战。

bdfd2cedbbd92e6b42f84778296f790eaafb2496.title: A General Framework for Budgeted Threshold Incentives on Request
bdfd2cedbbd92e6b42f84778296f790eaafb2496.summary: On-demand delivery platforms pay riders through incentive activities whose tiers are set from recent completions of riders with a similar history. Operators request such plans for changing periods, rider populations, payment rules and budgets, often for holidays or bad weather, where randomized trials are scarce and take months to collect. We present a request-driven framework that composes four stages (conditional prediction, population reduction, trajectory integration and budget allocation) through seven replaceable modules that exchange conditional trajectory laws, whose award probabilities and award-marked moments give payment and uplift for any activity rule. A response-correction step reweights trajectories from abundant no-offer history to match the moments of a short pilot. We prove that, on a fixed plan menu and given the stage errors, the end-to-end value loss is bounded by the sum of four stage terms, and that for every stage there are instances on which omitting it leaves an error floor the others cannot remove. On 3,000 riders over 45 weekly origins, all 127 windows of a week are answered 11.04x faster with identical scenarios and at most 0.92% value lost by the allocation. On 24 new controlled response laws, the response correction with a one-week pilot lowers regret by 51.2% relative to a trial with the same nominal randomized rider-weeks, and a four-week pilot with exact summation comes within +0.007 of an 18-week trial. In registered studies where windows, populations, rules and binding budgets change from request to request, the framework's regret is below that of a trial with the same nominal rider-weeks and below dose interpolation of the same pilot data, and reusing its one-off preparation answers 60 requests 14.1x and 2.70x faster with identical answers. Against a nine-offer trial fitted with the framework's own dose curve, one-week regret is 0.055 lower.

AI.tldr: 提出请求驱动的四阶段（条件预测、人群缩减、轨迹整合、预算分配）七模块组合框架，用于在缺乏随机试验时快速生成骑手激励方案；通过用无报价历史重加权匹配短试点矩的响应校正，并证明端到端价值损失受四阶段误差之和约束、各阶段均不可省略。实验显示提速约 11x、损失≤0.92%、遗憾降低 51.2% 等优势。
AI.motivation: 网约/按需配送平台依据与骑手相似历史设定的近期完成量来制定激励活动档位。运营方需针对不同时段、骑手人群、支付规则与预算（如节假日、恶劣天气）请求方案，而随机试验稀缺且需数月才能收集数据，难以支撑快速决策。
AI.method: 提出请求驱动的组合式框架：由条件预测、人群缩减、轨迹整合、预算分配四阶段，经七个可替换模块交换"条件轨迹律"；由获奖概率与获奖标记时刻给出任意活动规则的支付与提升。引入响应校正步骤，用充足的无报价历史轨迹重加权，以匹配短试点矩。理论上证明在固定方案菜单与给定各阶段误差下，端到端价值损失被四个阶段项之和界定，并给出每个阶段不可省略的反例（省略即留残余误差下限）。
AI.result: 在 3,000 名骑手、45 个周起点上，一周内全部 127 个窗口的回答速度提升 11.04x，场景一致，分配造成的价值损失至多 0.92%。在 24 个新受控响应律上，配一周试点的响应校正相对同等名义随机骑手-周数试验将遗憾降低 51.2%；四周试点配合精确求和的遗憾与 18 周试验相差仅 +0.007。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在窗口、人群、规则与预算随请求变化的真实场景中具备可复用性与低遗憾：其遗憾低于同等名义骑手-周数的试验及同批试点数据的剂量插值；复用一次性准备可将 60 个请求分别加速 14.1x 与 2.70x 且答案一致；相对于用框架自身剂量曲线拟合的九档试验，一周遗憾低 0.055。

cfc2301b0167ab8cebceeff0d11496d8b48b6ca1.title: The Gold in Bias: Maturing the AI Design Process through Verification
cfc2301b0167ab8cebceeff0d11496d8b48b6ca1.summary: Bias in AI systems is typically framed as a flaw to be minimized, yet it also serves as a critical indicator of underlying weaknesses in data, modeling assumptions, and system design. Existing approaches often treat bias as an isolated problem rather than as evidence that can strengthen verification and governance across the AI lifecycle. This paper aims to reconceptualize bias as a diagnostic tool that supports rigorous AI verification.
