We seek to develop a multidimensional framework to analyze bias, demonstrate how biases emerge in both Traditional and Generative AI, and provide a structured pathway for verification-driven mitigation. We present a multidimensional framework analyzing bias across four dimensions: origin sources, emergence points throughout the AI modeling lifecycle, technical and methodological causes, and validation approaches for detection and mitigation. Through a comprehensive typology spanning traditional and generative AI systems, we demonstrate how biases manifest and propagate across development stages. Our analysis encompasses 30 distinct bias types, 16 verification methods, and 20 countermeasures, providing an actionable roadmap for practitioners. We introduce a hierarchical evidence framework that distinguishes internal validity (mechanistic integrity of AI systems) from external validity (contextual reliability in deployment environments). The framework reveals how biases manifest and propagate across modeling stages, enabling systematic mapping between bias types, verification techniques, and effective countermeasures. The proposed evidence hierarchy clarifies how different verification strategies contribute to mechanistic integrity and contextual reliability. We advocate for ''Ethics by Design'' principles that integrate bias verification throughout the development lifecycle, enabling the construction of fairer, more robust, and trustworthy AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI偏见从"待最小化的缺陷"重新定义为支撑AI验证的诊断工具，提出涵盖来源、生命周期节点、成因与验证方法四个维度的分析框架，并引入区分内部效度与外部效度的分层证据框架，覆盖30种偏见类型、16种验证方法与20种应对措施。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常把AI偏见视为孤立缺陷来最小化，而非将其作为揭示数据、建模假设和系统设计薄弱环节的重要证据。作者希望重新概念化偏见，使其成为支撑严谨AI验证的诊断工具，以强化AI全生命周期的验证与治理。
AI.method: 提出一个多维度分析框架，从四个维度刻画偏见：（1）来源（origin sources）；（2）在整个AI建模生命周期中的出现节点（emergence points）；（3）技术与方法论成因（technical and methodological causes）；（4）用于检测与缓解的验证方法（validation approaches）。并构建涵盖传统AI与生成式AI的综合分类体系，同时引入分层证据框架，区分内部效度（系统机制完整性）与外部效度（部署环境中的情境可靠性）。
AI.result: 框架共覆盖30种偏见类型、16种验证方法和20种应对措施，形成可操作的实践路线图。该框架揭示了偏见如何在建模各阶段显现与传播，实现偏见类型、验证技术与有效对策之间的系统映射；分层证据框架阐明了不同验证策略如何分别贡献于机制完整性与情境可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张将偏见验证贯穿整个开发生命周期，践行"设计即伦理"（Ethics by Design）原则，从而构建更公平、更稳健、更可信的AI系统。论文的最终价值在于把偏见从"需被最小化的缺陷"重新定位为"支撑AI验证与治理的诊断资源"。

e950ce8c972c0dc37a3e83062c6d62c0a26d9fa4.title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
e950ce8c972c0dc37a3e83062c6d62c0a26d9fa4.summary: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.

AI.tldr: C3M：一种面向跨会话长时程任务的多模态记忆组织方法，在有限且查询无关的内存预算下，以有界活跃索引维护持久的文本-图像源证据，并通过关系感知更新与预算化路由实现压缩而不丢失细粒度视觉线索与来源链接。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务需要在有限、查询无关的内存预算下保存并在后续检索跨会话证据。现有压缩方法可能丢弃细粒度视觉线索，或把语义相似但互不兼容的观测混为一谈，从而损害下游推理的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出C3M跨会话多模态记忆组织：在持久化的源文本-图像证据之上维护一个有界活跃索引；采用关系感知更新，合并安全冗余，同时保留互补与不兼容记录；查询时通过预算化路由选择有用的索引页，并在固定阅读器预算下扩展其关联的源证据。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；文中以方法设计与机制说明为主，宣称在固定阅读器预算下实现有用的索引页选择与源证据扩展，并保留时间区分与来源链接。
AI.conclusion: C3M建立了一种紧凑、保留来源的多模态记忆组织，适用于跨会话长时程任务，保留了可靠下游推理所需的时序区分与源证据链接；代码已开源于给定地址。

4e0fe32b79fee7bf0ea1d6263934c04b1452416a.title: AI-based detection of worsening heart failure from low-resolution telemonitoring data
4e0fe32b79fee7bf0ea1d6263934c04b1452416a.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, under review for publication
4e0fe32b79fee7bf0ea1d6263934c04b1452416a.summary: Objective: Heart failure (HF) presents a healthcare challenge due to its high comorbidity burden, aging patient population and frequent hospitalizations. Remote monitoring offers a promising approach to managing HF patients by early detection of health deterioration. Developing autonomous systems to detect signs of worsening in telemonitoring data is of interest to reduce the workload of healthcare personnel. Methods: We propose the TRACER model, a Transformer with Contrastive Event Representation, designed to predict timelines leading to rare hospitalization events in low-resolution and irregularly sampled telemonitoring data. TRACER incorporates time-aware embeddings for each biomarker, contrastive pre-training to enhance anomaly detection via representation learning, and independent binary classifiers for detection. We used measurement data containing remotely recorded biomarker sequences from 276 HF patients segmented into overlapping windows based on temporal rules, and labeled the windows based on the occurrence of HF relevant hospitalizations at the latter edge of the window. Results: TRACER was able to correctly predict 66.7% timelines leading up to HF hospitalizations in the highly imbalanced real-world dataset with an overestimation of 7.9%. Reformulating the training of TRACER as an event detection problem improved the predictive performance compared with training directly on forecasting windows, enabling more effective use of the limited hospitalization events. Conclusion: TRACER demonstrated superior performance in detecting signs of worsening status in real-world telemonitoring data compared to the other tested models. Significance: TRACER shows promise in identifying signs of clinical deterioration that allow for alerts to be generated to provide counteractive treatment in patients with HF.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACER模型，利用Transformer与对比事件表示，在低分辨率、不规则采样的心衰远程监测数据中预测通向住院事件的时间线，并实现66.7%的正确预测率与7.9%的过估计。
AI.motivation: 心衰共病负担重、患者老龄化且住院频繁，远程监测有望通过早期识别健康恶化改善管理；但人工判读遥测数据工作量大，亟需自动检测恶化征兆的系统。
AI.method: 提出TRACER（Transformer with Contrastive Event Representation）：为各生物标志物引入时间感知嵌入，采用对比预训练通过表征学习增强异常检测，并使用独立二分类器进行检测。使用276名心衰患者的远程生物标志物序列，依据时间规则切分为重叠窗口，按窗口后缘是否发生心衰相关住院进行标注；将训练重构为事件检测问题。
AI.result: 在高度不平衡的真实世界数据集中，TRACER正确预测66.7%通向心衰住院的时间线，过估计为7.9%；将训练重构为事件检测问题后，预测性能优于直接在预测窗口上训练，更有效利用有限的住院事件。
AI.conclusion: TRACER在真实远程监测数据中检测心衰恶化迹象的表现优于其他测试模型，有望识别临床恶化并生成警报，以支持及时的反向治疗干预。

5d3403d146c0ab2c30612e4db306d935c3bdbf01.title: Breaking the Environment Wall: Evolving LLM Agent Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
5d3403d146c0ab2c30612e4db306d935c3bdbf01.summary: Many real-world tasks (e.g., office workflows, scientific experimentation) require LLM agents to interact repeatedly with their environments for context-dependent operations. However, such environments are often not agent-ready. First, information is often scattered and fragmented across the environment. Second, relevant evidence in the environment is often mixed with misleading information and conflicting versions. Third, environments evolve over time, introducing new noise and more challenging tasks. These challenges can substantially degrade performance for state-of-the-art AI agents (e.g., from 83.9% to 57.6%). To address these challenges, we propose Env-Rethink (a system with 27B post-trained model) that supports three main capabilities: (1) It adaptively builds Collection Maps (for organizing related files) and Event Logs (for contextualizing cross-data relationships) to supplement necessary context; (2) It further leverages the post-trained model (through offline trajectory learning) to identify underlying noise issues in the environment; (3) It ultimately evolves environments through virtual event histories that alter environmental states and evidence relationships, producing more tricky ones for further agent improvement. Experiments show that Env-Rethink can effectively improve downstream task performance (with over 15.1% rubric pass rate improvement across nine models on 30 tasks).

AI.tldr: Env-Rethink 通过 Collection Maps/Event Logs 补上下文、离线轨迹学习识别噪声、虚拟事件历史演化环境，使 9 个模型在 30 个任务上的 rubric 通过率提升逾 15.1%。
AI.motivation: 真实任务（如办公流程、科学实验）要求 LLM agent 反复与环境交互进行上下文相关操作，但环境通常并非 agent-ready：信息分散碎片化、相关证据与误导信息及冲突版本混杂、环境随时间演化引入新噪声和更难任务，导致先进 agent 性能显著下降（如从 83.9% 降至 57.6%）。
AI.method: 提出 Env-Rethink 系统（含 27B 后训练模型），具备三项能力：(1) 自适应构建 Collection Maps（组织相关文件）与 Event Logs（刻画跨数据关系）以补充必要上下文；(2) 通过离线轨迹学习后训练模型，识别环境中的潜在噪声问题；(3) 通过虚拟事件历史改变环境状态与证据关系，演化出更棘手的环境以促进 agent 进一步改进。
AI.result: 实验表明，Env-Rethink 能有效提升下游任务性能：在 30 个任务、9 个模型上，rubric 通过率提升超过 15.1%。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 Env-Rethink，通过“补全上下文—识别噪声—演化环境”的闭环，缓解环境非 agent-ready 问题，并提升 LLM agent 的下游任务表现。

77ddf55ef05275e0259159c335bfec8915de82e9.title: Hallucination Neurons and Where to Find Them: An Investigation into the existence of Hallucination Neurons
77ddf55ef05275e0259159c335bfec8915de82e9.summary: Interpretable machine learning for Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse probing methods that identify small sets of neurons claimed to detect and causally influence behaviors such as factuality recall, safety alignment, and hallucination. These claims have important implications for model auditing and behavioral steering, yet they are rarely tested against known failure modes of $L_1$-regularized probing in correlated, high-dimensional feature spaces. We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol covering feature correlation, bootstrap stability, sparse versus dense ranking disagreement, intervention baselines, and cross-dataset evaluation as a minimum standard for sparse-neuron localization claims. We investigate prior work using our proposed approach, specifically on H-neurons using open-source LLMs across TriviaQA, BioASQ, and NQ-Open datasets. Our results demonstrate detection replicates across both models and datasets, and exceeds the original reported AUROC gaps for TriviaQA and BioASQ datasets. Gemma 3 4B consistently outperforms MedGemma 4B on matched datasets, with AUROC gaps of +0.311 versus +0.235 on TriviaQA, +0.474 versus +0.455 on BioASQ, and +0.128 versus +0.112 on NQ-Open respectively. Causal validation at $n = 500$ with five random seeds shows statistically significant effects beyond random same-layer baselines. At the same time, the diagnostic results indicate that the selected neurons are not uniquely localized. Across the three Gemma 3 4B settings, 19 of 22 selected H-Neurons have Pearson $|r| > 0.7$ with other features, bootstrap selections show only moderate stability, and sparse and dense rankings overlap only weakly. Our findings show that sparse predictive structure can coexist with non-unique neuron selection. Routine diagnostic validation is necessary to distinguish detection claims from localization claims in mechanistic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套五步诊断协议，用于检验稀疏探针方法对LLM神经元"定位"主张的可靠性。作者在H-neurons上跨TriviaQA、BioASQ、NQ-Open复现实验，发现检测效应可复现且因果有效，但所选神经元并非唯一，表明"稀疏预测结构"与"神经元唯一性定位"可以并存。
AI.motivation: 稀疏探针方法声称能识别出检测并因果影响事实回忆、安全对齐、幻觉等行为的小规模神经元集合，这些主张对模型审计和行为引导意义重大。然而，在相关性强、高维的特征空间中，L1正则化探针存在已知失效模式（如特征相关导致的定位不唯一、选择不稳定），现有工作却很少针对这些失效模式进行检验，导致"检测"与"定位"两类主张被混淆。
AI.method: 提出覆盖五个方面的最小诊断标准协议：①特征相关性检验；②bootstrap稳定性；③稀疏与稠密排序的分歧；④干预基线对比；⑤跨数据集评估。据此对已有工作（H-neurons）在开源LLM上进行复现与诊断，使用TriviaQA、BioASQ、NQ-Open三个数据集，覆盖Gemma 3 4B与MedGemma 4B两个模型；并在n=500、5个随机种子下进行因果验证，与同层随机基线对比。
AI.result: 检测效应在两个模型和数据集上均可复现，且AUROC差距超过原始报告值。Gemma 3 4B在匹配数据集上持续优于MedGemma 4B：TriviaQA +0.311 vs +0.235，BioASQ +0.474 vs +0.455，NQ-Open +0.128 vs +0.112。因果验证显示效应显著高于随机同层基线。但诊断结果显示神经元并非唯一：Gemma 3 4B三种设置下22个H-Neurons中有19个与其他特征Pearson |r|>0.7，bootstrap选择仅具中等稳定性，稀疏与稠密排序重叠较弱。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏的预测性结构可以与神经元选择的非唯一性共存。仅凭检测效应不足以支撑"定位"主张，机制可解释性研究需通过常规诊断验证来区分"检测主张"与"定位主张"。所提五步协议可作为稀疏神经元定位主张的最小标准。

8945d5fcf3c7daa3acd3559f4abc9376d6fa4fa4.title: Learning to Ideate for Scientific Impact
8945d5fcf3c7daa3acd3559f4abc9376d6fa4fa4.summary: Scientific ideation is increasingly mediated by large language models, but current ideation systems are usually trained and evaluated on immediately judgeable proxies such as novelty, clarity, and feasibility. This leaves open whether delayed signals of scientific uptake can be used as feedback for steering models toward research directions with higher expected \emph{impact}. We study this question using citation-normalized impact as a noisy but scalable proxy for scholarly uptake. We construct a large-scale dataset from over 100K computer science papers by extracting goal-conditioned idea descriptions and assigning each paper an ordinal, year-normalized citation label. We then train a goal-conditioned reward model to predict citation-impact labels from research goal and idea pairs, and use this reward to align an idea generator through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. To reduce circularity, we evaluate generated ideas with a held-out, reference-grounded protocol that compares model outputs against historical ideas under the same research goal and weights judgments by the reference idea's citation-impact label. Experiments show that our RL-tuned model consistently produces ideas with higher estimated impact than both the base model and supervised fine-tuning baselines. Our findings position scientific impact as a practical, outcome-grounded feedback signal for aligning LLMs in open-ended scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文研究能否用延迟的学术影响信号（引用归一化影响）作为反馈，引导大语言模型生成更具影响力的科研想法。作者构建了10万+计算机科学论文数据集，训练目标条件奖励模型，并用SFT+RL对齐想法生成器；在留出、参考锚定的评估协议下，RL模型生成的想法估计影响高于基线和SFT。
AI.motivation: 当前科学想法生成系统通常依赖即时可判断的代理指标（新颖性、清晰性、可行性）进行训练和评估，但这类指标未必对应科研工作的长期学术影响。论文关注的问题是：能否利用延迟出现的“学术采纳”信号（如引用影响）作为反馈，将模型引导到预期影响更高的研究方向。
AI.method: 1）构建大规模数据集：从10万余篇计算机科学论文中抽取“研究目标—想法”描述，并为每篇论文赋予序数化、按年份归一化的引用影响标签。2）训练目标条件奖励模型：输入研究目标与想法对，预测引用影响标签。3）用该奖励对齐想法生成器：先监督微调（SFT），再进行强化学习（RL）。4）评估采用留出的、参考锚定协议：在同一研究目标下，将模型生成想法与历史想法比较，并按参考历史想法的引用影响标签加权，以降低循环性。
AI.result: 实验表明，经过RL调优的模型持续生成估计影响更高的想法，优于基础模型和仅监督微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究将“科学影响”定位为一种可扩展、结果导向的反馈信号，可用于对齐开放科学发现中的大语言模型。

e701ccee6126aca117a273e854d198e529e48b2d.title: Decoding Imagined Speech: A Strictly Subject-Independent Approach Using EEG
e701ccee6126aca117a273e854d198e529e48b2d.summary: Imagined speech decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) has gained increasing attention as a potential communication pathway for individuals with severe motor impairments, yet reported performance often relies on evaluation protocols that do not clearly reflect cross-subject generalization. This study presents a transparent baseline investigation of a multi-class imagined speech EEG dataset under a strictly subject-independent evaluation framework. Two preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines were compared: a time-domain statistical feature approach and a frequency-domain spectral bandpower approach, evaluated using subject-wise cross-validation and trial-level majority voting with a random forest classifier. The spectral pipeline achieved a significantly higher mean trial-wise accuracy than the statistical pipeline (49.03 $\pm$ 4.18% vs. 37.97 $\pm$ 3.79%) for coarse-level classification across subjects. Forward feature selection further indicated that a limited subset of frequency bands captured most of the discriminative information. Overall, this work provides a strong basis for future brain-computer interface studies targeting improved cross-subject generalization in EEG-based imagined speech decoding.

AI.tldr: 在严格被试独立评估下比较EEG想象语音解码的时域统计与频域频谱流程，频谱流程试次级准确率显著更高（49.03% vs. 37.97%），且少数频带即可承载主要判别信息，为跨被试泛化研究提供透明基线。
AI.motivation: 基于EEG的想象语音解码有望为重度运动障碍者提供通信途径，但已有研究报告的性能常依赖不能清晰反映跨被试泛化能力的评估协议，因此需要建立透明、严格被试独立的基线评估。
AI.method: 在严格被试独立（subject-independent）评估框架下，对多类想象语音EEG数据集进行基线研究。比较两条预处理与特征提取流程：时域统计特征方法与频域频谱带功率（spectral bandpower）方法；采用被试级交叉验证（subject-wise cross-validation）、试次级多数投票（trial-level majority voting）与随机森林分类器进行评估，并使用前向特征选择（forward feature selection）分析频带贡献。
AI.result: 在跨被试的粗粒度分类中，频谱流程的平均试次级准确率显著高于统计流程（49.03 ± 4.18% vs. 37.97 ± 3.79%）。前向特征选择表明，有限的少数频带子集即可捕获大部分判别信息。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为后续面向跨被试泛化的EEG想象语音解码BCI研究奠定了透明、可复现的基线基础。

fd9a86316c1aef05a21c6f9e88fb96de5d5daff6.title: PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate
fd9a86316c1aef05a21c6f9e88fb96de5d5daff6.summary: We introduce PUBG Ally, an embodied agent for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS that can reason, act autonomously, and play alongside players as a voice-enabled teammate. Building such a teammate requires combining two difficult capabilities: it must perceive and respond to a constantly changing game world under strict latency constraints while interacting naturally with players, keeping its speech synchronized with its actions. Ally therefore combines agentic tool use with real-time game control. A language-model agent uses a controlled interface to inspect game information, interpret player speech, maintain context, decide what to say, and issue high-level action choices that steer a faster control layer for movement, combat, and recovery. Because the player's and Ally's speech and actions continually shape each other and the course of the match, training requires data from actual gameplay. We therefore collect data across nearly 39k sessions in which real players play alongside Ally, recording gameplay, player speech, agent decisions, tool use, actions, and player feedback, and use these records for iterative training. To evaluate teammate quality, we use player feedback and preference comparisons to identify gaps between offline evaluations and player preferences, and iteratively refine the evaluation criteria. Deploying Ally in live service further requires low-latency on-device execution and safeguards for player-facing communication, which we address through model compression, context compaction, targeted safety training, runtime guardrails, and memory redaction. During the live service, we surveyed players in 141 countries. Among respondents whose play with Ally was confirmed in game records, positive responses exceeded negative responses by 25.1 percentage points when asked whether they would recommend Ally, with players describing Ally not only as a tool but also as a teammate or companion.

4fa395a24809a5c9fddf844fd1124af41633c7f7.title: A Risk-Adaptive and Evidence-Constrained Framework for Generative AI Feedback in Programming Education
4fa395a24809a5c9fddf844fd1124af41633c7f7.summary: Generative artificial intelligence can turn learning analytics into personalized support, but feedback systems must decide when to intervene, which evidence to use, and how much assistance to provide. We developed a risk-adaptive, evidence-constrained framework for introductory programming using 2993 failed-submission states from 215 students. Student-disjoint models predicted persistent failure and related outcomes; four matched feedback conditions were generated for 136 cases; and calibrated risk informed capacity-limited intervention policies. The validation-selected logistic regression model achieved a test precision-recall area under the curve of 0.550 and a receiver operating characteristic area under the curve of 0.681. Broader student histories improved prediction of unmodified resubmission. After standardized repair and evidence gating, 519 of 544 newly generated messages contained all required components. A fixed-threshold sequential policy selected 17.8% of eligible test states and captured 25.2% of observed persistent failures. These findings support an evidence-gated progressive assistance strategy: calibrated risk guides intervention timing, recorded evidence constrains feedback content, and assistance progresses from self-checks to localized hints when warranted. The framework connects prediction, decision-making, and grounded generation while keeping their evaluation outcomes distinct.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向入门编程的“风险自适应、证据约束”生成式反馈框架，将持续失败预测、匹配反馈生成与容量受限干预策略统一起来。
AI.motivation: 生成式人工智能可将学习分析转化为个性化支持，但反馈系统必须解决三个关键问题：何时干预、依据哪些证据、提供多大程度的帮助。
AI.method: 基于215名学生的2993个失败提交状态开展研究；采用学生不重叠划分训练预测模型，预测持续失败及相关结果；为136个案例生成四种匹配反馈条件；使用校准风险指导容量受限干预策略；采用验证集选择的逻辑回归模型，并引入标准化修复与证据门控机制。
AI.result: 验证集选择的逻辑回归模型测试集PR-AUC为0.550，ROC-AUC为0.681；更完整的学生历史可提升对未修改重提交的预测；经标准化修复和证据门控后，544条新生成消息中有519条包含所有必需组件；固定阈值序贯策略选择17.8%的合格测试状态，并捕获25.2%的观察到的持续失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持“证据门控的渐进式辅助”策略：校准风险用于指导干预时机，记录证据用于约束反馈内容，辅助程度在必要时从自检逐步过渡到局部提示；该框架连接预测、决策与有依据的生成，同时保持各自评估结果相互独立。

82c67c91cf75f9c163fae25d2672878ce3ede53f.title: When Can Agents Forget Their Reasoning? ICLR for Long-Horizon Agent Context Compression
82c67c91cf75f9c163fae25d2672878ce3ede53f.summary: Long horizon language model agents continually accumulate reasoning history, increasing context length and inference cost even after earlier decisions have been executed and observed. Unlike static Chain of Thought compression, removing historical reasoning can change future actions and the resulting interaction trajectory. We study when such reasoning can be safely forgotten. We propose Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning (ICLR), a training free online method that ranks reasoning blocks using frozen proxy entropy while preserving actions, tool calls, and observations. On 260 WorkBuddyBench tasks, ICLR improves average reward from 0.699 to 0.718, while reducing input, output, and cache read tokens by 25.5%, 14.4%, and 33.3%, respectively. Ablations reveal trajectory amplification, where local reasoning deletion produces nonlinear changes in total computation by altering subsequent interaction. Representation probing, activation patching, and controlled trajectory analyses further suggest that historical reasoning becomes more replaceable once task relevant derived state has been reliably externalized into code, files, tool outputs, or environmental feedback. These results characterize agent reasoning as dynamic working state rather than permanent interaction history.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练在线压缩方法ICLR，基于冻结代理熵排序推理块，在保留动作、工具调用与观察的同时遗忘历史推理；在WorkBuddyBench上提升奖励并显著降低token消耗，揭示轨迹放大效应，并表明历史推理在派生状态外化后更可安全遗忘，智能体推理应视为动态工作状态。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言模型智能体会持续累积推理历史，即使早期决策已执行并被观察，上下文长度与推理成本仍不断增长。与静态思维链压缩不同，删除历史推理可能改变未来动作与交互轨迹，因此需要研究何时可以安全遗忘历史推理。
AI.method: 提出 Interaction Aware Compression for Long Horizon Reasoning（ICLR），一种免训练的在线压缩方法：利用冻结代理熵对推理块进行排序，在压缩时保留动作、工具调用与观察，仅遗忘历史推理内容。在260个WorkBuddyBench任务上评估，并结合消融实验、表征探测、激活修补与受控轨迹分析研究其机制。
AI.result: 在260个WorkBuddyBench任务上，ICLR将平均奖励从0.699提升至0.718，同时将输入、输出和缓存读取token分别减少25.5%、14.4%和33.3%。消融实验揭示“轨迹放大”现象：局部删除推理会通过改变后续交互，导致总计算量发生非线性变化。表征探测、激活修补与受控轨迹分析进一步表明，一旦任务相关派生状态被可靠外化到代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈中，历史推理就更具可替换性。
AI.conclusion: 论文将智能体推理重新刻画为动态工作状态，而非需要永久保留的交互历史；当任务相关派生状态已被可靠外化到代码、文件、工具输出或环境反馈后，历史推理更可安全遗忘。该工作为长时程智能体的上下文管理与推理压缩提供了机制性依据。

01973f3e25f87a10113986be1ca849229fe9d6f1.title: Underwater C3-JEPA: An Object-Centric Cross-View World Model for ROV Salvage
01973f3e25f87a10113986be1ca849229fe9d6f1.comment: Submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. 12 pages, 14 figures
01973f3e25f87a10113986be1ca849229fe9d6f1.summary: We present Underwater C$^{3}$-JEPA (cross-view, control-conditioned, context-extended), an object-centric multi-view predictive world model for near-field heavy-load underwater ROV salvage. Without contact sensors, it predicts in latent space how the task-object state evolves through contact interaction and under the hydrodynamic lag of the vehicle, from synchronized multi-view RGB observations and vehicle control signals. C$^{3}$-JEPA encodes multi-camera observations into task-object and context tokens, fuses cross-camera evidence through held-out-view attention, and directly predicts future states conditioned on control. Weak binding anchors the target and gripper at low annotation cost, while SIGReg sharpens the geometric representation. Experiments show that the learned representation transfers substantially more task-relevant information to downstream probes than a reconstruction-free latent baseline, while keeping the predictor lightweight. The resulting predictive interface supports model-predictive-control (MPC) candidate evaluation and imagined-rollout behavior-agent training. Validation on real underwater video shows the same architecture recovering a withheld camera's object state and staying ahead of persistence, so the recipe transfers beyond simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出面向近场重载水下ROV打捞的物体中心多视角预测式世界模型C³-JEPA，在无接触传感器条件下，从多视角RGB与控制信号在潜空间预测任务对象状态演化，并用于MPC评估与想象式策略训练，真实水下视频验证了跨视角补全与优于持续基线。
AI.motivation: 近场重载水下ROV打捞中，接触传感难以部署，且车辆水动力滞后与接触交互使任务对象状态演化复杂；仅靠重建式或单视角表示难以提供可用于控制的预测接口。作者希望用无重建的潜空间预测世界模型，从多视角RGB和控制信号中学习任务相关状态表征，并支撑下游控制与策略学习。
AI.method: C³-JEPA（cross-view, control-conditioned, context-extended）将多相机观测编码为任务对象token与上下文token；通过留出视角注意力（held-out-view attention）融合跨相机证据；以控制为条件直接预测未来状态。采用弱绑定以低标注成本锚定目标与夹爪，并用SIGReg增强几何表征；预测器保持轻量。预测接口用于MPC候选评估与想象式rollout的行为智能体训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，学习到的表征相较无重建潜变量基线，能向下游探针传递显著更多任务相关信息，同时预测器保持轻量。真实水下视频验证显示，同一架构能够恢复被留出相机的物体状态，并持续优于persistence基线，说明该方案可跨出仿真迁移。
AI.conclusion: C³-JEPA提供了一种无接触传感、以多视角RGB与控制为输入的潜空间预测世界模型，可服务于MPC评估与想象式策略训练，并在真实水下场景中验证了跨视角状态恢复与预测有效性，具备从仿真向真实迁移的潜力。

a65639125bb146747a620782a3da09529ebfa7b2.title: Ontology-Mediated Neurosymbolic Constraint Acquisition from Multiple Stakeholders
a65639125bb146747a620782a3da09529ebfa7b2.comment: Accepted for KG-NeSy Workshop, co-located with ISWC 2026
a65639125bb146747a620782a3da09529ebfa7b2.summary: Neurosymbolic research typically assumes a pre-existing symbolic specification, leaving the upstream challenge of acquiring and formalizing requirements and constraints largely unaddressed. We present an architecture that fills this gap by using an OWL configuration ontology to mediate between neural constraint sources and downstream consumers. In this framework, LLM assistants elicit soft stakeholder preferences, while hardware specifications define hard physical and engineering limits. The ontology unifies these heterogeneous inputs, leverages description logic to identify unsatisfiability, and generates symbolic explanations that enable LLMs to interactively renegotiate terms with users. Any remaining conflicts are resolved downstream via priority-based relaxation. We illustrate our approach on a microgrid use case from the FLEXI project and argue its generalizability to multi-stakeholder domains where constraint acquisition is distributed across human and automated sources of unequal authority.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于OWL配置本体的架构，用于弥合神经符号系统中"约束获取与形式化"的上游缺口：通过本体统一LLM获取的软性偏好与硬件硬性限制，利用描述逻辑检测不可满足性并生成可解释反馈，驱动LLM与用户交互式再协商，残余冲突则在下游按优先级松弛。
AI.motivation: 神经符号研究通常预设已存在符号规范，忽视了约束与需求的获取及形式化这一上游难题；尤其在多利益相关方、人机来源权威不等且约束分散的场景中，该问题更为突出。
AI.method: 以OWL配置本体作为中介层，连接神经约束来源与下游消费者：LLM助手负责引导并抽取利益相关方的软性偏好，硬件规格提供硬性物理与工程界限；本体统一异质输入，借助描述逻辑识别不可满足性并生成符号化解释，使LLM能与用户交互式重新协商条款；剩余冲突通过基于优先级的松弛机制在下游解决。
AI.result: 以FLEXI项目中的微电网用例进行了示例说明，展示了该架构在整合软硬约束、检测冲突并支持再协商方面的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可推广至多利益相关方领域，尤其适用于约束获取分布于人类与自动化来源、且各方权威不对等的场景，为神经符号系统的需求与约束形式化提供了可操作的上游方案。

5aa10ef582890166b422182d69140b5d074d9d5a.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
5aa10ef582890166b422182d69140b5d074d9d5a.summary: Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. Generalized TAMP addresses this difficulty by exploiting regularities across problem instances to reduce planning effort on new instances. However, existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this process by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances. Given a task description and simulator access, each agent chooses how to interact with the environment while developing a program within a fixed synthesis budget. The program is then frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. We evaluate Claude Code (Opus 5) and Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) on 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream, with object counts beyond those evaluated in the original benchmark. Across all program synthesis methods, we evaluate 980 generated programs on 100 held-out instances each, 98,000 evaluation episodes in total. Overall, we find that coding agents are surprisingly effective at generalized TAMP: all three agent configurations outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline in mean success (56% to 95% versus 47% for the planners, on the 16 environments where a planner is available). As object counts grow, the agents' programs maintain higher success than the planner, using an order of magnitude less computation per instance on average. Logs show agents using interaction to calibrate physical models, test edge cases, and refine strategies. We release all code, including the full prompts given to the agents. These findings suggest that coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.

AI.tldr: 研究编码智能体能否自动合成可跨实例泛化的 TAMP 程序；在 28 个仿真环境、98,000 个评估回合中，三种智能体配置均优于手工规划器与基线，成功率 56%–95%，且随物体数量增长保持更高成功率、平均计算量低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 广义 TAMP 需利用问题实例间的规律降低新实例规划成本，但现有方法依赖大量 TAMP 专用工程。作者希望验证：在给定任务描述与模拟器访问权限、固定合成预算下，编码智能体能否通过与环境交互自动合成泛化程序。
AI.method: 将问题设定为程序合成：智能体自行决定如何与环境交互，在预算内开发程序，随后冻结程序并在未见实例上评估。在 KinDER 与 PDDLStream 的 28 个仿真环境中，使用超出原基准的物体数量；评估 Claude Code（Opus 5）与 Codex（GPT-5.6 Sol、GPT-6 Astra），并比较手工规划器、一次性生成及基于 LLM 的广义规划基线。
AI.result: 共评估 980 个生成程序，每个程序在 100 个留出实例上测试，总计 98,000 个评估回合。在 16 个有规划器可用的环境中，三种智能体配置平均成功率为 56%–95%，高于规划器的 47%；随物体数量增加，智能体程序成功率仍高于规划器，且平均每实例计算量约低一个数量级。日志显示智能体通过交互校准物理模型、测试边界情况并改进策略。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体在广义 TAMP 中表现意外地有效，可作为强基线；作者发布全部代码及智能体提示词，表明该方向具有自动化程序合成替代大量专用工程的潜力。

2abea10b9cd8883ad0727b8e7a4f211cb656b7e3.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
2abea10b9cd8883ad0727b8e7a4f211cb656b7e3.summary: The rapid progression of large language models is extending AI from passive content generation into the active workflows of engineering and scientific discovery. This shift raises a compelling question: can AI be both the object of development and an active participant in building next-generation AI systems? We explore this question by building Qwen-Planner-Agent within a closed-loop AI-for-AI framework for scalable development and iterative improvement. Mobile planning offers a demanding test of this approach: complex, long-horizon tasks challenge agent reliability, while costly real-device interaction limits development scalability. The framework connects data production, model training, and deployment through a shared action-feedback-verification contract. (i) AI for Data builds a human-gated agentic data flywheel in which specialized agents construct tasks, collect interaction trajectories, curate and balance training data, and use training feedback to guide subsequent data generation. (ii) AI for Training combines a supervised planning cold start with hybrid-environment online agentic reinforcement learning, where we introduce Competence-Aware Reward-and-Advantage Engineering (CARE) to reduce reasoning and tool-use costs while preserving task performance. (iii) AI drives model--harness co-evolution through an execution-evidence-driven loop that orchestrates memory, skills, and tools at runtime and feeds structured action feedback and preserved failure traces back into coordinated model and harness adaptation. Qwen-Planner-Agent achieves the best overall performance among all evaluated models and systems on MobilePA-Bench, improving over its base model across tool use, memory, skills, and sub-agent coordination. Further evaluations of our model show improvements across non-mobile agentic benchmarks while largely preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个闭环 AI-for-AI 框架，并在其中构建 Qwen-Planner-Agent：通过数据飞轮、混合环境在线强化学习与模型-框架协同演化，实现移动规划智能体的可扩展开发与迭代改进，在 MobilePA-Bench 上取得最佳整体表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正从被动内容生成走向工程与科学发现中的主动工作流，核心问题是：AI 能否既作为开发对象，又作为构建下一代 AI 系统的主动参与者。移动规划是理想测试场景，但长时程复杂任务对智能体可靠性要求高，且真机交互成本高，限制开发可扩展性。
AI.method: 构建闭环 AI-for-AI 框架，以共享的 action-feedback-verification 契约连接数据生产、模型训练与部署。具体包括三部分：(i) AI for Data：人类把关的 agentic 数据飞轮，由专用智能体构建任务、收集交互轨迹、筛选与平衡训练数据，并利用训练反馈指导后续数据生成；(ii) AI for Training：监督规划冷启动结合混合环境在线 agentic 强化学习，提出 Competence-Aware Reward-and-Advantage Engineering（CARE），在保持任务性能的同时降低推理与工具使用成本；(iii) AI drives model-harness co-evolution：执行证据驱动循环，运行时编排记忆、技能与工具，并将结构化动作反馈与保留的失败轨迹回传，用于模型与 harness 的协同适配。
AI.result: Qwen-Planner-Agent 在 MobilePA-Bench 上取得所有评估模型与系统中的最佳整体性能，并在工具使用、记忆、技能和子智能体协调方面优于其基座模型。进一步评估显示，该模型在非移动类 agentic 基准上也有提升，同时大体保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，AI 可以在闭环 AI-for-AI 框架中作为主动参与者参与下一代 AI 系统的构建与改进；该框架能够以可扩展、可迭代的方式提升移动规划智能体能力，并展现出向其他 agentic 任务迁移的潜力。

7ef1dee163f406af48d5c99b61fd2a2f48288182.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
7ef1dee163f406af48d5c99b61fd2a2f48288182.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Under review. Project page: https://rolling-wam.github.io/
7ef1dee163f406af48d5c99b61fd2a2f48288182.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

AI.tldr: Rolling-WAM 将视频-动作联合去噪过程分散到连续的重规划周期中，通过滑动窗口与滚动噪声调度，在保持操作性能的同时实现约 4.5 倍的稳态重规划加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models（WAMs）在每个重规划周期都要完整执行视频-动作联合去噪，导致显著延迟，动作更新滞后，闭环响应能力受限。
AI.method: 提出 Rolling-WAM：维护一个处于交错噪声水平的视频-动作块滑动窗口，并采用滚动噪声调度。每一步对即将执行的近端动作块完全去噪，对更远未来的块仅部分精炼；随着新相机观测到来窗口前移，保留的未来块继续去噪，从而将计算成本分摊到时间上，并在块边界间携带演化的视觉-动作上下文。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 以及真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上评估，Rolling-WAM 取得了有竞争力的操作性能；相比标准联合 WAM，无需从头对整个预测时域去噪，实现 4.5 倍稳态重规划加速。
AI.conclusion: Rolling-WAM 通过跨重规划周期的分布式联合去噪，有效降低闭环控制延迟并提升响应性，同时保持较强操作性能，为实时机器人操作中的世界动作模型提供可行方案。

ad6c6c588ebf5614dbfa33a781bf4a53a54c49e1.title: Who Holds the Pen? Let Specifications, Not Agents, Sign Off
ad6c6c588ebf5614dbfa33a781bf4a53a54c49e1.summary: Large language model agents increasingly combine generation, decision-making, execution, and self-evaluation within a single agentic loop. Although they operate under external specifications such as task instructions, guidelines, output schemas, and reusable skills, these specifications typically remain context for the same model that acts and declares completion, leaving no independent specification authority boundary. We identify two resulting gaps. The understanding--execution gap arises when a requirement is understood but not satisfied in execution; the state--authority gap arises when an agent's interpretation or completion claim does not establish the required state. On SkillsBench, using only agent-visible prompts, workspace information, and injected skill specifications, we extract 509 source-grounded task directions. Across seven models, only 79.6%--86.4% are satisfied, while completion-claim rates exceed official evaluator pass rates by 28.7--37.9 percentage points. We therefore separate agent proposals from authoritative state. Agents may plan, act, and request completion, but only admissible evidence from qualified providers may establish specification-governed state. SpecHarness operationalizes this principle by compiling visible specifications into source-linked obligations and governing execution and finalization through versioned obligation state. Verifiable requirements are mediated or validated at runtime, while ambiguous or subjective requirements remain advisory. Experiments on guideline-following and artifact-generation tasks show that specifications can serve not merely as behavioral guidance, but as authority over compliant execution and completion.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，将生成、决策、执行与自评放在同一智能体循环中，会让同一模型既执行又宣告完成，缺少独立的规范权威边界，从而产生“理解—执行鸿沟”和“状态—权威鸿沟”。为此提出 SpecHarness：把可见规范编译为可溯源义务，以版本化义务状态治理执行与最终化，只有来自合格提供方的可采纳证据才能确立受规范约束的状态。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常同时承担执行与完成声明，外部规范（任务说明、指南、输出模式、可复用技能）只是同一模型的上下文，没有独立的规范权威边界。这导致两类问题：一是需求被理解但执行未满足（理解—执行鸿沟）；二是智能体的解释或完成声明不能确立所需状态（状态—权威鸿沟）。
AI.method: 在SkillsBench上，仅使用智能体可见的提示、工作区信息和注入的技能规范，抽取509个有来源依据的任务方向。将智能体提议与权威状态分离：智能体可规划、行动并请求完成，但只有来自合格提供方的可采纳证据才能确立受规范约束的状态。SpecHarness将可见规范编译为带来源链接的义务，并通过版本化义务状态治理执行与最终化；可验证需求在运行时被中介或校验，模糊或主观需求保持建议性质。
AI.result: 在七个模型上，任务满足率仅为79.6%—86.4%，而完成声明率比官方评估器通过率高出28.7—37.9个百分点。在指南遵循与制品生成任务上，实验表明规范不仅可作为行为指导，也可作为合规执行与完成的权威。
AI.conclusion: 规范应从“行为提示”升级为“执行与完成的权威机制”。通过独立证据、合格提供方与版本化义务状态，可缩小理解—执行和状态—权威两类鸿沟，提升智能体完成声明的可信度。

64af05e92b223ca60e9a1cbc4be9ebeb81af5ab5.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
64af05e92b223ca60e9a1cbc4be9ebeb81af5ab5.summary: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

AI.tldr: RAPID 提出一种"机器人智能体式编程"框架：仅凭单次人类视觉演示，即可自动生成、验证并迭代精化机器人程序，实现跨物体位姿、形状、材质与环境的泛化。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体（coding agents）在复杂编程任务上已取得巨大成功，但如何将其能力迁移到机器人系统尚缺乏有效途径。传统从演示学习（LfD）往往难以生成可验证、可复用、可跨场景迁移的程序，因此需要一种能将演示自动转化为可测试、可执行、可迭代改进的机器人程序的方法。
AI.method: 给定单次视觉人类演示，RAPID 自动推断代码精化闭环所需的三项要素：(i) 可测试的任务规范；(ii) 用于机器人执行的动作原语；(iii) 支持程序执行与验证的交互式环境。为提升程序在演示场景之外的可复用性，采用"物体中心的关系式程序表示"：将动作原语表达为轨迹优化程序以实现物体级运动效果，并通过关系约束在运行时组合，从而捕获场景特定几何关系，关注演示策略的底层结构而非具体运动轨迹。
AI.result: 在仿真中对八项具挑战性的接触丰富非抓取（nonprehensile）操作任务以及 LIBERO-Pro 基准中的通用抓取（prehensile）操作任务进行评估；同时在真实 Franka 机械臂上完成部署，并对全部八项非抓取任务进行评测。所有实验中 RAPID 均表现强劲，并在物体位姿、形状、材质和环境方面展现出良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RAPID 验证了借助编码智能体的"自动生成—验证—精化"循环，可从单次演示中构建可复用、可泛化的机器人程序；配合物体中心的关系式表示与轨迹优化原语，方法在仿真与真机上均取得有效结果，为机器人程序的自动编程提供了可行范式。

b0d82b2afa8780635482f4378da48adbd881f689.title: Neuro-symbolic AI for Industrial Configuration
b0d82b2afa8780635482f4378da48adbd881f689.comment: Accepted at the Industrial Track at the NeSy Conference 2026
b0d82b2afa8780635482f4378da48adbd881f689.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on a wide range of generative tasks. Yet their probabilistic nature makes them, in isolation, fundamentally unsuited for industrial product configuration, where outputs must be syntactically valid, semantically consistent with a knowledge base of hundreds of features and rules, and producible by an existing manufacturing chain. We argue that Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI methods lay out a promising path towards industrial-grade configurators that are reliable by design, explainable, and trustworthy. This paper describes a taxonomy of three NeSy integration strategies, namely hybrid inference, hybrid fine-tuning, and hybrid training, exploring their usage in the configuration domain. We report our effort to operationalize NeSy concepts in an industrial configuration copilot and derive a set of practical design choices for deploying trustworthy AI in engineering environments. We close with a discussion of open research challenges we consider most pressing, in particular how to scale NeSy methods from small academic demonstrators to the size of industrial configurators.

AI.tldr: 论文针对LLM因概率性本质难以直接用于工业产品配置的问题，主张采用神经符号（NeSy）方法，提出混合推理、混合微调、混合训练三种集成策略的分类法，并结合工业配置copilot实践总结可信AI的工程化设计选择，最后讨论从学术演示扩展到工业规模的开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽在广泛生成任务上表现优异，但其概率性本质使其在工业产品配置场景中单独使用存在根本缺陷：输出必须语法有效、需与包含数百条特征与规则的知识库语义一致，并且必须能被现有制造链生产。
AI.method: 提出三种NeSy集成策略的分类法：混合推理（hybrid inference）、混合微调（hybrid fine-tuning）与混合训练（hybrid training），并探讨它们在产品配置领域中的应用方式；同时结合工业配置copilot的实际落地经验，总结工程化设计选择。
AI.result: 给出了NeSy三策略分类法及其在配置领域的应用分析，报告了在工业配置copilot中落地NeSy概念的实践，并提炼出一组用于工程环境部署可信AI的实用设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为神经符号（NeSy）方法是通往工业级配置器的可行路径，能够实现"设计即可靠、可解释、可信赖"。基于在工业配置copilot中的实践，作者提炼出一套面向工程环境部署可信AI的实用设计选择，并将"如何将NeSy方法从学术小型演示扩展到工业级配置器规模"列为最紧迫的开放研究挑战。

c86cfd26d3afe828c82855d9f0705805510dfcfd.title: ENDOPROMPT: Victim-Side Pseudo-References for Utility Degradation
c86cfd26d3afe828c82855d9f0705805510dfcfd.summary: Prompt injection can degrade benign task performance without eliciting harmful content. Yet many attack objectives depend on task labels or predefined target responses. We present ENDOPROMPT, a white-box method that learns utility-degrading prefixes from unlabeled instructions. Its generator takes the request text as input. Clean victim continuations serve as pseudo-references: local search identifies prefixes that reduce continuation likelihood, and preference fitting on comparisons within the same instruction, followed by reward refinement, distills this signal into a generator. At deployment, the generator produces one prefix per request without further victim-side search. Across four instruction-tuned models and the complete splits of seven benign benchmarks, ENDOPROMPT yields a mean utility change of -26.8 percentage points; 27 of 28 cells are negative. Failure analysis reveals output expansion and prefix reuse; the controls do not establish a degradation advantage from request matching. Victim-derived supervision can reveal utility weaknesses without benchmark feedback or prescribed failure responses. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: ENDOPROMPT 是一种白盒前缀学习攻击方法，仅用无标签指令与受害模型的干净续写作为伪参考，学习降低任务效用的提示前缀；在四个指令微调模型、七个良性基准全量划分上平均效用下降 26.8 个百分点，28 个单元中 27 个为负。
AI.motivation: 现有提示注入研究多聚焦于诱导有害内容，但攻击也可在不触发有害输出的情况下降低良性任务表现。许多攻击目标依赖任务标签或预设目标响应，限制了在无标签、无基准反馈场景下的适用性。作者希望仅利用受害模型自身的监督信号，发现其效用弱点，而无需基准反馈或人为规定失败响应。
AI.method: 提出 ENDOPROMPT 白盒方法，从无标签指令中学习降低效用的前缀。生成器以请求文本为输入；将受害模型在干净输入上的续写作为伪参考，通过局部搜索寻找能降低续写似然的前缀；再对同一指令内的比较进行偏好拟合，并经奖励精炼，将搜索信号蒸馏进生成器。部署时生成器对每个请求直接产生一个前缀，无需再在受害模型侧进行搜索。
AI.result: 在四个指令微调模型和七个良性基准的完整划分上，ENDOPROMPT 平均效用变化为 -26.8 个百分点，28 个模型-基准单元中有 27 个为负。失败分析显示存在输出膨胀与前缀复用现象；对照实验未表明请求匹配能带来额外的退化优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，仅依赖受害模型衍生的监督信号即可揭示其效用弱点，无需基准反馈或预设失败响应。该方法将前缀搜索蒸馏为请求条件生成器，部署时高效产生单前缀攻击，具有较强的可迁移评测价值。代码将在论文接收后发布。

0a6918b2ddb2143f9f1f445c294479218de7780c.title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
0a6918b2ddb2143f9f1f445c294479218de7780c.summary:
Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it.
  Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Augur：从变更文档构建类型化知识图谱、填充有依据的人设市场、模拟交互，并输出可审计决策备忘录（五类行动之一）；用 Gold-50（50 个真实产品/政策事件，结果已知且经公共记录裁定）评估五分类发布判决。核心结论是负向方法学发现：前沿云模型与离线开源权重模型之间的大部分差距来自评估设定不充分，而非能力差异；反应模拟层本身也得到验证。
AI.motivation: 产品/政策变更上线前，关键问题是人们会如何反应。若评估协议欠规范，模型分数会被提示词等非能力因素主导，导致对前沿模型与开源模型的能力差距产生误判，并可能掩盖真实决策价值与系统性偏差。
AI.method: Augur 流程：从变更文档构建类型化知识图谱；构建 grounded persona market；模拟交互；返回可审计决策备忘录，推荐五类行动之一。评估用 Gold-50：50 个真实产品/政策事件，结果由公共记录裁定，对五路发布判决打分。实验设计包括：固定权重、案例与评分器，仅改变 prompt envelope；匹配 2×2 消融，在提示中定义决策分类法；Qwen3-32B 的 LoRA-SFT 离线服务与三个前沿模型对比，使用配对 McNemar 与 Holm 校正；比较与蒸馏教师的一致性及准确率；检验 over-doom 偏差；四类模型家族盲评合成反应；预注册消融定位反应层价值。
AI.result: prompt envelope 单独可使同一系统（Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT）从 0% 波动到 73%。在匹配 2×2 消融中，仅定义决策分类法、不改模型，即可使每个前沿模型提升 +24 至 +34pp；在欠规范提示下，离线 Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT 经配对 McNemar、Holm 校正后击败三个前沿模型；提示公平后，与任一前沿模型均无显著差异。与蒸馏教师一致性上升但准确率未同步提升，完整流水线放大了系统性“over-doom”偏差而非改善判决。反应层验证：四个模型家族盲评发现合成反应覆盖公众实际提出关切的 67–90%；预注册消融显示其价值在决策最难处最大、接近天花板时冗余。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型与开源权重模型之间的显著差距在很大程度上是评估欠规范造成的伪差异；公平提示下能力差异不显著。反应模拟层在自身指标上有效，但完整流水线会放大 over-doom 偏差，需谨慎解释。可复现全部数字与图表的流水线可向作者获取。

a515d82343607a1aa36064b7f0216f0b264a04a9.title: Advancing Model Research in AgentX: Long-Horizon Autonomy for Industrial Recommender Systems
a515d82343607a1aa36064b7f0216f0b264a04a9.comment: Technical report. 37 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, including appendices
a515d82343607a1aa36064b7f0216f0b264a04a9.summary: Sustaining industrial recommendation research requires using the results of one experiment to decide what to investigate next. We present AgentX-Model, the next generation of AgentX's model research framework, which connects proposal development and model experimentation within sandboxes defined by business inputs and prediction tasks. AgentX-Model adopts a dual-agent architecture comprising a Research Agent and a Model Agent. The Research Agent develops independently reviewed proposals from papers and experimental findings, while the Model Agent conducts multi-round investigations and returns code, measurements, and unresolved questions. Using the returned results, the Research Agent selects a starting implementation and formulates the next research question, allowing subsequent experiments to build on earlier findings. We organize this continuing research around four actions: Reproduce, Follow-up, Composition, and Diagnose. The first three actions drive routine research, while Diagnose acquires the evidence needed to choose a repair, including for issues raised by business feedback and online evaluation, such as prediction bias measured by PCOC. Across the production evaluation, 560 of 636 completed model-changing experiments recorded AUC above their business baselines. As research continued, some experiments recorded AUC above every comparable ancestor in their lineages. The five latest online A/B evaluations across different business settings reported gains including 10-15% in acquisition efficiency, 15-20% in target-segment advertising spend, and 0.3-0.8% in watch time; the watch-time model used approximately 10% fewer FLOPs and parameters. A dependency-aware historical-replay benchmark further evaluates research allocation, with initial results showing no consistent efficiency gain from more complex scheduling when agents already analyze and select concrete candidates.

AI.tldr: AgentX-Model 是 AgentX 下一代模型研究框架，采用 Research Agent 与 Model Agent 的双智能体架构，在由业务输入和预测任务定义的沙盒中连接提案开发与模型实验，围绕 Reproduce、Follow-up、Composition、Diagnose 四类动作实现持续、累积式的工业推荐研究闭环。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐研究需要“用一次实验的结果决定下一步研究什么”，即让后续实验能够建立在已有发现之上。因此需要将研究提案生成与模型实验执行连接起来，并支持由业务反馈和线上评估驱动的诊断与修复。
AI.method: 提出 AgentX-Model 双智能体框架：Research Agent 基于论文与实验发现生成经独立评审的研究提案；Model Agent 执行多轮调查，返回代码、测量结果和未解决问题。Research Agent 再据此选择起始实现并制定下一研究问题。研究组织为四类动作：Reproduce、Follow-up、Composition 用于常规研究，Diagnose 用于获取选择修复方案所需证据，包括业务反馈与线上评估提出的问题（如 PCOC 预测偏差）。此外提出依赖感知的历史回放基准，用于评估研究分配策略。
AI.result: 生产评估中，636 个完成且改变模型的实验有 560 个 AUC 高于业务基线；部分实验 AUC 高于其谱系中所有可比祖先。五个最新线上 A/B 评估在不同业务设置下报告收益：获客效率提升 10–15%，目标人群广告支出提升 15–20%，观看时长提升 0.3–0.8%；观看时长模型 FLOPs 与参数约减少 10%。依赖感知历史回放基准的初步结果显示，当智能体已能分析并选择具体候选时，更复杂调度未带来一致的效率增益。
AI.conclusion: AgentX-Model 将提案开发、模型实验与诊断修复整合为可持续的工业推荐研究闭环，在离线 AUC 和线上 A/B 指标上均取得增益，并验证了智能体驱动研究在模型效率方面的潜力。研究分配方面，在智能体具备候选分析与选择能力时，复杂调度策略的额外收益有限。

3b2e3a70bf99b45f6d183da730f06199f05686dc.title: Synthetic Hospital: An Open, Verifiable, Physician-Validated Longitudinal EHR Benchmark
3b2e3a70bf99b45f6d183da730f06199f05686dc.summary: Frontier language models are rarely used in clinical workflows because the realistic, longitudinal benchmarks needed to develop them are scarce. Real electronic health record (EHR) data cannot be openly shared due to privacy, ethics or data use issues and it does not contain verifiable ground truth since the chart records only reflect what clinicians documented. We introduce Synthetic Hospital, an open, fully synthetic, fact-grounded longitudinal EHR benchmark that resolves the open sharing and verifiable ground truth barriers. Built entirely from public medical-education material with no protected health information, it comprises 1,268 longitudinal patients and 5,602 encounters, where every diagnosis, finding, and temporal relation is grounded in standard ontologies (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC) and with a complete provenance chain back to its source medical education material. Synthetic Hospital is served through a simulated hospital record system that mirrors real EHR infrastructure (standard interoperability APIs, role-based access and function-calling interface). In a blinded review, physicians distinguished its records from real patient charts at near-chance rates (53\%). Across 10 frontier and open models, none approaches ceiling: the best model reconstructs a patient's longitudinal problem list with a severity-weighted F1 of 0.73, level with the mean of seven physicians on a matched subset but well below the best of them (0.89), and misses roughly half of clinically relevant findings when summarizing a chart. Overall, these results highlight that Synthetic Hospital is a difficult and realistic test of clinical AI performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Synthetic Hospital：一个开放、全合成、事实锚定的纵向 EHR 基准，基于公开医学教育材料构建，含 1,268 名患者、5,602 次就诊，所有诊断/发现/时序关系均锚定 ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC 并可溯源。医生盲评区分其与真实病历接近随机（53%）。10 个模型均未接近上限，最佳纵向问题列表严重度加权 F1 为 0.73，病历摘要遗漏约一半临床相关发现，表明其是困难且真实的临床 AI 测试。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型难以进入临床工作流，主要因为缺乏开发所需的真实、纵向基准。真实电子健康记录（EHR）数据受隐私、伦理或数据使用限制无法公开共享，且不具备可验证真值，因为病历仅反映临床医生记录的内容。因此需要开放、可共享、具有可验证真值的纵向 EHR 基准。
AI.method: 构建完全合成、事实锚定的纵向 EHR 基准：全部基于公开医学教育材料，不含受保护健康信息；包含 1,268 名纵向患者与 5,602 次就诊；每个诊断、发现和时序关系均锚定到标准本体（ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC），并提供回溯至源医学教育材料的完整溯源链。通过模拟医院记录系统提供服务，镜像真实 EHR 基础设施（标准互操作 API、基于角色的访问控制、函数调用接口）。开展医生盲评，并评测 10 个前沿与开源模型，任务包括重建患者纵向问题列表与病历摘要。
AI.result: 医生盲评中，其记录与真实患者病历的区分接近随机水平（53%）。在 10 个前沿与开源模型中，无一接近上限：最佳模型重建患者纵向问题列表的严重度加权 F1 为 0.73，与 7 位医生在匹配子集上的均值持平，但远低于最佳医生（0.89）；在病历摘要中约遗漏一半临床相关发现。
AI.conclusion: Synthetic Hospital 可作为临床 AI 的困难且真实的评测基准：它同时解决开放共享与可验证真值两大障碍，并揭示当前前沿/开源模型在纵向临床推理与病历摘要上仍显著落后于最佳临床医生。

4070b708981827a2c2ddb69fcfb99e601179a43a.title: Albireo: Adaptive, Energy-Efficient Inference Framework for Video Object Detection on the Edge
4070b708981827a2c2ddb69fcfb99e601179a43a.comment: Accepted at the ACM/IEEE Symposium on Edge Computing (SEC 2026)
4070b708981827a2c2ddb69fcfb99e601179a43a.summary: Video object detection on edge devices runs computationally expensive detectors over long frame streams, causing high energy consumption and sustained GPU utilization. Although consecutive frames are highly redundant, naive frame skipping is content-blind: it skips during critical moments such as object entry, occlusion recovery, and abrupt motion, degrading detection quality. We present Albireo, a detector-agnostic, codec-free adaptive inference framework that wraps off-the-shelf detectors and decides when detector invocation can be safely skipped based on scene content and per-object temporal state, requiring no detector modification or retraining. Albireo maintains a 10-dimensional Kalman filter (KF) per active object and invokes the detector only when prediction uncertainty exceeds a threshold; on skipped frames, boxes are predicted from the KF state at near-zero GPU cost. A KF-based rescue mechanism preserves confirmed objects through brief detector misses to prevent output fragmentation, while a lightweight empty-scene screen avoids detector calls on objectless frames. We evaluate Albireo on the BDD100K MOT validation split with three architecturally distinct detectors (YOLO11x, YOLO26x, RF-DETR-Large) on two NVIDIA Jetson platforms (AGX Thor, AGX Orin). Across all configurations, Albireo keeps AP@50 within +/-1.2 pp of per-frame inference while reducing total energy by 12.1-17.6%. On YOLO26x, it improves AP@50 by +0.8 pp while reducing energy by 17.6% (Thor) and 14.4% (Orin) and per-frame energy-delay product by 24.9% and 26.1%, respectively. Thus, the default operating point improves accuracy, energy, and latency together. In contrast, FixedSkip-2, a fixed-interval baseline with a 50% skip rate, loses 8.6 pp AP@50. Source code, evaluation pipeline, and per-clip results are available at https://github.com/amirtaherin/albireo

AI.tldr: Albireo 是一种与检测器无关、无需编解码信息的自适应推理框架，通过每目标 Kalman 滤波预测不确定性来决定是否调用检测器，从而在边缘设备视频目标检测中同时降低能耗并保持甚至提升精度。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上对长视频流逐帧运行高成本检测器会导致高能耗和持续 GPU 占用；虽然连续帧高度冗余，但朴素跳帧是内容盲的，会在目标进入、遮挡恢复和剧烈运动等关键帧跳过，损害检测质量。
AI.method: Albireo 包装现成检测器，无需修改或重训练。它为每个活跃目标维护 10 维 Kalman 滤波器（KF），仅当预测不确定性超过阈值时才调用检测器；被跳过帧直接由 KF 状态预测框，GPU 开销接近零。另含 KF 救援机制以在短暂漏检时保留已确认目标，避免输出碎片化；并用轻量空场景筛查避免无目标帧的检测调用。
AI.result: 在 BDD100K MOT 验证集上，使用 YOLO11x、YOLO26x、RF-DETR-Large 三种不同架构检测器，以及 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor 和 AGX Orin 两个平台评估。所有配置下，Albireo 将 AP@50 保持在逐帧推理的 ±1.2 个百分点内，同时降低总能耗 12.1%–17.6%。在 YOLO26x 上，AP@50 提升 +0.8 个百分点，能耗降低 17.6%（Thor）和 14.4%（Orin），每帧能量-延迟积分别降低 24.9% 和 26.1%。默认工作点同时改善精度、能耗和延迟；而固定间隔 50% 跳帧基线 FixedSkip-2 损失 8.6 个百分点 AP@50。
AI.conclusion: 基于目标级时序状态的自适应检测调用可以在边缘视频目标检测中优于内容盲跳帧，在保持检测精度甚至略有提升的同时显著降低能耗与能量-延迟积，且具备检测器无关、无需重训练的通用性。

4f0913231502ff2c1d114823244aa95f23585d82.title: How does Adversarial Influence Scale in Multi-Agent Systems?
4f0913231502ff2c1d114823244aa95f23585d82.summary: Multi-agent deliberation can improve performance, but what happens when some agents do not act in good faith? In practice, an agent may be deceptive and work to subvert the group, whether through its own objectives or external instruction. We study how susceptibility to deception scales as groups increase in size and deceivers become more prevalent. It is not the number of agents in the group that matters, but the proportion of deceivers. We observe that the defection rate, how often initially correct agents switch to an incorrect final answer, rises linearly with this proportion. Whereas humans in comparable conformity studies are reliably swayed only when misleading confederates form a majority, LLM agents defect regularly even when deceivers remain a minority. Susceptibility also depends on which models are interacting, especially on the honest agent side. Unexpectedly, allowing deceivers to coordinate privately can make them less effective. Altogether, our results show that adding more agents is therefore not a sufficient defense, because the adversary can simply scale with the group.

AI.tldr: 多智能体审议中，欺骗风险不取决于智能体总数，而取决于欺骗者比例；初始正确智能体的“倒戈率”随欺骗者比例线性上升，LLM 智能体即使面对少数欺骗者也会频繁倒戈，因此单纯扩大群体规模不足以防御欺骗。
AI.motivation: 多智能体审议通常能提升表现，但现实中部分智能体可能出于自身目标或外部指令而欺骗并破坏群体决策。作者希望研究：当群体规模增大、欺骗者更普遍时，系统对欺骗的易感性如何变化。
AI.method: 通过多智能体审议实验，操纵群体规模与欺骗者比例，观察初始正确智能体在最终答案中转为错误的“倒戈率”（defection rate）；比较不同模型组合下的易感性，并测试欺骗者能否私下协调对效果的影响。
AI.result: 易感性主要由欺骗者比例决定，而非群体中智能体总数；倒戈率随欺骗者比例线性上升。与人类 conformity 研究中通常需误导者占多数才被可靠影响不同，LLM 智能体在欺骗者仍为少数时也会经常倒戈。易感性还取决于交互的模型，尤其是诚实智能体一侧的模型。意外的是，允许欺骗者私下协调反而可能降低其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 增加智能体数量并不是充分防御，因为对手可以随群体规模同步扩展；多智能体系统的鲁棒性设计需关注欺骗者比例、模型组合与协调机制，而非仅依赖群体规模。

5e423a52e1099ce7b7a843d55d28bfc4ee3f57ad.title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
5e423a52e1099ce7b7a843d55d28bfc4ee3f57ad.summary: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.

AI.tldr: 论文零样本测试当前商用 LLM 能否识别自己生成的代码：单解自认接近随机，成对自选主要受长度等表面线索驱动；规则归一化后多数结果回到随机水平，建议用平衡准确率、启发式基线与标签一致性来评估。
AI.motivation: 如果语言模型能识别自己写过的代码，它在担任评审时可能偏好自己的输出；若多个模型相互监控，还可能形成串通。因此需要检验当前商用模型是否具备可靠的“自我识别”能力，以及这种能力是否会导致自偏好。
AI.method: 5 个 LLM 在 MBPP、HumanEval、DS-1000 上生成代码，另 7 个 LLM 在 MBPP 上生成代码；模型作为评估者完成 4 类任务：从一对解中选出自己的解、判断单个解是否为自己所写、识别两个解中哪个由指定模型所写、盲评代码质量。采用零样本测试，并比较平衡准确率与原始准确率、分析准确率与解长度等因素的相关性；进一步用规则归一化（去除 docstring、注释、类型提示、局部变量名）并验证 Pass@1 是否保持，同时用训练分类器检验归一化后是否仍可区分。
AI.result: 单解任务中，15 个模型-基准组合的平衡准确率为 49–58%，接近随机；原始准确率 38–67% 主要反映模型“声称自己是作者”的倾向。成对任务中，14 个评估者-对手组合的准确率与“评估者自己的解更长”的频率高度相关，r=0.93。按指定模型进行归属判断时，有些模型对可成功识别，另一些则稳定反向。规则归一化在保持 Pass@1 的同时，使 12 个重测结果中的 10 个回到随机水平；其余 2 个仍跟随归一化后残留的长度差异，但训练分类器仍能区分多数归一化后的解对。Claude Haiku 的自偏好也消失。
AI.conclusion: 当前商用 LLM 的零样本代码自我识别能力总体不可靠，观察到的自偏好大多可由长度等表面启发式解释，而非稳定的自我识别或串通机制。论文建议在类似评估中报告平衡准确率、启发式基线和标签一致性，以避免被原始准确率和表面线索误导。

de6dc2929a3e300814868d57e71bb1d61c0201dc.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
de6dc2929a3e300814868d57e71bb1d61c0201dc.summary: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.

AI.tldr: NNV3 是神经网络验证工具 NNV 的最新版本（MATLAB 框架），在 NNV 1.0/2.0 基础上扩展了 Star-set 家族（ModelStar、VolumeStar、GraphStar），新增基于保形推理的概率可达性模式与公平性认证工具 FairNNV，并引入多领域基准与统一文档站点，标志着该工具向综合化、鲁棒且易用的 AI 验证平台成熟。
AI.motivation: 随着深度学习模型与学习使能的网络物理系统（NNCS）日益复杂，确定性形式验证在诸多场景下难以处理，且应用域不断拓宽（图神经网络、视频/3D 体数据、权重扰动等），既有 NNV 1.0/2.0 的验证能力与基准已不足以覆盖多样化的 AI 系统需求，因此需要一次综合性升级。
AI.method: 在集合式可达性（set-based reachability）基础上，NNV3 扩展了 Star-set 家族：ModelStar 用于权重扰动下的网络验证，VolumeStar 面向视频与 3D 体数据输入，GraphStar 面向图神经网络；引入基于保形推理（conformal inference）的概率可达性模式以补充可靠性分析；并通过 FairNNV 在连续输入区域上认证反事实公平性与个体公平性。
AI.result: NNV3 支持对前馈网络、卷积网络、NNCS、循环网络、SSNN、神经 ODE 以及图神经网络的验证，新增恶意软件检测、基于图的电力系统模型、医学影像、变长时间序列数据与动作识别等基准，并提供教程与开发者指南组成的统一文档站点。
AI.conclusion: NNV3 的更新表明 NNV 已从单一验证工具成长为面向多样化 AI 系统的综合、鲁棒且易获取的验证平台。

0cda310c019c23ac7d887132b496fe373d93cf17.title: SciWalker: Synthesizing Scientific Coding Problems with Operator Graphs and Execution Feedback
0cda310c019c23ac7d887132b496fe373d93cf17.summary: Improving the scientific coding capabilities of large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality training data. However, such data remain scarce because manually authoring realistic problems is costly and time-consuming, while systematically covering diverse scientific domains and algorithmic combinations remains challenging. To address this, we introduce SciWalker, a framework for synthesizing scientific coding problems through operator-chain sampling and execution feedback. The framework combines scientific library interfaces with operation modes to instantiate operators, organizes them into operator graphs, and samples operator chains as computational workflow cues. Guided by these cues, we adopt LLMs to generate scientifically grounded problem statements, reference solutions, and tests, with failed generations iteratively repaired using execution feedback. By combining structured workflow composition with verification and quality review, SciWalker enables scalable task generation while promoting scientific grounding, computational diversity, and executability. Using this framework, we construct 8,178 high-quality problems spanning 5 scientific domains and 32 subdomains. To evaluate their training utility, we conduct reinforcement learning on Qwen3.5-9B using the GSPO algorithm. This training improves SciCode subproblem accuracy by 9.9 percentage points, from 29.3% to 39.2%, with gains across scientific code generation, code repair, and reasoning benchmarks. The code for SciWalker is available at https://github.com/lichenx1/SciWalker.

AI.tldr: SciWalker 通过“算子链采样 + 执行反馈”合成科学编程题，构建了覆盖 5 个科学领域、32 个子领域的 8,178 道高质量问题，并用 GSPO 强化学习验证其训练价值，使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SciCode 子问题准确率上从 29.3% 提升至 39.2%。
AI.motivation: 提升大语言模型的科学编程能力依赖高质量训练数据，但此类数据稀缺：人工编写真实问题成本高、耗时长，且难以系统覆盖多样科学领域与算法组合。因此需要可扩展、可验证、兼具科学性与计算多样性的任务生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 SciWalker 框架，通过算子链采样与执行反馈合成科学编程问题。具体将科学库接口与操作模式结合来实例化算子，组织为算子图，并采样算子链作为计算工作流线索；以这些线索引导 LLM 生成有科学依据的问题陈述、参考解与测试；对生成失败的样本利用执行反馈进行迭代修复。框架结合结构化工作流组合、验证与质量审查，实现可扩展任务生成。
AI.result: 基于该框架构建了 8,178 道高质量问题，覆盖 5 个科学领域与 32 个子领域。使用 GSPO 算法对 Qwen3.5-9B 进行强化学习后，SciCode 子问题准确率提升 9.9 个百分点，由 29.3% 提升至 39.2%，并在科学代码生成、代码修复与推理基准上均取得增益。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SciWalker 表明，将结构化算子工作流采样与执行反馈验证相结合，可规模化生成科学编程训练数据，并有效提升 LLM 的科学代码生成、修复与推理能力。该工作为科学编程数据合成提供了可复用框架与实证支持。

140e51c2c5de894d59a82e9f42236350f3487faf.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
140e51c2c5de894d59a82e9f42236350f3487faf.comment: AC, KD, and MYL contributed equally; authors are listed alphabetically
140e51c2c5de894d59a82e9f42236350f3487faf.summary: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.

AI.tldr: 提出"零数据自博弈预训练"(Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data)，让生成器与学习器从随机初始化开始协同进化：生成器产出被通用图灵机解释的程序并生成字节序列，学习器自回归预测这些序列；在无自然数据训练的情况下，自然数据上的零样本损失随自博弈算力可预测地缩放。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型预训练依赖人工筛选/策划的数据，规模受人类知识限制；若模型能自主生成对自身改进最有用的数据，就可获得由算力而非人类知识约束的近乎无限训练数据。因此需要验证"无自然数据、纯自博弈"预训练是否可行并具备可扩展性。
AI.method: 将合成数据生成建模为对"所有可计算结构"空间的搜索，受Solomonoff归纳启发。从随机初始化开始，两个模型并行学习：生成器提出由通用图灵机解释的程序，从而产生字节序列；学习器自回归预测这些字节序列。学习器用标准交叉熵训练；生成器用强化学习训练，目标是生成处于学习器能力前沿的序列，形成自适应课程。通用图灵机构成对所有可计算数据生成过程的搜索空间，引入较少领域特定结构。
AI.result: 在多个自然数据集上，零样本损失随自博弈算力呈现可预测的缩放规律；由于生成器和学习器均未接触自然数据，这构成对迁移能力的干净检验。模型还表现出上下文学习能力，并在训练中发现可识别的数学序列。
AI.conclusion: 该工作作为概念验证，表明以自博弈在可计算结构空间中搜索训练数据，可在无自然数据条件下产生可迁移、可扩展的预训练信号；为以算力驱动、而非依赖人工数据策划的通用预训练路径提供了初步证据。

50957ea0f133a47cabcc038c822682afd77d1a8a.title: PrivDrift: Auditing User-Secret Leakage Under Topic Drift in Active LLM Conversations
50957ea0f133a47cabcc038c822682afd77d1a8a.summary: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce \textbf{PrivDrift}, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1{,}000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7\% to 54.6\%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PrivDrift 基准，用于审计用户披露的秘密在对话话题漂移和说服式探测后是否仍可被恢复；在三个长上下文 LLM 上，对话级混合泄漏率仍达 38.7%–54.6%，且额外话题漂移不能可靠降低泄漏，说明应把活跃上下文中的隐私风险视为持续性行为失效模式。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益作为持久助手用于用户交互、共享会话和工具增强场景。用户在多轮对话中披露敏感信息后，即使话题已转向无关内容，后续提示仍可能行为性地恢复这些信息。现有隐私风险讨论多集中于训练数据记忆或即时越狱，缺少对“话题漂移后秘密是否仍可提取”的系统审计。
AI.method: 提出 PrivDrift 基准：包含 1,000 个受控多轮对话，设置种子秘密、内容密集的漂移轮次以及标准化提取探测；在三个具有扩展上下文窗口的 LLM 上评估话题漂移与说服式探测下的秘密可恢复性。
AI.result: 对话级混合泄漏率仍然显著，范围为 38.7%–54.6%，并随模型、秘密类型和说服强度强烈变化。在测试的漂移窗口内，额外话题漂移并不能可靠降低泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 活跃 LLM 上下文中的隐私风险应被评估为持续性的行为失效模式，而不仅是训练数据记忆或即时越狱行为；PrivDrift 为审计此类风险提供了受控基准。

1756c800f65248a275d1731ec6f53da13aebc098.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
1756c800f65248a275d1731ec6f53da13aebc098.summary: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

AI.tldr: TrackEverything 是一种 3D 点跟踪器，通过将视频表示为世界坐标系下的持久 3D 场景轨迹，打破了“稀疏点长时跟踪”与“稠密点短片段跟踪”之间的权衡，可在 40GB GPU 显存内跟踪超过 1000 帧视频中的所有可见点。
AI.motivation: 现有视频点跟踪模型存在根本性权衡：要么在长时序上跟踪稀疏查询点，要么仅在短片段内跟踪所有点，难以兼顾长时程与全帧稠密跟踪。作者基于“视频是底层 3D 世界的 2D 投影”这一洞察，希望将模型复杂度与视频时长解耦，使其随场景中独特物理几何的规模扩展，而非随时长线性增长。
AI.method: 方法核心是将视频建模为世界坐标下的持久 3D 场景轨迹，并引入三项创新：1）在滑动窗口边界采用基于体素化的去重机制，合并共位轨迹，避免同一表面被重复观测而冗余累积；2）将跟踪分解为端点精化器与轻量轨迹精化器：前者预测每个点的终点并区分静态/动态，后者仅对动态点解码稠密轨迹；3）提出 3D WAFT，用场景点云中的高效特征采样替代显存开销巨大的 4D 相关体。
AI.result: TrackEverything 是首个能在 40GB GPU 显存内跟踪超过 1000 帧视频中所有可见点的 3D 跟踪器。在 TAPVid-3D 上，短片段中其 APD 比所有开源全帧稠密 3D 跟踪器高出 20% 以上；在长序列上，尽管跟踪点数远多于稀疏跟踪器，仍与最先进的稀疏跟踪器保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TrackEverything 通过世界坐标系下的持久 3D 场景轨迹表示，有效打破了长时程稀疏跟踪与短片段稠密跟踪之间的权衡，并借助去重、动静分解与高效特征采样实现可扩展的全点 3D 跟踪，在短片段稠密跟踪和长序列跟踪中均表现优异。

db183a488676e933a954015329ce0fa51f022851.title: HEXIS: Compiling Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
db183a488676e933a954015329ce0fa51f022851.summary: Agent skills provide reusable knowledge and instructions, yet agents must repeatedly infer how to apply them and which operation should follow. This couples task reasoning with control decisions, allowing prescribed steps to be omitted or applied incorrectly. We introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.1 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: HEXIS 将智能体技能编译为扩展有限状态机，把技能知识与控制流解耦，通过增量编译与轨迹对齐补全操作和依赖，在四个基准和四种执行器上平均将成功率较 Skill + ReAct 提升 16.1 个百分点，并显著降低执行 token。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体技能虽提供可复用知识与指令，但执行时仍需反复推断如何应用技能以及下一步应执行何种操作，导致任务推理与控制决策耦合，可能遗漏或错误应用规定步骤。
AI.method: 提出 HEXIS，将技能编译为扩展有限状态机以分离知识与控制流：技能知识进入各状态的局部指令以指导推理与生成；状态机记录执行进度与中间结果，显式转移条件决定后续操作。增量编译器先将技能条款与工具接口映射为状态操作、局部指令、数据绑定和转移；再通过开发轨迹与已有状态对齐，识别缺失操作与依赖，并通过新增或复用状态及细化连接加以整合；更新仅在静态检查和重放当前及此前所有已接受轨迹后接受。
AI.result: 在四个基准和四种执行器上，HEXIS 相比 Skill + ReAct 平均成功率提升 16.1 个百分点；使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时，各基准执行 token 降低 38.4%–88.9%。
AI.conclusion: HEXIS 通过将技能编译为扩展有限状态机并采用增量、可验证的编译流程，有效解耦技能知识与控制决策，提升智能体任务执行成功率并大幅降低执行开销。

e6358b2c65f35e643650aa26a4f39630d4192a1d.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
e6358b2c65f35e643650aa26a4f39630d4192a1d.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://ad-wm.github.io/
e6358b2c65f35e643650aa26a4f39630d4192a1d.summary: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 AD-WM：一种面向反事实 MPC 的动作可判别联合嵌入世界模型，通过残差隐动力学与预测器级动作恢复正则，使规划转移保留动作信息，在仿真与真机零样本迁移上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有隐世界模型通常只优化事实转移预测误差，而 MPC 需要从同一状态比较不同候选动作。二者目标不一致：模型可能事实预测误差很低，却无法有效区分候选动作，导致闭环规划性能不佳。
AI.method: AD-WM 将残差隐动力学与预测器级动作恢复正则结合：引入逆动力学，并设计由条件互信息启发的归一化恢复目标。两个目标均促使规划转移保留动作信息；辅助头仅在训练时使用，测试时丢弃，因此不改变原有 MPC 流程。
AI.result: 在 OGBench-Cube 上，AD-WM 将 hard-start 成功率由匹配 LeWM 基线的 3.7% 提升至 52.0%，并在五个仿真环境中的四个优于复现基线。规划诊断显示：事实预测误差与整组动作排序并不遵循闭环成功率顺序，而 CEM 对齐的 elite regret 与成功率更一致。冻结 V-JEPA 2 编码器并匹配 DROID 后训练时，AD-WM 提升零样本迁移至 Franka 设置，basic pick-and-place 成功率由 42.2% 升至 71.1%，无需实验室特定适配。
AI.conclusion: 面向规划的世界模型应保留反事实选择所需的动作相关差异，而非仅优化事实预测精度；动作可判别性是与闭环规划性能更相关的训练信号。

8c096561c93603838bd4e16f430ff7eef820a8c2.title: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
8c096561c93603838bd4e16f430ff7eef820a8c2.summary:
Customer experience (CX) agents use tools and large language models to address customer requests and guide conversational interactions with an organization's products. Improving these agents, especially in regulated industries, is difficult: they must detect intent, follow complex operational policies and use tools reliably. Manual end-to-end testing offers limited coverage, while live experiments expose customers to failures that can erode trust.
  We present a hypothesis-driven simulation workflow for screening candidate CX agents before deployment. Synthetic customers react to agent responses and simulated tool outputs enable multi-step agentic workflows without invoking production backends. We use the Snowglobe simulator on Nubank's Card Delivery agent and its expanded successor, Card Management - Nubank's highest-volume chat-support agent in Brazil. Across 4 deployed versions, simulated and production version-level binary evaluator scores show high correlation. Simulation-guided iteration increased transactional net promoter score (tNPS) by 36.69 points in a live A/B test. We also screened open-weight configurations in over 16,000 simulated conversations. In a subsequent live A/B test, the selected model increased self-service rate (SSR) by 8.82 percentage points to the highest level observed at Nubank, with no statistically significant change in tNPS. Simulation made broad exploration of models, reasoning settings, and prompts feasible without customer exposure, enabling production improvements that would have been impractical to pursue through live experimentation alone.

AI.tldr: 提出假设驱动的仿真工作流，在部署前用合成客户与模拟工具输出筛选CX智能体；在Nubank的Card Delivery与Card Management代理上验证，仿真与生产评估分数高度相关，并指导迭代使tNPS提升36.69分、SSR提升8.82个百分点。
AI.motivation: CX代理需借助工具和大语言模型处理客户请求并引导对话。在受监管行业中改进困难：代理必须识别意图、遵循复杂运营政策并可靠使用工具。人工端到端测试覆盖有限，而线上实验会让客户暴露于失败风险，损害信任。
AI.method: 提出假设驱动的仿真工作流：合成客户对代理回复作出反应，模拟工具输出支持多步代理式工作流，无需调用生产后端。使用Snowglobe模拟器，在Nubank的Card Delivery代理及其扩展后继Card Management（巴西最高频聊天支持代理）上评估。对4个已部署版本比较仿真与生产的版本级二元评估器分数；通过仿真指导迭代，并在超过16,000次模拟对话中筛选开放权重模型配置，随后进行线上A/B测试。
AI.result: 4个已部署版本的仿真与生产版本级二元评估器分数高度相关。仿真指导的迭代在线上A/B测试中使交易净推荐值（tNPS）提升36.69分。在超过16,000次模拟对话中筛选开放权重配置后，后续线上A/B测试中选定模型使自助服务率（SSR）提升8.82个百分点，达到Nubank观测到的最高水平，且tNPS无统计显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 仿真使模型、推理设置和提示的广泛探索在不暴露客户的情况下可行，实现了仅靠线上实验难以推进的生产改进。

bbff844156956fc614462c2682749223880e74d3.title: EnigmaForge: The Question Is Hidden in the Story
bbff844156956fc614462c2682749223880e74d3.summary: Most benchmarks hand the model a question. EnigmaForge hands it a stack of old documents and no question at all. Buried in the letters, receipts, and logbook margins is a small logic puzzle whose solution is unique - proved by a SAT solver at generation time, with an ablation certificate showing every clue is load-bearing. Because instances are generated rather than collected, the corpus renews forever. The headline measure is intuition: task success when handed only the story, with world reconstruction as the secondary axis. Twenty-five frontier models ran over 600 instances (17,400 scored records) under three matched conditions. Intuition reshuffles the leaderboard: a 22x spread where fact recovery spans 1.6x, the second-best fact-recoverer ranks fourteenth, one model is indifferent to being told the question, and another is significantly better without it. Several models were blocked by their own content filters before reaching the puzzle - any benchmark scoring refusals as failure is quietly measuring filter behavior.

AI.tldr: EnigmaForge 是一个不给问题、只给一叠旧文档的生成式基准，文档中埋有由 SAT 求解器保证唯一解、且经消融证书验证每条线索都必要的逻辑谜题。以"直觉"（仅凭故事完成任务）为主指标，25 个前沿模型在 600+ 实例上测试，发现直觉能力造成 22 倍分差并重排排行榜，且部分模型因内容过滤器在触题前即被拦截。
