AI.motivation: 现有基准几乎都以"给定问题"的方式考察模型，默认模型已被明确告知要解决什么。作者希望检验一种更贴近真实情报/考古场景的能力——在没有任何明确提问的情况下，从杂乱原始文档中自主发现并求解隐藏谜题（即"直觉"），并探究这种能力是否与常规事实检索能力一致。
AI.method: 构建生成式基准 EnigmaForge：向模型提供一叠旧文档（信件、收据、航海日志页边），其中埋藏一个逻辑谜题但不给出任何提问。生成时用 SAT 求解器证明解唯一，并通过消融证书证明每条线索都是必要的（load-bearing）。因采用生成而非收集，语料可无限更新。评测设置三个匹配条件，用 25 个前沿模型在 600 多个实例（17,400 条打分记录）上运行，以"仅凭故事的任务成功率（直觉）"为主指标，"世界重建"为次指标。
AI.result: 直觉能力重排了排行榜：直觉得分差距达 22 倍，而事实恢复能力仅相差 1.6 倍；事实恢复排名第二的模型在直觉上仅排第十四；有一个模型在被明确告知问题时表现无差异，另一个模型在不被提问时反而显著更好。此外，若干模型在接触到谜题前就被自身内容过滤器拦截。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了"直觉"（从无问题的原始文档中自主定位并求解隐藏谜题）与常规事实检索是两种不同能力：直觉能力在不同模型间差异巨大，且无法由事实恢复能力预测。因此，仅用"是否拒绝"作为失败判定的评测，实际上是在隐性测量模型内容过滤器的行为，而非其推理能力。

1b7d0db86958b0ede6fa419619e25afe01c50159.title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
1b7d0db86958b0ede6fa419619e25afe01c50159.comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026
1b7d0db86958b0ede6fa419619e25afe01c50159.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing $\textbf{GRASP}$, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ($\sim$12.4$\%$$\uparrow$), ZebraLogic ($\sim$30.8$\%$$\uparrow$), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7$\%$ over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5$\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出 GRASP，一种策略感知、多阶段、上下文隔离的规划框架，用于为复杂任务生成高质量自然语言可执行计划，并在多数据集与多任务扩展场景中显著超越直接 LLM 规划器及前沿推理模型。
AI.motivation: LLM 的可靠性通常随任务复杂度上升而下降；直接让 LLM 生成复杂任务的可执行自然语言计划时，性能容易退化，尤其在多任务或交错任务场景下会出现明显崩溃。
AI.method: GRASP 将规划流程解耦为专门化、上下文隔离的模块：GenPlan 预编译全局宏观准则；RevPlan 在隔离上下文窗口中探索替代性的局部策略；VerPlan 使用多准则判别器独立评估规划轨迹。该方法强调上下文隔离与严格的宏观正则化。
AI.result: GRASP 在多个数据集上达到新的 SOTA：Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling 准确率提升约 12.4%，ZebraLogic 提升约 30.8%，SciBench Math 亦有提升；在多任务扩展中消除多任务退化惩罚；交错双任务环境中相对直接 LLM 规划器最高绝对准确率增益达 16.7%；并比 GPT-5-mini 等前沿推理模型高 14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过多阶段、策略感知与上下文隔离的规划架构，GRASP 能有效缓解复杂任务与多任务场景下的 LLM 规划可靠性下降问题，显著提升复杂自然语言可执行计划的生成质量。

b0a6efe7a29501f81ae9875000b2d7fb83982b70.title: Accelerating Video Diffusion via Training-Free Trajectory Routing
b0a6efe7a29501f81ae9875000b2d7fb83982b70.summary: Video diffusion is computationally expensive, as it requires executing a large model across many denoising steps. Even with step-distillation, inference remains expensive because every distilled step still requires a costly model evaluation. We present TRACK: TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection, a heterogeneous denoising strategy that switches between compatible large and small models at selected steps, reducing the average cost per denoising evaluation. The switching steps are determined using a calibration process. TRACK first rolls out a reference trajectory with the large model. Then at each step, the small model's prediction is also collected and compared against the large model's prediction to obtain a relative disagreement score. Both models receive the same latent, timestep, conditioning, and guidance inputs. Aggregating this signal over a calibration set produces a disagreement score map across diffusion steps, which determines a switching policy for an efficient inference process: quality-sensitive steps keep using the large model, while steps with low disagreement scores are routed to the small model. Inference executes only the selected model at each step, requiring no retraining, architecture or scheduler changes, or online dual-model evaluation. Across Wan 2.1, Cosmos 3, TurboDiffusion, and FastVideo, TRACK yields $1.95\times$, $2.04\times$-$2.73\times$, $2.69\times$, and $2.17\times$ speedups, respectively, with comparable aggregate quality and high diversity retention. TRACK thereby establishes automated, training-free model switching as a practical acceleration paradigm for video diffusion.

AI.tldr: TRACK 提出一种免训练、无需架构/调度器修改的异构去噪策略：通过校准阶段计算大/小模型预测的相对分歧分数图，确定切换策略，在质量敏感步保留大模型、低分歧步路由到小模型，从而降低平均单步成本。在 Wan 2.1、Cosmos 3、TurboDiffusion、FastVideo 上分别取得 1.95×、2.04×–2.73×、2.69×、2.17× 加速，质量相当且多样性保持良好。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型推理代价高昂：需在大量去噪步上执行大模型；即便采用步蒸馏，每一步仍需一次昂贵的大模型评估。因此需要一种能在去噪过程中降低平均单步计算成本、又不损失生成质量的加速方案。
AI.method: TRACK（TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection）采用异构去噪与模型切换：首先用大模型 rollout 一条参考轨迹；在每个去噪步额外采集小模型预测，并与大模型预测对比，得到相对分歧分数（两模型共享相同 latent、timestep、conditioning 与 guidance 输入）。在校准集上聚合该信号，形成跨扩散步的分歧分数图，据此确定切换策略（top-K 选择）：质量敏感步继续使用大模型，低分歧步路由至小模型。推理时每步仅执行所选模型，无需重训练、无需改动架构或调度器、也无需在线双模型评估。
AI.result: 在 Wan 2.1、Cosmos 3、TurboDiffusion、FastVideo 上，TRACK 分别实现 1.95×、2.04×–2.73×、2.69×、2.17× 的加速，同时保持可比的整体质量与较高的多样性保留率。
AI.conclusion: TRACK 确立了自动化、免训练模型切换作为视频扩散加速的一种实用范式。

4f723a5f86ee10c088a0fd8ec38d0747707d072c.title: Search-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Component Query Understanding in Roblox Game Search
4f723a5f86ee10c088a0fd8ec38d0747707d072c.summary: Query understanding (QU) plays a critical role in production search systems, translating raw user queries into search execution plans that drive downstream retrieval and ranking. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled QU to be framed as a structured multi-task generation problem (e.g., intent classification, query expansion), optimizing such models to produce search-engine-coupled outputs remains challenging: static, label-based supervision fails to capture how each component actually interacts with the underlying search pipeline to affect downstream performance. We present a search-aware reinforcement learning (RL) framework for QU based on a distill-then-RL paradigm. Teacher-student supervised fine-tuning (SFT) first yields a well-formed, schema-compliant policy initialization. The RL stage then optimizes each QU component with rewards derived from live interaction with the search engine, tailored to that component's operational role, rather than a single reward tied to the final search outcome. Experiments on Roblox search show that this component-specific optimization improves both per-component utility and downstream search quality, raising NDCG@20 by 8.9 points over the SFT policy and by 3.5 points over training with a single end-to-end reward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向查询理解（QU）的搜索感知强化学习框架，采用“先蒸馏后强化学习”范式：先用教师-学生SFT获得符合schema的策略初始化，再用来自搜索引擎实时交互的、按各QU组件角色定制的奖励进行RL优化，从而提升各组件效用与下游搜索质量。
AI.motivation: 查询理解在生产搜索系统中至关重要，负责将用户原始查询转化为搜索执行计划以驱动召回与排序。LLM使QU可被建模为结构化多任务生成（如意图分类、查询扩展），但现有静态、基于标签的监督无法反映各QU组件与搜索流水线交互后对下游性能的实际影响，导致优化目标与搜索效果脱节。
AI.method: 提出搜索感知强化学习框架，基于distill-then-RL范式：第一阶段用教师-学生监督微调（SFT）得到结构良好、符合schema的策略初始化；第二阶段用强化学习优化每个QU组件，奖励来自与搜索引擎的实时交互，并针对该组件的操作角色定制，而非使用与最终搜索结果绑定的单一端到端奖励。
AI.result: 在Roblox搜索上的实验表明，组件级定制优化同时提升各组件效用和下游搜索质量：相比SFT策略，NDCG@20提升8.9个点；相比使用单一端到端奖励训练，NDCG@20提升3.5个点。
AI.conclusion: 面向QU的搜索感知RL与组件级奖励设计优于静态标签监督和单一端到端奖励，能够更有效地将QU模型优化与搜索系统下游表现对齐。

ccb98e572a296f3b2e8619cb5acdfd95cc6f62a0.title: Beyond Average Safety: Chance-Constrained LLM Fine-tuning
ccb98e572a296f3b2e8619cb5acdfd95cc6f62a0.summary: Fine-tuning large language models on new objectives can improve helpfulness, instruction following, or domain-specific performance, but it can also induce regressions on safety-critical prompts. Existing safety-preserving fine-tuning methods typically control average safety loss or use weighted auxiliary penalties, which can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose a chance-constrained formulation for safety-preserving fine-tuning that limits the fraction of safety examples whose degradation relative to a reference model exceeds a prescribed threshold. Because the resulting empirical chance constraint contains a discontinuous indicator, we introduce a differentiable majorization of the violation rate, yielding a tractable conservative constraint. We then develop a constraint-aware gradient descent method that treats the majorized constraint as a safe set in parameter space and minimally modifies the fine-tuning direction to preserve feasibility. The resulting update admits a closed form and produces a tail-aware safety correction that emphasizes examples near or above the degradation threshold. We conduct an extensive set of experiments on harmful fine-tuning across three different tasks and three models and show that our approach consistently outperforms the baselines that exist in the literature. These results suggest that safety preservation in LLM fine-tuning is better viewed as a reliability-constrained optimization problem than as average-risk regularization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种机会约束式安全保持微调方法，通过可微的违规率majorization与约束感知梯度下降，限制安全样本退化比例，在多个任务和模型上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型微调虽能提升有用性、指令遵循或领域性能，但可能损害安全关键提示的表现。现有方法多控制平均安全损失或使用加权辅助惩罚，容易掩盖罕见但严重的失败案例。
AI.method: 将安全保持微调建模为机会约束优化：限制相对于参考模型退化超过给定阈值的安全样本比例。由于经验机会约束包含不连续指示函数，作者引入违规率的可微majorization，得到可处理的保守约束；进而提出约束感知梯度下降，将majorized约束视为参数空间中的安全集，以闭式解最小修正微调方向，形成尾部感知的安全校正，重点处理接近或超过退化阈值的样本。
AI.result: 在三个任务、三个模型上进行了大量有害微调实验，所提方法持续优于文献中的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM微调中的安全保持更适合被看作可靠性约束优化问题，而非平均风险正则化问题。

a20637bbdaa412c10240d6851e50387fb057d842.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
a20637bbdaa412c10240d6851e50387fb057d842.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for autonomous mobile GUI agents, but most existing systems rely on the VLM for both planning and action grounding at nearly every interaction step, leading to substantial latency and model-serving cost. We introduce Jev-Mobile, which shifts this paradigm to low-frequency VLM planning and high-frequency lightweight execution: the VLM specifies local goals, the accessibility tree defines a structured executable action space, and Jev, a fast typed decision model, repeatedly selects actions within this space. This design allows multiple GUI actions to be executed under a single VLM decision, reducing expensive VLM inference while preserving adaptive interaction. On the full AndroidWorld task suite, Jev-Mobile achieves 79% task success, compared with 78% for SeeAct-V and 84% for a Step-wise VLM baseline. Among successful trajectories, it reduces mean end-to-end execution time by 32.7% and mean model API cost by 73.4% relative to Step-wise VLM. These results show that decoupling high-level VLM reasoning from low-level action execution can substantially improve mobile GUI agent efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance.

AI.tldr: Jev-Mobile 提出低频 VLM 规划与高频轻量执行的解耦范式，用可访问性树构建结构化动作空间，并由快速类型化决策模型 Jev 连续选动作，从而在保持任务成功率竞争力的同时显著降低移动 GUI 智能体的延迟与 API 成本。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的自主移动 GUI 智能体通常在每个交互步骤都依赖 VLM 同时完成规划与动作落地，导致显著延迟与模型服务成本，难以满足高频交互场景的效率需求。
AI.method: Jev-Mobile 将高层推理与低层执行解耦：VLM 仅低频指定局部目标；可访问性树（accessibility tree）提供结构化可执行动作空间；轻量类型化决策模型 Jev 在该空间中高频重复选择动作，使单次 VLM 决策下可执行多个 GUI 动作，保留自适应交互能力。
AI.result: 在完整 AndroidWorld 任务集上，Jev-Mobile 达到 79% 任务成功率，对比 SeeAct-V 的 78% 与逐步 VLM 基线的 84%；在成功轨迹中，相较逐步 VLM 基线，平均端到端执行时间降低 32.7%，平均模型 API 成本降低 73.4%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，将高层 VLM 推理与低层动作执行解耦，可在维持有竞争力的任务性能的同时，大幅提升移动 GUI 智能体的效率，验证了低频规划+高频轻量执行范式的有效性。

aa00b551032852c1e7144f64b2dcb35b144aa9d2.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
aa00b551032852c1e7144f64b2dcb35b144aa9d2.summary: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes. We argue that this brittleness arises from two biases induced by complex reasoning spaces: an exploration bias, where models are drawn toward locally plausible but structurally unstable branches, and a compounding bias, where small local deviations accumulate across depth and suppress rare rewards. We introduce Symbolic Closure Analysis (SCA) as a theoretical lens characterizing how branching structures and sparse rewards induce these biases in long-horizon reasoning with local admissibility, and as a design principle for structural priors in less formal reasoning tasks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose SAGE (Structural Admissibility-Guided Exploration), a unified framework that injects structural guidance to alleviate exploration bias and compounding bias in long-horizon reasoning. SAGE combines two complementary structural guidance: algebraic sparsification, which projects locally admissible candidates onto operator-indexed algebraic subspaces to suppress spurious branching and mitigate exploration bias, and hyperbolic structural guidance, which embeds reasoning states into a negatively curved space to provide dense depth-wise signals and mitigate compounding bias. Across 12 benchmarks and 7 model families, SAGE outperforms competitive baselines. In particular, SAGE achieves up to an 8-fold improvement on the Andrews-Curtis problem, an open real-world long-horizon task. Code is available at: https://github.com/Susan571/SAGE-NeurIPS2026.

AI.tldr: 论文从稀疏奖励下LLM长程推理的脆弱性出发，提出SCA理论分析探索偏差与累积偏差，并据此设计SAGE框架，通过代数稀疏化和双曲结构引导缓解两类偏差，在12个基准、7个模型族上超越基线，Andrews-Curtis任务最高提升8倍。
AI.motivation: LLM在稀疏奖励下的长程推理仍很脆弱。作者认为这种脆弱性源于复杂推理空间带来的两种偏差：探索偏差使模型偏向局部看似合理但结构不稳定的分支；累积偏差使局部小偏离随推理深度累积，进而抑制稀有奖励的获得。因此需要从理论层面刻画这些偏差，并据此引入结构先验来改善长程推理。
AI.method: 论文提出Symbolic Closure Analysis（SCA）作为理论透镜，分析在局部可容许条件下，分支结构与稀疏奖励如何诱发上述两类偏差，并将其作为非形式推理任务中结构先验的设计原则。基于该分析，提出SAGE（Structural Admissibility-Guided Exploration）统一框架，注入两类互补的结构引导：一是代数稀疏化，将局部可容许候选投影到算子索引的代数子空间，以抑制虚假分支、缓解探索偏差；二是双曲结构引导，将推理状态嵌入负曲率空间，以提供密集的深度方向信号、缓解累积偏差。
AI.result: 在12个基准和7个模型族上，SAGE均优于竞争基线。尤其在Andrews-Curtis问题这一开放的真实世界长程任务上，SAGE取得最高8倍的性能提升。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SCA为长程推理中由分支结构与稀疏奖励诱发的探索偏差和累积偏差提供了理论解释，并给出了结构先验的设计原则。SAGE通过代数稀疏化与双曲结构引导验证了该原则的有效性，表明结构引导能显著缓解两类偏差，提升稀疏奖励下长程推理的表现。

0831c84a65525b3dfff90bc6db452aa729ec98c7.title: Diverse Geometries, Frozen Weights: Robust Heterogeneous Treatment-Effect Estimation via Causal Expert Ensembles
0831c84a65525b3dfff90bc6db452aa729ec98c7.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 8 benchmark protocols. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary file
0831c84a65525b3dfff90bc6db452aa729ec98c7.summary: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects from observational data is difficult because the most appropriate inductive bias varies with overlap, treatment imbalance, prognostic structure, and sample size. We introduce the Geometry-Diverse Anchor-Correction Expert Ensemble (GeoACE), a five-expert framework that combines a common anchor-correction estimator with complementary overlap-aware and outcome-guided geometries. Its task-level ensemble weights are learned only from internal validation predictions, frozen before test evaluation, and then applied to experts refitted on the complete development sample. The fifth expert, O-Phi-ACE, constructs an outcome-free, overlap-aware statistical projection from covariates and treatment assignment and replaces the anchor input with this lower-dimensional geometry. We evaluate GeoACE against 11 comparators on eight benchmark protocols. Adding O-Phi-ACE reduced mean sqrt(PEHE) relative to the four-expert ensemble on all seven benchmarks with individual-effect truth, winning 998 of 1,225 paired tasks; the change on JOBS policy risk was negligible. The five-expert ensemble ranked first on IHDP100, IHDPA, and IHDPB and second on NEWS, differing from the NEWS leader by 0.13%. Across the seven sqrt(PEHE) benchmarks it obtained the lowest observed average rank (3.714), although the omnibus Friedman and Iman-Davenport tests were not significant (p=0.328 and p=0.330). Using the same five frozen experts, inverse-DR weighting was consistently better than winner-take-all selection, convex DR fitting, R-stacking, and causal Q-aggregation in benchmark-balanced analyses, but was statistically indistinguishable from equal weighting and DR ridge shrinkage. The evidence therefore supports geometry-diverse expert libraries and leakage-free aggregation as a robustness strategy, not universal superiority of either GeoACE or one weighting rule.

AI.tldr: GeoACE 是一个由五个专家组成的异构处理效应估计框架：以"锚点-校正"估计器为核心，结合重叠感知与结果引导的多种几何结构；集成权重仅依据内部验证预测学习、冻结后再应用于全样本重拟合的专家。实验表明，加入无结果信息的重叠感知专家 O-Phi-ACE 可在多数基准上降低 sqrt(PEHE)，但整体统计显著性不足，说明其价值在于几何多样性与无泄漏聚合的稳健性，而非普遍最优。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计异质处理效应（HTE）困难，因为最优的归纳偏置（inductive bias）会随重叠度、处理组不平衡、预后结构（prognostic structure）与样本量而变化，单一模型难以在所有情形下保持优势。因此需要一种能够自适应整合多种归纳偏置、同时避免测试信息泄漏的稳健估计方案。
AI.method: 提出 GeoACE（Geometry-Diverse Anchor-Correction Expert Ensemble），一个五专家框架：以共同的"锚点-校正"（anchor-correction）估计器为基础，搭配互补的"重叠感知"与"结果引导"几何结构。集成权重在任务层面仅由内部验证预测学习，在测试评估前冻结，再应用于在完整开发样本上重拟合的专家。第五个专家 O-Phi-ACE 由协变量与处理分配构造一个无结果、重叠感知的统计投影（低维几何），并用该几何替换锚点输入。
AI.result: 在八个基准协议、11 个对比方法上评估：加入 O-Phi-ACE 后，在全部七个具有个体效应真值的基准上相对四专家集成降低了平均 sqrt(PEHE)，在 1,225 个配对任务中胜出 998 个；JOBS 策略风险变化可忽略。五专家集成在 IHDP100、IHDPA、IHDPB 上排名第一，在 NEWS 上排名第二（与榜首相差 0.13%）。在七个 sqrt(PEHE) 基准上取得最低平均排名 3.714，但 Friedman 与 Iman-Davenport 检验不显著（p=0.328、0.330）。使用同一组五个冻结专家时，inverse-DR 加权在基准均衡分析中持续优于 winner-take-all、convex DR 拟合、R-stacking 与 causal Q-aggregation，但与等权及 DR ridge 收缩在统计上无法区分。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持"几何多样化专家库 + 无泄漏聚合"作为一种稳健性策略，而非 GeoACE 本身或某一加权规则的普遍优越性；即在平均表现上有改善，但尚缺乏统计显著的整体优势。

286432b2561f3b57e2d1b1adb93ee622c2cbb9f0.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
286432b2561f3b57e2d1b1adb93ee622c2cbb9f0.summary: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ExplorationBench，用规则可执行、与常识冲突的 AlienCode 与 AlienLogic 两个沙盒，将科学探索评估转化为可精确验证的基准，以区分“探索发现”与“预训练回忆”。评估 10 个 AI 系统发现，最强系统能习得并应用新规则，但轨迹间波动大，继续探索可能停滞或逆转已有收益。
AI.motivation: 科学发现始于已知问题终结之处，此时 AI 系统必须进行探索：提出假设、设计实验并基于结果迭代。但评估这种能力很困难：(1) 如何验证一个真正新的假设是否成立；(2) 如何判断系统是通过探索发现该假设，还是仅从预训练数据中回忆了相关知识。
AI.method: 提出 ExplorationBench：将科学探索评估这一“wicked problem”转化为具体、可处理的框架，构建于可验证的 Alien Worlds 之上。其规则可执行，因此答案可被精确检验；其规则与熟悉知识冲突，因此仅靠预训练回忆无法解题。基准包含两个沙盒：AlienCode（31 个发现目标，70 个任务）和 AlienLogic（24 个发现目标，70 个任务）。每个沙盒提供有缺陷的手册、任务特定的环境反馈以及专用工具调用 schema。系统利用这些资源探索沙盒，再解决留出任务。实验评估 10 个 AI 系统。
AI.result: 对 10 个 AI 系统的评估显示：最强系统能够习得并应用不熟悉的规则；但性能在不同轨迹间差异显著，持续探索可能停滞甚至逆转此前的收益。
AI.conclusion: ExplorationBench 是面向“AI 在未知环境中通过探索获取并应用全新知识”这一目标的基础性一步，为科学探索能力评估提供了可验证、可扩展的基准框架。

4055db440cb8cd54ddc54b735029e5a521d86587.title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
4055db440cb8cd54ddc54b735029e5a521d86587.summary: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. This reading rests on the assumption that scalar alignment scores reflect content-level cross-modal interaction. To test this assumption, we apply controlled interventions to the visual stream. Across 13 MLLMs from five families spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters, replacing projector-output visual tokens with Gaussian noise sharply reduces task accuracy, yet four standard scalar measures (CKA, SVCCA, MIR, and the leading principal-angle cosine) fail to consistently separate the corrupted stream from the original. We call this failure the alignment illusion and trace it to the shared language-model pathway: anisotropic MLP down-projections pull visual and text tokens toward common output directions, producing weight-induced alignment. Because this component is essentially one-dimensional, we introduce the principal-angle gap (PA gap), defined as the difference between the top two principal-angle cosines, which separates weight-induced similarity from multi-directional visual structure. Under graded visual corruption, the PA gap tracks task accuracy more consistently than the scalar scores we consider; under a structured but irrelevant image, it further exposes regimes in which internal geometry and task accuracy come apart. Internal visual-text alignment in MLLMs is therefore best read as a geometric diagnostic of the visual stream inside the language model rather than a direct proxy for content-level cross-modal interaction, and is most informative when calibrated by controlled task evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 MLLM 中常见的视觉-文本标量对齐分数可能产生“对齐幻觉”：即使视觉输入被高斯噪声破坏、任务准确率大幅下降，CKA、SVCCA、MIR 和主角度余弦等指标仍无法稳定区分损坏流。作者将其归因于语言模型 MLP down-projection 造成的权重诱导、近一维对齐，并提出 PA gap 作为更能反映多方向视觉结构的几何诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把 MLLM 中层间视觉-文本相似度解释为语言模型逐步将视觉内容整合进共享表示空间，但这一解读依赖一个未经验证的假设：标量对齐分数能够反映内容级跨模态交互。本文旨在检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 对视觉流进行受控干预：将 projector 输出的视觉 token 替换为高斯噪声，并在 13 个 MLLM、5 个模型家族、0.5B–72B 参数范围内测试 CKA、SVCCA、MIR 和 leading principal-angle cosine 等标量对齐指标。进一步提出 principal-angle gap（PA gap），定义为最高两个 principal-angle cosine 之差，以区分权重诱导的相似性与多方向视觉结构。
AI.result: 用高斯噪声替换视觉 token 会显著降低任务准确率，但四种标准标量指标无法一致地区分损坏视觉流与原始视觉流，作者称此为 alignment illusion。其根源在于共享语言模型路径：各向异性 MLP down-projection 将视觉与文本 token 拉向共同输出方向，形成权重诱导对齐，且该分量基本是一维的。PA gap 能分离这种权重诱导相似性与多方向视觉结构；在渐进视觉损坏下，PA gap 比标量分数更一致地跟踪任务准确率；在结构化但无关图像下，还能揭示内部几何与任务准确率分离的情形。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 内部的视觉-文本对齐不应被直接等同于内容级跨模态交互，而应被理解为语言模型内部视觉流的几何诊断；只有在受控任务证据校准下，这类内部几何指标才具有充分解释力。

fd5c27455dcc6fb3013b60245c5d62f68e61b61b.title: Let Training Guide Selection: Online Synthetic Data Filtering via Real-Anchored Utility
fd5c27455dcc6fb3013b60245c5d62f68e61b61b.summary: Synthetic data can scale training supervision when real-world data are limited, but noise and distribution mismatch can reduce its value. Existing synthetic data selection methods often emphasize fidelity or diversity rather than the learner's evolving needs. We propose FROST, an online framework that estimates synthetic-data utility through gradient feedback anchored in real training data. It calibrates batch utility against recent history to determine when filtering is needed and filters samples only in out-of-band batches to determine what to retain, without an external verifier or held-out validation set. Experiments on two public benchmarks for image classification and LLM fine-tuning for text-to-SQL show that FROST filters out around 20--30% of the synthetic data while improving real-task performance compared with training on the full synthetic data pool. We further apply FROST during training in a large-scale industrial ads re-ranking system, achieving significant performance gains over a highly optimized production baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalizability.

AI.tldr: FROST 通过真实数据锚定的梯度反馈在线评估合成数据效用，仅在异常批次中过滤约 20%–30% 样本，无需外部验证器，在图像分类、文本到 SQL 微调及工业广告重排序中均优于全量合成数据训练。
AI.motivation: 合成数据可在真实数据有限时扩展监督信号，但噪声与分布不匹配会降低其价值。现有合成数据选择方法多强调保真度或多样性，而非学习者不断变化的需求。
AI.method: 提出 FROST 在线框架：以真实训练数据为锚点，通过梯度反馈估计合成数据的效用；将批次效用与近期历史进行校准，以判断何时需要过滤；仅对“超出正常波动范围”（out-of-band）的批次进行样本筛选，以决定保留哪些样本。整个流程不依赖外部验证器或留出验证集。
AI.result: 在图像分类与面向文本到 SQL 的 LLM 微调两个公开基准上，FROST 过滤掉约 20%–30% 的合成数据，同时相比使用完整合成数据池训练提升了真实任务性能。进一步将 FROST 应用于大规模工业广告重排序系统的训练中，在高度优化的生产基线上取得显著性能增益，表明其有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FROST 是一种无需外部验证器或留出验证集的在线合成数据筛选框架，能够依据学习者的实时需求动态选择合成样本，并在公开基准与大规模工业系统中验证了其有效性与泛化性。

2ff0ed31ffa3d2114295880bfd0cc93bbae1b9bd.title: A Living Benchmark for Information Retrieval from Electronic Health Records
2ff0ed31ffa3d2114295880bfd0cc93bbae1b9bd.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based clinical assistants are increasingly being integrated into electronic health record (EHR) systems, transforming how clinicians retrieve and synthesize information from patient records. Their safety and utility depend on rigorous evaluation, yet existing benchmarks are manually curated, costly to update, and rapidly become obsolete with evolving technological advancements. We present a scalable framework that automatically generates question--answer pairs from longitudinal EHR notes. Nineteen clinicians validate the benchmark generator, producing the Benchmark for Retrieving Information in EHRs (BRIE), a continuously maintainable evaluation dataset. Across nine LLMs and five inference strategies, state-of-the-art systems frequently omit clinically important information, particularly for questions requiring synthesis across multiple documents and encounters. Because the generator itself is validated, BRIE supports evaluations that static benchmarks cannot, including the generation of multiple answers that reflect variation in clinician reasoning for robust performance assessment and continuously refreshing benchmark content to guard against leakage. Our results demonstrate that scalable benchmark generation enables rigorous, up-to-date evaluation of clinical LLMs as they are deployed in rapidly evolving healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展框架，自动从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）笔记生成问答对，经19名临床医生验证，构建可持续维护的评测基准BRIE，用于严格评估临床大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的临床助手正被集成进电子健康记录系统，其安全性与实用性依赖严格评测。然而现有基准多为人工构建、更新成本高，且随技术快速迭代而迅速过时，难以满足持续评测需求。
AI.method: 设计可扩展框架，自动从纵向EHR笔记中生成问题-答案对；由19名临床医生对基准生成器进行验证，从而产出可持续维护的评测数据集BRIE。并在此基础上对9个大语言模型、5种推理策略进行评测。
AI.result: 评测显示，即使是当前最先进的系统也频繁遗漏临床重要信息，尤其在需要跨多份文档和多次就诊进行信息综合的问题上表现突出。由于生成器本身经过验证，BRIE还支持静态基准无法实现的评测，例如生成反映临床医生推理差异的多个答案，以及持续刷新基准内容以防止数据泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的基准生成能够为快速演变的医疗场景中部署的临床大语言模型提供严格且最新的评测，验证了自动生成基准在临床LLM评测中的可行性与价值。

c9c018847048fa1299abe6b0b6b8dc136a0b0c51.title: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
c9c018847048fa1299abe6b0b6b8dc136a0b0c51.summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty over both node and edge features. This extension enables the propagation of linear message-passing operations and the sound approximation of ReLU nonlinearities for GNN architectures, including graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism network with edge features (GINE) layers. We evaluate GNNV across three power system tasks, PF, OPF, and CFA, on the IEEE-24, IEEE-39, and IEEE-118 test cases, as well as two standard graph classification benchmarks, ENZYMES and PROTEINS. Our results show that GNNV provides tighter robustness guarantees than CORA on graph classification models with ReLU-based activations and, for the first time, delivers edge-aware robustness guarantees for GINE-based PF and OPF models under joint node and edge perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出GNNV，用GraphStar集将NNV扩展到图结构输入，支持GCN/GINE消息传递与ReLU的可靠验证，在电力系统PF/OPF/CFA及图分类任务上给出更紧的鲁棒性保证。
AI.motivation: GNN已成为电力系统快速、拓扑感知代理模型的重要方法，广泛用于潮流分析、最优潮流估计和连锁故障分析；但GNN模型的形式化验证仍具挑战，现有方法验证范围有限，尤其缺乏对节点与边特征联合不确定性的处理。
AI.method: 将神经网络验证（NNV）框架扩展至图结构输入，提出GraphStar集——Star集的推广，可刻画节点和边特征上的不确定性；据此推导线性消息传递操作的传播规则，并对ReLU非线性进行可靠过近似，覆盖GCN与GINE等GNN架构。
AI.result: 在IEEE-24、IEEE-39、IEEE-118测试系统上的PF、OPF、CFA三项电力系统任务，以及ENZYMES、PROTEINS两个图分类基准上评估GNNV。结果表明：对含ReLU激活的图分类模型，GNNV比CORA提供更紧的鲁棒性保证；并首次为基于GINE的PF与OPF模型在节点和边联合扰动下提供边感知鲁棒性保证。
AI.conclusion: GNNV可作为图结构GNN的通用验证框架，尤其适用于电力系统代理模型的鲁棒性认证，并为边特征不确定性下的验证提供了新能力。

db74478bcf61b537eca9fd761e0ac6051709f8c0.title: Residual Correlation as a Diagnostic for Joint-Uncertainty Gains from GP Coregionalisation
db74478bcf61b537eca9fd761e0ac6051709f8c0.summary:
In multi-target regression, correlated targets are often coupled through multi-output Gaussian processes with an intrinsic model of coregionalisation (GP-ICM), assuming that sharing statistical strength improves overall performance. In practice, the benefits are inconsistent. Across the settings studied, we find that the main benefit of coregionalisation is joint uncertainty quantification rather than point prediction. Raw target correlation does not predict when coupling helps; in the separable GP-ICM settings studied here, residual correlation, the cross-target dependence left unexplained by independent per-target predictors, is the strongest predictor of joint-uncertainty gains.
  We introduce a lightweight diagnostic, $D_{\rm logdet}=-\frac{1}{2}\log\det R_{\rm res}$, which represents the idealised joint negative log-likelihood (NLL) gain from modelling a full rather than diagonal residual covariance and is computable from independent GPs alone. Across a controlled synthetic study, 16 multi-target benchmarks, and frozen transformer and convolutional neural network representations for keypoint regression, point prediction remains largely unchanged ($ΔR^2\approx 0$). In contrast, $D_{\rm logdet}$ strongly predicts observed ICM NLL improvements ($ρ_s=-0.83$, $p<0.001$), outperforming heuristics such as the feature-to-sample ratio. We also propose Residual-ICM, which preserves independent marginal variances while adding residual-correlation structure to the joint covariance. Residual-ICM achieves the best average joint NLL among the compared methods, while the diagnostic indicates when covariance coupling is likely to be useful. The diagnostic is specific to global Gaussian residual dependence, the structure captured by separable coregionalisation.

AI.tldr: 论文指出多目标回归中GP-ICM的核心价值在于联合不确定性量化而非点预测，并提出轻量级诊断量D_logdet与Residual-ICM方法，用于判断残差协方差耦合何时有用。
AI.motivation: 在多目标回归中，相关目标常通过带内在核心区域化模型的多输出高斯过程（GP-ICM）耦合，假设共享统计强度能提升整体性能。然而实践中这种收益并不稳定，作者希望厘清核心区域化究竟在何种情形下真正带来好处，并找出能预测其收益的指标。
AI.method: 作者首先区分原始目标相关性与残差相关性（即独立逐目标预测器无法解释的跨目标依赖），发现后者才是联合不确定性收益的最强预测因子。据此提出轻量级诊断量 D_logdet = -1/2·log det R_res，表示用完整残差协方差替代对角协方差时的理想化联合负对数似然（NLL）增益，可仅由独立GP计算得到。进一步提出 Residual-ICM，在保持独立边缘方差的同时向联合协方差中引入残差相关结构。
AI.result: 在受控合成实验、16个多目标基准，以及用于关键点回归的冻结Transformer与卷积神经网络表征上，点预测基本不变（ΔR²≈0）。相比之下，D_logdet能强预测观测到的ICM NLL改进（ρ_s=-0.83，p<0.001），优于特征-样本比等启发式指标。Residual-ICM在所比较方法中取得最佳平均联合NLL。
AI.conclusion: 核心区域化的主要收益来自联合不确定性量化而非点预测，且原始目标相关性无法预测耦合是否有益，残差相关性才是关键。D_logdet可指示协方差耦合何时有用，但该诊断仅适用于可分离核心区域化所刻画的全局高斯残差依赖结构。

642b25e70b479ee7538d97c9258b92d2a60bb646.title: AT-SKM-Net: An Accelerated Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Framework for Linear Hard-Constraint Feasibility on Dynamic Graphs
642b25e70b479ee7538d97c9258b92d2a60bb646.summary: Graph-structured optimization with linear constraints is fundamental to critical infrastructure but faces scalability limits due to massive strict hard constraints and high dimensionality. While recent projection-based methods such as Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Net (T-SKM-Net) guarantee feasibility, they face high computational costs in dynamic environments by processing the entire constraint set and requiring expensive matrix factorizations. To bridge this gap, we propose the Accelerated Trainable-SKM (AT-SKM) Net framework. To concentrate computation on the active constraints and eliminate redundant calculations, we introduce a hybrid sampling strategy guided by a topology-aware heterogeneous GNN model. To efficiently handle topological shifts in graph-based constraints, we employ a Cholesky Update mechanism that theoretically reduces the equality projection complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2) under low-rank perturbations. Experiments on random geometric graphs, N-1 Security-Constrained DC-OPF, and minimum-cost gas transport problem demonstrate that AT-SKM reduces iteration counts by up to 85% and achieves 2.95x-7.29x SKM layer speedups, while maintaining zero constraint violations.

AI.tldr: 提出AT-SKM Net框架，用拓扑感知异质GNN引导混合采样并结合Cholesky更新，加速图结构线性约束优化中的可训练SKM投影，同时保持零约束违反。
AI.motivation: 图结构线性约束优化是关键基础设施中的基础问题，但大规模严格硬约束与高维性带来严重可扩展性瓶颈。现有T-SKM-Net等投影方法虽能保证可行性，却需处理全部约束并进行昂贵矩阵分解，在动态环境下计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出加速可训练SKM网络（AT-SKM）。核心包括：1）设计由拓扑感知异质GNN引导的混合采样策略，将计算集中于活跃约束并消除冗余计算；2）引入Cholesky更新机制以高效应对图约束的拓扑变化，理论上在低秩扰动下将等式投影复杂度从O(N^3)降至O(N^2)。
AI.result: 在随机几何图、N-1安全约束DC-OPF以及最小成本天然气运输问题上验证：AT-SKM将迭代次数最多减少85%，SKM层获得2.95倍至7.29倍加速，同时保持零约束违反。
AI.conclusion: AT-SKM通过活跃约束聚焦采样与低秩Cholesky更新，有效缓解了动态图结构线性约束优化中的计算瓶颈，在不牺牲可行性的前提下显著提升效率，为大规模基础设施优化提供了可行路径。

15bc071061fce251af43aa3e06050ebddeceda7a.title: On the SoS Certifiability of Log-Concave Distributions
15bc071061fce251af43aa3e06050ebddeceda7a.summary:
For an arbitrary isotropic log-concave distribution $P$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, we prove that the polynomial $(Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m - \mathbb{E}_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m$ is a sum of squares for every even $m\ge2$, where $C>0$ is a universal constant. This removes the dependence on the Poincaré constant in the theorem of Kothari and Steinhardt (arXiv:1711.07465), recovering the optimal moment bounds for log-concave distributions. As an immediate corollary, we obtain computationally efficient algorithms with dimension-free error guarantees for a wide range of high-dimensional statistical estimation problems.
  Our proof uses stochastic localization to decompose $P$ as an average of random strongly log-concave measures, whose centered moments admit the subgaussian certificates of Diakonikolas, Hopkins, Pensia, and Tiegel (STOC 2025; arXiv:2410.21194). With a covariance-adapted choice of localization, we show that a fourth-moment certificate derived from Letwin's variance inequality for quadratic forms (arXiv:2607.24164) suffices to control this averaging at every even degree.

AI.tldr: 该文证明：对任意各向同性对数凹分布 \(P\)，多项式 \((Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m-\mathbb E_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m\) 对任意偶数 \(m\ge2\) 都是平方和；由此移除 Kothari–Steinhardt 结果中对 Poincaré 常数的依赖，恢复对数凹分布的最优矩界，并给出高维统计估计中具有维度无关误差保证的高效算法。
AI.motivation: 先前关于对数凹分布矩界/平方和证书的结果依赖 Poincaré 常数，未能达到最优矩界，也限制了高维统计估计中维度无关误差保证。本文旨在消除该依赖，建立更优的矩证书并推广算法应用。
AI.method: 核心工具是随机局部化：将 \(P\) 分解为随机强对数凹测度的平均；这些强对数凹测度的中心矩具有 Diakonikolas–Hopkins–Pensia–Tiegel（STOC 2025）给出的次高斯证书。作者采用协方差自适应的局部化选择，并证明由 Letwin 关于二次型的方差不等式导出的四阶矩证书足以在每个偶数阶控制该平均过程。
AI.result: 证明了主定理：存在通用常数 \(C>0\)，使对任意偶数 \(m\ge2\)，\((Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m-\mathbb E_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m\) 为平方和。该结果移除了 Kothari–Steinhardt 定理中的 Poincaré 常数依赖，恢复了对数凹分布的最优矩界。作为直接推论，得到一类高维统计估计问题的计算高效算法，并具有维度无关误差保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过对数凹分布的随机局部化分解与协方差自适应四阶矩证书，建立了任意偶数阶的最优平方和矩不等式，从而统一改进了对数凹分布矩界及其高维统计估计应用。

fffdfbed2999d6a3f1519c907b5e5debd85e9962.title: Intrinsic-Extrinsic Coupling in Learning Dynamics
fffdfbed2999d6a3f1519c907b5e5debd85e9962.summary: A learner's current observations need not determine its response to further training. We formulate intrinsic-extrinsic coupling through the continuation-conditioned value of a constrained learning-state intervention, with observation-relative fibers describing present agreement. An executable finite-frame classifier-head write protects current logits while repairing specified historical margins under finite-precision acceptance checks. We distinguish local admissibility, continuation-conditioned intervention value, and complete-policy performance. A matched four-cell contrast identifies readout-specific non-additivity between the same intrinsic intervention and alternative external continuations. In a CLINC-derived class-incremental setting, replay changes the write's 32-update contribution from five correct predictions to zero. Nonzero interactions also occur under output distillation, with a RoBERTa backbone, and under optimizer-native SGDW dynamics. Under SGDW, correct-count interactions are negative in all three activated roots at 128 updates, showing that coupling need not imply positive synergy. The mathematical analysis distinguishes feasible local repairs and favorable terminal outputs from training-reachable repair regions. Separate coordination tests show that content controls match or exceed the development gain, while a five-root fresh-test comparison with Fiber present in every arm shows root-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial correct-count effects. On the secondary cross-entropy readout, guided allocation yields lower mean loss than standard replay in all five pairs. Together, these results make intrinsic-extrinsic coupling operational by connecting executable state geometry to continuation-conditioned value, matched interaction identification, and closed-loop coordination, while separating identified coupling from complete-policy performance.

AI.tldr: 本文将“内在—外在耦合”操作化：用受约束学习状态干预的延续条件价值来刻画“当前观察不必决定后续训练响应”，并通过可执行的有限帧分类器头写入、匹配四格交互识别与闭环协调实验，将可执行状态几何与延续条件价值联系起来，同时把已识别耦合与完整策略性能区分开。
AI.motivation: 学习者当前观察未必决定其对后续训练的响应；需要形式化内在干预与外部延续之间的耦合，并避免把局部可容许、延续条件干预价值和完整策略性能混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出以延续为条件的受约束学习状态干预价值，用观察相对纤维描述当前一致性；设计可执行的有限帧分类器头写入，在保护当前logits的同时修复指定历史间隔，并施加有限精度接受检验；通过匹配四格对比识别同一内在干预与不同外部延续之间的读出特定非可加性；结合数学分析区分可行局部修复、有利终端输出与训练可达修复区域，并开展协调测试。
AI.result: 在基于CLINC的类增量设定中，回放使该写入的32次更新贡献从5个正确预测变为0；输出蒸馏、RoBERTa骨干与优化器原生SGDW动态下也出现非零交互。SGDW下，128次更新时三个激活根的 correct-count 交互均为负，表明耦合不必然带来正向协同。内容控制可匹配或超过开发增益；含Fiber的五根新测试比较显示 correct-count 效应依根而异，而非普遍有益。在次要交叉熵读出上，引导分配在全部五对中平均损失低于标准回放。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果通过连接可执行状态几何、延续条件价值、匹配交互识别与闭环协调，使内在—外在耦合具备可操作性，并将已识别的耦合与完整策略性能明确分离。

3a0db6c737551e33cd07ce2f09db086aaf030a50.title: Beyond Compression: Training Latent Representations for Stable Long-Horizon Rollout in Neural Surrogate Solvers
3a0db6c737551e33cd07ce2f09db086aaf030a50.summary: Latent neural surrogate solvers, or latent dynamics models, accelerate simulations of time-dependent physical systems by evolving a compressed latent space rather than resolving full-resolution fields directly. In principle this reduces computational cost and simplifies learning, but in practice errors often accumulate rapidly during long autoregressive rollouts, limiting predictive utility. We show that this instability does not stem from the latent representation itself, but arises when it is trained solely for reconstruction, producing representations poorly suited to long-horizon forecasting. We systematically evaluate training-level interventions that align latent representations with long-horizon rollout: Koopman operator learning and Hamming noise injection during autoencoder training to improve compression, together with noise injection and multi-step rollout fine-tuning to improve dynamics. Interventions that improve long-horizon rollout stability often degrade conventional training metrics, including reconstruction and one-step prediction accuracy. Collectively, these interventions reduce long-rollout error by approximately 40\% and match or exceed the accuracy of full-resolution models on two physics benchmarks, while requiring 2 orders of magnitude fewer floating point operations and half the GPU memory. Applied to mesoscale crystal-plasticity simulations of high-cycle fatigue, the resulting surrogate achieves stable extrapolation over horizons orders of magnitude beyond those observed during training. More broadly, these results show that neural compression should be designed not merely to reduce dimensionality, but to restructure the solution space for stable dynamical evolution, a key requirement for reliable, efficient neural surrogates in scientific applications.

AI.tldr: 针对潜空间神经常微分/动力学代理模型在长自回归推演中误差快速累积的问题，作者指出不稳定并非源自潜表示本身，而是仅用重构目标训练出的潜空间不适配长时预测。通过 Koopman 算子学习、Hamming 噪声注入、噪声注入与多步 rollout 微调等训练干预，长推演误差降低约 40%，在两个物理基准上匹配或超越全分辨率模型，同时减少约两个数量级 FLOPs 和一半 GPU 内存，并在介观晶体塑性高周疲劳模拟中实现远超训练时域的外推。
AI.motivation: 潜空间神经代理求解器理论上可通过在压缩潜空间演化来降低计算成本并简化学习，但实际长自回归 rollout 中误差迅速累积，限制预测效用。作者希望厘清不稳定的来源，并说明问题不在于潜表示本身，而在于其训练目标与长时预测不匹配。
AI.method: 系统评估训练层面的干预：在自编码器训练中引入 Koopman 算子学习和 Hamming 噪声注入以改善压缩；在动力学学习中引入噪声注入和多步 rollout 微调以改善长期演化。比较重构、单步预测和长 rollout 误差，并与全分辨率模型在计算量和显存上对比；进一步应用于介观晶体塑性高周疲劳模拟。
AI.result: 改善长时 rollout 稳定性的干预常会降低重构和单步预测等常规指标；综合干预使长 rollout 误差降低约 40%，在两个物理基准上匹配或超越全分辨率模型，FLOPs 少两个数量级，GPU 内存减半；在晶体塑性高周疲劳模拟中，代理模型可稳定外推至训练时域数个数量级之外。
AI.conclusion: 神经压缩不应仅以降维为目标，而应重构解空间以支持稳定的动力学演化；这是构建可靠、高效科学神经代理模型的关键要求。

8965f7c0bb414ffaa7ee18c5eaf8f26e62d84251.title: Minimally Invasive Steering of Language Models
8965f7c0bb414ffaa7ee18c5eaf8f26e62d84251.summary: Pre-logit steering adapts a frozen language model to a test-time reward by adding vectors to its final hidden states. Unregularized reward optimization can substantially alter the output distribution and degrade generation quality. We propose Minimally Invasive Steering Vector Optimization (MISVO), which penalizes interventions using the local KL geometry of the induced token distribution. The resulting Fisher quadratic measures distributional sensitivity and admits an analytic gradient computed through matrix--vector products with the frozen language-model head. We derive an exact decomposition of the sequence-level KL gradient into an analytic Fisher term and a suffix score-function term. For a fixed generation horizon, we show that the suffix term is second order in the steering magnitude and that three Fisher surrogates agree with the full KL gradient to first order. MISVO uses the frozen-reference surrogate to optimize position-specific interventions without updating model parameters. Across preference and code-generation tasks on models with approximately 1B--14B parameters, MISVO achieves the highest mean reward in six of seven model--task settings, with diversity and coherence scores close to those of Best-of-N.

AI.tldr: MISVO 用局部 KL 几何/Fisher 二次型约束 pre-logit steering，推导序列级 KL 梯度的 Fisher 项与后缀 score-function 项，并据此优化位置特定干预；在 1B–14B 模型上多数设置取得最高平均奖励，同时保持接近 Best-of-N 的多样性与连贯性。
AI.motivation: Pre-logit steering 通过向冻结语言模型最终隐状态添加向量，使其适应测试时奖励。但无正则的奖励优化会显著改变输出分布并损害生成质量，因此需要一种对模型干预更小、能控制分布偏移的导向方法。
AI.method: 提出 MISVO：以诱导 token 分布的局部 KL 几何惩罚干预；构造 Fisher 二次型度量分布敏感性，并利用与冻结语言模型 head 的矩阵—向量乘积解析计算梯度。推导序列级 KL 梯度的精确分解，即解析 Fisher 项与后缀 score-function 项；证明在固定生成长度下后缀项关于导向幅度为二阶小量，且三种 Fisher 代理与完整 KL 梯度一阶一致。采用冻结参考代理优化位置特定干预，不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在约 1B–14B 参数模型的偏好任务与代码生成任务上，MISVO 在 7 个模型—任务设置中的 6 个取得最高平均奖励，且多样性、连贯性得分接近 Best-of-N。
AI.conclusion: MISVO 通过在奖励优化中显式约束分布偏移，实现了对冻结语言模型的高效、微创式测试时导向，在不更新模型参数的前提下兼顾奖励提升与生成质量。

7bd0f95dcea3b33f40761fd048ee7c164014055d.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
7bd0f95dcea3b33f40761fd048ee7c164014055d.summary: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出 PoEM 框架：给定新奖励函数时，不运行额外 RL，而是利用已在其他奖励上后训练好的模型来预测/近似目标 RL 策略。
AI.motivation: 基础模型的 RL 后训练计算开销大、过程不稳定，且每当奖励模型改变或需要组合多个奖励时都必须从头运行 RL，因此需要探索能否直接预测新奖励下的 RL 结果。
AI.method: 首先证明若新奖励可写为已有奖励的线性组合，则新策略在 log 空间中也表现为已有 log 策略的线性组合；进一步发现即使奖励之间非线性相关，不同奖励 RL 训练得到的 log 策略通常张成近似低秩子空间。基于此，仅利用奖励或基策略在样本上的输出即可估计组合权重，并据此设计算法：输入后训练模型与新奖励函数，近似目标 RL 策略，而无需执行任何额外 RL 训练。
AI.result: 在合成奖励与真实奖励上进行了实验验证，覆盖文本和图像两种模态。
AI.conclusion: RL 后训练结果在新奖励下可以被预测；PoEM 能在不重新运行 RL 的情况下近似目标策略，为降低 RL 后训练成本与提升可组合性提供了可行路径。

65a322d79ca8a1dc1b0581f3a6010a8f3089bcac.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
65a322d79ca8a1dc1b0581f3a6010a8f3089bcac.summary: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriSpeak——一个面向大音频语言模型（LALMs）的语音事实核查探针基准，包含 3,879 条口语声明，揭示出稳定的文本—语音模态差距，并表明检索需与显式推理结合才能有效验证口语声明。
AI.motivation: 在线虚假信息日益以语音形式出现（新闻片段、播客、访谈、政治演讲、社交媒体视频），因此需要能够直接从语音中验证声明的事实核查系统；同时需探究事实核查能力能否从文本迁移到语音，以及检索增强的 LALM 能否利用文本证据支持或反驳口语声明。
AI.method: 构建 VeriSpeak 探针基准：包含 3,879 条口语声明，覆盖时间、地理与关系类事实，真假标签均衡。基准设计用于检验文本到语音的迁移性，并评估检索增强 LALM 利用文本证据验证口语声明的能力；实验对比了纯检索、检索+显式推理以及 thinking-tuned LALM 等设置。
AI.result: 实验发现一致的文本—语音模态差距：能可靠验证书面声明的 LALM 在相同声明转为语音后常常失败；仅靠检索增益有限，模型常将检索到的证据与口语声明混为一谈；而检索结合显式推理可改善声明—证据对比，thinking-tuned LALM 达到 86.1% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语音虚假信息检测不仅需要语音理解能力，还需要对检索证据进行有依据（grounded）的推理。数据集已在 Hugging Face 公开。

3905ad42037148e2a0d02a5a29ef88828055960b.title: Temporal Gradient Inversion for Private Trajectory Reconstruction in Embodied Reinforcement Learning
3905ad42037148e2a0d02a5a29ef88828055960b.summary: Distributed learning in embodied reinforcement-learning agents offers a degree of privacy by retaining raw sensor data on-device and transmitting only policy gradients to the server. Yet temporal structure can amplify this leakage beyond single-frame attacks. We introduce Temporal Reconstruction Attack on Consecutive Encodings (TRACE), an amortized temporal gradient-inversion attack that autoregressively reconstructs the sequence of private observation-action trajectories from per-step policy-learning gradients. The attack exploits two structural signals ignored by prior single-frame methods: (i) cross-time correlation between successive embodied gradients, which we formalize via a conditional mutual-information bound, and (ii) closed-form action recovery from policy-head gradient structure, which we prove exact when standard entropy regularization is sufficiently small. On held-out embodied scenes, TRACE reaches $18.8$ dB PSNR with near-perfect action recovery at $3$-$4.5$ ms per reconstructed frame, dominating the learning-based baseline across all reconstruction metrics and exceeding optimization attacks while running orders of magnitude faster. Further evaluation demonstrates TRACE's broader applicability across recurrent, residual, and compact transformer victim architectures, multi-modal inputs, and larger discrete action spaces. Defense experiments suggest that protecting temporal gradient streams may require sequence-aware privacy mechanisms.

AI.tldr: TRACE：面向具身强化学习分布式训练的时序梯度反演攻击，利用连续梯度的跨时间相关性与策略头梯度的闭式动作恢复，自回归重建私有观测-动作轨迹。
AI.motivation: 分布式具身强化学习仅上传策略梯度、保留原始传感器数据，常被视为具备隐私保护；但已有单帧梯度反演攻击忽略了时序结构，连续策略学习梯度中的时间相关性可能显著放大隐私泄露。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Temporal Reconstruction Attack on Consecutive Encodings），一种摊销式时序梯度反演攻击：从每步策略学习梯度中自回归重建私有观测-动作轨迹。利用两个结构信号：(i) 连续具身梯度间的跨时间相关性，并以条件互信息上界形式化；(ii) 从策略头梯度结构中闭式恢复动作，并证明在标准熵正则足够小时该恢复是精确的。
AI.result: 在留出的具身场景中，TRACE达到18.8 dB PSNR，动作恢复近乎完美，每帧重建耗时3–4.5 ms；在所有重建指标上优于基于学习的基线，并超过优化攻击且速度快若干数量级。进一步评估表明其可推广至循环、残差和紧凑Transformer受害架构、多模态输入及更大的离散动作空间。
AI.conclusion: 防御实验表明，保护时序梯度流可能需要序列感知的隐私机制；仅依赖单帧或逐帧防护不足以应对TRACE类时序梯度反演攻击。

a90e37adca0616f23a7f1e6626231d38391e0c47.title: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Environments for Benchmarking and Training LLM Forecasting Agents
a90e37adca0616f23a7f1e6626231d38391e0c47.summary: We introduce Forecast-Dojo, a replayable environment for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents. It combines resolved prediction-market questions with dated news, allowing agents to research an event and revisit their predictions at successive historical dates. The same tasks and tools support repeated evaluation, collection of training interactions, and feedback from recorded outcomes without waiting for new events to resolve. Forecast-Dojo contains 1,568 Polymarket events, split by time into training and evaluation periods, and 18.8M dated news articles. In an evaluation of 12 models, research tools lower Brier score for all 12. Forecasts also improve as events unfold, with the largest gains at steps where more newly dated evidence is recorded. Every model still trails historical market forecasts in both Brier score and accuracy. A belief notebook carried between dates lowers research cost but does not consistently improve forecast quality. Beyond evaluation, Forecast-Dojo provides interaction trajectories and outcome feedback for agent learning, with supervised fine-tuning as a proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 提出 Forecast-Dojo：一个可回放、可重复评估与训练的 LLM 预测智能体基准环境，结合已结算的预测市场问题与带日期新闻，用于评估、轨迹采集与结果反馈训练。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 预测智能体评估依赖新事件结算，难以重复实验、持续获取监督信号，也难以系统比较研究工具、时间推进与历史市场基线。
AI.method: 构建回放式环境：将 1,568 个 Polymarket 已结算事件按时间划分为训练期与评估期，配套 18.8M 篇带日期新闻；智能体可在历史日期节点检索证据、更新预测，并在不同日期重复评估；同时记录交互轨迹与结果反馈，支持 SFT 概念验证。
AI.result: 评估 12 个模型：研究工具使全部 12 个模型的 Brier 分数下降；随事件推进预测改善，新增带日期证据更多的步骤增益最大；但所有模型在 Brier 分数与准确率上仍落后于历史市场预测；跨日期传递的 belief notebook 降低研究成本，但未稳定提升预测质量。
AI.conclusion: Forecast-Dojo 提供了可回放、可重复、带结果反馈的 LLM 预测智能体评估与训练平台；当前模型仍不及市场基线，研究工具与记忆机制各有收益但存在权衡，轨迹与结果反馈可用于智能体学习。

b2350cfe79b0f082204a92ffcf9bdfeae0f480cd.title: Graph, Loop, and Harness Engineering for Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering and Analytical Processing
b2350cfe79b0f082204a92ffcf9bdfeae0f480cd.summary: Large language model agents increasingly automate data workflows, but end-to-end cloud data engineering and analytical execution require reliable coordination across code, data, infrastructure, and runtime environments. We present two zero-trust frameworks. Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering generates, deploys, and verifies complete cloud data-engineering solutions from natural-language tasks, with completion conditioned on repository, deployment, runtime, and policy evidence. Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP combines governed Data Preparation with verified Online Analytical Processing (OLAP), permitting production promotion only after validation and evidence-bound approval, and releasing analytical answers only after Same-Snapshot Execution, Exact Result Equivalence, deterministic grounding, and reflection. Both frameworks share three abstractions: graph engineering for evidence-gated workflow structure, loop engineering for bounded recovery, and agent-harness engineering for zero-trust execution. We evaluate both frameworks under nominal execution, controlled failures, bounded recovery, and policy-constrained conditions, measuring verified completion, recovery, authorization enforcement, production promotion, and verified OLAP execution.

AI.tldr: 提出两个零信任智能体框架：Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering 与 Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP，用图工程、循环工程与智能体-挂具工程统一编排代码、数据、基础设施与运行时，并以证据门控实现可验证的端到端云数据工程与 OLAP 执行。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体虽在自动化数据工作流上进展迅速，但端到端云数据工程与分析执行需要跨代码、数据、基础设施和运行时环境的可靠协同；现有流程缺乏零信任验证、证据约束与受控恢复机制，难以保证完成、授权与生产晋升的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出两个零信任框架。其一，Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering 从自然语言任务生成、部署并验证完整云数据工程方案，完成条件依赖仓库、部署、运行时与策略证据。其二，Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP 将受治理的数据准备与可验证 OLAP 结合，仅在验证与证据绑定批准后允许生产晋升，并仅在满足同快照执行、精确结果等价、确定性 grounding 与反思后才释放分析答案。两者共享三类抽象：图工程（证据门控工作流结构）、循环工程（有界恢复）、智能体-挂具工程（零信任执行）。
AI.result: 在名义执行、受控故障、有界恢复与策略约束条件下对两个框架进行评估，测量指标包括验证完成、恢复能力、授权执行、生产晋升与可验证 OLAP 执行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以零信任与证据门控为核心，将智能体数据工程和 OLAP 分析统一到可验证执行范式中，为跨代码、数据、基础设施与运行时的云数据工作流提供可靠协同与生产级晋升保障。
